greek_text: του δε ιησου χριστου η γεννησις ουτως ην μνηστευθεισης γαρ της μητρος αυτου μαριας τω ιωσηφ πριν η συνελθειν αυτους ευρεθη εν γαστρι εχουσα εκ πνευματος αγιου

ukjv_translation: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was likewise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)

ukjv_translation: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

greek_text: εγω δε λεγω υμιν οτι πας ο βλεπων γυναικα προς το επιθυμησαι αυτης ηδη εμοιχευσεν αυτην εν τη καρδια αυτου
transliteration: egw de legw umin oti pav o blepwn gunaika prov to epiyumhsai authv hdh emoiceusen authn en th kardia autou
draft_translation: But I say to you, That whoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, That whosoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whosoever

greek_text: ει δε ο οφθαλμος σου ο δεξιος σκανδαλιζει σε εξελε αυτον και βαλε απο σου συμφερει γαρ σοι ινα αποληται εν των μελων σου και μη ολον το σωμα σου βληθη εις γεενναν
transliteration: ei de o ofyalmov sou o dexiov skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou sumferei gar soi ina apolhtai en twn melwn sou kai mh olon to swma sou blhyh eiv geennan
draft_translation: And if your right eye cause you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into Gehenna.
ukjv_translation: And if your right eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
review_notes: rendered geenna as Gehenna; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: και ει η δεξια σου χειρ σκανδαλιζει σε εκκοψον αυτην και βαλε απο σου συμφερει γαρ σοι ινα αποληται εν των μελων σου και μη ολον το σωμα σου βληθη εις γεενναν
transliteration: kai ei h dexia sou ceir skandalizei se ekkoqon authn kai bale apo sou sumferei gar soi ina apolhtai en twn melwn sou kai mh olon to swma sou blhyh eiv geennan
draft_translation: And if your right hand cause you to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into Gehenna.
ukjv_translation: And if your right hand offend you, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
review_notes: rendered geenna as Gehenna; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: ερρεθη δε οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου δοτω αυτη αποστασιον
transliteration: erreyh de oti ov an apolush thn gunaika autou dotw auth apostasion
draft_translation: It has been said, Whoever shall release his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
ukjv_translation: It has been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; modernized whosoever

greek_text: εγω δε λεγω υμιν οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου παρεκτος λογου πορνειας ποιει αυτην μοιχασθαι και ος εαν απολελυμενην γαμηση μοιχαται
transliteration: egw de legw umin oti ov an apolush thn gunaika autou parektov logou porneiav poiei authn moicasyai kai ov ean apolelumenhn gamhsh moicatai
draft_translation: But I say to you, That whoever shall release his wife, saving for the cause of sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery: and whoever shall marry her that is divorced commits adultery.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause (o. logos) of fornication, causes her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced commits adultery.
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized porneia wording; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παλιν ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη τοις αρχαιοις ουκ επιορκησεις αποδωσεις δε τω κυριω τους ορκους σου
transliteration: palin hkousate oti erreyh toiv arcaioiv ouk epiorkhseiv apodwseiv de tw kuriw touv orkouv sou
draft_translation: Again, you have heard that it has been said by them of old time, You shall not renounce swearing yourself, but shall perform to the Lord your oaths:
ukjv_translation: Again, all of you have heard that it has been said by them of old time, You shall not renounce swearing yourself, but shall perform unto the Lord yours oaths:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yours before noun; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εγω δε λεγω υμιν μη ομοσαι ολως μητε εν τω ουρανω οτι θρονος εστιν του θεου
transliteration: egw de legw umin mh omosai olwv mhte en tw ouranw oti yronov estin tou yeou
draft_translation: But I say to you, do not swear at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized swear-not idiom

greek_text: μητε εν τη γη οτι υποποδιον εστιν των ποδων αυτου μητε εις ιεροσολυμα οτι πολις εστιν του μεγαλου βασιλεως
transliteration: mhte en th gh oti upopodion estin twn podwn autou mhte eiv ierosoluma oti poliv estin tou megalou basilewv
draft_translation: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
ukjv_translation: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: μητε εν τη κεφαλη σου ομοσης οτι ου δυνασαι μιαν τριχα λευκην η μελαιναν ποιησαι
transliteration: mhte en th kefalh sou omoshv oti ou dunasai mian trica leukhn h melainan poihsai
draft_translation: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you cannot make one hair white or black.
ukjv_translation: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you can not make one hair white or black.

greek_text: εστω δε ο λογος υμων ναι ναι ου ου το δε περισσον τουτων εκ του πονηρου εστιν
transliteration: estw de o logov umwn nai nai ou ou to de perisson toutwn ek tou ponhrou estin
draft_translation: But let your word be, Yes, yes; No, no: for whatever is more than these comes of evil.
ukjv_translation: But let your communication (o. logos) be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.

greek_text: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη οφθαλμον αντι οφθαλμου και οδοντα αντι οδοντος
transliteration: hkousate oti erreyh ofyalmon anti ofyalmou kai odonta anti odontov
draft_translation: You have heard that it has been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
ukjv_translation: All of you have heard that it has been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

greek_text: εγω δε λεγω υμιν μη αντιστηναι τω πονηρω αλλ οστις σε ραπισει επι την δεξιαν σου σιαγονα στρεψον αυτω και την αλλην
transliteration: egw de legw umin mh antisthnai tw ponhrw all ostiv se rapisei epi thn dexian sou siagona streqon autw kai thn allhn
draft_translation: But I say to you, That you do not resist evil: but whoever shall strike you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, That all of you resist not evil: but whosoever shall strike you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized resist-not wording; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και τω θελοντι σοι κριθηναι και τον χιτωνα σου λαβειν αφες αυτω και το ιματιον
transliteration: kai tw yelonti soi kriyhnai kai ton citwna sou labein afev autw kai to imation
draft_translation: And if anyone will sue you at the law, and take away your tunic, let him have your cloak also.
ukjv_translation: And if any man will sue you at the law, and take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; rendered chiton as tunic

greek_text: και οστις σε αγγαρευσει μιλιον εν υπαγε μετ αυτου δυο
transliteration: kai ostiv se aggareusei milion en upage met autou duo
draft_translation: And whoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him two.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him two.

greek_text: τω αιτουντι σε διδου και τον θελοντα απο σου δανεισασθαι μη αποστραφης
transliteration: tw aitounti se didou kai ton yelonta apo sou daneisasyai mh apostrafhv
draft_translation: Give to him who asks you, and from him who would borrow of you do not turn away.
ukjv_translation: Give to him that asks you, and from him that would borrow of you turn not you away.

greek_text: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου και μισησεις τον εχθρον σου
transliteration: hkousate oti erreyh agaphseiv ton plhsion sou kai mishseiv ton ecyron sou
draft_translation: You have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbor, and hate your enemy.
ukjv_translation: All of you have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbour, and hate yours enemy.
review_notes: modernized neighbour spelling; modernized yours before noun; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εγω δε λεγω υμιν αγαπατε τους εχθρους υμων ευλογειτε τους καταρωμενους υμας καλως ποιειτε τους μισουντας υμας και προσευχεσθε υπερ των επηρεαζοντων υμας και διωκοντων υμας
transliteration: egw de legw umin agapate touv ecyrouv umwn eulogeite touv katarwmenouv umav kalwv poieite touv misountav umav kai proseucesye uper twn ephreazontwn umav kai diwkontwn umav
draft_translation: But I say to you, Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who despitefully use you, and persecute you;
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; modernized them-which relative

greek_text: οπως γενησθε υιοι του πατρος υμων του εν ουρανοις οτι τον ηλιον αυτου ανατελλει επι πονηρους και αγαθους και βρεχει επι δικαιους και αδικους
transliteration: opwv genhsye uioi tou patrov umwn tou en ouranoiv oti ton hlion autou anatellei epi ponhrouv kai agayouv kai brecei epi dikaiouv kai adikouv
draft_translation: That you may be the children of your Father who is in heaven: for he makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
ukjv_translation: That all of you may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εαν γαρ αγαπησητε τους αγαπωντας υμας τινα μισθον εχετε ουχι και οι τελωναι το αυτο ποιουσιν
transliteration: ean gar agaphshte touv agapwntav umav tina misyon ecete ouci kai oi telwnai to auto poiousin
draft_translation: For if you love those who love you, what reward have you? do not even the tax collectors the same?
ukjv_translation: For if all of you love them which love you, what reward have all of you? do not even the publicans the same?
review_notes: modernized them-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: και εαν ασπασησθε τους αδελφους υμων μονον τι περισσον ποιειτε ουχι και οι τελωναι ουτως ποιουσιν
transliteration: kai ean aspashsye touv adelfouv umwn monon ti perisson poieite ouci kai oi telwnai outwv poiousin
draft_translation: And if you salute your brothers only, what do you more than others? do not even the tax collectors so?
ukjv_translation: And if all of you salute your brethren only, what do all of you more than others? do not even the publicans so?
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: εσεσθε ουν υμεις τελειοι ωσπερ ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις τελειος εστιν
transliteration: esesye oun umeiv teleioi wsper o pathr umwn o en toiv ouranoiv teleiov estin
draft_translation: Therefore be perfect, even as your Father who is in heaven is perfect.
ukjv_translation: Be all of you therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
review_notes: modernized be-therefore order; modernized be-you imperative; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: προσεχετε την ελεημοσυνην υμων μη ποιειν εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων προς το θεαθηναι αυτοις ει δε μηγε μισθον ουκ εχετε παρα τω πατρι υμων τω εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: prosecete thn elehmosunhn umwn mh poiein emprosyen twn anyrwpwn prov to yeayhnai autoiv ei de mhge misyon ouk ecete para tw patri umwn tw en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: Take heed that you do not do your charitable giving before men, to be seen of them: otherwise you have no reward of your Father who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Take heed that all of you do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise all of you have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
review_notes: modernized alms wording; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οταν ουν ποιης ελεημοσυνην μη σαλπισης εμπροσθεν σου ωσπερ οι υποκριται ποιουσιν εν ταις συναγωγαις και εν ταις ρυμαις οπως δοξασθωσιν υπο των ανθρωπων αμην λεγω υμιν απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
transliteration: otan oun poihv elehmosunhn mh salpishv emprosyen sou wsper oi upokritai poiousin en taiv sunagwgaiv kai en taiv rumaiv opwv doxasywsin upo twn anyrwpwn amhn legw umin apecousin ton misyon autwn
draft_translation: Therefore when you do your alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Amen, I say to you, They have their reward.
ukjv_translation: Therefore when you do yours alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; modernized yours before noun; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: σου δε ποιουντος ελεημοσυνην μη γνωτω η αριστερα σου τι ποιει η δεξια σου
transliteration: sou de poiountov elehmosunhn mh gnwtw h aristera sou ti poiei h dexia sou
draft_translation: But when you do charitable giving, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:
ukjv_translation: But when you do alms, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:

greek_text: οπως η σου η ελεημοσυνη εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αυτος αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
transliteration: opwv h sou h elehmosunh en tw kruptw kai o pathr sou o blepwn en tw kruptw autov apodwsei soi en tw fanerw
draft_translation: That your alms may be in secret: and your Father who sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.
ukjv_translation: That yours alms may be in secret: and your Father which sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: και οταν προσευχη ουκ εση ωσπερ οι υποκριται οτι φιλουσιν εν ταις συναγωγαις και εν ταις γωνιαις των πλατειων εστωτες προσευχεσθαι οπως αν φανωσιν τοις ανθρωποις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
transliteration: kai otan proseuch ouk esh wsper oi upokritai oti filousin en taiv sunagwgaiv kai en taiv gwniaiv twn plateiwn estwtev proseucesyai opwv an fanwsin toiv anyrwpoiv amhn legw umin oti apecousin ton misyon autwn
draft_translation: And when you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Amen, I say to you, They have their reward.
ukjv_translation: And when you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: συ δε οταν προσευχη εισελθε εις το ταμιειον σου και κλεισας την θυραν σου προσευξαι τω πατρι σου τω εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
transliteration: su de otan proseuch eiselye eiv to tamieion sou kai kleisav thn yuran sou proseuxai tw patri sou tw en tw kruptw kai o pathr sou o blepwn en tw kruptw apodwsei soi en tw fanerw
draft_translation: But you, when you pray, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret shall reward you openly.
ukjv_translation: But you, when you pray, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret; and your Father which sees in secret shall reward you openly.

greek_text: προσευχομενοι δε μη βαττολογησητε ωσπερ οι εθνικοι δοκουσιν γαρ οτι εν τη πολυλογια αυτων εισακουσθησονται
transliteration: proseucomenoi de mh battologhshte wsper oi eynikoi dokousin gar oti en th polulogia autwn eisakousyhsontai
draft_translation: But when you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the nations do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
ukjv_translation: But when all of you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: μη ουν ομοιωθητε αυτοις οιδεν γαρ ο πατηρ υμων ων χρειαν εχετε προ του υμας αιτησαι αυτον
transliteration: mh oun omoiwyhte autoiv oiden gar o pathr umwn wn creian ecete pro tou umav aithsai auton
draft_translation: Do not therefore be like them: for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask him.
ukjv_translation: Be not all of you therefore like unto them: for your Father knows what things all of you have need of, before all of you ask him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized be-not-you imperative; modernized like-to wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουτως ουν προσευχεσθε υμεις πατερ ημων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αγιασθητω το ονομα σου
transliteration: outwv oun proseucesye umeiv pater hmwn o en toiv ouranoiv agiasyhtw to onoma sou
draft_translation: Therefore pray this way: Our Father who is in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
ukjv_translation: After this manner therefore pray all of you: Our Father which are in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
review_notes: fixed Father relative agreement; modernized personal which as who; modernized pray-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ελθετω η βασιλεια σου γενηθητω το θελημα σου ως εν ουρανω και επι της γης
transliteration: elyetw h basileia sou genhyhtw to yelhma sou wv en ouranw kai epi thv ghv
draft_translation: Your kingdom come, Your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Your kingdom come, Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

greek_text: τον αρτον ημων τον επιουσιον δος ημιν σημερον
transliteration: ton arton hmwn ton epiousion dov hmin shmeron
draft_translation: Give us this day our daily bread.
ukjv_translation: Give us this day our daily bread.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και αφες ημιν τα οφειληματα ημων ως και ημεις αφιεμεν τοις οφειλεταις ημων
transliteration: kai afev hmin ta ofeilhmata hmwn wv kai hmeiv afiemen toiv ofeiletaiv hmwn
draft_translation: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
ukjv_translation: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και μη εισενεγκης ημας εις πειρασμον αλλα ρυσαι ημας απο του πονηρου οτι σου εστιν η βασιλεια και η δυναμις και η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην
transliteration: kai mh eisenegkhv hmav eiv peirasmon alla rusai hmav apo tou ponhrou oti sou estin h basileia kai h dunamiv kai h doxa eiv touv aiwnav amhn
draft_translation: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
review_notes: fixed yours artifact; modernized forever spelling; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: εαν γαρ αφητε τοις ανθρωποις τα παραπτωματα αυτων αφησει και υμιν ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος
transliteration: ean gar afhte toiv anyrwpoiv ta paraptwmata autwn afhsei kai umin o pathr umwn o ouraniov
draft_translation: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
ukjv_translation: For if all of you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

greek_text: εαν δε μη αφητε τοις ανθρωποις τα παραπτωματα αυτων ουδε ο πατηρ υμων αφησει τα παραπτωματα υμων
transliteration: ean de mh afhte toiv anyrwpoiv ta paraptwmata autwn oude o pathr umwn afhsei ta paraptwmata umwn
draft_translation: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
review_notes: modernized forgive-not wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οταν δε νηστευητε μη γινεσθε ωσπερ οι υποκριται σκυθρωποι αφανιζουσιν γαρ τα προσωπα αυτων οπως φανωσιν τοις ανθρωποις νηστευοντες αμην λεγω υμιν οτι απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
transliteration: otan de nhsteuhte mh ginesye wsper oi upokritai skuyrwpoi afanizousin gar ta proswpa autwn opwv fanwsin toiv anyrwpoiv nhsteuontev amhn legw umin oti apecousin ton misyon autwn
draft_translation: Moreover when you fast, do not be, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men to fast. Amen, I say to you, They have their reward.
ukjv_translation: Moreover when all of you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized be-not imperative; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: συ δε νηστευων αλειψαι σου την κεφαλην και το προσωπον σου νιψαι
transliteration: su de nhsteuwn aleiqai sou thn kefalhn kai to proswpon sou niqai
draft_translation: But you, when you fast, anoint your head, and wash your face;
ukjv_translation: But you, when you fast, anoint yours head, and wash your face;

greek_text: οπως μη φανης τοις ανθρωποις νηστευων αλλα τω πατρι σου τω εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
transliteration: opwv mh fanhv toiv anyrwpoiv nhsteuwn alla tw patri sou tw en tw kruptw kai o pathr sou o blepwn en tw kruptw apodwsei soi en tw fanerw
draft_translation: That you appear not to men to fast, but to your Father who is in secret: and your Father, who sees in secret, shall reward you openly.
ukjv_translation: That you appear not unto men to fast, but unto your Father which is in secret: and your Father, which sees in secret, shall reward you openly.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: μη θησαυριζετε υμιν θησαυρους επι της γης οπου σης και βρωσις αφανιζει και οπου κλεπται διορυσσουσιν και κλεπτουσιν

transliteration: oudeiv dunatai dusi kurioiv douleuein h gar ton ena mishsei kai ton eteron agaphsei h enov anyexetai kai tou eterou katafronhsei ou dunasye yew douleuein kai mammwna

greek_text: δια τουτο λεγω υμιν μη μεριμνατε τη ψυχη υμων τι φαγητε και τι πιητε μηδε τω σωματι υμων τι ενδυσησθε ουχι η ψυχη πλειον εστιν της τροφης και το σωμα του ενδυματος

greek_text: εμβλεψατε εις τα πετεινα του ουρανου οτι ου σπειρουσιν ουδε θεριζουσιν ουδε συναγουσιν εις αποθηκας και ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος τρεφει αυτα ουχ υμεις μαλλον διαφερετε αυτων

draft_translation: Look the birds of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much better than they?
ukjv_translation: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are all of you not much better than they?

greek_text: τις δε εξ υμων μεριμνων δυναται προσθειναι επι την ηλικιαν αυτου πηχυν ενα

draft_translation: And why are you anxious for clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they do not toil, neither do they spin:

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ουδε σολομων εν παση τη δοξη αυτου περιεβαλετο ως εν τουτων
transliteration: legw de umin oti oude solomwn en pash th doxh autou periebaleto wv en toutwn
draft_translation: And yet I say to you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
ukjv_translation: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

greek_text: ει δε τον χορτον του αγρου σημερον οντα και αυριον εις κλιβανον βαλλομενον ο θεος ουτως αμφιεννυσιν ου πολλω μαλλον υμας ολιγοπιστοι
transliteration: ei de ton corton tou agrou shmeron onta kai aurion eiv klibanon ballomenon o yeov outwv amfiennusin ou pollw mallon umav oligopistoi
draft_translation: Therefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O all of you of little faith?
review_notes: modernized today spelling; modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη ουν μεριμνησητε λεγοντες τι φαγωμεν η τι πιωμεν η τι περιβαλωμεθα
transliteration: mh oun merimnhshte legontev ti fagwmen h ti piwmen h ti peribalwmeya
draft_translation: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, with what shall we be clothed?
ukjv_translation: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

greek_text: παντα γαρ ταυτα τα εθνη επιζητει οιδεν γαρ ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος οτι χρηζετε τουτων απαντων

greek_text: ζητειτε δε πρωτον την βασιλειαν του θεου και την δικαιοσυνην αυτου και ταυτα παντα προστεθησεται υμιν

draft_translation: Therefore do not be anxious for the next day: for the next day will be anxious for its own things. Sufficient to the day is the evil of it.

greek_text: τι δε βλεπεις το καρφος το εν τω οφθαλμω του αδελφου σου την δε εν τω σω οφθαλμω δοκον ου κατανοεις

review_notes: modernized behold; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: υποκριτα εκβαλε πρωτον την δοκον εκ του οφθαλμου σου και τοτε διαβλεψεις εκβαλειν το καρφος εκ του οφθαλμου του αδελφου σου
transliteration: upokrita ekbale prwton thn dokon ek tou ofyalmou sou kai tote diableqeiv ekbalein to karfov ek tou ofyalmou tou adelfou sou

ukjv_translation: You hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of yours own eye; and then shall you see clearly to cast out the splinter out of your brother's eye.

greek_text: μη δωτε το αγιον τοις κυσιν μηδε βαλητε τους μαργαριτας υμων εμπροσθεν των χοιρων μηποτε καταπατησωσιν αυτους εν τοις ποσιν αυτων και στραφεντες ρηξωσιν υμας

draft_translation: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you:

greek_text: εισελθετε δια της στενης πυλης οτι πλατεια η πυλη και ευρυχωρος η οδος η απαγουσα εις την απωλειαν και πολλοι εισιν οι εισερχομενοι δι αυτης

draft_translation: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
ukjv_translation: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

greek_text: απο των καρπων αυτων επιγνωσεσθε αυτους μητι συλλεγουσιν απο ακανθων σταφυλην η απο τριβολων συκα

draft_translation: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
ukjv_translation: All of you shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

greek_text: ουτως παν δενδρον αγαθον καρπους καλους ποιει το δε σαπρον δενδρον καρπους πονηρους ποιει

draft_translation: Even so every good tree produces good fruit; but a corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
ukjv_translation: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.

greek_text: ου δυναται δενδρον αγαθον καρπους πονηρους ποιειν ουδε δενδρον σαπρον καρπους καλους ποιειν
transliteration: ou dunatai dendron agayon karpouv ponhrouv poiein oude dendron sapron karpouv kalouv poiein
draft_translation: A good tree cannot bear evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bear good fruit.
ukjv_translation: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

draft_translation: Every tree that does not bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

greek_text: αραγε απο των καρπων αυτων επιγνωσεσθε αυτους
transliteration: arage apo twn karpwn autwn epignwsesye autouv
draft_translation: Therefore by their fruits you shall know them.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore by their fruits all of you shall know them.

greek_text: ου πας ο λεγων μοι κυριε κυριε εισελευσεται εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων αλλ ο ποιων το θελημα του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
transliteration: ou pav o legwn moi kurie kurie eiseleusetai eiv thn basileian twn ouranwn all o poiwn to yelhma tou patrov mou tou en ouranoiv
draft_translation: Not every one that says to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

transliteration: polloi erousin moi en ekeinh th hmera kurie kurie ou tw sw onomati proefhteusamen kai tw sw onomati daimonia exebalomen kai tw sw onomati dunameiv pollav epoihsamen

review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και τοτε ομολογησω αυτοις οτι ουδεποτε εγνων υμας αποχωρειτε απ εμου οι εργαζομενοι την ανομιαν

draft_translation: And then will I profess to them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity.
ukjv_translation: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, all of you that work iniquity.

greek_text: πας ουν οστις ακουει μου τους λογους τουτους και ποιει αυτους ομοιωσω αυτον ανδρι φρονιμω οστις ωκοδομησεν την οικιαν αυτου επι την πετραν

ukjv_translation: Therefore whosoever hears these sayings (o. logos) of mine, and does them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

ukjv_translation: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

ukjv_translation: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

greek_text: και ιδου προσεφερον αυτω παραλυτικον επι κλινης βεβλημενον και ιδων ο ιησους την πιστιν αυτων ειπεν τω παραλυτικω θαρσει τεκνον αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου
transliteration: kai idou proseferon autw paralutikon epi klinhv beblhmenon kai idwn o ihsouv thn pistin autwn eipen tw paralutikw yarsei teknon afewntai soi ai amartiai sou
draft_translation: And, look, they brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said to the paralyzed man, Son, take courage; your sins are forgiven you.
ukjv_translation: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; your sins be forgiven you.

greek_text: και ιδου τινες των γραμματεων ειπον εν εαυτοις ουτος βλασφημει
transliteration: kai idou tinev twn grammatewn eipon en eautoiv outov blasfhmei
draft_translation: And, look, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemes.
ukjv_translation: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemes.

greek_text: και ιδων ο ιησους τας ενθυμησεις αυτων ειπεν ινα τι υμεις ενθυμεισθε πονηρα εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
transliteration: kai idwn o ihsouv tav enyumhseiv autwn eipen ina ti umeiv enyumeisye ponhra en taiv kardiaiv umwn
draft_translation: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Why do you think evil in your hearts?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think all of you evil in your hearts?
review_notes: modernized inverted question; modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τι γαρ εστιν ευκοπωτερον ειπειν αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι η ειπειν εγειραι και περιπατει
transliteration: ti gar estin eukopwteron eipein afewntai soi ai amartiai h eipein egeirai kai peripatei
draft_translation: For whether is easier, to say, your sins are forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and walk?
ukjv_translation: For whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and walk?

greek_text: ινα δε ειδητε οτι εξουσιαν εχει ο υιος του ανθρωπου επι της γης αφιεναι αμαρτιας τοτε λεγει τω παραλυτικω εγερθεις αρον σου την κλινην και υπαγε εις τον οικον σου
transliteration: ina de eidhte oti exousian ecei o uiov tou anyrwpou epi thv ghv afienai amartiav tote legei tw paralutikw egeryeiv aron sou thn klinhn kai upage eiv ton oikon sou
draft_translation: But that you may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick with paralysis,) Arise, take up your bed, and go to your house.
ukjv_translation: But that all of you may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto yours house.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized palsy; modernized sick-of wording; modernized yours before noun; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εγερθεις απηλθεν εις τον οικον αυτου
transliteration: kai egeryeiv aphlyen eiv ton oikon autou
draft_translation: And he arose, and departed to his house.
ukjv_translation: And he arose, and departed to his house.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ιδοντες δε οι οχλοι εθαυμασαν και εδοξασαν τον θεον τον δοντα εξουσιαν τοιαυτην τοις ανθρωποις
transliteration: idontev de oi ocloi eyaumasan kai edoxasan ton yeon ton donta exousian toiauthn toiv anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: But when the crowds saw it, they marveled, and glorified God, who had given such power to men.
ukjv_translation: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized marvelled spelling; modernized personal which as who; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: και παραγων ο ιησους εκειθεν ειδεν ανθρωπον καθημενον επι το τελωνιον ματθαιον λεγομενον και λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι και αναστας ηκολουθησεν αυτω
transliteration: kai paragwn o ihsouv ekeiyen eiden anyrwpon kayhmenon epi to telwnion matyaion legomenon kai legei autw akolouyei moi kai anastav hkolouyhsen autw
draft_translation: And as Jesus passed forth from there, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the tax booth: and he says to him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
ukjv_translation: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he says unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized from-thence idiom; modernized tax-booth idiom

greek_text: και εγενετο αυτου ανακειμενου εν τη οικια και ιδου πολλοι τελωναι και αμαρτωλοι ελθοντες συνανεκειντο τω ιησου και τοις μαθηταις αυτου
transliteration: kai egeneto autou anakeimenou en th oikia kai idou polloi telwnai kai amartwloi elyontev sunanekeinto tw ihsou kai toiv mayhtaiv autou
draft_translation: And it happened, as Jesus reclined at table in the house, look, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at food in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
review_notes: modernized behold; modernized came-to-pass idiom; modernized reclining-at-meal idiom; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: και ιδοντες οι φαρισαιοι ειπον τοις μαθηταις αυτου δια τι μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων εσθιει ο διδασκαλος υμων
transliteration: kai idontev oi farisaioi eipon toiv mayhtaiv autou dia ti meta twn telwnwn kai amartwlwn esyiei o didaskalov umwn
draft_translation: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why eats your Teacher with tax collectors and sinners?
ukjv_translation: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eats your Master with publicans and sinners?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered didaskalos as teacher; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ακουσας ειπεν αυτοις ου χρειαν εχουσιν οι ισχυοντες ιατρου αλλ οι κακως εχοντες
transliteration: o de ihsouv akousav eipen autoiv ou creian ecousin oi iscuontev iatrou all oi kakwv econtev
draft_translation: But when Jesus heard that, he said to them, those who are whole need not a physician, but those who are sick.
ukjv_translation: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized residual be wording; modernized they-that relative

greek_text: πορευθεντες δε μαθετε τι εστιν ελεον θελω και ου θυσιαν ου γαρ ηλθον καλεσαι δικαιους αλλ αμαρτωλους εις μετανοιαν
transliteration: poreuyentev de mayete ti estin eleon yelw kai ou yusian ou gar hlyon kalesai dikaiouv all amartwlouv eiv metanoian
draft_translation: But go and learn what that means, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
ukjv_translation: But go all of you and learn what that means, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
review_notes: modernized go-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τοτε προσερχονται αυτω οι μαθηται ιωαννου λεγοντες δια τι ημεις και οι φαρισαιοι νηστευομεν πολλα οι δε μαθηται σου ου νηστευουσιν
transliteration: tote prosercontai autw oi mayhtai iwannou legontev dia ti hmeiv kai oi farisaioi nhsteuomen polla oi de mayhtai sou ou nhsteuousin
draft_translation: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples do not fast?
ukjv_translation: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples fast not?

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μη δυνανται οι υιοι του νυμφωνος πενθειν εφ οσον μετ αυτων εστιν ο νυμφιος ελευσονται δε ημεραι οταν απαρθη απ αυτων ο νυμφιος και τοτε νηστευσουσιν
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv o ihsouv mh dunantai oi uioi tou numfwnov penyein ef oson met autwn estin o numfiov eleusontai de hmerai otan aparyh ap autwn o numfiov kai tote nhsteusousin
draft_translation: And Jesus said to them, Can the children of the bride-chamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bride-chamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

greek_text: ουδεις δε επιβαλλει επιβλημα ρακους αγναφου επι ιματιω παλαιω αιρει γαρ το πληρωμα αυτου απο του ιματιου και χειρον σχισμα γινεται
transliteration: oudeiv de epiballei epiblhma rakouv agnafou epi imatiw palaiw airei gar to plhrwma autou apo tou imatiou kai ceiron scisma ginetai
draft_translation: No one puts a piece of new cloth to an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the clothing, and the rent is made worse.
ukjv_translation: No man puts a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
review_notes: cleaned old-garment wording; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized garment where not contextually technical; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: ουδε βαλλουσιν οινον νεον εις ασκους παλαιους ει δε μηγε ρηγνυνται οι ασκοι και ο οινος εκχειται και οι ασκοι απολουνται αλλα βαλλουσιν οινον νεον εις ασκους καινους και αμφοτερα συντηρουνται
transliteration: oude ballousin oinon neon eiv askouv palaiouv ei de mhge rhgnuntai oi askoi kai o oinov ekceitai kai oi askoi apolountai alla ballousin oinon neon eiv askouv kainouv kai amfotera sunthrountai
draft_translation: Neither do men put new wine into old wineskins: else the wineskins break, and the wine runs out, and the wineskins perish: but they put new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
ukjv_translation: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

greek_text: ταυτα αυτου λαλουντος αυτοις ιδου αρχων εις ελθων προσεκυνει αυτω λεγων οτι η θυγατηρ μου αρτι ετελευτησεν αλλα ελθων επιθες την χειρα σου επ αυτην και ζησεται
transliteration: tauta autou lalountov autoiv idou arcwn eiv elywn prosekunei autw legwn oti h yugathr mou arti eteleuthsen alla elywn epiyev thn ceira sou ep authn kai zhsetai
draft_translation: While he spoke these things to them, look, there came a certain ruler, and worshiped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.
ukjv_translation: While he spoke these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; modernized worshipped spelling

greek_text: και εγερθεις ο ιησους ηκολουθησεν αυτω και οι μαθηται αυτου
transliteration: kai egeryeiv o ihsouv hkolouyhsen autw kai oi mayhtai autou
draft_translation: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ιδου γυνη αιμορροουσα δωδεκα ετη προσελθουσα οπισθεν ηψατο του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου
transliteration: kai idou gunh aimorroousa dwdeka eth proselyousa opisyen hqato tou kraspedou tou imatiou autou
draft_translation: And, look, a woman, having an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his clothing:
ukjv_translation: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

greek_text: ελεγεν γαρ εν εαυτη εαν μονον αψωμαι του ιματιου αυτου σωθησομαι
transliteration: elegen gar en eauth ean monon aqwmai tou imatiou autou swyhsomai
draft_translation: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his clothing, I shall be whole.
ukjv_translation: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
review_notes: modernized garment where not contextually technical

greek_text: ο δε ιησους επιστραφεις και ιδων αυτην ειπεν θαρσει θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε και εσωθη η γυνη απο της ωρας εκεινης
transliteration: o de ihsouv epistrafeiv kai idwn authn eipen yarsei yugater h pistiv sou seswken se kai eswyh h gunh apo thv wrav ekeinhv
draft_translation: But Jesus turned about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
ukjv_translation: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

greek_text: και ελθων ο ιησους εις την οικιαν του αρχοντος και ιδων τους αυλητας και τον οχλον θορυβουμενον
transliteration: kai elywn o ihsouv eiv thn oikian tou arcontov kai idwn touv aulhtav kai ton oclon yoruboumenon
draft_translation: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute players and the people making a noise,
ukjv_translation: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

greek_text: λεγει αυτοις αναχωρειτε ου γαρ απεθανεν το κορασιον αλλα καθευδει και κατεγελων αυτου
transliteration: legei autoiv anacwreite ou gar apeyanen to korasion alla kayeudei kai kategelwn autou
draft_translation: He said to them, Give place: for the girl is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.
ukjv_translation: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized maid

greek_text: οτε δε εξεβληθη ο οχλος εισελθων εκρατησεν της χειρος αυτης και ηγερθη το κορασιον
transliteration: ote de exeblhyh o oclov eiselywn ekrathsen thv ceirov authv kai hgeryh to korasion
draft_translation: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
ukjv_translation: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

greek_text: και εξηλθεν η φημη αυτη εις ολην την γην εκεινην
transliteration: kai exhlyen h fhmh auth eiv olhn thn ghn ekeinhn
draft_translation: And the report of this went out into all that land.
ukjv_translation: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

greek_text: και παραγοντι εκειθεν τω ιησου ηκολουθησαν αυτω δυο τυφλοι κραζοντες και λεγοντες ελεησον ημας υιε δαβιδ
transliteration: kai paragonti ekeiyen tw ihsou hkolouyhsan autw duo tufloi krazontev kai legontev elehson hmav uie dabid
draft_translation: And when Jesus departed from there, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, You son of David, have mercy on us.
ukjv_translation: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, You son of David, have mercy on us.

greek_text: ελθοντι δε εις την οικιαν προσηλθον αυτω οι τυφλοι και λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους πιστευετε οτι δυναμαι τουτο ποιησαι λεγουσιν αυτω ναι κυριε
transliteration: elyonti de eiv thn oikian proshlyon autw oi tufloi kai legei autoiv o ihsouv pisteuete oti dunamai touto poihsai legousin autw nai kurie
draft_translation: And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus says to them, Believe you that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, Lord.
ukjv_translation: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus says unto them, Believe all of you that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized was-come perfect; modernized yea; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τοτε ηψατο των οφθαλμων αυτων λεγων κατα την πιστιν υμων γενηθητω υμιν
transliteration: tote hqato twn ofyalmwn autwn legwn kata thn pistin umwn genhyhtw umin
draft_translation: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it to you.
ukjv_translation: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

greek_text: και ανεωχθησαν αυτων οι οφθαλμοι και ενεβριμησατο αυτοις ο ιησους λεγων ορατε μηδεις γινωσκετω
transliteration: kai anewcyhsan autwn oi ofyalmoi kai enebrimhsato autoiv o ihsouv legwn orate mhdeiv ginwsketw
draft_translation: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See that no one knows it.
ukjv_translation: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

greek_text: οι δε εξελθοντες διεφημισαν αυτον εν ολη τη γη εκεινη
transliteration: oi de exelyontev diefhmisan auton en olh th gh ekeinh
draft_translation: But they, when they were departed, spread widely his fame in all that country.
ukjv_translation: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

greek_text: αυτων δε εξερχομενων ιδου προσηνεγκαν αυτω ανθρωπον κωφον δαιμονιζομενον
transliteration: autwn de exercomenwn idou proshnegkan autw anyrwpon kwfon daimonizomenon
draft_translation: As they went out, look, they brought to him a mute man possessed with a demon.
ukjv_translation: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
review_notes: modernized behold; rendered daimonion as demon; rendered kophos as mute

greek_text: και εκβληθεντος του δαιμονιου ελαλησεν ο κωφος και εθαυμασαν οι οχλοι λεγοντες ουδεποτε εφανη ουτως εν τω ισραηλ
transliteration: kai ekblhyentov tou daimoniou elalhsen o kwfov kai eyaumasan oi ocloi legontev oudepote efanh outwv en tw israhl
draft_translation: And when the demon was cast out, the mute spoke: and the crowds marveled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
ukjv_translation: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spoke: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
review_notes: modernized marvelled spelling; rendered daimonion as demon; rendered kophos as mute; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: οι δε φαρισαιοι ελεγον εν τω αρχοντι των δαιμονιων εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια
transliteration: oi de farisaioi elegon en tw arconti twn daimoniwn ekballei ta daimonia
draft_translation: But the Pharisees said, He casts out demons through the prince of the demons.
ukjv_translation: But the Pharisees said, He casts out devils through the prince of the devils.

greek_text: και περιηγεν ο ιησους τας πολεις πασας και τας κωμας διδασκων εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων και κηρυσσων το ευαγγελιον της βασιλειας και θεραπευων πασαν νοσον και πασαν μαλακιαν εν τω λαω
transliteration: kai perihgen o ihsouv tav poleiv pasav kai tav kwmav didaskwn en taiv sunagwgaiv autwn kai khrusswn to euaggelion thv basileiav kai yerapeuwn pasan noson kai pasan malakian en tw law
draft_translation: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the good news of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

greek_text: ιδων δε τους οχλους εσπλαγχνισθη περι αυτων οτι ησαν εκλελυμενοι και ερριμμενοι ωσει προβατα μη εχοντα ποιμενα
transliteration: idwn de touv oclouv esplagcnisyh peri autwn oti hsan eklelumenoi kai errimmenoi wsei probata mh econta poimena
draft_translation: But when he saw the crowds, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered, as sheep having no shepherd.
ukjv_translation: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
review_notes: modernized abroad idiom; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: τοτε λεγει τοις μαθηταις αυτου ο μεν θερισμος πολυς οι δε εργαται ολιγοι
transliteration: tote legei toiv mayhtaiv autou o men yerismov poluv oi de ergatai oligoi
draft_translation: Then he says to his disciples, The harvest truly is abundant, but the laborers are few;
ukjv_translation: Then says he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is abundant, but the labourers are few;

greek_text: δεηθητε ουν του κυριου του θερισμου οπως εκβαλη εργατας εις τον θερισμον αυτου
transliteration: dehyhte oun tou kuriou tou yerismou opwv ekbalh ergatav eiv ton yerismon autou
draft_translation: Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth laborers into his harvest.
ukjv_translation: Pray all of you therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; modernized pray-you imperative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος τους δωδεκα μαθητας αυτου εδωκεν αυτοις εξουσιαν πνευματων ακαθαρτων ωστε εκβαλλειν αυτα και θεραπευειν πασαν νοσον και πασαν μαλακιαν
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov touv dwdeka mayhtav autou edwken autoiv exousian pneumatwn akayartwn wste ekballein auta kai yerapeuein pasan noson kai pasan malakian
draft_translation: And when he had called to him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
ukjv_translation: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: των δε δωδεκα αποστολων τα ονοματα εστιν ταυτα πρωτος σιμων ο λεγομενος πετρος και ανδρεας ο αδελφος αυτου ιακωβος ο του ζεβεδαιου και ιωαννης ο αδελφος αυτου
transliteration: twn de dwdeka apostolwn ta onomata estin tauta prwtov simwn o legomenov petrov kai andreav o adelfov autou iakwbov o tou zebedaiou kai iwannhv o adelfov autou
draft_translation: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
ukjv_translation: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: φιλιππος και βαρθολομαιος θωμας και ματθαιος ο τελωνης ιακωβος ο του αλφαιου και λεββαιος ο επικληθεις θαδδαιος

draft_translation: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

greek_text: ασθενουντας θεραπευετε λεπρους καθαριζετε νεκρους εγειρετε δαιμονια εκβαλλετε δωρεαν ελαβετε δωρεαν δοτε

greek_text: μη πηραν εις οδον μηδε δυο χιτωνας μηδε υποδηματα μηδε ραβδους αξιος γαρ ο εργατης της τροφης αυτου εστιν
transliteration: mh phran eiv odon mhde duo citwnav mhde upodhmata mhde rabdouv axiov gar o ergathv thv trofhv autou estin

greek_text: εις ην δ αν πολιν η κωμην εισελθητε εξετασατε τις εν αυτη αξιος εστιν κακει μεινατε εως αν εξελθητε
transliteration: eiv hn d an polin h kwmhn eiselyhte exetasate tiv en auth axiov estin kakei meinate ewv an exelyhte
draft_translation: And into whatever city or town you shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till you go from there.

greek_text: εισερχομενοι δε εις την οικιαν ασπασασθε αυτην

review_notes: modernized article before h-word; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εαν μεν η η οικια αξια ελθετω η ειρηνη υμων επ αυτην εαν δε μη η αξια η ειρηνη υμων προς υμας επιστραφητω
transliteration: kai ean men h h oikia axia elyetw h eirhnh umwn ep authn ean de mh h axia h eirhnh umwn prov umav epistrafhtw
draft_translation: And if the house is worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.
ukjv_translation: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

greek_text: και ος εαν μη δεξηται υμας μηδε ακουση τους λογους υμων εξερχομενοι της οικιας η της πολεως εκεινης εκτιναξατε τον κονιορτον των ποδων υμων
transliteration: kai ov ean mh dexhtai umav mhde akoush touv logouv umwn exercomenoi thv oikiav h thv polewv ekeinhv ektinaxate ton koniorton twn podwn umwn
draft_translation: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, (o. logos) when all of you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
review_notes: modernized whosoever; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αμην λεγω υμιν ανεκτοτερον εσται γη σοδομων και γομορρων εν ημερα κρισεως η τη πολει εκεινη
transliteration: amhn legw umin anektoteron estai gh sodomwn kai gomorrwn en hmera krisewv h th polei ekeinh
draft_translation: Amen, I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
ukjv_translation: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: ιδου εγω αποστελλω υμας ως προβατα εν μεσω λυκων γινεσθε ουν φρονιμοι ως οι οφεις και ακεραιοι ως αι περιστεραι

draft_translation: Look, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: Be therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
ukjv_translation: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be all of you therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; modernized behold; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: προσεχετε δε απο των ανθρωπων παραδωσουσιν γαρ υμας εις συνεδρια και εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων μαστιγωσουσιν υμας
transliteration: prosecete de apo twn anyrwpwn paradwsousin gar umav eiv sunedria kai en taiv sunagwgaiv autwn mastigwsousin umav
draft_translation: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
ukjv_translation: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και επι ηγεμονας δε και βασιλεις αχθησεσθε ενεκεν εμου εις μαρτυριον αυτοις και τοις εθνεσιν
transliteration: kai epi hgemonav de kai basileiv acyhsesye eneken emou eiv marturion autoiv kai toiv eynesin
draft_translation: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the nations.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: οταν δε παραδιδωσιν υμας μη μεριμνησητε πως η τι λαλησητε δοθησεται γαρ υμιν εν εκεινη τη ωρα τι λαλησετε
transliteration: otan de paradidwsin umav mh merimnhshte pwv h ti lalhshte doyhsetai gar umin en ekeinh th wra ti lalhsete
draft_translation: But when they deliver you up, do not be anxious how or what you shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.
ukjv_translation: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what all of you shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what all of you shall speak.
review_notes: modernized take-no-thought idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ου γαρ υμεις εστε οι λαλουντες αλλα το πνευμα του πατρος υμων το λαλουν εν υμιν
transliteration: ou gar umeiv este oi lalountev alla to pneuma tou patrov umwn to laloun en umin
draft_translation: For it is not you that speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
ukjv_translation: For it is not all of you that speak, but the Spirit (o. pneuma) of your Father which speaks in you.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: παραδωσει δε αδελφος αδελφον εις θανατον και πατηρ τεκνον και επαναστησονται τεκνα επι γονεις και θανατωσουσιν αυτους
transliteration: paradwsei de adelfov adelfon eiv yanaton kai pathr teknon kai epanasthsontai tekna epi goneiv kai yanatwsousin autouv
draft_translation: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
ukjv_translation: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου ο δε υπομεινας εις τελος ουτος σωθησεται
transliteration: kai esesye misoumenoi upo pantwn dia to onoma mou o de upomeinav eiv telov outov swyhsetai
draft_translation: And you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but the one who endures to the end shall be saved.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endures to the end shall be saved.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οταν δε διωκωσιν υμας εν τη πολει ταυτη φευγετε εις την αλλην αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν ου μη τελεσητε τας πολεις του ισραηλ εως αν ελθη ο υιος του ανθρωπου
transliteration: otan de diwkwsin umav en th polei tauth feugete eiv thn allhn amhn gar legw umin ou mh teleshte tav poleiv tou israhl ewv an elyh o uiov tou anyrwpou
draft_translation: But when they persecute you in this city, flee you into another: for truly I say to you, You shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
ukjv_translation: But when they persecute you in this city, flee all of you into another: for verily I say unto you, All of you shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
review_notes: kept gar-linked amen formula as for truly; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: ουκ εστιν μαθητης υπερ τον διδασκαλον ουδε δουλος υπερ τον κυριον αυτου
transliteration: ouk estin mayhthv uper ton didaskalon oude doulov uper ton kurion autou
draft_translation: The disciple is not above his teacher, nor the slave above his Lord.
ukjv_translation: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered didaskalos as teacher; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: αρκετον τω μαθητη ινα γενηται ως ο διδασκαλος αυτου και ο δουλος ως ο κυριος αυτου ει τον οικοδεσποτην βεελζεβουβ εκαλεσαν ποσω μαλλον τους οικιακους αυτου
transliteration: arketon tw mayhth ina genhtai wv o didaskalov autou kai o doulov wv o kuriov autou ei ton oikodespothn beelzeboub ekalesan posw mallon touv oikiakouv autou
draft_translation: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his teacher, and the slave as his Lord. If they have called the teacher of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
ukjv_translation: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered didaskalos as teacher; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: μη ουν φοβηθητε αυτους ουδεν γαρ εστιν κεκαλυμμενον ο ουκ αποκαλυφθησεται και κρυπτον ο ου γνωσθησεται
transliteration: mh oun fobhyhte autouv ouden gar estin kekalummenon o ouk apokalufyhsetai kai krupton o ou gnwsyhsetai
draft_translation: Do not fear them therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
ukjv_translation: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

greek_text: ο λεγω υμιν εν τη σκοτια ειπατε εν τω φωτι και ο εις το ους ακουετε κηρυξατε επι των δωματων
transliteration: o legw umin en th skotia eipate en tw fwti kai o eiv to ouv akouete khruxate epi twn dwmatwn
draft_translation: What I tell you in darkness, speak in light: and what you hear in the ear, preach upon the housetops.
ukjv_translation: What I tell you in darkness, that speak all of you in light: and what all of you hear in the ear, that preach all of you upon the housetops.

greek_text: και μη φοβηθητε απο των αποκτεινοντων το σωμα την δε ψυχην μη δυναμενων αποκτειναι φοβηθητε δε μαλλον τον δυναμενον και ψυχην και σωμα απολεσαι εν γεεννη
transliteration: kai mh fobhyhte apo twn apokteinontwn to swma thn de quchn mh dunamenwn apokteinai fobhyhte de mallon ton dunamenon kai quchn kai swma apolesai en geennh
draft_translation: And do not fear those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
ukjv_translation: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
review_notes: modernized fear-not imperative; modernized him-which relative; modernized them-which relative; rendered geenna as Gehenna

greek_text: ουχι δυο στρουθια ασσαριου πωλειται και εν εξ αυτων ου πεσειται επι την γην ανευ του πατρος υμων
transliteration: ouci duo strouyia assariou pwleitai kai en ex autwn ou peseitai epi thn ghn aneu tou patrov umwn
draft_translation: Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
ukjv_translation: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

greek_text: υμων δε και αι τριχες της κεφαλης πασαι ηριθμημεναι εισιν
transliteration: umwn de kai ai tricev thv kefalhv pasai hriymhmenai eisin
draft_translation: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
ukjv_translation: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: μη ουν φοβηθητε πολλων στρουθιων διαφερετε υμεις
transliteration: mh oun fobhyhte pollwn strouyiwn diaferete umeiv
draft_translation: Do not fear therefore, you are of more value than many sparrows.
ukjv_translation: Fear all of you not therefore, all of you are of more value than many sparrows.
review_notes: modernized fear-not imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: πας ουν οστις ομολογησει εν εμοι εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων ομολογησω καγω εν αυτω εμπροσθεν του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
transliteration: pav oun ostiv omologhsei en emoi emprosyen twn anyrwpwn omologhsw kagw en autw emprosyen tou patrov mou tou en ouranoiv
draft_translation: Whoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; modernized whosoever

greek_text: οστις δ αν αρνησηται με εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων αρνησομαι αυτον καγω εμπροσθεν του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
transliteration: ostiv d an arnhshtai me emprosyen twn anyrwpwn arnhsomai auton kagw emprosyen tou patrov mou tou en ouranoiv
draft_translation: But whoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; modernized whosoever

greek_text: μη νομισητε οτι ηλθον βαλειν ειρηνην επι την γην ουκ ηλθον βαλειν ειρηνην αλλα μαχαιραν
transliteration: mh nomishte oti hlyon balein eirhnhn epi thn ghn ouk hlyon balein eirhnhn alla macairan
draft_translation: Do not think that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
ukjv_translation: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

greek_text: ηλθον γαρ διχασαι ανθρωπον κατα του πατρος αυτου και θυγατερα κατα της μητρος αυτης και νυμφην κατα της πενθερας αυτης
transliteration: hlyon gar dicasai anyrwpon kata tou patrov autou kai yugatera kata thv mhtrov authv kai numfhn kata thv penyerav authv
draft_translation: For I am come to set a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
ukjv_translation: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

greek_text: και εχθροι του ανθρωπου οι οικιακοι αυτου
transliteration: kai ecyroi tou anyrwpou oi oikiakoi autou
draft_translation: And a man's enemies shall be they of his own household.
ukjv_translation: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

greek_text: ο φιλων πατερα η μητερα υπερ εμε ουκ εστιν μου αξιος και ο φιλων υιον η θυγατερα υπερ εμε ουκ εστιν μου αξιος
transliteration: o filwn patera h mhtera uper eme ouk estin mou axiov kai o filwn uion h yugatera uper eme ouk estin mou axiov
draft_translation: the one who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and the one who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
ukjv_translation: He that loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

greek_text: και ος ου λαμβανει τον σταυρον αυτου και ακολουθει οπισω μου ουκ εστιν μου αξιος
transliteration: kai ov ou lambanei ton stauron autou kai akolouyei opisw mou ouk estin mou axiov
draft_translation: And the one who does not take his cross, and follows after me, is not worthy of me.
ukjv_translation: And he that takes not his cross, and follows after me, is not worthy of me.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized takes-not wording

greek_text: ο ευρων την ψυχην αυτου απολεσει αυτην και ο απολεσας την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου ευρησει αυτην
transliteration: o eurwn thn quchn autou apolesei authn kai o apolesav thn quchn autou eneken emou eurhsei authn
draft_translation: the one who finds his life shall lose it: and the one who loses his life for my sake shall find it.
ukjv_translation: He that finds his life shall lose it: and he that loses his life for my sake shall find it.

greek_text: ο δεχομενος υμας εμε δεχεται και ο εμε δεχομενος δεχεται τον αποστειλαντα με
transliteration: o decomenov umav eme decetai kai o eme decomenov decetai ton aposteilanta me
draft_translation: the one who receives you receives me, and the one who receives me receives him who sent me.
ukjv_translation: He that receives you receives me, and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized him-that relative

greek_text: ο δεχομενος προφητην εις ονομα προφητου μισθον προφητου ληψεται και ο δεχομενος δικαιον εις ονομα δικαιου μισθον δικαιου ληψεται
transliteration: o decomenov profhthn eiv onoma profhtou misyon profhtou lhqetai kai o decomenov dikaion eiv onoma dikaiou misyon dikaiou lhqetai
draft_translation: the one who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and the one who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
ukjv_translation: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

greek_text: και ος εαν ποτιση ενα των μικρων τουτων ποτηριον ψυχρου μονον εις ονομα μαθητου αμην λεγω υμιν ου μη απολεση τον μισθον αυτου
transliteration: kai ov ean potish ena twn mikrwn toutwn pothrion qucrou monon eiv onoma mayhtou amhn legw umin ou mh apolesh ton misyon autou
draft_translation: And whoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, Amen, I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
review_notes: aligned emphatic negation idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized no-wise idiom; modernized verily; modernized whosoever; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους διατασσων τοις δωδεκα μαθηταις αυτου μετεβη εκειθεν του διδασκειν και κηρυσσειν εν ταις πολεσιν αυτων
transliteration: kai egeneto ote etelesen o ihsouv diatasswn toiv dwdeka mayhtaiv autou metebh ekeiyen tou didaskein kai khrussein en taiv polesin autwn
draft_translation: And it happened, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and to preach in their cities.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

greek_text: ο δε ιωαννης ακουσας εν τω δεσμωτηριω τα εργα του χριστου πεμψας δυο των μαθητων αυτου
transliteration: o de iwannhv akousav en tw desmwthriw ta erga tou cristou pemqav duo twn mayhtwn autou
draft_translation: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
ukjv_translation: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειπεν αυτω συ ει ο ερχομενος η ετερον προσδοκωμεν
transliteration: eipen autw su ei o ercomenov h eteron prosdokwmen
draft_translation: And said to him, Are you the one who should come, or do we look for another?

ukjv_translation: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

greek_text: η πως δυναται τις εισελθειν εις την οικιαν του ισχυρου και τα σκευη αυτου διαρπασαι εαν μη πρωτον δηση τον ισχυρον και τοτε την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασει
transliteration: h pwv dunatai tiv eiselyein eiv thn oikian tou iscurou kai ta skeuh autou diarpasai ean mh prwton dhsh ton iscuron kai tote thn oikian autou diarpasei
draft_translation: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

draft_translation: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
ukjv_translation: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

greek_text: γεννηματα εχιδνων πως δυνασθε αγαθα λαλειν πονηροι οντες εκ γαρ του περισσευματος της καρδιας το στομα λαλει

ukjv_translation: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν οτι παν ρημα αργον ο εαν λαλησωσιν οι ανθρωποι αποδωσουσιν περι αυτου λογον εν ημερα κρισεως

ukjv_translation: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

ukjv_translation: Then he says, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he has come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.

draft_translation: Then one said to him, Look, your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to speak with you.
ukjv_translation: Then one said unto him, Behold, your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to speak with you.

draft_translation: But he answered and said to him who told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brothers?

draft_translation: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Look, my mother and my brothers!

review_notes: modernized personal which as who; modernized whosoever

draft_translation: The same day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.
ukjv_translation: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

draft_translation: And he spoke many things to them in parables, saying, Look, a sower went forth to sow;

draft_translation: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field; which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy of it goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
ukjv_translation: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy thereof goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

transliteration: ouc outov estin o tou tektonov uiov ouci h mhthr autou legetai mariam kai oi adelfoi autou iakwbov kai iwshv kai simwn kai ioudav

ukjv_translation: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

greek_text: και αι αδελφαι αυτου ουχι πασαι προς ημας εισιν ποθεν ουν τουτω ταυτα παντα

greek_text: και εσκανδαλιζοντο εν αυτω ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ουκ εστιν προφητης ατιμος ει μη εν τη πατριδι αυτου και εν τη οικια αυτου

draft_translation: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.

greek_text: και θελων αυτον αποκτειναι εφοβηθη τον οχλον οτι ως προφητην αυτον ειχον
