transliteration: o de ihsouv apokriyeiv eipen autoiv hliav men ercetai prwton kai apokatasthsei panta
draft_translation: And Jesus answered and said to them, Elijah truly shall first come, and restore all things.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elijah truly shall first come, and restore all things.

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ηλιας ηδη ηλθεν και ουκ επεγνωσαν αυτον αλλ εποιησαν εν αυτω οσα ηθελησαν ουτως και ο υιος του ανθρωπου μελλει πασχειν υπ αυτων
transliteration: legw de umin oti hliav hdh hlyen kai ouk epegnwsan auton all epoihsan en autw osa hyelhsan outwv kai o uiov tou anyrwpou mellei pascein up autwn
draft_translation: But I say to you, That Elijah has come already, and they did not know him, but have done to him whatever they wished. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer by them.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, That Elijah has come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

greek_text: τοτε συνηκαν οι μαθηται οτι περι ιωαννου του βαπτιστου ειπεν αυτοις
transliteration: tote sunhkan oi mayhtai oti peri iwannou tou baptistou eipen autoiv
draft_translation: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptist.
ukjv_translation: Then the disciples understood that he spoke unto them of John the Baptist.

greek_text: και ελθοντων αυτων προς τον οχλον προσηλθεν αυτω ανθρωπος γονυπετων αυτω
transliteration: kai elyontwn autwn prov ton oclon proshlyen autw anyrwpov gonupetwn autw
draft_translation: And when they had come to the crowd, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
ukjv_translation: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
review_notes: modernized were-come perfect; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: και λεγων κυριε ελεησον μου τον υιον οτι σεληνιαζεται και κακως πασχει πολλακις γαρ πιπτει εις το πυρ και πολλακις εις το υδωρ
transliteration: kai legwn kurie elehson mou ton uion oti selhniazetai kai kakwv pascei pollakiv gar piptei eiv to pur kai pollakiv eiv to udwr
draft_translation: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is moonstruck, and severely afflicted: for frequently he falls into the fire, and often into the water.
ukjv_translation: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatic, and sore vexed: for frequently he falls into the fire, and often into the water.
review_notes: literalized seleniazomai; modernized sore modifier; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και προσηνεγκα αυτον τοις μαθηταις σου και ουκ ηδυνηθησαν αυτον θεραπευσαι
transliteration: kai proshnegka auton toiv mayhtaiv sou kai ouk hdunhyhsan auton yerapeusai
draft_translation: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.
ukjv_translation: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν ω γενεα απιστος και διεστραμμενη εως ποτε εσομαι μεθ υμων εως ποτε ανεξομαι υμων φερετε μοι αυτον ωδε
transliteration: apokriyeiv de o ihsouv eipen w genea apistov kai diestrammenh ewv pote esomai mey umwn ewv pote anexomai umwn ferete moi auton wde
draft_translation: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him here to me.
ukjv_translation: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him here to me.

greek_text: και επετιμησεν αυτω ο ιησους και εξηλθεν απ αυτου το δαιμονιον και εθεραπευθη ο παις απο της ωρας εκεινης
transliteration: kai epetimhsen autw o ihsouv kai exhlyen ap autou to daimonion kai eyerapeuyh o paiv apo thv wrav ekeinhv
draft_translation: And Jesus rebuked the demon; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

greek_text: τοτε προσελθοντες οι μαθηται τω ιησου κατ ιδιαν ειπον δια τι ημεις ουκ ηδυνηθημεν εκβαλειν αυτο
transliteration: tote proselyontev oi mayhtai tw ihsou kat idian eipon dia ti hmeiv ouk hdunhyhmen ekbalein auto
draft_translation: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could we not cast him out?
ukjv_translation: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις δια την απιστιαν υμων αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν εαν εχητε πιστιν ως κοκκον σιναπεως ερειτε τω ορει τουτω μεταβηθι εντευθεν εκει και μεταβησεται και ουδεν αδυνατησει υμιν
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen autoiv dia thn apistian umwn amhn gar legw umin ean echte pistin wv kokkon sinapewv ereite tw orei toutw metabhyi enteuyen ekei kai metabhsetai kai ouden adunathsei umin
draft_translation: And Jesus said to them, Because of your unbelief: for truly I say to you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you shall say to this mountain, Remove behind to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible to you.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If all of you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, all of you shall say unto this mountain, Remove behind to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
review_notes: kept gar-linked amen formula as for truly; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: τουτο δε το γενος ουκ εκπορευεται ει μη εν προσευχη και νηστεια
transliteration: touto de to genov ouk ekporeuetai ei mh en proseuch kai nhsteia
draft_translation: Nevertheless this kind does not go out but by prayer and fasting.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless this kind goes not out but by prayer and fasting.

greek_text: αναστρεφομενων δε αυτων εν τη γαλιλαια ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μελλει ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοσθαι εις χειρας ανθρωπων
transliteration: anastrefomenwn de autwn en th galilaia eipen autoiv o ihsouv mellei o uiov tou anyrwpou paradidosyai eiv ceirav anyrwpwn
draft_translation: And while they remained in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
ukjv_translation: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
review_notes: modernized abode; modernized archaic directional unto

greek_text: και αποκτενουσιν αυτον και τη τριτη ημερα εγερθησεται και ελυπηθησαν σφοδρα
transliteration: kai apoktenousin auton kai th trith hmera egeryhsetai kai eluphyhsan sfodra
draft_translation: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceedingly sorry.
ukjv_translation: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

greek_text: ελθοντων δε αυτων εις καπερναουμ προσηλθον οι τα διδραχμα λαμβανοντες τω πετρω και ειπον ο διδασκαλος υμων ου τελει τα διδραχμα
transliteration: elyontwn de autwn eiv kapernaoum proshlyon oi ta didracma lambanontev tw petrw kai eipon o didaskalov umwn ou telei ta didracma
draft_translation: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Does not your teacher pay tribute?
ukjv_translation: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Does not your master pay tribute?
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; modernized were-come perfect; rendered didaskalos as teacher

greek_text: λεγει ναι και οτε εισηλθεν εις την οικιαν προεφθασεν αυτον ο ιησους λεγων τι σοι δοκει σιμων οι βασιλεις της γης απο τινων λαμβανουσιν τελη η κηνσον απο των υιων αυτων η απο των αλλοτριων
transliteration: legei nai kai ote eishlyen eiv thn oikian proefyasen auton o ihsouv legwn ti soi dokei simwn oi basileiv thv ghv apo tinwn lambanousin telh h khnson apo twn uiwn autwn h apo twn allotriwn
draft_translation: He says, Yes. And when he had come into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, What do you think, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
ukjv_translation: He says, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What think you, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
review_notes: modernized inverted question; modernized prevented-as-anticipated; modernized was-come perfect

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο πετρος απο των αλλοτριων εφη αυτω ο ιησους αραγε ελευθεροι εισιν οι υιοι
transliteration: legei autw o petrov apo twn allotriwn efh autw o ihsouv arage eleuyeroi eisin oi uioi
draft_translation: Peter says to him, Of strangers. Jesus says to him, Then the children are free.
ukjv_translation: Peter says unto him, Of strangers. Jesus says unto him, Then are the children free.

greek_text: ινα δε μη σκανδαλισωμεν αυτους πορευθεις εις την θαλασσαν βαλε αγκιστρον και τον αναβαντα πρωτον ιχθυν αρον και ανοιξας το στομα αυτου ευρησεις στατηρα εκεινον λαβων δος αυτοις αντι εμου και σου
transliteration: ina de mh skandaliswmen autouv poreuyeiv eiv thn yalassan bale agkistron kai ton anabanta prwton icyun aron kai anoixav to stoma autou eurhseiv stathra ekeinon labwn dov autoiv anti emou kai sou
draft_translation: Notwithstanding, lest we should cause them to stumble, go to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first comes up; and when you have opened his mouth, you shall find a piece of money: that take, and give to them for me and you.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go you to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first comes up; and when you have opened his mouth, you shall find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized article before h-word; modernized go-you imperative; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: εν εκεινη τη ωρα προσηλθον οι μαθηται τω ιησου λεγοντες τις αρα μειζων εστιν εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
transliteration: en ekeinh th wra proshlyon oi mayhtai tw ihsou legontev tiv ara meizwn estin en th basileia twn ouranwn
draft_translation: At the same time the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
ukjv_translation: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος ο ιησους παιδιον εστησεν αυτο εν μεσω αυτων
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov o ihsouv paidion esthsen auto en mesw autwn
draft_translation: And Jesus called a little child to him, and set him in the midst of them,
ukjv_translation: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

greek_text: και ειπεν αμην λεγω υμιν εαν μη στραφητε και γενησθε ως τα παιδια ου μη εισελθητε εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων
transliteration: kai eipen amhn legw umin ean mh strafhte kai genhsye wv ta paidia ou mh eiselyhte eiv thn basileian twn ouranwn
draft_translation: And said, Amen, I say to you, Except you be converted, and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
ukjv_translation: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except all of you be converted, and become as little children, all of you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: οστις ουν ταπεινωση εαυτον ως το παιδιον τουτο ουτος εστιν ο μειζων εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
transliteration: ostiv oun tapeinwsh eauton wv to paidion touto outov estin o meizwn en th basileia twn ouranwn
draft_translation: Whoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

greek_text: και ος εαν δεξηται παιδιον τοιουτον εν επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται
transliteration: kai ov ean dexhtai paidion toiouton en epi tw onomati mou eme decetai
draft_translation: And whoever shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.
ukjv_translation: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.

greek_text: ος δ αν σκανδαλιση ενα των μικρων τουτων των πιστευοντων εις εμε συμφερει αυτω ινα κρεμασθη μυλος ονικος επι τον τραχηλον αυτου και καταποντισθη εν τω πελαγει της θαλασσης
transliteration: ov d an skandalish ena twn mikrwn toutwn twn pisteuontwn eiv eme sumferei autw ina kremasyh mulov onikov epi ton trachlon autou kai katapontisyh en tw pelagei thv yalasshv
draft_translation: But whoever shall offend one of these little ones who believe in me, it would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
ukjv_translation: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
review_notes: fixed millstone relative artifact; modernized him-that relative; modernized personal which as who; modernized whoso

greek_text: ουαι τω κοσμω απο των σκανδαλων αναγκη γαρ εστιν ελθειν τα σκανδαλα πλην ουαι τω ανθρωπω εκεινω δι ου το σκανδαλον ερχεται
transliteration: ouai tw kosmw apo twn skandalwn anagkh gar estin elyein ta skandala plhn ouai tw anyrwpw ekeinw di ou to skandalon ercetai
draft_translation: Woe to the world because of offenses! for it must be that offenses come; but woe to that man by whom the stumbling block comes!
ukjv_translation: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must essentially be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!
review_notes: cleaned must-essentially source artifact; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized offence spelling; rendered skandalon as stumbling block

greek_text: ει δε η χειρ σου η ο πους σου σκανδαλιζει σε εκκοψον αυτα και βαλε απο σου καλον σοι εστιν εισελθειν εις την ζωην χωλον η κυλλον η δυο χειρας η δυο ποδας εχοντα βληθηναι εις το πυρ το αιωνιον
transliteration: ei de h ceir sou h o pouv sou skandalizei se ekkoqon auta kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin eiselyein eiv thn zwhn cwlon h kullon h duo ceirav h duo podav econta blhyhnai eiv to pur to aiwnion
draft_translation: Therefore if your hand or your foot cause you to stumble, cut them off, and cast them from you: it is better for you to enter into life halt or physically disabled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into eternal fire.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore if your hand or your foot offend you, cut them off, and cast them from you: it is better for you to enter into life halt or physically disabled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; rendered aionios as eternal; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: και ει ο οφθαλμος σου σκανδαλιζει σε εξελε αυτον και βαλε απο σου καλον σοι εστιν μονοφθαλμον εις την ζωην εισελθειν η δυο οφθαλμους εχοντα βληθηναι εις την γεενναν του πυρος
transliteration: kai ei o ofyalmov sou skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin monofyalmon eiv thn zwhn eiselyein h duo ofyalmouv econta blhyhnai eiv thn geennan tou purov
draft_translation: And if your eye cause you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into Gehenna of fire.
ukjv_translation: And if yours eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
review_notes: modernized yours before noun; rendered geenna as Gehenna; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: ορατε μη καταφρονησητε ενος των μικρων τουτων λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι οι αγγελοι αυτων εν ουρανοις δια παντος βλεπουσιν το προσωπον του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
transliteration: orate mh katafronhshte enov twn mikrwn toutwn legw gar umin oti oi aggeloi autwn en ouranoiv dia pantov blepousin to proswpon tou patrov mou tou en ouranoiv
draft_translation: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say to you, That in heaven their angels always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Take heed that all of you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

greek_text: ηλθεν γαρ ο υιος του ανθρωπου σωσαι το απολωλος
transliteration: hlyen gar o uiov tou anyrwpou swsai to apolwlov
draft_translation: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.
ukjv_translation: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τι υμιν δοκει εαν γενηται τινι ανθρωπω εκατον προβατα και πλανηθη εν εξ αυτων ουχι αφεις τα εννενηκονταεννεα επι τα ορη πορευθεις ζητει το πλανωμενον
transliteration: ti umin dokei ean genhtai tini anyrwpw ekaton probata kai planhyh en ex autwn ouci afeiv ta ennenhkontaennea epi ta orh poreuyeiv zhtei to planwmenon
draft_translation: What do you think? if a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them has gone astray, does he not leave the ninety-nine, and go into the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
ukjv_translation: How think all of you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?

greek_text: και εαν γενηται ευρειν αυτο αμην λεγω υμιν οτι χαιρει επ αυτω μαλλον η επι τοις εννενηκονταεννεα τοις μη πεπλανημενοις
transliteration: kai ean genhtai eurein auto amhn legw umin oti cairei ep autw mallon h epi toiv ennenhkontaennea toiv mh peplanhmenoiv
draft_translation: And if it happens that he finds it, Amen, I say to you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine that did not go astray.
ukjv_translation: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; modernized went-not wording; rendered amen formula directly; rendered ean genetai as if it happens

greek_text: ουτως ουκ εστιν θελημα εμπροσθεν του πατρος υμων του εν ουρανοις ινα αποληται εις των μικρων τουτων
transliteration: outwv ouk estin yelhma emprosyen tou patrov umwn tou en ouranoiv ina apolhtai eiv twn mikrwn toutwn
draft_translation: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
ukjv_translation: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

greek_text: εαν δε αμαρτηση εις σε ο αδελφος σου υπαγε και ελεγξον αυτον μεταξυ σου και αυτου μονου εαν σου ακουση εκερδησας τον αδελφον σου
transliteration: ean de amarthsh eiv se o adelfov sou upage kai elegxon auton metaxu sou kai autou monou ean sou akoush ekerdhsav ton adelfon sou
draft_translation: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.
ukjv_translation: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εαν δε μη ακουση παραλαβε μετα σου ετι ενα η δυο ινα επι στοματος δυο μαρτυρων η τριων σταθη παν ρημα
transliteration: ean de mh akoush paralabe meta sou eti ena h duo ina epi stomatov duo marturwn h triwn stayh pan rhma
draft_translation: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
ukjv_translation: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word (o. rhema) may be established.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εαν δε παρακουση αυτων ειπε τη εκκλησια εαν δε και της εκκλησιας παρακουση εστω σοι ωσπερ ο εθνικος και ο τελωνης
transliteration: ean de parakoush autwn eipe th ekklhsia ean de kai thv ekklhsiav parakoush estw soi wsper o eynikov kai o telwnhv
draft_translation: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it to the assembly: but if he neglect to hear the assembly, let him be to you as a man of the nations and a tax collector.
ukjv_translation: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto you as an heathen man and a publican.
review_notes: fixed nations-man article artifact; modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered ethne as nations; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: αμην λεγω υμιν οσα εαν δησητε επι της γης εσται δεδεμενα εν τω ουρανω και οσα εαν λυσητε επι της γης εσται λελυμενα εν τω ουρανω
transliteration: amhn legw umin osa ean dhshte epi thv ghv estai dedemena en tw ouranw kai osa ean lushte epi thv ghv estai lelumena en tw ouranw
draft_translation: Amen, I say to you, Whatever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever all of you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever all of you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: παλιν λεγω υμιν οτι εαν δυο υμων συμφωνησωσιν επι της γης περι παντος πραγματος ου εαν αιτησωνται γενησεται αυτοις παρα του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
transliteration: palin legw umin oti ean duo umwn sumfwnhswsin epi thv ghv peri pantov pragmatov ou ean aithswntai genhsetai autoiv para tou patrov mou tou en ouranoiv
draft_translation: Again I say to you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as concerning anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as concerning any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: ου γαρ εισιν δυο η τρεις συνηγμενοι εις το εμον ονομα εκει ειμι εν μεσω αυτων
transliteration: ou gar eisin duo h treiv sunhgmenoi eiv to emon onoma ekei eimi en mesw autwn
draft_translation: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the midst of them.
ukjv_translation: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

greek_text: τοτε προσελθων αυτω ο πετρος ειπεν κυριε ποσακις αμαρτησει εις εμε ο αδελφος μου και αφησω αυτω εως επτακις
transliteration: tote proselywn autw o petrov eipen kurie posakiv amarthsei eiv eme o adelfov mou kai afhsw autw ewv eptakiv
draft_translation: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
ukjv_translation: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους ου λεγω σοι εως επτακις αλλ εως εβδομηκοντακις επτα
transliteration: legei autw o ihsouv ou legw soi ewv eptakiv all ewv ebdomhkontakiv epta
draft_translation: Jesus says to him, I say not to you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
ukjv_translation: Jesus says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

greek_text: δια τουτο ωμοιωθη η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω βασιλει ος ηθελησεν συναραι λογον μετα των δουλων αυτου
transliteration: dia touto wmoiwyh h basileia twn ouranwn anyrwpw basilei ov hyelhsen sunarai logon meta twn doulwn autou
draft_translation: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened to a certain king, which would take account of his slaves.
ukjv_translation: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account (o. logos) of his servants.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: αρξαμενου δε αυτου συναιρειν προσηνεχθη αυτω εις οφειλετης μυριων ταλαντων
transliteration: arxamenou de autou sunairein proshnecyh autw eiv ofeilethv muriwn talantwn
draft_translation: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought to him, who owed him ten thousand talents.
ukjv_translation: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

greek_text: μη εχοντος δε αυτου αποδουναι εκελευσεν αυτον ο κυριος αυτου πραθηναι και την γυναικα αυτου και τα τεκνα και παντα οσα ειχεν και αποδοθηναι
transliteration: mh econtov de autou apodounai ekeleusen auton o kuriov autou prayhnai kai thn gunaika autou kai ta tekna kai panta osa eicen kai apodoyhnai
draft_translation: But since he had not to pay, his Lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
ukjv_translation: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
review_notes: cleaned forasmuch-as modernization artifact; modernized forasmuch; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: πεσων ουν ο δουλος προσεκυνει αυτω λεγων κυριε μακροθυμησον επ εμοι και παντα σοι αποδωσω
transliteration: peswn oun o doulov prosekunei autw legwn kurie makroyumhson ep emoi kai panta soi apodwsw
draft_translation: The slave therefore fell down, and worshiped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
ukjv_translation: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
review_notes: modernized worshipped spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: σπλαγχνισθεις δε ο κυριος του δουλου εκεινου απελυσεν αυτον και το δανειον αφηκεν αυτω
transliteration: splagcnisyeiv de o kuriov tou doulou ekeinou apelusen auton kai to daneion afhken autw
draft_translation: Then the Lord of that slave was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
ukjv_translation: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: εξελθων δε ο δουλος εκεινος ευρεν ενα των συνδουλων αυτου ος ωφειλεν αυτω εκατον δηναρια και κρατησας αυτον επνιγεν λεγων αποδος μοι ο τι οφειλεις
transliteration: exelywn de o doulov ekeinov euren ena twn sundoulwn autou ov wfeilen autw ekaton dhnaria kai krathsav auton epnigen legwn apodov moi o ti ofeileiv
draft_translation: But the same slave went out, and found one of his fellow slaves, which owed him a hundred denarii: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owe.
ukjv_translation: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owe.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; rendered Greek coin term transliterally; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: πεσων ουν ο συνδουλος αυτου εις τους ποδας αυτου παρεκαλει αυτον λεγων μακροθυμησον επ εμοι και παντα αποδωσω σοι
transliteration: peswn oun o sundoulov autou eiv touv podav autou parekalei auton legwn makroyumhson ep emoi kai panta apodwsw soi
draft_translation: And his fellow slave fell down at his feet, and begged him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
ukjv_translation: And his fellow servant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
review_notes: modernized besought; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ο δε ουκ ηθελεν αλλ απελθων εβαλεν αυτον εις φυλακην εως ου αποδω το οφειλομενον
transliteration: o de ouk hyelen all apelywn ebalen auton eiv fulakhn ewv ou apodw to ofeilomenon
draft_translation: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
ukjv_translation: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ιδοντες δε οι συνδουλοι αυτου τα γενομενα ελυπηθησαν σφοδρα και ελθοντες διεσαφησαν τω κυριω αυτων παντα τα γενομενα
transliteration: idontev de oi sundouloi autou ta genomena eluphyhsan sfodra kai elyontev diesafhsan tw kuriw autwn panta ta genomena
draft_translation: So when his fellow slaves saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told to their Lord all that was done.
ukjv_translation: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: τοτε προσκαλεσαμενος αυτον ο κυριος αυτου λεγει αυτω δουλε πονηρε πασαν την οφειλην εκεινην αφηκα σοι επει παρεκαλεσας με
transliteration: tote proskalesamenov auton o kuriov autou legei autw doule ponhre pasan thn ofeilhn ekeinhn afhka soi epei parekalesav me
draft_translation: Then his Lord, after that he had called him, said to him, O you wicked slave, I forgave you all that debt, because you desired me:
ukjv_translation: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O you wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt, because you desired me:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ουκ εδει και σε ελεησαι τον συνδουλον σου ως και εγω σε ηλεησα
transliteration: ouk edei kai se elehsai ton sundoulon sou wv kai egw se hlehsa
draft_translation: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellow slave, even as I had pity on you?
ukjv_translation: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellow servant, even as I had pity on you?

greek_text: και οργισθεις ο κυριος αυτου παρεδωκεν αυτον τοις βασανισταις εως ου αποδω παν το οφειλομενον αυτω
transliteration: kai orgisyeiv o kuriov autou paredwken auton toiv basanistaiv ewv ou apodw pan to ofeilomenon autw
draft_translation: And his Lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due to him.
ukjv_translation: And his lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ουτως και ο πατηρ μου ο επουρανιος ποιησει υμιν εαν μη αφητε εκαστος τω αδελφω αυτου απο των καρδιων υμων τα παραπτωματα αυτων
transliteration: outwv kai o pathr mou o epouraniov poihsei umin ean mh afhte ekastov tw adelfw autou apo twn kardiwn umwn ta paraptwmata autwn
draft_translation: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also to you, if you from your hearts do not forgive every one his brother their trespasses.
ukjv_translation: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if all of you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forgive-not wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους τους λογους τουτους μετηρεν απο της γαλιλαιας και ηλθεν εις τα ορια της ιουδαιας περαν του ιορδανου
transliteration: kai egeneto ote etelesen o ihsouv touv logouv toutouv methren apo thv galilaiav kai hlyen eiv ta oria thv ioudaiav peran tou iordanou
draft_translation: And it happened, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond Jordan;
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, (o. logos) he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
review_notes: modernized came-to-pass idiom; modernized coasts as borders; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: και ηκολουθησαν αυτω οχλοι πολλοι και εθεραπευσεν αυτους εκει
transliteration: kai hkolouyhsan autw ocloi polloi kai eyerapeusen autouv ekei
draft_translation: And great crowds followed him; and he healed them there.
ukjv_translation: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

greek_text: και προσηλθον αυτω οι φαρισαιοι πειραζοντες αυτον και λεγοντες αυτω ει εξεστιν ανθρωπω απολυσαι την γυναικα αυτου κατα πασαν αιτιαν
transliteration: kai proshlyon autw oi farisaioi peirazontev auton kai legontev autw ei exestin anyrwpw apolusai thn gunaika autou kata pasan aitian
draft_translation: The Pharisees also came to him, tempting him, and saying to him, Is it lawful for a man to release his wife for every cause?
ukjv_translation: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; modernized archaic directional unto

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ουκ ανεγνωτε οτι ο ποιησας απ αρχης αρσεν και θηλυ εποιησεν αυτους
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv eipen autoiv ouk anegnwte oti o poihsav ap archv arsen kai yhlu epoihsen autouv
draft_translation: And he answered and said to them, Have you not read, that the one who made them at the beginning made them male and female,
ukjv_translation: And he answered and said unto them, Have all of you not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized he-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και ειπεν ενεκεν τουτου καταλειψει ανθρωπος τον πατερα και την μητερα και προσκολληθησεται τη γυναικι αυτου και εσονται οι δυο εις σαρκα μιαν
transliteration: kai eipen eneken toutou kataleiqei anyrwpov ton patera kai thn mhtera kai proskollhyhsetai th gunaiki autou kai esontai oi duo eiv sarka mian
draft_translation: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cling to his wife: and they two shall be one flesh?
ukjv_translation: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they two shall be one flesh?

greek_text: ωστε ουκετι εισιν δυο αλλα σαρξ μια ο ουν ο θεος συνεζευξεν ανθρωπος μη χωριζετω
transliteration: wste ouketi eisin duo alla sarx mia o oun o yeov sunezeuxen anyrwpov mh cwrizetw
draft_translation: Therefore they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, let not man put asunder.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, let not man put asunder.

greek_text: λεγουσιν αυτω τι ουν μωσης ενετειλατο δουναι βιβλιον αποστασιου και απολυσαι αυτην
transliteration: legousin autw ti oun mwshv eneteilato dounai biblion apostasiou kai apolusai authn
draft_translation: They say to him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to release her?
ukjv_translation: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; modernized archaic directional unto

greek_text: λεγει αυτοις οτι μωσης προς την σκληροκαρδιαν υμων επετρεψεν υμιν απολυσαι τας γυναικας υμων απ αρχης δε ου γεγονεν ουτως
transliteration: legei autoiv oti mwshv prov thn sklhrokardian umwn epetreqen umin apolusai tav gunaikav umwn ap archv de ou gegonen outwv
draft_translation: He says to them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts permitted you to release your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
ukjv_translation: He says unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized suffer-as-permit wording

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου ει μη επι πορνεια και γαμηση αλλην μοιχαται και ο απολελυμενην γαμησας μοιχαται
transliteration: legw de umin oti ov an apolush thn gunaika autou ei mh epi porneia kai gamhsh allhn moicatai kai o apolelumenhn gamhsav moicatai
draft_translation: And I say to you, Whoever shall release his wife, except it be for sexual immorality, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoever marries her who has been released does commit adultery.
ukjv_translation: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoso marries her which is put away does commit adultery.
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; fixed release participle artifact; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized porneia wording; modernized whoso; modernized whosoever

greek_text: λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ει ουτως εστιν η αιτια του ανθρωπου μετα της γυναικος ου συμφερει γαμησαι
transliteration: legousin autw oi mayhtai autou ei outwv estin h aitia tou anyrwpou meta thv gunaikov ou sumferei gamhsai
draft_translation: His disciples say to him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
ukjv_translation: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις ου παντες χωρουσιν τον λογον τουτον αλλ οις δεδοται
transliteration: o de eipen autoiv ou pantev cwrousin ton logon touton all oiv dedotai
draft_translation: But he said to them, Not all men can receive this saying, except those to whom it is given.
ukjv_translation: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, (o. logos) save they to whom it is given.

greek_text: εισιν γαρ ευνουχοι οιτινες εκ κοιλιας μητρος εγεννηθησαν ουτως και εισιν ευνουχοι οιτινες ευνουχισθησαν υπο των ανθρωπων και εισιν ευνουχοι οιτινες ευνουχισαν εαυτους δια την βασιλειαν των ουρανων ο δυναμενος χωρειν χωρειτω
transliteration: eisin gar eunoucoi oitinev ek koiliav mhtrov egennhyhsan outwv kai eisin eunoucoi oitinev eunoucisyhsan upo twn anyrwpwn kai eisin eunoucoi oitinev eunoucisan eautouv dia thn basileian twn ouranwn o dunamenov cwrein cwreitw
draft_translation: For there are some eunuchs, who were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, who were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. The one who is able to receive it, let him receive it.
ukjv_translation: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

greek_text: τοτε προσηνεχθη αυτω παιδια ινα τας χειρας επιθη αυτοις και προσευξηται οι δε μαθηται επετιμησαν αυτοις
transliteration: tote proshnecyh autw paidia ina tav ceirav epiyh autoiv kai proseuxhtai oi de mayhtai epetimhsan autoiv
draft_translation: Then were there brought to him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
ukjv_translation: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αφετε τα παιδια και μη κωλυετε αυτα ελθειν προς με των γαρ τοιουτων εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen afete ta paidia kai mh kwluete auta elyein prov me twn gar toioutwn estin h basileia twn ouranwn
draft_translation: But Jesus said, allow little children, and forbid them not, to come to me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
ukjv_translation: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized suffer-little-children idiom

greek_text: και επιθεις αυτοις τας χειρας επορευθη εκειθεν
transliteration: kai epiyeiv autoiv tav ceirav eporeuyh ekeiyen
draft_translation: And he laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
ukjv_translation: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

greek_text: και ιδου εις προσελθων ειπεν αυτω διδασκαλε αγαθε τι αγαθον ποιησω ινα εχω ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: kai idou eiv proselywn eipen autw didaskale agaye ti agayon poihsw ina ecw zwhn aiwnion
draft_translation: And, look, one came and said to him, Good Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
ukjv_translation: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; rendered didaskalos as teacher

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτω τι με λεγεις αγαθον ουδεις αγαθος ει μη εις ο θεος ει δε θελεις εισελθειν εις την ζωην τηρησον τας εντολας
transliteration: o de eipen autw ti me legeiv agayon oudeiv agayov ei mh eiv o yeov ei de yeleiv eiselyein eiv thn zwhn thrhson tav entolav
draft_translation: And he said to him, Why do you call me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto him, Why call you me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ποιας ο δε ιησους ειπεν το ου φονευσεις ου μοιχευσεις ου κλεψεις ου ψευδομαρτυρησεις
transliteration: legei autw poiav o de ihsouv eipen to ou foneuseiv ou moiceuseiv ou kleqeiv ou qeudomarturhseiv
draft_translation: He says to him, Which? Jesus said, You shall do no murder, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness,
ukjv_translation: He says unto him, Which? Jesus said, You shall do no murder, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness,

greek_text: τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα και αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον
transliteration: tima ton patera sou kai thn mhtera kai agaphseiv ton plhsion sou wv seauton
draft_translation: Honor your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
ukjv_translation: Honour your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbour as yourself.
review_notes: modernized honour spelling; modernized neighbour spelling

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο νεανισκος παντα ταυτα εφυλαξαμην εκ νεοτητος μου τι ετι υστερω
transliteration: legei autw o neaniskov panta tauta efulaxamhn ek neothtov mou ti eti usterw
draft_translation: The young man says to him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
ukjv_translation: The young man says unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

greek_text: εφη αυτω ο ιησους ει θελεις τελειος ειναι υπαγε πωλησον σου τα υπαρχοντα και δος πτωχοις και εξεις θησαυρον εν ουρανω και δευρο ακολουθει μοι
transliteration: efh autw o ihsouv ei yeleiv teleiov einai upage pwlhson sou ta uparconta kai dov ptwcoiv kai exeiv yhsauron en ouranw kai deuro akolouyei moi
draft_translation: Jesus said to him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
ukjv_translation: Jesus said unto him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

greek_text: ακουσας δε ο νεανισκος τον λογον απηλθεν λυπουμενος ην γαρ εχων κτηματα πολλα
transliteration: akousav de o neaniskov ton logon aphlyen lupoumenov hn gar ecwn kthmata polla
draft_translation: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
ukjv_translation: But when the young man heard that saying, (o. logos) he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου αμην λεγω υμιν οτι δυσκολως πλουσιος εισελευσεται εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen toiv mayhtaiv autou amhn legw umin oti duskolwv plousiov eiseleusetai eiv thn basileian twn ouranwn
draft_translation: Then said Jesus to his disciples, Amen, I say to you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
ukjv_translation: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: παλιν δε λεγω υμιν ευκοπωτερον εστιν καμηλον δια τρυπηματος ραφιδος διελθειν η πλουσιον εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελθειν
transliteration: palin de legw umin eukopwteron estin kamhlon dia truphmatov rafidov dielyein h plousion eiv thn basileian tou yeou eiselyein
draft_translation: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

greek_text: ακουσαντες δε οι μαθηται αυτου εξεπλησσοντο σφοδρα λεγοντες τις αρα δυναται σωθηναι
transliteration: akousantev de oi mayhtai autou exeplhssonto sfodra legontev tiv ara dunatai swyhnai
draft_translation: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
ukjv_translation: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εμβλεψας δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις παρα ανθρωποις τουτο αδυνατον εστιν παρα δε θεω παντα δυνατα εστιν
transliteration: embleqav de o ihsouv eipen autoiv para anyrwpoiv touto adunaton estin para de yew panta dunata estin
draft_translation: But Jesus beheld them, and said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

ukjv_translation: Saying, What think all of you of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized inverted question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: λεγει αυτοις πως ουν δαβιδ εν πνευματι κυριον αυτον καλει λεγων
transliteration: legei autoiv pwv oun dabid en pneumati kurion auton kalei legwn
draft_translation: He says to them, How then does David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
ukjv_translation: He says unto them, How then does David in spirit (o. pneuma) call him Lord, saying,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
transliteration: eipen o kuriov tw kuriw mou kayou ek dexiwn mou ewv an yw touv ecyrouv sou upopodion twn podwn sou
draft_translation: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?
ukjv_translation: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make yours enemies your footstool?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yours before noun; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ει ουν δαβιδ καλει αυτον κυριον πως υιος αυτου εστιν
transliteration: ei oun dabid kalei auton kurion pwv uiov autou estin
draft_translation: If David then calls him Lord, how is he his son?
ukjv_translation: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

greek_text: και ουδεις εδυνατο αυτω αποκριθηναι λογον ουδε ετολμησεν τις απ εκεινης της ημερας επερωτησαι αυτον ουκετι
transliteration: kai oudeiv edunato autw apokriyhnai logon oude etolmhsen tiv ap ekeinhv thv hmerav eperwthsai auton ouketi
draft_translation: And no one was able to answer him a word, neither dared anyone from that day forth ask him any more questions.
ukjv_translation: And no man was able to answer him a word, (o. logos) neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized durst; modernized no-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τοτε ο ιησους ελαλησεν τοις οχλοις και τοις μαθηταις αυτου
transliteration: tote o ihsouv elalhsen toiv ocloiv kai toiv mayhtaiv autou
draft_translation: Then Jesus spoke to the crowd, and to his disciples,
ukjv_translation: Then spoke Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

greek_text: λεγων επι της μωσεως καθεδρας εκαθισαν οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι
transliteration: legwn epi thv mwsewv kayedrav ekayisan oi grammateiv kai oi farisaioi
draft_translation: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
ukjv_translation: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

greek_text: παντα ουν οσα αν ειπωσιν υμιν τηρειν τηρειτε και ποιειτε κατα δε τα εργα αυτων μη ποιειτε λεγουσιν γαρ και ου ποιουσιν
transliteration: panta oun osa an eipwsin umin threin threite kai poieite kata de ta erga autwn mh poieite legousin gar kai ou poiousin
draft_translation: All therefore whatever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not do according to their works: for they say, and do not.
ukjv_translation: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not all of you after their works: for they say, and do not.
review_notes: modernized do-not-you wording; modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: δεσμευουσιν γαρ φορτια βαρεα και δυσβαστακτα και επιτιθεασιν επι τους ωμους των ανθρωπων τω δε δακτυλω αυτων ου θελουσιν κινησαι αυτα
transliteration: desmeuousin gar fortia barea kai dusbastakta kai epitiyeasin epi touv wmouv twn anyrwpwn tw de daktulw autwn ou yelousin kinhsai auta
draft_translation: For they bind heavy and grievous burdens, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
ukjv_translation: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

greek_text: παντα δε τα εργα αυτων ποιουσιν προς το θεαθηναι τοις ανθρωποις πλατυνουσιν δε τα φυλακτηρια αυτων και μεγαλυνουσιν τα κρασπεδα των ιματιων αυτων
transliteration: panta de ta erga autwn poiousin prov to yeayhnai toiv anyrwpoiv platunousin de ta fulakthria autwn kai megalunousin ta kraspeda twn imatiwn autwn
draft_translation: But all their works they do in order to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their clothes,
ukjv_translation: But all their works they do in order to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
review_notes: modernized garments where not contextually technical

greek_text: φιλουσιν τε την πρωτοκλισιαν εν τοις δειπνοις και τας πρωτοκαθεδριας εν ταις συναγωγαις
transliteration: filousin te thn prwtoklisian en toiv deipnoiv kai tav prwtokayedriav en taiv sunagwgaiv
draft_translation: And love the chief places at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
ukjv_translation: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

greek_text: και τους ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις και καλεισθαι υπο των ανθρωπων ραββι ραββι
transliteration: kai touv aspasmouv en taiv agoraiv kai kaleisyai upo twn anyrwpwn rabbi rabbi
draft_translation: And greetings in the markets, and to be called by men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
ukjv_translation: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

greek_text: υμεις δε μη κληθητε ραββι εις γαρ εστιν υμων ο καθηγητης ο χριστος παντες δε υμεις αδελφοι εστε
transliteration: umeiv de mh klhyhte rabbi eiv gar estin umwn o kayhghthv o cristov pantev de umeiv adelfoi este
draft_translation: But do not be called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all you are brothers.
ukjv_translation: But be not all of you called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all you are brethren.
review_notes: modernized be-not-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: και πατερα μη καλεσητε υμων επι της γης εις γαρ εστιν ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: kai patera mh kaleshte umwn epi thv ghv eiv gar estin o pathr umwn o en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: And call no one your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, who is in heaven.
ukjv_translation: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: μηδε κληθητε καθηγηται εις γαρ υμων εστιν ο καθηγητης ο χριστος
transliteration: mhde klhyhte kayhghtai eiv gar umwn estin o kayhghthv o cristov
draft_translation: Neither be called teachers: for one is your Teacher, even Christ.
ukjv_translation: Neither be all of you called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

greek_text: ο δε μειζων υμων εσται υμων διακονος
transliteration: o de meizwn umwn estai umwn diakonov
draft_translation: But the one who is greatest among you shall be your servant.
ukjv_translation: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

greek_text: οστις δε υψωσει εαυτον ταπεινωθησεται και οστις ταπεινωσει εαυτον υψωθησεται
transliteration: ostiv de uqwsei eauton tapeinwyhsetai kai ostiv tapeinwsei eauton uqwyhsetai
draft_translation: And whoever shall exalt himself shall be brought low; and the one who shall humble himself shall be exalted.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be brought low; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

greek_text: ουαι δε υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι κλειετε την βασιλειαν των ουρανων εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων υμεις γαρ ουκ εισερχεσθε ουδε τους εισερχομενους αφιετε εισελθειν
transliteration: ouai de umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti kleiete thn basileian twn ouranwn emprosyen twn anyrwpwn umeiv gar ouk eisercesye oude touv eisercomenouv afiete eiselyein
draft_translation: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for you neither go in yourselves, nor do you allow those who are entering to go in.
ukjv_translation: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for all of you neither go in yourselves, neither suffer all of you them that are entering to go in.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι κατεσθιετε τας οικιας των χηρων και προφασει μακρα προσευχομενοι δια τουτο ληψεσθε περισσοτερον κριμα
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti katesyiete tav oikiav twn chrwn kai profasei makra proseucomenoi dia touto lhqesye perissoteron krima
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore you shall receive the greater judgment.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore all of you shall receive the greater damnation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered krima/krisis as judgment

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι περιαγετε την θαλασσαν και την ξηραν ποιησαι ενα προσηλυτον και οταν γενηται ποιειτε αυτον υιον γεεννης διπλοτερον υμων
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti periagete thn yalassan kai thn xhran poihsai ena proshluton kai otan genhtai poieite auton uion geennhv diploteron umwn
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of Gehenna than yourselves.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, all of you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered geenna as Gehenna

greek_text: ουαι υμιν οδηγοι τυφλοι οι λεγοντες ος αν ομοση εν τω ναω ουδεν εστιν ος δ αν ομοση εν τω χρυσω του ναου οφειλει
transliteration: ouai umin odhgoi tufloi oi legontev ov an omosh en tw naw ouden estin ov d an omosh en tw crusw tou naou ofeilei
draft_translation: Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, all of you blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

greek_text: μωροι και τυφλοι τις γαρ μειζων εστιν ο χρυσος η ο ναος ο αγιαζων τον χρυσον
transliteration: mwroi kai tufloi tiv gar meizwn estin o crusov h o naov o agiazwn ton cruson
draft_translation: You fools and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
ukjv_translation: All of you fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that santifies the gold?

greek_text: και ος εαν ομοση εν τω θυσιαστηριω ουδεν εστιν ος δ αν ομοση εν τω δωρω τω επανω αυτου οφειλει
transliteration: kai ov ean omosh en tw yusiasthriw ouden estin ov d an omosh en tw dwrw tw epanw autou ofeilei
draft_translation: And, Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
ukjv_translation: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever swears by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

greek_text: μωροι και τυφλοι τι γαρ μειζον το δωρον η το θυσιαστηριον το αγιαζον το δωρον
transliteration: mwroi kai tufloi ti gar meizon to dwron h to yusiasthrion to agiazon to dwron
draft_translation: You fools and blind: for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
ukjv_translation: All of you fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that santifies the gift?

greek_text: ο ουν ομοσας εν τω θυσιαστηριω ομνυει εν αυτω και εν πασιν τοις επανω αυτου
transliteration: o oun omosav en tw yusiasthriw omnuei en autw kai en pasin toiv epanw autou
draft_translation: Whoever therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things on it.
ukjv_translation: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things thereon.

greek_text: και ο ομοσας εν τω ναω ομνυει εν αυτω και εν τω κατοικουντι αυτον
transliteration: kai o omosav en tw naw omnuei en autw kai en tw katoikounti auton
draft_translation: And whoever shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him who dwells in it.
ukjv_translation: And whoso shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him that dwells therein.
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized therein; modernized whoso

greek_text: και ο ομοσας εν τω ουρανω ομνυει εν τω θρονω του θεου και εν τω καθημενω επανω αυτου
transliteration: kai o omosav en tw ouranw omnuei en tw yronw tou yeou kai en tw kayhmenw epanw autou
draft_translation: And the one who shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits on it.
ukjv_translation: And he that shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him that sits thereon.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι αποδεκατουτε το ηδυοσμον και το ανηθον και το κυμινον και αφηκατε τα βαρυτερα του νομου την κρισιν και τον ελεον και την πιστιν ταυτα εδει ποιησαι κακεινα μη αφιεναι
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti apodekatoute to hduosmon kai to anhyon kai to kuminon kai afhkate ta barutera tou nomou thn krisin kai ton eleon kai thn pistin tauta edei poihsai kakeina mh afienai
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these you ought to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought all of you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

greek_text: οδηγοι τυφλοι οι διυλιζοντες τον κωνωπα την δε καμηλον καταπινοντες
transliteration: odhgoi tufloi oi diulizontev ton kwnwpa thn de kamhlon katapinontev
draft_translation: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel.
ukjv_translation: All of you blind guides, which strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι καθαριζετε το εξωθεν του ποτηριου και της παροψιδος εσωθεν δε γεμουσιν εξ αρπαγης και ακρασιας
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti kayarizete to exwyen tou pothriou kai thv paroqidov eswyen de gemousin ex arpaghv kai akrasiav
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

greek_text: φαρισαιε τυφλε καθαρισον πρωτον το εντος του ποτηριου και της παροψιδος ινα γενηται και το εκτος αυτων καθαρον
transliteration: farisaie tufle kayarison prwton to entov tou pothriou kai thv paroqidov ina genhtai kai to ektov autwn kayaron
draft_translation: You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
ukjv_translation: You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι παρομοιαζετε ταφοις κεκονιαμενοις οιτινες εξωθεν μεν φαινονται ωραιοι εσωθεν δε γεμουσιν οστεων νεκρων και πασης ακαθαρσιας
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti paromoiazete tafoiv kekoniamenoiv oitinev exwyen men fainontai wraioi eswyen de gemousin ostewn nekrwn kai pashv akayarsiav
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are like whitewashed tombs, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you are like unto whitewashed sepulchers, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

greek_text: ουτως και υμεις εξωθεν μεν φαινεσθε τοις ανθρωποις δικαιοι εσωθεν δε μεστοι εστε υποκρισεως και ανομιας
transliteration: outwv kai umeiv exwyen men fainesye toiv anyrwpoiv dikaioi eswyen de mestoi este upokrisewv kai anomiav
draft_translation: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but within you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
ukjv_translation: Even so all of you also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within all of you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι οικοδομειτε τους ταφους των προφητων και κοσμειτε τα μνημεια των δικαιων
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti oikodomeite touv tafouv twn profhtwn kai kosmeite ta mnhmeia twn dikaiwn
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because you build the tombs of the prophets, and adorn the tombs of the righteous,
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because all of you build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchers of the righteous,

greek_text: και λεγετε ει ημεν εν ταις ημεραις των πατερων ημων ουκ αν ημεν κοινωνοι αυτων εν τω αιματι των προφητων
transliteration: kai legete ei hmen en taiv hmeraiv twn paterwn hmwn ouk an hmen koinwnoi autwn en tw aimati twn profhtwn
draft_translation: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
ukjv_translation: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ωστε μαρτυρειτε εαυτοις οτι υιοι εστε των φονευσαντων τους προφητας
transliteration: wste martureite eautoiv oti uioi este twn foneusantwn touv profhtav
draft_translation: Therefore you are witnesses to yourselves, that you are the children of those who killed the prophets.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore all of you be witnesses unto yourselves, that all of you are the children of them which killed the prophets.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized residual be wording; modernized them-which relative; modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και υμεις πληρωσατε το μετρον των πατερων υμων
transliteration: kai umeiv plhrwsate to metron twn paterwn umwn
draft_translation: Fill up then the measure of your fathers.
ukjv_translation: Fill all of you up then the measure of your fathers.

greek_text: οφεις γεννηματα εχιδνων πως φυγητε απο της κρισεως της γεεννης
transliteration: ofeiv gennhmata ecidnwn pwv fughte apo thv krisewv thv geennhv
draft_translation: You serpents, you generation of vipers, how can you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
ukjv_translation: All of you serpents, all of you generation of vipers, how can all of you escape the damnation of hell?
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered geenna as Gehenna; rendered krima/krisis as judgment

greek_text: δια τουτο ιδου εγω αποστελλω προς υμας προφητας και σοφους και γραμματεις και εξ αυτων αποκτενειτε και σταυρωσετε και εξ αυτων μαστιγωσετε εν ταις συναγωγαις υμων και διωξετε απο πολεως εις πολιν
transliteration: dia touto idou egw apostellw prov umav profhtav kai sofouv kai grammateiv kai ex autwn apokteneite kai staurwsete kai ex autwn mastigwsete en taiv sunagwgaiv umwn kai diwxete apo polewv eiv polin
draft_translation: Therefore, look, I send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them you shall kill and crucify; and some of them you shall scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them all of you shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall all of you scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

greek_text: οπως ελθη εφ υμας παν αιμα δικαιον εκχυνομενον επι της γης απο του αιματος αβελ του δικαιου εως του αιματος ζαχαριου υιου βαραχιου ον εφονευσατε μεταξυ του ναου και του θυσιαστηριου
transliteration: opwv elyh ef umav pan aima dikaion ekcunomenon epi thv ghv apo tou aimatov abel tou dikaiou ewv tou aimatov zacariou uiou baraciou on efoneusate metaxu tou naou kai tou yusiasthriou
draft_translation: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you killed between the temple and the altar.
ukjv_translation: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom all of you slew between the temple and the altar.

greek_text: αμην λεγω υμιν ηξει ταυτα παντα επι την γενεαν ταυτην
transliteration: amhn legw umin hxei tauta panta epi thn genean tauthn
draft_translation: Amen, I say to you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
ukjv_translation: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: ιερουσαλημ ιερουσαλημ η αποκτεινουσα τους προφητας και λιθοβολουσα τους απεσταλμενους προς αυτην ποσακις ηθελησα επισυναγαγειν τα τεκνα σου ον τροπον επισυναγει ορνις τα νοσσια εαυτης υπο τας πτερυγας και ουκ ηθελησατε
transliteration: ierousalhm ierousalhm h apokteinousa touv profhtav kai liyobolousa touv apestalmenouv prov authn posakiv hyelhsa episunagagein ta tekna sou on tropon episunagei orniv ta nossia eauthv upo tav pterugav kai ouk hyelhsate
draft_translation: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets, and stone those who are sent to you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
ukjv_translation: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that kill the prophets, and stone them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and all of you would not!

greek_text: ιδου αφιεται υμιν ο οικος υμων ερημος
transliteration: idou afietai umin o oikov umwn erhmov

draft_translation: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you hungry, and fed you? or thirsty, and gave you drink?

greek_text: ποτε δε σε ειδομεν ξενον και συνηγαγομεν η γυμνον και περιεβαλομεν

draft_translation: When did we see you a stranger, and take you in? or naked, and clothe you?
ukjv_translation: When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and clothed you?

greek_text: ποτε δε σε ειδομεν ασθενη η εν φυλακη και ηλθομεν προς σε

draft_translation: Or when did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?
ukjv_translation: Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you?

greek_text: και αποκριθεις ο βασιλευς ερει αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν εφ οσον εποιησατε ενι τουτων των αδελφων μου των ελαχιστων εμοι εποιησατε

draft_translation: And the King shall answer and say to them, Amen, I say to you, Inasmuch as you have done it to one of the least of these my brothers, you have done it to me.
ukjv_translation: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as all of you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, all of you have done it unto me.

greek_text: τοτε ερει και τοις εξ ευωνυμων πορευεσθε απ εμου οι κατηραμενοι εις το πυρ το αιωνιον το ητοιμασμενον τω διαβολω και τοις αγγελοις αυτου

draft_translation: Then shall he say also to them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into eternal fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
ukjv_translation: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, all of you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

greek_text: επεινασα γαρ και ουκ εδωκατε μοι φαγειν εδιψησα και ουκ εποτισατε με

review_notes: modernized an-hungered idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ξενος ημην και ου συνηγαγετε με γυμνος και ου περιεβαλετε με ασθενης και εν φυλακη και ουκ επεσκεψασθε με

draft_translation: I was a stranger, and you did not take me in: naked, and you did not clothe me: sick, and in prison, and you did not visit me.
ukjv_translation: I was a stranger, and all of you took me not in: naked, and all of you clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and all of you visited me not.

greek_text: τοτε αποκριθησονται αυτω και αυτοι λεγοντες κυριε ποτε σε ειδομεν πεινωντα η διψωντα η ξενον η γυμνον η ασθενη η εν φυλακη και ου διηκονησαμεν σοι

draft_translation: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to you?
ukjv_translation: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungered, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto you?
review_notes: modernized an-hungered idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: τοτε αποκριθησεται αυτοις λεγων αμην λεγω υμιν εφ οσον ουκ εποιησατε ενι τουτων των ελαχιστων ουδε εμοι εποιησατε
transliteration: tote apokriyhsetai autoiv legwn amhn legw umin ef oson ouk epoihsate eni toutwn twn elacistwn oude emoi epoihsate
draft_translation: Then shall he answer them, saying, Amen, I say to you, Inasmuch as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.

greek_text: και απελευσονται ουτοι εις κολασιν αιωνιον οι δε δικαιοι εις ζωην αιωνιον

draft_translation: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
ukjv_translation: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

greek_text: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους παντας τους λογους τουτους ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου

greek_text: οιδατε οτι μετα δυο ημερας το πασχα γινεται και ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται εις το σταυρωθηναι
transliteration: oidate oti meta duo hmerav to pasca ginetai kai o uiov tou anyrwpou paradidotai eiv to staurwyhnai
draft_translation: You know that after two days is the feast of the Passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
ukjv_translation: All of you know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
review_notes: capitalized Passover; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τοτε συνηχθησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι του λαου εις την αυλην του αρχιερεως του λεγομενου καιαφα
transliteration: tote sunhcyhsan oi arciereiv kai oi grammateiv kai oi presbuteroi tou laou eiv thn aulhn tou arcierewv tou legomenou kaiafa
draft_translation: Then the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people assembled together to the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
ukjv_translation: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

greek_text: και συνεβουλευσαντο ινα τον ιησουν κρατησωσιν δολω και αποκτεινωσιν
transliteration: kai sunebouleusanto ina ton ihsoun krathswsin dolw kai apokteinwsin
draft_translation: And consulted that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
ukjv_translation: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtlety, and kill him.

greek_text: ελεγον δε μη εν τη εορτη ινα μη θορυβος γενηται εν τω λαω
transliteration: elegon de mh en th eorth ina mh yorubov genhtai en tw law
draft_translation: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
ukjv_translation: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

greek_text: του δε ιησου γενομενου εν βηθανια εν οικια σιμωνος του λεπρου

transliteration: balousa gar auth to muron touto epi tou swmatov mou prov to entafiasai me epoihsen
draft_translation: For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
ukjv_translation: For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

draft_translation: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

draft_translation: And said to them, What will you give me, and I will deliver him to you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

draft_translation: The Son of man goes as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it would have been good for that man if he had not been born.

draft_translation: But I say to you, I will not drink from now on of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

draft_translation: Jesus said to him, Amen, I say to you, That this night, before the cock crow, you shall deny me three times.

draft_translation: The rest said, Let him be, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.

transliteration: kai idou to katapetasma tou naou escisyh eiv duo apo anwyen ewv katw kai h gh eseisyh kai ai petrai escisyhsan
draft_translation: And, look, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split;
ukjv_translation: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

greek_text: και τα μνημεια ανεωχθησαν και πολλα σωματα των κεκοιμημενων αγιων ηγερθη
