greek_text: και εξελθοντες εκ των μνημειων μετα την εγερσιν αυτου εισηλθον εις την αγιαν πολιν και ενεφανισθησαν πολλοις
transliteration: kai exelyontev ek twn mnhmeiwn meta thn egersin autou eishlyon eiv thn agian polin kai enefanisyhsan polloiv
draft_translation: And they came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared to many.
ukjv_translation: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

greek_text: ο δε εκατονταρχος και οι μετ αυτου τηρουντες τον ιησουν ιδοντες τον σεισμον και τα γενομενα εφοβηθησαν σφοδρα λεγοντες αληθως θεου υιος ην ουτος
transliteration: o de ekatontarcov kai oi met autou thrountev ton ihsoun idontev ton seismon kai ta genomena efobhyhsan sfodra legontev alhywv yeou uiov hn outov
draft_translation: Now when the centurion, and those who were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
ukjv_translation: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

greek_text: ησαν δε εκει γυναικες πολλαι απο μακροθεν θεωρουσαι αιτινες ηκολουθησαν τω ιησου απο της γαλιλαιας διακονουσαι αυτω
transliteration: hsan de ekei gunaikev pollai apo makroyen yewrousai aitinev hkolouyhsan tw ihsou apo thv galilaiav diakonousai autw
draft_translation: And many women were there beholding far off, who followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him:
ukjv_translation: And many women were there beholding far off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

greek_text: εν αις ην μαρια η μαγδαληνη και μαρια η του ιακωβου και ιωση μητηρ και η μητηρ των υιων ζεβεδαιου
transliteration: en aiv hn maria h magdalhnh kai maria h tou iakwbou kai iwsh mhthr kai h mhthr twn uiwn zebedaiou
draft_translation: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.
ukjv_translation: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.

greek_text: οψιας δε γενομενης ηλθεν ανθρωπος πλουσιος απο αριμαθαιας τουνομα ιωσηφ ος και αυτος εμαθητευσεν τω ιησου
transliteration: oqiav de genomenhv hlyen anyrwpov plousiov apo arimayaiav tounoma iwshf ov kai autov emayhteusen tw ihsou
draft_translation: When evening had come, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
ukjv_translation: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

greek_text: ουτος προσελθων τω πιλατω ητησατο το σωμα του ιησου τοτε ο πιλατος εκελευσεν αποδοθηναι το σωμα
transliteration: outov proselywn tw pilatw hthsato to swma tou ihsou tote o pilatov ekeleusen apodoyhnai to swma
draft_translation: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
ukjv_translation: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

greek_text: και λαβων το σωμα ο ιωσηφ ενετυλιξεν αυτο σινδονι καθαρα

draft_translation: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
ukjv_translation: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εθηκεν αυτο εν τω καινω αυτου μνημειω ο ελατομησεν εν τη πετρα και προσκυλισας λιθον μεγαν τη θυρα του μνημειου απηλθεν
transliteration: kai eyhken auto en tw kainw autou mnhmeiw o elatomhsen en th petra kai proskulisav liyon megan th yura tou mnhmeiou aphlyen
draft_translation: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
ukjv_translation: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

greek_text: ην δε εκει μαρια η μαγδαληνη και η αλλη μαρια καθημεναι απεναντι του ταφου
transliteration: hn de ekei maria h magdalhnh kai h allh maria kayhmenai apenanti tou tafou
draft_translation: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting opposite to the tomb.
ukjv_translation: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting opposite to the tomb.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τη δε επαυριον ητις εστιν μετα την παρασκευην συνηχθησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι φαρισαιοι προς πιλατον
transliteration: th de epaurion htiv estin meta thn paraskeuhn sunhcyhsan oi arciereiv kai oi farisaioi prov pilaton
draft_translation: Now the next day, which followed the day of preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,
ukjv_translation: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

greek_text: λεγοντες κυριε εμνησθημεν οτι εκεινος ο πλανος ειπεν ετι ζων μετα τρεις ημερας εγειρομαι
transliteration: legontev kurie emnhsyhmen oti ekeinov o planov eipen eti zwn meta treiv hmerav egeiromai
draft_translation: Saying, Sir, we remember that this deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
ukjv_translation: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

greek_text: κελευσον ουν ασφαλισθηναι τον ταφον εως της τριτης ημερας μηποτε ελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου νυκτος κλεψωσιν αυτον και ειπωσιν τω λαω ηγερθη απο των νεκρων και εσται η εσχατη πλανη χειρων της πρωτης
transliteration: keleuson oun asfalisyhnai ton tafon ewv thv trithv hmerav mhpote elyontev oi mayhtai autou nuktov kleqwsin auton kai eipwsin tw law hgeryh apo twn nekrwn kai estai h escath planh ceirwn thv prwthv
draft_translation: Command therefore that the tomb be secured until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say to the people, He has risen from the dead: so the last deception shall be worse than the first.
ukjv_translation: Command therefore that the tomb be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He has risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

greek_text: εφη δε αυτοις ο πιλατος εχετε κουστωδιαν υπαγετε ασφαλισασθε ως οιδατε
transliteration: efh de autoiv o pilatov ecete koustwdian upagete asfalisasye wv oidate
draft_translation: Pilate said to them, You have a guard: go your way, make it as secure as you can.
ukjv_translation: Pilate said unto them, All of you have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as all of you can.

greek_text: οι δε πορευθεντες ησφαλισαντο τον ταφον σφραγισαντες τον λιθον μετα της κουστωδιας
transliteration: oi de poreuyentev hsfalisanto ton tafon sfragisantev ton liyon meta thv koustwdiav
draft_translation: So they went, and secured the tomb, sealing the stone, and setting a guard.
ukjv_translation: So they went, and made the tomb sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

greek_text: οψε δε σαββατων τη επιφωσκουση εις μιαν σαββατων ηλθεν μαρια η μαγδαληνη και η αλλη μαρια θεωρησαι τον ταφον
transliteration: oqe de sabbatwn th epifwskoush eiv mian sabbatwn hlyen maria h magdalhnh kai h allh maria yewrhsai ton tafon
draft_translation: After the Sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
ukjv_translation: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the tomb.

greek_text: και ιδου σεισμος εγενετο μεγας αγγελος γαρ κυριου καταβας εξ ουρανου προσελθων απεκυλισεν τον λιθον απο της θυρας και εκαθητο επανω αυτου
transliteration: kai idou seismov egeneto megav aggelov gar kuriou katabav ex ouranou proselywn apekulisen ton liyon apo thv yurav kai ekayhto epanw autou
draft_translation: And, look, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
ukjv_translation: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
review_notes: modernized behold; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ην δε η ιδεα αυτου ως αστραπη και το ενδυμα αυτου λευκον ωσει χιων
transliteration: hn de h idea autou wv astraph kai to enduma autou leukon wsei ciwn
draft_translation: His countenance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow:
ukjv_translation: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

greek_text: απο δε του φοβου αυτου εσεισθησαν οι τηρουντες και εγενοντο ωσει νεκροι
transliteration: apo de tou fobou autou eseisyhsan oi thrountev kai egenonto wsei nekroi
draft_translation: And for fear of him the guards shook, and became as dead men.
ukjv_translation: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

greek_text: αποκριθεις δε ο αγγελος ειπεν ταις γυναιξιν μη φοβεισθε υμεις οιδα γαρ οτι ιησουν τον εσταυρωμενον ζητειτε
transliteration: apokriyeiv de o aggelov eipen taiv gunaixin mh fobeisye umeiv oida gar oti ihsoun ton estaurwmenon zhteite
draft_translation: And the angel answered and said to the women, Do not fear: for I know that you seek Jesus, who was crucified.
ukjv_translation: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not all of you: for I know that all of you seek Jesus, which was crucified.

greek_text: ουκ εστιν ωδε ηγερθη γαρ καθως ειπεν δευτε ιδετε τον τοπον οπου εκειτο ο κυριος
transliteration: ouk estin wde hgeryh gar kaywv eipen deute idete ton topon opou ekeito o kuriov
draft_translation: He is not here: for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
ukjv_translation: He is not here: for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

greek_text: και ταχυ πορευθεισαι ειπατε τοις μαθηταις αυτου οτι ηγερθη απο των νεκρων και ιδου προαγει υμας εις την γαλιλαιαν εκει αυτον οψεσθε ιδου ειπον υμιν
transliteration: kai tacu poreuyeisai eipate toiv mayhtaiv autou oti hgeryh apo twn nekrwn kai idou proagei umav eiv thn galilaian ekei auton oqesye idou eipon umin
draft_translation: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead; and, look, he goes before you into Galilee; there you shall see him: look, I have told you.
ukjv_translation: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead; and, behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there shall all of you see him: lo, I have told you.

greek_text: και εξελθουσαι ταχυ απο του μνημειου μετα φοβου και χαρας μεγαλης εδραμον απαγγειλαι τοις μαθηταις αυτου
transliteration: kai exelyousai tacu apo tou mnhmeiou meta fobou kai carav megalhv edramon apaggeilai toiv mayhtaiv autou
draft_translation: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy; and ran to bring word to his disciples.
ukjv_translation: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

greek_text: ως δε επορευοντο απαγγειλαι τοις μαθηταις αυτου και ιδου ο ιησους απηντησεν αυταις λεγων χαιρετε αι δε προσελθουσαι εκρατησαν αυτου τους ποδας και προσεκυνησαν αυτω
transliteration: wv de eporeuonto apaggeilai toiv mayhtaiv autou kai idou o ihsouv aphnthsen autaiv legwn cairete ai de proselyousai ekrathsan autou touv podav kai prosekunhsan autw
draft_translation: And as they went to tell his disciples, look, Jesus met them, saying, Greetings. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshiped him.
ukjv_translation: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

greek_text: τοτε λεγει αυταις ο ιησους μη φοβεισθε υπαγετε απαγγειλατε τοις αδελφοις μου ινα απελθωσιν εις την γαλιλαιαν κακει με οψονται
transliteration: tote legei autaiv o ihsouv mh fobeisye upagete apaggeilate toiv adelfoiv mou ina apelywsin eiv thn galilaian kakei me oqontai
draft_translation: Then Jesus said to them, Do not be afraid: go tell my brothers that they go into Galilee, and there they shall see me.
ukjv_translation: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

greek_text: πορευομενων δε αυτων ιδου τινες της κουστωδιας ελθοντες εις την πολιν απηγγειλαν τοις αρχιερευσιν απαντα τα γενομενα
transliteration: poreuomenwn de autwn idou tinev thv koustwdiav elyontev eiv thn polin aphggeilan toiv arciereusin apanta ta genomena
draft_translation: Now when they were going, look, some of the guard came into the city, and reported to the chief priests all the things that were done.
ukjv_translation: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and showed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

greek_text: και συναχθεντες μετα των πρεσβυτερων συμβουλιον τε λαβοντες αργυρια ικανα εδωκαν τοις στρατιωταις
transliteration: kai sunacyentev meta twn presbuterwn sumboulion te labontev arguria ikana edwkan toiv stratiwtaiv
draft_translation: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,
ukjv_translation: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

greek_text: λεγοντες ειπατε οτι οι μαθηται αυτου νυκτος ελθοντες εκλεψαν αυτον ημων κοιμωμενων
transliteration: legontev eipate oti oi mayhtai autou nuktov elyontev ekleqan auton hmwn koimwmenwn
draft_translation: Saying, Say, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
ukjv_translation: Saying, Say all of you, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
review_notes: modernized say-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εαν ακουσθη τουτο επι του ηγεμονος ημεις πεισομεν αυτον και υμας αμεριμνους ποιησομεν
transliteration: kai ean akousyh touto epi tou hgemonov hmeiv peisomen auton kai umav amerimnouv poihsomen
draft_translation: And if this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
ukjv_translation: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

greek_text: οι δε λαβοντες τα αργυρια εποιησαν ως εδιδαχθησαν και διεφημισθη ο λογος ουτος παρα ιουδαιοις μεχρι της σημερον
transliteration: oi de labontev ta arguria epoihsan wv edidacyhsan kai diefhmisyh o logov outov para ioudaioiv mecri thv shmeron
draft_translation: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
ukjv_translation: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying (o. logos) is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οι δε ενδεκα μαθηται επορευθησαν εις την γαλιλαιαν εις το ορος ου εταξατο αυτοις ο ιησους
transliteration: oi de endeka mayhtai eporeuyhsan eiv thn galilaian eiv to orov ou etaxato autoiv o ihsouv
draft_translation: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, to a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
ukjv_translation: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

greek_text: και ιδοντες αυτον προσεκυνησαν αυτω οι δε εδιστασαν
transliteration: kai idontev auton prosekunhsan autw oi de edistasan
draft_translation: And when they saw him, they worshiped him: but some doubted.
ukjv_translation: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

greek_text: και προσελθων ο ιησους ελαλησεν αυτοις λεγων εδοθη μοι πασα εξουσια εν ουρανω και επι γης
transliteration: kai proselywn o ihsouv elalhsen autoiv legwn edoyh moi pasa exousia en ouranw kai epi ghv
draft_translation: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, All authority is given to me in heaven and on earth.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus came and spoke unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

greek_text: πορευθεντες ουν μαθητευσατε παντα τα εθνη βαπτιζοντες αυτους εις το ονομα του πατρος και του υιου και του αγιου πνευματος
transliteration: poreuyentev oun mayhteusate panta ta eynh baptizontev autouv eiv to onoma tou patrov kai tou uiou kai tou agiou pneumatov
draft_translation: Go therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit:
ukjv_translation: Go all of you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma)

greek_text: διδασκοντες αυτους τηρειν παντα οσα ενετειλαμην υμιν και ιδου εγω μεθ υμων ειμι πασας τας ημερας εως της συντελειας του αιωνος αμην
transliteration: didaskontev autouv threin panta osa eneteilamhn umin kai idou egw mey umwn eimi pasav tav hmerav ewv thv sunteleiav tou aiwnov amhn
draft_translation: Teaching them to observe all things whatever I have commanded you: and, look, I am with you always, even to the completion of the age. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized lo; modernized whatsoever; rendered synteleia tou aionos as completion of the age

greek_text: αρχη του ευαγγελιου ιησου χριστου υιου του θεου
transliteration: arch tou euaggeliou ihsou cristou uiou tou yeou
draft_translation: Beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ, Son of God.
ukjv_translation: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

greek_text: ως γεγραπται εν τοις προφηταις ιδου εγω αποστελλω τον αγγελον μου προ προσωπου σου ος κατασκευασει την οδον σου εμπροσθεν σου
transliteration: wv gegraptai en toiv profhtaiv idou egw apostellw ton aggelon mou pro proswpou sou ov kataskeuasei thn odon sou emprosyen sou
draft_translation: As it is written in the prophets, Look, I send my messenger before your face, who shall prepare your way before you.
ukjv_translation: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.

greek_text: φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ετοιμασατε την οδον κυριου ευθειας ποιειτε τας τριβους αυτου
transliteration: fwnh bowntov en th erhmw etoimasate thn odon kuriou euyeiav poieite tav tribouv autou
draft_translation: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
ukjv_translation: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare all of you the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

greek_text: εγενετο ιωαννης βαπτιζων εν τη ερημω και κηρυσσων βαπτισμα μετανοιας εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων
transliteration: egeneto iwannhv baptizwn en th erhmw kai khrusswn baptisma metanoiav eiv afesin amartiwn
draft_translation: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
ukjv_translation: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

greek_text: και εξεπορευετο προς αυτον πασα η ιουδαια χωρα και οι ιεροσολυμιται και εβαπτιζοντο παντες εν τω ιορδανη ποταμω υπ αυτου εξομολογουμενοι τας αμαρτιας αυτων
transliteration: kai exeporeueto prov auton pasa h ioudaia cwra kai oi ierosolumitai kai ebaptizonto pantev en tw iordanh potamw up autou exomologoumenoi tav amartiav autwn
draft_translation: And there went out to him all the land of Judea, and those of Jerusalem, and were all baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

ukjv_translation: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

greek_text: και μη δυναμενοι προσεγγισαι αυτω δια τον οχλον απεστεγασαν την στεγην οπου ην και εξορυξαντες χαλωσιν τον κραββατον εφ ω ο παραλυτικος κατεκειτο
transliteration: kai mh dunamenoi proseggisai autw dia ton oclon apestegasan thn steghn opou hn kai exoruxantev calwsin ton krabbaton ef w o paralutikov katekeito
draft_translation: And when they could not come near to him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken through it, they let down the bed in which the one sick with paralysis lay.
ukjv_translation: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

greek_text: ιδων δε ο ιησους την πιστιν αυτων λεγει τω παραλυτικω τεκνον αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου
transliteration: idwn de o ihsouv thn pistin autwn legei tw paralutikw teknon afewntai soi ai amartiai sou
draft_translation: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the sick with paralysis, Son, your sins are forgiven you.
ukjv_translation: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, your sins be forgiven you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized palsy; modernized sick-of wording; modernized sins-be-forgiven wording

greek_text: ησαν δε τινες των γραμματεων εκει καθημενοι και διαλογιζομενοι εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων
transliteration: hsan de tinev twn grammatewn ekei kayhmenoi kai dialogizomenoi en taiv kardiaiv autwn
draft_translation: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
ukjv_translation: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

greek_text: τι ουτος ουτως λαλει βλασφημιας τις δυναται αφιεναι αμαρτιας ει μη εις ο θεος
transliteration: ti outov outwv lalei blasfhmiav tiv dunatai afienai amartiav ei mh eiv o yeov
draft_translation: Why does this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
ukjv_translation: Why does this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ευθεως επιγνους ο ιησους τω πνευματι αυτου οτι ουτως διαλογιζονται εν εαυτοις ειπεν αυτοις τι ταυτα διαλογιζεσθε εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
transliteration: kai euyewv epignouv o ihsouv tw pneumati autou oti outwv dialogizontai en eautoiv eipen autoiv ti tauta dialogizesye en taiv kardiaiv umwn
draft_translation: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said to them, Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
ukjv_translation: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit (o. pneuma) that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason all of you these things in your hearts?

greek_text: τι εστιν ευκοπωτερον ειπειν τω παραλυτικω αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι η ειπειν εγειραι και αρον σου τον κραββατον και περιπατει
transliteration: ti estin eukopwteron eipein tw paralutikw afewntai soi ai amartiai h eipein egeirai kai aron sou ton krabbaton kai peripatei
draft_translation: Which is easier to say to the one sick with paralysis, your sins are forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?
ukjv_translation: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?

greek_text: ινα δε ειδητε οτι εξουσιαν εχει ο υιος του ανθρωπου αφιεναι επι της γης αμαρτιας λεγει τω παραλυτικω
transliteration: ina de eidhte oti exousian ecei o uiov tou anyrwpou afienai epi thv ghv amartiav legei tw paralutikw
draft_translation: But that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins, (he says to the one sick with paralysis,)
ukjv_translation: But that all of you may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, (he says to the sick of the palsy,)

greek_text: σοι λεγω εγειραι και αρον τον κραββατον σου και υπαγε εις τον οικον σου
transliteration: soi legw egeirai kai aron ton krabbaton sou kai upage eiv ton oikon sou
draft_translation: I say to you, Arise, and take up your bed, and go your way into your house.
ukjv_translation: I say unto you, Arise, and take up your bed, and go your way into yours house.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: και ηγερθη ευθεως και αρας τον κραββατον εξηλθεν εναντιον παντων ωστε εξιστασθαι παντας και δοξαζειν τον θεον λεγοντας οτι ουδεποτε ουτως ειδομεν
transliteration: kai hgeryh euyewv kai arav ton krabbaton exhlyen enantion pantwn wste existasyai pantav kai doxazein ton yeon legontav oti oudepote outwv eidomen
draft_translation: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
ukjv_translation: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

greek_text: και εξηλθεν παλιν παρα την θαλασσαν και πας ο οχλος ηρχετο προς αυτον και εδιδασκεν αυτους
transliteration: kai exhlyen palin para thn yalassan kai pav o oclov hrceto prov auton kai edidasken autouv
draft_translation: And he went forth again by the seaside; and all the crowd came to him, and he taught them.
ukjv_translation: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

greek_text: και παραγων ειδεν λευιν τον του αλφαιου καθημενον επι το τελωνιον και λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι και αναστας ηκολουθησεν αυτω
transliteration: kai paragwn eiden leuin ton tou alfaiou kayhmenon epi to telwnion kai legei autw akolouyei moi kai anastav hkolouyhsen autw
draft_translation: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth, and said to him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
ukjv_translation: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized tax-booth idiom

greek_text: και εγενετο εν τω κατακεισθαι αυτον εν τη οικια αυτου και πολλοι τελωναι και αμαρτωλοι συνανεκειντο τω ιησου και τοις μαθηταις αυτου ησαν γαρ πολλοι και ηκολουθησαν αυτω
transliteration: kai egeneto en tw katakeisyai auton en th oikia autou kai polloi telwnai kai amartwloi sunanekeinto tw ihsou kai toiv mayhtaiv autou hsan gar polloi kai hkolouyhsan autw
draft_translation: And it happened, that, as Jesus reclined at table in his house, many tax collectors and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at food in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
review_notes: modernized came-to-pass idiom; modernized reclining-at-meal idiom; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: και οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι ιδοντες αυτον εσθιοντα μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων ελεγον τοις μαθηταις αυτου τι οτι μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων εσθιει και πινει
transliteration: kai oi grammateiv kai oi farisaioi idontev auton esyionta meta twn telwnwn kai amartwlwn elegon toiv mayhtaiv autou ti oti meta twn telwnwn kai amartwlwn esyiei kai pinei
draft_translation: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with tax collectors and sinners, they said to his disciples, How is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?
ukjv_translation: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eats and drinks with publicans and sinners?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered telones as tax collector

greek_text: και ακουσας ο ιησους λεγει αυτοις ου χρειαν εχουσιν οι ισχυοντες ιατρου αλλ οι κακως εχοντες ουκ ηλθον καλεσαι δικαιους αλλα αμαρτωλους εις μετανοιαν
transliteration: kai akousav o ihsouv legei autoiv ou creian ecousin oi iscuontev iatrou all oi kakwv econtev ouk hlyon kalesai dikaiouv alla amartwlouv eiv metanoian
draft_translation: When Jesus heard it, he says to them, Those who are whole have no need of the physician, but those who are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
ukjv_translation: When Jesus heard it, he says unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

greek_text: και ησαν οι μαθηται ιωαννου και οι των φαρισαιων νηστευοντες και ερχονται και λεγουσιν αυτω δια τι οι μαθηται ιωαννου και οι των φαρισαιων νηστευουσιν οι δε σοι μαθηται ου νηστευουσιν
transliteration: kai hsan oi mayhtai iwannou kai oi twn farisaiwn nhsteuontev kai ercontai kai legousin autw dia ti oi mayhtai iwannou kai oi twn farisaiwn nhsteuousin oi de soi mayhtai ou nhsteuousin
draft_translation: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say to him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?
ukjv_translation: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples fast not?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized fast-not wording

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μη δυνανται οι υιοι του νυμφωνος εν ω ο νυμφιος μετ αυτων εστιν νηστευειν οσον χρονον μεθ εαυτων εχουσιν τον νυμφιον ου δυνανται νηστευειν
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv o ihsouv mh dunantai oi uioi tou numfwnov en w o numfiov met autwn estin nhsteuein oson cronon mey eautwn ecousin ton numfion ou dunantai nhsteuein
draft_translation: And Jesus said to them, Can the wedding guests fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

greek_text: ελευσονται δε ημεραι οταν απαρθη απ αυτων ο νυμφιος και τοτε νηστευσουσιν εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
transliteration: eleusontai de hmerai otan aparyh ap autwn o numfiov kai tote nhsteusousin en ekeinaiv taiv hmeraiv
draft_translation: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
ukjv_translation: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ουδεις επιβλημα ρακους αγναφου επιρραπτει επι ιματιω παλαιω ει δε μη αιρει το πληρωμα αυτου το καινον του παλαιου και χειρον σχισμα γινεται
transliteration: kai oudeiv epiblhma rakouv agnafou epirraptei epi imatiw palaiw ei de mh airei to plhrwma autou to kainon tou palaiou kai ceiron scisma ginetai
draft_translation: No one also sews a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up takes away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
ukjv_translation: No man also sews a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up takes away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
review_notes: cleaned old-garment wording; modernized garment where not contextually technical; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: και ουδεις βαλλει οινον νεον εις ασκους παλαιους ει δε μη ρησσει ο οινος ο νεος τους ασκους και ο οινος εκχειται και οι ασκοι απολουνται αλλα οινον νεον εις ασκους καινους βλητεον
transliteration: kai oudeiv ballei oinon neon eiv askouv palaiouv ei de mh rhssei o oinov o neov touv askouv kai o oinov ekceitai kai oi askoi apolountai alla oinon neon eiv askouv kainouv blhteon
draft_translation: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins: else the new wine does burst the wineskins, and the wine is spilled, and the wineskins will be ruined: but new wine must be put into new wineskins.
ukjv_translation: And no man puts new wine into old bottles: else the new wine does burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be ruined: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; rendered askos as wineskin

greek_text: και εγενετο παραπορευεσθαι αυτον εν τοις σαββασιν δια των σποριμων και ηρξαντο οι μαθηται αυτου οδον ποιειν τιλλοντες τους σταχυας
transliteration: kai egeneto paraporeuesyai auton en toiv sabbasin dia twn sporimwn kai hrxanto oi mayhtai autou odon poiein tillontev touv stacuav
draft_translation: And it happened, that he went through the grain fields on the Sabbath; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
review_notes: modernized Sabbath-day wording; modernized came-to-pass idiom; modernized corn as grain

greek_text: και οι φαρισαιοι ελεγον αυτω ιδε τι ποιουσιν εν τοις σαββασιν ο ουκ εξεστιν
transliteration: kai oi farisaioi elegon autw ide ti poiousin en toiv sabbasin o ouk exestin
draft_translation: And the Pharisees said to him, Look, why do they do on the Sabbath that which is not lawful?
ukjv_translation: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

greek_text: και αυτος ελεγεν αυτοις ουδεποτε ανεγνωτε τι εποιησεν δαβιδ οτε χρειαν εσχεν και επεινασεν αυτος και οι μετ αυτου
transliteration: kai autov elegen autoiv oudepote anegnwte ti epoihsen dabid ote creian escen kai epeinasen autov kai oi met autou
draft_translation: And he said to them, Have you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and those who were with him?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Have all of you never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungered, he, and they that were with him?
review_notes: modernized an-hungered idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized they-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: πως εισηλθεν εις τον οικον του θεου επι αβιαθαρ του αρχιερεως και τους αρτους της προθεσεως εφαγεν ους ουκ εξεστιν φαγειν ει μη τοις ιερευσιν και εδωκεν και τοις συν αυτω ουσιν
transliteration: pwv eishlyen eiv ton oikon tou yeou epi abiayar tou arcierewv kai touv artouv thv proyesewv efagen ouv ouk exestin fagein ei mh toiv iereusin kai edwken kai toiv sun autw ousin
draft_translation: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the showbread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?
ukjv_translation: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the showbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

greek_text: και ελεγεν αυτοις το σαββατον δια τον ανθρωπον εγενετο ουχ ο ανθρωπος δια το σαββατον
transliteration: kai elegen autoiv to sabbaton dia ton anyrwpon egeneto ouc o anyrwpov dia to sabbaton
draft_translation: And he said to them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

greek_text: ωστε κυριος εστιν ο υιος του ανθρωπου και του σαββατου
transliteration: wste kuriov estin o uiov tou anyrwpou kai tou sabbatou
draft_translation: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
ukjv_translation: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

greek_text: και εισηλθεν παλιν εις την συναγωγην και ην εκει ανθρωπος εξηραμμενην εχων την χειρα
transliteration: kai eishlyen palin eiv thn sunagwghn kai hn ekei anyrwpov exhrammenhn ecwn thn ceira
draft_translation: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had a withered hand.
ukjv_translation: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

greek_text: και παρετηρουν αυτον ει τοις σαββασιν θεραπευσει αυτον ινα κατηγορησωσιν αυτου
transliteration: kai parethroun auton ei toiv sabbasin yerapeusei auton ina kathgorhswsin autou
draft_translation: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath; that they might accuse him.
ukjv_translation: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

greek_text: και λεγει τω ανθρωπω τω εξηραμμενην εχοντι την χειρα εγειραι εις το μεσον
transliteration: kai legei tw anyrwpw tw exhrammenhn econti thn ceira egeirai eiv to meson
draft_translation: And he says to the man who had the withered hand, Stand up in the midst.
ukjv_translation: And he says unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

greek_text: και λεγει αυτοις εξεστιν τοις σαββασιν αγαθοποιησαι η κακοποιησαι ψυχην σωσαι η αποκτειναι οι δε εσιωπων
transliteration: kai legei autoiv exestin toiv sabbasin agayopoihsai h kakopoihsai quchn swsai h apokteinai oi de esiwpwn
draft_translation: And he says to them, Is it lawful to do good on the Sabbath, or to do evil? To save life, or to kill? But they were silent.
ukjv_translation: And he says unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
review_notes: fixed question casing; modernized Sabbath-days wording; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized held-their-peace idiom

greek_text: και περιβλεψαμενος αυτους μετ οργης συλλυπουμενος επι τη πωρωσει της καρδιας αυτων λεγει τω ανθρωπω εκτεινον την χειρα σου και εξετεινεν και αποκατεσταθη η χειρ αυτου υγιης ως η αλλη
transliteration: kai peribleqamenov autouv met orghv sullupoumenov epi th pwrwsei thv kardiav autwn legei tw anyrwpw ekteinon thn ceira sou kai exeteinen kai apokatestayh h ceir autou ugihv wv h allh
draft_translation: And when he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he says to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
ukjv_translation: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he says unto the man, Stretch forth yours hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

greek_text: και εξελθοντες οι φαρισαιοι ευθεως μετα των ηρωδιανων συμβουλιον εποιουν κατ αυτου οπως αυτον απολεσωσιν
transliteration: kai exelyontev oi farisaioi euyewv meta twn hrwdianwn sumboulion epoioun kat autou opwv auton apoleswsin
draft_translation: And the Pharisees went forth, and immediately took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
ukjv_translation: And the Pharisees went forth, and immediately took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ο ιησους ανεχωρησεν μετα των μαθητων αυτου προς την θαλασσαν και πολυ πληθος απο της γαλιλαιας ηκολουθησαν αυτω και απο της ιουδαιας
transliteration: kai o ihsouv anecwrhsen meta twn mayhtwn autou prov thn yalassan kai polu plhyov apo thv galilaiav hkolouyhsan autw kai apo thv ioudaiav
draft_translation: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judea,
ukjv_translation: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

greek_text: και απο ιεροσολυμων και απο της ιδουμαιας και περαν του ιορδανου και οι περι τυρον και σιδωνα πληθος πολυ ακουσαντες οσα εποιει ηλθον προς αυτον
transliteration: kai apo ierosolumwn kai apo thv idoumaiav kai peran tou iordanou kai oi peri turon kai sidwna plhyov polu akousantev osa epoiei hlyon prov auton
draft_translation: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and from beyond Jordan; and those around Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came to him.
ukjv_translation: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

greek_text: και ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα πλοιαριον προσκαρτερη αυτω δια τον οχλον ινα μη θλιβωσιν αυτον
transliteration: kai eipen toiv mayhtaiv autou ina ploiarion proskarterh autw dia ton oclon ina mh ylibwsin auton
draft_translation: And he spoke to his disciples, that a small boat should be ready for him because of the crowd, lest they should crush him.
ukjv_translation: And he spoke to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should crowd upon him.

greek_text: πολλους γαρ εθεραπευσεν ωστε επιπιπτειν αυτω ινα αυτου αψωνται οσοι ειχον μαστιγας
transliteration: pollouv gar eyerapeusen wste epipiptein autw ina autou aqwntai osoi eicon mastigav
draft_translation: For he had healed many; so that they pressed upon him in order to touch him, as many as had plagues.
ukjv_translation: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him in order to touch him, as many as had plagues.

greek_text: και τα πνευματα τα ακαθαρτα οταν αυτον εθεωρει προσεπιπτεν αυτω και εκραζεν λεγοντα οτι συ ει ο υιος του θεου
transliteration: kai ta pneumata ta akayarta otan auton eyewrei prosepipten autw kai ekrazen legonta oti su ei o uiov tou yeou
draft_translation: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, You are the Son of God.
ukjv_translation: And unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, You are the Son of God.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και πολλα επετιμα αυτοις ινα μη αυτον φανερον ποιησωσιν
transliteration: kai polla epetima autoiv ina mh auton faneron poihswsin
draft_translation: And he strictly charged them that they should not make him known.
ukjv_translation: And he strictly charged them that they should not make him known.
review_notes: fixed charged-them relative artifact; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και αναβαινει εις το ορος και προσκαλειται ους ηθελεν αυτος και απηλθον προς αυτον
transliteration: kai anabainei eiv to orov kai proskaleitai ouv hyelen autov kai aphlyon prov auton
draft_translation: And he goes up onto a mountain, and calls to him whom he wanted: and they came to him.
ukjv_translation: And he goes up into a mountain, and calls unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

greek_text: και εποιησεν δωδεκα ινα ωσιν μετ αυτου και ινα αποστελλη αυτους κηρυσσειν
transliteration: kai epoihsen dwdeka ina wsin met autou kai ina apostellh autouv khrussein
draft_translation: And he appointed twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
ukjv_translation: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

draft_translation: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is out of his mind.

greek_text: και οι γραμματεις οι απο ιεροσολυμων καταβαντες ελεγον οτι βεελζεβουλ εχει και οτι εν τω αρχοντι των δαιμονιων εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια

draft_translation: And he called them to him, and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
ukjv_translation: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

draft_translation: And if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
ukjv_translation: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

draft_translation: And if Satan rises up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.
ukjv_translation: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.

greek_text: ου δυναται ουδεις τα σκευη του ισχυρου εισελθων εις την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασαι εαν μη πρωτον τον ισχυρον δηση και τοτε την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασει

ukjv_translation: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

greek_text: ος δ αν βλασφημηση εις το πνευμα το αγιον ουκ εχει αφεσιν εις τον αιωνα αλλ ενοχος εστιν αιωνιου κρισεως
transliteration: ov d an blasfhmhsh eiv to pneuma to agion ouk ecei afesin eiv ton aiwna all enocov estin aiwniou krisewv

ukjv_translation: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

draft_translation: And the crowd sat around him, and they said to him, Look, your mother and your brothers outside seek you.
ukjv_translation: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, your mother and your brethren without seek for you.

greek_text: και απεκριθη αυτοις λεγων τις εστιν η μητηρ μου η οι αδελφοι μου
transliteration: kai apekriyh autoiv legwn tiv estin h mhthr mou h oi adelfoi mou
draft_translation: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brothers?
ukjv_translation: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

greek_text: και περιβλεψαμενος κυκλω τους περι αυτον καθημενους λεγει ιδε η μητηρ μου και οι αδελφοι μου

draft_translation: And he looked around at those who sat about him, and said, Look, my mother and my brothers!
ukjv_translation: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

transliteration: ov gar an poihsh to yelhma tou yeou outov adelfov mou kai adelfh mou kai mhthr estin
draft_translation: For whoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

greek_text: και παλιν ηρξατο διδασκειν παρα την θαλασσαν και συνηχθη προς αυτον οχλος πολυς ωστε αυτον εμβαντα εις το πλοιον καθησθαι εν τη θαλασση και πας ο οχλος προς την θαλασσαν επι της γης ην
transliteration: kai palin hrxato didaskein para thn yalassan kai sunhcyh prov auton oclov poluv wste auton embanta eiv to ploion kayhsyai en th yalassh kai pav o oclov prov thn yalassan epi thv ghv hn

draft_translation: And he taught them many things in parables, and said to them in his teaching,
ukjv_translation: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

ukjv_translation: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

draft_translation: And it happened, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the birds of the air came and devoured it up.

transliteration: allo de epesen epi to petrwdev opou ouk eicen ghn pollhn kai euyewv exaneteilen dia to mh ecein bayov ghv
draft_translation: And some fell on stony ground, where it did not have much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
ukjv_translation: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

greek_text: ηλιου δε ανατειλαντος εκαυματισθη και δια το μη εχειν ριζαν εξηρανθη
transliteration: hliou de anateilantov ekaumatisyh kai dia to mh ecein rizan exhranyh
draft_translation: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

draft_translation: And when he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parable.
ukjv_translation: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

draft_translation: And he said to them, To you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but to those who are outside, all these things are done in parables:
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

transliteration: ina blepontev blepwsin kai mh idwsin kai akouontev akouwsin kai mh suniwsin mhpote epistreqwsin kai afeyh autoiv ta amarthmata
draft_translation: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

draft_translation: And he said to them, Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket, or under a bed? and not to be set on a lampstand?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

draft_translation: For there is nothing hidden, which shall not be manifested; neither was anything kept secret, but that it should come out.

draft_translation: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.

draft_translation: And he said to them, Take heed what you hear: with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you: and to you that hear shall more be given.

greek_text: ος γαρ αν εχη δοθησεται αυτω και ος ουκ εχει και ο εχει αρθησεται απ αυτου
transliteration: ov gar an ech doyhsetai autw kai ov ouk ecei kai o ecei aryhsetai ap autou
draft_translation: For the one who has, to him shall be given: and the one who has not, from him shall be taken even that which he has.
ukjv_translation: For he that has, to him shall be given: and he that has not, from him shall be taken even that which he has.

greek_text: και ελεγεν ουτως εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου ως εαν ανθρωπος βαλη τον σπορον επι της γης
transliteration: kai elegen outwv estin h basileia tou yeou wv ean anyrwpov balh ton sporon epi thv ghv
draft_translation: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
ukjv_translation: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και καθευδη και εγειρηται νυκτα και ημεραν και ο σπορος βλαστανη και μηκυνηται ως ουκ οιδεν αυτος
transliteration: kai kayeudh kai egeirhtai nukta kai hmeran kai o sporov blastanh kai mhkunhtai wv ouk oiden autov
draft_translation: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he does not know how.
ukjv_translation: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knows not how.

greek_text: αυτοματη γαρ η γη καρποφορει πρωτον χορτον ειτα σταχυν ειτα πληρη σιτον εν τω σταχυι
transliteration: automath gar h gh karpoforei prwton corton eita stacun eita plhrh siton en tw stacui
draft_translation: For the earth produces fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full grain in the ear.
ukjv_translation: For the earth brings forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
review_notes: modernized corn as grain; rendered general brings-forth as produces

greek_text: οταν δε παραδω ο καρπος ευθεως αποστελλει το δρεπανον οτι παρεστηκεν ο θερισμος
transliteration: otan de paradw o karpov euyewv apostellei to drepanon oti paresthken o yerismov
draft_translation: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.
ukjv_translation: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.

greek_text: και ελεγεν τινι ομοιωσωμεν την βασιλειαν του θεου η εν ποια παραβολη παραβαλωμεν αυτην
transliteration: kai elegen tini omoiwswmen thn basileian tou yeou h en poia parabolh parabalwmen authn
draft_translation: And he said, To which shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
ukjv_translation: And he said, Unto which shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

greek_text: ως κοκκω σιναπεως ος οταν σπαρη επι της γης μικροτερος παντων των σπερματων εστιν των επι της γης
transliteration: wv kokkw sinapewv ov otan sparh epi thv ghv mikroterov pantwn twn spermatwn estin twn epi thv ghv
draft_translation: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that are in the earth:
ukjv_translation: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

greek_text: και οταν σπαρη αναβαινει και γινεται παντων των λαχανων μειζων και ποιει κλαδους μεγαλους ωστε δυνασθαι υπο την σκιαν αυτου τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατασκηνουν
transliteration: kai otan sparh anabainei kai ginetai pantwn twn lacanwn meizwn kai poiei kladouv megalouv wste dunasyai upo thn skian autou ta peteina tou ouranou kataskhnoun
draft_translation: But when it is sown, it grows up, and becomes greater than all herbs, and shoots out great branches; so that the birds of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
ukjv_translation: But when it is sown, it grows up, and becomes greater than all herbs, and shoots out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

greek_text: και τοιαυταις παραβολαις πολλαις ελαλει αυτοις τον λογον καθως ηδυναντο ακουειν
transliteration: kai toiautaiv parabolaiv pollaiv elalei autoiv ton logon kaywv hdunanto akouein
draft_translation: And with many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
ukjv_translation: And with many such parables spoke he the word (o. logos) unto them, as they were able to hear it.

greek_text: χωρις δε παραβολης ουκ ελαλει αυτοις κατ ιδιαν δε τοις μαθηταις αυτου επελυεν παντα
transliteration: cwriv de parabolhv ouk elalei autoiv kat idian de toiv mayhtaiv autou epeluen panta
draft_translation: But without a parable he did not speak to them: and when they were alone, he explained all things to his disciples.
ukjv_translation: But without a parable spoke he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

greek_text: και λεγει αυτοις εν εκεινη τη ημερα οψιας γενομενης διελθωμεν εις το περαν
transliteration: kai legei autoiv en ekeinh th hmera oqiav genomenhv dielywmen eiv to peran
draft_translation: And the same day, when evening had come, he says to them, Let us pass over to the other side.
ukjv_translation: And the same day, when the even was come, he says unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

greek_text: και αφεντες τον οχλον παραλαμβανουσιν αυτον ως ην εν τω πλοιω και αλλα δε πλοιαρια ην μετ αυτου
transliteration: kai afentev ton oclon paralambanousin auton wv hn en tw ploiw kai alla de ploiaria hn met autou
draft_translation: And when they had sent away the crowd, they took him even as he was in the boat. And there were also with him other little boats.
ukjv_translation: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

greek_text: και γινεται λαιλαψ ανεμου μεγαλη τα δε κυματα επεβαλλεν εις το πλοιον ωστε αυτο ηδη γεμιζεσθαι
transliteration: kai ginetai lailaq anemou megalh ta de kumata epeballen eiv to ploion wste auto hdh gemizesyai
draft_translation: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, so that it was now full.
ukjv_translation: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

greek_text: και ην αυτος επι τη πρυμνη επι το προσκεφαλαιον καθευδων και διεγειρουσιν αυτον και λεγουσιν αυτω διδασκαλε ου μελει σοι οτι απολλυμεθα
transliteration: kai hn autov epi th prumnh epi to proskefalaion kayeudwn kai diegeirousin auton kai legousin autw didaskale ou melei soi oti apollumeya
draft_translation: And he was in the stern of the boat, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say to him, Teacher, do you not care that we perish?
ukjv_translation: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, care you not that we perish?

greek_text: και διεγερθεις επετιμησεν τω ανεμω και ειπεν τη θαλασση σιωπα πεφιμωσο και εκοπασεν ο ανεμος και εγενετο γαληνη μεγαλη
transliteration: kai diegeryeiv epetimhsen tw anemw kai eipen th yalassh siwpa pefimwso kai ekopasen o anemov kai egeneto galhnh megalh
draft_translation: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
ukjv_translation: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις τι δειλοι εστε ουτως πως ουκ εχετε πιστιν
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv ti deiloi este outwv pwv ouk ecete pistin
draft_translation: And he said to them, Why are you so fearful? how is it that you have no faith?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Why are all of you so fearful? how is it that all of you have no faith?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εφοβηθησαν φοβον μεγαν και ελεγον προς αλληλους τις αρα ουτος εστιν οτι και ο ανεμος και η θαλασσα υπακουουσιν αυτω
transliteration: kai efobhyhsan fobon megan kai elegon prov allhlouv tiv ara outov estin oti kai o anemov kai h yalassa upakouousin autw
draft_translation: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What sort of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
ukjv_translation: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

greek_text: και ηλθον εις το περαν της θαλασσης εις την χωραν των γαδαρηνων
transliteration: kai hlyon eiv to peran thv yalasshv eiv thn cwran twn gadarhnwn
draft_translation: And they came over to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
ukjv_translation: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

greek_text: και εξελθοντι αυτω εκ του πλοιου ευθεως απηντησεν αυτω εκ των μνημειων ανθρωπος εν πνευματι ακαθαρτω
transliteration: kai exelyonti autw ek tou ploiou euyewv aphnthsen autw ek twn mnhmeiwn anyrwpov en pneumati akayartw
draft_translation: And when he had come out of the boat, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
ukjv_translation: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit, (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized was-come perfect; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ploion as boat

greek_text: ος την κατοικησιν ειχεν εν τοις μνημειοις και ουτε αλυσεσιν ουδεις ηδυνατο αυτον δησαι
transliteration: ov thn katoikhsin eicen en toiv mnhmeioiv kai oute alusesin oudeiv hdunato auton dhsai
draft_translation: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no one could bind him, no, not with chains:
ukjv_translation: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

greek_text: δια το αυτον πολλακις πεδαις και αλυσεσιν δεδεσθαι και διεσπασθαι υπ αυτου τας αλυσεις και τας πεδας συντετριφθαι και ουδεις αυτον ισχυεν δαμασαι
transliteration: dia to auton pollakiv pedaiv kai alusesin dedesyai kai diespasyai up autou tav aluseiv kai tav pedav suntetrifyai kai oudeiv auton iscuen damasai
draft_translation: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been pulled apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could anyone tame him.
ukjv_translation: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

greek_text: και δια παντος νυκτος και ημερας εν τοις ορεσιν και εν τοις μνημασιν ην κραζων και κατακοπτων εαυτον λιθοις
transliteration: kai dia pantov nuktov kai hmerav en toiv oresin kai en toiv mnhmasin hn krazwn kai katakoptwn eauton liyoiv
draft_translation: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
ukjv_translation: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ιδων δε τον ιησουν απο μακροθεν εδραμεν και προσεκυνησεν αυτω
transliteration: idwn de ton ihsoun apo makroyen edramen kai prosekunhsen autw
draft_translation: But when he saw Jesus far off, he ran and worshiped him,
ukjv_translation: But when he saw Jesus far off, he ran and worshipped him,

greek_text: και κραξας φωνη μεγαλη ειπεν τι εμοι και σοι ιησου υιε του θεου του υψιστου ορκιζω σε τον θεον μη με βασανισης
transliteration: kai kraxav fwnh megalh eipen ti emoi kai soi ihsou uie tou yeou tou uqistou orkizw se ton yeon mh me basanishv
draft_translation: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, that you do not torment me.
ukjv_translation: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the most high God? I adjure you by God, that you torment me not.

greek_text: ελεγεν γαρ αυτω εξελθε το πνευμα το ακαθαρτον εκ του ανθρωπου
transliteration: elegen gar autw exelye to pneuma to akayarton ek tou anyrwpou
draft_translation: For he said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.
ukjv_translation: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και επηρωτα αυτον τι σοι ονομα και απεκριθη λεγων λεγεων ονομα μοι οτι πολλοι εσμεν
transliteration: kai ephrwta auton ti soi onoma kai apekriyh legwn legewn onoma moi oti polloi esmen
draft_translation: And he asked him, What is your name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
ukjv_translation: And he asked him, What is your name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και παρεκαλει αυτον πολλα ινα μη αυτους αποστειλη εξω της χωρας
transliteration: kai parekalei auton polla ina mh autouv aposteilh exw thv cwrav
draft_translation: And he begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
ukjv_translation: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

greek_text: ην δε εκει προς τα ορη αγελη χοιρων μεγαλη βοσκομενη
transliteration: hn de ekei prov ta orh agelh coirwn megalh boskomenh
draft_translation: Now there was there near the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
ukjv_translation: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

greek_text: και παρεκαλεσαν αυτον παντες οι δαιμονες λεγοντες πεμψον ημας εις τους χοιρους ινα εις αυτους εισελθωμεν
transliteration: kai parekalesan auton pantev oi daimonev legontev pemqon hmav eiv touv coirouv ina eiv autouv eiselywmen
draft_translation: And all the demons begged him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
ukjv_translation: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
review_notes: modernized besought; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και επετρεψεν αυτοις ευθεως ο ιησους και εξελθοντα τα πνευματα τα ακαθαρτα εισηλθον εις τους χοιρους και ωρμησεν η αγελη κατα του κρημνου εις την θαλασσαν ησαν δε ως δισχιλιοι και επνιγοντο εν τη θαλασση
transliteration: kai epetreqen autoiv euyewv o ihsouv kai exelyonta ta pneumata ta akayarta eishlyon eiv touv coirouv kai wrmhsen h agelh kata tou krhmnou eiv thn yalassan hsan de wv discilioi kai epnigonto en th yalassh
draft_translation: And immediately Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
ukjv_translation: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits (o. pneuma) went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
review_notes: modernized forthwith; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οι δε βοσκοντες τους χοιρους εφυγον και ανηγγειλαν εις την πολιν και εις τους αγρους και εξηλθον ιδειν τι εστιν το γεγονος
transliteration: oi de boskontev touv coirouv efugon kai anhggeilan eiv thn polin kai eiv touv agrouv kai exhlyon idein ti estin to gegonov
draft_translation: And those who fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
ukjv_translation: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

greek_text: και ερχονται προς τον ιησουν και θεωρουσιν τον δαιμονιζομενον καθημενον και ιματισμενον και σωφρονουντα τον εσχηκοτα τον λεγεωνα και εφοβηθησαν
transliteration: kai ercontai prov ton ihsoun kai yewrousin ton daimonizomenon kayhmenon kai imatismenon kai swfronounta ton eschkota ton legewna kai efobhyhsan
draft_translation: And they come to Jesus, and see him who was possessed with the demon, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
ukjv_translation: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και διηγησαντο αυτοις οι ιδοντες πως εγενετο τω δαιμονιζομενω και περι των χοιρων
transliteration: kai dihghsanto autoiv oi idontev pwv egeneto tw daimonizomenw kai peri twn coirwn
draft_translation: And those who saw it told them how it befell to him who was possessed with the demon, and also concerning the swine.
ukjv_translation: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized they-that relative; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και ηρξαντο παρακαλειν αυτον απελθειν απο των οριων αυτων
transliteration: kai hrxanto parakalein auton apelyein apo twn oriwn autwn
draft_translation: And they began to pray him to depart out of their borders.
ukjv_translation: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

greek_text: και εμβαντος αυτου εις το πλοιον παρεκαλει αυτον ο δαιμονισθεις ινα η μετ αυτου
transliteration: kai embantov autou eiv to ploion parekalei auton o daimonisyeiv ina h met autou
draft_translation: And when he had come into the boat, the one who had been possessed with the demon asked him that he might be with him.
ukjv_translation: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
review_notes: fixed prayed-him relative artifact; modernized he-that relative; modernized him-that relative; modernized was-come perfect; rendered daimonion as demon; rendered ploion as boat

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ουκ αφηκεν αυτον αλλα λεγει αυτω υπαγε εις τον οικον σου προς τους σους και αναγγειλον αυτοις οσα σοι ο κυριος εποιησεν και ηλεησεν σε
transliteration: o de ihsouv ouk afhken auton alla legei autw upage eiv ton oikon sou prov touv souv kai anaggeilon autoiv osa soi o kuriov epoihsen kai hlehsen se
draft_translation: Nevertheless Jesus did not allow him, but says to him, Go home to your friends, and tell them how great things the Lord has done for you, and has had compassion on you.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless Jesus suffered him not, but says unto him, Go home to your friends, and tell them how great things the Lord has done for you, and has had compassion on you.

greek_text: και απηλθεν και ηρξατο κηρυσσειν εν τη δεκαπολει οσα εποιησεν αυτω ο ιησους και παντες εθαυμαζον
transliteration: kai aphlyen kai hrxato khrussein en th dekapolei osa epoihsen autw o ihsouv kai pantev eyaumazon
draft_translation: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and everyone marveled.
ukjv_translation: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

greek_text: και διαπερασαντος του ιησου εν τω πλοιω παλιν εις το περαν συνηχθη οχλος πολυς επ αυτον και ην παρα την θαλασσαν
transliteration: kai diaperasantov tou ihsou en tw ploiw palin eiv to peran sunhcyh oclov poluv ep auton kai hn para thn yalassan
draft_translation: And when Jesus had crossed over again by boat to the other side, many people gathered to him: and he was near the sea.
ukjv_translation: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

greek_text: και ιδου ερχεται εις των αρχισυναγωγων ονοματι ιαειρος και ιδων αυτον πιπτει προς τους ποδας αυτου
transliteration: kai idou ercetai eiv twn arcisunagwgwn onomati iaeirov kai idwn auton piptei prov touv podav autou
draft_translation: And, look, there comes one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
ukjv_translation: And, behold, there comes one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

greek_text: και παρεκαλει αυτον πολλα λεγων οτι το θυγατριον μου εσχατως εχει ινα ελθων επιθης αυτη τας χειρας οπως σωθη και ζησεται
transliteration: kai parekalei auton polla legwn oti to yugatrion mou escatwv ecei ina elywn epiyhv auth tav ceirav opwv swyh kai zhsetai
draft_translation: And begged him greatly, saying, My little daughter lies at the point of death: I ask you, come and lay your hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
ukjv_translation: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lies at the point of death: I pray you, come and lay your hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

greek_text: και απηλθεν μετ αυτου και ηκολουθει αυτω οχλος πολυς και συνεθλιβον αυτον
transliteration: kai aphlyen met autou kai hkolouyei autw oclov poluv kai suneylibon auton
draft_translation: And Jesus went with him; and many people followed him, and thronged him.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

greek_text: και γυνη τις ουσα εν ρυσει αιματος ετη δωδεκα
transliteration: kai gunh tiv ousa en rusei aimatov eth dwdeka
draft_translation: And a certain woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years,
ukjv_translation: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

greek_text: και πολλα παθουσα υπο πολλων ιατρων και δαπανησασα τα παρ εαυτης παντα και μηδεν ωφεληθεισα αλλα μαλλον εις το χειρον ελθουσα
transliteration: kai polla payousa upo pollwn iatrwn kai dapanhsasa ta par eauthv panta kai mhden wfelhyeisa alla mallon eiv to ceiron elyousa
draft_translation: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was not improved, but rather grew worse,
ukjv_translation: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing improved, but rather grew worse,

greek_text: ακουσασα περι του ιησου ελθουσα εν τω οχλω οπισθεν ηψατο του ιματιου αυτου
transliteration: akousasa peri tou ihsou elyousa en tw oclw opisyen hqato tou imatiou autou
draft_translation: When she had heard of Jesus, she came in the crowd behind, and touched his clothing.
ukjv_translation: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

greek_text: ελεγεν γαρ οτι καν των ιματιων αυτου αψωμαι σωθησομαι
transliteration: elegen gar oti kan twn imatiwn autou aqwmai swyhsomai
draft_translation: For she said, If I may touch even his clothes, I shall be made whole.
ukjv_translation: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

greek_text: και ευθεως εξηρανθη η πηγη του αιματος αυτης και εγνω τω σωματι οτι ιαται απο της μαστιγος
transliteration: kai euyewv exhranyh h phgh tou aimatov authv kai egnw tw swmati oti iatai apo thv mastigov
draft_translation: And immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
ukjv_translation: And immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

greek_text: και ευθεως ο ιησους επιγνους εν εαυτω την εξ αυτου δυναμιν εξελθουσαν επιστραφεις εν τω οχλω ελεγεν τις μου ηψατο των ιματιων
transliteration: kai euyewv o ihsouv epignouv en eautw thn ex autou dunamin exelyousan epistrafeiv en tw oclw elegen tiv mou hqato twn imatiwn
draft_translation: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that power had gone out of him, turned around in the crowd, and said, Who touched my clothes?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

greek_text: και ελεγον αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου βλεπεις τον οχλον συνθλιβοντα σε και λεγεις τις μου ηψατο

draft_translation: And his disciples said to him, You see the crowd thronging you, and you say, Who touched me?
ukjv_translation: And his disciples said unto him, You see the multitude thronging you, and says you, Who touched me?

greek_text: και περιεβλεπετο ιδειν την τουτο ποιησασαν
transliteration: kai perieblepeto idein thn touto poihsasan
draft_translation: And he looked around to see her who had done this thing.
ukjv_translation: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

greek_text: η δε γυνη φοβηθεισα και τρεμουσα ειδυια ο γεγονεν επ αυτη ηλθεν και προσεπεσεν αυτω και ειπεν αυτω πασαν την αληθειαν
transliteration: h de gunh fobhyeisa kai tremousa eiduia o gegonen ep auth hlyen kai prosepesen autw kai eipen autw pasan thn alhyeian
draft_translation: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
ukjv_translation: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
