greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτη θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε υπαγε εις ειρηνην και ισθι υγιης απο της μαστιγος σου
transliteration: o de eipen auth yugater h pistiv sou seswken se upage eiv eirhnhn kai isyi ugihv apo thv mastigov sou
draft_translation: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you whole; go in peace, and be healed of your plague.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto her, Daughter, your faith has made you whole; go in peace, and be whole of your plague.

greek_text: ετι αυτου λαλουντος ερχονται απο του αρχισυναγωγου λεγοντες οτι η θυγατηρ σου απεθανεν τι ετι σκυλλεις τον διδασκαλον
transliteration: eti autou lalountov ercontai apo tou arcisunagwgou legontev oti h yugathr sou apeyanen ti eti skulleiv ton didaskalon
draft_translation: While he yet spoke, certain people came from the ruler of the synagogue's house who said, Your daughter is dead: why trouble the Teacher any further?
ukjv_translation: While he yet spoke, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Your daughter is dead: why trouble you the Master any further?

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ευθεως ακουσας τον λογον λαλουμενον λεγει τω αρχισυναγωγω μη φοβου μονον πιστευε
transliteration: o de ihsouv euyewv akousav ton logon laloumenon legei tw arcisunagwgw mh fobou monon pisteue
draft_translation: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he says to the ruler of the synagogue, Do not be afraid, only believe.
ukjv_translation: As soon as Jesus heard the word (o. logos) that was spoken, he says unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

greek_text: και ουκ αφηκεν ουδενα αυτω συνακολουθησαι ει μη πετρον και ιακωβον και ιωαννην τον αδελφον ιακωβου
transliteration: kai ouk afhken oudena autw sunakolouyhsai ei mh petron kai iakwbon kai iwannhn ton adelfon iakwbou
draft_translation: And he allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
ukjv_translation: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

greek_text: και ερχεται εις τον οικον του αρχισυναγωγου και θεωρει θορυβον και κλαιοντας και αλαλαζοντας πολλα
transliteration: kai ercetai eiv ton oikon tou arcisunagwgou kai yewrei yorubon kai klaiontav kai alalazontav polla
draft_translation: And he comes to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and sees the tumult, and those who wept and wailed greatly.
ukjv_translation: And he comes to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and sees the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

greek_text: και εισελθων λεγει αυτοις τι θορυβεισθε και κλαιετε το παιδιον ουκ απεθανεν αλλα καθευδει
transliteration: kai eiselywn legei autoiv ti yorubeisye kai klaiete to paidion ouk apeyanen alla kayeudei
draft_translation: And when he had come in, he says to them, Why make you this disturbance, and weep? the girl is not dead, but sleeps.
ukjv_translation: And when he was come in, he says unto them, Why make all of you this disturbance, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleeps.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized damsel; modernized was-come perfect; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και κατεγελων αυτου ο δε εκβαλων απαντας παραλαμβανει τον πατερα του παιδιου και την μητερα και τους μετ αυτου και εισπορευεται οπου ην το παιδιον ανακειμενον
transliteration: kai kategelwn autou o de ekbalwn apantav paralambanei ton patera tou paidiou kai thn mhtera kai touv met autou kai eisporeuetai opou hn to paidion anakeimenon
draft_translation: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he takes the father and the mother of the girl, and those who were with him, and enters in where the girl was lying.
ukjv_translation: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he takes the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and enters in where the damsel was lying.

greek_text: και κρατησας της χειρος του παιδιου λεγει αυτη ταλιθα κουμι ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον το κορασιον σοι λεγω εγειραι
transliteration: kai krathsav thv ceirov tou paidiou legei auth taliya koumi o estin meyermhneuomenon to korasion soi legw egeirai
draft_translation: And he took the girl by the hand, and said to her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Girl, I say to you, arise.
ukjv_translation: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto you, arise.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized damsel

greek_text: και ευθεως ανεστη το κορασιον και περιεπατει ην γαρ ετων δωδεκα και εξεστησαν εκστασει μεγαλη
transliteration: kai euyewv anesth to korasion kai periepatei hn gar etwn dwdeka kai exesthsan ekstasei megalh
draft_translation: And immediately the girl arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
ukjv_translation: And immediately the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

greek_text: και διεστειλατο αυτοις πολλα ινα μηδεις γνω τουτο και ειπεν δοθηναι αυτη φαγειν
transliteration: kai diesteilato autoiv polla ina mhdeiv gnw touto kai eipen doyhnai auth fagein
draft_translation: And he charged them strictly that no one should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
ukjv_translation: And he charged them strictly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

greek_text: και εξηλθεν εκειθεν και ηλθεν εις την πατριδα αυτου και ακολουθουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου
transliteration: kai exhlyen ekeiyen kai hlyen eiv thn patrida autou kai akolouyousin autw oi mayhtai autou
draft_translation: And he went out from there, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
ukjv_translation: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

greek_text: και γενομενου σαββατου ηρξατο εν τη συναγωγη διδασκειν και πολλοι ακουοντες εξεπλησσοντο λεγοντες ποθεν τουτω ταυτα και τις η σοφια η δοθεισα αυτω οτι και δυναμεις τοιαυται δια των χειρων αυτου γινονται
transliteration: kai genomenou sabbatou hrxato en th sunagwgh didaskein kai polloi akouontev exeplhssonto legontev poyen toutw tauta kai tiv h sofia h doyeisa autw oti kai dunameiv toiautai dia twn ceirwn autou ginontai
draft_translation: And when the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, from where has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given to him, that even such mighty works are worked by his hands?
ukjv_translation: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
review_notes: fixed from-whence artifact; modernized Sabbath-day wording; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized was-come perfect; modernized whence; modernized wrought

greek_text: ουχ ουτος εστιν ο τεκτων ο υιος μαριας αδελφος δε ιακωβου και ιωση και ιουδα και σιμωνος και ουκ εισιν αι αδελφαι αυτου ωδε προς ημας και εσκανδαλιζοντο εν αυτω
transliteration: ouc outov estin o tektwn o uiov mariav adelfov de iakwbou kai iwsh kai iouda kai simwnov kai ouk eisin ai adelfai autou wde prov hmav kai eskandalizonto en autw
draft_translation: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
ukjv_translation: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
review_notes: standardized contextual NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: ελεγεν δε αυτοις ο ιησους οτι ουκ εστιν προφητης ατιμος ει μη εν τη πατριδι αυτου και εν τοις συγγενεσιν και εν τη οικια αυτου
transliteration: elegen de autoiv o ihsouv oti ouk estin profhthv atimov ei mh en th patridi autou kai en toiv suggenesin kai en th oikia autou
draft_translation: But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
ukjv_translation: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

greek_text: και ουκ ηδυνατο εκει ουδεμιαν δυναμιν ποιησαι ει μη ολιγοις αρρωστοις επιθεις τας χειρας εθεραπευσεν
transliteration: kai ouk hdunato ekei oudemian dunamin poihsai ei mh oligoiv arrwstoiv epiyeiv tav ceirav eyerapeusen
draft_translation: And he could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
ukjv_translation: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

greek_text: και εθαυμαζεν δια την απιστιαν αυτων και περιηγεν τας κωμας κυκλω διδασκων
transliteration: kai eyaumazen dia thn apistian autwn kai perihgen tav kwmav kuklw didaskwn
draft_translation: And he marveled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
ukjv_translation: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

greek_text: και προσκαλειται τους δωδεκα και ηρξατο αυτους αποστελλειν δυο δυο και εδιδου αυτοις εξουσιαν των πνευματων των ακαθαρτων
transliteration: kai proskaleitai touv dwdeka kai hrxato autouv apostellein duo duo kai edidou autoiv exousian twn pneumatwn twn akayartwn
draft_translation: And he called to him the twelve, and began to send them forth two by two; and gave them authority over unclean spirits;
ukjv_translation: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits; (o. pneuma)

greek_text: και παρηγγειλεν αυτοις ινα μηδεν αιρωσιν εις οδον ει μη ραβδον μονον μη πηραν μη αρτον μη εις την ζωνην χαλκον
transliteration: kai parhggeilen autoiv ina mhden airwsin eiv odon ei mh rabdon monon mh phran mh arton mh eiv thn zwnhn calkon
draft_translation: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no pouch, no bread, no money in their purse:
ukjv_translation: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no pouch, no bread, no money in their purse:
review_notes: fixed commanded-them relative artifact; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: αλλ υποδεδεμενους σανδαλια και μη ενδυσασθαι δυο χιτωνας
transliteration: all upodedemenouv sandalia kai mh endusasyai duo citwnav
draft_translation: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two tunics.
ukjv_translation: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

greek_text: και ελεγεν αυτοις οπου εαν εισελθητε εις οικιαν εκει μενετε εως αν εξελθητε εκειθεν
transliteration: kai elegen autoiv opou ean eiselyhte eiv oikian ekei menete ewv an exelyhte ekeiyen
draft_translation: And he said to them, Whatever place you enter into a house, remain there till you depart from that place.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, In what place whatsoever all of you enter into an house, there abide till all of you depart from that place.

greek_text: και οσοι αν μη δεξωνται υμας μηδε ακουσωσιν υμων εκπορευομενοι εκειθεν εκτιναξατε τον χουν τον υποκατω των ποδων υμων εις μαρτυριον αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν ανεκτοτερον εσται σοδομοις η γομορροις εν ημερα κρισεως η τη πολει εκεινη
transliteration: kai osoi an mh dexwntai umav mhde akouswsin umwn ekporeuomenoi ekeiyen ektinaxate ton coun ton upokatw twn podwn umwn eiv marturion autoiv amhn legw umin anektoteron estai sodomoiv h gomorroiv en hmera krisewv h th polei ekeinh
draft_translation: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when you depart from there, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Amen, I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when all of you depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized thence; modernized verily; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: και εξελθοντες εκηρυσσον ινα μετανοησωσιν
transliteration: kai exelyontev ekhrusson ina metanohswsin
draft_translation: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
ukjv_translation: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και δαιμονια πολλα εξεβαλλον και ηλειφον ελαιω πολλους αρρωστους και εθεραπευον
transliteration: kai daimonia polla exeballon kai hleifon elaiw pollouv arrwstouv kai eyerapeuon
draft_translation: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
ukjv_translation: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

greek_text: και ηκουσεν ο βασιλευς ηρωδης φανερον γαρ εγενετο το ονομα αυτου και ελεγεν οτι ιωαννης ο βαπτιζων εκ νεκρων ηγερθη και δια τουτο ενεργουσιν αι δυναμεις εν αυτω
transliteration: kai hkousen o basileuv hrwdhv faneron gar egeneto to onoma autou kai elegen oti iwannhv o baptizwn ek nekrwn hgeryh kai dia touto energousin ai dunameiv en autw
draft_translation: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread widely:) and he said, John the Baptist has risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works show themselves in him.
ukjv_translation: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do show forth themselves in him.

greek_text: αλλοι ελεγον οτι ηλιας εστιν αλλοι δε ελεγον οτι προφητης εστιν η ως εις των προφητων
transliteration: alloi elegon oti hliav estin alloi de elegon oti profhthv estin h wv eiv twn profhtwn
draft_translation: Others said, That it is Elijah. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
ukjv_translation: Others said, That it is Elijah. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ακουσας δε ο ηρωδης ειπεν οτι ον εγω απεκεφαλισα ιωαννην ουτος εστιν αυτος ηγερθη εκ νεκρων
transliteration: akousav de o hrwdhv eipen oti on egw apekefalisa iwannhn outov estin autov hgeryh ek nekrwn
draft_translation: But when Herod heard of it, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he has risen from the dead.
ukjv_translation: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he has risen from the dead.

greek_text: αυτος γαρ ο ηρωδης αποστειλας εκρατησεν τον ιωαννην και εδησεν αυτον εν τη φυλακη δια ηρωδιαδα την γυναικα φιλιππου του αδελφου αυτου οτι αυτην εγαμησεν
transliteration: autov gar o hrwdhv aposteilav ekrathsen ton iwannhn kai edhsen auton en th fulakh dia hrwdiada thn gunaika filippou tou adelfou autou oti authn egamhsen
draft_translation: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: because he had married her.
ukjv_translation: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

greek_text: ελεγεν γαρ ο ιωαννης τω ηρωδη οτι ουκ εξεστιν σοι εχειν την γυναικα του αδελφου σου
transliteration: elegen gar o iwannhv tw hrwdh oti ouk exestin soi ecein thn gunaika tou adelfou sou
draft_translation: For John had said to Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.
ukjv_translation: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.

greek_text: η δε ηρωδιας ενειχεν αυτω και ηθελεν αυτον αποκτειναι και ουκ ηδυνατο
transliteration: h de hrwdiav eneicen autw kai hyelen auton apokteinai kai ouk hdunato
draft_translation: Therefore Herodias held a grudge against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
ukjv_translation: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

greek_text: ο γαρ ηρωδης εφοβειτο τον ιωαννην ειδως αυτον ανδρα δικαιον και αγιον και συνετηρει αυτον και ακουσας αυτου πολλα εποιει και ηδεως αυτου ηκουεν
transliteration: o gar hrwdhv efobeito ton iwannhn eidwv auton andra dikaion kai agion kai sunethrei auton kai akousav autou polla epoiei kai hdewv autou hkouen
draft_translation: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just and holy man, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
ukjv_translation: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
review_notes: fixed adjective-order artifact; modernized article before h-word

greek_text: και γενομενης ημερας ευκαιρου οτε ηρωδης τοις γενεσιοις αυτου δειπνον εποιει τοις μεγιστασιν αυτου και τοις χιλιαρχοις και τοις πρωτοις της γαλιλαιας
transliteration: kai genomenhv hmerav eukairou ote hrwdhv toiv genesioiv autou deipnon epoiei toiv megistasin autou kai toiv ciliarcoiv kai toiv prwtoiv thv galilaiav
draft_translation: And when a suitable day had come, Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief men of Galilee;
ukjv_translation: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

greek_text: και εισελθουσης της θυγατρος αυτης της ηρωδιαδος και ορχησαμενης και αρεσασης τω ηρωδη και τοις συνανακειμενοις ειπεν ο βασιλευς τω κορασιω αιτησον με ο εαν θελης και δωσω σοι
transliteration: kai eiselyoushv thv yugatrov authv thv hrwdiadov kai orchsamenhv kai aresashv tw hrwdh kai toiv sunanakeimenoiv eipen o basileuv tw korasiw aithson me o ean yelhv kai dwsw soi
draft_translation: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and those who sat with him, the king said to the girl, Ask of me whatever you will, and I will give it you.
ukjv_translation: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever you will, and I will give it you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized damsel; modernized them-that relative; modernized whatsoever

greek_text: και ωμοσεν αυτη οτι ο εαν με αιτησης δωσω σοι εως ημισους της βασιλειας μου
transliteration: kai wmosen auth oti o ean me aithshv dwsw soi ewv hmisouv thv basileiav mou
draft_translation: And he swore to her, Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give it to you, up to the half of my kingdom.
ukjv_translation: And he swore unto her, Whatsoever you shall ask of me, I will give it you, unto the half of my kingdom.

greek_text: η δε εξελθουσα ειπεν τη μητρι αυτης τι αιτησομαι η δε ειπεν την κεφαλην ιωαννου του βαπτιστου
transliteration: h de exelyousa eipen th mhtri authv ti aithsomai h de eipen thn kefalhn iwannou tou baptistou
draft_translation: And she went forth, and said to her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
ukjv_translation: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

greek_text: και εισελθουσα ευθεως μετα σπουδης προς τον βασιλεα ητησατο λεγουσα θελω ινα μοι δως εξαυτης επι πινακι την κεφαλην ιωαννου του βαπτιστου
transliteration: kai eiselyousa euyewv meta spoudhv prov ton basilea hthsato legousa yelw ina moi dwv exauthv epi pinaki thn kefalhn iwannou tou baptistou
draft_translation: And she came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, saying, I will that you give me immediately in a platter the head of John the Baptist.
ukjv_translation: And she came in immediately with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that you give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

draft_translation: But you say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatever you might have been profited by me; he shall be free.

greek_text: και ουκετι αφιετε αυτον ουδεν ποιησαι τω πατρι αυτου η τη μητρι αυτου
transliteration: kai ouketi afiete auton ouden poihsai tw patri autou h th mhtri autou
draft_translation: And you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother;
ukjv_translation: And all of you suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

greek_text: ακυρουντες τον λογον του θεου τη παραδοσει υμων η παρεδωκατε και παρομοια τοιαυτα πολλα ποιειτε
transliteration: akurountev ton logon tou yeou th paradosei umwn h paredwkate kai paromoia toiauta polla poieite
draft_translation: Making the word of God of no effect through your tradition, which you have delivered: and many such things you do.
ukjv_translation: Making the word (o. logos) of God of no effect through your tradition, which all of you have delivered: and many such like things do all of you.

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος παντα τον οχλον ελεγεν αυτοις ακουετε μου παντες και συνιετε
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov panta ton oclon elegen autoiv akouete mou pantev kai suniete
draft_translation: And when he had called all the people to him, he said to them, Listen to me every one of you, and understand:
ukjv_translation: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized hearken

greek_text: ουδεν εστιν εξωθεν του ανθρωπου εισπορευομενον εις αυτον ο δυναται αυτον κοινωσαι αλλα τα εκπορευομενα απ αυτου εκεινα εστιν τα κοινουντα τον ανθρωπον
transliteration: ouden estin exwyen tou anyrwpou eisporeuomenon eiv auton o dunatai auton koinwsai alla ta ekporeuomena ap autou ekeina estin ta koinounta ton anyrwpon
draft_translation: There is nothing from outside a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are the things that defile the man.
ukjv_translation: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

greek_text: ει τις εχει ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
transliteration: ei tiv ecei wta akouein akouetw
draft_translation: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.
ukjv_translation: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

greek_text: και οτε εισηλθεν εις οικον απο του οχλου επηρωτων αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου περι της παραβολης
transliteration: kai ote eishlyen eiv oikon apo tou oclou ephrwtwn auton oi mayhtai autou peri thv parabolhv
draft_translation: And when he had entered into the house away from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
ukjv_translation: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

greek_text: και λεγει αυτοις ουτως και υμεις ασυνετοι εστε ου νοειτε οτι παν το εξωθεν εισπορευομενον εις τον ανθρωπον ου δυναται αυτον κοινωσαι
transliteration: kai legei autoiv outwv kai umeiv asunetoi este ou noeite oti pan to exwyen eisporeuomenon eiv ton anyrwpon ou dunatai auton koinwsai
draft_translation: And he says to them, Are you also so without understanding? Do you not perceive, that whatever thing from outside enters into the man, it cannot defile him;
ukjv_translation: And he says unto them, Are all of you so without understanding also? Do all of you not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without enters into the man, it cannot defile him;

greek_text: οτι ουκ εισπορευεται αυτου εις την καρδιαν αλλ εις την κοιλιαν και εις τον αφεδρωνα εκπορευεται καθαριζον παντα τα βρωματα
transliteration: oti ouk eisporeuetai autou eiv thn kardian all eiv thn koilian kai eiv ton afedrwna ekporeuetai kayarizon panta ta brwmata
draft_translation: Because it enters not into his heart, but into the belly, and goes out into the latrine, purging all foods?
ukjv_translation: Because it enters not into his heart, but into the belly, and goes out into the draught, purging all meats?
review_notes: modernized meats; rendered draught as latrine

greek_text: ελεγεν δε οτι το εκ του ανθρωπου εκπορευομενον εκεινο κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
transliteration: elegen de oti to ek tou anyrwpou ekporeuomenon ekeino koinoi ton anyrwpon
draft_translation: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that defiles the man.
ukjv_translation: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that defiles the man.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εσωθεν γαρ εκ της καρδιας των ανθρωπων οι διαλογισμοι οι κακοι εκπορευονται μοιχειαι πορνειαι φονοι
transliteration: eswyen gar ek thv kardiav twn anyrwpwn oi dialogismoi oi kakoi ekporeuontai moiceiai porneiai fonoi
draft_translation: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual immoralities, murders,
ukjv_translation: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

greek_text: κλοπαι πλεονεξιαι πονηριαι δολος ασελγεια οφθαλμος πονηρος βλασφημια υπερηφανια αφροσυνη
transliteration: klopai pleonexiai ponhriai dolov aselgeia ofyalmov ponhrov blasfhmia uperhfania afrosunh
draft_translation: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, licentiousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
ukjv_translation: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

greek_text: παντα ταυτα τα πονηρα εσωθεν εκπορευεται και κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
transliteration: panta tauta ta ponhra eswyen ekporeuetai kai koinoi ton anyrwpon
draft_translation: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
ukjv_translation: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εκειθεν αναστας απηλθεν εις τα μεθορια τυρου και σιδωνος και εισελθων εις την οικιαν ουδενα ηθελεν γνωναι και ουκ ηδυνηθη λαθειν
transliteration: kai ekeiyen anastav aphlyen eiv ta meyoria turou kai sidwnov kai eiselywn eiv thn oikian oudena hyelen gnwnai kai ouk hdunhyh layein
draft_translation: And from there he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into a house, and would have no one know it: but he could not be hidden.
ukjv_translation: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

greek_text: ακουσασα γαρ γυνη περι αυτου ης ειχεν το θυγατριον αυτης πνευμα ακαθαρτον ελθουσα προσεπεσεν προς τους ποδας αυτου
transliteration: akousasa gar gunh peri autou hv eicen to yugatrion authv pneuma akayarton elyousa prosepesen prov touv podav autou
draft_translation: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
ukjv_translation: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, (o. pneuma) heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ην δε η γυνη ελληνις συροφοινισσα τω γενει και ηρωτα αυτον ινα το δαιμονιον εκβαλλη εκ της θυγατρος αυτης
transliteration: hn de h gunh ellhniv surofoinissa tw genei kai hrwta auton ina to daimonion ekballh ek thv yugatrov authv
draft_translation: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she begged him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
ukjv_translation: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized besought; modernized him-that relative; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτη αφες πρωτον χορτασθηναι τα τεκνα ου γαρ καλον εστιν λαβειν τον αρτον των τεκνων και βαλειν τοις κυναριοις
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen auth afev prwton cortasyhnai ta tekna ou gar kalon estin labein ton arton twn teknwn kai balein toiv kunarioiv
draft_translation: But Jesus said to her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not fitting to take the children's bread, and to cast it to the dogs.
ukjv_translation: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized meet-as-fitting

greek_text: η δε απεκριθη και λεγει αυτω ναι κυριε και γαρ τα κυναρια υποκατω της τραπεζης εσθιει απο των ψιχιων των παιδιων
transliteration: h de apekriyh kai legei autw nai kurie kai gar ta kunaria upokatw thv trapezhv esyiei apo twn qiciwn twn paidiwn
draft_translation: And she answered and said to him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
ukjv_translation: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτη δια τουτον τον λογον υπαγε εξεληλυθεν το δαιμονιον εκ της θυγατρος σου
transliteration: kai eipen auth dia touton ton logon upage exelhluyen to daimonion ek thv yugatrov sou
draft_translation: And he said to her, For this saying go your way; the demon is gone out of your daughter.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto her, For this saying (o. logos) go your way; the devil is gone out of your daughter.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και απελθουσα εις τον οικον αυτης ευρεν το δαιμονιον εξεληλυθος και την θυγατερα βεβλημενην επι της κλινης
transliteration: kai apelyousa eiv ton oikon authv euren to daimonion exelhluyov kai thn yugatera beblhmenhn epi thv klinhv
draft_translation: And when she had come to her house, she found the demon gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
ukjv_translation: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
review_notes: modernized was-come perfect; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και παλιν εξελθων εκ των οριων τυρου και σιδωνος ηλθεν προς την θαλασσαν της γαλιλαιας ανα μεσον των οριων δεκαπολεως
transliteration: kai palin exelywn ek twn oriwn turou kai sidwnov hlyen prov thn yalassan thv galilaiav ana meson twn oriwn dekapolewv
draft_translation: And again, departing from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, he came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the borders of Decapolis.
ukjv_translation: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

greek_text: και φερουσιν αυτω κωφον μογιλαλον και παρακαλουσιν αυτον ινα επιθη αυτω την χειρα
transliteration: kai ferousin autw kwfon mogilalon kai parakalousin auton ina epiyh autw thn ceira
draft_translation: And they bring to him one that was deaf, and had a speech impediment; and they plead to him to put his hand upon him.
ukjv_translation: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an barrier in his speech; and they plead to him to put his hand upon him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized speech-impediment wording

greek_text: και απολαβομενος αυτον απο του οχλου κατ ιδιαν εβαλεν τους δακτυλους αυτου εις τα ωτα αυτου και πτυσας ηψατο της γλωσσης αυτου
transliteration: kai apolabomenov auton apo tou oclou kat idian ebalen touv daktulouv autou eiv ta wta autou kai ptusav hqato thv glwsshv autou
draft_translation: And he took him aside from the crowd, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
ukjv_translation: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

greek_text: και αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον εστεναξεν και λεγει αυτω εφφαθα ο εστιν διανοιχθητι
transliteration: kai anableqav eiv ton ouranon estenaxen kai legei autw effaya o estin dianoicyhti
draft_translation: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and says to him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
ukjv_translation: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and says unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

greek_text: και ευθεως διηνοιχθησαν αυτου αι ακοαι και ελυθη ο δεσμος της γλωσσης αυτου και ελαλει ορθως
transliteration: kai euyewv dihnoicyhsan autou ai akoai kai eluyh o desmov thv glwsshv autou kai elalei orywv
draft_translation: And immediately his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plainly.
ukjv_translation: And immediately his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plain.

greek_text: και διεστειλατο αυτοις ινα μηδενι ειπωσιν οσον δε αυτος αυτοις διεστελλετο μαλλον περισσοτερον εκηρυσσον
transliteration: kai diesteilato autoiv ina mhdeni eipwsin oson de autov autoiv diestelleto mallon perissoteron ekhrusson
draft_translation: And he charged them that they should tell no one: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
ukjv_translation: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
review_notes: fixed charged-them relative artifact; modernized no-man idiom; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και υπερπερισσως εξεπλησσοντο λεγοντες καλως παντα πεποιηκεν και τους κωφους ποιει ακουειν και τους αλαλους λαλειν
transliteration: kai uperperisswv exeplhssonto legontev kalwv panta pepoihken kai touv kwfouv poiei akouein kai touv alalouv lalein
draft_translation: And they were beyond measure astonished, saying, He has done all things well: he makes both the deaf to hear, and the mute to speak.
ukjv_translation: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He has done all things well: he makes both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

greek_text: εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις παμπολλου οχλου οντος και μη εχοντων τι φαγωσιν προσκαλεσαμενος ο ιησους τους μαθητας αυτου λεγει αυτοις
transliteration: en ekeinaiv taiv hmeraiv pampollou oclou ontov kai mh econtwn ti fagwsin proskalesamenov o ihsouv touv mayhtav autou legei autoiv
draft_translation: In those days, the crowd being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him, and says to them,
ukjv_translation: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and says unto them,

greek_text: σπλαγχνιζομαι επι τον οχλον οτι ηδη ημερας τρεις προσμενουσιν μοι και ουκ εχουσιν τι φαγωσιν
transliteration: splagcnizomai epi ton oclon oti hdh hmerav treiv prosmenousin moi kai ouk ecousin ti fagwsin
draft_translation: I have compassion on the crowd, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
ukjv_translation: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

greek_text: και εαν απολυσω αυτους νηστεις εις οικον αυτων εκλυθησονται εν τη οδω τινες γαρ αυτων μακροθεν ηκασιν
transliteration: kai ean apolusw autouv nhsteiv eiv oikon autwn ekluyhsontai en th odw tinev gar autwn makroyen hkasin
draft_translation: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for some of them came from far.
ukjv_translation: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

greek_text: και απεκριθησαν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ποθεν τουτους δυνησεται τις ωδε χορτασαι αρτων επ ερημιας
transliteration: kai apekriyhsan autw oi mayhtai autou poyen toutouv dunhsetai tiv wde cortasai artwn ep erhmiav
draft_translation: And his disciples answered him, from where can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
ukjv_translation: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

greek_text: και επηρωτα αυτους ποσους εχετε αρτους οι δε ειπον επτα
transliteration: kai ephrwta autouv posouv ecete artouv oi de eipon epta
draft_translation: And he asked them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven.
ukjv_translation: And he asked them, How many loaves have all of you? And they said, Seven.

greek_text: και παρηγγειλεν τω οχλω αναπεσειν επι της γης και λαβων τους επτα αρτους ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα παραθωσιν και παρεθηκαν τω οχλω
transliteration: kai parhggeilen tw oclw anapesein epi thv ghv kai labwn touv epta artouv eucaristhsav eklasen kai edidou toiv mayhtaiv autou ina paraywsin kai pareyhkan tw oclw
draft_translation: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and broke them, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and they set them before the people.
ukjv_translation: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

greek_text: και ειχον ιχθυδια ολιγα και ευλογησας ειπεν παραθειναι και αυτα
transliteration: kai eicon icyudia oliga kai euloghsav eipen parayeinai kai auta
draft_translation: And they had a few small fish: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
ukjv_translation: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

greek_text: εφαγον δε και εχορτασθησαν και ηραν περισσευματα κλασματων επτα σπυριδας
transliteration: efagon de kai ecortasyhsan kai hran perisseumata klasmatwn epta spuridav
draft_translation: So they all ate, and were filled: and they took up of the broken food that was left seven baskets.
ukjv_translation: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken food that was left seven baskets.

greek_text: ησαν δε οι φαγοντες ως τετρακισχιλιοι και απελυσεν αυτους
transliteration: hsan de oi fagontev wv tetrakiscilioi kai apelusen autouv
draft_translation: And those who had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
ukjv_translation: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

greek_text: και ευθεως εμβας εις το πλοιον μετα των μαθητων αυτου ηλθεν εις τα μερη δαλμανουθα
transliteration: kai euyewv embav eiv to ploion meta twn mayhtwn autou hlyen eiv ta merh dalmanouya
draft_translation: And immediately he entered into a boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
ukjv_translation: And immediately he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

greek_text: και εξηλθον οι φαρισαιοι και ηρξαντο συζητειν αυτω ζητουντες παρ αυτου σημειον απο του ουρανου πειραζοντες αυτον
transliteration: kai exhlyon oi farisaioi kai hrxanto suzhtein autw zhtountev par autou shmeion apo tou ouranou peirazontev auton
draft_translation: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, testing him.
ukjv_translation: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

greek_text: και αναστεναξας τω πνευματι αυτου λεγει τι η γενεα αυτη σημειον επιζητει αμην λεγω υμιν ει δοθησεται τη γενεα ταυτη σημειον
transliteration: kai anastenaxav tw pneumati autou legei ti h genea auth shmeion epizhtei amhn legw umin ei doyhsetai th genea tauth shmeion
draft_translation: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and says, Why does this generation seek after a sign? Amen, I say to you, There shall no sign be given to this generation.
ukjv_translation: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, (o. pneuma) and says, Why does this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: και αφεις αυτους εμβας παλιν εις το πλοιον απηλθεν εις το περαν
transliteration: kai afeiv autouv embav palin eiv to ploion aphlyen eiv to peran
draft_translation: And he left them, and entering into the boat again departed to the other side.
ukjv_translation: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

greek_text: και επελαθοντο οι μαθηται λαβειν αρτους και ει μη ενα αρτον ουκ ειχον μεθ εαυτων εν τω πλοιω
transliteration: kai epelayonto oi mayhtai labein artouv kai ei mh ena arton ouk eicon mey eautwn en tw ploiw
draft_translation: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the boat with them more than one loaf.
ukjv_translation: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

greek_text: και διεστελλετο αυτοις λεγων ορατε βλεπετε απο της ζυμης των φαρισαιων και της ζυμης ηρωδου
transliteration: kai diestelleto autoiv legwn orate blepete apo thv zumhv twn farisaiwn kai thv zumhv hrwdou
draft_translation: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
ukjv_translation: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και διελογιζοντο προς αλληλους λεγοντες οτι αρτους ουκ εχομεν
transliteration: kai dielogizonto prov allhlouv legontev oti artouv ouk ecomen
draft_translation: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
ukjv_translation: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και γνους ο ιησους λεγει αυτοις τι διαλογιζεσθε οτι αρτους ουκ εχετε ουπω νοειτε ουδε συνιετε ετι πεπωρωμενην εχετε την καρδιαν υμων
transliteration: kai gnouv o ihsouv legei autoiv ti dialogizesye oti artouv ouk ecete oupw noeite oude suniete eti pepwrwmenhn ecete thn kardian umwn
draft_translation: And when Jesus knew it, he says to them, Why do you reason, because you have no bread? do you not yet perceive, nor understand? is your heart still hardened?
ukjv_translation: And when Jesus knew it, he says unto them, Why reason all of you, because all of you have no bread? perceive all of you not yet, neither understand? have all of you your heart yet hardened?

greek_text: οφθαλμους εχοντες ου βλεπετε και ωτα εχοντες ουκ ακουετε και ου μνημονευετε
transliteration: ofyalmouv econtev ou blepete kai wta econtev ouk akouete kai ou mnhmoneuete
draft_translation: Having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, do you not hear? and do you not remember?
ukjv_translation: Having eyes, see all of you not? and having ears, hear all of you not? and do all of you not remember?

greek_text: οτε τους πεντε αρτους εκλασα εις τους πεντακισχιλιους ποσους κοφινους πληρεις κλασματων ηρατε λεγουσιν αυτω δωδεκα
transliteration: ote touv pente artouv eklasa eiv touv pentakisciliouv posouv kofinouv plhreiv klasmatwn hrate legousin autw dwdeka
draft_translation: When I broke the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments did you take up? They say to him, Twelve.
ukjv_translation: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took all of you up? They say unto him, Twelve.

greek_text: οτε δε τους επτα εις τους τετρακισχιλιους ποσων σπυριδων πληρωματα κλασματων ηρατε οι δε ειπον επτα
transliteration: ote de touv epta eiv touv tetrakisciliouv poswn spuridwn plhrwmata klasmatwn hrate oi de eipon epta
draft_translation: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments did you take up? And they said, Seven.
ukjv_translation: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took all of you up? And they said, Seven.

greek_text: και ελεγεν αυτοις πως ου συνιετε
transliteration: kai elegen autoiv pwv ou suniete
draft_translation: And he said to them, How is it that you do not understand?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, How is it that all of you do not understand?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και ερχεται εις βηθσαιδα και φερουσιν αυτω τυφλον και παρακαλουσιν αυτον ινα αυτου αψηται
transliteration: kai ercetai eiv bhysaida kai ferousin autw tuflon kai parakalousin auton ina autou aqhtai
draft_translation: And he comes to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.
ukjv_translation: And he comes to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

greek_text: και επιλαβομενος της χειρος του τυφλου εξηγαγεν αυτον εξω της κωμης και πτυσας εις τα ομματα αυτου επιθεις τας χειρας αυτω επηρωτα αυτον ει τι βλεπει
transliteration: kai epilabomenov thv ceirov tou tuflou exhgagen auton exw thv kwmhv kai ptusav eiv ta ommata autou epiyeiv tav ceirav autw ephrwta auton ei ti blepei
draft_translation: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw anything.
ukjv_translation: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

greek_text: και αναβλεψας ελεγεν βλεπω τους ανθρωπους ως δενδρα περιπατουντας
transliteration: kai anableqav elegen blepw touv anyrwpouv wv dendra peripatountav
draft_translation: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
ukjv_translation: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειτα παλιν επεθηκεν τας χειρας επι τους οφθαλμους αυτου και εποιησεν αυτον αναβλεψαι και αποκατεσταθη και ενεβλεψεν τηλαυγως απαντας
transliteration: eita palin epeyhken tav ceirav epi touv ofyalmouv autou kai epoihsen auton anableqai kai apokatestayh kai enebleqen thlaugwv apantav
draft_translation: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
ukjv_translation: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

greek_text: και απεστειλεν αυτον εις τον οικον αυτου λεγων μηδε εις την κωμην εισελθης μηδε ειπης τινι εν τη κωμη
transliteration: kai apesteilen auton eiv ton oikon autou legwn mhde eiv thn kwmhn eiselyhv mhde eiphv tini en th kwmh
draft_translation: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Do not go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
ukjv_translation: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

greek_text: και εξηλθεν ο ιησους και οι μαθηται αυτου εις τας κωμας καισαρειας της φιλιππου και εν τη οδω επηρωτα τους μαθητας αυτου λεγων αυτοις τινα με λεγουσιν οι ανθρωποι ειναι
transliteration: kai exhlyen o ihsouv kai oi mayhtai autou eiv tav kwmav kaisareiav thv filippou kai en th odw ephrwta touv mayhtav autou legwn autoiv tina me legousin oi anyrwpoi einai
draft_translation: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and on the way he asked his disciples, saying to them, Who do men say that I am?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

greek_text: οι δε απεκριθησαν ιωαννην τον βαπτιστην και αλλοι ηλιαν αλλοι δε ενα των προφητων
transliteration: oi de apekriyhsan iwannhn ton baptisthn kai alloi hlian alloi de ena twn profhtwn
draft_translation: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others, One of the prophets.
ukjv_translation: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others, One of the prophets.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και αυτος λεγει αυτοις υμεις δε τινα με λεγετε ειναι αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος λεγει αυτω συ ει ο χριστος
transliteration: kai autov legei autoiv umeiv de tina me legete einai apokriyeiv de o petrov legei autw su ei o cristov
draft_translation: And he says to them, But who do you say that I am? And Peter answers and says to him, You are the Christ.
ukjv_translation: And he says unto them, But whom say all of you that I am? And Peter answers and says unto him, You are the Christ.
review_notes: fixed question casing; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized inverted question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και επετιμησεν αυτοις ινα μηδενι λεγωσιν περι αυτου
transliteration: kai epetimhsen autoiv ina mhdeni legwsin peri autou
draft_translation: And he charged them that they should tell no one of him.
ukjv_translation: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
review_notes: fixed charged-them relative artifact; modernized no-man idiom; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και ηρξατο διδασκειν αυτους οτι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου πολλα παθειν και αποδοκιμασθηναι απο των πρεσβυτερων και αρχιερεων και γραμματεων και αποκτανθηναι και μετα τρεις ημερας αναστηναι
transliteration: kai hrxato didaskein autouv oti dei ton uion tou anyrwpou polla payein kai apodokimasyhnai apo twn presbuterwn kai arcierewn kai grammatewn kai apoktanyhnai kai meta treiv hmerav anasthnai
draft_translation: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and by the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
ukjv_translation: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

greek_text: και παρρησια τον λογον ελαλει και προσλαβομενος αυτον ο πετρος ηρξατο επιτιμαν αυτω
transliteration: kai parrhsia ton logon elalei kai proslabomenov auton o petrov hrxato epitiman autw
draft_translation: And he spoke that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
ukjv_translation: And he spoke that saying (o. logos) openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ο δε επιστραφεις και ιδων τους μαθητας αυτου επετιμησεν τω πετρω λεγων υπαγε οπισω μου σατανα οτι ου φρονεις τα του θεου αλλα τα των ανθρωπων
transliteration: o de epistrafeiv kai idwn touv mayhtav autou epetimhsen tw petrw legwn upage opisw mou satana oti ou froneiv ta tou yeou alla ta twn anyrwpwn
draft_translation: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get behind me, Satan: for you do not mind the things that are of God, but the things that are of men.
ukjv_translation: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get you behind me, Satan: for you savour not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
review_notes: modernized get-you imperative; modernized savour; modernized things-that-be wording; rendered phroneo as mind

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος τον οχλον συν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ειπεν αυτοις οστις θελει οπισω μου ελθειν απαρνησασθω εαυτον και αρατω τον σταυρον αυτου και ακολουθειτω μοι
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov ton oclon sun toiv mayhtaiv autou eipen autoiv ostiv yelei opisw mou elyein aparnhsasyw eauton kai aratw ton stauron autou kai akolouyeitw moi
draft_translation: And when he had called the people to him with his disciples also, he said to them, Whoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
ukjv_translation: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whosoever

greek_text: ος γαρ αν θελη την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην ος δ αν απολεση την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου και του ευαγγελιου ουτος σωσει αυτην
transliteration: ov gar an yelh thn quchn autou swsai apolesei authn ov d an apolesh thn quchn autou eneken emou kai tou euaggeliou outov swsei authn
draft_translation: For whoever will save his life shall lose it; but whoever shall lose his life for my sake and the good news, the same shall save it.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
review_notes: fixed good-news possessive artifact; modernized whosoever; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: τι γαρ ωφελησει ανθρωπον εαν κερδηση τον κοσμον ολον και ζημιωθη την ψυχην αυτου
transliteration: ti gar wfelhsei anyrwpon ean kerdhsh ton kosmon olon kai zhmiwyh thn quchn autou
draft_translation: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
ukjv_translation: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: η τι δωσει ανθρωπος ανταλλαγμα της ψυχης αυτου
transliteration: h ti dwsei anyrwpov antallagma thv quchv autou
draft_translation: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
ukjv_translation: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ος γαρ αν επαισχυνθη με και τους εμους λογους εν τη γενεα ταυτη τη μοιχαλιδι και αμαρτωλω και ο υιος του ανθρωπου επαισχυνθησεται αυτον οταν ελθη εν τη δοξη του πατρος αυτου μετα των αγγελων των αγιων
transliteration: ov gar an epaiscunyh me kai touv emouv logouv en th genea tauth th moicalidi kai amartwlw kai o uiov tou anyrwpou epaiscunyhsetai auton otan elyh en th doxh tou patrov autou meta twn aggelwn twn agiwn
draft_translation: Whoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words (o. logos) in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

greek_text: και ελεγεν αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εισιν τινες των ωδε εστηκοτων οιτινες ου μη γευσωνται θανατου εως αν ιδωσιν την βασιλειαν του θεου εληλυθυιαν εν δυναμει
transliteration: kai elegen autoiv amhn legw umin oti eisin tinev twn wde esthkotwn oitinev ou mh geuswntai yanatou ewv an idwsin thn basileian tou yeou elhluyuian en dunamei
draft_translation: And he said to them, Amen, I say to you, That there is some of those who stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; modernized there-be idiom; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: και μεθ ημερας εξ παραλαμβανει ο ιησους τον πετρον και τον ιακωβον και τον ιωαννην και αναφερει αυτους εις ορος υψηλον κατ ιδιαν μονους και μετεμορφωθη εμπροσθεν αυτων
transliteration: kai mey hmerav ex paralambanei o ihsouv ton petron kai ton iakwbon kai ton iwannhn kai anaferei autouv eiv orov uqhlon kat idian monouv kai metemorfwyh emprosyen autwn
draft_translation: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, and leads them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
ukjv_translation: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, and leads them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

greek_text: και τα ιματια αυτου εγενετο στιλβοντα λευκα λιαν ως χιων οια γναφευς επι της γης ου δυναται λευκαναι
transliteration: kai ta imatia autou egeneto stilbonta leuka lian wv ciwn oia gnafeuv epi thv ghv ou dunatai leukanai
draft_translation: And his clothing became shining, exceedingly white as snow; such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
ukjv_translation: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no launderer on earth can white them.

greek_text: και ωφθη αυτοις ηλιας συν μωσει και ησαν συλλαλουντες τω ιησου
transliteration: kai wfyh autoiv hliav sun mwsei kai hsan sullalountev tw ihsou
draft_translation: And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
ukjv_translation: And there appeared unto them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

greek_text: και αποκριθεις ο πετρος λεγει τω ιησου ραββι καλον εστιν ημας ωδε ειναι και ποιησωμεν σκηνας τρεις σοι μιαν και μωσει μιαν και ηλια μιαν
transliteration: kai apokriyeiv o petrov legei tw ihsou rabbi kalon estin hmav wde einai kai poihswmen skhnav treiv soi mian kai mwsei mian kai hlia mian
draft_translation: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Teacher, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
ukjv_translation: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

greek_text: ου γαρ ηδει τι λαληση ησαν γαρ εκφοβοι
transliteration: ou gar hdei ti lalhsh hsan gar ekfoboi
draft_translation: For he does not know what to say; for they were greatly afraid.
ukjv_translation: For he knows not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
review_notes: modernized knows-not idiom; modernized sore modifier

greek_text: και εγενετο νεφελη επισκιαζουσα αυτοις και ηλθεν φωνη εκ της νεφελης λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος αυτου ακουετε
transliteration: kai egeneto nefelh episkiazousa autoiv kai hlyen fwnh ek thv nefelhv legousa outov estin o uiov mou o agaphtov autou akouete
draft_translation: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
ukjv_translation: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εξαπινα περιβλεψαμενοι ουκετι ουδενα ειδον αλλα τον ιησουν μονον μεθ εαυτων
transliteration: kai exapina peribleqamenoi ouketi oudena eidon alla ton ihsoun monon mey eautwn
draft_translation: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no one any more, except Jesus only with themselves.
ukjv_translation: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; modernized save-as-except wording

greek_text: καταβαινοντων δε αυτων απο του ορους διεστειλατο αυτοις ινα μηδενι διηγησωνται α ειδον ει μη οταν ο υιος του ανθρωπου εκ νεκρων αναστη
transliteration: katabainontwn de autwn apo tou orouv diesteilato autoiv ina mhdeni dihghswntai a eidon ei mh otan o uiov tou anyrwpou ek nekrwn anasth
draft_translation: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
ukjv_translation: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
review_notes: fixed charged-them relative artifact; modernized no-man idiom; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και τον λογον εκρατησαν προς εαυτους συζητουντες τι εστιν το εκ νεκρων αναστηναι
transliteration: kai ton logon ekrathsan prov eautouv suzhtountev ti estin to ek nekrwn anasthnai
draft_translation: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what rising from the dead should mean.
ukjv_translation: And they kept that saying (o. logos) with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

greek_text: και επηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες οτι λεγουσιν οι γραμματεις οτι ηλιαν δει ελθειν πρωτον
transliteration: kai ephrwtwn auton legontev oti legousin oi grammateiv oti hlian dei elyein prwton
draft_translation: And they asked him, saying, Why do the scribes say that Elijah must first come?
ukjv_translation: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elijah must first come?

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ηλιας μεν ελθων πρωτον αποκαθιστα παντα και πως γεγραπται επι τον υιον του ανθρωπου ινα πολλα παθη και εξουδενωθη
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv eipen autoiv hliav men elywn prwton apokayista panta kai pwv gegraptai epi ton uion tou anyrwpou ina polla payh kai exoudenwyh
draft_translation: And he answered and told them, Elijah truly comes first, and restores all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be treated with contempt.
ukjv_translation: And he answered and told them, Elijah verily comes first, and restores all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nothing.

greek_text: αλλα λεγω υμιν οτι και ηλιας εληλυθεν και εποιησαν αυτω οσα ηθελησαν καθως γεγραπται επ αυτον
transliteration: alla legw umin oti kai hliav elhluyen kai epoihsan autw osa hyelhsan kaywv gegraptai ep auton
draft_translation: But I say to you, That Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, as it is written of him.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, That Elijah is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

greek_text: και ελθων προς τους μαθητας ειδεν οχλον πολυν περι αυτους και γραμματεις συζητουντας αυτοις
transliteration: kai elywn prov touv mayhtav eiden oclon polun peri autouv kai grammateiv suzhtountav autoiv
draft_translation: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great crowd about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
ukjv_translation: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

greek_text: και ευθεως πας ο οχλος ιδων αυτον εξεθαμβηθη και προστρεχοντες ησπαζοντο αυτον
transliteration: kai euyewv pav o oclov idwn auton exeyambhyh kai prostrecontev hspazonto auton
draft_translation: And immediately all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him greeted him.
ukjv_translation: And immediately all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

greek_text: και επηρωτησεν τους γραμματεις τι συζητειτε προς αυτους
transliteration: kai ephrwthsen touv grammateiv ti suzhteite prov autouv
draft_translation: And he asked the scribes, What do you question with them?
ukjv_translation: And he asked the scribes, What question all of you with them?

greek_text: και αποκριθεις εις εκ του οχλου ειπεν διδασκαλε ηνεγκα τον υιον μου προς σε εχοντα πνευμα αλαλον
transliteration: kai apokriyeiv eiv ek tou oclou eipen didaskale hnegka ton uion mou prov se econta pneuma alalon
draft_translation: And one of the crowd answered and said, Teacher, I have brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
ukjv_translation: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto you my son, which has a dumb spirit; (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered alalos as mute; rendered didaskalos as teacher; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: και οπου αν αυτον καταλαβη ρησσει αυτον και αφριζει και τριζει τους οδοντας αυτου και ξηραινεται και ειπον τοις μαθηταις σου ινα αυτο εκβαλωσιν και ουκ ισχυσαν
transliteration: kai opou an auton katalabh rhssei auton kai afrizei kai trizei touv odontav autou kai xhrainetai kai eipon toiv mayhtaiv sou ina auto ekbalwsin kai ouk iscusan
draft_translation: And wherever he takes him, he tears him: and he foams, and gnashes with his teeth, and pines away: and I spoke to your disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
ukjv_translation: And where ever he takes him, he tears him: and he foams, and gnashes with his teeth, and pins away: and I spoke to your disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
review_notes: fixed pines-away spelling; modernized wherever spelling

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις αυτω λεγει ω γενεα απιστος εως ποτε προς υμας εσομαι εως ποτε ανεξομαι υμων φερετε αυτον προς με
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv autw legei w genea apistov ewv pote prov umav esomai ewv pote anexomai umwn ferete auton prov me
draft_translation: He answers him, and says, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him to me.
ukjv_translation: He answers him, and says, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

greek_text: και ηνεγκαν αυτον προς αυτον και ιδων αυτον ευθεως το πνευμα εσπαραξεν αυτον και πεσων επι της γης εκυλιετο αφριζων
transliteration: kai hnegkan auton prov auton kai idwn auton euyewv to pneuma esparaxen auton kai peswn epi thv ghv ekulieto afrizwn
draft_translation: And they brought him to him: and when he saw him, immediately the spirit tore him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
ukjv_translation: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, immediately the spirit (o. pneuma) tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

greek_text: και επηρωτησεν τον πατερα αυτου ποσος χρονος εστιν ως τουτο γεγονεν αυτω ο δε ειπεν παιδιοθεν

draft_translation: And he asked his father, How long has this been happening to him? And he said, From childhood.

draft_translation: And frequently it has cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
ukjv_translation: And frequently it has cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if you can do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω το ει δυνασαι πιστευσαι παντα δυνατα τω πιστευοντι

draft_translation: Jesus said to him, If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.

greek_text: και ευθεως κραξας ο πατηρ του παιδιου μετα δακρυων ελεγεν πιστευω κυριε βοηθει μου τη απιστια

greek_text: ιδων δε ο ιησους οτι επισυντρεχει οχλος επετιμησεν τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω λεγων αυτω το πνευμα το αλαλον και κωφον εγω σοι επιτασσω εξελθε εξ αυτου και μηκετι εισελθης εις αυτον

draft_translation: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, You mute and deaf spirit, I charge you, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

greek_text: και κραξαν και πολλα σπαραξαν αυτον εξηλθεν και εγενετο ωσει νεκρος ωστε πολλους λεγειν οτι απεθανεν

draft_translation: And the spirit cried, and convulsed him greatly, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; so that many said, He is dead.
ukjv_translation: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις τουτο το γενος εν ουδενι δυναται εξελθειν ει μη εν προσευχη και νηστεια
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv touto to genov en oudeni dunatai exelyein ei mh en proseuch kai nhsteia
draft_translation: And he said to them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

greek_text: και εκειθεν εξελθοντες παρεπορευοντο δια της γαλιλαιας και ουκ ηθελεν ινα τις γνω

ukjv_translation: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

greek_text: εδιδασκεν γαρ τους μαθητας αυτου και ελεγεν αυτοις οτι ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται εις χειρας ανθρωπων και αποκτενουσιν αυτον και αποκτανθεις τη τριτη ημερα αναστησεται
transliteration: edidasken gar touv mayhtav autou kai elegen autoiv oti o uiov tou anyrwpou paradidotai eiv ceirav anyrwpwn kai apoktenousin auton kai apoktanyeiv th trith hmera anasthsetai
draft_translation: For he taught his disciples, and said to them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after he has been killed, he shall rise the third day.
ukjv_translation: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

greek_text: οι δε ηγνοουν το ρημα και εφοβουντο αυτον επερωτησαι

draft_translation: But they did not understand that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
ukjv_translation: But they understood not that saying, (o. rhema) and were afraid to ask him.

greek_text: και ηλθεν εις καπερναουμ και εν τη οικια γενομενος επηρωτα αυτους τι εν τη οδω προς εαυτους διελογιζεσθε

draft_translation: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that you disputed among yourselves on the way?

greek_text: οι δε εσιωπων προς αλληλους γαρ διελεχθησαν εν τη οδω τις μειζων

greek_text: και καθισας εφωνησεν τους δωδεκα και λεγει αυτοις ει τις θελει πρωτος ειναι εσται παντων εσχατος και παντων διακονος

draft_translation: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and says to them, If anyone desires to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
ukjv_translation: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and says unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

greek_text: και λαβων παιδιον εστησεν αυτο εν μεσω αυτων και εναγκαλισαμενος αυτο ειπεν αυτοις
transliteration: kai labwn paidion esthsen auto en mesw autwn kai enagkalisamenov auto eipen autoiv
draft_translation: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said to them,
ukjv_translation: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

greek_text: ος εαν εν των τοιουτων παιδιων δεξηται επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται και ος εαν εμε δεξηται ουκ εμε δεχεται αλλα τον αποστειλαντα με
transliteration: ov ean en twn toioutwn paidiwn dexhtai epi tw onomati mou eme decetai kai ov ean eme dexhtai ouk eme decetai alla ton aposteilanta me
draft_translation: Whoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receives me: and whoever shall receive me, does not receive me, but him who sent me.

review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized receives-not wording; modernized whosoever

greek_text: απεκριθη δε αυτω ο ιωαννης λεγων διδασκαλε ειδομεν τινα εν τω ονοματι σου εκβαλλοντα δαιμονια ος ουκ ακολουθει ημιν και εκωλυσαμεν αυτον οτι ουκ ακολουθει ημιν

draft_translation: But Jesus said, Do not forbid him: for there is no one who shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

draft_translation: For the one who is not against us is for us.

transliteration: ov gar an potish umav pothrion udatov en tw onomati mou oti cristou este amhn legw umin ou mh apolesh ton misyon autou
draft_translation: For whoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you belong to Christ, Amen, I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because all of you belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: και ος αν σκανδαλιση ενα των μικρων τουτων των πιστευοντων εις εμε καλον εστιν αυτω μαλλον ει περικειται λιθος μυλικος περι τον τραχηλον αυτου και βεβληται εις την θαλασσαν
transliteration: kai ov an skandalish ena twn mikrwn toutwn twn pisteuontwn eiv eme kalon estin autw mallon ei perikeitai liyov mulikov peri ton trachlon autou kai beblhtai eiv thn yalassan
draft_translation: And whoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

draft_translation: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to release his wife? tempting him.

draft_translation: And Jesus answered and said to them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

draft_translation: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that comes in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
ukjv_translation: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that comes in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

greek_text: και εισηλθεν εις ιεροσολυμα ο ιησους και εις το ιερον και περιβλεψαμενος παντα οψιας ηδη ουσης της ωρας εξηλθεν εις βηθανιαν μετα των δωδεκα

draft_translation: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of those who sold doves;
ukjv_translation: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

greek_text: και ουκ ηφιεν ινα τις διενεγκη σκευος δια του ιερου

draft_translation: And he would not allow anyone to carry any vessel through the temple.
ukjv_translation: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

greek_text: και εδιδασκεν λεγων αυτοις ου γεγραπται οτι ο οικος μου οικος προσευχης κληθησεται πασιν τοις εθνεσιν υμεις δε εποιησατε αυτον σπηλαιον ληστων

draft_translation: And he taught, saying to them, Is it not written, My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations? but you have made it a den of thieves.
ukjv_translation: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but all of you have made it a den of thieves.

greek_text: και ηκουσαν οι γραμματεις και οι αρχιερεις και εζητουν πως αυτον απολεσουσιν εφοβουντο γαρ αυτον οτι πας ο οχλος εξεπλησσετο επι τη διδαχη αυτου

draft_translation: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people were astonished at his teaching.
ukjv_translation: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

greek_text: και οτε οψε εγενετο εξεπορευετο εξω της πολεως
transliteration: kai ote oqe egeneto exeporeueto exw thv polewv
draft_translation: And when evening had come, he went out of the city.
ukjv_translation: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

draft_translation: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
ukjv_translation: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

draft_translation: And Peter, calling to remembrance, says to him, Teacher, look, the fig tree which you cursed is withered away.
ukjv_translation: And Peter calling to remembrance says unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which you cursed is withered away.

transliteration: kai apokriyeiv ihsouv legei autoiv ecete pistin yeou
draft_translation: And Jesus answering says to them, Have faith in God.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answering says unto them, Have faith in God.

draft_translation: For truly I say to you, That whoever shall say to this mountain, Be removed, and be cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he says will happen; he shall have whatever he says.
ukjv_translation: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be you removed, and be you cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he says shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he says.

draft_translation: Therefore I say to you, Whatever things you desire, when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you shall have them.
ukjv_translation: Therefore I say unto you, What things whatsoever all of you desire, when all of you pray, believe that all of you receive them, and all of you shall have them.

greek_text: και οταν στηκητε προσευχομενοι αφιετε ει τι εχετε κατα τινος ινα και ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αφη υμιν τα παραπτωματα υμων

ukjv_translation: And when all of you stand praying, forgive, if all of you have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

transliteration: ei de umeiv ouk afiete oude o pathr umwn o en toiv ouranoiv afhsei ta paraptwmata umwn
draft_translation: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

draft_translation: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
ukjv_translation: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

greek_text: και λεγουσιν αυτω εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιεις και τις σοι την εξουσιαν ταυτην εδωκεν ινα ταυτα ποιης

draft_translation: And say to him, By what authority do you do these things? and who gave you this authority to do these things?
ukjv_translation: And say unto him, By what authority do you these things? and who gave you this authority to do these things?

draft_translation: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, (o. logos) and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

greek_text: το βαπτισμα ιωαννου εξ ουρανου ην η εξ ανθρωπων αποκριθητε μοι
transliteration: to baptisma iwannou ex ouranou hn h ex anyrwpwn apokriyhte moi
draft_translation: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
ukjv_translation: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

greek_text: και ελογιζοντο προς εαυτους λεγοντες εαν ειπωμεν εξ ουρανου ερει δια τι ουν ουκ επιστευσατε αυτω

draft_translation: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did you not believe him?
ukjv_translation: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did all of you not believe him?

greek_text: αλλ εαν ειπωμεν εξ ανθρωπων εφοβουντο τον λαον απαντες γαρ ειχον τον ιωαννην οτι οντως προφητης ην
transliteration: all ean eipwmen ex anyrwpwn efobounto ton laon apantev gar eicon ton iwannhn oti ontwv profhthv hn
draft_translation: But if we shall say, From men; they feared the people: for all counted John to be a prophet indeed.
ukjv_translation: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

greek_text: και αποκριθεντες λεγουσιν τω ιησου ουκ οιδαμεν και ο ιησους αποκριθεις λεγει αυτοις ουδε εγω λεγω υμιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
