draft_translation: And they answered and said to Jesus, We do not know. And Jesus answering says to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
ukjv_translation: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering says unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

draft_translation: And he began to speak to them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and dug a place for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to tenant farmers, and went into a far country.
ukjv_translation: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and dug a place for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

greek_text: και απεστειλεν προς τους γεωργους τω καιρω δουλον ινα παρα των γεωργων λαβη απο του καρπου του αμπελωνος

draft_translation: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a slave, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
ukjv_translation: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

transliteration: eti oun ena uion ecwn agaphton autou apesteilen kai auton prov autouv escaton legwn oti entraphsontai ton uion mou
draft_translation: Having yet therefore one son, his beloved, he sent him also last to them, saying, They will respect my son.
ukjv_translation: Having yet therefore one son, his beloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

draft_translation: But those tenant farmers said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
ukjv_translation: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.

draft_translation: What therefore shall the owner of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the tenant farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
ukjv_translation: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

greek_text: ουδε την γραφην ταυτην ανεγνωτε λιθον ον απεδοκιμασαν οι οικοδομουντες ουτος εγενηθη εις κεφαλην γωνιας
transliteration: oude thn grafhn tauthn anegnwte liyon on apedokimasan oi oikodomountev outov egenhyh eiv kefalhn gwniav
draft_translation: And have you not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner:
ukjv_translation: And have all of you not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

greek_text: παρα κυριου εγενετο αυτη και εστιν θαυμαστη εν οφθαλμοις ημων

greek_text: και εζητουν αυτον κρατησαι και εφοβηθησαν τον οχλον εγνωσαν γαρ οτι προς αυτους την παραβολην ειπεν και αφεντες αυτον απηλθον

greek_text: οι δε ελθοντες λεγουσιν αυτω διδασκαλε οιδαμεν οτι αληθης ει και ου μελει σοι περι ουδενος ου γαρ βλεπεις εις προσωπον ανθρωπων αλλ επ αληθειας την οδον του θεου διδασκεις εξεστιν κηνσον καισαρι δουναι η ου
transliteration: oi de elyontev legousin autw didaskale oidamen oti alhyhv ei kai ou melei soi peri oudenov ou gar blepeiv eiv proswpon anyrwpwn all ep alhyeiav thn odon tou yeou didaskeiv exestin khnson kaisari dounai h ou
draft_translation: And when they had come, they say to him, Teacher, we know that you are true, and care for no one: for you do not regard the person of men, but teach the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tax to Caesar, or not?
ukjv_translation: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that you are true, and care for no man: for you regard not the person of men, but teach the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

greek_text: δωμεν η μη δωμεν ο δε ειδως αυτων την υποκρισιν ειπεν αυτοις τι με πειραζετε φερετε μοι δηναριον ινα ιδω
transliteration: dwmen h mh dwmen o de eidwv autwn thn upokrisin eipen autoiv ti me peirazete ferete moi dhnarion ina idw
draft_translation: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why do you test me? bring me a denarius, that I may see it.
ukjv_translation: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt all of you me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

greek_text: οι δε ηνεγκαν και λεγει αυτοις τινος η εικων αυτη και η επιγραφη οι δε ειπον αυτω καισαρος
transliteration: oi de hnegkan kai legei autoiv tinov h eikwn auth kai h epigrafh oi de eipon autw kaisarov
draft_translation: And they brought it. And he says to them, Whose is this image and inscription? And they said to him, Caesar's.
ukjv_translation: And they brought it. And he says unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

greek_text: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις αποδοτε τα καισαρος καισαρι και τα του θεου τω θεω και εθαυμασαν επ αυτω
transliteration: kai apokriyeiv o ihsouv eipen autoiv apodote ta kaisarov kaisari kai ta tou yeou tw yew kai eyaumasan ep autw
draft_translation: And Jesus answering said to them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marveled at him.

greek_text: και ερχονται σαδδουκαιοι προς αυτον οιτινες λεγουσιν αναστασιν μη ειναι και επηρωτησαν αυτον λεγοντες

draft_translation: Then come to him the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
ukjv_translation: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

greek_text: διδασκαλε μωσης εγραψεν ημιν οτι εαν τινος αδελφος αποθανη και καταλιπη γυναικα και τεκνα μη αφη ινα λαβη ο αδελφος αυτου την γυναικα αυτου και εξαναστηση σπερμα τω αδελφω αυτου
transliteration: didaskale mwshv egraqen hmin oti ean tinov adelfov apoyanh kai kataliph gunaika kai tekna mh afh ina labh o adelfov autou thn gunaika autou kai exanasthsh sperma tw adelfw autou
draft_translation: Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
ukjv_translation: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered didaskalos as teacher

greek_text: επτα ουν αδελφοι ησαν και ο πρωτος ελαβεν γυναικα και αποθνησκων ουκ αφηκεν σπερμα
transliteration: epta oun adelfoi hsan kai o prwtov elaben gunaika kai apoynhskwn ouk afhken sperma
draft_translation: Now there were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
ukjv_translation: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

greek_text: και ο δευτερος ελαβεν αυτην και απεθανεν και ουδε αυτος αφηκεν σπερμα και ο τριτος ωσαυτως
transliteration: kai o deuterov elaben authn kai apeyanen kai oude autov afhken sperma kai o tritov wsautwv
draft_translation: And the second took her, and died, neither did he leave any seed: and the third likewise.
ukjv_translation: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

greek_text: και ελαβον αυτην οι επτα και ουκ αφηκαν σπερμα εσχατη παντων απεθανεν και η γυνη
transliteration: kai elabon authn oi epta kai ouk afhkan sperma escath pantwn apeyanen kai h gunh
draft_translation: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman also died.
ukjv_translation: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

greek_text: εν τη ουν αναστασει οταν αναστωσιν τινος αυτων εσται γυνη οι γαρ επτα εσχον αυτην γυναικα
transliteration: en th oun anastasei otan anastwsin tinov autwn estai gunh oi gar epta escon authn gunaika
draft_translation: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her as wife.
ukjv_translation: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

greek_text: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ου δια τουτο πλανασθε μη ειδοτες τας γραφας μηδε την δυναμιν του θεου
transliteration: kai apokriyeiv o ihsouv eipen autoiv ou dia touto planasye mh eidotev tav grafav mhde thn dunamin tou yeou
draft_translation: And Jesus answering said to them, Do you not therefore err, because you do not know the scriptures, neither the power of God?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do all of you not therefore go astray, because all of you know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

greek_text: οταν γαρ εκ νεκρων αναστωσιν ουτε γαμουσιν ουτε γαμισκονται αλλ εισιν ως αγγελοι οι εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: otan gar ek nekrwn anastwsin oute gamousin oute gamiskontai all eisin wv aggeloi oi en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels who are in heaven.
ukjv_translation: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

greek_text: περι δε των νεκρων οτι εγειρονται ουκ ανεγνωτε εν τη βιβλω μωσεως επι της βατου ως ειπεν αυτω ο θεος λεγων εγω ο θεος αβρααμ και ο θεος ισαακ και ο θεος ιακωβ
transliteration: peri de twn nekrwn oti egeirontai ouk anegnwte en th biblw mwsewv epi thv batou wv eipen autw o yeov legwn egw o yeov abraam kai o yeov isaak kai o yeov iakwb
draft_translation: And concerning the dead, that they rise: have you not read in the book of Moses, how at the bush God spoke to him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
ukjv_translation: And as concerning the dead, that they rise: have all of you not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spoke unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

greek_text: ουκ εστιν ο θεος νεκρων αλλα θεος ζωντων υμεις ουν πολυ πλανασθε
transliteration: ouk estin o yeov nekrwn alla yeov zwntwn umeiv oun polu planasye
draft_translation: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: you therefore do greatly err.
ukjv_translation: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: all of you therefore do greatly go astray.

greek_text: και προσελθων εις των γραμματεων ακουσας αυτων συζητουντων ειδως οτι καλως αυτοις απεκριθη επηρωτησεν αυτον ποια εστιν πρωτη πασων εντολη
transliteration: kai proselywn eiv twn grammatewn akousav autwn suzhtountwn eidwv oti kalwv autoiv apekriyh ephrwthsen auton poia estin prwth paswn entolh
draft_translation: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
ukjv_translation: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο δε ιησους απεκριθη αυτω οτι πρωτη πασων των εντολων ακουε ισραηλ κυριος ο θεος ημων κυριος εις εστιν
transliteration: o de ihsouv apekriyh autw oti prwth paswn twn entolwn akoue israhl kuriov o yeov hmwn kuriov eiv estin
draft_translation: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

greek_text: και αγαπησεις κυριον τον θεον σου εξ ολης της καρδιας σου και εξ ολης της ψυχης σου και εξ ολης της διανοιας σου και εξ ολης της ισχυος σου αυτη πρωτη εντολη
transliteration: kai agaphseiv kurion ton yeon sou ex olhv thv kardiav sou kai ex olhv thv quchv sou kai ex olhv thv dianoiav sou kai ex olhv thv iscuov sou auth prwth entolh
draft_translation: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.
ukjv_translation: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.

greek_text: και δευτερα ομοια αυτη αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον μειζων τουτων αλλη εντολη ουκ εστιν
transliteration: kai deutera omoia auth agaphseiv ton plhsion sou wv seauton meizwn toutwn allh entolh ouk estin
draft_translation: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbor as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these.
ukjv_translation: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbour as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these.

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτω ο γραμματευς καλως διδασκαλε επ αληθειας ειπας οτι εις εστιν θεος και ουκ εστιν αλλος πλην αυτου
transliteration: kai eipen autw o grammateuv kalwv didaskale ep alhyeiav eipav oti eiv estin yeov kai ouk estin allov plhn autou
draft_translation: And the scribe said to him, Well, Teacher, you have said the truth: for there is one God; and there is no other but he:
ukjv_translation: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, you have said the truth: for there is one God; and there is no other but he:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered didaskalos as teacher

greek_text: και το αγαπαν αυτον εξ ολης της καρδιας και εξ ολης της συνεσεως και εξ ολης της ψυχης και εξ ολης της ισχυος και το αγαπαν τον πλησιον ως εαυτον πλειον εστιν παντων των ολοκαυτωματων και των θυσιων
transliteration: kai to agapan auton ex olhv thv kardiav kai ex olhv thv sunesewv kai ex olhv thv quchv kai ex olhv thv iscuov kai to agapan ton plhsion wv eauton pleion estin pantwn twn olokautwmatwn kai twn yusiwn
draft_translation: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
ukjv_translation: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

greek_text: και ο ιησους ιδων αυτον οτι νουνεχως απεκριθη ειπεν αυτω ου μακραν ει απο της βασιλειας του θεου και ουδεις ουκετι ετολμα αυτον επερωτησαι
transliteration: kai o ihsouv idwn auton oti nounecwv apekriyh eipen autw ou makran ei apo thv basileiav tou yeou kai oudeiv ouketi etolma auton eperwthsai
draft_translation: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And no one after that dared ask him any question.
ukjv_translation: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

draft_translation: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?

draft_translation: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater judgment.
ukjv_translation: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

ukjv_translation: And Jesus sat opposite to the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

draft_translation: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two lepta, which make a quadrans.
ukjv_translation: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

ukjv_translation: And he called unto him his disciples, and says unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow has cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

draft_translation: For all they cast in out of their abundance; but she out of her poverty cast in all that she had, even all her living.
ukjv_translation: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her lack did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

draft_translation: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples says to him, Teacher, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

draft_translation: And Jesus answering said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

greek_text: ειπε ημιν ποτε ταυτα εσται και τι το σημειον οταν μελλη παντα ταυτα συντελεισθαι
transliteration: eipe hmin pote tauta estai kai ti to shmeion otan mellh panta tauta sunteleisyai
draft_translation: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
ukjv_translation: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο δε ιησους αποκριθεις αυτοις ηρξατο λεγειν βλεπετε μη τις υμας πλανηση
transliteration: o de ihsouv apokriyeiv autoiv hrxato legein blepete mh tiv umav planhsh
draft_translation: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest anyone deceive you:
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

greek_text: πολλοι γαρ ελευσονται επι τω ονοματι μου λεγοντες οτι εγω ειμι και πολλους πλανησουσιν
transliteration: polloi gar eleusontai epi tw onomati mou legontev oti egw eimi kai pollouv planhsousin
draft_translation: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
ukjv_translation: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: οταν δε ακουσητε πολεμους και ακοας πολεμων μη θροεισθε δει γαρ γενεσθαι αλλ ουπω το τελος
transliteration: otan de akoushte polemouv kai akoav polemwn mh yroeisye dei gar genesyai all oupw to telov
draft_translation: And when you shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled: for such things must be; but the end shall not be yet.
ukjv_translation: And when all of you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be all of you not troubled: for such things must essentially be; but the end shall not be yet.
review_notes: cleaned must-essentially source artifact; modernized be-you-not imperative; modernized rumours spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εγερθησεται γαρ εθνος επι εθνος και βασιλεια επι βασιλειαν και εσονται σεισμοι κατα τοπους και εσονται λιμοι και ταραχαι αρχαι ωδινων ταυτα
transliteration: egeryhsetai gar eynov epi eynov kai basileia epi basileian kai esontai seismoi kata topouv kai esontai limoi kai taracai arcai wdinwn tauta
draft_translation: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in various places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of birth pains.
ukjv_translation: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

greek_text: βλεπετε δε υμεις εαυτους παραδωσουσιν γαρ υμας εις συνεδρια και εις συναγωγας δαρησεσθε και επι ηγεμονων και βασιλεων αχθησεσθε ενεκεν εμου εις μαρτυριον αυτοις
transliteration: blepete de umeiv eautouv paradwsousin gar umav eiv sunedria kai eiv sunagwgav darhsesye kai epi hgemonwn kai basilewn acyhsesye eneken emou eiv marturion autoiv
draft_translation: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
ukjv_translation: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues all of you shall be beaten: and all of you shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

greek_text: και εις παντα τα εθνη δει πρωτον κηρυχθηναι το ευαγγελιον
transliteration: kai eiv panta ta eynh dei prwton khrucyhnai to euaggelion
draft_translation: And the good news must first be published among all nations.
ukjv_translation: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

greek_text: οταν δε αγαγωσιν υμας παραδιδοντες μη προμεριμνατε τι λαλησητε μηδε μελετατε αλλ ο εαν δοθη υμιν εν εκεινη τη ωρα τουτο λαλειτε ου γαρ εστε υμεις οι λαλουντες αλλα το πνευμα το αγιον
transliteration: otan de agagwsin umav paradidontev mh promerimnate ti lalhshte mhde meletate all o ean doyh umin en ekeinh th wra touto laleite ou gar este umeiv oi lalountev alla to pneuma to agion
draft_translation: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, do not worry beforehand what you shall speak, neither do you premeditate: but whatever shall be given you in that hour, that speak: for it is not you that speak, but the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what all of you shall speak, neither do all of you premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak all of you: for it is not all of you that speak, but the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: παραδωσει δε αδελφος αδελφον εις θανατον και πατηρ τεκνον και επαναστησονται τεκνα επι γονεις και θανατωσουσιν αυτους
transliteration: paradwsei de adelfov adelfon eiv yanaton kai pathr teknon kai epanasthsontai tekna epi goneiv kai yanatwsousin autouv
draft_translation: Now brother shall betray brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
ukjv_translation: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

greek_text: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου ο δε υπομεινας εις τελος ουτος σωθησεται
transliteration: kai esesye misoumenoi upo pantwn dia to onoma mou o de upomeinav eiv telov outov swyhsetai
draft_translation: And you shall be hated by all for my name's sake: but the one who shall endure to the end, the same shall be saved.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

greek_text: οταν δε ιδητε το βδελυγμα της ερημωσεως το ρηθεν υπο δανιηλ του προφητου εστως οπου ου δει ο αναγινωσκων νοειτω τοτε οι εν τη ιουδαια φευγετωσαν εις τα ορη
transliteration: otan de idhte to bdelugma thv erhmwsewv to rhyen upo danihl tou profhtou estwv opou ou dei o anaginwskwn noeitw tote oi en th ioudaia feugetwsan eiv ta orh
draft_translation: But when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him who reads understand,) then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains:
ukjv_translation: But when all of you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that reads understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized them-that relative; modernized who-be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: ο δε επι του δωματος μη καταβατω εις την οικιαν μηδε εισελθετω αραι τι εκ της οικιας αυτου
transliteration: o de epi tou dwmatov mh katabatw eiv thn oikian mhde eiselyetw arai ti ek thv oikiav autou
draft_translation: And let him who is on the housetop not go down into the house, nor enter it, to take anything out of his house:
ukjv_translation: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

greek_text: και ο εις τον αγρον ων μη επιστρεψατω εις τα οπισω αραι το ιματιον αυτου
transliteration: kai o eiv ton agron wn mh epistreqatw eiv ta opisw arai to imation autou
draft_translation: And let him who is in the field not turn back again in order to take up his garment.
ukjv_translation: And let him that is in the field not turn back again in order to take up his garment.

greek_text: ουαι δε ταις εν γαστρι εχουσαις και ταις θηλαζουσαις εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
transliteration: ouai de taiv en gastri ecousaiv kai taiv yhlazousaiv en ekeinaiv taiv hmeraiv
draft_translation: But woe to those who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing in those days!
ukjv_translation: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

greek_text: προσευχεσθε δε ινα μη γενηται η φυγη υμων χειμωνος
transliteration: proseucesye de ina mh genhtai h fugh umwn ceimwnov
draft_translation: And pray that your flight not be in the winter.
ukjv_translation: And pray all of you that your flight be not in the winter.
review_notes: modernized be-not clause; modernized pray-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εσονται γαρ αι ημεραι εκειναι θλιψις οια ου γεγονεν τοιαυτη απ αρχης κτισεως ης εκτισεν ο θεος εως του νυν και ου μη γενηται
transliteration: esontai gar ai hmerai ekeinai yliqiv oia ou gegonen toiauth ap archv ktisewv hv ektisen o yeov ewv tou nun kai ou mh genhtai
draft_translation: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created to this time, neither shall be.
ukjv_translation: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

greek_text: και ει μη κυριος εκολοβωσεν τας ημερας ουκ αν εσωθη πασα σαρξ αλλα δια τους εκλεκτους ους εξελεξατο εκολοβωσεν τας ημερας
transliteration: kai ei mh kuriov ekolobwsen tav hmerav ouk an eswyh pasa sarx alla dia touv eklektouv ouv exelexato ekolobwsen tav hmerav
draft_translation: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh would be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he has chosen, he has shortened the days.
ukjv_translation: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he has chosen, he has shortened the days.

greek_text: και τοτε εαν τις υμιν ειπη ιδου ωδε ο χριστος η ιδου εκει μη πιστευσητε
transliteration: kai tote ean tiv umin eiph idou wde o cristov h idou ekei mh pisteushte
draft_translation: And then if anyone shall say to you, Look, here is Christ; or, look, he is there; do not believe him:
ukjv_translation: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

greek_text: εγερθησονται γαρ ψευδοχριστοι και ψευδοπροφηται και δωσουσιν σημεια και τερατα προς το αποπλαναν ει δυνατον και τους εκλεκτους
transliteration: egeryhsontai gar qeudocristoi kai qeudoprofhtai kai dwsousin shmeia kai terata prov to apoplanan ei dunaton kai touv eklektouv
draft_translation: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall show signs and wonders, to deceive, if it were possible, even the elect.
ukjv_translation: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall show signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

greek_text: υμεις δε βλεπετε ιδου προειρηκα υμιν παντα
transliteration: umeiv de blepete idou proeirhka umin panta
draft_translation: But take heed: look, I have foretold you all things.
ukjv_translation: But take all of you heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

greek_text: αλλ εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις μετα την θλιψιν εκεινην ο ηλιος σκοτισθησεται και η σεληνη ου δωσει το φεγγος αυτης
transliteration: all en ekeinaiv taiv hmeraiv meta thn yliqin ekeinhn o hliov skotisyhsetai kai h selhnh ou dwsei to feggov authv
draft_translation: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give its light,
ukjv_translation: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

greek_text: και οι αστερες του ουρανου εσονται εκπιπτοντες και αι δυναμεις αι εν τοις ουρανοις σαλευθησονται
transliteration: kai oi asterev tou ouranou esontai ekpiptontev kai ai dunameiv ai en toiv ouranoiv saleuyhsontai
draft_translation: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
ukjv_translation: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και τοτε οψονται τον υιον του ανθρωπου ερχομενον εν νεφελαις μετα δυναμεως πολλης και δοξης
transliteration: kai tote oqontai ton uion tou anyrwpou ercomenon en nefelaiv meta dunamewv pollhv kai doxhv
draft_translation: And then they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
ukjv_translation: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

greek_text: και τοτε αποστελει τους αγγελους αυτου και επισυναξει τους εκλεκτους αυτου εκ των τεσσαρων ανεμων απ ακρου γης εως ακρου ουρανου
transliteration: kai tote apostelei touv aggelouv autou kai episunaxei touv eklektouv autou ek twn tessarwn anemwn ap akrou ghv ewv akrou ouranou
draft_translation: And then he shall send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
ukjv_translation: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

greek_text: απο δε της συκης μαθετε την παραβολην οταν αυτης ηδη ο κλαδος απαλος γενηται και εκφυη τα φυλλα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς το θερος εστιν
transliteration: apo de thv sukhv mayete thn parabolhn otan authv hdh o kladov apalov genhtai kai ekfuh ta fulla ginwskete oti egguv to yerov estin
draft_translation: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When its branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near:
ukjv_translation: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, all of you know that summer is near:

greek_text: ουτως και υμεις οταν ταυτα ιδητε γινομενα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς εστιν επι θυραις
transliteration: outwv kai umeiv otan tauta idhte ginomena ginwskete oti egguv estin epi yuraiv
draft_translation: So you likewise, when you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is near, even at the doors.
ukjv_translation: So all of you in like manner, when all of you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
review_notes: modernized like-manner idiom; modernized nigh; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ου μη παρελθη η γενεα αυτη μεχρις ου παντα ταυτα γενηται
transliteration: amhn legw umin oti ou mh parelyh h genea auth mecriv ou panta tauta genhtai
draft_translation: Amen, I say to you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
ukjv_translation: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: ο ουρανος και η γη παρελευσονται οι δε λογοι μου ου μη παρελθωσιν
transliteration: o ouranov kai h gh pareleusontai oi de logoi mou ou mh parelywsin
draft_translation: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
ukjv_translation: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words (o. logos) shall not pass away.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: περι δε της ημερας εκεινης και της ωρας ουδεις οιδεν ουδε οι αγγελοι οι εν ουρανω ουδε ο υιος ει μη ο πατηρ
transliteration: peri de thv hmerav ekeinhv kai thv wrav oudeiv oiden oude oi aggeloi oi en ouranw oude o uiov ei mh o pathr
draft_translation: But of that day and that hour knows no one, no, not the angels who are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
ukjv_translation: But of that day and that hour knows no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: βλεπετε αγρυπνειτε και προσευχεσθε ουκ οιδατε γαρ ποτε ο καιρος εστιν
transliteration: blepete agrupneite kai proseucesye ouk oidate gar pote o kairov estin
draft_translation: Take heed, watch and pray: for you do not know when the time is.
ukjv_translation: Take all of you heed, watch and pray: for all of you know not when the time is.

greek_text: ως ανθρωπος αποδημος αφεις την οικιαν αυτου και δους τοις δουλοις αυτου την εξουσιαν και εκαστω το εργον αυτου και τω θυρωρω ενετειλατο ινα γρηγορη
transliteration: wv anyrwpov apodhmov afeiv thn oikian autou kai douv toiv douloiv autou thn exousian kai ekastw to ergon autou kai tw yurwrw eneteilato ina grhgorh
draft_translation: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his slaves, and to every man his work, and commanded the gate keeper to watch.
ukjv_translation: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the gate keeper to watch.

greek_text: γρηγορειτε ουν ουκ οιδατε γαρ ποτε ο κυριος της οικιας ερχεται οψε η μεσονυκτιου η αλεκτοροφωνιας η πρωι
transliteration: grhgoreite oun ouk oidate gar pote o kuriov thv oikiav ercetai oqe h mesonuktiou h alektorofwniav h prwi
draft_translation: Watch therefore: for you do not know when the master of the house comes, at evening, or at midnight, or at rooster-crowing, or in the morning:
ukjv_translation: Watch all of you therefore: for all of you know not when the master of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

greek_text: μη ελθων εξαιφνης ευρη υμας καθευδοντας
transliteration: mh elywn exaifnhv eurh umav kayeudontav
draft_translation: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
ukjv_translation: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

greek_text: α δε υμιν λεγω πασιν λεγω γρηγορειτε
transliteration: a de umin legw pasin legw grhgoreite
draft_translation: And what I say to you I say to all, Watch.
ukjv_translation: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

greek_text: ην δε το πασχα και τα αζυμα μετα δυο ημερας και εζητουν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις πως αυτον εν δολω κρατησαντες αποκτεινωσιν
transliteration: hn de to pasca kai ta azuma meta duo hmerav kai ezhtoun oi arciereiv kai oi grammateiv pwv auton en dolw krathsantev apokteinwsin
draft_translation: After two days was the feast of the Passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by deceit, and put him to death.
ukjv_translation: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

greek_text: ελεγον δε μη εν τη εορτη μηποτε θορυβος εσται του λαου
transliteration: elegon de mh en th eorth mhpote yorubov estai tou laou
draft_translation: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
ukjv_translation: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

greek_text: και οντος αυτου εν βηθανια εν τη οικια σιμωνος του λεπρου κατακειμενου αυτου ηλθεν γυνη εχουσα αλαβαστρον μυρου ναρδου πιστικης πολυτελους και συντριψασα το αλαβαστρον κατεχεεν αυτου κατα της κεφαλης
transliteration: kai ontov autou en bhyania en th oikia simwnov tou leprou katakeimenou autou hlyen gunh ecousa alabastron murou nardou pistikhv polutelouv kai suntriqasa to alabastron kateceen autou kata thv kefalhv
draft_translation: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he reclined at table, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of very costly spikenard; and she broke the box, and poured it on his head.
ukjv_translation: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at food, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

greek_text: ησαν δε τινες αγανακτουντες προς εαυτους και λεγοντες εις τι η απωλεια αυτη του μυρου γεγονεν
transliteration: hsan de tinev aganaktountev prov eautouv kai legontev eiv ti h apwleia auth tou murou gegonen
draft_translation: And there were some who were indignant within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
ukjv_translation: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

greek_text: ηδυνατο γαρ τουτο πραθηναι επανω τριακοσιων δηναριων και δοθηναι τοις πτωχοις και ενεβριμωντο αυτη
transliteration: hdunato gar touto prayhnai epanw triakosiwn dhnariwn kai doyhnai toiv ptwcoiv kai enebrimwnto auth
draft_translation: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and have been given to the poor. And they grumbled against her.
ukjv_translation: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αφετε αυτην τι αυτη κοπους παρεχετε καλον εργον ειργασατο εις εμε
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen afete authn ti auth kopouv parecete kalon ergon eirgasato eiv eme
draft_translation: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why do you trouble her? she has done a good work for me.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble all of you her? she has wrought a good work on me.

greek_text: παντοτε γαρ τους πτωχους εχετε μεθ εαυτων και οταν θελητε δυνασθε αυτους ευ ποιησαι εμε δε ου παντοτε εχετε
transliteration: pantote gar touv ptwcouv ecete mey eautwn kai otan yelhte dunasye autouv eu poihsai eme de ou pantote ecete
draft_translation: For you have the poor with you always, and whenever you desire you may do them good: but me you have not always.
ukjv_translation: For all of you have the poor with you always, and whenever all of you will all of you may do them good: but me all of you have not always.

greek_text: ο ειχεν αυτη εποιησεν προελαβεν μυρισαι μου το σωμα εις τον ενταφιασμον
transliteration: o eicen auth epoihsen proelaben murisai mou to swma eiv ton entafiasmon
draft_translation: She has done what she could: she has come beforehand to anoint my body for burial.
ukjv_translation: She has done what she could: she has come beforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

greek_text: αμην λεγω υμιν οπου αν κηρυχθη το ευαγγελιον τουτο εις ολον τον κοσμον και ο εποιησεν αυτη λαληθησεται εις μνημοσυνον αυτης
transliteration: amhn legw umin opou an khrucyh to euaggelion touto eiv olon ton kosmon kai o epoihsen auth lalhyhsetai eiv mnhmosunon authv
draft_translation: Amen, I say to you, wherever this good news shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
ukjv_translation: Verily I say unto you, Where ever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; modernized wherever spelling; rendered amen formula directly; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και ο ιουδας ο ισκαριωτης εις των δωδεκα απηλθεν προς τους αρχιερεις ινα παραδω αυτον αυτοις
transliteration: kai o ioudav o iskariwthv eiv twn dwdeka aphlyen prov touv arciereiv ina paradw auton autoiv
draft_translation: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests, to betray him to them.
ukjv_translation: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

ukjv_translation: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings (o. rhema) were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

draft_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he has visited and redeemed his people,
ukjv_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he has visited and redeemed his people,

transliteration: kai hgeiren kerav swthriav hmin en tw oikw dabid tou paidov autou
draft_translation: And has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
ukjv_translation: And has raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

ukjv_translation: As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

transliteration: poihsai eleov meta twn paterwn hmwn kai mnhsyhnai diayhkhv agiav autou

ukjv_translation: And you, child, shall be called the prophet of the Highest: for you shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

ukjv_translation: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

ukjv_translation: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

greek_text: και επεστρεψαν οι ποιμενες δοξαζοντες και αινουντες τον θεον επι πασιν οις ηκουσαν και ειδον καθως ελαληθη προς αυτους
transliteration: kai epestreqan oi poimenev doxazontev kai ainountev ton yeon epi pasin oiv hkousan kai eidon kaywv elalhyh prov autouv
draft_translation: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told to them.
ukjv_translation: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

greek_text: και οτε επλησθησαν ημεραι οκτω του περιτεμειν το παιδιον και εκληθη το ονομα αυτου ιησους το κληθεν υπο του αγγελου προ του συλληφθηναι αυτον εν τη κοιλια
transliteration: kai ote eplhsyhsan hmerai oktw tou peritemein to paidion kai eklhyh to onoma autou ihsouv to klhyen upo tou aggelou pro tou sullhfyhnai auton en th koilia
draft_translation: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus, who was so named by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
ukjv_translation: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

greek_text: και οτε επλησθησαν αι ημεραι του καθαρισμου αυτης κατα τον νομον μωσεως ανηγαγον αυτον εις ιεροσολυμα παραστησαι τω κυριω
transliteration: kai ote eplhsyhsan ai hmerai tou kayarismou authv kata ton nomon mwsewv anhgagon auton eiv ierosoluma parasthsai tw kuriw
draft_translation: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
ukjv_translation: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται εν νομω κυριου οτι παν αρσεν διανοιγον μητραν αγιον τω κυριω κληθησεται
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai en nomw kuriou oti pan arsen dianoigon mhtran agion tw kuriw klhyhsetai
draft_translation: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
ukjv_translation: (As it is written in the law of the LORD, Every male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

greek_text: και του δουναι θυσιαν κατα το ειρημενον εν νομω κυριου ζευγος τρυγονων η δυο νεοσσους περιστερων
transliteration: kai tou dounai yusian kata to eirhmenon en nomw kuriou zeugov trugonwn h duo neossouv peristerwn
draft_translation: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
ukjv_translation: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

greek_text: και ιδου ην ανθρωπος εν ιερουσαλημ ω ονομα σιμεων και ο ανθρωπος ουτος δικαιος και ευλαβης προσδεχομενος παρακλησιν του ισραηλ και πνευμα αγιον ην επ αυτον
transliteration: kai idou hn anyrwpov en ierousalhm w onoma simewn kai o anyrwpov outov dikaiov kai eulabhv prosdecomenov paraklhsin tou israhl kai pneuma agion hn ep auton
draft_translation: And, look, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
ukjv_translation: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) was upon him.

greek_text: και ην αυτω κεχρηματισμενον υπο του πνευματος του αγιου μη ιδειν θανατον πριν η ιδη τον χριστον κυριου
transliteration: kai hn autw kecrhmatismenon upo tou pneumatov tou agiou mh idein yanaton prin h idh ton criston kuriou
draft_translation: And it was revealed to him by the Holy Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
ukjv_translation: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και ηλθεν εν τω πνευματι εις το ιερον και εν τω εισαγαγειν τους γονεις το παιδιον ιησουν του ποιησαι αυτους κατα το ειθισμενον του νομου περι αυτου
transliteration: kai hlyen en tw pneumati eiv to ieron kai en tw eisagagein touv goneiv to paidion ihsoun tou poihsai autouv kata to eiyismenon tou nomou peri autou
draft_translation: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
ukjv_translation: And he came by the Spirit (o. pneuma) into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και αυτος εδεξατο αυτο εις τας αγκαλας αυτου και ευλογησεν τον θεον και ειπεν
transliteration: kai autov edexato auto eiv tav agkalav autou kai euloghsen ton yeon kai eipen
draft_translation: Then he took him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
ukjv_translation: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

greek_text: νυν απολυεις τον δουλον σου δεσποτα κατα το ρημα σου εν ειρηνη
transliteration: nun apolueiv ton doulon sou despota kata to rhma sou en eirhnh
draft_translation: Lord, now let you your slave depart in peace, according to your word:
ukjv_translation: Lord, now let you your servant depart in peace, according to your word: (o. rhema)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: οτι ειδον οι οφθαλμοι μου το σωτηριον σου
transliteration: oti eidon oi ofyalmoi mou to swthrion sou
draft_translation: For my eyes have seen your salvation,
ukjv_translation: For mine eyes have seen your salvation,

greek_text: ο ητοιμασας κατα προσωπον παντων των λαων
transliteration: o htoimasav kata proswpon pantwn twn lawn
draft_translation: Which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
ukjv_translation: Which you have prepared before the face of all people;

greek_text: φως εις αποκαλυψιν εθνων και δοξαν λαου σου ισραηλ
transliteration: fwv eiv apokaluqin eynwn kai doxan laou sou israhl
draft_translation: A light to lighten the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.
ukjv_translation: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

greek_text: και ην ιωσηφ και η μητηρ αυτου θαυμαζοντες επι τοις λαλουμενοις περι αυτου
transliteration: kai hn iwshf kai h mhthr autou yaumazontev epi toiv laloumenoiv peri autou
draft_translation: And Joseph and his mother marveled at those things which were spoken of him.
ukjv_translation: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

greek_text: και ευλογησεν αυτους σιμεων και ειπεν προς μαριαμ την μητερα αυτου ιδου ουτος κειται εις πτωσιν και αναστασιν πολλων εν τω ισραηλ και εις σημειον αντιλεγομενον
transliteration: kai euloghsen autouv simewn kai eipen prov mariam thn mhtera autou idou outov keitai eiv ptwsin kai anastasin pollwn en tw israhl kai eiv shmeion antilegomenon
draft_translation: And Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary his mother, Look, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
ukjv_translation: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

greek_text: και σου δε αυτης την ψυχην διελευσεται ρομφαια οπως αν αποκαλυφθωσιν εκ πολλων καρδιων διαλογισμοι
transliteration: kai sou de authv thn quchn dieleusetai romfaia opwv an apokalufywsin ek pollwn kardiwn dialogismoi
draft_translation: (Yes, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
ukjv_translation: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

greek_text: και ην αννα προφητις θυγατηρ φανουηλ εκ φυλης ασηρ αυτη προβεβηκυια εν ημεραις πολλαις ζησασα ετη μετα ανδρος επτα απο της παρθενιας αυτης
transliteration: kai hn anna profhtiv yugathr fanouhl ek fulhv ashr auth probebhkuia en hmeraiv pollaiv zhsasa eth meta androv epta apo thv paryeniav authv
draft_translation: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher: she was of great age, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity;
ukjv_translation: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

greek_text: και αυτη χηρα ως ετων ογδοηκοντατεσσαρων η ουκ αφιστατο απο του ιερου νηστειαις και δεησεσιν λατρευουσα νυκτα και ημεραν
transliteration: kai auth chra wv etwn ogdohkontatessarwn h ouk afistato apo tou ierou nhsteiaiv kai dehsesin latreuousa nukta kai hmeran
draft_translation: And she was a widow of about eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
ukjv_translation: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

greek_text: και αυτη αυτη τη ωρα επιστασα ανθωμολογειτο τω κυριω και ελαλει περι αυτου πασιν τοις προσδεχομενοις λυτρωσιν εν ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: kai auth auth th wra epistasa anywmologeito tw kuriw kai elalei peri autou pasin toiv prosdecomenoiv lutrwsin en ierousalhm
draft_translation: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spoke of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και ως ετελεσαν απαντα τα κατα τον νομον κυριου υπεστρεψαν εις την γαλιλαιαν εις την πολιν αυτων ναζαρεθ
transliteration: kai wv etelesan apanta ta kata ton nomon kuriou upestreqan eiv thn galilaian eiv thn polin autwn nazarey
draft_translation: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
ukjv_translation: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

greek_text: το δε παιδιον ηυξανεν και εκραταιουτο πνευματι πληρουμενον σοφιας και χαρις θεου ην επ αυτο
transliteration: to de paidion huxanen kai ekrataiouto pneumati plhroumenon sofiav kai cariv yeou hn ep auto
draft_translation: And the child grew, and grew strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
ukjv_translation: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, (o. pneuma) filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
review_notes: modernized waxed-strong idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και επορευοντο οι γονεις αυτου κατ ετος εις ιερουσαλημ τη εορτη του πασχα
transliteration: kai eporeuonto oi goneiv autou kat etov eiv ierousalhm th eorth tou pasca
draft_translation: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the Passover.
ukjv_translation: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

greek_text: και οτε εγενετο ετων δωδεκα αναβαντων αυτων εις ιεροσολυμα κατα το εθος της εορτης
transliteration: kai ote egeneto etwn dwdeka anabantwn autwn eiv ierosoluma kata to eyov thv eorthv
draft_translation: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
ukjv_translation: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και τελειωσαντων τας ημερας εν τω υποστρεφειν αυτους υπεμεινεν ιησους ο παις εν ιερουσαλημ και ουκ εγνω ιωσηφ και η μητηρ αυτου
transliteration: kai teleiwsantwn tav hmerav en tw upostrefein autouv upemeinen ihsouv o paiv en ierousalhm kai ouk egnw iwshf kai h mhthr autou
draft_translation: And when they had completed the days, as they returned, the child Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother did not know it.
ukjv_translation: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

greek_text: νομισαντες δε αυτον εν τη συνοδια ειναι ηλθον ημερας οδον και ανεζητουν αυτον εν τοις συγγενεσιν και εν τοις γνωστοις
transliteration: nomisantev de auton en th sunodia einai hlyon hmerav odon kai anezhtoun auton en toiv suggenesin kai en toiv gnwstoiv
draft_translation: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their relatives and acquaintance.
ukjv_translation: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

greek_text: και μη ευροντες αυτον υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ ζητουντες αυτον
transliteration: kai mh eurontev auton upestreqan eiv ierousalhm zhtountev auton
draft_translation: And when they did not find him, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
ukjv_translation: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

greek_text: και εγενετο μεθ ημερας τρεις ευρον αυτον εν τω ιερω καθεζομενον εν μεσω των διδασκαλων και ακουοντα αυτων και επερωτωντα αυτους
transliteration: kai egeneto mey hmerav treiv euron auton en tw ierw kayezomenon en mesw twn didaskalwn kai akouonta autwn kai eperwtwnta autouv
draft_translation: And it happened, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

greek_text: εξισταντο δε παντες οι ακουοντες αυτου επι τη συνεσει και ταις αποκρισεσιν αυτου
transliteration: existanto de pantev oi akouontev autou epi th sunesei kai taiv apokrisesin autou
draft_translation: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
ukjv_translation: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ιδοντες αυτον εξεπλαγησαν και προς αυτον η μητηρ αυτου ειπεν τεκνον τι εποιησας ημιν ουτως ιδου ο πατηρ σου καγω οδυνωμενοι εζητουμεν σε
transliteration: kai idontev auton exeplaghsan kai prov auton h mhthr autou eipen teknon ti epoihsav hmin outwv idou o pathr sou kagw odunwmenoi ezhtoumen se
draft_translation: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said to him, Son, why have you dealt with us thus? look, your father and I have sought you anxiously.
ukjv_translation: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why have you thus dealt with us? behold, your father and I have sought you sorrowing.

greek_text: και ειπεν προς αυτους τι οτι εζητειτε με ουκ ηδειτε οτι εν τοις του πατρος μου δει ειναι με
transliteration: kai eipen prov autouv ti oti ezhteite me ouk hdeite oti en toiv tou patrov mou dei einai me
draft_translation: And he said to them, How is it that you sought me? do you not know that I must be about my Father's business?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, How is it that all of you sought me? know all of you not that I must be about my Father's business?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized know-you-not question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και αυτοι ου συνηκαν το ρημα ο ελαλησεν αυτοις
transliteration: kai autoi ou sunhkan to rhma o elalhsen autoiv
draft_translation: And they did not understand the saying which he spoke to them.
ukjv_translation: And they understood not the saying (o. rhema) which he spoke unto them.

greek_text: και κατεβη μετ αυτων και ηλθεν εις ναζαρεθ και ην υποτασσομενος αυτοις και η μητηρ αυτου διετηρει παντα τα ρηματα ταυτα εν τη καρδια αυτης
transliteration: kai katebh met autwn kai hlyen eiv nazarey kai hn upotassomenov autoiv kai h mhthr autou diethrei panta ta rhmata tauta en th kardia authv
draft_translation: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
ukjv_translation: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings (o. rhema) in her heart.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και ιησους προεκοπτεν σοφια και ηλικια και χαριτι παρα θεω και ανθρωποις
transliteration: kai ihsouv proekopten sofia kai hlikia kai cariti para yew kai anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

greek_text: εν ετει δε πεντεκαιδεκατω της ηγεμονιας τιβεριου καισαρος ηγεμονευοντος ποντιου πιλατου της ιουδαιας και τετραρχουντος της γαλιλαιας ηρωδου φιλιππου δε του αδελφου αυτου τετραρχουντος της ιτουραιας και τραχωνιτιδος χωρας και λυσανιου της αβιληνης τετραρχουντος
transliteration: en etei de pentekaidekatw thv hgemoniav tiberiou kaisarov hgemoneuontov pontiou pilatou thv ioudaiav kai tetrarcountov thv galilaiav hrwdou filippou de tou adelfou autou tetrarcountov thv itouraiav kai tracwnitidov cwrav kai lusaniou thv abilhnhv tetrarcountov
draft_translation: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
ukjv_translation: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

greek_text: επ αρχιερεων αννα και καιαφα εγενετο ρημα θεου επι ιωαννην τον του ζαχαριου υιον εν τη ερημω
transliteration: ep arcierewn anna kai kaiafa egeneto rhma yeou epi iwannhn ton tou zacariou uion en th erhmw
draft_translation: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
ukjv_translation: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word (o. rhema) of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και ηλθεν εις πασαν την περιχωρον του ιορδανου κηρυσσων βαπτισμα μετανοιας εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων
transliteration: kai hlyen eiv pasan thn pericwron tou iordanou khrusswn baptisma metanoiav eiv afesin amartiwn
draft_translation: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins;
ukjv_translation: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

greek_text: ως γεγραπται εν βιβλω λογων ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ετοιμασατε την οδον κυριου ευθειας ποιειτε τας τριβους αυτου
transliteration: wv gegraptai en biblw logwn hsaiou tou profhtou legontov fwnh bowntov en th erhmw etoimasate thn odon kuriou euyeiav poieite tav tribouv autou
draft_translation: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
ukjv_translation: As it is written in the book of the words (o. logos) of Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare all of you the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

greek_text: πασα φαραγξ πληρωθησεται και παν ορος και βουνος ταπεινωθησεται και εσται τα σκολια εις ευθειαν και αι τραχειαι εις οδους λειας
transliteration: pasa faragx plhrwyhsetai kai pan orov kai bounov tapeinwyhsetai kai estai ta skolia eiv euyeian kai ai traceiai eiv odouv leiav
draft_translation: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
ukjv_translation: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και οψεται πασα σαρξ το σωτηριον του θεου
transliteration: kai oqetai pasa sarx to swthrion tou yeou
draft_translation: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
ukjv_translation: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ελεγεν ουν τοις εκπορευομενοις οχλοις βαπτισθηναι υπ αυτου γεννηματα εχιδνων τις υπεδειξεν υμιν φυγειν απο της μελλουσης οργης
transliteration: elegen oun toiv ekporeuomenoiv ocloiv baptisyhnai up autou gennhmata ecidnwn tiv upedeixen umin fugein apo thv melloushv orghv
draft_translation: Then he said to the crowd that came forth to be baptized by him, O offspring of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
ukjv_translation: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

greek_text: ποιησατε ουν καρπους αξιους της μετανοιας και μη αρξησθε λεγειν εν εαυτοις πατερα εχομεν τον αβρααμ λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι δυναται ο θεος εκ των λιθων τουτων εγειραι τεκνα τω αβρααμ
transliteration: poihsate oun karpouv axiouv thv metanoiav kai mh arxhsye legein en eautoiv patera ecomen ton abraam legw gar umin oti dunatai o yeov ek twn liywn toutwn egeirai tekna tw abraam
draft_translation: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for our father: for I say to you, That God is able from these stones to raise up children to Abraham.
ukjv_translation: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

greek_text: ηδη δε και η αξινη προς την ριζαν των δενδρων κειται παν ουν δενδρον μη ποιουν καρπον καλον εκκοπτεται και εις πυρ βαλλεται
transliteration: hdh de kai h axinh prov thn rizan twn dendrwn keitai pan oun dendron mh poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eiv pur balletai
draft_translation: And now also the axe is laid to the root of the trees: every tree therefore which does not bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
ukjv_translation: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

ukjv_translation: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up in order to read.

greek_text: και επεδοθη αυτω βιβλιον ησαιου του προφητου και αναπτυξας το βιβλιον ευρεν τον τοπον ου ην γεγραμμενον
transliteration: kai epedoyh autw biblion hsaiou tou profhtou kai anaptuxav to biblion euren ton topon ou hn gegrammenon
draft_translation: And there was delivered to him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
ukjv_translation: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

greek_text: πνευμα κυριου επ εμε ου ενεκεν εχρισεν με ευαγγελιζεσθαι πτωχοις απεσταλκεν με ιασασθαι τους συντετριμμενους την καρδιαν κηρυξαι αιχμαλωτοις αφεσιν και τυφλοις αναβλεψιν αποστειλαι τεθραυσμενους εν αφεσει
transliteration: pneuma kuriou ep eme ou eneken ecrisen me euaggelizesyai ptwcoiv apestalken me iasasyai touv suntetrimmenouv thn kardian khruxai aicmalwtoiv afesin kai tufloiv anableqin aposteilai teyrausmenouv en afesei
draft_translation: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to preach the good news to the poor; he has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty those who are bruised,
ukjv_translation: The Spirit (o. pneuma) of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: κηρυξαι ενιαυτον κυριου δεκτον
transliteration: khruxai eniauton kuriou dekton
draft_translation: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
ukjv_translation: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

greek_text: και πτυξας το βιβλιον αποδους τω υπηρετη εκαθισεν και παντων εν τη συναγωγη οι οφθαλμοι ησαν ατενιζοντες αυτω
transliteration: kai ptuxav to biblion apodouv tw uphreth ekayisen kai pantwn en th sunagwgh oi ofyalmoi hsan atenizontev autw
draft_translation: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the attendant, and sat down. And the eyes of all those who were in the synagogue were fixed on him.
ukjv_translation: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

greek_text: ηρξατο δε λεγειν προς αυτους οτι σημερον πεπληρωται η γραφη αυτη εν τοις ωσιν υμων
transliteration: hrxato de legein prov autouv oti shmeron peplhrwtai h grafh auth en toiv wsin umwn
draft_translation: And he began to say to them, Today this scripture is fulfilled in your ears.
ukjv_translation: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

greek_text: και παντες εμαρτυρουν αυτω και εθαυμαζον επι τοις λογοις της χαριτος τοις εκπορευομενοις εκ του στοματος αυτου και ελεγον ουχ ουτος εστιν ο υιος ιωσηφ
transliteration: kai pantev emarturoun autw kai eyaumazon epi toiv logoiv thv caritov toiv ekporeuomenoiv ek tou stomatov autou kai elegon ouc outov estin o uiov iwshf
draft_translation: And all bore him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is this not Joseph's son?
ukjv_translation: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words (o. logos) which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

greek_text: και ειπεν προς αυτους παντως ερειτε μοι την παραβολην ταυτην ιατρε θεραπευσον σεαυτον οσα ηκουσαμεν γενομενα εν τη καπερναουμ ποιησον και ωδε εν τη πατριδι σου
transliteration: kai eipen prov autouv pantwv ereite moi thn parabolhn tauthn iatre yerapeuson seauton osa hkousamen genomena en th kapernaoum poihson kai wde en th patridi sou
draft_translation: And he said to them, You will surely say to me this proverb, Physician, heal yourself: whatever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your country.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, All of you will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal yourself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your country.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ουδεις προφητης δεκτος εστιν εν τη πατριδι αυτου
transliteration: eipen de amhn legw umin oti oudeiv profhthv dektov estin en th patridi autou
draft_translation: And he said, Amen, I say to you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
ukjv_translation: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: επ αληθειας δε λεγω υμιν πολλαι χηραι ησαν εν ταις ημεραις ηλιου εν τω ισραηλ οτε εκλεισθη ο ουρανος επι ετη τρια και μηνας εξ ως εγενετο λιμος μεγας επι πασαν την γην
transliteration: ep alhyeiav de legw umin pollai chrai hsan en taiv hmeraiv hliou en tw israhl ote ekleisyh o ouranov epi eth tria kai mhnav ex wv egeneto limov megav epi pasan thn ghn
draft_translation: But I tell you truthfully, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
ukjv_translation: But I tell you truthfully, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και προς ουδεμιαν αυτων επεμφθη ηλιας ει μη εις σαρεπτα της σιδωνος προς γυναικα χηραν
transliteration: kai prov oudemian autwn epemfyh hliav ei mh eiv sarepta thv sidwnov prov gunaika chran
draft_translation: But to none of them was Elijah sent, except to Zarephath, a city of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
ukjv_translation: But unto none of them was Elijah sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

greek_text: και πολλοι λεπροι ησαν επι ελισσαιου του προφητου εν τω ισραηλ και ουδεις αυτων εκαθαρισθη ει μη νεεμαν ο συρος
transliteration: kai polloi leproi hsan epi elissaiou tou profhtou en tw israhl kai oudeiv autwn ekayarisyh ei mh neeman o surov
draft_translation: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, except Naaman the Syrian.
ukjv_translation: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

greek_text: και επλησθησαν παντες θυμου εν τη συναγωγη ακουοντες ταυτα
transliteration: kai eplhsyhsan pantev yumou en th sunagwgh akouontev tauta
draft_translation: And all those in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
ukjv_translation: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

greek_text: και ανασταντες εξεβαλον αυτον εξω της πολεως και ηγαγον αυτον εως της οφρυος του ορους εφ ου η πολις αυτων ωκοδομητο εις το κατακρημνισαι αυτον
transliteration: kai anastantev exebalon auton exw thv polewv kai hgagon auton ewv thv ofruov tou orouv ef ou h poliv autwn wkodomhto eiv to katakrhmnisai auton
draft_translation: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
ukjv_translation: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whereon

greek_text: αυτος δε διελθων δια μεσου αυτων επορευετο
transliteration: autov de dielywn dia mesou autwn eporeueto
draft_translation: But he, passing through the midst of them, went his way,
ukjv_translation: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

greek_text: και κατηλθεν εις καπερναουμ πολιν της γαλιλαιας και ην διδασκων αυτους εν τοις σαββασιν
transliteration: kai kathlyen eiv kapernaoum polin thv galilaiav kai hn didaskwn autouv en toiv sabbasin
draft_translation: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the Sabbath.
ukjv_translation: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

greek_text: και εξεπλησσοντο επι τη διδαχη αυτου οτι εν εξουσια ην ο λογος αυτου
transliteration: kai exeplhssonto epi th didach autou oti en exousia hn o logov autou
draft_translation: And they were astonished at his teaching: for his word was with authority.
ukjv_translation: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word (o. logos) was with power.

greek_text: και εν τη συναγωγη ην ανθρωπος εχων πνευμα δαιμονιου ακαθαρτου και ανεκραξεν φωνη μεγαλη
transliteration: kai en th sunagwgh hn anyrwpov ecwn pneuma daimoniou akayartou kai anekraxen fwnh megalh
draft_translation: And in the synagogue there was a man, who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and cried out with a loud voice,
ukjv_translation: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit (o. pneuma) of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: λεγων εα τι ημιν και σοι ιησου ναζαρηνε ηλθες απολεσαι ημας οιδα σε τις ει ο αγιος του θεου
transliteration: legwn ea ti hmin kai soi ihsou nazarhne hlyev apolesai hmav oida se tiv ei o agiov tou yeou
draft_translation: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to destroy us? I know who you are; the Holy One of God.
ukjv_translation: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Jesus of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are; the Holy One of God.

greek_text: και επετιμησεν αυτω ο ιησους λεγων φιμωθητι και εξελθε εξ αυτου και ριψαν αυτον το δαιμονιον εις το μεσον εξηλθεν απ αυτου μηδεν βλαψαν αυτον
transliteration: kai epetimhsen autw o ihsouv legwn fimwyhti kai exelye ex autou kai riqan auton to daimonion eiv to meson exhlyen ap autou mhden blaqan auton
draft_translation: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be silent, and come out of him. And when the demon had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
review_notes: fixed imperative casing; modernized hold-your-peace idiom; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και εγενετο θαμβος επι παντας και συνελαλουν προς αλληλους λεγοντες τις ο λογος ουτος οτι εν εξουσια και δυναμει επιτασσει τοις ακαθαρτοις πνευμασιν και εξερχονται
transliteration: kai egeneto yambov epi pantav kai sunelaloun prov allhlouv legontev tiv o logov outov oti en exousia kai dunamei epitassei toiv akayartoiv pneumasin kai exercontai
draft_translation: And they were all amazed, and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.
ukjv_translation: And they were all amazed, and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word (o. logos) is this! for with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) and they come out.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και εξεπορευετο ηχος περι αυτου εις παντα τοπον της περιχωρου
transliteration: kai exeporeueto hcov peri autou eiv panta topon thv pericwrou
draft_translation: And the report about him went out into every place of the region around.
ukjv_translation: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

greek_text: αναστας δε εκ της συναγωγης εισηλθεν εις την οικιαν σιμωνος η πενθερα δε του σιμωνος ην συνεχομενη πυρετω μεγαλω και ηρωτησαν αυτον περι αυτης
transliteration: anastav de ek thv sunagwghv eishlyen eiv thn oikian simwnov h penyera de tou simwnov hn sunecomenh puretw megalw kai hrwthsan auton peri authv
draft_translation: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's mother-in-law was taken with a great fever; and they begged him for her.
ukjv_translation: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

greek_text: και επιστας επανω αυτης επετιμησεν τω πυρετω και αφηκεν αυτην παραχρημα δε αναστασα διηκονει αυτοις
transliteration: kai epistav epanw authv epetimhsen tw puretw kai afhken authn paracrhma de anastasa dihkonei autoiv
draft_translation: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and served them.
ukjv_translation: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

greek_text: δυνοντος δε του ηλιου παντες οσοι ειχον ασθενουντας νοσοις ποικιλαις ηγαγον αυτους προς αυτον ο δε ενι εκαστω αυτων τας χειρας επιθεις εθεραπευσεν αυτους
transliteration: dunontov de tou hliou pantev osoi eicon asyenountav nosoiv poikilaiv hgagon autouv prov auton o de eni ekastw autwn tav ceirav epiyeiv eyerapeusen autouv
draft_translation: Now when the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
ukjv_translation: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized divers; modernized they-that relative

greek_text: εξηρχετο δε και δαιμονια απο πολλων κραζοντα και λεγοντα οτι συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου και επιτιμων ουκ εια αυτα λαλειν οτι ηδεισαν τον χριστον αυτον ειναι
transliteration: exhrceto de kai daimonia apo pollwn krazonta kai legonta oti su ei o cristov o uiov tou yeou kai epitimwn ouk eia auta lalein oti hdeisan ton criston auton einai
draft_translation: And demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, You are Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them did not allow them to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
ukjv_translation: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, You are Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
review_notes: modernized suffer-as-allow wording; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: γενομενης δε ημερας εξελθων επορευθη εις ερημον τοπον και οι οχλοι εζητουν αυτον και ηλθον εως αυτου και κατειχον αυτον του μη πορευεσθαι απ αυτων
transliteration: genomenhv de hmerav exelywn eporeuyh eiv erhmon topon kai oi ocloi ezhtoun auton kai hlyon ewv autou kai kateicon auton tou mh poreuesyai ap autwn
draft_translation: And when it was day, he departed and went into a deserted place: and the people sought him, and came to him, and tried to hold him back, that he should not depart from them.
ukjv_translation: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτους οτι και ταις ετεραις πολεσιν ευαγγελισασθαι με δει την βασιλειαν του θεου οτι εις τουτο απεσταλμαι
transliteration: o de eipen prov autouv oti kai taiv eteraiv polesin euaggelisasyai me dei thn basileian tou yeou oti eiv touto apestalmai
