draft_translation: And those who reclined at table with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgives sins also?
ukjv_translation: And they that sat at food with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgives sins also?
review_notes: modernized reclining-at-meal idiom; modernized they-that relative

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς την γυναικα η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε πορευου εις ειρηνην
transliteration: eipen de prov thn gunaika h pistiv sou seswken se poreuou eiv eirhnhn
draft_translation: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
ukjv_translation: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εγενετο εν τω καθεξης και αυτος διωδευεν κατα πολιν και κωμην κηρυσσων και ευαγγελιζομενος την βασιλειαν του θεου και οι δωδεκα συν αυτω
transliteration: kai egeneto en tw kayexhv kai autov diwdeuen kata polin kai kwmhn khrusswn kai euaggelizomenov thn basileian tou yeou kai oi dwdeka sun autw
draft_translation: And it happened afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and proclaiming the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and showing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

greek_text: και γυναικες τινες αι ησαν τεθεραπευμεναι απο πνευματων πονηρων και ασθενειων μαρια η καλουμενη μαγδαληνη αφ ης δαιμονια επτα εξεληλυθει
transliteration: kai gunaikev tinev ai hsan teyerapeumenai apo pneumatwn ponhrwn kai asyeneiwn maria h kaloumenh magdalhnh af hv daimonia epta exelhluyei
draft_translation: And certain women, who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven demons,
ukjv_translation: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits (o. pneuma) and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και ιωαννα γυνη χουζα επιτροπου ηρωδου και σουσαννα και ετεραι πολλαι αιτινες διηκονουν αυτω απο των υπαρχοντων αυταις
transliteration: kai iwanna gunh couza epitropou hrwdou kai sousanna kai eterai pollai aitinev dihkonoun autw apo twn uparcontwn autaiv
draft_translation: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who served him from their possessions.
ukjv_translation: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

greek_text: συνιοντος δε οχλου πολλου και των κατα πολιν επιπορευομενων προς αυτον ειπεν δια παραβολης
transliteration: suniontov de oclou pollou kai twn kata polin epiporeuomenwn prov auton eipen dia parabolhv
draft_translation: And when a great crowd was gathered together, and had come to him out of every city, he spoke by a parable:
ukjv_translation: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spoke by a parable:

greek_text: εξηλθεν ο σπειρων του σπειραι τον σπορον αυτου και εν τω σπειρειν αυτον ο μεν επεσεν παρα την οδον και κατεπατηθη και τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατεφαγεν αυτο
transliteration: exhlyen o speirwn tou speirai ton sporon autou kai en tw speirein auton o men epesen para thn odon kai katepathyh kai ta peteina tou ouranou katefagen auto
draft_translation: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trampled down, and the birds of the air devoured it.
ukjv_translation: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

greek_text: και ετερον επεσεν επι την πετραν και φυεν εξηρανθη δια το μη εχειν ικμαδα
transliteration: kai eteron epesen epi thn petran kai fuen exhranyh dia to mh ecein ikmada
draft_translation: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it sprang up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
ukjv_translation: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

greek_text: και ετερον επεσεν εν μεσω των ακανθων και συμφυεισαι αι ακανθαι απεπνιξαν αυτο
transliteration: kai eteron epesen en mesw twn akanywn kai sumfueisai ai akanyai apepnixan auto
draft_translation: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
ukjv_translation: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ετερον επεσεν επι την γην την αγαθην και φυεν εποιησεν καρπον εκατονταπλασιονα ταυτα λεγων εφωνει ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
transliteration: kai eteron epesen epi thn ghn thn agayhn kai fuen epoihsen karpon ekatontaplasiona tauta legwn efwnei o ecwn wta akouein akouetw
draft_translation: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bore fruit a hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, The one who has ears to hear, let him hear.
ukjv_translation: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

greek_text: επηρωτων δε αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες τις ειη η παραβολη αυτη
transliteration: ephrwtwn de auton oi mayhtai autou legontev tiv eih h parabolh auth
draft_translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable mean?
ukjv_translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν υμιν δεδοται γνωναι τα μυστηρια της βασιλειας του θεου τοις δε λοιποις εν παραβολαις ινα βλεποντες μη βλεπωσιν και ακουοντες μη συνιωσιν
transliteration: o de eipen umin dedotai gnwnai ta musthria thv basileiav tou yeou toiv de loipoiv en parabolaiv ina blepontev mh blepwsin kai akouontev mh suniwsin
draft_translation: And he said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
ukjv_translation: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

greek_text: εστιν δε αυτη η παραβολη ο σπορος εστιν ο λογος του θεου
transliteration: estin de auth h parabolh o sporov estin o logov tou yeou
draft_translation: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
ukjv_translation: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word (o. logos) of God.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οι δε παρα την οδον εισιν οι ακουοντες ειτα ερχεται ο διαβολος και αιρει τον λογον απο της καρδιας αυτων ινα μη πιστευσαντες σωθωσιν
transliteration: oi de para thn odon eisin oi akouontev eita ercetai o diabolov kai airei ton logon apo thv kardiav autwn ina mh pisteusantev swywsin
draft_translation: Those by the wayside are those who hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
ukjv_translation: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word (o. logos) out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

greek_text: οι δε επι της πετρας οι οταν ακουσωσιν μετα χαρας δεχονται τον λογον και ουτοι ριζαν ουκ εχουσιν οι προς καιρον πιστευουσιν και εν καιρω πειρασμου αφιστανται
transliteration: oi de epi thv petrav oi otan akouswsin meta carav decontai ton logon kai outoi rizan ouk ecousin oi prov kairon pisteuousin kai en kairw peirasmou afistantai
draft_translation: Those on the rock are they, who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
ukjv_translation: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word (o. logos) with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

greek_text: το δε εις τας ακανθας πεσον ουτοι εισιν οι ακουσαντες και υπο μεριμνων και πλουτου και ηδονων του βιου πορευομενοι συμπνιγονται και ου τελεσφορουσιν
transliteration: to de eiv tav akanyav peson outoi eisin oi akousantev kai upo merimnwn kai ploutou kai hdonwn tou biou poreuomenoi sumpnigontai kai ou telesforousin
draft_translation: And that which fell among thorns are they, who, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
ukjv_translation: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

greek_text: το δε εν τη καλη γη ουτοι εισιν οιτινες εν καρδια καλη και αγαθη ακουσαντες τον λογον κατεχουσιν και καρποφορουσιν εν υπομονη
transliteration: to de en th kalh gh outoi eisin oitinev en kardia kalh kai agayh akousantev ton logon katecousin kai karpoforousin en upomonh
draft_translation: But that on the good ground are they, who in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bear fruit with patience.
ukjv_translation: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, (o. logos) keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

greek_text: ουδεις δε λυχνον αψας καλυπτει αυτον σκευει η υποκατω κλινης τιθησιν αλλ επι λυχνιας επιτιθησιν ινα οι εισπορευομενοι βλεπωσιν το φως
transliteration: oudeiv de lucnon aqav kaluptei auton skeuei h upokatw klinhv tiyhsin all epi lucniav epitiyhsin ina oi eisporeuomenoi blepwsin to fwv
draft_translation: No one, when he has lighted a lamp, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a lampstand, that those who enter in may see the light.
ukjv_translation: No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν κρυπτον ο ου φανερον γενησεται ουδε αποκρυφον ο ου γνωσθησεται και εις φανερον ελθη
transliteration: ou gar estin krupton o ou faneron genhsetai oude apokrufon o ou gnwsyhsetai kai eiv faneron elyh
draft_translation: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither anything hidden, that shall not be known and come out.
ukjv_translation: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

greek_text: βλεπετε ουν πως ακουετε ος γαρ αν εχη δοθησεται αυτω και ος αν μη εχη και ο δοκει εχειν αρθησεται απ αυτου
transliteration: blepete oun pwv akouete ov gar an ech doyhsetai autw kai ov an mh ech kai o dokei ecein aryhsetai ap autou
draft_translation: Take heed therefore how you hear: for whoever has, to him shall be given; and whoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.
ukjv_translation: Take heed therefore how all of you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.
review_notes: modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: παρεγενοντο δε προς αυτον η μητηρ και οι αδελφοι αυτου και ουκ ηδυναντο συντυχειν αυτω δια τον οχλον
transliteration: paregenonto de prov auton h mhthr kai oi adelfoi autou kai ouk hdunanto suntucein autw dia ton oclon
draft_translation: Then came to him his mother and his brothers, and could not come near him because of the crowd.
ukjv_translation: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

greek_text: και απηγγελη αυτω λεγοντων η μητηρ σου και οι αδελφοι σου εστηκασιν εξω ιδειν σε θελοντες
transliteration: kai aphggelh autw legontwn h mhthr sou kai oi adelfoi sou esthkasin exw idein se yelontev
draft_translation: And it was told him by certain who said, Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.
ukjv_translation: And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν προς αυτους μητηρ μου και αδελφοι μου ουτοι εισιν οι τον λογον του θεου ακουοντες και ποιουντες αυτον
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv eipen prov autouv mhthr mou kai adelfoi mou outoi eisin oi ton logon tou yeou akouontev kai poiountev auton
draft_translation: And he answered and said to them, My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.
ukjv_translation: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word (o. logos) of God, and do it.

greek_text: και εγενετο εν μια των ημερων και αυτος ενεβη εις πλοιον και οι μαθηται αυτου και ειπεν προς αυτους διελθωμεν εις το περαν της λιμνης και ανηχθησαν
transliteration: kai egeneto en mia twn hmerwn kai autov enebh eiv ploion kai oi mayhtai autou kai eipen prov autouv dielywmen eiv to peran thv limnhv kai anhcyhsan
draft_translation: Now it happened on a certain day, that he went into a boat with his disciples: and he said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
ukjv_translation: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized came-to-pass idiom; rendered ploion as boat

greek_text: πλεοντων δε αυτων αφυπνωσεν και κατεβη λαιλαψ ανεμου εις την λιμνην και συνεπληρουντο και εκινδυνευον
transliteration: pleontwn de autwn afupnwsen kai katebh lailaq anemou eiv thn limnhn kai suneplhrounto kai ekinduneuon
draft_translation: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in danger.
ukjv_translation: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

greek_text: προσελθοντες δε διηγειραν αυτον λεγοντες επιστατα επιστατα απολλυμεθα ο δε εγερθεις επετιμησεν τω ανεμω και τω κλυδωνι του υδατος και επαυσαντο και εγενετο γαληνη
transliteration: proselyontev de dihgeiran auton legontev epistata epistata apollumeya o de egeryeiv epetimhsen tw anemw kai tw kludwni tou udatov kai epausanto kai egeneto galhnh
draft_translation: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we are perishing. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
ukjv_translation: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτοις που εστιν η πιστις υμων φοβηθεντες δε εθαυμασαν λεγοντες προς αλληλους τις αρα ουτος εστιν οτι και τοις ανεμοις επιτασσει και τω υδατι και υπακουουσιν αυτω
transliteration: eipen de autoiv pou estin h pistiv umwn fobhyentev de eyaumasan legontev prov allhlouv tiv ara outov estin oti kai toiv anemoiv epitassei kai tw udati kai upakouousin autw
draft_translation: And he said to them, Where is your faith? And they, being afraid, wondered, saying one to another, Who then is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.

greek_text: και κατεπλευσαν εις την χωραν των γαδαρηνων ητις εστιν αντιπεραν της γαλιλαιας
transliteration: kai katepleusan eiv thn cwran twn gadarhnwn htiv estin antiperan thv galilaiav
draft_translation: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite to Galilee.
ukjv_translation: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite to Galilee.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εξελθοντι δε αυτω επι την γην υπηντησεν αυτω ανηρ τις εκ της πολεως ος ειχεν δαιμονια εκ χρονων ικανων και ιματιον ουκ ενεδιδυσκετο και εν οικια ουκ εμενεν αλλ εν τοις μνημασιν
transliteration: exelyonti de autw epi thn ghn uphnthsen autw anhr tiv ek thv polewv ov eicen daimonia ek cronwn ikanwn kai imation ouk enedidusketo kai en oikia ouk emenen all en toiv mnhmasin
draft_translation: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, who had demons long time, and wore no clothes, neither remained in any house, but in the tombs.
ukjv_translation: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
review_notes: modernized abode; modernized personal which as who; modernized ware as wore; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: ιδων δε τον ιησουν και ανακραξας προσεπεσεν αυτω και φωνη μεγαλη ειπεν τι εμοι και σοι ιησου υιε του θεου του υψιστου δεομαι σου μη με βασανισης
transliteration: idwn de ton ihsoun kai anakraxav prosepesen autw kai fwnh megalh eipen ti emoi kai soi ihsou uie tou yeou tou uqistou deomai sou mh me basanishv
draft_translation: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of God most high? I plead to you, torment me not.
ukjv_translation: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of God most high? I plead to you, torment me not.

greek_text: παρηγγειλεν γαρ τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω εξελθειν απο του ανθρωπου πολλοις γαρ χρονοις συνηρπακει αυτον και εδεσμειτο αλυσεσιν και πεδαις φυλασσομενος και διαρρησσων τα δεσμα ηλαυνετο υπο του δαιμονος εις τας ερημους

draft_translation: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he broke the bands, and was driven of the demon into the wilderness.)
ukjv_translation: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit (o. pneuma) to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

greek_text: επηρωτησεν δε αυτον ο ιησους λεγων τι σοι εστιν ονομα ο δε ειπεν λεγεων οτι δαιμονια πολλα εισηλθεν εις αυτον
transliteration: ephrwthsen de auton o ihsouv legwn ti soi estin onoma o de eipen legewn oti daimonia polla eishlyen eiv auton
draft_translation: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many demons were entered into him.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

greek_text: και παρεκαλουν αυτον ινα μη επιταξη αυτοις εις την αβυσσον απελθειν
transliteration: kai parekaloun auton ina mh epitaxh autoiv eiv thn abusson apelyein
draft_translation: And they begged him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
ukjv_translation: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized besought; modernized him-that relative

greek_text: ην δε εκει αγελη χοιρων ικανων βοσκομενων εν τω ορει και παρεκαλουν αυτον ινα επιτρεψη αυτοις εις εκεινους εισελθειν και επετρεψεν αυτοις
transliteration: hn de ekei agelh coirwn ikanwn boskomenwn en tw orei kai parekaloun auton ina epitreqh autoiv eiv ekeinouv eiselyein kai epetreqen autoiv
draft_translation: And there was there a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they begged him that he would permit them to enter into them. And he permitted them.
ukjv_translation: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

greek_text: εξελθοντα δε τα δαιμονια απο του ανθρωπου εισηλθεν εις τους χοιρους και ωρμησεν η αγελη κατα του κρημνου εις την λιμνην και απεπνιγη
transliteration: exelyonta de ta daimonia apo tou anyrwpou eishlyen eiv touv coirouv kai wrmhsen h agelh kata tou krhmnou eiv thn limnhn kai apepnigh
draft_translation: Then went the demons out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
ukjv_translation: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

greek_text: ιδοντες δε οι βοσκοντες το γεγενημενον εφυγον και απελθοντες απηγγειλαν εις την πολιν και εις τους αγρους
transliteration: idontev de oi boskontev to gegenhmenon efugon kai apelyontev aphggeilan eiv thn polin kai eiv touv agrouv
draft_translation: When those who fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
ukjv_translation: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

greek_text: εξηλθον δε ιδειν το γεγονος και ηλθον προς τον ιησουν και ευρον καθημενον τον ανθρωπον αφ ου τα δαιμονια εξεληλυθει ιματισμενον και σωφρονουντα παρα τους ποδας του ιησου και εφοβηθησαν
transliteration: exhlyon de idein to gegonov kai hlyon prov ton ihsoun kai euron kayhmenon ton anyrwpon af ou ta daimonia exelhluyei imatismenon kai swfronounta para touv podav tou ihsou kai efobhyhsan
draft_translation: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the demons were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
ukjv_translation: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

greek_text: απηγγειλαν δε αυτοις και οι ιδοντες πως εσωθη ο δαιμονισθεις
transliteration: aphggeilan de autoiv kai oi idontev pwv eswyh o daimonisyeiv
draft_translation: They also which saw it told them by what means the one who was possessed of the demons was healed.
ukjv_translation: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και ηρωτησαν αυτον απαν το πληθος της περιχωρου των γαδαρηνων απελθειν απ αυτων οτι φοβω μεγαλω συνειχοντο αυτος δε εμβας εις το πλοιον υπεστρεψεν
transliteration: kai hrwthsan auton apan to plhyov thv pericwrou twn gadarhnwn apelyein ap autwn oti fobw megalw suneiconto autov de embav eiv to ploion upestreqen
draft_translation: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about begged him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the boat, and returned back again.
ukjv_translation: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
review_notes: modernized besought; rendered ploion as boat

greek_text: εδεετο δε αυτου ο ανηρ αφ ου εξεληλυθει τα δαιμονια ειναι συν αυτω απελυσεν δε αυτον ο ιησους λεγων
transliteration: edeeto de autou o anhr af ou exelhluyei ta daimonia einai sun autw apelusen de auton o ihsouv legwn
draft_translation: Now the man out of whom the demons were departed begged him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
ukjv_translation: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized besought; modernized him-that relative; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: υποστρεφε εις τον οικον σου και διηγου οσα εποιησεν σοι ο θεος και απηλθεν καθ ολην την πολιν κηρυσσων οσα εποιησεν αυτω ο ιησους
transliteration: upostrefe eiv ton oikon sou kai dihgou osa epoihsen soi o yeov kai aphlyen kay olhn thn polin khrusswn osa epoihsen autw o ihsouv
draft_translation: Return to your own house, and declare how great things God has done to you. And he went his way, and proclaimed throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done to him.
ukjv_translation: Return to yours own house, and show how great things God has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

greek_text: εγενετο δε εν τω υποστρεψαι τον ιησουν απεδεξατο αυτον ο οχλος ησαν γαρ παντες προσδοκωντες αυτον
transliteration: egeneto de en tw upostreqai ton ihsoun apedexato auton o oclov hsan gar pantev prosdokwntev auton
draft_translation: And it happened, that, when Jesus returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

greek_text: και ιδου ηλθεν ανηρ ω ονομα ιαειρος και αυτος αρχων της συναγωγης υπηρχεν και πεσων παρα τους ποδας του ιησου παρεκαλει αυτον εισελθειν εις τον οικον αυτου
transliteration: kai idou hlyen anhr w onoma iaeirov kai autov arcwn thv sunagwghv uphrcen kai peswn para touv podav tou ihsou parekalei auton eiselyein eiv ton oikon autou
draft_translation: And, look, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and begged him that he would come into his house:
ukjv_translation: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized behold; modernized besought; modernized him-that relative

greek_text: οτι θυγατηρ μονογενης ην αυτω ως ετων δωδεκα και αυτη απεθνησκεν εν δε τω υπαγειν αυτον οι οχλοι συνεπνιγον αυτον
transliteration: oti yugathr monogenhv hn autw wv etwn dwdeka kai auth apeynhsken en de tw upagein auton oi ocloi sunepnigon auton
draft_translation: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay dying. But as he went the people crowded him.
ukjv_translation: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

greek_text: και γυνη ουσα εν ρυσει αιματος απο ετων δωδεκα ητις εις ιατρους προσαναλωσασα ολον τον βιον ουκ ισχυσεν υπ ουδενος θεραπευθηναι
transliteration: kai gunh ousa en rusei aimatov apo etwn dwdeka htiv eiv iatrouv prosanalwsasa olon ton bion ouk iscusen up oudenov yerapeuyhnai
draft_translation: And a woman having a flow of blood twelve years, who had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed by any,
ukjv_translation: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

greek_text: προσελθουσα οπισθεν ηψατο του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου και παραχρημα εστη η ρυσις του αιματος αυτης
transliteration: proselyousa opisyen hqato tou kraspedou tou imatiou autou kai paracrhma esth h rusiv tou aimatov authv
draft_translation: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her flow of blood stopped.
ukjv_translation: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stopped.

greek_text: και ειπεν ο ιησους τις ο αψαμενος μου αρνουμενων δε παντων ειπεν ο πετρος και οι μετ αυτου επιστατα οι οχλοι συνεχουσιν σε και αποθλιβουσιν και λεγεις τις ο αψαμενος μου
transliteration: kai eipen o ihsouv tiv o aqamenov mou arnoumenwn de pantwn eipen o petrov kai oi met autou epistata oi ocloi sunecousin se kai apoylibousin kai legeiv tiv o aqamenov mou
draft_translation: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and those who were with him said, Master, the crowd throng you and press you, and you say, Who touched me?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude crowd upon you and press you, and says you, Who touched me?

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ειπεν ηψατο μου τις εγω γαρ εγνων δυναμιν εξελθουσαν απ εμου
transliteration: o de ihsouv eipen hqato mou tiv egw gar egnwn dunamin exelyousan ap emou
draft_translation: And Jesus said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that power has gone out of me.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

greek_text: ιδουσα δε η γυνη οτι ουκ ελαθεν τρεμουσα ηλθεν και προσπεσουσα αυτω δι ην αιτιαν ηψατο αυτου απηγγειλεν αυτω ενωπιον παντος του λαου και ως ιαθη παραχρημα
transliteration: idousa de h gunh oti ouk elayen tremousa hlyen kai prospesousa autw di hn aitian hqato autou aphggeilen autw enwpion pantov tou laou kai wv iayh paracrhma
draft_translation: And when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared to him before all the people for what reason she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
ukjv_translation: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτη θαρσει θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε πορευου εις ειρηνην
transliteration: o de eipen auth yarsei yugater h pistiv sou seswken se poreuou eiv eirhnhn
draft_translation: And he said to her, Daughter, take courage: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.

greek_text: ετι αυτου λαλουντος ερχεται τις παρα του αρχισυναγωγου λεγων αυτω οτι τεθνηκεν η θυγατηρ σου μη σκυλλε τον διδασκαλον
transliteration: eti autou lalountov ercetai tiv para tou arcisunagwgou legwn autw oti teynhken h yugathr sou mh skulle ton didaskalon
draft_translation: While he yet spoke, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; do not trouble the Teacher.
ukjv_translation: While he yet spoke, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ακουσας απεκριθη αυτω λεγων μη φοβου μονον πιστευε και σωθησεται
transliteration: o de ihsouv akousav apekriyh autw legwn mh fobou monon pisteue kai swyhsetai
draft_translation: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Do not fear: only believe, and she shall be made whole.
ukjv_translation: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

greek_text: εισελθων δε εις την οικιαν ουκ αφηκεν εισελθειν ουδενα ει μη πετρον και ιακωβον και ιωαννην και τον πατερα της παιδος και την μητερα
transliteration: eiselywn de eiv thn oikian ouk afhken eiselyein oudena ei mh petron kai iakwbon kai iwannhn kai ton patera thv paidov kai thn mhtera
draft_translation: And when he came into the house, he allowed no one to go in, except Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
ukjv_translation: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

greek_text: εκλαιον δε παντες και εκοπτοντο αυτην ο δε ειπεν μη κλαιετε ουκ απεθανεν αλλα καθευδει
transliteration: eklaion de pantev kai ekoptonto authn o de eipen mh klaiete ouk apeyanen alla kayeudei
draft_translation: And all wept, and mourned her: but he said, Do not weep; she is not dead, but sleeps.
ukjv_translation: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleeps.

greek_text: και κατεγελων αυτου ειδοτες οτι απεθανεν
transliteration: kai kategelwn autou eidotev oti apeyanen
draft_translation: And they laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
ukjv_translation: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

greek_text: αυτος δε εκβαλων εξω παντας και κρατησας της χειρος αυτης εφωνησεν λεγων η παις εγειρου
transliteration: autov de ekbalwn exw pantav kai krathsav thv ceirov authv efwnhsen legwn h paiv egeirou
draft_translation: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Girl, arise.
ukjv_translation: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

greek_text: και επεστρεψεν το πνευμα αυτης και ανεστη παραχρημα και διεταξεν αυτη δοθηναι φαγειν
transliteration: kai epestreqen to pneuma authv kai anesth paracrhma kai dietaxen auth doyhnai fagein
draft_translation: And her spirit returned, and she arose immediately: and he commanded that food be given to her.
ukjv_translation: And her spirit (o. pneuma) came again, and she arose immediately: and he commanded to give her food.

greek_text: και εξεστησαν οι γονεις αυτης ο δε παρηγγειλεν αυτοις μηδενι ειπειν το γεγονος
transliteration: kai exesthsan oi goneiv authv o de parhggeilen autoiv mhdeni eipein to gegonov
draft_translation: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no one what was done.
ukjv_translation: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
review_notes: fixed charged-them relative artifact; modernized no-man idiom; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: συγκαλεσαμενος δε τους δωδεκα μαθητας αυτου εδωκεν αυτοις δυναμιν και εξουσιαν επι παντα τα δαιμονια και νοσους θεραπευειν
transliteration: sugkalesamenov de touv dwdeka mayhtav autou edwken autoiv dunamin kai exousian epi panta ta daimonia kai nosouv yerapeuein
draft_translation: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
ukjv_translation: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

greek_text: και απεστειλεν αυτους κηρυσσειν την βασιλειαν του θεου και ιασθαι τους ασθενουντας
transliteration: kai apesteilen autouv khrussein thn basileian tou yeou kai iasyai touv asyenountav
draft_translation: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
ukjv_translation: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ειπεν προς αυτους μηδεν αιρετε εις την οδον μητε ραβδους μητε πηραν μητε αρτον μητε αργυριον μητε ανα δυο χιτωνας εχειν
transliteration: kai eipen prov autouv mhden airete eiv thn odon mhte rabdouv mhte phran mhte arton mhte argurion mhte ana duo citwnav ecein
draft_translation: And he said to them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staffs, nor pouch, neither bread, neither money; neither have two tunics apiece.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor pouch, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized staves; rendered chiton as tunic

greek_text: και εις ην αν οικιαν εισελθητε εκει μενετε και εκειθεν εξερχεσθε
transliteration: kai eiv hn an oikian eiselyhte ekei menete kai ekeiyen exercesye
draft_translation: And whatever house you enter into, there remain, and from there depart.
ukjv_translation: And whatsoever house all of you enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

greek_text: και οσοι αν μη δεξωνται υμας εξερχομενοι απο της πολεως εκεινης και τον κονιορτον απο των ποδων υμων αποτιναξατε εις μαρτυριον επ αυτους
transliteration: kai osoi an mh dexwntai umav exercomenoi apo thv polewv ekeinhv kai ton koniorton apo twn podwn umwn apotinaxate eiv marturion ep autouv
draft_translation: And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever will not receive you, when all of you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

greek_text: εξερχομενοι δε διηρχοντο κατα τας κωμας ευαγγελιζομενοι και θεραπευοντες πανταχου
transliteration: exercomenoi de dihrconto kata tav kwmav euaggelizomenoi kai yerapeuontev pantacou
draft_translation: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the good news, and healing everywhere.
ukjv_translation: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
review_notes: modernized every where spelling; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ηκουσεν δε ηρωδης ο τετραρχης τα γινομενα υπ αυτου παντα και διηπορει δια το λεγεσθαι υπο τινων οτι ιωαννης εγηγερται εκ νεκρων
transliteration: hkousen de hrwdhv o tetrarchv ta ginomena up autou panta kai dihporei dia to legesyai upo tinwn oti iwannhv eghgertai ek nekrwn
draft_translation: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because it was said by some, that John had risen from the dead;
ukjv_translation: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

greek_text: υπο τινων δε οτι ηλιας εφανη αλλων δε οτι προφητης εις των αρχαιων ανεστη
transliteration: upo tinwn de oti hliav efanh allwn de oti profhthv eiv twn arcaiwn anesth
draft_translation: And by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets had risen again.
ukjv_translation: And of some, that Elijah had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

greek_text: και ειπεν ο ηρωδης ιωαννην εγω απεκεφαλισα τις δε εστιν ουτος περι ου εγω ακουω τοιαυτα και εζητει ιδειν αυτον
transliteration: kai eipen o hrwdhv iwannhn egw apekefalisa tiv de estin outov peri ou egw akouw toiauta kai ezhtei idein auton
draft_translation: And Herod said, John I have beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he sought to see him.
ukjv_translation: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

greek_text: και υποστρεψαντες οι αποστολοι διηγησαντο αυτω οσα εποιησαν και παραλαβων αυτους υπεχωρησεν κατ ιδιαν εις τοπον ερημον πολεως καλουμενης βηθσαιδα
transliteration: kai upostreqantev oi apostoloi dihghsanto autw osa epoihsan kai paralabwn autouv upecwrhsen kat idian eiv topon erhmon polewv kaloumenhv bhysaida
draft_translation: And the apostles, when they had returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a deserted place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
ukjv_translation: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

greek_text: οι δε οχλοι γνοντες ηκολουθησαν αυτω και δεξαμενος αυτους ελαλει αυτοις περι της βασιλειας του θεου και τους χρειαν εχοντας θεραπειας ιατο
transliteration: oi de ocloi gnontev hkolouyhsan autw kai dexamenov autouv elalei autoiv peri thv basileiav tou yeou kai touv creian econtav yerapeiav iato
draft_translation: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spoke to them of the kingdom of God, and healed those who had need of healing.

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς αυτους δοτε αυτοις υμεις φαγειν οι δε ειπον ουκ εισιν ημιν πλειον η πεντε αρτοι και δυο ιχθυες ει μητι πορευθεντες ημεις αγορασωμεν εις παντα τον λαον τουτον βρωματα

draft_translation: But he said to them, Give you them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fish; except we should go and buy food for all this people.

transliteration: hsan gar wsei andrev pentakiscilioi eipen de prov touv mayhtav autou kataklinate autouv klisiav ana penthkonta
draft_translation: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a group.
ukjv_translation: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

greek_text: και εποιησαν ουτως και ανεκλιναν απαντας

draft_translation: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
ukjv_translation: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

greek_text: λαβων δε τους πεντε αρτους και τους δυο ιχθυας αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον ευλογησεν αυτους και κατεκλασεν και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις παρατιθεναι τω οχλω

draft_translation: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and broke, and gave to the disciples to set before the crowd.
ukjv_translation: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

ukjv_translation: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

greek_text: και εγενετο εν τω ειναι αυτον προσευχομενον καταμονας συνησαν αυτω οι μαθηται και επηρωτησεν αυτους λεγων τινα με λεγουσιν οι οχλοι ειναι

draft_translation: And it happened, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Who do the people say that I am?
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

greek_text: οι δε αποκριθεντες ειπον ιωαννην τον βαπτιστην αλλοι δε ηλιαν αλλοι δε οτι προφητης τις των αρχαιων ανεστη
transliteration: oi de apokriyentev eipon iwannhn ton baptisthn alloi de hlian alloi de oti profhthv tiv twn arcaiwn anesth
draft_translation: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others say, that one of the old prophets has risen again.
ukjv_translation: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others say, that one of the old prophets has risen again.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτοις υμεις δε τινα με λεγετε ειναι αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος ειπεν τον χριστον του θεου
transliteration: eipen de autoiv umeiv de tina me legete einai apokriyeiv de o petrov eipen ton criston tou yeou
draft_translation: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
ukjv_translation: He said unto them, But whom say all of you that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
review_notes: fixed question casing; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized inverted question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

draft_translation: And he strictly charged them, and commanded them to tell this to no one;
ukjv_translation: And he strictly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

greek_text: ειπων οτι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου πολλα παθειν και αποδοκιμασθηναι απο των πρεσβυτερων και αρχιερεων και γραμματεων και αποκτανθηναι και τη τριτη ημερα εγερθηναι
transliteration: eipwn oti dei ton uion tou anyrwpou polla payein kai apodokimasyhnai apo twn presbuterwn kai arcierewn kai grammatewn kai apoktanyhnai kai th trith hmera egeryhnai
draft_translation: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.
ukjv_translation: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

greek_text: ελεγεν δε προς παντας ει τις θελει οπισω μου ελθειν απαρνησασθω εαυτον και αρατω τον σταυρον αυτου καθ ημεραν και ακολουθειτω μοι
transliteration: elegen de prov pantav ei tiv yelei opisw mou elyein aparnhsasyw eauton kai aratw ton stauron autou kay hmeran kai akolouyeitw moi
draft_translation: And he said to them all, If anyone will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
ukjv_translation: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

greek_text: ος γαρ αν θελη την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην ος δ αν απολεση την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου ουτος σωσει αυτην
transliteration: ov gar an yelh thn quchn autou swsai apolesei authn ov d an apolesh thn quchn autou eneken emou outov swsei authn
draft_translation: For whoever will save his life shall lose it: but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

greek_text: τι γαρ ωφελειται ανθρωπος κερδησας τον κοσμον ολον εαυτον δε απολεσας η ζημιωθεις
transliteration: ti gar wfeleitai anyrwpov kerdhsav ton kosmon olon eauton de apolesav h zhmiwyeiv
draft_translation: For what is a man profited, if he gains the whole world, and loses himself, or is cast away?
ukjv_translation: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

greek_text: ος γαρ αν επαισχυνθη με και τους εμους λογους τουτον ο υιος του ανθρωπου επαισχυνθησεται οταν ελθη εν τη δοξη αυτου και του πατρος και των αγιων αγγελων
transliteration: ov gar an epaiscunyh me kai touv emouv logouv touton o uiov tou anyrwpou epaiscunyhsetai otan elyh en th doxh autou kai tou patrov kai twn agiwn aggelwn
draft_translation: For whoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, (o. logos) of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
review_notes: modernized whosoever; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν αληθως εισιν τινες των ωδε εστηκοτων οι ου μη γευσονται θανατου εως αν ιδωσιν την βασιλειαν του θεου
transliteration: legw de umin alhywv eisin tinev twn wde esthkotwn oi ou mh geusontai yanatou ewv an idwsin thn basileian tou yeou
draft_translation: But I tell you truthfully, there are some standing here, who shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: But I tell you truthfully, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

greek_text: εγενετο δε μετα τους λογους τουτους ωσει ημεραι οκτω και παραλαβων τον πετρον και ιωαννην και ιακωβον ανεβη εις το ορος προσευξασθαι
transliteration: egeneto de meta touv logouv toutouv wsei hmerai oktw kai paralabwn ton petron kai iwannhn kai iakwbon anebh eiv to orov proseuxasyai
draft_translation: And it happened about eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up onto a mountain to pray.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, (o. logos) he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

greek_text: και εγενετο εν τω προσευχεσθαι αυτον το ειδος του προσωπου αυτου ετερον και ο ιματισμος αυτου λευκος εξαστραπτων
transliteration: kai egeneto en tw proseucesyai auton to eidov tou proswpou autou eteron kai o imatismov autou leukov exastraptwn
draft_translation: And as he prayed, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing was white and flashing.
ukjv_translation: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and flashing.

greek_text: και ιδου ανδρες δυο συνελαλουν αυτω οιτινες ησαν μωσης και ηλιας
transliteration: kai idou andrev duo sunelaloun autw oitinev hsan mwshv kai hliav
draft_translation: And, look, there talked with him two men, who were Moses and Elijah:
ukjv_translation: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elijah:
review_notes: modernized behold; modernized personal which as who

transliteration: oi ofyentev en doxh elegon thn exodon autou hn emellen plhroun en ierousalhm
draft_translation: Who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: Who appeared in glory, and spoke of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

greek_text: ο δε πετρος και οι συν αυτω ησαν βεβαρημενοι υπνω διαγρηγορησαντες δε ειδον την δοξαν αυτου και τους δυο ανδρας τους συνεστωτας αυτω
transliteration: o de petrov kai oi sun autw hsan bebarhmenoi upnw diagrhgorhsantev de eidon thn doxan autou kai touv duo andrav touv sunestwtav autw
draft_translation: But Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
ukjv_translation: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

greek_text: και εγενετο εν τω διαχωριζεσθαι αυτους απ αυτου ειπεν ο πετρος προς τον ιησουν επιστατα καλον εστιν ημας ωδε ειναι και ποιησωμεν σκηνας τρεις μιαν σοι και μωσει μιαν και μιαν ηλια μη ειδως ο λεγει
transliteration: kai egeneto en tw diacwrizesyai autouv ap autou eipen o petrov prov ton ihsoun epistata kalon estin hmav wde einai kai poihswmen skhnav treiv mian soi kai mwsei mian kai mian hlia mh eidwv o legei
draft_translation: And it happened, as they departed from him, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.

greek_text: ταυτα δε αυτου λεγοντος εγενετο νεφελη και επεσκιασεν αυτους εφοβηθησαν δε εν τω εκεινους εισελθειν εις την νεφελην
transliteration: tauta de autou legontov egeneto nefelh kai epeskiasen autouv efobhyhsan de en tw ekeinouv eiselyein eiv thn nefelhn
draft_translation: While he thus spoke, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
ukjv_translation: While he thus spoke, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

greek_text: και φωνη εγενετο εκ της νεφελης λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος αυτου ακουετε
transliteration: kai fwnh egeneto ek thv nefelhv legousa outov estin o uiov mou o agaphtov autou akouete
draft_translation: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
ukjv_translation: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εν τω γενεσθαι την φωνην ευρεθη ο ιησους μονος και αυτοι εσιγησαν και ουδενι απηγγειλαν εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις ουδεν ων εωρακασιν
transliteration: kai en tw genesyai thn fwnhn eureyh o ihsouv monov kai autoi esighsan kai oudeni aphggeilan en ekeinaiv taiv hmeraiv ouden wn ewrakasin
draft_translation: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it secret, and told no one in those days any of those things which they had seen.
ukjv_translation: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

draft_translation: And it happened, that on the next day, when they had come down from the hill, a great crowd met him.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

greek_text: και ιδου ανηρ απο του οχλου ανεβοησεν λεγων διδασκαλε δεομαι σου επιβλεψον επι τον υιον μου οτι μονογενης εστιν μοι
transliteration: kai idou anhr apo tou oclou anebohsen legwn didaskale deomai sou epibleqon epi ton uion mou oti monogenhv estin moi
draft_translation: And, look, a man of the crowd cried out, saying, Teacher, I beg you, look upon my son: for he is my only child.
ukjv_translation: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I plead to you, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

greek_text: και ιδου πνευμα λαμβανει αυτον και εξαιφνης κραζει και σπαρασσει αυτον μετα αφρου και μογις αποχωρει απ αυτου συντριβον αυτον
transliteration: kai idou pneuma lambanei auton kai exaifnhv krazei kai sparassei auton meta afrou kai mogiv apocwrei ap autou suntribon auton
draft_translation: And, look, a spirit takes him, and he suddenly cries out; and it tears him so that he foams again, and with difficulty departs from him, bruising him.
ukjv_translation: And, lo, a spirit (o. pneuma) takes him, and he suddenly cries out; and it tears him that he foams again, and bruising him hardly departs from him.
review_notes: fixed hardly-departs word order; fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized him-that relative; modernized lo; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και εδεηθην των μαθητων σου ινα εκβαλλωσιν αυτο και ουκ ηδυνηθησαν

draft_translation: And I begged your disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
ukjv_translation: And I besought your disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

draft_translation: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and bear with you? Bring your son here.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring your son here.

greek_text: ετι δε προσερχομενου αυτου ερρηξεν αυτον το δαιμονιον και συνεσπαραξεν επετιμησεν δε ο ιησους τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω και ιασατο τον παιδα και απεδωκεν αυτον τω πατρι αυτου
transliteration: eti de prosercomenou autou errhxen auton to daimonion kai sunesparaxen epetimhsen de o ihsouv tw pneumati tw akayartw kai iasato ton paida kai apedwken auton tw patri autou
draft_translation: And as he was yet a coming, the demon threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
ukjv_translation: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, (o. pneuma) and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: εξεπλησσοντο δε παντες επι τη μεγαλειοτητι του θεου παντων δε θαυμαζοντων επι πασιν οις εποιησεν ο ιησους ειπεν προς τους μαθητας αυτου
transliteration: exeplhssonto de pantev epi th megaleiothti tou yeou pantwn de yaumazontwn epi pasin oiv epoihsen o ihsouv eipen prov touv mayhtav autou
draft_translation: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while every one wondered at all things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
ukjv_translation: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
