transliteration: yesye umeiv eiv ta wta umwn touv logouv toutouv o gar uiov tou anyrwpou mellei paradidosyai eiv ceirav anyrwpwn
draft_translation: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
ukjv_translation: Let these sayings (o. logos) sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οι δε ηγνοουν το ρημα τουτο και ην παρακεκαλυμμενον απ αυτων ινα μη αισθωνται αυτο και εφοβουντο ερωτησαι αυτον περι του ρηματος τουτου
transliteration: oi de hgnooun to rhma touto kai hn parakekalummenon ap autwn ina mh aisywntai auto kai efobounto erwthsai auton peri tou rhmatov toutou
draft_translation: But they did not understand this saying, and it was hidden from them, so that they did not perceive it: and they feared to ask him about that saying.
ukjv_translation: But they understood not this saying, (o. rhema) and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying. (o. rhema)

greek_text: εισηλθεν δε διαλογισμος εν αυτοις το τις αν ειη μειζων αυτων
transliteration: eishlyen de dialogismov en autoiv to tiv an eih meizwn autwn
draft_translation: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
ukjv_translation: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ιδων τον διαλογισμον της καρδιας αυτων επιλαβομενος παιδιου εστησεν αυτο παρ εαυτω
transliteration: o de ihsouv idwn ton dialogismon thv kardiav autwn epilabomenov paidiou esthsen auto par eautw
draft_translation: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
ukjv_translation: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις ος εαν δεξηται τουτο το παιδιον επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται και ος εαν εμε δεξηται δεχεται τον αποστειλαντα με ο γαρ μικροτερος εν πασιν υμιν υπαρχων ουτος εσται μεγας
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv ov ean dexhtai touto to paidion epi tw onomati mou eme decetai kai ov ean eme dexhtai decetai ton aposteilanta me o gar mikroterov en pasin umin uparcwn outov estai megav
draft_translation: And said to them, Whoever shall receive this child in my name receives me: and whoever shall receive me receives him who sent me: for the one who is least among you all, the same shall be great.
ukjv_translation: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receives me: and whosoever shall receive me receives him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

greek_text: αποκριθεις δε ο ιωαννης ειπεν επιστατα ειδομεν τινα επι τω ονοματι σου εκβαλλοντα τα δαιμονια και εκωλυσαμεν αυτον οτι ουκ ακολουθει μεθ ημων
transliteration: apokriyeiv de o iwannhv eipen epistata eidomen tina epi tw onomati sou ekballonta ta daimonia kai ekwlusamen auton oti ouk akolouyei mey hmwn
draft_translation: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he follows not with us.
ukjv_translation: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in your name; and we forbad him, because he follows not with us.
review_notes: modernized forbad; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: και ειπεν προς αυτον ο ιησους μη κωλυετε ος γαρ ουκ εστιν καθ ημων υπερ ημων εστιν
transliteration: kai eipen prov auton o ihsouv mh kwluete ov gar ouk estin kay hmwn uper hmwn estin
draft_translation: And Jesus said to him, Do not forbid him: for the one who is not against us is for us.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

greek_text: εγενετο δε εν τω συμπληρουσθαι τας ημερας της αναληψεως αυτου και αυτος το προσωπον αυτου εστηριξεν του πορευεσθαι εις ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: egeneto de en tw sumplhrousyai tav hmerav thv analhqewv autou kai autov to proswpon autou esthrixen tou poreuesyai eiv ierousalhm
draft_translation: And it happened, when the time had come that he should be received up, he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

greek_text: και απεστειλεν αγγελους προ προσωπου αυτου και πορευθεντες εισηλθον εις κωμην σαμαρειτων ωστε ετοιμασαι αυτω
transliteration: kai apesteilen aggelouv pro proswpou autou kai poreuyentev eishlyon eiv kwmhn samareitwn wste etoimasai autw
draft_translation: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
ukjv_translation: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

greek_text: και ουκ εδεξαντο αυτον οτι το προσωπον αυτου ην πορευομενον εις ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: kai ouk edexanto auton oti to proswpon autou hn poreuomenon eiv ierousalhm
draft_translation: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

greek_text: ιδοντες δε οι μαθηται αυτου ιακωβος και ιωαννης ειπον κυριε θελεις ειπωμεν πυρ καταβηναι απο του ουρανου και αναλωσαι αυτους ως και ηλιας εποιησεν
transliteration: idontev de oi mayhtai autou iakwbov kai iwannhv eipon kurie yeleiv eipwmen pur katabhnai apo tou ouranou kai analwsai autouv wv kai hliav epoihsen
draft_translation: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elijah did?
ukjv_translation: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, will you that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elijah did?
review_notes: modernized will-you-that idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: στραφεις δε επετιμησεν αυτοις και ειπεν ουκ οιδατε οιου πνευματος εστε υμεις
transliteration: strafeiv de epetimhsen autoiv kai eipen ouk oidate oiou pneumatov este umeiv
draft_translation: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, You do not know what manner of spirit you are of.
ukjv_translation: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, All of you know not what manner of spirit (o. pneuma) all of you are of.

greek_text: ο γαρ υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ ηλθεν ψυχας ανθρωπων απολεσαι αλλα σωσαι και επορευθησαν εις ετεραν κωμην
transliteration: o gar uiov tou anyrwpou ouk hlyen qucav anyrwpwn apolesai alla swsai kai eporeuyhsan eiv eteran kwmhn
draft_translation: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
ukjv_translation: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εγενετο δε πορευομενων αυτων εν τη οδω ειπεν τις προς αυτον ακολουθησω σοι οπου αν απερχη κυριε
transliteration: egeneto de poreuomenwn autwn en th odw eipen tiv prov auton akolouyhsw soi opou an aperch kurie
draft_translation: And it happened, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said to him, Lord, I will follow you anywhere you go.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow you anywhere you go.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized came-to-pass idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους αι αλωπεκες φωλεους εχουσιν και τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατασκηνωσεις ο δε υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ εχει που την κεφαλην κλινη
transliteration: kai eipen autw o ihsouv ai alwpekev fwleouv ecousin kai ta peteina tou ouranou kataskhnwseiv o de uiov tou anyrwpou ouk ecei pou thn kefalhn klinh
draft_translation: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man has nowhere to lay his head.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man has not where to lay his head.

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς ετερον ακολουθει μοι ο δε ειπεν κυριε επιτρεψον μοι απελθοντι πρωτον θαψαι τον πατερα μου
transliteration: eipen de prov eteron akolouyei moi o de eipen kurie epitreqon moi apelyonti prwton yaqai ton patera mou
draft_translation: And he said to another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ο ιησους αφες τους νεκρους θαψαι τους εαυτων νεκρους συ δε απελθων διαγγελλε την βασιλειαν του θεου
transliteration: eipen de autw o ihsouv afev touv nekrouv yaqai touv eautwn nekrouv su de apelywn diaggelle thn basileian tou yeou
draft_translation: Jesus said to him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go and preach the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go you and preach the kingdom of God.

greek_text: ειπεν δε και ετερος ακολουθησω σοι κυριε πρωτον δε επιτρεψον μοι αποταξασθαι τοις εις τον οικον μου
transliteration: eipen de kai eterov akolouyhsw soi kurie prwton de epitreqon moi apotaxasyai toiv eiv ton oikon mou
draft_translation: And another also said, Lord, I will follow you; but let me first go bid farewell to those who are at home at my house.
ukjv_translation: And another also said, Lord, I will follow you; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς αυτον ο ιησους ουδεις επιβαλων την χειρα αυτου επ αροτρον και βλεπων εις τα οπισω ευθετος εστιν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
transliteration: eipen de prov auton o ihsouv oudeiv epibalwn thn ceira autou ep arotron kai blepwn eiv ta opisw euyetov estin eiv thn basileian tou yeou
draft_translation: And Jesus said to him, No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

greek_text: μετα δε ταυτα ανεδειξεν ο κυριος και ετερους εβδομηκοντα και απεστειλεν αυτους ανα δυο προ προσωπου αυτου εις πασαν πολιν και τοπον ου εμελλεν αυτος ερχεσθαι
transliteration: meta de tauta anedeixen o kuriov kai eterouv ebdomhkonta kai apesteilen autouv ana duo pro proswpou autou eiv pasan polin kai topon ou emellen autov ercesyai
draft_translation: After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before his face into every city and place, where he himself would come.
ukjv_translation: After these things the LORD appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, where he himself would come.

greek_text: ελεγεν ουν προς αυτους ο μεν θερισμος πολυς οι δε εργαται ολιγοι δεηθητε ουν του κυριου του θερισμου οπως εκβαλλη εργατας εις τον θερισμον αυτου
transliteration: elegen oun prov autouv o men yerismov poluv oi de ergatai oligoi dehyhte oun tou kuriou tou yerismou opwv ekballh ergatav eiv ton yerismon autou
draft_translation: Therefore said he to them, The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few: Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth laborers into his harvest.
ukjv_translation: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray all of you therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized labour spelling; modernized pray-you imperative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: υπαγετε ιδου εγω αποστελλω υμας ως αρνας εν μεσω λυκων
transliteration: upagete idou egw apostellw umav wv arnav en mesw lukwn
draft_translation: Go your ways: look, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
ukjv_translation: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

greek_text: μη βασταζετε βαλαντιον μη πηραν μηδε υποδηματα και μηδενα κατα την οδον ασπασησθε
transliteration: mh bastazete balantion mh phran mhde upodhmata kai mhdena kata thn odon aspashsye
draft_translation: Carry neither purse, nor pouch, nor shoes: and greet no one on the way.
ukjv_translation: Carry neither purse, nor pouch, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

greek_text: εις ην δ αν οικιαν εισερχησθε πρωτον λεγετε ειρηνη τω οικω τουτω
transliteration: eiv hn d an oikian eiserchsye prwton legete eirhnh tw oikw toutw
draft_translation: And into whatever house you enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
ukjv_translation: And into whatsoever house all of you enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εαν μεν η εκει ο υιος ειρηνης επαναπαυσεται επ αυτον η ειρηνη υμων ει δε μηγε εφ υμας ανακαμψει
transliteration: kai ean men h ekei o uiov eirhnhv epanapausetai ep auton h eirhnh umwn ei de mhge ef umav anakamqei
draft_translation: And if the son of peace is there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall return to you again.
ukjv_translation: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

greek_text: εν αυτη δε τη οικια μενετε εσθιοντες και πινοντες τα παρ αυτων αξιος γαρ ο εργατης του μισθου αυτου εστιν μη μεταβαινετε εξ οικιας εις οικιαν
transliteration: en auth de th oikia menete esyiontev kai pinontev ta par autwn axiov gar o ergathv tou misyou autou estin mh metabainete ex oikiav eiv oikian
draft_translation: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Do not go from house to house.
ukjv_translation: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

greek_text: και εις ην δ αν πολιν εισερχησθε και δεχωνται υμας εσθιετε τα παρατιθεμενα υμιν
transliteration: kai eiv hn d an polin eiserchsye kai decwntai umav esyiete ta paratiyemena umin
draft_translation: And into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
ukjv_translation: And into whatsoever city all of you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

greek_text: και θεραπευετε τους εν αυτη ασθενεις και λεγετε αυτοις ηγγικεν εφ υμας η βασιλεια του θεου
transliteration: kai yerapeuete touv en auth asyeneiv kai legete autoiv hggiken ef umav h basileia tou yeou
draft_translation: And heal the sick that are in it, and say to them, The kingdom of God has come near to you.
ukjv_translation: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God has come nigh unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized nigh; modernized therein

greek_text: εις ην δ αν πολιν εισερχησθε και μη δεχωνται υμας εξελθοντες εις τας πλατειας αυτης ειπατε
transliteration: eiv hn d an polin eiserchsye kai mh decwntai umav exelyontev eiv tav plateiav authv eipate
draft_translation: But into whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, go out into its streets, and say,
ukjv_translation: But into whatsoever city all of you enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

greek_text: και τον κονιορτον τον κολληθεντα ημιν εκ της πολεως υμων απομασσομεθα υμιν πλην τουτο γινωσκετε οτι ηγγικεν εφ υμας η βασιλεια του θεου
transliteration: kai ton koniorton ton kollhyenta hmin ek thv polewv umwn apomassomeya umin plhn touto ginwskete oti hggiken ef umav h basileia tou yeou
draft_translation: Even the very dust of your city, which clings to us, we wipe off against you: nevertheless be sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come near to you.
ukjv_translation: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaves on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be all of you sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come nigh unto you.

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν οτι σοδομοις εν τη ημερα εκεινη ανεκτοτερον εσται η τη πολει εκεινη
transliteration: legw de umin oti sodomoiv en th hmera ekeinh anektoteron estai h th polei ekeinh
draft_translation: But I say to you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
ukjv_translation: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

greek_text: ουαι σοι χωραζιν ουαι σοι βηθσαιδα οτι ει εν τυρω και σιδωνι εγενοντο αι δυναμεις αι γενομεναι εν υμιν παλαι αν εν σακκω και σποδω καθημεναι μετενοησαν
transliteration: ouai soi cwrazin ouai soi bhysaida oti ei en turw kai sidwni egenonto ai dunameiv ai genomenai en umin palai an en sakkw kai spodw kayhmenai metenohsan
draft_translation: Woe to you, Chorazin! woe to you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they would have repented a great while ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

greek_text: πλην τυρω και σιδωνι ανεκτοτερον εσται εν τη κρισει η υμιν
transliteration: plhn turw kai sidwni anektoteron estai en th krisei h umin
draft_translation: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
ukjv_translation: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και συ καπερναουμ η εως του ουρανου υψωθεισα εως αδου καταβιβασθηση
transliteration: kai su kapernaoum h ewv tou ouranou uqwyeisa ewv adou katabibasyhsh
draft_translation: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to Hades.
ukjv_translation: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to hell.

greek_text: ο ακουων υμων εμου ακουει και ο αθετων υμας εμε αθετει ο δε εμε αθετων αθετει τον αποστειλαντα με
transliteration: o akouwn umwn emou akouei kai o ayetwn umav eme ayetei o de eme ayetwn ayetei ton aposteilanta me
draft_translation: The one who hears you hears me; and the one who despises you despises me; and the one who despises me despises him who sent me.
ukjv_translation: He that hears you hears me; and he that despises you despises me; and he that despises me despises him that sent me.

greek_text: υπεστρεψαν δε οι εβδομηκοντα μετα χαρας λεγοντες κυριε και τα δαιμονια υποτασσεται ημιν εν τω ονοματι σου
transliteration: upestreqan de oi ebdomhkonta meta carav legontev kurie kai ta daimonia upotassetai hmin en tw onomati sou
draft_translation: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us through your name.
ukjv_translation: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through your name.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτοις εθεωρουν τον σαταναν ως αστραπην εκ του ουρανου πεσοντα
transliteration: eipen de autoiv eyewroun ton satanan wv astraphn ek tou ouranou pesonta
draft_translation: And he said to them, I beheld Satan fall as lightning from heaven.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

greek_text: ιδου διδωμι υμιν την εξουσιαν του πατειν επανω οφεων και σκορπιων και επι πασαν την δυναμιν του εχθρου και ουδεν υμας ου μη αδικησει
transliteration: idou didwmi umin thn exousian tou patein epanw ofewn kai skorpiwn kai epi pasan thn dunamin tou ecyrou kai ouden umav ou mh adikhsei
draft_translation: Look, I give to you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
ukjv_translation: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

greek_text: πλην εν τουτω μη χαιρετε οτι τα πνευματα υμιν υποτασσεται χαιρετε δε μαλλον οτι τα ονοματα υμων εγραφη εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: plhn en toutw mh cairete oti ta pneumata umin upotassetai cairete de mallon oti ta onomata umwn egrafh en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits (o. pneuma) are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

greek_text: εν αυτη τη ωρα ηγαλλιασατο τω πνευματι ο ιησους και ειπεν εξομολογουμαι σοι πατερ κυριε του ουρανου και της γης οτι απεκρυψας ταυτα απο σοφων και συνετων και απεκαλυψας αυτα νηπιοις ναι ο πατηρ οτι ουτως εγενετο ευδοκια εμπροσθεν σου
transliteration: en auth th wra hgalliasato tw pneumati o ihsouv kai eipen exomologoumai soi pater kurie tou ouranou kai thv ghv oti apekruqav tauta apo sofwn kai sunetwn kai apekaluqav auta nhpioiv nai o pathr oti outwv egeneto eudokia emprosyen sou
draft_translation: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them to babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in your sight.
ukjv_translation: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, (o. pneuma) and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in your sight.

greek_text: παντα παρεδοθη μοι υπο του πατρος μου και ουδεις γινωσκει τις εστιν ο υιος ει μη ο πατηρ και τις εστιν ο πατηρ ει μη ο υιος και ω εαν βουληται ο υιος αποκαλυψαι
transliteration: panta paredoyh moi upo tou patrov mou kai oudeiv ginwskei tiv estin o uiov ei mh o pathr kai tiv estin o pathr ei mh o uiov kai w ean boulhtai o uiov apokaluqai
draft_translation: All things are delivered to me by my Father: and no one knows who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
ukjv_translation: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knows who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

greek_text: και στραφεις προς τους μαθητας κατ ιδιαν ειπεν μακαριοι οι οφθαλμοι οι βλεποντες α βλεπετε
transliteration: kai strafeiv prov touv mayhtav kat idian eipen makarioi oi ofyalmoi oi blepontev a blepete
draft_translation: And he turned to his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see:
ukjv_translation: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that all of you see:

greek_text: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι πολλοι προφηται και βασιλεις ηθελησαν ιδειν α υμεις βλεπετε και ουκ ειδον και ακουσαι α ακουετε και ουκ ηκουσαν
transliteration: legw gar umin oti polloi profhtai kai basileiv hyelhsan idein a umeiv blepete kai ouk eidon kai akousai a akouete kai ouk hkousan
draft_translation: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.
ukjv_translation: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which all of you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which all of you hear, and have not heard them.

greek_text: και ιδου νομικος τις ανεστη εκπειραζων αυτον και λεγων διδασκαλε τι ποιησας ζωην αιωνιον κληρονομησω
transliteration: kai idou nomikov tiv anesth ekpeirazwn auton kai legwn didaskale ti poihsav zwhn aiwnion klhronomhsw
draft_translation: And, look, a certain lawyer stood up, and tested him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
ukjv_translation: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτον εν τω νομω τι γεγραπται πως αναγινωσκεις
transliteration: o de eipen prov auton en tw nomw ti gegraptai pwv anaginwskeiv
draft_translation: He said to him, What is written in the law? how do you read?
ukjv_translation: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how read you?

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αγαπησεις κυριον τον θεον σου εξ ολης της καρδιας σου και εξ ολης της ψυχης σου και εξ ολης της ισχυος σου και εξ ολης της διανοιας σου και τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv eipen agaphseiv kurion ton yeon sou ex olhv thv kardiav sou kai ex olhv thv quchv sou kai ex olhv thv iscuov sou kai ex olhv thv dianoiav sou kai ton plhsion sou wv seauton
draft_translation: And he answering said, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.
ukjv_translation: And he answering said, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbour as yourself.
review_notes: modernized neighbour spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ορθως απεκριθης τουτο ποιει και ζηση
transliteration: eipen de autw orywv apekriyhv touto poiei kai zhsh
draft_translation: And he said to him, You have answered rightly: do this, and you shall live.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto him, You have answered right: this do, and you shall live.

greek_text: ο δε θελων δικαιουν εαυτον ειπεν προς τον ιησουν και τις εστιν μου πλησιον

draft_translation: But he, willing to justify himself, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbor?

draft_translation: And it happened, as he spoke these things, a certain woman of the crowd lifted up her voice, and said to him, Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which you have nursed.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, as he spoke these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare you, and the breast which you have sucked.

greek_text: αυτος δε ειπεν μενουνγε μακαριοι οι ακουοντες τον λογον του θεου και φυλασσοντες αυτον
transliteration: autov de eipen menounge makarioi oi akouontev ton logon tou yeou kai fulassontev auton
draft_translation: But he said, Yes rather, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.
ukjv_translation: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word (o. logos) of God, and keep it.

greek_text: των δε οχλων επαθροιζομενων ηρξατο λεγειν η γενεα αυτη πονηρα εστιν σημειον επιζητει και σημειον ου δοθησεται αυτη ει μη το σημειον ιωνα του προφητου
transliteration: twn de oclwn epayroizomenwn hrxato legein h genea auth ponhra estin shmeion epizhtei kai shmeion ou doyhsetai auth ei mh to shmeion iwna tou profhtou
draft_translation: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and no sign shall be given it, but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
ukjv_translation: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

greek_text: καθως γαρ εγενετο ιωνας σημειον τοις νινευιταις ουτως εσται και ο υιος του ανθρωπου τη γενεα ταυτη
transliteration: kaywv gar egeneto iwnav shmeion toiv nineuitaiv outwv estai kai o uiov tou anyrwpou th genea tauth
draft_translation: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
ukjv_translation: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: βασιλισσα νοτου εγερθησεται εν τη κρισει μετα των ανδρων της γενεας ταυτης και κατακρινει αυτους οτι ηλθεν εκ των περατων της γης ακουσαι την σοφιαν σολομωντος και ιδου πλειον σολομωντος ωδε
transliteration: basilissa notou egeryhsetai en th krisei meta twn andrwn thv geneav tauthv kai katakrinei autouv oti hlyen ek twn peratwn thv ghv akousai thn sofian solomwntov kai idou pleion solomwntov wde
draft_translation: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the people of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, look, a greater than Solomon is here.
ukjv_translation: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

greek_text: ανδρες νινευι αναστησονται εν τη κρισει μετα της γενεας ταυτης και κατακρινουσιν αυτην οτι μετενοησαν εις το κηρυγμα ιωνα και ιδου πλειον ιωνα ωδε
transliteration: andrev nineui anasthsontai en th krisei meta thv geneav tauthv kai katakrinousin authn oti metenohsan eiv to khrugma iwna kai idou pleion iwna wde
draft_translation: The people of Nineveh shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and, look, a greater than Jonah is here.
ukjv_translation: The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

greek_text: ουδεις δε λυχνον αψας εις κρυπτον τιθησιν ουδε υπο τον μοδιον αλλ επι την λυχνιαν ινα οι εισπορευομενοι το φεγγος βλεπωσιν
transliteration: oudeiv de lucnon aqav eiv krupton tiyhsin oude upo ton modion all epi thn lucnian ina oi eisporeuomenoi to feggov blepwsin
draft_translation: No one, when he has lighted a lamp, puts it in a secret place, neither under a basket, but on a lampstand, that those who come in may see the light.
ukjv_translation: No man, when he has lighted a candle, puts it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

greek_text: ο λυχνος του σωματος εστιν ο οφθαλμος οταν ουν ο οφθαλμος σου απλους η και ολον το σωμα σου φωτεινον εστιν επαν δε πονηρος η και το σωμα σου σκοτεινον
transliteration: o lucnov tou swmatov estin o ofyalmov otan oun o ofyalmov sou aplouv h kai olon to swma sou fwteinon estin epan de ponhrov h kai to swma sou skoteinon
draft_translation: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when your eye is clear, your whole body also is full of light; but when your eye is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
ukjv_translation: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when yours eye is single, your whole body also is full of light; but when yours eye is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

greek_text: σκοπει ουν μη το φως το εν σοι σκοτος εστιν
transliteration: skopei oun mh to fwv to en soi skotov estin
draft_translation: Take heed therefore that the light which is in you not be darkness.
ukjv_translation: Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not darkness.

greek_text: ει ουν το σωμα σου ολον φωτεινον μη εχον τι μερος σκοτεινον εσται φωτεινον ολον ως οταν ο λυχνος τη αστραπη φωτιζη σε
transliteration: ei oun to swma sou olon fwteinon mh econ ti merov skoteinon estai fwteinon olon wv otan o lucnov th astraph fwtizh se
draft_translation: If your whole body therefore is full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp gives you light.
ukjv_translation: If your whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle does give you light.

greek_text: εν δε τω λαλησαι ηρωτα αυτον φαρισαιος τις οπως αριστηση παρ αυτω εισελθων δε ανεπεσεν
transliteration: en de tw lalhsai hrwta auton farisaiov tiv opwv aristhsh par autw eiselywn de anepesen
draft_translation: And as he spoke, a certain Pharisee begged him to dine with him: and he went in, and reclined at table.
ukjv_translation: And as he spoke, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to food.

greek_text: ο δε φαρισαιος ιδων εθαυμασεν οτι ου πρωτον εβαπτισθη προ του αριστου
transliteration: o de farisaiov idwn eyaumasen oti ou prwton ebaptisyh pro tou aristou
draft_translation: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed before dinner.
ukjv_translation: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

greek_text: ειπεν δε ο κυριος προς αυτον νυν υμεις οι φαρισαιοι το εξωθεν του ποτηριου και του πινακος καθαριζετε το δε εσωθεν υμων γεμει αρπαγης και πονηριας
transliteration: eipen de o kuriov prov auton nun umeiv oi farisaioi to exwyen tou pothriou kai tou pinakov kayarizete to de eswyen umwn gemei arpaghv kai ponhriav
draft_translation: And the Lord said to him, Now you Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of greed and wickedness.
ukjv_translation: And the Lord said unto him, Now do all of you Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

greek_text: αφρονες ουχ ο ποιησας το εξωθεν και το εσωθεν εποιησεν
transliteration: afronev ouc o poihsav to exwyen kai to eswyen epoihsen
draft_translation: You fools, did not the one who made that which is outside make that which is inside also?
ukjv_translation: All of you fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

greek_text: πλην τα ενοντα δοτε ελεημοσυνην και ιδου παντα καθαρα υμιν εστιν
transliteration: plhn ta enonta dote elehmosunhn kai idou panta kayara umin estin
draft_translation: But rather give alms of such things as you have; and, look, all things are clean to you.
ukjv_translation: But rather give alms of such things as all of you have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αλλ ουαι υμιν τοις φαρισαιοις οτι αποδεκατουτε το ηδυοσμον και το πηγανον και παν λαχανον και παρερχεσθε την κρισιν και την αγαπην του θεου ταυτα εδει ποιησαι κακεινα μη αφιεναι
transliteration: all ouai umin toiv farisaioiv oti apodekatoute to hduosmon kai to phganon kai pan lacanon kai parercesye thn krisin kai thn agaphn tou yeou tauta edei poihsai kakeina mh afienai
draft_translation: But woe to you, Pharisees! for you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
ukjv_translation: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for all of you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love (o. agape) of God: these ought all of you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν τοις φαρισαιοις οτι αγαπατε την πρωτοκαθεδριαν εν ταις συναγωγαις και τους ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις
transliteration: ouai umin toiv farisaioiv oti agapate thn prwtokayedrian en taiv sunagwgaiv kai touv aspasmouv en taiv agoraiv
draft_translation: Woe to you, Pharisees! for you love the chief seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for all of you love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι εστε ως τα μνημεια τα αδηλα και οι ανθρωποι οι περιπατουντες επανω ουκ οιδασιν
transliteration: ouai umin grammateiv kai farisaioi upokritai oti este wv ta mnhmeia ta adhla kai oi anyrwpoi oi peripatountev epanw ouk oidasin
draft_translation: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are as unmarked graves, and the people that walk over them are not aware of them.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

greek_text: αποκριθεις δε τις των νομικων λεγει αυτω διδασκαλε ταυτα λεγων και ημας υβριζεις
transliteration: apokriyeiv de tiv twn nomikwn legei autw didaskale tauta legwn kai hmav ubrizeiv
draft_translation: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said to him, Teacher, by saying these things you reproach us also.
ukjv_translation: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying you reproach us also.

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν και υμιν τοις νομικοις ουαι οτι φορτιζετε τους ανθρωπους φορτια δυσβαστακτα και αυτοι ενι των δακτυλων υμων ου προσψαυετε τοις φορτιοις
transliteration: o de eipen kai umin toiv nomikoiv ouai oti fortizete touv anyrwpouv fortia dusbastakta kai autoi eni twn daktulwn umwn ou prosqauete toiv fortioiv
draft_translation: And he said, Woe to you also, you lawyers! for you load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
ukjv_translation: And he said, Woe unto you also, all of you lawyers! for all of you load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and all of you yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized touch-not idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουαι υμιν οτι οικοδομειτε τα μνημεια των προφητων οι δε πατερες υμων απεκτειναν αυτους
transliteration: ouai umin oti oikodomeite ta mnhmeia twn profhtwn oi de paterev umwn apekteinan autouv
draft_translation: Woe to you! for you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you! for all of you build the sepulchers of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

greek_text: αρα μαρτυρειτε και συνευδοκειτε τοις εργοις των πατερων υμων οτι αυτοι μεν απεκτειναν αυτους υμεις δε οικοδομειτε αυτων τα μνημεια
transliteration: ara martureite kai suneudokeite toiv ergoiv twn paterwn umwn oti autoi men apekteinan autouv umeiv de oikodomeite autwn ta mnhmeia
draft_translation: Truly you bear witness that you approve the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.
ukjv_translation: Truly all of you bear witness that all of you allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and all of you build their sepulchers.

greek_text: δια τουτο και η σοφια του θεου ειπεν αποστελω εις αυτους προφητας και αποστολους και εξ αυτων αποκτενουσιν και εκδιωξουσιν
transliteration: dia touto kai h sofia tou yeou eipen apostelw eiv autouv profhtav kai apostolouv kai ex autwn apoktenousin kai ekdiwxousin
draft_translation: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall kill and persecute:
ukjv_translation: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

greek_text: ινα εκζητηθη το αιμα παντων των προφητων το εκχυνομενον απο καταβολης κοσμου απο της γενεας ταυτης
transliteration: ina ekzhthyh to aima pantwn twn profhtwn to ekcunomenon apo katabolhv kosmou apo thv geneav tauthv
draft_translation: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
ukjv_translation: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

greek_text: απο του αιματος αβελ εως του αιματος ζαχαριου του απολομενου μεταξυ του θυσιαστηριου και του οικου ναι λεγω υμιν εκζητηθησεται απο της γενεας ταυτης
transliteration: apo tou aimatov abel ewv tou aimatov zacariou tou apolomenou metaxu tou yusiasthriou kai tou oikou nai legw umin ekzhthyhsetai apo thv geneav tauthv
draft_translation: From the blood of Abel to the blood of Zacharias who perished between the altar and the temple: truly I say to you, It shall be required of this generation.
ukjv_translation: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

greek_text: ουαι υμιν τοις νομικοις οτι ηρατε την κλειδα της γνωσεως αυτοι ουκ εισηλθετε και τους εισερχομενους εκωλυσατε
transliteration: ouai umin toiv nomikoiv oti hrate thn kleida thv gnwsewv autoi ouk eishlyete kai touv eisercomenouv ekwlusate
draft_translation: Woe to you, lawyers! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you did not enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in you hindered.
ukjv_translation: Woe unto you, lawyers! for all of you have taken away the key of knowledge: all of you entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in all of you hindered.

greek_text: λεγοντος δε αυτου ταυτα προς αυτους ηρξαντο οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι δεινως ενεχειν και αποστοματιζειν αυτον περι πλειονων
transliteration: legontov de autou tauta prov autouv hrxanto oi grammateiv kai oi farisaioi deinwv enecein kai apostomatizein auton peri pleionwn
draft_translation: And as he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
ukjv_translation: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

greek_text: ενεδρευοντες αυτον και ζητουντες θηρευσαι τι εκ του στοματος αυτου ινα κατηγορησωσιν αυτου
transliteration: enedreuontev auton kai zhtountev yhreusai ti ek tou stomatov autou ina kathgorhswsin autou
draft_translation: Lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
ukjv_translation: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

greek_text: εν οις επισυναχθεισων των μυριαδων του οχλου ωστε καταπατειν αλληλους ηρξατο λεγειν προς τους μαθητας αυτου πρωτον προσεχετε εαυτοις απο της ζυμης των φαρισαιων ητις εστιν υποκρισις
transliteration: en oiv episunacyeiswn twn muriadwn tou oclou wste katapatein allhlouv hrxato legein prov touv mayhtav autou prwton prosecete eautoiv apo thv zumhv twn farisaiwn htiv estin upokrisiv
draft_translation: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable crowd of people, so that they trode one upon another, he began to say to his disciples first of all, Beware you of the leaven of the Pharisees, who is hypocrisy.
ukjv_translation: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware all of you of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized insomuch-that idiom; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ochlos as crowd

greek_text: ουδεν δε συγκεκαλυμμενον εστιν ο ουκ αποκαλυφθησεται και κρυπτον ο ου γνωσθησεται
transliteration: ouden de sugkekalummenon estin o ouk apokalufyhsetai kai krupton o ou gnwsyhsetai
draft_translation: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hidden, that shall not be known.
ukjv_translation: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

greek_text: ανθ ων οσα εν τη σκοτια ειπατε εν τω φωτι ακουσθησεται και ο προς το ους ελαλησατε εν τοις ταμειοις κηρυχθησεται επι των δωματων
transliteration: any wn osa en th skotia eipate en tw fwti akousyhsetai kai o prov to ouv elalhsate en toiv tameioiv khrucyhsetai epi twn dwmatwn
draft_translation: Therefore whatever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which you have spoken in the ear in private rooms shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
ukjv_translation: Therefore whatsoever all of you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which all of you have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν τοις φιλοις μου μη φοβηθητε απο των αποκτεινοντων το σωμα και μετα ταυτα μη εχοντων περισσοτερον τι ποιησαι
transliteration: legw de umin toiv filoiv mou mh fobhyhte apo twn apokteinontwn to swma kai meta tauta mh econtwn perissoteron ti poihsai
draft_translation: And I say to you my friends, Do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
ukjv_translation: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

greek_text: υποδειξω δε υμιν τινα φοβηθητε φοβηθητε τον μετα το αποκτειναι εξουσιαν εχοντα εμβαλειν εις την γεενναν ναι λεγω υμιν τουτον φοβηθητε
transliteration: upodeixw de umin tina fobhyhte fobhyhte ton meta to apokteinai exousian econta embalein eiv thn geennan nai legw umin touton fobhyhte
draft_translation: But I will forewarn you whom you shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power to cast into Gehenna; yes, I say to you, Fear him.
ukjv_translation: But I will forewarn you whom all of you shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yea; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered geenna as Gehenna

greek_text: ουχι πεντε στρουθια πωλειται ασσαριων δυο και εν εξ αυτων ουκ εστιν επιλελησμενον ενωπιον του θεου
transliteration: ouci pente strouyia pwleitai assariwn duo kai en ex autwn ouk estin epilelhsmenon enwpion tou yeou
draft_translation: Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
ukjv_translation: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

greek_text: αλλα και αι τριχες της κεφαλης υμων πασαι ηριθμηνται μη ουν φοβεισθε πολλων στρουθιων διαφερετε
transliteration: alla kai ai tricev thv kefalhv umwn pasai hriymhntai mh oun fobeisye pollwn strouyiwn diaferete
draft_translation: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Do not fear therefore: you are of more value than many sparrows.
ukjv_translation: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: all of you are of more value than many sparrows.

greek_text: λεγω δε υμιν πας ος αν ομολογηση εν εμοι εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων και ο υιος του ανθρωπου ομολογησει εν αυτω εμπροσθεν των αγγελων του θεου
transliteration: legw de umin pav ov an omologhsh en emoi emprosyen twn anyrwpwn kai o uiov tou anyrwpou omologhsei en autw emprosyen twn aggelwn tou yeou
draft_translation: Also I say to you, Whoever shall confess me before people, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
ukjv_translation: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

greek_text: ο δε αρνησαμενος με ενωπιον των ανθρωπων απαρνηθησεται ενωπιον των αγγελων του θεου
transliteration: o de arnhsamenov me enwpion twn anyrwpwn aparnhyhsetai enwpion twn aggelwn tou yeou
draft_translation: But the one who denies me before people shall be denied before the angels of God.
ukjv_translation: But he that denies me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

greek_text: και πας ος ερει λογον εις τον υιον του ανθρωπου αφεθησεται αυτω τω δε εις το αγιον πνευμα βλασφημησαντι ουκ αφεθησεται
transliteration: kai pav ov erei logon eiv ton uion tou anyrwpou afeyhsetai autw tw de eiv to agion pneuma blasfhmhsanti ouk afeyhsetai
draft_translation: And whoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever shall speak a word (o. logos) against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemes against the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) it shall not be forgiven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οταν δε προσφερωσιν υμας επι τας συναγωγας και τας αρχας και τας εξουσιας μη μεριμνατε πως η τι απολογησησθε η τι ειπητε
transliteration: otan de prosferwsin umav epi tav sunagwgav kai tav arcav kai tav exousiav mh merimnate pwv h ti apologhshsye h ti eiphte
draft_translation: And when they bring you to the synagogues, and to magistrates, and powers, do not be anxious how or what thing you shall answer, or what you shall say:
ukjv_translation: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take all of you no thought how or what thing all of you shall answer, or what all of you shall say:

greek_text: το γαρ αγιον πνευμα διδαξει υμας εν αυτη τη ωρα α δει ειπειν
transliteration: to gar agion pneuma didaxei umav en auth th wra a dei eipein
draft_translation: For the Holy Spirit shall teach you in the same hour what you ought to say.
ukjv_translation: For the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) shall teach you in the same hour what all of you ought to say.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειπεν δε τις αυτω εκ του οχλου διδασκαλε ειπε τω αδελφω μου μερισασθαι μετ εμου την κληρονομιαν
transliteration: eipen de tiv autw ek tou oclou didaskale eipe tw adelfw mou merisasyai met emou thn klhronomian
draft_translation: And one of the crowd said to him, Teacher, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
ukjv_translation: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτω ανθρωπε τις με κατεστησεν δικαστην η μεριστην εφ υμας
transliteration: o de eipen autw anyrwpe tiv me katesthsen dikasthn h meristhn ef umav
draft_translation: And he said to him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς αυτους ορατε και φυλασσεσθε απο της πλεονεξιας οτι ουκ εν τω περισσευειν τινι η ζωη αυτου εστιν εκ των υπαρχοντων αυτου
transliteration: eipen de prov autouv orate kai fulassesye apo thv pleonexiav oti ouk en tw perisseuein tini h zwh autou estin ek twn uparcontwn autou
draft_translation: And he said to them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life does not consist in the abundance of the things which he possesses.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consists not in the abundance of the things which he possesses.

greek_text: ειπεν δε παραβολην προς αυτους λεγων ανθρωπου τινος πλουσιου ευφορησεν η χωρα
transliteration: eipen de parabolhn prov autouv legwn anyrwpou tinov plousiou euforhsen h cwra
draft_translation: And he spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man bore plentifully:
ukjv_translation: And he spoke a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized childbirth bring-forth idiom

greek_text: και διελογιζετο εν εαυτω λεγων τι ποιησω οτι ουκ εχω που συναξω τους καρπους μου
transliteration: kai dielogizeto en eautw legwn ti poihsw oti ouk ecw pou sunaxw touv karpouv mou
draft_translation: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room to store my fruits?
ukjv_translation: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

greek_text: και ειπεν τουτο ποιησω καθελω μου τας αποθηκας και μειζονας οικοδομησω και συναξω εκει παντα τα γενηματα μου και τα αγαθα μου
transliteration: kai eipen touto poihsw kayelw mou tav apoyhkav kai meizonav oikodomhsw kai sunaxw ekei panta ta genhmata mou kai ta agaya mou
draft_translation: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I store all my fruits and my goods.
ukjv_translation: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

greek_text: και ερω τη ψυχη μου ψυχη εχεις πολλα αγαθα κειμενα εις ετη πολλα αναπαυου φαγε πιε ευφραινου
transliteration: kai erw th quch mou quch eceiv polla agaya keimena eiv eth polla anapauou fage pie eufrainou
draft_translation: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years; take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
ukjv_translation: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have much goods laid up for many years; take yours ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ο θεος αφρον ταυτη τη νυκτι την ψυχην σου απαιτουσιν απο σου α δε ητοιμασας τινι εσται
transliteration: eipen de autw o yeov afron tauth th nukti thn quchn sou apaitousin apo sou a de htoimasav tini estai
draft_translation: But God said to him, You fool, this night your soul shall be required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you have provided?
ukjv_translation: But God said unto him, You fool, this night your soul shall be required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you have provided?

greek_text: ουτως ο θησαυριζων εαυτω και μη εις θεον πλουτων
transliteration: outwv o yhsaurizwn eautw kai mh eiv yeon ploutwn
draft_translation: So is the one who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
ukjv_translation: So is he that lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς τους μαθητας αυτου δια τουτο υμιν λεγω μη μεριμνατε τη ψυχη υμων τι φαγητε μηδε τω σωματι τι ενδυσησθε
transliteration: eipen de prov touv mayhtav autou dia touto umin legw mh merimnate th quch umwn ti faghte mhde tw swmati ti endushsye
draft_translation: And he said to his disciples, Therefore I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you shall eat; neither for the body, what you shall put on.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what all of you shall eat; neither for the body, what all of you shall put on.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized take-no-thought idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: η ψυχη πλειον εστιν της τροφης και το σωμα του ενδυματος
transliteration: h quch pleion estin thv trofhv kai to swma tou endumatov
draft_translation: The life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
ukjv_translation: The life is more than food, and the body is more than raiment.

greek_text: κατανοησατε τους κορακας οτι ου σπειρουσιν ουδε θεριζουσιν οις ουκ εστιν ταμειον ουδε αποθηκη και ο θεος τρεφει αυτους ποσω μαλλον υμεις διαφερετε των πετεινων
transliteration: katanohsate touv korakav oti ou speirousin oude yerizousin oiv ouk estin tameion oude apoyhkh kai o yeov trefei autouv posw mallon umeiv diaferete twn peteinwn
draft_translation: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feeds them: how much more are you better than the birds?
ukjv_translation: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feeds them: how much more are all of you better than the fowls?
review_notes: modernized fowls; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τις δε εξ υμων μεριμνων δυναται προσθειναι επι την ηλικιαν αυτου πηχυν ενα
transliteration: tiv de ex umwn merimnwn dunatai prosyeinai epi thn hlikian autou phcun ena
draft_translation: And which of you by being anxious can add to his stature one cubit?
ukjv_translation: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

greek_text: ει ουν ουτε ελαχιστον δυνασθε τι περι των λοιπων μεριμνατε
transliteration: ei oun oute elaciston dunasye ti peri twn loipwn merimnate
draft_translation: If then you are not able to do that thing which is least, why are you anxious for the rest?
ukjv_translation: If all of you then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take all of you thought for the rest?
review_notes: modernized be-not clause; modernized take-you-thought idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: κατανοησατε τα κρινα πως αυξανει ου κοπια ουδε νηθει λεγω δε υμιν ουδε σολομων εν παση τη δοξη αυτου περιεβαλετο ως εν τουτων
transliteration: katanohsate ta krina pwv auxanei ou kopia oude nhyei legw de umin oude solomwn en pash th doxh autou periebaleto wv en toutwn
draft_translation: Consider the lilies how they grow: they do not toil, they do not spin; and yet I say to you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
ukjv_translation: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized spin-not wording; modernized toil-not wording

greek_text: ει δε τον χορτον εν τω αγρω σημερον οντα και αυριον εις κλιβανον βαλλομενον ο θεος ουτως αμφιεννυσιν ποσω μαλλον υμας ολιγοπιστοι
transliteration: ei de ton corton en tw agrw shmeron onta kai aurion eiv klibanon ballomenon o yeov outwv amfiennusin posw mallon umav oligopistoi
draft_translation: If then God so clothes the grass, which is today in the field, and tomorrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
ukjv_translation: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and tomorrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O all of you of little faith?

greek_text: και υμεις μη ζητειτε τι φαγητε η τι πιητε και μη μετεωριζεσθε
transliteration: kai umeiv mh zhteite ti faghte h ti pihte kai mh metewrizesye
draft_translation: And do not seek what you shall eat, or what you shall drink, neither be of doubtful mind.
ukjv_translation: And seek not all of you what all of you shall eat, or what all of you shall drink, neither be all of you of doubtful mind.

greek_text: ταυτα γαρ παντα τα εθνη του κοσμου επιζητει υμων δε ο πατηρ οιδεν οτι χρηζετε τουτων
transliteration: tauta gar panta ta eynh tou kosmou epizhtei umwn de o pathr oiden oti crhzete toutwn
draft_translation: For all these things the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knows that you have need of these things.
ukjv_translation: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knows that all of you have need of these things.

greek_text: πλην ζητειτε την βασιλειαν του θεου και ταυτα παντα προστεθησεται υμιν
transliteration: plhn zhteite thn basileian tou yeou kai tauta panta prosteyhsetai umin
draft_translation: But rather seek the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added to you.
ukjv_translation: But rather seek all of you the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

greek_text: μη φοβου το μικρον ποιμνιον οτι ευδοκησεν ο πατηρ υμων δουναι υμιν την βασιλειαν
transliteration: mh fobou to mikron poimnion oti eudokhsen o pathr umwn dounai umin thn basileian
draft_translation: Do not fear, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
ukjv_translation: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

greek_text: πωλησατε τα υπαρχοντα υμων και δοτε ελεημοσυνην ποιησατε εαυτοις βαλαντια μη παλαιουμενα θησαυρον ανεκλειπτον εν τοις ουρανοις οπου κλεπτης ουκ εγγιζει ουδε σης διαφθειρει
transliteration: pwlhsate ta uparconta umwn kai dote elehmosunhn poihsate eautoiv balantia mh palaioumena yhsauron anekleipton en toiv ouranoiv opou klepthv ouk eggizei oude shv diafyeirei
draft_translation: Sell what you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which do not grow old, a treasure in the heavens that fails not, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.
ukjv_translation: Sell that all of you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that fails not, where no thief approaches, neither moth corrupts.

greek_text: οπου γαρ εστιν ο θησαυρος υμων εκει και η καρδια υμων εσται
transliteration: opou gar estin o yhsaurov umwn ekei kai h kardia umwn estai
draft_translation: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
ukjv_translation: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εστωσαν υμων αι οσφυες περιεζωσμεναι και οι λυχνοι καιομενοι
transliteration: estwsan umwn ai osfuev periezwsmenai kai oi lucnoi kaiomenoi
draft_translation: Let your loins be girded, and your lamps burning;
ukjv_translation: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

greek_text: και υμεις ομοιοι ανθρωποις προσδεχομενοις τον κυριον εαυτων ποτε αναλυσει εκ των γαμων ινα ελθοντος και κρουσαντος ευθεως ανοιξωσιν αυτω
transliteration: kai umeiv omoioi anyrwpoiv prosdecomenoiv ton kurion eautwn pote analusei ek twn gamwn ina elyontov kai krousantov euyewv anoixwsin autw
draft_translation: And you yourselves be like men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately.
ukjv_translation: And all of you yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open unto him immediately.

greek_text: μακαριοι οι δουλοι εκεινοι ους ελθων ο κυριος ευρησει γρηγορουντας αμην λεγω υμιν οτι περιζωσεται και ανακλινει αυτους και παρελθων διακονησει αυτοις
transliteration: makarioi oi douloi ekeinoi ouv elywn o kuriov eurhsei grhgorountav amhn legw umin oti perizwsetai kai anaklinei autouv kai parelywn diakonhsei autoiv
draft_translation: Blessed are those slaves, whom the Lord when he comes shall find watching: Amen, I say to you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to food, and will come forth and serve them.
ukjv_translation: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he comes shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to food, and will come forth and serve them.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered amen formula directly; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: και εαν ελθη εν τη δευτερα φυλακη και εν τη τριτη φυλακη ελθη και ευρη ουτως μακαριοι εισιν οι δουλοι εκεινοι
transliteration: kai ean elyh en th deutera fulakh kai en th trith fulakh elyh kai eurh outwv makarioi eisin oi douloi ekeinoi
draft_translation: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those slaves.
ukjv_translation: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

greek_text: τουτο δε γινωσκετε οτι ει ηδει ο οικοδεσποτης ποια ωρα ο κλεπτης ερχεται εγρηγορησεν αν και ουκ αν αφηκεν διορυγηναι τον οικον αυτου
transliteration: touto de ginwskete oti ei hdei o oikodespothv poia wra o klepthv ercetai egrhgorhsen an kai ouk an afhken diorughnai ton oikon autou
draft_translation: And this know, that if the householder had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have allowed his house to be broken through.
ukjv_translation: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
review_notes: modernized goodman-of-house idiom; modernized suffer-as-allow wording

greek_text: και υμεις ουν γινεσθε ετοιμοι οτι η ωρα ου δοκειτε ο υιος του ανθρωπου ερχεται
transliteration: kai umeiv oun ginesye etoimoi oti h wra ou dokeite o uiov tou anyrwpou ercetai
draft_translation: Be therefore ready also: for the Son of man comes at an hour when you do not expect.
ukjv_translation: Be all of you therefore ready also: for the Son of man comes at an hour when all of you think not.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ο πετρος κυριε προς ημας την παραβολην ταυτην λεγεις η και προς παντας
transliteration: eipen de autw o petrov kurie prov hmav thn parabolhn tauthn legeiv h kai prov pantav
draft_translation: Then Peter said to him, Lord, do you speak this parable to us, or even to all?
ukjv_translation: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speak you this parable unto us, or even to all?

greek_text: ειπεν δε ο κυριος τις αρα εστιν ο πιστος οικονομος και φρονιμος ον καταστησει ο κυριος επι της θεραπειας αυτου του διδοναι εν καιρω το σιτομετριον
transliteration: eipen de o kuriov tiv ara estin o pistov oikonomov kai fronimov on katasthsei o kuriov epi thv yerapeiav autou tou didonai en kairw to sitometrion
draft_translation: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?
ukjv_translation: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?

greek_text: μακαριος ο δουλος εκεινος ον ελθων ο κυριος αυτου ευρησει ποιουντα ουτως
transliteration: makariov o doulov ekeinov on elywn o kuriov autou eurhsei poiounta outwv
draft_translation: Blessed is that slave, whom his Lord when he comes shall find so doing.
ukjv_translation: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: αληθως λεγω υμιν οτι επι πασιν τοις υπαρχουσιν αυτου καταστησει αυτον
transliteration: alhywv legw umin oti epi pasin toiv uparcousin autou katasthsei auton
draft_translation: Truthfully I say to you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has.
ukjv_translation: Truthfully I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has.

greek_text: εαν δε ειπη ο δουλος εκεινος εν τη καρδια αυτου χρονιζει ο κυριος μου ερχεσθαι και αρξηται τυπτειν τους παιδας και τας παιδισκας εσθιειν τε και πινειν και μεθυσκεσθαι
transliteration: ean de eiph o doulov ekeinov en th kardia autou cronizei o kuriov mou ercesyai kai arxhtai tuptein touv paidav kai tav paidiskav esyiein te kai pinein kai meyuskesyai
draft_translation: But and if that slave say in his heart, My Lord delays his coming; and shall begin to beat the male slaves and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
ukjv_translation: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delays his coming; and shall begin to beat the male servants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ηξει ο κυριος του δουλου εκεινου εν ημερα η ου προσδοκα και εν ωρα η ου γινωσκει και διχοτομησει αυτον και το μερος αυτου μετα των απιστων θησει
transliteration: hxei o kuriov tou doulou ekeinou en hmera h ou prosdoka kai en wra h ou ginwskei kai dicotomhsei auton kai to merov autou meta twn apistwn yhsei
draft_translation: The Lord of that slave will come in a day when he looks not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
ukjv_translation: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looks not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: εκεινος δε ο δουλος ο γνους το θελημα του κυριου εαυτου και μη ετοιμασας μηδε ποιησας προς το θελημα αυτου δαρησεται πολλας
transliteration: ekeinov de o doulov o gnouv to yelhma tou kuriou eautou kai mh etoimasav mhde poihsav prov to yelhma autou darhsetai pollav
draft_translation: And that slave, which knew his Lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
ukjv_translation: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ο δε μη γνους ποιησας δε αξια πληγων δαρησεται ολιγας παντι δε ω εδοθη πολυ πολυ ζητηθησεται παρ αυτου και ω παρεθεντο πολυ περισσοτερον αιτησουσιν αυτον
transliteration: o de mh gnouv poihsav de axia plhgwn darhsetai oligav panti de w edoyh polu polu zhthyhsetai par autou kai w pareyento polu perissoteron aithsousin auton
draft_translation: But the one who did not know, and did commit things worthy of blows, shall be beaten with few blows. For to whomever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom people have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
ukjv_translation: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

greek_text: πυρ ηλθον βαλειν εις την γην και τι θελω ει ηδη ανηφθη
transliteration: pur hlyon balein eiv thn ghn kai ti yelw ei hdh anhfyh
draft_translation: I have come to send fire on the earth; and what do I wish, if it is already kindled?
ukjv_translation: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

greek_text: βαπτισμα δε εχω βαπτισθηναι και πως συνεχομαι εως ου τελεσθη
transliteration: baptisma de ecw baptisyhnai kai pwv sunecomai ewv ou telesyh
draft_translation: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I constrained till it is accomplished!
ukjv_translation: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

greek_text: δοκειτε οτι ειρηνην παρεγενομην δουναι εν τη γη ουχι λεγω υμιν αλλ η διαμερισμον
transliteration: dokeite oti eirhnhn paregenomhn dounai en th gh ouci legw umin all h diamerismon
draft_translation: Do you suppose that I have come to give peace on earth? I tell you, No; but rather division:
ukjv_translation: Suppose all of you that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

greek_text: εσονται γαρ απο του νυν πεντε εν οικω ενι διαμεμερισμενοι τρεις επι δυσιν και δυο επι τρισιν
transliteration: esontai gar apo tou nun pente en oikw eni diamemerismenoi treiv epi dusin kai duo epi trisin
draft_translation: For from now on there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
ukjv_translation: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

greek_text: διαμερισθησεται πατηρ εφ υιω και υιος επι πατρι μητηρ επι θυγατρι και θυγατηρ επι μητρι πενθερα επι την νυμφην αυτης και νυμφη επι την πενθεραν αυτης
transliteration: diamerisyhsetai pathr ef uiw kai uiov epi patri mhthr epi yugatri kai yugathr epi mhtri penyera epi thn numfhn authv kai numfh epi thn penyeran authv
draft_translation: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
ukjv_translation: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

greek_text: ελεγεν δε και τοις οχλοις οταν ιδητε την νεφελην ανατελλουσαν απο δυσμων ευθεως λεγετε ομβρος ερχεται και γινεται ουτως
transliteration: elegen de kai toiv ocloiv otan idhte thn nefelhn anatellousan apo dusmwn euyewv legete ombrov ercetai kai ginetai outwv
draft_translation: And he said also to the people, When you see a cloud rise out of the west, immediately you say, There comes a shower; and so it is.
ukjv_translation: And he said also to the people, When all of you see a cloud rise out of the west, immediately all of you say, There comes a shower; and so it is.

greek_text: και οταν νοτον πνεοντα λεγετε οτι καυσων εσται και γινεται
transliteration: kai otan noton pneonta legete oti kauswn estai kai ginetai
draft_translation: And when you see the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it comes to pass.
ukjv_translation: And when all of you see the south wind blow, all of you say, There will be heat; and it comes to pass.

greek_text: υποκριται το προσωπον του ουρανου και της γης οιδατε δοκιμαζειν τον δε καιρον τουτον πως ου δοκιμαζετε

draft_translation: You hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that you do not discern this time?

draft_translation: When you go with your adversary to the magistrate, as you are on the way, give diligence that you may be delivered from him; lest he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison.

draft_translation: I tell you, you shall not depart from there, till you have paid the very last lepton.

greek_text: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις δοκειτε οτι οι γαλιλαιοι ουτοι αμαρτωλοι παρα παντας τους γαλιλαιους εγενοντο οτι τοιαυτα πεπονθασιν

draft_translation: And Jesus answering said to them, Do you suppose that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?
ukjv_translation: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose all of you that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

greek_text: ουχι λεγω υμιν αλλ εαν μη μετανοητε παντες ωσαυτως απολεισθε

draft_translation: I tell you, No: but, unless you repent, you shall all likewise perish.
ukjv_translation: I tell you, Nay: but, except all of you repent, all of you shall all likewise perish.

greek_text: η εκεινοι οι δεκα και οκτω εφ ους επεσεν ο πυργος εν τω σιλωαμ και απεκτεινεν αυτους δοκειτε οτι ουτοι οφειλεται εγενοντο παρα παντας ανθρωπους τους κατοικουντας εν ιερουσαλημ

draft_translation: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them, do you think that they were sinners above all people who dwelt in Jerusalem?
ukjv_translation: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think all of you that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

ukjv_translation: I tell you, Nay: but, except all of you repent, all of you shall all likewise perish.

greek_text: ελεγεν δε ταυτην την παραβολην συκην ειχεν τις εν τω αμπελωνι αυτου πεφυτευμενην και ηλθεν καρπον ζητων εν αυτη και ουχ ευρεν

ukjv_translation: He spoke also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

greek_text: ειπεν δε προς τον αμπελουργον ιδου τρια ετη ερχομαι ζητων καρπον εν τη συκη ταυτη και ουχ ευρισκω εκκοψον αυτην ινα τι και την γην καταργει

draft_translation: And he answering said to him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig around it, and put manure on it:
ukjv_translation: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

draft_translation: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have a donkey or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not immediately pull him out on the Sabbath?

greek_text: οταν κληθης υπο τινος εις γαμους μη κατακλιθης εις την πρωτοκλισιαν μηποτε εντιμοτερος σου η κεκλημενος υπ αυτου

greek_text: και ελθων ο σε και αυτον καλεσας ερει σοι δος τουτω τοπον και τοτε αρξη μετ αισχυνης τον εσχατον τοπον κατεχειν

draft_translation: And the one who invited you and him come and say to you, Give this man place; and you begin with shame to take the lowest place.
ukjv_translation: And he that bade you and him come and say to you, Give this man place; and you begin with shame to take the low room.

greek_text: αλλ οταν κληθης πορευθεις αναπεσον εις τον εσχατον τοπον ινα οταν ελθη ο κεκληκως σε ειπη σοι φιλε προσαναβηθι ανωτερον τοτε εσται σοι δοξα ενωπιον των συνανακειμενων σοι
transliteration: all otan klhyhv poreuyeiv anapeson eiv ton escaton topon ina otan elyh o keklhkwv se eiph soi file prosanabhyi anwteron tote estai soi doxa enwpion twn sunanakeimenwn soi
draft_translation: But when you are invited, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when the one who invited you comes, he may say to you, Friend, go up higher: then shall you have honor in the presence of those who sit to eat with you.
ukjv_translation: But when you are bidden, go and sit down in the low room; that when he that bade you comes, he may say unto you, Friend, go up higher: then shall you have worship in the presence of them that sit to eat with you.

greek_text: οτι πας ο υψων εαυτον ταπεινωθησεται και ο ταπεινων εαυτον υψωθησεται

ukjv_translation: For whosoever exalts himself shall be brought low; and he that humbles himself shall be exalted.

greek_text: ελεγεν δε και τω κεκληκοτι αυτον οταν ποιης αριστον η δειπνον μη φωνει τους φιλους σου μηδε τους αδελφους σου μηδε τους συγγενεις σου μηδε γειτονας πλουσιους μηποτε και αυτοι σε αντικαλεσωσιν και γενηται σοι ανταποδομα
transliteration: elegen de kai tw keklhkoti auton otan poihv ariston h deipnon mh fwnei touv filouv sou mhde touv adelfouv sou mhde touv suggeneiv sou mhde geitonav plousiouv mhpote kai autoi se antikaleswsin kai genhtai soi antapodoma
draft_translation: Then said he also to him who invited him, When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brothers, neither your kinsmen, nor your rich neighbors; lest they also bid you again, and a recompense be made you.
ukjv_translation: Then said he also to him that bade him, When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brethren, neither your kinsmen, nor your rich neighbours; lest they also bid you again, and a recompence be made you.

draft_translation: And you shall be blessed; for they cannot repay you: for you shall be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.
ukjv_translation: And you shall be blessed; for they cannot recompense you: for you shall be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

greek_text: ακουσας δε τις των συνανακειμενων ταυτα ειπεν αυτω μακαριος ος φαγεται αρτον εν τη βασιλεια του θεου
transliteration: akousav de tiv twn sunanakeimenwn tauta eipen autw makariov ov fagetai arton en th basileia tou yeou
draft_translation: And when one of those who reclined at table with him heard these things, he said to him, Blessed is the one who shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

draft_translation: And sent his slave at supper time to say to those who were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
ukjv_translation: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

draft_translation: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I ask you, have me excused.

draft_translation: If anyone comes to me, and does not hate his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

draft_translation: And whoever does not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
ukjv_translation: And whosoever does not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

transliteration: tiv gar ex umwn yelwn purgon oikodomhsai ouci prwton kayisav qhfizei thn dapanhn ei ecei ta prov apartismon
draft_translation: For which of you, intending to build a tower, does not sit down first, and count the cost, whether he has sufficient to finish it?
ukjv_translation: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sits not down first, and counts the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
