draft_translation: Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not sit down first, and consult whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
ukjv_translation: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sits not down first, and consults whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that comes against him with twenty thousand?

draft_translation: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an embassy, and asks conditions of peace.

draft_translation: I say to you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repents, more than over ninety-nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.
ukjv_translation: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repents, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

greek_text: η τις γυνη δραχμας εχουσα δεκα εαν απολεση δραχμην μιαν ουχι απτει λυχνον και σαροι την οικιαν και ζητει επιμελως εως οτου ευρη
transliteration: h tiv gunh dracmav ecousa deka ean apolesh dracmhn mian ouci aptei lucnon kai saroi thn oikian kai zhtei epimelwv ewv otou eurh
draft_translation: Or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she loses one piece, does not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she finds it?
ukjv_translation: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, does not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

greek_text: και ευρουσα συγκαλειται τας φιλας και τας γειτονας λεγουσα συγχαρητε μοι οτι ευρον την δραχμην ην απωλεσα
transliteration: kai eurousa sugkaleitai tav filav kai tav geitonav legousa sugcarhte moi oti euron thn dracmhn hn apwlesa
draft_translation: And when she has found it, she calls her friends and her neighbors together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
ukjv_translation: And when she has found it, she calls her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

greek_text: ουτως λεγω υμιν χαρα γινεται ενωπιον των αγγελων του θεου επι ενι αμαρτωλω μετανοουντι
transliteration: outwv legw umin cara ginetai enwpion twn aggelwn tou yeou epi eni amartwlw metanoounti
draft_translation: Likewise, I say to you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repents.
ukjv_translation: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repents.

greek_text: ειπεν δε ανθρωπος τις ειχεν δυο υιους
transliteration: eipen de anyrwpov tiv eicen duo uiouv
draft_translation: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
ukjv_translation: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ειπεν ο νεωτερος αυτων τω πατρι πατερ δος μοι το επιβαλλον μερος της ουσιας και διειλεν αυτοις τον βιον
transliteration: kai eipen o newterov autwn tw patri pater dov moi to epiballon merov thv ousiav kai dieilen autoiv ton bion
draft_translation: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falls to me. And he divided to them his living.
ukjv_translation: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falls to me. And he divided unto them his living.

greek_text: και μετ ου πολλας ημερας συναγαγων απαντα ο νεωτερος υιος απεδημησεν εις χωραν μακραν και εκει διεσκορπισεν την ουσιαν αυτου ζων ασωτως
transliteration: kai met ou pollav hmerav sunagagwn apanta o newterov uiov apedhmhsen eiv cwran makran kai ekei dieskorpisen thn ousian autou zwn aswtwv
draft_translation: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his possessions with riotous living.
ukjv_translation: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

greek_text: δαπανησαντος δε αυτου παντα εγενετο λιμος ισχυρος κατα την χωραν εκεινην και αυτος ηρξατο υστερεισθαι
transliteration: dapanhsantov de autou panta egeneto limov iscurov kata thn cwran ekeinhn kai autov hrxato ustereisyai
draft_translation: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in lack.
ukjv_translation: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in lack.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και πορευθεις εκολληθη ενι των πολιτων της χωρας εκεινης και επεμψεν αυτον εις τους αγρους αυτου βοσκειν χοιρους
transliteration: kai poreuyeiv ekollhyh eni twn politwn thv cwrav ekeinhv kai epemqen auton eiv touv agrouv autou boskein coirouv
draft_translation: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
ukjv_translation: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και επεθυμει γεμισαι την κοιλιαν αυτου απο των κερατιων ων ησθιον οι χοιροι και ουδεις εδιδου αυτω
transliteration: kai epeyumei gemisai thn koilian autou apo twn keratiwn wn hsyion oi coiroi kai oudeiv edidou autw
draft_translation: And he would gladly have filled his belly with the husks that the swine ate: and no one gave to him.
ukjv_translation: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

greek_text: εις εαυτον δε ελθων ειπεν ποσοι μισθιοι του πατρος μου περισσευουσιν αρτων εγω δε λιμω απολλυμαι
transliteration: eiv eauton de elywn eipen posoi misyioi tou patrov mou perisseuousin artwn egw de limw apollumai
draft_translation: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
ukjv_translation: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αναστας πορευσομαι προς τον πατερα μου και ερω αυτω πατερ ημαρτον εις τον ουρανον και ενωπιον σου
transliteration: anastav poreusomai prov ton patera mou kai erw autw pater hmarton eiv ton ouranon kai enwpion sou
draft_translation: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before you,
ukjv_translation: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before you,

greek_text: και ουκετι ειμι αξιος κληθηναι υιος σου ποιησον με ως ενα των μισθιων σου
transliteration: kai ouketi eimi axiov klhyhnai uiov sou poihson me wv ena twn misyiwn sou
draft_translation: And am no longer worthy to be called your son: make me as one of your hired servants.
ukjv_translation: And am no more worthy to be called your son: make me as one of your hired servants.

greek_text: και αναστας ηλθεν προς τον πατερα εαυτου ετι δε αυτου μακραν απεχοντος ειδεν αυτον ο πατηρ αυτου και εσπλαγχνισθη και δραμων επεπεσεν επι τον τραχηλον αυτου και κατεφιλησεν αυτον
transliteration: kai anastav hlyen prov ton patera eautou eti de autou makran apecontov eiden auton o pathr autou kai esplagcnisyh kai dramwn epepesen epi ton trachlon autou kai katefilhsen auton
draft_translation: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
ukjv_translation: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ο υιος πατερ ημαρτον εις τον ουρανον και ενωπιον σου και ουκετι ειμι αξιος κληθηναι υιος σου
transliteration: eipen de autw o uiov pater hmarton eiv ton ouranon kai enwpion sou kai ouketi eimi axiov klhyhnai uiov sou
draft_translation: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight, and am no longer worthy to be called your son.
ukjv_translation: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight, and am no more worthy to be called your son.

greek_text: ειπεν δε ο πατηρ προς τους δουλους αυτου εξενεγκατε την στολην την πρωτην και ενδυσατε αυτον και δοτε δακτυλιον εις την χειρα αυτου και υποδηματα εις τους ποδας
transliteration: eipen de o pathr prov touv doulouv autou exenegkate thn stolhn thn prwthn kai endusate auton kai dote daktulion eiv thn ceira autou kai upodhmata eiv touv podav
draft_translation: But the father said to his slaves, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
ukjv_translation: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

greek_text: και ενεγκαντες τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον θυσατε και φαγοντες ευφρανθωμεν
transliteration: kai enegkantev ton moscon ton siteuton yusate kai fagontev eufranywmen
draft_translation: And bring here the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
ukjv_translation: And bring here the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

greek_text: οτι ουτος ο υιος μου νεκρος ην και ανεζησεν και απολωλως ην και ευρεθη και ηρξαντο ευφραινεσθαι
transliteration: oti outov o uiov mou nekrov hn kai anezhsen kai apolwlwv hn kai eureyh kai hrxanto eufrainesyai
draft_translation: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
ukjv_translation: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

greek_text: ην δε ο υιος αυτου ο πρεσβυτερος εν αγρω και ως ερχομενος ηγγισεν τη οικια ηκουσεν συμφωνιας και χορων
transliteration: hn de o uiov autou o presbuterov en agrw kai wv ercomenov hggisen th oikia hkousen sumfwniav kai corwn
draft_translation: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
ukjv_translation: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος ενα των παιδων επυνθανετο τι ειη ταυτα
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov ena twn paidwn epunyaneto ti eih tauta
draft_translation: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
ukjv_translation: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτω οτι ο αδελφος σου ηκει και εθυσεν ο πατηρ σου τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον οτι υγιαινοντα αυτον απελαβεν
transliteration: o de eipen autw oti o adelfov sou hkei kai eyusen o pathr sou ton moscon ton siteuton oti ugiainonta auton apelaben
draft_translation: And he said to him, Your brother has come; and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has received him safe and sound.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto him, Your brother has come; and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has received him safe and sound.

greek_text: ωργισθη δε και ουκ ηθελεν εισελθειν ο ουν πατηρ αυτου εξελθων παρεκαλει αυτον
transliteration: wrgisyh de kai ouk hyelen eiselyein o oun pathr autou exelywn parekalei auton
draft_translation: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore his father came out, and implored him.
ukjv_translation: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and implored him.

greek_text: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν τω πατρι ιδου τοσαυτα ετη δουλευω σοι και ουδεποτε εντολην σου παρηλθον και εμοι ουδεποτε εδωκας εριφον ινα μετα των φιλων μου ευφρανθω
transliteration: o de apokriyeiv eipen tw patri idou tosauta eth douleuw soi kai oudepote entolhn sou parhlyon kai emoi oudepote edwkav erifon ina meta twn filwn mou eufranyw
draft_translation: And he answering said to his father, Look, these many years I serve you, neither did I at any time transgress your commandment: and yet you never gave me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
ukjv_translation: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve you, neither transgressed I at any time your commandment: and yet you never gave me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

greek_text: οτε δε ο υιος σου ουτος ο καταφαγων σου τον βιον μετα πορνων ηλθεν εθυσας αυτω τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον
transliteration: ote de o uiov sou outov o katafagwn sou ton bion meta pornwn hlyen eyusav autw ton moscon ton siteuton
draft_translation: But as soon as this your son had come, which has devoured your living with prostitutes, you have killed for him the fatted calf.
ukjv_translation: But as soon as this your son was come, which has devoured your living with harlots, you have killed for him the fatted calf.
review_notes: modernized porne wording; modernized was-come perfect

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν αυτω τεκνον συ παντοτε μετ εμου ει και παντα τα εμα σα εστιν
transliteration: o de eipen autw teknon su pantote met emou ei kai panta ta ema sa estin
draft_translation: And he said to him, Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto him, Son, you are ever with me, and all that I have is yours.

greek_text: ευφρανθηναι δε και χαρηναι εδει οτι ο αδελφος σου ουτος νεκρος ην και ανεζησεν και απολωλως ην και ευρεθη
transliteration: eufranyhnai de kai carhnai edei oti o adelfov sou outov nekrov hn kai anezhsen kai apolwlwv hn kai eureyh
draft_translation: It was fitting that we should make merry, and be glad: for this your brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
ukjv_translation: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this your brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

greek_text: ελεγεν δε και προς τους μαθητας αυτου ανθρωπος τις ην πλουσιος ος ειχεν οικονομον και ουτος διεβληθη αυτω ως διασκορπιζων τα υπαρχοντα αυτου
transliteration: elegen de kai prov touv mayhtav autou anyrwpov tiv hn plousiov ov eicen oikonomon kai outov dieblhyh autw wv diaskorpizwn ta uparconta autou
draft_translation: And he said also to his disciples, There was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and the same was accused to him that he had wasted his goods.
ukjv_translation: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: και φωνησας αυτον ειπεν αυτω τι τουτο ακουω περι σου αποδος τον λογον της οικονομιας σου ου γαρ δυνηση ετι οικονομειν
transliteration: kai fwnhsav auton eipen autw ti touto akouw peri sou apodov ton logon thv oikonomiav sou ou gar dunhsh eti oikonomein
draft_translation: And he called him, and said to him, What is this that I hear of you? give an account of your stewardship; for you may no longer be steward.
ukjv_translation: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of you? give an account (o. logos) of your stewardship; for you may be no longer steward.

greek_text: ειπεν δε εν εαυτω ο οικονομος τι ποιησω οτι ο κυριος μου αφαιρειται την οικονομιαν απ εμου σκαπτειν ουκ ισχυω επαιτειν αισχυνομαι
transliteration: eipen de en eautw o oikonomov ti poihsw oti o kuriov mou afaireitai thn oikonomian ap emou skaptein ouk iscuw epaitein aiscunomai
draft_translation: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord takes away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
ukjv_translation: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord takes away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

greek_text: εγνων τι ποιησω ινα οταν μετασταθω της οικονομιας δεξωνται με εις τους οικους αυτων
transliteration: egnwn ti poihsw ina otan metastayw thv oikonomiav dexwntai me eiv touv oikouv autwn
draft_translation: I know what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
ukjv_translation: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

greek_text: και προσκαλεσαμενος ενα εκαστον των χρεωφειλετων του κυριου εαυτου ελεγεν τω πρωτω ποσον οφειλεις τω κυριω μου
transliteration: kai proskalesamenov ena ekaston twn crewfeiletwn tou kuriou eautou elegen tw prwtw poson ofeileiv tw kuriw mou
draft_translation: So he called every one of his lord's debtors to him, and said to the first, How much do you owe my lord?
ukjv_translation: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owe you unto my lord?

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν εκατον βατους ελαιου και ειπεν αυτω δεξαι σου το γραμμα και καθισας ταχεως γραψον πεντηκοντα
transliteration: o de eipen ekaton batouv elaiou kai eipen autw dexai sou to gramma kai kayisav tacewv graqon penthkonta
draft_translation: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said to him, Take your bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
ukjv_translation: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take your bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

greek_text: επειτα ετερω ειπεν συ δε ποσον οφειλεις ο δε ειπεν εκατον κορους σιτου και λεγει αυτω δεξαι σου το γραμμα και γραψον ογδοηκοντα
transliteration: epeita eterw eipen su de poson ofeileiv o de eipen ekaton korouv sitou kai legei autw dexai sou to gramma kai graqon ogdohkonta
draft_translation: Then he said to another, And how much do you owe? And he said, A hundred measures of wheat. And he said to him, Take your bill, and write eighty.
ukjv_translation: Then said he to another, And how much owe you? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take your bill, and write fourscore.

greek_text: και επηνεσεν ο κυριος τον οικονομον της αδικιας οτι φρονιμως εποιησεν οτι οι υιοι του αιωνος τουτου φρονιμωτεροι υπερ τους υιους του φωτος εις την γενεαν εαυτων εισιν
transliteration: kai ephnesen o kuriov ton oikonomon thv adikiav oti fronimwv epoihsen oti oi uioi tou aiwnov toutou fronimwteroi uper touv uiouv tou fwtov eiv thn genean eautwn eisin
draft_translation: And the Lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this age are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
ukjv_translation: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered this aion as this age

greek_text: καγω υμιν λεγω ποιησατε εαυτοις φιλους εκ του μαμωνα της αδικιας ινα οταν εκλιπητε δεξωνται υμας εις τας αιωνιους σκηνας
transliteration: kagw umin legw poihsate eautoiv filouv ek tou mamwna thv adikiav ina otan ekliphte dexwntai umav eiv tav aiwniouv skhnav
draft_translation: And I say to you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when you fail, they may receive you into eternal habitations.
ukjv_translation: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when all of you fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: ο πιστος εν ελαχιστω και εν πολλω πιστος εστιν και ο εν ελαχιστω αδικος και εν πολλω αδικος εστιν
transliteration: o pistov en elacistw kai en pollw pistov estin kai o en elacistw adikov kai en pollw adikov estin
draft_translation: The one who is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and the one who is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
ukjv_translation: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

greek_text: ει ουν εν τω αδικω μαμωνα πιστοι ουκ εγενεσθε το αληθινον τις υμιν πιστευσει
transliteration: ei oun en tw adikw mamwna pistoi ouk egenesye to alhyinon tiv umin pisteusei
draft_translation: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
ukjv_translation: If therefore all of you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

greek_text: και ει εν τω αλλοτριω πιστοι ουκ εγενεσθε το υμετερον τις υμιν δωσει
transliteration: kai ei en tw allotriw pistoi ouk egenesye to umeteron tiv umin dwsei
draft_translation: And if you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who shall give you that which is your own?
ukjv_translation: And if all of you have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

greek_text: ουδεις οικετης δυναται δυσι κυριοις δουλευειν η γαρ τον ενα μισησει και τον ετερον αγαπησει η ενος ανθεξεται και του ετερου καταφρονησει ου δυνασθε θεω δουλευειν και μαμωνα
transliteration: oudeiv oikethv dunatai dusi kurioiv douleuein h gar ton ena mishsei kai ton eteron agaphsei h enov anyexetai kai tou eterou katafronhsei ou dunasye yew douleuein kai mamwna
draft_translation: No slave can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.
ukjv_translation: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. All of you cannot serve God and mammon.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ηκουον δε ταυτα παντα και οι φαρισαιοι φιλαργυροι υπαρχοντες και εξεμυκτηριζον αυτον
transliteration: hkouon de tauta panta kai oi farisaioi filarguroi uparcontev kai exemukthrizon auton
draft_translation: And the Pharisees also, who were lovers of money, heard all these things: and they derided him.
ukjv_translation: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

greek_text: και ειπεν αυτοις υμεις εστε οι δικαιουντες εαυτους ενωπιον των ανθρωπων ο δε θεος γινωσκει τας καρδιας υμων οτι το εν ανθρωποις υψηλον βδελυγμα ενωπιον του θεου εστιν
transliteration: kai eipen autoiv umeiv este oi dikaiountev eautouv enwpion twn anyrwpwn o de yeov ginwskei tav kardiav umwn oti to en anyrwpoiv uqhlon bdelugma enwpion tou yeou estin
draft_translation: And he said to them, You are those who justify yourselves before people; but God knows your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among people is abomination in the sight of God.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, All of you are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knows your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

greek_text: ο νομος και οι προφηται εως ιωαννου απο τοτε η βασιλεια του θεου ευαγγελιζεται και πας εις αυτην βιαζεται
transliteration: o nomov kai oi profhtai ewv iwannou apo tote h basileia tou yeou euaggelizetai kai pav eiv authn biazetai
draft_translation: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every one presses into it.

greek_text: οτι ηξουσιν ημεραι επι σε και περιβαλουσιν οι εχθροι σου χαρακα σοι και περικυκλωσουσιν σε και συνεξουσιν σε παντοθεν

draft_translation: And at the season he sent a slave to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
ukjv_translation: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

draft_translation: And again he sent another slave: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

ukjv_translation: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

draft_translation: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do to them?

draft_translation: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, may it not be.

draft_translation: And he looked on them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same has become the head of the corner?
ukjv_translation: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

draft_translation: Whoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

greek_text: και εζητησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις επιβαλειν επ αυτον τας χειρας εν αυτη τη ωρα και εφοβηθησαν τον λαον εγνωσαν γαρ οτι προς αυτους την παραβολην ταυτην ειπεν

draft_translation: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

transliteration: legontev didaskale mwshv egraqen hmin ean tinov adelfov apoyanh ecwn gunaika kai outov ateknov apoyanh ina labh o adelfov autou thn gunaika kai exanasthsh sperma tw adelfw autou
draft_translation: Saying, Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If anyone's brother dies, having a wife, and he dies childless, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.

draft_translation: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her as wife.

greek_text: οτι δε εγειρονται οι νεκροι και μωσης εμηνυσεν επι της βατου ως λεγει κυριον τον θεον αβρααμ και τον θεον ισαακ και τον θεον ιακωβ

draft_translation: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he calls the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

draft_translation: And he said to them, How do they say that Christ is David's son?
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

greek_text: και αυτος δαβιδ λεγει εν βιβλω ψαλμων ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου
transliteration: kai autov dabid legei en biblw qalmwn eipen o kuriov tw kuriw mou kayou ek dexiwn mou
draft_translation: And David himself says in the book of Psalms, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,
ukjv_translation: And David himself says in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand,

draft_translation: David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he then his son?
ukjv_translation: David therefore calls him Lord, how is he then his son?

draft_translation: Then in the hearing of all the people he said to his disciples,
ukjv_translation: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

greek_text: προσεχετε απο των γραμματεων των θελοντων περιπατειν εν στολαις και φιλουντων ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις και πρωτοκαθεδριας εν ταις συναγωγαις και πρωτοκλισιας εν τοις δειπνοις

draft_translation: Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief seats at feasts;
ukjv_translation: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

greek_text: οι κατεσθιουσιν τας οικιας των χηρων και προφασει μακρα προσευχονται ουτοι ληψονται περισσοτερον κριμα

draft_translation: For all these from their abundance cast into the offerings of God: but she from her destitution cast in all the livelihood that she had.
ukjv_translation: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her destitution has cast in all the living that she had.

greek_text: και τινων λεγοντων περι του ιερου οτι λιθοις καλοις και αναθημασιν κεκοσμηται ειπεν

ukjv_translation: As for these things which all of you behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

greek_text: επηρωτησαν δε αυτον λεγοντες διδασκαλε ποτε ουν ταυτα εσται και τι το σημειον οταν μελλη ταυτα γινεσθαι

ukjv_translation: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

greek_text: ο δε ειπεν βλεπετε μη πλανηθητε πολλοι γαρ ελευσονται επι τω ονοματι μου λεγοντες οτι εγω ειμι και ο καιρος ηγγικεν μη ουν πορευθητε οπισω αυτων
transliteration: o de eipen blepete mh planhyhte polloi gar eleusontai epi tw onomati mou legontev oti egw eimi kai o kairov hggiken mh oun poreuyhte opisw autwn
draft_translation: And he said, Take heed that you be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draws near: do not go therefore after them.
ukjv_translation: And he said, Take heed that all of you be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draws near: go all of you not therefore after them.

greek_text: οταν δε ακουσητε πολεμους και ακαταστασιας μη πτοηθητε δει γαρ ταυτα γενεσθαι πρωτον αλλ ουκ ευθεως το τελος
transliteration: otan de akoushte polemouv kai akatastasiav mh ptohyhte dei gar tauta genesyai prwton all ouk euyewv to telov
draft_translation: But when you shall hear of wars and commotions, do not be terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not immediately.
ukjv_translation: But when all of you shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

transliteration: tote elegen autoiv egeryhsetai eynov epi eynov kai basileia epi basileian
draft_translation: Then he said to them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
ukjv_translation: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

greek_text: σεισμοι τε μεγαλοι κατα τοπους και λιμοι και λοιμοι εσονται φοβητρα τε και σημεια απ ουρανου μεγαλα εσται
transliteration: seismoi te megaloi kata topouv kai limoi kai loimoi esontai fobhtra te kai shmeia ap ouranou megala estai
draft_translation: And great earthquakes shall be in various places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
ukjv_translation: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

draft_translation: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand what you shall answer:
ukjv_translation: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what all of you shall answer:

draft_translation: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to contradict nor resist.
ukjv_translation: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

transliteration: paradoyhsesye de kai upo gonewn kai adelfwn kai suggenwn kai filwn kai yanatwsousin ex umwn
draft_translation: And you shall be betrayed both by parents, and brothers, and kinsfolks, and friends; and they shall cause some of you to be put to death.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

greek_text: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου
transliteration: kai esesye misoumenoi upo pantwn dia to onoma mou
draft_translation: And you shall be hated by all for my name's sake.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

draft_translation: But not a hair of your head shall perish.
ukjv_translation: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

draft_translation: By your patience possess your souls.
ukjv_translation: In your patience possess all of you your souls.

greek_text: οταν δε ιδητε κυκλουμενην υπο στρατοπεδων την ιερουσαλημ τοτε γνωτε οτι ηγγικεν η ερημωσις αυτης

draft_translation: And when you shall see Jerusalem surrounded with armies, then know that its desolation is near.
ukjv_translation: And when all of you shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

greek_text: τοτε οι εν τη ιουδαια φευγετωσαν εις τα ορη και οι εν μεσω αυτης εκχωρειτωσαν και οι εν ταις χωραις μη εισερχεσθωσαν εις αυτην

draft_translation: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains; and let those who are in the midst of it depart out; and let not those who are in the fields enter into it.
ukjv_translation: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter therein.

ukjv_translation: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

greek_text: και πεσουνται στοματι μαχαιρας και αιχμαλωτισθησονται εις παντα τα εθνη και ιερουσαλημ εσται πατουμενη υπο εθνων αχρι πληρωθωσιν καιροι εθνων
transliteration: kai pesountai stomati macairav kai aicmalwtisyhsontai eiv panta ta eynh kai ierousalhm estai patoumenh upo eynwn acri plhrwywsin kairoi eynwn
draft_translation: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trampled down of the nations, until the times of the nations be fulfilled.
ukjv_translation: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

draft_translation: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draws near.
ukjv_translation: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draws nigh.

transliteration: outwv kai umeiv otan idhte tauta ginomena ginwskete oti egguv estin h basileia tou yeou
draft_translation: So likewise you, when you see these things happen, know that the kingdom of God is near at hand.
ukjv_translation: So likewise all of you, when all of you see these things come to pass, know all of you that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

draft_translation: And he said to them the third time, Why, what evil has he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore punish him, and let him go.

greek_text: οι δε επεκειντο φωναις μεγαλαις αιτουμενοι αυτον σταυρωθηναι και κατισχυον αι φωναι αυτων και των αρχιερεων

ukjv_translation: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

greek_text: οτι ιδου ερχονται ημεραι εν αις ερουσιν μακαριαι αι στειραι και κοιλιαι αι ουκ εγεννησαν και μαστοι οι ουκ εθηλασαν

greek_text: ο δε ιησους ελεγεν πατερ αφες αυτοις ου γαρ οιδασιν τι ποιουσιν διαμεριζομενοι δε τα ιματια αυτου εβαλον κληρον

ukjv_translation: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

ukjv_translation: And saying, If you be the king of the Jews, save yourself.

draft_translation: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man has done nothing wrong.
ukjv_translation: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man has done nothing amiss.

ukjv_translation: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

transliteration: kai eipen autoiv umeiv ek twn katw este egw ek twn anw eimi umeiv ek tou kosmou toutou este egw ouk eimi ek tou kosmou toutou
draft_translation: And he said to them, You are from beneath; I am from above: you are of this world; I am not of this world.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto them, All of you are from beneath; I am from above: all of you are of this world; I am not of this world.

greek_text: ειπον ουν υμιν οτι αποθανεισθε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων εαν γαρ μη πιστευσητε οτι εγω ειμι αποθανεισθε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων
transliteration: eipon oun umin oti apoyaneisye en taiv amartiaiv umwn ean gar mh pisteushte oti egw eimi apoyaneisye en taiv amartiaiv umwn
draft_translation: I said therefore to you, that you shall die in your sins: for if you do not believe that I am he, you shall die in your sins.

greek_text: ελεγον ουν αυτω συ τις ει και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους την αρχην ο τι και λαλω υμιν
transliteration: elegon oun autw su tiv ei kai eipen autoiv o ihsouv thn archn o ti kai lalw umin
draft_translation: Then they said to him, Who are you? And Jesus says to them, Even the same that I said to you from the beginning.
ukjv_translation: Then said they unto him, Who are you? And Jesus says unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

greek_text: πολλα εχω περι υμων λαλειν και κρινειν αλλ ο πεμψας με αληθης εστιν καγω α ηκουσα παρ αυτου ταυτα λεγω εις τον κοσμον
transliteration: polla ecw peri umwn lalein kai krinein all o pemqav me alhyhv estin kagw a hkousa par autou tauta legw eiv ton kosmon
draft_translation: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but the one who sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
ukjv_translation: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

greek_text: ουκ εγνωσαν οτι τον πατερα αυτοις ελεγεν
transliteration: ouk egnwsan oti ton patera autoiv elegen
draft_translation: They did not understand that he spoke to them of the Father.
ukjv_translation: They understood not that he spoke to them of the Father.

greek_text: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους οταν υψωσητε τον υιον του ανθρωπου τοτε γνωσεσθε οτι εγω ειμι και απ εμαυτου ποιω ουδεν αλλα καθως εδιδαξεν με ο πατηρ μου ταυτα λαλω
transliteration: eipen oun autoiv o ihsouv otan uqwshte ton uion tou anyrwpou tote gnwsesye oti egw eimi kai ap emautou poiw ouden alla kaywv edidaxen me o pathr mou tauta lalw
draft_translation: Then Jesus said to them, When you have lifted up the Son of man, then shall you know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak these things.
ukjv_translation: Then said Jesus unto them, When all of you have lifted up the Son of man, then shall all of you know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak these things.

greek_text: και ο πεμψας με μετ εμου εστιν ουκ αφηκεν με μονον ο πατηρ οτι εγω τα αρεστα αυτω ποιω παντοτε
transliteration: kai o pemqav me met emou estin ouk afhken me monon o pathr oti egw ta aresta autw poiw pantote
draft_translation: And the one who sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
ukjv_translation: And he that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

greek_text: ταυτα αυτου λαλουντος πολλοι επιστευσαν εις αυτον
transliteration: tauta autou lalountov polloi episteusan eiv auton
draft_translation: As he spoke these words, many believed on him.

greek_text: ελεγεν ουν ο ιησους προς τους πεπιστευκοτας αυτω ιουδαιους εαν υμεις μεινητε εν τω λογω τω εμω αληθως μαθηται μου εστε
transliteration: elegen oun o ihsouv prov touv pepisteukotav autw ioudaiouv ean umeiv meinhte en tw logw tw emw alhywv mayhtai mou este
draft_translation: Then said Jesus to those Jews who believed on him, If you continue in my word, then are you my disciples indeed;
ukjv_translation: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If all of you continue in my word, (o. logos) then are all of you my disciples indeed;
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και γνωσεσθε την αληθειαν και η αληθεια ελευθερωσει υμας
transliteration: kai gnwsesye thn alhyeian kai h alhyeia eleuyerwsei umav
draft_translation: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
ukjv_translation: And all of you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

greek_text: απεκριθησαν αυτω σπερμα αβρααμ εσμεν και ουδενι δεδουλευκαμεν πωποτε πως συ λεγεις οτι ελευθεροι γενησεσθε
transliteration: apekriyhsan autw sperma abraam esmen kai oudeni dedouleukamen pwpote pwv su legeiv oti eleuyeroi genhsesye
draft_translation: They answered him, We are Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to anyone: how do you say, You shall be made free?
ukjv_translation: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how says you, All of you shall be made free?
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized how-says-you idiom; modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι πας ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν δουλος εστιν της αμαρτιας
transliteration: apekriyh autoiv o ihsouv amhn amhn legw umin oti pav o poiwn thn amartian doulov estin thv amartiav

greek_text: ο δε δουλος ου μενει εν τη οικια εις τον αιωνα ο υιος μενει εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: o de doulov ou menei en th oikia eiv ton aiwna o uiov menei eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: And the slave does not abide in the house forever: but the Son abides ever.
ukjv_translation: And the servant abides not in the house for ever: but the Son abides ever.
review_notes: modernized abides-not wording; modernized forever spelling; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: εαν ουν ο υιος υμας ελευθερωση οντως ελευθεροι εσεσθε
transliteration: ean oun o uiov umav eleuyerwsh ontwv eleuyeroi esesye
draft_translation: If the Son therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
ukjv_translation: If the Son therefore shall make you free, all of you shall be free indeed.

greek_text: οιδα οτι σπερμα αβρααμ εστε αλλα ζητειτε με αποκτειναι οτι ο λογος ο εμος ου χωρει εν υμιν
transliteration: oida oti sperma abraam este alla zhteite me apokteinai oti o logov o emov ou cwrei en umin
draft_translation: I know that you are Abraham's seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word has no place in you.
ukjv_translation: I know that all of you are Abraham's seed; but all of you seek to kill me, because my word (o. logos) has no place in you.

greek_text: εγω ο εωρακα παρα τω πατρι μου λαλω και υμεις ουν ο εωρακατε παρα τω πατρι υμων ποιειτε
transliteration: egw o ewraka para tw patri mou lalw kai umeiv oun o ewrakate para tw patri umwn poieite
draft_translation: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do that which you have seen with your father.
ukjv_translation: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and all of you do that which all of you have seen with your father.

greek_text: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω ο πατηρ ημων αβρααμ εστιν λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους ει τεκνα του αβρααμ ητε τα εργα του αβρααμ εποιειτε αν
transliteration: apekriyhsan kai eipon autw o pathr hmwn abraam estin legei autoiv o ihsouv ei tekna tou abraam hte ta erga tou abraam epoieite an

ukjv_translation: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus says unto them, If all of you were Abraham's children, all of you would do the works of Abraham.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: νυν δε ζητειτε με αποκτειναι ανθρωπον ος την αληθειαν υμιν λελαληκα ην ηκουσα παρα του θεου τουτο αβρααμ ουκ εποιησεν
transliteration: nun de zhteite me apokteinai anyrwpon ov thn alhyeian umin lelalhka hn hkousa para tou yeou touto abraam ouk epoihsen
draft_translation: But now you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth, which I have heard from God: Abraham did not do this.
ukjv_translation: But now all of you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

greek_text: υμεις ποιειτε τα εργα του πατρος υμων ειπον ουν αυτω ημεις εκ πορνειας ου γεγεννημεθα ενα πατερα εχομεν τον θεον
transliteration: umeiv poieite ta erga tou patrov umwn eipon oun autw hmeiv ek porneiav ou gegennhmeya ena patera ecomen ton yeon
draft_translation: You do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We were not born of sexual immorality; we have one Father, even God.
ukjv_translation: All of you do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
review_notes: modernized porneia wording; modernized we-be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους ει ο θεος πατηρ υμων ην ηγαπατε αν εμε εγω γαρ εκ του θεου εξηλθον και ηκω ουδε γαρ απ εμαυτου εληλυθα αλλ εκεινος με απεστειλεν
transliteration: eipen autoiv o ihsouv ei o yeov pathr umwn hn hgapate an eme egw gar ek tou yeou exhlyon kai hkw oude gar ap emautou elhluya all ekeinov me apesteilen
draft_translation: Jesus said to them, If God were your Father, you would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither did I come of myself, but he sent me.
ukjv_translation: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, all of you would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

greek_text: δια τι την λαλιαν την εμην ου γινωσκετε οτι ου δυνασθε ακουειν τον λογον τον εμον
transliteration: dia ti thn lalian thn emhn ou ginwskete oti ou dunasye akouein ton logon ton emon
draft_translation: Why do you not understand my speech? even because you cannot hear my word.
ukjv_translation: Why do all of you not understand my speech? even because all of you cannot hear my word. (o. logos)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: υμεις εκ πατρος του διαβολου εστε και τας επιθυμιας του πατρος υμων θελετε ποιειν εκεινος ανθρωποκτονος ην απ αρχης και εν τη αληθεια ουχ εστηκεν οτι ουκ εστιν αληθεια εν αυτω οταν λαλη το ψευδος εκ των ιδιων λαλει οτι ψευστης εστιν και ο πατηρ αυτου
transliteration: umeiv ek patrov tou diabolou este kai tav epiyumiav tou patrov umwn yelete poiein ekeinov anyrwpoktonov hn ap archv kai en th alhyeia ouc esthken oti ouk estin alhyeia en autw otan lalh to qeudov ek twn idiwn lalei oti qeusthv estin kai o pathr autou
draft_translation: You are of your father the devil, and the desires of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and did not remain in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
ukjv_translation: All of you are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father all of you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

greek_text: εγω δε οτι την αληθειαν λεγω ου πιστευετε μοι
transliteration: egw de oti thn alhyeian legw ou pisteuete moi
draft_translation: And because I tell you the truth, you do not believe me.
ukjv_translation: And because I tell you the truth, all of you believe me not.

greek_text: τις εξ υμων ελεγχει με περι αμαρτιας ει δε αληθειαν λεγω δια τι υμεις ου πιστευετε μοι
transliteration: tiv ex umwn elegcei me peri amartiav ei de alhyeian legw dia ti umeiv ou pisteuete moi
draft_translation: Which of you convicts me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do you not believe me?
ukjv_translation: Which of you convinces me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do all of you not believe me?

greek_text: ο ων εκ του θεου τα ρηματα του θεου ακουει δια τουτο υμεις ουκ ακουετε οτι εκ του θεου ουκ εστε
transliteration: o wn ek tou yeou ta rhmata tou yeou akouei dia touto umeiv ouk akouete oti ek tou yeou ouk este
draft_translation: The one who is of God hears God's words: you therefore do not hear them, because you are not of God.
ukjv_translation: He that is of God hears God's words: (o. rhema) all of you therefore hear them not, because all of you are not of God.

greek_text: απεκριθησαν ουν οι ιουδαιοι και ειπον αυτω ου καλως λεγομεν ημεις οτι σαμαρειτης ει συ και δαιμονιον εχεις
transliteration: apekriyhsan oun oi ioudaioi kai eipon autw ou kalwv legomen hmeiv oti samareithv ei su kai daimonion eceiv
draft_translation: Then answered the Jews, and said to him, Say we not well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?
ukjv_translation: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that you are a Samaritan, and have a devil?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: απεκριθη ιησους εγω δαιμονιον ουκ εχω αλλα τιμω τον πατερα μου και υμεις ατιμαζετε με
transliteration: apekriyh ihsouv egw daimonion ouk ecw alla timw ton patera mou kai umeiv atimazete me
draft_translation: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and you do dishonour me.

review_notes: modernized honour spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: εγω δε ου ζητω την δοξαν μου εστιν ο ζητων και κρινων

draft_translation: And I do not seek my own glory: there is one that seeks and judges.
ukjv_translation: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeks and judges.

transliteration: amhn amhn legw umin ean tiv ton logon ton emon thrhsh yanaton ou mh yewrhsh eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: Amen, amen, I say to you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
ukjv_translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, (o. logos) he shall never see death.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: ειπον ουν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι νυν εγνωκαμεν οτι δαιμονιον εχεις αβρααμ απεθανεν και οι προφηται και συ λεγεις εαν τις τον λογον μου τηρηση ου μη γευσεται θανατου εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: eipon oun autw oi ioudaioi nun egnwkamen oti daimonion eceiv abraam apeyanen kai oi profhtai kai su legeiv ean tiv ton logon mou thrhsh ou mh geusetai yanatou eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: Then said the Jews to him, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and you says, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

draft_translation: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom do you make yourself?
ukjv_translation: Are you greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom make you yourself?

greek_text: απεκριθη ιησους εαν εγω δοξαζω εμαυτον η δοξα μου ουδεν εστιν εστιν ο πατηρ μου ο δοξαζων με ον υμεις λεγετε οτι θεος υμων εστιν
transliteration: apekriyh ihsouv ean egw doxazw emauton h doxa mou ouden estin estin o pathr mou o doxazwn me on umeiv legete oti yeov umwn estin
draft_translation: Jesus answered, If I honor myself, my honor is nothing: it is my Father that honors me; of whom you say, that he is your God:
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honors me; of whom all of you say, that he is your God:

greek_text: και ουκ εγνωκατε αυτον εγω δε οιδα αυτον και εαν ειπω οτι ουκ οιδα αυτον εσομαι ομοιος υμων ψευστης αλλ οιδα αυτον και τον λογον αυτου τηρω
transliteration: kai ouk egnwkate auton egw de oida auton kai ean eipw oti ouk oida auton esomai omoiov umwn qeusthv all oida auton kai ton logon autou thrw

ukjv_translation: Then said the Jews unto him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?

draft_translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, Teacher, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
ukjv_translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
