greek_text: λεγει αυτω σιμων πετρος κυριε που υπαγεις απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους οπου υπαγω ου δυνασαι μοι νυν ακολουθησαι υστερον δε ακολουθησεις μοι
transliteration: legei autw simwn petrov kurie pou upageiv apekriyh autw o ihsouv opou upagw ou dunasai moi nun akolouyhsai usteron de akolouyhseiv moi
draft_translation: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where go you? Jesus answered him, Where I go, you cannot follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards.
ukjv_translation: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, where go you? Jesus answered him, Where I go, you can not follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized cannot spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο πετρος κυριε δια τι ου δυναμαι σοι ακολουθησαι αρτι την ψυχην μου υπερ σου θησω
transliteration: legei autw o petrov kurie dia ti ou dunamai soi akolouyhsai arti thn quchn mou uper sou yhsw
draft_translation: Peter said to him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake.
ukjv_translation: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους την ψυχην σου υπερ εμου θησεις αμην αμην λεγω σοι ου μη αλεκτωρ φωνησει εως ου απαρνηση με τρις
transliteration: apekriyh autw o ihsouv thn quchn sou uper emou yhseiv amhn amhn legw soi ou mh alektwr fwnhsei ewv ou aparnhsh me triv
draft_translation: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Amen, amen, I say to you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me three times.
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me three times.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: μη ταρασσεσθω υμων η καρδια πιστευετε εις τον θεον και εις εμε πιστευετε
transliteration: mh tarassesyw umwn h kardia pisteuete eiv ton yeon kai eiv eme pisteuete
draft_translation: Let not your heart be troubled: you believe in God, believe also in me.
ukjv_translation: Let not your heart be troubled: all of you believe in God, believe also in me.

greek_text: εν τη οικια του πατρος μου μοναι πολλαι εισιν ει δε μη ειπον αν υμιν πορευομαι ετοιμασαι τοπον υμιν
transliteration: en th oikia tou patrov mou monai pollai eisin ei de mh eipon an umin poreuomai etoimasai topon umin
draft_translation: In my Father's house are many dwelling places: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
ukjv_translation: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

greek_text: και εαν πορευθω και ετοιμασω υμιν τοπον παλιν ερχομαι και παραληψομαι υμας προς εμαυτον ινα οπου ειμι εγω και υμεις ητε
transliteration: kai ean poreuyw kai etoimasw umin topon palin ercomai kai paralhqomai umav prov emauton ina opou eimi egw kai umeiv hte
draft_translation: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you to myself; that where I am, there you may be also.
ukjv_translation: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there all of you may be also.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και οπου εγω υπαγω οιδατε και την οδον οιδατε
transliteration: kai opou egw upagw oidate kai thn odon oidate
draft_translation: And where I go you know, and the way you know.
ukjv_translation: And where I go all of you know, and the way all of you know.

greek_text: λεγει αυτω θωμας κυριε ουκ οιδαμεν που υπαγεις και πως δυναμεθα την οδον ειδεναι
transliteration: legei autw ywmav kurie ouk oidamen pou upageiv kai pwv dunameya thn odon eidenai
draft_translation: Thomas says to him, Lord, we do not know where you go; and how can we know the way?
ukjv_translation: Thomas says unto him, Lord, we know not where you go; and how can we know the way?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized know-not idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους εγω ειμι η οδος και η αληθεια και η ζωη ουδεις ερχεται προς τον πατερα ει μη δι εμου
transliteration: legei autw o ihsouv egw eimi h odov kai h alhyeia kai h zwh oudeiv ercetai prov ton patera ei mh di emou
draft_translation: Jesus says to him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no one comes to the Father, but by me.
ukjv_translation: Jesus says unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man comes unto the Father, but by me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: ει εγνωκειτε με και τον πατερα μου εγνωκειτε αν και απ αρτι γινωσκετε αυτον και εωρακατε αυτον
transliteration: ei egnwkeite me kai ton patera mou egnwkeite an kai ap arti ginwskete auton kai ewrakate auton
draft_translation: If you had known me, you should have known my Father also: and from now on you know him, and have seen him.
ukjv_translation: If all of you had known me, all of you should have known my Father also: and from henceforth all of you know him, and have seen him.
review_notes: modernized from-henceforth idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: λεγει αυτω φιλιππος κυριε δειξον ημιν τον πατερα και αρκει ημιν
transliteration: legei autw filippov kurie deixon hmin ton patera kai arkei hmin
draft_translation: Philip says to him, Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.
ukjv_translation: Philip says unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it satisfies us.

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους τοσουτον χρονον μεθ υμων ειμι και ουκ εγνωκας με φιλιππε ο εωρακως εμε εωρακεν τον πατερα και πως συ λεγεις δειξον ημιν τον πατερα
transliteration: legei autw o ihsouv tosouton cronon mey umwn eimi kai ouk egnwkav me filippe o ewrakwv eme ewraken ton patera kai pwv su legeiv deixon hmin ton patera
draft_translation: Jesus says to him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? The one who has seen me has seen the Father; and how do you say then, Show us the Father?
ukjv_translation: Jesus says unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? he that has seen me has seen the Father; and how says you then, Show us the Father?

greek_text: ου πιστευεις οτι εγω εν τω πατρι και ο πατηρ εν εμοι εστιν τα ρηματα α εγω λαλω υμιν απ εμαυτου ου λαλω ο δε πατηρ ο εν εμοι μενων αυτος ποιει τα εργα
transliteration: ou pisteueiv oti egw en tw patri kai o pathr en emoi estin ta rhmata a egw lalw umin ap emautou ou lalw o de pathr o en emoi menwn autov poiei ta erga
draft_translation: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak to you I do not speak of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works.
ukjv_translation: Believe you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the (o. rhema) words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works.

greek_text: πιστευετε μοι οτι εγω εν τω πατρι και ο πατηρ εν εμοι ει δε μη δια τα εργα αυτα πιστευετε μοι
transliteration: pisteuete moi oti egw en tw patri kai o pathr en emoi ei de mh dia ta erga auta pisteuete moi
draft_translation: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
ukjv_translation: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ο πιστευων εις εμε τα εργα α εγω ποιω κακεινος ποιησει και μειζονα τουτων ποιησει οτι εγω προς τον πατερα μου πορευομαι
transliteration: amhn amhn legw umin o pisteuwn eiv eme ta erga a egw poiw kakeinov poihsei kai meizona toutwn poihsei oti egw prov ton patera mou poreuomai
draft_translation: Amen, amen, I say to you, the one who believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go to my Father.
ukjv_translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized he-that relative; modernized verily; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: και ο τι αν αιτησητε εν τω ονοματι μου τουτο ποιησω ινα δοξασθη ο πατηρ εν τω υιω
transliteration: kai o ti an aithshte en tw onomati mou touto poihsw ina doxasyh o pathr en tw uiw
draft_translation: And whatever you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
ukjv_translation: And whatsoever all of you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εαν τι αιτησητε εν τω ονοματι μου εγω ποιησω
transliteration: ean ti aithshte en tw onomati mou egw poihsw
draft_translation: If you shall ask anything in my name, I will do it.
ukjv_translation: If all of you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εαν αγαπατε με τας εντολας τας εμας τηρησατε
transliteration: ean agapate me tav entolav tav emav thrhsate
draft_translation: If you love me, keep my commandments.
ukjv_translation: If all of you love me, keep my commandments.

greek_text: και εγω ερωτησω τον πατερα και αλλον παρακλητον δωσει υμιν ινα μενη μεθ υμων εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: kai egw erwthsw ton patera kai allon paraklhton dwsei umin ina menh mey umwn eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you forever;
ukjv_translation: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

greek_text: το πνευμα της αληθειας ο ο κοσμος ου δυναται λαβειν οτι ου θεωρει αυτο ουδε γινωσκει αυτο υμεις δε γινωσκετε αυτο οτι παρ υμιν μενει και εν υμιν εσται
transliteration: to pneuma thv alhyeiav o o kosmov ou dunatai labein oti ou yewrei auto oude ginwskei auto umeiv de ginwskete auto oti par umin menei kai en umin estai
draft_translation: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see him, neither knows him: but you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you.
ukjv_translation: Even the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but all of you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you.

greek_text: ουκ αφησω υμας ορφανους ερχομαι προς υμας
transliteration: ouk afhsw umav orfanouv ercomai prov umav
draft_translation: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
ukjv_translation: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ετι μικρον και ο κοσμος με ουκ ετι θεωρει υμεις δε θεωρειτε με οτι εγω ζω και υμεις ζησεσθε
transliteration: eti mikron kai o kosmov me ouk eti yewrei umeiv de yewreite me oti egw zw kai umeiv zhsesye
draft_translation: Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but you see me: because I live, you shall live also.
ukjv_translation: Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but all of you see me: because I live, all of you shall live also.

greek_text: εν εκεινη τη ημερα γνωσεσθε υμεις οτι εγω εν τω πατρι μου και υμεις εν εμοι καγω εν υμιν
transliteration: en ekeinh th hmera gnwsesye umeiv oti egw en tw patri mou kai umeiv en emoi kagw en umin
draft_translation: At that day you shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
ukjv_translation: At that day all of you shall know that I am in my Father, and all of you in me, and I in you.

greek_text: ο εχων τας εντολας μου και τηρων αυτας εκεινος εστιν ο αγαπων με ο δε αγαπων με αγαπηθησεται υπο του πατρος μου και εγω αγαπησω αυτον και εμφανισω αυτω εμαυτον
transliteration: o ecwn tav entolav mou kai thrwn autav ekeinov estin o agapwn me o de agapwn me agaphyhsetai upo tou patrov mou kai egw agaphsw auton kai emfanisw autw emauton
draft_translation: The one who has my commandments, and keeps them, he is the one who loves me: and the one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
ukjv_translation: He that has my commandments, and keeps them, he it is that loves me: and he that loves me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ιουδας ουχ ο ισκαριωτης κυριε τι γεγονεν οτι ημιν μελλεις εμφανιζειν σεαυτον και ουχι τω κοσμω
transliteration: legei autw ioudav ouc o iskariwthv kurie ti gegonen oti hmin melleiv emfanizein seauton kai ouci tw kosmw
draft_translation: Judas says to him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?
ukjv_translation: Judas says unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself unto us, and not unto the world?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτω εαν τις αγαπα με τον λογον μου τηρησει και ο πατηρ μου αγαπησει αυτον και προς αυτον ελευσομεθα και μονην παρ αυτω ποιησομεν
transliteration: apekriyh o ihsouv kai eipen autw ean tiv agapa me ton logon mou thrhsei kai o pathr mou agaphsei auton kai prov auton eleusomeya kai monhn par autw poihsomen
draft_translation: Jesus answered and said to him, If a man loves me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our dwelling with him.
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: (o. logos) and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

greek_text: ο μη αγαπων με τους λογους μου ου τηρει και ο λογος ον ακουετε ουκ εστιν εμος αλλα του πεμψαντος με πατρος
transliteration: o mh agapwn me touv logouv mou ou threi kai o logov on akouete ouk estin emov alla tou pemqantov me patrov
draft_translation: The one who does not love me does not keep my sayings: and the word which you hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.
ukjv_translation: He that loves me not keeps not my sayings: (o. logos) and the word (o. logos) which all of you hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

greek_text: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν παρ υμιν μενων
transliteration: tauta lelalhka umin par umin menwn
draft_translation: These things have I spoken to you, being yet present with you.
ukjv_translation: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

greek_text: ο δε παρακλητος το πνευμα το αγιον ο πεμψει ο πατηρ εν τω ονοματι μου εκεινος υμας διδαξει παντα και υπομνησει υμας παντα α ειπον υμιν
transliteration: o de paraklhtov to pneuma to agion o pemqei o pathr en tw onomati mou ekeinov umav didaxei panta kai upomnhsei umav panta a eipon umin
draft_translation: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatever I have said to you.
ukjv_translation: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

greek_text: ειρηνην αφιημι υμιν ειρηνην την εμην διδωμι υμιν ου καθως ο κοσμος διδωσιν εγω διδωμι υμιν μη ταρασσεσθω υμων η καρδια μηδε δειλιατω
transliteration: eirhnhn afihmi umin eirhnhn thn emhn didwmi umin ou kaywv o kosmov didwsin egw didwmi umin mh tarassesyw umwn h kardia mhde deiliatw
draft_translation: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give to you: not as the world gives, do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
ukjv_translation: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

greek_text: ηκουσατε οτι εγω ειπον υμιν υπαγω και ερχομαι προς υμας ει ηγαπατε με εχαρητε αν οτι ειπον πορευομαι προς τον πατερα οτι ο πατηρ μου μειζων μου εστιν
transliteration: hkousate oti egw eipon umin upagw kai ercomai prov umav ei hgapate me ecarhte an oti eipon poreuomai prov ton patera oti o pathr mou meizwn mou estin
draft_translation: You have heard how I said to you, I go away, and come again to you. If you loved me, you would rejoice, because I said, I go to the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
ukjv_translation: All of you have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If all of you loved me, all of you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και νυν ειρηκα υμιν πριν γενεσθαι ινα οταν γενηται πιστευσητε
transliteration: kai nun eirhka umin prin genesyai ina otan genhtai pisteushte
draft_translation: And now I have told you before it happens, that, when it has happened, you might believe.
ukjv_translation: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it has come to pass, all of you might believe.

greek_text: ουκ ετι πολλα λαλησω μεθ υμων ερχεται γαρ ο του κοσμου τουτου αρχων και εν εμοι ουκ εχει ουδεν
transliteration: ouk eti polla lalhsw mey umwn ercetai gar o tou kosmou toutou arcwn kai en emoi ouk ecei ouden
draft_translation: No longer will I talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me.
ukjv_translation: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me.

greek_text: αλλ ινα γνω ο κοσμος οτι αγαπω τον πατερα και καθως ενετειλατο μοι ο πατηρ ουτως ποιω εγειρεσθε αγωμεν εντευθεν
transliteration: all ina gnw o kosmov oti agapw ton patera kai kaywv eneteilato moi o pathr outwv poiw egeiresye agwmen enteuyen
draft_translation: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
ukjv_translation: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go behind.

greek_text: εγω ειμι η αμπελος η αληθινη και ο πατηρ μου ο γεωργος εστιν
transliteration: egw eimi h ampelov h alhyinh kai o pathr mou o gewrgov estin
draft_translation: I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser.
ukjv_translation: I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

greek_text: παν κλημα εν εμοι μη φερον καρπον αιρει αυτο και παν το καρπον φερον καθαιρει αυτο ινα πλειονα καρπον φερη
transliteration: pan klhma en emoi mh feron karpon airei auto kai pan to karpon feron kayairei auto ina pleiona karpon ferh
draft_translation: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he prunes it, that it may bear more fruit.
ukjv_translation: Every branch in me that bears not fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he purges it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

greek_text: ηδη υμεις καθαροι εστε δια τον λογον ον λελαληκα υμιν
transliteration: hdh umeiv kayaroi este dia ton logon on lelalhka umin
draft_translation: Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken to you.
ukjv_translation: Now all of you are clean through the word (o. logos) which I have spoken unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μεινατε εν εμοι καγω εν υμιν καθως το κλημα ου δυναται καρπον φερειν αφ εαυτου εαν μη μεινη εν τη αμπελω ουτως ουδε υμεις εαν μη εν εμοι μεινητε
transliteration: meinate en emoi kagw en umin kaywv to klhma ou dunatai karpon ferein af eautou ean mh meinh en th ampelw outwv oude umeiv ean mh en emoi meinhte
draft_translation: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can you, except you abide in me.
ukjv_translation: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can all of you, except all of you abide in me.

greek_text: εγω ειμι η αμπελος υμεις τα κληματα ο μενων εν εμοι καγω εν αυτω ουτος φερει καρπον πολυν οτι χωρις εμου ου δυνασθε ποιειν ουδεν
transliteration: egw eimi h ampelov umeiv ta klhmata o menwn en emoi kagw en autw outov ferei karpon polun oti cwriv emou ou dunasye poiein ouden
draft_translation: I am the vine, you are the branches: the one who abides in me, and I in him, the same produces much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.
ukjv_translation: I am the vine, all of you are the branches: He that abides in me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit: for without me all of you can do nothing.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered general brings-forth as produces

greek_text: εαν μη τις μεινη εν εμοι εβληθη εξω ως το κλημα και εξηρανθη και συναγουσιν αυτα και εις πυρ βαλλουσιν και καιεται
transliteration: ean mh tiv meinh en emoi eblhyh exw wv to klhma kai exhranyh kai sunagousin auta kai eiv pur ballousin kai kaietai
draft_translation: If anyone does not abide in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
ukjv_translation: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

greek_text: εαν μεινητε εν εμοι και τα ρηματα μου εν υμιν μεινη ο εαν θελητε αιτησεσθε και γενησεται υμιν
transliteration: ean meinhte en emoi kai ta rhmata mou en umin meinh o ean yelhte aithsesye kai genhsetai umin
draft_translation: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done to you.
ukjv_translation: If all of you abide in me, and my words (o. rhema) abide in you, all of you shall ask what all of you will, and it shall be done unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εν τουτω εδοξασθη ο πατηρ μου ινα καρπον πολυν φερητε και γενησεσθε εμοι μαθηται
transliteration: en toutw edoxasyh o pathr mou ina karpon polun ferhte kai genhsesye emoi mayhtai
draft_translation: In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; so shall you be my disciples.
ukjv_translation: Herein is my Father glorified, that all of you bear much fruit; so shall all of you be my disciples.

greek_text: καθως ηγαπησεν με ο πατηρ καγω ηγαπησα υμας μεινατε εν τη αγαπη τη εμη
transliteration: kaywv hgaphsen me o pathr kagw hgaphsa umav meinate en th agaph th emh
draft_translation: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: abide in my love.
ukjv_translation: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue all of you in my love. (o. agape)

greek_text: εαν τας εντολας μου τηρησητε μενειτε εν τη αγαπη μου καθως εγω τας εντολας του πατρος μου τετηρηκα και μενω αυτου εν τη αγαπη
transliteration: ean tav entolav mou thrhshte meneite en th agaph mou kaywv egw tav entolav tou patrov mou tethrhka kai menw autou en th agaph
draft_translation: If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
ukjv_translation: If all of you keep my commandments, all of you shall abide in my love; (o. agape) even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love. (o. agape)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα η χαρα η εμη εν υμιν μεινη και η χαρα υμων πληρωθη
transliteration: tauta lelalhka umin ina h cara h emh en umin meinh kai h cara umwn plhrwyh
draft_translation: These things have I spoken to you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
ukjv_translation: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

greek_text: αυτη εστιν η εντολη η εμη ινα αγαπατε αλληλους καθως ηγαπησα υμας
transliteration: auth estin h entolh h emh ina agapate allhlouv kaywv hgaphsa umav
draft_translation: This is my commandment, That you love one another, as I have loved you.
ukjv_translation: This is my commandment, That all of you love one another, as I have loved you.

greek_text: μειζονα ταυτης αγαπην ουδεις εχει ινα τις την ψυχην αυτου θη υπερ των φιλων αυτου
transliteration: meizona tauthv agaphn oudeiv ecei ina tiv thn quchn autou yh uper twn filwn autou
draft_translation: Greater love has no one than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
ukjv_translation: Greater love (o. agape) has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: υμεις φιλοι μου εστε εαν ποιητε οσα εγω εντελλομαι υμιν
transliteration: umeiv filoi mou este ean poihte osa egw entellomai umin
draft_translation: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
ukjv_translation: All of you are my friends, if all of you do whatsoever I command you.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουκετι υμας λεγω δουλους οτι ο δουλος ουκ οιδεν τι ποιει αυτου ο κυριος υμας δε ειρηκα φιλους οτι παντα α ηκουσα παρα του πατρος μου εγνωρισα υμιν
transliteration: ouketi umav legw doulouv oti o doulov ouk oiden ti poiei autou o kuriov umav de eirhka filouv oti panta a hkousa para tou patrov mou egnwrisa umin
draft_translation: From now on I call you not slaves; for the slave does not know what his Lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known to you.
ukjv_translation: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized henceforth; modernized knows-not idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ουχ υμεις με εξελεξασθε αλλ εγω εξελεξαμην υμας και εθηκα υμας ινα υμεις υπαγητε και καρπον φερητε και ο καρπος υμων μενη ινα ο τι αν αιτησητε τον πατερα εν τω ονοματι μου δω υμιν
transliteration: ouc umeiv me exelexasye all egw exelexamhn umav kai eyhka umav ina umeiv upaghte kai karpon ferhte kai o karpov umwn menh ina o ti an aithshte ton patera en tw onomati mou dw umin
draft_translation: You have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatever you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
ukjv_translation: All of you have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that all of you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever all of you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

greek_text: ταυτα εντελλομαι υμιν ινα αγαπατε αλληλους
transliteration: tauta entellomai umin ina agapate allhlouv
draft_translation: These things I command you, that you love one another.
ukjv_translation: These things I command you, that all of you love one another.

greek_text: ει ο κοσμος υμας μισει γινωσκετε οτι εμε πρωτον υμων μεμισηκεν
transliteration: ei o kosmov umav misei ginwskete oti eme prwton umwn memishken
draft_translation: If the world hate you, you know that it hated me before it hated you.
ukjv_translation: If the world hate you, all of you know that it hated me before it hated you.

greek_text: ει εκ του κοσμου ητε ο κοσμος αν το ιδιον εφιλει οτι δε εκ του κοσμου ουκ εστε αλλ εγω εξελεξαμην υμας εκ του κοσμου δια τουτο μισει υμας ο κοσμος
transliteration: ei ek tou kosmou hte o kosmov an to idion efilei oti de ek tou kosmou ouk este all egw exelexamhn umav ek tou kosmou dia touto misei umav o kosmov
draft_translation: If you were of the world, the world would love its own: but because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
ukjv_translation: If all of you were of the world, the world would love his own: but because all of you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

greek_text: μνημονευετε του λογου ου εγω ειπον υμιν ουκ εστιν δουλος μειζων του κυριου αυτου ει εμε εδιωξαν και υμας διωξουσιν ει τον λογον μου ετηρησαν και τον υμετερον τηρησουσιν
transliteration: mnhmoneuete tou logou ou egw eipon umin ouk estin doulov meizwn tou kuriou autou ei eme ediwxan kai umav diwxousin ei ton logon mou ethrhsan kai ton umeteron thrhsousin
draft_translation: Remember the word that I said to you, The slave is not greater than his Lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
ukjv_translation: Remember the word (o. logos) that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, (o. logos) they will keep yours also.

greek_text: αλλα ταυτα παντα ποιησουσιν υμιν δια το ονομα μου οτι ουκ οιδασιν τον πεμψαντα με
transliteration: alla tauta panta poihsousin umin dia to onoma mou oti ouk oidasin ton pemqanta me
draft_translation: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they do not know him who sent me.
ukjv_translation: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; modernized know-not idiom

greek_text: ει μη ηλθον και ελαλησα αυτοις αμαρτιαν ουκ ειχον νυν δε προφασιν ουκ εχουσιν περι της αμαρτιας αυτων
transliteration: ei mh hlyon kai elalhsa autoiv amartian ouk eicon nun de profasin ouk ecousin peri thv amartiav autwn
draft_translation: If I had not come and spoken to them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
ukjv_translation: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.

greek_text: ο εμε μισων και τον πατερα μου μισει
transliteration: o eme miswn kai ton patera mou misei
draft_translation: The one who hates me hates my Father also.
ukjv_translation: He that hates me hates my Father also.

greek_text: ει τα εργα μη εποιησα εν αυτοις α ουδεις αλλος πεποιηκεν αμαρτιαν ουκ ειχον νυν δε και εωρακασιν και μεμισηκασιν και εμε και τον πατερα μου
transliteration: ei ta erga mh epoihsa en autoiv a oudeiv allov pepoihken amartian ouk eicon nun de kai ewrakasin kai memishkasin kai eme kai ton patera mou
draft_translation: If I had not done among them the works which no other man did, they had not had sin: but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.
ukjv_translation: If I had not done among them the works which no other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

greek_text: αλλ ινα πληρωθη ο λογος ο γεγραμμενος εν τω νομω αυτων οτι εμισησαν με δωρεαν
transliteration: all ina plhrwyh o logov o gegrammenov en tw nomw autwn oti emishsan me dwrean
draft_translation: But this comes to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
ukjv_translation: But this comes to pass, that the word (o. logos) might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οταν δε ελθη ο παρακλητος ον εγω πεμψω υμιν παρα του πατρος το πνευμα της αληθειας ο παρα του πατρος εκπορευεται εκεινος μαρτυρησει περι εμου
transliteration: otan de elyh o paraklhtov on egw pemqw umin para tou patrov to pneuma thv alhyeiav o para tou patrov ekporeuetai ekeinov marturhsei peri emou
draft_translation: But when the Comforter has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me:
ukjv_translation: But when the Comforter has come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και υμεις δε μαρτυρειτε οτι απ αρχης μετ εμου εστε
transliteration: kai umeiv de martureite oti ap archv met emou este
draft_translation: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with me from the beginning.
ukjv_translation: And all of you also shall bear witness, because all of you have been with me from the beginning.

greek_text: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα μη σκανδαλισθητε
transliteration: tauta lelalhka umin ina mh skandalisyhte
draft_translation: These things have I spoken to you, that you should not be stumbled.
ukjv_translation: These things have I spoken unto you, that all of you should not be offended.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: αποσυναγωγους ποιησουσιν υμας αλλ ερχεται ωρα ινα πας ο αποκτεινας υμας δοξη λατρειαν προσφερειν τω θεω
transliteration: aposunagwgouv poihsousin umav all ercetai wra ina pav o apokteinav umav doxh latreian prosferein tw yew
draft_translation: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yes, the time comes, that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
ukjv_translation: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does God service.

greek_text: και ταυτα ποιησουσιν υμιν οτι ουκ εγνωσαν τον πατερα ουδε εμε
transliteration: kai tauta poihsousin umin oti ouk egnwsan ton patera oude eme
draft_translation: And these things will they do to you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
ukjv_translation: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

greek_text: αλλα ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα οταν ελθη η ωρα μνημονευητε αυτων οτι εγω ειπον υμιν ταυτα δε υμιν εξ αρχης ουκ ειπον οτι μεθ υμων ημην
transliteration: alla tauta lelalhka umin ina otan elyh h wra mnhmoneuhte autwn oti egw eipon umin tauta de umin ex archv ouk eipon oti mey umwn hmhn
draft_translation: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not to you at the beginning, because I was with you.
ukjv_translation: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, all of you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: νυν δε υπαγω προς τον πεμψαντα με και ουδεις εξ υμων ερωτα με που υπαγεις
transliteration: nun de upagw prov ton pemqanta me kai oudeiv ex umwn erwta me pou upageiv
draft_translation: But now I go my way to him who sent me; and none of you asks me, Where are you going?
ukjv_translation: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asks me, Where go you?

greek_text: αλλ οτι ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν η λυπη πεπληρωκεν υμων την καρδιαν
transliteration: all oti tauta lelalhka umin h luph peplhrwken umwn thn kardian
draft_translation: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
ukjv_translation: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled your heart.

greek_text: αλλ εγω την αληθειαν λεγω υμιν συμφερει υμιν ινα εγω απελθω εαν γαρ μη απελθω ο παρακλητος ουκ ελευσεται προς υμας εαν δε πορευθω πεμψω αυτον προς υμας
transliteration: all egw thn alhyeian legw umin sumferei umin ina egw apelyw ean gar mh apelyw o paraklhtov ouk eleusetai prov umav ean de poreuyw pemqw auton prov umav
draft_translation: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I depart, I will send him to you.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized go-not idiom

greek_text: και ελθων εκεινος ελεγξει τον κοσμον περι αμαρτιας και περι δικαιοσυνης και περι κρισεως
transliteration: kai elywn ekeinov elegxei ton kosmon peri amartiav kai peri dikaiosunhv kai peri krisewv
draft_translation: And when he has come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
ukjv_translation: And when he has come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: περι αμαρτιας μεν οτι ου πιστευουσιν εις εμε
transliteration: peri amartiav men oti ou pisteuousin eiv eme
draft_translation: Of sin, because they do not believe on me;
ukjv_translation: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

greek_text: περι δικαιοσυνης δε οτι προς τον πατερα μου υπαγω και ουκ ετι θεωρειτε με
transliteration: peri dikaiosunhv de oti prov ton patera mou upagw kai ouk eti yewreite me
draft_translation: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and you see me no more;
ukjv_translation: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and all of you see me no more;

greek_text: περι δε κρισεως οτι ο αρχων του κοσμου τουτου κεκριται
transliteration: peri de krisewv oti o arcwn tou kosmou toutou kekritai
draft_translation: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
ukjv_translation: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ετι πολλα εχω λεγειν υμιν αλλ ου δυνασθε βασταζειν αρτι
transliteration: eti polla ecw legein umin all ou dunasye bastazein arti
draft_translation: I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
ukjv_translation: I have yet many things to say unto you, but all of you cannot bear them now.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οταν δε ελθη εκεινος το πνευμα της αληθειας οδηγησει υμας εις πασαν την αληθειαν ου γαρ λαλησει αφ εαυτου αλλ οσα αν ακουση λαλησει και τα ερχομενα αναγγελει υμιν
transliteration: otan de elyh ekeinov to pneuma thv alhyeiav odhghsei umav eiv pasan thn alhyeian ou gar lalhsei af eautou all osa an akoush lalhsei kai ta ercomena anaggelei umin
draft_translation: Nevertheless when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will show you things to come.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless when he, the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will show you things to come.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εκεινος εμε δοξασει οτι εκ του εμου ληψεται και αναγγελει υμιν
transliteration: ekeinov eme doxasei oti ek tou emou lhqetai kai anaggelei umin
draft_translation: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall show it to you.
ukjv_translation: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall show it unto you.

greek_text: παντα οσα εχει ο πατηρ εμα εστιν δια τουτο ειπον οτι εκ του εμου ληψεται και αναγγελει υμιν
transliteration: panta osa ecei o pathr ema estin dia touto eipon oti ek tou emou lhqetai kai anaggelei umin
draft_translation: All things that the Father has are mine: therefore I said, that he shall take of mine, and shall show it to you.
ukjv_translation: All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall show it unto you.

greek_text: μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με οτι εγω υπαγω προς τον πατερα
transliteration: mikron kai ou yewreite me kai palin mikron kai oqesye me oti egw upagw prov ton patera
draft_translation: A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me, because I go to the Father.
ukjv_translation: A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me, because I go to the Father.

greek_text: ειπον ουν εκ των μαθητων αυτου προς αλληλους τι εστιν τουτο ο λεγει ημιν μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με και οτι εγω υπαγω προς τον πατερα
transliteration: eipon oun ek twn mayhtwn autou prov allhlouv ti estin touto o legei hmin mikron kai ou yewreite me kai palin mikron kai oqesye me kai oti egw upagw prov ton patera
draft_translation: Then some of his disciples said among themselves, What is this that he says to us, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
ukjv_translation: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he says unto us, A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

greek_text: ελεγον ουν τουτο τι εστιν ο λεγει το μικρον ουκ οιδαμεν τι λαλει
transliteration: elegon oun touto ti estin o legei to mikron ouk oidamen ti lalei
draft_translation: They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.
ukjv_translation: They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εγνω ουν ο ιησους οτι ηθελον αυτον ερωταν και ειπεν αυτοις περι τουτου ζητειτε μετ αλληλων οτι ειπον μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με
transliteration: egnw oun o ihsouv oti hyelon auton erwtan kai eipen autoiv peri toutou zhteite met allhlwn oti eipon mikron kai ou yewreite me kai palin mikron kai oqesye me
draft_translation: Now Jesus knew that they desired to ask him, and said to them, Do you inquire among yourselves concerning what I said, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me?
ukjv_translation: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do all of you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me?

greek_text: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι κλαυσετε και θρηνησετε υμεις ο δε κοσμος χαρησεται υμεις δε λυπηθησεσθε αλλ η λυπη υμων εις χαραν γενησεται
transliteration: amhn amhn legw umin oti klausete kai yrhnhsete umeiv o de kosmov carhsetai umeiv de luphyhsesye all h luph umwn eiv caran genhsetai
draft_translation: Amen, amen, I say to you, That you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
ukjv_translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That all of you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and all of you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered amen formula directly

greek_text: η γυνη οταν τικτη λυπην εχει οτι ηλθεν η ωρα αυτης οταν δε γεννηση το παιδιον ουκ ετι μνημονευει της θλιψεως δια την χαραν οτι εγεννηθη ανθρωπος εις τον κοσμον
transliteration: h gunh otan tikth luphn ecei oti hlyen h wra authv otan de gennhsh to paidion ouk eti mnhmoneuei thv yliqewv dia thn caran oti egennhyh anyrwpov eiv ton kosmon
draft_translation: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour has come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembers no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
ukjv_translation: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour has come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembers no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και υμεις ουν λυπην μεν νυν εχετε παλιν δε οψομαι υμας και χαρησεται υμων η καρδια και την χαραν υμων ουδεις αιρει αφ υμων
transliteration: kai umeiv oun luphn men nun ecete palin de oqomai umav kai carhsetai umwn h kardia kai thn caran umwn oudeiv airei af umwn
draft_translation: And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one takes from you.
ukjv_translation: And all of you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εν εκεινη τη ημερα εμε ουκ ερωτησετε ουδεν αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι οσα αν αιτησητε τον πατερα εν τω ονοματι μου δωσει υμιν
transliteration: kai en ekeinh th hmera eme ouk erwthsete ouden amhn amhn legw umin oti osa an aithshte ton patera en tw onomati mou dwsei umin
draft_translation: And in that day you shall ask me nothing. Amen, amen, I say to you, Whatever you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

greek_text: ταυτα εν παροιμιαις λελαληκα υμιν ερχεται ωρα οτε ουκ ετι εν παροιμιαις λαλησω υμιν αλλα παρρησια περι του πατρος αναγγελω υμιν

ukjv_translation: At that day all of you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

greek_text: αυτος γαρ ο πατηρ φιλει υμας οτι υμεις εμε πεφιληκατε και πεπιστευκατε οτι εγω παρα του θεου εξηλθον

greek_text: εξηλθον παρα του πατρος και εληλυθα εις τον κοσμον παλιν αφιημι τον κοσμον και πορευομαι προς τον πατερα

greek_text: νυν οιδαμεν οτι οιδας παντα και ου χρειαν εχεις ινα τις σε ερωτα εν τουτω πιστευομεν οτι απο θεου εξηλθες

greek_text: ιδου ερχεται ωρα και νυν εληλυθεν ινα σκορπισθητε εκαστος εις τα ιδια και εμε μονον αφητε και ουκ ειμι μονος οτι ο πατηρ μετ εμου εστιν
transliteration: idou ercetai wra kai nun elhluyen ina skorpisyhte ekastov eiv ta idia kai eme monon afhte kai ouk eimi monov oti o pathr met emou estin
draft_translation: Look, the hour comes, yes, has now come, that you shall be scattered, each to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
ukjv_translation: Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that all of you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

greek_text: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα εν εμοι ειρηνην εχητε εν τω κοσμω θλιψιν εξετε αλλα θαρσειτε εγω νενικηκα τον κοσμον

greek_text: ταυτα ελαλησεν ο ιησους και επηρεν τους οφθαλμους αυτου εις τον ουρανον και ειπεν πατερ εληλυθεν η ωρα δοξασον σου τον υιον ινα και ο υιος σου δοξαση σε

ukjv_translation: These words spoke Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you:

greek_text: καθως εδωκας αυτω εξουσιαν πασης σαρκος ινα παν ο δεδωκας αυτω δωση αυτοις ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: kaywv edwkav autw exousian pashv sarkov ina pan o dedwkav autw dwsh autoiv zwhn aiwnion

transliteration: auth de estin h aiwniov zwh ina ginwskwsin se ton monon alhyinon yeon kai on apesteilav ihsoun criston
draft_translation: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
ukjv_translation: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.

greek_text: εγω σε εδοξασα επι της γης το εργον ετελειωσα ο δεδωκας μοι ινα ποιησω

greek_text: εφανερωσα σου το ονομα τοις ανθρωποις ους δεδωκας μοι εκ του κοσμου σοι ησαν και εμοι αυτους δεδωκας και τον λογον σου τετηρηκασιν

draft_translation: I have manifested your name to the people whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me; and they have kept your word.

draft_translation: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are of you.
ukjv_translation: Now they have known that all things whatsoever you have given me are of you.

greek_text: οτι τα ρηματα α δεδωκας μοι δεδωκα αυτοις και αυτοι ελαβον και εγνωσαν αληθως οτι παρα σου εξηλθον και επιστευσαν οτι συ με απεστειλας
transliteration: oti ta rhmata a dedwkav moi dedwka autoiv kai autoi elabon kai egnwsan alhywv oti para sou exhlyon kai episteusan oti su me apesteilav
draft_translation: For I have given to them the words which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known truly that I came out from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
ukjv_translation: For I have given unto them the words (o. rhema) which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me.

greek_text: εγω περι αυτων ερωτω ου περι του κοσμου ερωτω αλλα περι ων δεδωκας μοι οτι σοι εισιν

draft_translation: I pray for them: I do not pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me; for they are yours.
ukjv_translation: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours.

greek_text: και τα εμα παντα σα εστιν και τα σα εμα και δεδοξασμαι εν αυτοις
transliteration: kai ta ema panta sa estin kai ta sa ema kai dedoxasmai en autoiv
draft_translation: And all mine are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them.
ukjv_translation: And all mine are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them.

greek_text: και ουκ ετι ειμι εν τω κοσμω και ουτοι εν τω κοσμω εισιν και εγω προς σε ερχομαι πατερ αγιε τηρησον αυτους εν τω ονοματι σου ους δεδωκας μοι ινα ωσιν εν καθως ημεις
transliteration: kai ouk eti eimi en tw kosmw kai outoi en tw kosmw eisin kai egw prov se ercomai pater agie thrhson autouv en tw onomati sou ouv dedwkav moi ina wsin en kaywv hmeiv
draft_translation: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name, those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.
ukjv_translation: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through yours own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.

greek_text: οτε ημην μετ αυτων εν τω κοσμω εγω ετηρουν αυτους εν τω ονοματι σου ους δεδωκας μοι εφυλαξα και ουδεις εξ αυτων απωλετο ει μη ο υιος της απωλειας ινα η γραφη πληρωθη
transliteration: ote hmhn met autwn en tw kosmw egw ethroun autouv en tw onomati sou ouv dedwkav moi efulaxa kai oudeiv ex autwn apwleto ei mh o uiov thv apwleiav ina h grafh plhrwyh
draft_translation: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of destruction; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
ukjv_translation: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

greek_text: νυν δε προς σε ερχομαι και ταυτα λαλω εν τω κοσμω ινα εχωσιν την χαραν την εμην πεπληρωμενην εν αυτοις
transliteration: nun de prov se ercomai kai tauta lalw en tw kosmw ina ecwsin thn caran thn emhn peplhrwmenhn en autoiv
draft_translation: And now I come to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
ukjv_translation: And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

greek_text: εγω δεδωκα αυτοις τον λογον σου και ο κοσμος εμισησεν αυτους οτι ουκ εισιν εκ του κοσμου καθως εγω ουκ ειμι εκ του κοσμου
transliteration: egw dedwka autoiv ton logon sou kai o kosmov emishsen autouv oti ouk eisin ek tou kosmou kaywv egw ouk eimi ek tou kosmou
draft_translation: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
ukjv_translation: I have given them your word; (o. logos) and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

draft_translation: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

ukjv_translation: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek all of you?

greek_text: απεκριθησαν αυτω ιησουν τον ναζωραιον λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους εγω ειμι ειστηκει δε και ιουδας ο παραδιδους αυτον μετ αυτων

transliteration: wv oun eipen autoiv oti egw eimi aphlyon eiv ta opisw kai epeson camai
draft_translation: As soon then as he had said to them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
ukjv_translation: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

greek_text: παλιν ουν αυτους επηρωτησεν τινα ζητειτε οι δε ειπον ιησουν τον ναζωραιον
transliteration: palin oun autouv ephrwthsen tina zhteite oi de eipon ihsoun ton nazwraion
draft_translation: Then he asked them again, Whom do you seek? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
ukjv_translation: Then asked he them again, Whom seek all of you? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

greek_text: απεκριθη ο ιησους ειπον υμιν οτι εγω ειμι ει ουν εμε ζητειτε αφετε τουτους υπαγειν
transliteration: apekriyh o ihsouv eipon umin oti egw eimi ei oun eme zhteite afete toutouv upagein
draft_translation: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore you seek me, let these go their way:
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore all of you seek me, let these go their way:

greek_text: ινα πληρωθη ο λογος ον ειπεν οτι ους δεδωκας μοι ουκ απωλεσα εξ αυτων ουδενα
transliteration: ina plhrwyh o logov on eipen oti ouv dedwkav moi ouk apwlesa ex autwn oudena
draft_translation: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of those whom you gave me I have lost none.
ukjv_translation: That the saying (o. logos) might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of them which you gave me have I lost none.

greek_text: σιμων ουν πετρος εχων μαχαιραν ειλκυσεν αυτην και επαισεν τον του αρχιερεως δουλον και απεκοψεν αυτου το ωτιον το δεξιον ην δε ονομα τω δουλω μαλχος
transliteration: simwn oun petrov ecwn macairan eilkusen authn kai epaisen ton tou arcierewv doulon kai apekoqen autou to wtion to dexion hn de onoma tw doulw malcov
draft_translation: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and stroke the high priest's slave, and cut off his right ear. The slave's name was Malchus.
ukjv_translation: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and stroke the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

greek_text: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους τω πετρω βαλε την μαχαιραν σου εις την θηκην το ποτηριον ο δεδωκεν μοι ο πατηρ ου μη πιω αυτο
transliteration: eipen oun o ihsouv tw petrw bale thn macairan sou eiv thn yhkhn to pothrion o dedwken moi o pathr ou mh piw auto
draft_translation: Then Jesus said to Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?
ukjv_translation: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?

greek_text: η ουν σπειρα και ο χιλιαρχος και οι υπηρεται των ιουδαιων συνελαβον τον ιησουν και εδησαν αυτον
transliteration: h oun speira kai o ciliarcov kai oi uphretai twn ioudaiwn sunelabon ton ihsoun kai edhsan auton
draft_translation: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
ukjv_translation: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και απηγαγον αυτον προς ανναν πρωτον ην γαρ πενθερος του καιαφα ος ην αρχιερευς του ενιαυτου εκεινου
transliteration: kai aphgagon auton prov annan prwton hn gar penyerov tou kaiafa ov hn arciereuv tou eniautou ekeinou
draft_translation: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was the high priest that same year.
ukjv_translation: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

greek_text: ην δε καιαφας ο συμβουλευσας τοις ιουδαιοις οτι συμφερει ενα ανθρωπον απολεσθαι υπερ του λαου
transliteration: hn de kaiafav o sumbouleusav toiv ioudaioiv oti sumferei ena anyrwpon apolesyai uper tou laou
draft_translation: Now Caiaphas was the one who gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
ukjv_translation: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

greek_text: ηκολουθει δε τω ιησου σιμων πετρος και αλλος μαθητης ο δε μαθητης εκεινος ην γνωστος τω αρχιερει και συνεισηλθεν τω ιησου εις την αυλην του αρχιερεως
transliteration: hkolouyei de tw ihsou simwn petrov kai allov mayhthv o de mayhthv ekeinov hn gnwstov tw arcierei kai suneishlyen tw ihsou eiv thn aulhn tou arcierewv
draft_translation: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known to the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
ukjv_translation: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

greek_text: ο δε πετρος ειστηκει προς τη θυρα εξω εξηλθεν ουν ο μαθητης ο αλλος ος ην γνωστος τω αρχιερει και ειπεν τη θυρωρω και εισηγαγεν τον πετρον
transliteration: o de petrov eisthkei prov th yura exw exhlyen oun o mayhthv o allov ov hn gnwstov tw arcierei kai eipen th yurwrw kai eishgagen ton petron
draft_translation: But Peter stood at the door outside. Then that other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out, and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
ukjv_translation: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spoke unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

greek_text: λεγει ουν η παιδισκη η θυρωρος τω πετρω μη και συ εκ των μαθητων ει του ανθρωπου τουτου λεγει εκεινος ουκ ειμι
transliteration: legei oun h paidiskh h yurwrov tw petrw mh kai su ek twn mayhtwn ei tou anyrwpou toutou legei ekeinov ouk eimi
draft_translation: Then says the girl that kept the door to Peter, Are not you also one of this man's disciples? He says, I am not.
ukjv_translation: Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Are not you also one of this man's disciples? He says, I am not.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized damsel

greek_text: ειστηκεισαν δε οι δουλοι και οι υπηρεται ανθρακιαν πεποιηκοτες οτι ψυχος ην και εθερμαινοντο ην δε μετ αυτων ο πετρος εστως και θερμαινομενος
transliteration: eisthkeisan de oi douloi kai oi uphretai anyrakian pepoihkotev oti qucov hn kai eyermainonto hn de met autwn o petrov estwv kai yermainomenov
draft_translation: And the slaves and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
ukjv_translation: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

greek_text: ο ουν αρχιερευς ηρωτησεν τον ιησουν περι των μαθητων αυτου και περι της διδαχης αυτου
transliteration: o oun arciereuv hrwthsen ton ihsoun peri twn mayhtwn autou kai peri thv didachv autou
draft_translation: The high priest then asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his doctrine.
ukjv_translation: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

greek_text: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους εγω παρρησια ελαλησα τω κοσμω εγω παντοτε εδιδαξα εν τη συναγωγη και εν τω ιερω οπου παντοτε οι ιουδαιοι συνερχονται και εν κρυπτω ελαλησα ουδεν
transliteration: apekriyh autw o ihsouv egw parrhsia elalhsa tw kosmw egw pantote edidaxa en th sunagwgh kai en tw ierw opou pantote oi ioudaioi sunercontai kai en kruptw elalhsa ouden
draft_translation: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I always taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews always come together; and in secret I said nothing.
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

greek_text: τι με επερωτας επερωτησον τους ακηκοοτας τι ελαλησα αυτοις ιδε ουτοι οιδασιν α ειπον εγω
transliteration: ti me eperwtav eperwthson touv akhkootav ti elalhsa autoiv ide outoi oidasin a eipon egw
draft_translation: Why do you ask me? ask those who heard me what I have said to them: look, they know what I said.
ukjv_translation: Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

greek_text: ταυτα δε αυτου ειποντος εις των υπηρετων παρεστηκως εδωκεν ραπισμα τω ιησου ειπων ουτως αποκρινη τω αρχιερει
transliteration: tauta de autou eipontov eiv twn uphretwn paresthkwv edwken rapisma tw ihsou eipwn outwv apokrinh tw arcierei
draft_translation: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers who stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Do you answer the high priest so?
ukjv_translation: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answer you the high priest so?

greek_text: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους ει κακως ελαλησα μαρτυρησον περι του κακου ει δε καλως τι με δερεις
transliteration: apekriyh autw o ihsouv ei kakwv elalhsa marturhson peri tou kakou ei de kalwv ti me dereiv
draft_translation: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why do you strike me?
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smite you me?

greek_text: απεστειλεν ουν αυτον ο αννας δεδεμενον προς καιαφαν τον αρχιερεα
transliteration: apesteilen oun auton o annav dedemenon prov kaiafan ton arcierea
draft_translation: Now Annas had sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
ukjv_translation: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

greek_text: ην δε σιμων πετρος εστως και θερμαινομενος ειπον ουν αυτω μη και συ εκ των μαθητων αυτου ει ηρνησατο εκεινος και ειπεν ουκ ειμι
transliteration: hn de simwn petrov estwv kai yermainomenov eipon oun autw mh kai su ek twn mayhtwn autou ei hrnhsato ekeinov kai eipen ouk eimi
draft_translation: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore to him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
ukjv_translation: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

greek_text: λεγει εις εκ των δουλων του αρχιερεως συγγενης ων ου απεκοψεν πετρος το ωτιον ουκ εγω σε ειδον εν τω κηπω μετ αυτου
transliteration: legei eiv ek twn doulwn tou arcierewv suggenhv wn ou apekoqen petrov to wtion ouk egw se eidon en tw khpw met autou
draft_translation: One of the slaves of the high priest, being his relative whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?
ukjv_translation: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?
review_notes: modernized kinsman; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: παλιν ουν ηρνησατο ο πετρος και ευθεως αλεκτωρ εφωνησεν
transliteration: palin oun hrnhsato o petrov kai euyewv alektwr efwnhsen
draft_translation: Peter then denied again: and immediately the rooster crowed.
ukjv_translation: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

greek_text: αγουσιν ουν τον ιησουν απο του καιαφα εις το πραιτωριον ην δε πρωια και αυτοι ουκ εισηλθον εις το πραιτωριον ινα μη μιανθωσιν αλλ ινα φαγωσιν το πασχα
transliteration: agousin oun ton ihsoun apo tou kaiafa eiv to praitwrion hn de prwia kai autoi ouk eishlyon eiv to praitwrion ina mh mianywsin all ina fagwsin to pasca
draft_translation: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the judgment hall: and it was early; and they themselves did not go into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the Passover.
ukjv_translation: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

greek_text: εξηλθεν ουν ο πιλατος προς αυτους και ειπεν τινα κατηγοριαν φερετε κατα του ανθρωπου τουτου
transliteration: exhlyen oun o pilatov prov autouv kai eipen tina kathgorian ferete kata tou anyrwpou toutou
draft_translation: Pilate then went out to them, and said, What accusation do you bring against this man?
ukjv_translation: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring all of you against this man?

greek_text: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω ει μη ην ουτος κακοποιος ουκ αν σοι παρεδωκαμεν αυτον
transliteration: apekriyhsan kai eipon autw ei mh hn outov kakopoiov ouk an soi paredwkamen auton
draft_translation: They answered and said to him, If he were not an evildoer, we would not have delivered him up to you.
ukjv_translation: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a villain, we would not have delivered him up unto you.

greek_text: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο πιλατος λαβετε αυτον υμεις και κατα τον νομον υμων κρινατε αυτον ειπον ουν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι ημιν ουκ εξεστιν αποκτειναι ουδενα
transliteration: eipen oun autoiv o pilatov labete auton umeiv kai kata ton nomon umwn krinate auton eipon oun autw oi ioudaioi hmin ouk exestin apokteinai oudena
draft_translation: Then said Pilate to them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said to him, It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death:
ukjv_translation: Then said Pilate unto them, Take all of you him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
review_notes: fixed take-you-him imperative; modernized any-man idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ινα ο λογος του ιησου πληρωθη ον ειπεν σημαινων ποιω θανατω ημελλεν αποθνησκειν
transliteration: ina o logov tou ihsou plhrwyh on eipen shmainwn poiw yanatw hmellen apoynhskein
draft_translation: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.
ukjv_translation: That the saying (o. logos) of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εισηλθεν ουν εις το πραιτωριον παλιν ο πιλατος και εφωνησεν τον ιησουν και ειπεν αυτω συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
transliteration: eishlyen oun eiv to praitwrion palin o pilatov kai efwnhsen ton ihsoun kai eipen autw su ei o basileuv twn ioudaiwn
draft_translation: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?
ukjv_translation: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Are you the King of the Jews?

greek_text: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους αφ εαυτου συ τουτο λεγεις η αλλοι σοι ειπον περι εμου
transliteration: apekriyh autw o ihsouv af eautou su touto legeiv h alloi soi eipon peri emou
draft_translation: Jesus answered him, Do you say this thing of yourself, or did others tell it to you of me?
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered him, Says you this thing of yourself, or did others tell it you of me?

greek_text: απεκριθη ο πιλατος μητι εγω ιουδαιος ειμι το εθνος το σον και οι αρχιερεις παρεδωκαν σε εμοι τι εποιησας
transliteration: apekriyh o pilatov mhti egw ioudaiov eimi to eynov to son kai oi arciereiv paredwkan se emoi ti epoihsav
draft_translation: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you to me: what have you done?
ukjv_translation: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Yours own nation and the chief priests have delivered you unto me: what have you done?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: απεκριθη ο ιησους η βασιλεια η εμη ουκ εστιν εκ του κοσμου τουτου ει εκ του κοσμου τουτου ην η βασιλεια η εμη οι υπηρεται αν οι εμοι ηγωνιζοντο ινα μη παραδοθω τοις ιουδαιοις νυν δε η βασιλεια η εμη ουκ εστιν εντευθεν
transliteration: apekriyh o ihsouv h basileia h emh ouk estin ek tou kosmou toutou ei ek tou kosmou toutou hn h basileia h emh oi uphretai an oi emoi hgwnizonto ina mh paradoyw toiv ioudaioiv nun de h basileia h emh ouk estin enteuyen
draft_translation: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now my kingdom is not from here.
ukjv_translation: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from behind.

greek_text: ειπεν ουν αυτω ο πιλατος ουκουν βασιλευς ει συ απεκριθη ο ιησους συ λεγεις οτι βασιλευς ειμι εγω εγω εις τουτο γεγεννημαι και εις τουτο εληλυθα εις τον κοσμον ινα μαρτυρησω τη αληθεια πας ο ων εκ της αληθειας ακουει μου της φωνης
transliteration: eipen oun autw o pilatov oukoun basileuv ei su apekriyh o ihsouv su legeiv oti basileuv eimi egw egw eiv touto gegennhmai kai eiv touto elhluya eiv ton kosmon ina marturhsw th alhyeia pav o wn ek thv alhyeiav akouei mou thv fwnhv
draft_translation: Pilate therefore said to him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. To this end I was born, and for this cause I came into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Everyone that is of the truth hears my voice.
ukjv_translation: Pilate therefore said unto him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You says that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.

greek_text: λεγει αυτω ο πιλατος τι εστιν αληθεια και τουτο ειπων παλιν εξηλθεν προς τους ιουδαιους και λεγει αυτοις εγω ουδεμιαν αιτιαν ευρισκω εν αυτω
transliteration: legei autw o pilatov ti estin alhyeia kai touto eipwn palin exhlyen prov touv ioudaiouv kai legei autoiv egw oudemian aitian euriskw en autw
draft_translation: Pilate says to him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and says to them, I find in him no fault at all.
ukjv_translation: Pilate says unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and says unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

greek_text: εστιν δε συνηθεια υμιν ινα ενα υμιν απολυσω εν τω πασχα βουλεσθε ουν υμιν απολυσω τον βασιλεα των ιουδαιων
transliteration: estin de sunhyeia umin ina ena umin apolusw en tw pasca boulesye oun umin apolusw ton basilea twn ioudaiwn
draft_translation: But you have a custom, that I should release to you one at the Passover: do you therefore want me to release to you the King of the Jews?
ukjv_translation: But all of you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will all of you therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
review_notes: capitalized Passover; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized will-you-that idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εκραυγασαν ουν παλιν παντες λεγοντες μη τουτον αλλα τον βαραββαν ην δε ο βαραββας ληστης
transliteration: ekraugasan oun palin pantev legontev mh touton alla ton barabban hn de o barabbav lhsthv
draft_translation: Then they all cried again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
ukjv_translation: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

greek_text: τοτε ουν ελαβεν ο πιλατος τον ιησουν και εμαστιγωσεν
transliteration: tote oun elaben o pilatov ton ihsoun kai emastigwsen
draft_translation: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
ukjv_translation: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και οι στρατιωται πλεξαντες στεφανον εξ ακανθων επεθηκαν αυτου τη κεφαλη και ιματιον πορφυρουν περιεβαλον αυτον
transliteration: kai oi stratiwtai plexantev stefanon ex akanywn epeyhkan autou th kefalh kai imation porfuroun periebalon auton
draft_translation: And the soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
ukjv_translation: And the soldiers intertwined a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

greek_text: και ελεγον χαιρε ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων και εδιδουν αυτω ραπισματα
transliteration: kai elegon caire o basileuv twn ioudaiwn kai edidoun autw rapismata
draft_translation: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they struck him with their hands.
ukjv_translation: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they stroke him with their hands.

greek_text: εξηλθεν ουν παλιν εξω ο πιλατος και λεγει αυτοις ιδε αγω υμιν αυτον εξω ινα γνωτε οτι εν αυτω ουδεμιαν αιτιαν ευρισκω
transliteration: exhlyen oun palin exw o pilatov kai legei autoiv ide agw umin auton exw ina gnwte oti en autw oudemian aitian euriskw
draft_translation: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says to them, Look, I bring him forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in him.
ukjv_translation: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that all of you may know that I find no fault in him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εξηλθεν ουν ο ιησους εξω φορων τον ακανθινον στεφανον και το πορφυρουν ιματιον και λεγει αυτοις ιδε ο ανθρωπος
transliteration: exhlyen oun o ihsouv exw forwn ton akanyinon stefanon kai to porfuroun imation kai legei autoiv ide o anyrwpov
draft_translation: Then Jesus came forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says to them, Look, the man!
ukjv_translation: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man!

ukjv_translation: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

draft_translation: And beholding the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
ukjv_translation: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

ukjv_translation: By stretching forth yours hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of your holy child Jesus.
