draft_translation: For he supposed his brothers would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they did not understand.
ukjv_translation: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

greek_text: τη δε επιουση ημερα ωφθη αυτοις μαχομενοις και συνηλασεν αυτους εις ειρηνην ειπων ανδρες αδελφοι εστε υμεις ινα τι αδικειτε αλληλους
transliteration: th de epioush hmera wfyh autoiv macomenoiv kai sunhlasen autouv eiv eirhnhn eipwn andrev adelfoi este umeiv ina ti adikeite allhlouv
draft_translation: And the next day he showed himself to them as they strove, and tried to reconcile them, saying, Men, you are brothers; why do you wrong one another?
ukjv_translation: And the next day he showed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them to reconcile again, saying, Sirs, all of you are brethren; why do all of you wrong one to another?

greek_text: ο δε αδικων τον πλησιον απωσατο αυτον ειπων τις σε κατεστησεν αρχοντα και δικαστην εφ ημας
transliteration: o de adikwn ton plhsion apwsato auton eipwn tiv se katesthsen arconta kai dikasthn ef hmav
draft_translation: But the one who did his neighbor wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
ukjv_translation: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized neighbour spelling

greek_text: μη ανελειν με συ θελεις ον τροπον ανειλες χθες τον αιγυπτιον
transliteration: mh anelein me su yeleiv on tropon aneilev cyev ton aiguption
draft_translation: Will you kill me, as you did the Egyptian yesterday?
ukjv_translation: Will you kill me, as you did the Egyptian yesterday?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εφυγεν δε μωσης εν τω λογω τουτω και εγενετο παροικος εν γη μαδιαμ ου εγεννησεν υιους δυο
transliteration: efugen de mwshv en tw logw toutw kai egeneto paroikov en gh madiam ou egennhsen uiouv duo
draft_translation: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Midian, where he fathered two sons.
ukjv_translation: Then fled Moses at this saying, (o. logos) and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he brings forth two sons.
review_notes: aligned gennao with fathered; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered general brings-forth as produces; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: και πληρωθεντων ετων τεσσαρακοντα ωφθη αυτω εν τη ερημω του ορους σινα αγγελος κυριου εν φλογι πυρος βατου
transliteration: kai plhrwyentwn etwn tessarakonta wfyh autw en th erhmw tou orouv sina aggelov kuriou en flogi purov batou
draft_translation: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
ukjv_translation: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

greek_text: ο δε μωσης ιδων εθαυμασεν το οραμα προσερχομενου δε αυτου κατανοησαι εγενετο φωνη κυριου προς αυτον
transliteration: o de mwshv idwn eyaumasen to orama prosercomenou de autou katanohsai egeneto fwnh kuriou prov auton
draft_translation: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to look it, the voice of the Lord came to him,
ukjv_translation: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the LORD came unto him,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: εγω ο θεος των πατερων σου ο θεος αβρααμ και ο θεος ισαακ και ο θεος ιακωβ εντρομος δε γενομενος μωσης ουκ ετολμα κατανοησαι
transliteration: egw o yeov twn paterwn sou o yeov abraam kai o yeov isaak kai o yeov iakwb entromov de genomenov mwshv ouk etolma katanohsai
draft_translation: Saying, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and dared not look.
ukjv_translation: Saying, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

greek_text: ειπεν δε αυτω ο κυριος λυσον το υποδημα των ποδων σου ο γαρ τοπος εν ω εστηκας γη αγια εστιν
transliteration: eipen de autw o kuriov luson to upodhma twn podwn sou o gar topov en w esthkav gh agia estin
draft_translation: Then said the Lord to him, Put off your shoes from your feet: for the place where you stand is holy ground.
ukjv_translation: Then said the Lord to him, Put off your shoes from your feet: for the place where you stand is holy ground.

greek_text: ιδων ειδον την κακωσιν του λαου μου του εν αιγυπτω και του στεναγμου αυτων ηκουσα και κατεβην εξελεσθαι αυτους και νυν δευρο αποστελω σε εις αιγυπτον
transliteration: idwn eidon thn kakwsin tou laou mou tou en aiguptw kai tou stenagmou autwn hkousa kai katebhn exelesyai autouv kai nun deuro apostelw se eiv aigupton
draft_translation: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and have come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you into Egypt.
ukjv_translation: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you into Egypt.

greek_text: τουτον τον μωυσην ον ηρνησαντο ειποντες τις σε κατεστησεν αρχοντα και δικαστην τουτον ο θεος αρχοντα και λυτρωτην απεστειλεν εν χειρι αγγελου του οφθεντος αυτω εν τη βατω
transliteration: touton ton mwushn on hrnhsanto eipontev tiv se katesthsen arconta kai dikasthn touton o yeov arconta kai lutrwthn apesteilen en ceiri aggelou tou ofyentov autw en th batw
draft_translation: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? this one God sent to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
ukjv_translation: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

greek_text: ουτος εξηγαγεν αυτους ποιησας τερατα και σημεια εν γη αιγυπτου και εν ερυθρα θαλασση και εν τη ερημω ετη τεσσαρακοντα
transliteration: outov exhgagen autouv poihsav terata kai shmeia en gh aiguptou kai en eruyra yalassh kai en th erhmw eth tessarakonta
draft_translation: He brought them out, after he had worked wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
ukjv_translation: He brought them out, after that he had showed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

greek_text: ουτος εστιν ο μωυσης ο ειπων τοις υιοις ισραηλ προφητην υμιν αναστησει κυριος ο θεος υμων εκ των αδελφων υμων ως εμε αυτου ακουσεσθε
transliteration: outov estin o mwushv o eipwn toiv uioiv israhl profhthn umin anasthsei kuriov o yeov umwn ek twn adelfwn umwn wv eme autou akousesye
draft_translation: This is that Moses, which said to the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up to you of your brothers, like to me; him shall you hear.
ukjv_translation: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall all of you hear.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ουτος εστιν ο γενομενος εν τη εκκλησια εν τη ερημω μετα του αγγελου του λαλουντος αυτω εν τω ορει σινα και των πατερων ημων ος εδεξατο λογια ζωντα δουναι ημιν
transliteration: outov estin o genomenov en th ekklhsia en th erhmw meta tou aggelou tou lalountov autw en tw orei sina kai twn paterwn hmwn ov edexato logia zwnta dounai hmin
draft_translation: This is he, that was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give to us:
ukjv_translation: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spoke to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ω ουκ ηθελησαν υπηκοοι γενεσθαι οι πατερες ημων αλλ απωσαντο και εστραφησαν ταις καρδιαις αυτων εις αιγυπτον
transliteration: w ouk hyelhsan uphkooi genesyai oi paterev hmwn all apwsanto kai estrafhsan taiv kardiaiv autwn eiv aigupton
draft_translation: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
ukjv_translation: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειποντες τω ααρων ποιησον ημιν θεους οι προπορευσονται ημων ο γαρ μωσης ουτος ος εξηγαγεν ημας εκ γης αιγυπτου ουκ οιδαμεν τι γεγονεν αυτω
transliteration: eipontev tw aarwn poihson hmin yeouv oi proporeusontai hmwn o gar mwshv outov ov exhgagen hmav ek ghv aiguptou ouk oidamen ti gegonen autw
draft_translation: Saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.
ukjv_translation: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

greek_text: και εμοσχοποιησαν εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις και ανηγαγον θυσιαν τω ειδωλω και ευφραινοντο εν τοις εργοις των χειρων αυτων
transliteration: kai emoscopoihsan en taiv hmeraiv ekeinaiv kai anhgagon yusian tw eidwlw kai eufrainonto en toiv ergoiv twn ceirwn autwn
draft_translation: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
ukjv_translation: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

greek_text: εστρεψεν δε ο θεος και παρεδωκεν αυτους λατρευειν τη στρατια του ουρανου καθως γεγραπται εν βιβλω των προφητων μη σφαγια και θυσιας προσηνεγκατε μοι ετη τεσσαρακοντα εν τη ερημω οικος ισραηλ
transliteration: estreqen de o yeov kai paredwken autouv latreuein th stratia tou ouranou kaywv gegraptai en biblw twn profhtwn mh sfagia kai yusiav proshnegkate moi eth tessarakonta en th erhmw oikov israhl
draft_translation: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O you house of Israel, did you offer to me slain beasts and sacrifices for forty years in the wilderness?
ukjv_translation: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O all of you house of Israel, have all of you offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

greek_text: και ανελαβετε την σκηνην του μολοχ και το αστρον του θεου υμων ρεμφαν τους τυπους ους εποιησατε προσκυνειν αυτοις και μετοικιω υμας επεκεινα βαβυλωνος
transliteration: kai anelabete thn skhnhn tou moloc kai to astron tou yeou umwn remfan touv tupouv ouv epoihsate proskunein autoiv kai metoikiw umav epekeina babulwnov
draft_translation: Yes, you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which you made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
ukjv_translation: Yea, all of you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which all of you made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
review_notes: modernized yea; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: η σκηνη του μαρτυριου ην τοις πατρασιν ημων εν τη ερημω καθως διεταξατο ο λαλων τω μωση ποιησαι αυτην κατα τον τυπον ον εωρακει
transliteration: h skhnh tou marturiou hn toiv patrasin hmwn en th erhmw kaywv dietaxato o lalwn tw mwsh poihsai authn kata ton tupon on ewrakei
draft_translation: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking to Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
ukjv_translation: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

greek_text: ην και εισηγαγον διαδεξαμενοι οι πατερες ημων μετα ιησου εν τη κατασχεσει των εθνων ων εξωσεν ο θεος απο προσωπου των πατερων ημων εως των ημερων δαβιδ
transliteration: hn kai eishgagon diadexamenoi oi paterev hmwn meta ihsou en th katascesei twn eynwn wn exwsen o yeov apo proswpou twn paterwn hmwn ewv twn hmerwn dabid
draft_translation: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David;
ukjv_translation: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: ος ευρεν χαριν ενωπιον του θεου και ητησατο ευρειν σκηνωμα τω θεω ιακωβ
transliteration: ov euren carin enwpion tou yeou kai hthsato eurein skhnwma tw yew iakwb
draft_translation: Who found favor before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
ukjv_translation: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

greek_text: σολομων δε ωκοδομησεν αυτω οικον
transliteration: solomwn de wkodomhsen autw oikon
draft_translation: But Solomon built him a house.
ukjv_translation: But Solomon built him an house.

greek_text: αλλ ουχ ο υψιστος εν χειροποιητοις ναοις κατοικει καθως ο προφητης λεγει
transliteration: all ouc o uqistov en ceiropoihtoiv naoiv katoikei kaywv o profhthv legei
draft_translation: Nevertheless the Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands; as says the prophet,
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless the most High dwells not in temples made with hands; as says the prophet,

greek_text: ο ουρανος μοι θρονος η δε γη υποποδιον των ποδων μου ποιον οικον οικοδομησετε μοι λεγει κυριος η τις τοπος της καταπαυσεως μου
transliteration: o ouranov moi yronov h de gh upopodion twn podwn mou poion oikon oikodomhsete moi legei kuriov h tiv topov thv katapausewv mou
draft_translation: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will you build me? says the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
ukjv_translation: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will all of you build me? says the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουχι η χειρ μου εποιησεν ταυτα παντα
transliteration: ouci h ceir mou epoihsen tauta panta
draft_translation: Has not my hand made all these things?
ukjv_translation: Has not my hand made all these things?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: σκληροτραχηλοι και απεριτμητοι τη καρδια και τοις ωσιν υμεις αει τω πνευματι τω αγιω αντιπιπτετε ως οι πατερες υμων και υμεις
transliteration: sklhrotrachloi kai aperitmhtoi th kardia kai toiv wsin umeiv aei tw pneumati tw agiw antipiptete wv oi paterev umwn kai umeiv
draft_translation: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit: as your fathers did, so do you.
ukjv_translation: All of you stubborn and uncircumcised in heart and ears, all of you do always resist the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) as your fathers did, so do all of you.

greek_text: τινα των προφητων ουκ εδιωξαν οι πατερες υμων και απεκτειναν τους προκαταγγειλαντας περι της ελευσεως του δικαιου ου νυν υμεις προδοται και φονεις γεγενησθε
transliteration: tina twn profhtwn ouk ediwxan oi paterev umwn kai apekteinan touv prokataggeilantav peri thv eleusewv tou dikaiou ou nun umeiv prodotai kai foneiv gegenhsye
draft_translation: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have killed those who showed before of the coming of the Righteous One; of whom you have now been the betrayers and murderers:
ukjv_translation: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which showed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom all of you have been now the betrayers and murderers:

greek_text: οιτινες ελαβετε τον νομον εις διαταγας αγγελων και ουκ εφυλαξατε
transliteration: oitinev elabete ton nomon eiv diatagav aggelwn kai ouk efulaxate
draft_translation: Who have received the law by the ordinances of angels, and have not kept it.
ukjv_translation: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

greek_text: ακουοντες δε ταυτα διεπριοντο ταις καρδιαις αυτων και εβρυχον τους οδοντας επ αυτον
transliteration: akouontev de tauta dieprionto taiv kardiaiv autwn kai ebrucon touv odontav ep auton
draft_translation: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
ukjv_translation: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

greek_text: υπαρχων δε πληρης πνευματος αγιου ατενισας εις τον ουρανον ειδεν δοξαν θεου και ιησουν εστωτα εκ δεξιων του θεου
transliteration: uparcwn de plhrhv pneumatov agiou atenisav eiv ton ouranon eiden doxan yeou kai ihsoun estwta ek dexiwn tou yeou
draft_translation: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God,
ukjv_translation: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

greek_text: και ειπεν ιδου θεωρω τους ουρανους ανεωγμενους και τον υιον του ανθρωπου εκ δεξιων εστωτα του θεου
transliteration: kai eipen idou yewrw touv ouranouv anewgmenouv kai ton uion tou anyrwpou ek dexiwn estwta tou yeou
draft_translation: And said, Look, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing at the right hand of God.
ukjv_translation: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

greek_text: κραξαντες δε φωνη μεγαλη συνεσχον τα ωτα αυτων και ωρμησαν ομοθυμαδον επ αυτον
transliteration: kraxantev de fwnh megalh sunescon ta wta autwn kai wrmhsan omoyumadon ep auton
draft_translation: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
ukjv_translation: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και εκβαλοντες εξω της πολεως ελιθοβολουν και οι μαρτυρες απεθεντο τα ιματια αυτων παρα τους ποδας νεανιου καλουμενου σαυλου
transliteration: kai ekbalontev exw thv polewv eliyoboloun kai oi marturev apeyento ta imatia autwn para touv podav neaniou kaloumenou saulou
draft_translation: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
ukjv_translation: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ελιθοβολουν τον στεφανον επικαλουμενον και λεγοντα κυριε ιησου δεξαι το πνευμα μου
transliteration: kai eliyoboloun ton stefanon epikaloumenon kai legonta kurie ihsou dexai to pneuma mou
draft_translation: And they stoned Stephen, invoking and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
ukjv_translation: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: θεις δε τα γονατα εκραξεν φωνη μεγαλη κυριε μη στησης αυτοις την αμαρτιαν ταυτην και τουτο ειπων εκοιμηθη
transliteration: yeiv de ta gonata ekraxen fwnh megalh kurie mh sthshv autoiv thn amartian tauthn kai touto eipwn ekoimhyh
draft_translation: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, do not lay this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
ukjv_translation: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

greek_text: σαυλος δε ην συνευδοκων τη αναιρεσει αυτου εγενετο δε εν εκεινη τη ημερα διωγμος μεγας επι την εκκλησιαν την εν ιεροσολυμοις παντες τε διεσπαρησαν κατα τας χωρας της ιουδαιας και σαμαρειας πλην των αποστολων
transliteration: saulov de hn suneudokwn th anairesei autou egeneto de en ekeinh th hmera diwgmov megav epi thn ekklhsian thn en ierosolumoiv pantev te diesparhsan kata tav cwrav thv ioudaiav kai samareiav plhn twn apostolwn
draft_translation: And Saul was consenting to his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the assembly which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
ukjv_translation: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
review_notes: modernized abroad idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: συνεκομισαν δε τον στεφανον ανδρες ευλαβεις και εποιησαντο κοπετον μεγαν επ αυτω
transliteration: sunekomisan de ton stefanon andrev eulabeiv kai epoihsanto kopeton megan ep autw
draft_translation: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
ukjv_translation: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: σαυλος δε ελυμαινετο την εκκλησιαν κατα τους οικους εισπορευομενος συρων τε ανδρας και γυναικας παρεδιδου εις φυλακην
transliteration: saulov de elumaineto thn ekklhsian kata touv oikouv eisporeuomenov surwn te andrav kai gunaikav paredidou eiv fulakhn
draft_translation: As for Saul, he made havoc of the assembly, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
ukjv_translation: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

greek_text: οι μεν ουν διασπαρεντες διηλθον ευαγγελιζομενοι τον λογον
transliteration: oi men oun diasparentev dihlyon euaggelizomenoi ton logon
draft_translation: Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.
ukjv_translation: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word. (o. logos)
review_notes: modernized abroad idiom; modernized every where spelling; modernized they-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: φιλιππος δε κατελθων εις πολιν της σαμαρειας εκηρυσσεν αυτοις τον χριστον
transliteration: filippov de katelywn eiv polin thv samareiav ekhrussen autoiv ton criston

ukjv_translation: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

transliteration: oi de apeiyountev ioudaioi ephgeiran kai ekakwsan tav qucav twn eynwn kata twn adelfwn
draft_translation: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the nations, and made their minds evil affected against the brothers.
ukjv_translation: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
review_notes: rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: ικανον μεν ουν χρονον διετριψαν παρρησιαζομενοι επι τω κυριω τω μαρτυρουντι τω λογω της χαριτος αυτου και διδοντι σημεια και τερατα γινεσθαι δια των χειρων αυτων
transliteration: ikanon men oun cronon dietriqan parrhsiazomenoi epi tw kuriw tw marturounti tw logw thv caritov autou kai didonti shmeia kai terata ginesyai dia twn ceirwn autwn
draft_translation: Long time therefore remained they speaking boldly in the Lord, who gave testimony to the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
ukjv_translation: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word (o. logos) of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
review_notes: modernized abode; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εσχισθη δε το πληθος της πολεως και οι μεν ησαν συν τοις ιουδαιοις οι δε συν τοις αποστολοις
transliteration: escisyh de to plhyov thv polewv kai oi men hsan sun toiv ioudaioiv oi de sun toiv apostoloiv
draft_translation: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
ukjv_translation: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ως δε εγενετο ορμη των εθνων τε και ιουδαιων συν τοις αρχουσιν αυτων υβρισαι και λιθοβολησαι αυτους
transliteration: wv de egeneto ormh twn eynwn te kai ioudaiwn sun toiv arcousin autwn ubrisai kai liyobolhsai autouv
draft_translation: And when there was an assault made both of the nations, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
ukjv_translation: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

greek_text: συνιδοντες κατεφυγον εις τας πολεις της λυκαονιας λυστραν και δερβην και την περιχωρον
transliteration: sunidontev katefugon eiv tav poleiv thv lukaoniav lustran kai derbhn kai thn pericwron
draft_translation: They perceived it, and fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding region:
ukjv_translation: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lies round about:

greek_text: κακει ησαν ευαγγελιζομενοι
transliteration: kakei hsan euaggelizomenoi
draft_translation: And there they preached the good news.
ukjv_translation: And there they preached the gospel.

greek_text: και τις ανηρ εν λυστροις αδυνατος τοις ποσιν εκαθητο χωλος εκ κοιλιας μητρος αυτου υπαρχων ος ουδεποτε περιεπεπατηκει
transliteration: kai tiv anhr en lustroiv adunatov toiv posin ekayhto cwlov ek koiliav mhtrov autou uparcwn ov oudepote periepepathkei
draft_translation: And a certain man at Lystra sat powerless in his feet, being lame from his mother's womb, who had never walked:
ukjv_translation: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

greek_text: ουτος ηκουεν του παυλου λαλουντος ος ατενισας αυτω και ιδων οτι πιστιν εχει του σωθηναι
transliteration: outov hkouen tou paulou lalountov ov atenisav autw kai idwn oti pistin ecei tou swyhnai
draft_translation: This man heard Paul speaking: who, looking intently at him, and perceiving that he had faith to be made well,
ukjv_translation: The same heard Paul speak: who steadfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

greek_text: ειπεν μεγαλη τη φωνη αναστηθι επι τους ποδας σου ορθος και ηλλετο και περιεπατει
transliteration: eipen megalh th fwnh anasthyi epi touv podav sou oryov kai hlleto kai periepatei
draft_translation: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped and walked.
ukjv_translation: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped and walked.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: οι δε οχλοι ιδοντες ο εποιησεν ο παυλος επηραν την φωνην αυτων λυκαονιστι λεγοντες οι θεοι ομοιωθεντες ανθρωποις κατεβησαν προς ημας
transliteration: oi de ocloi idontev o epoihsen o paulov ephran thn fwnhn autwn lukaonisti legontev oi yeoi omoiwyentev anyrwpoiv katebhsan prov hmav
draft_translation: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men.
ukjv_translation: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

greek_text: εκαλουν τε τον μεν βαρναβαν δια τον δε παυλον ερμην επειδη αυτος ην ο ηγουμενος του λογου
transliteration: ekaloun te ton men barnaban dia ton de paulon ermhn epeidh autov hn o hgoumenov tou logou
draft_translation: And they called Barnabas, Zeus; and Paul, Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
ukjv_translation: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker. (o. logos)

greek_text: ο δε ιερευς του διος του οντος προ της πολεως αυτων ταυρους και στεμματα επι τους πυλωνας ενεγκας συν τοις οχλοις ηθελεν θυειν
transliteration: o de iereuv tou diov tou ontov pro thv polewv autwn taurouv kai stemmata epi touv pulwnav enegkav sun toiv ocloiv hyelen yuein
draft_translation: Then the priest of Zeus, whose temple was before their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and wished to sacrifice with the crowds.
ukjv_translation: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

greek_text: ακουσαντες δε οι αποστολοι βαρναβας και παυλος διαρρηξαντες τα ιματια αυτων εισεπηδησαν εις τον οχλον κραζοντες
transliteration: akousantev de oi apostoloi barnabav kai paulov diarrhxantev ta imatia autwn eisephdhsan eiv ton oclon krazontev
draft_translation: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard, they tore their clothes, and rushed into the crowd, crying out,
ukjv_translation: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

greek_text: και λεγοντες ανδρες τι ταυτα ποιειτε και ημεις ομοιοπαθεις εσμεν υμιν ανθρωποι ευαγγελιζομενοι υμας απο τουτων των ματαιων επιστρεφειν επι τον θεον τον ζωντα ος εποιησεν τον ουρανον και την γην και την θαλασσαν και παντα τα εν αυτοις
transliteration: kai legontev andrev ti tauta poieite kai hmeiv omoiopayeiv esmen umin anyrwpoi euaggelizomenoi umav apo toutwn twn mataiwn epistrefein epi ton yeon ton zwnta ov epoihsen ton ouranon kai thn ghn kai thn yalassan kai panta ta en autoiv
draft_translation: And saying, Men, why are you doing these things? We also are humans of like nature with you, preaching good news to you, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are in them:
ukjv_translation: And saying, Sirs, why do all of you these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that all of you should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

greek_text: ος εν ταις παρωχημεναις γενεαις ειασεν παντα τα εθνη πορευεσθαι ταις οδοις αυτων
transliteration: ov en taiv parwchmenaiv geneaiv eiasen panta ta eynh poreuesyai taiv odoiv autwn
draft_translation: Who in past generations allowed all nations to walk in their own ways.
ukjv_translation: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

greek_text: καιτοιγε ουκ αμαρτυρον εαυτον αφηκεν αγαθοποιων ουρανοθεν ημιν υετους διδους και καιρους καρποφορους εμπιπλων τροφης και ευφροσυνης τας καρδιας ημων
transliteration: kaitoige ouk amarturon eauton afhken agayopoiwn ouranoyen hmin uetouv didouv kai kairouv karpoforouv empiplwn trofhv kai eufrosunhv tav kardiav hmwn
draft_translation: Nevertheless he did not leave himself without witness, doing good, giving us rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

greek_text: και ταυτα λεγοντες μολις κατεπαυσαν τους οχλους του μη θυειν αυτοις
transliteration: kai tauta legontev moliv katepausan touv oclouv tou mh yuein autoiv
draft_translation: And with these sayings they barely restrained the crowds from sacrificing to them.
ukjv_translation: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

greek_text: επηλθον δε απο αντιοχειας και ικονιου ιουδαιοι και πεισαντες τους οχλους και λιθασαντες τον παυλον εσυρον εξω της πολεως νομισαντες αυτον τεθναναι
transliteration: ephlyon de apo antioceiav kai ikoniou ioudaioi kai peisantev touv oclouv kai liyasantev ton paulon esuron exw thv polewv nomisantev auton teynanai
draft_translation: And certain Jews came there from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the crowds, and having stoned Paul, dragged him out of the city, supposing him to be dead.
ukjv_translation: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

greek_text: κυκλωσαντων δε αυτον των μαθητων αναστας εισηλθεν εις την πολιν και τη επαυριον εξηλθεν συν τω βαρναβα εις δερβην
transliteration: kuklwsantwn de auton twn mayhtwn anastav eishlyen eiv thn polin kai th epaurion exhlyen sun tw barnaba eiv derbhn
draft_translation: Nevertheless, as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

greek_text: ευαγγελισαμενοι τε την πολιν εκεινην και μαθητευσαντες ικανους υπεστρεψαν εις την λυστραν και ικονιον και αντιοχειαν
transliteration: euaggelisamenoi te thn polin ekeinhn kai mayhteusantev ikanouv upestreqan eiv thn lustran kai ikonion kai antioceian
draft_translation: And when they had preached the good news to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
ukjv_translation: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

greek_text: επιστηριζοντες τας ψυχας των μαθητων παρακαλουντες εμμενειν τη πιστει και οτι δια πολλων θλιψεων δει ημας εισελθειν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
transliteration: episthrizontev tav qucav twn mayhtwn parakalountev emmenein th pistei kai oti dia pollwn yliqewn dei hmav eiselyein eiv thn basileian tou yeou
draft_translation: Strengthening the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

greek_text: χειροτονησαντες δε αυτοις πρεσβυτερους κατ εκκλησιαν προσευξαμενοι μετα νηστειων παρεθεντο αυτους τω κυριω εις ον πεπιστευκεισαν
transliteration: ceirotonhsantev de autoiv presbuterouv kat ekklhsian proseuxamenoi meta nhsteiwn pareyento autouv tw kuriw eiv on pepisteukeisan
draft_translation: And when they had ordained them elders in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
ukjv_translation: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και διελθοντες την πισιδιαν ηλθον εις παμφυλιαν
transliteration: kai dielyontev thn pisidian hlyon eiv pamfulian
draft_translation: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
ukjv_translation: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και λαλησαντες εν περγη τον λογον κατεβησαν εις ατταλειαν
transliteration: kai lalhsantev en pergh ton logon katebhsan eiv attaleian
draft_translation: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia:
ukjv_translation: And when they had preached the word (o. logos) in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

greek_text: κακειθεν απεπλευσαν εις αντιοχειαν οθεν ησαν παραδεδομενοι τη χαριτι του θεου εις το εργον ο επληρωσαν
transliteration: kakeiyen apepleusan eiv antioceian oyen hsan paradedomenoi th cariti tou yeou eiv to ergon o eplhrwsan
draft_translation: And from there sailed to Antioch, from where they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
ukjv_translation: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
review_notes: fixed from-whence artifact; modernized thence; modernized whence

greek_text: παραγενομενοι δε και συναγαγοντες την εκκλησιαν ανηγγειλαν οσα εποιησεν ο θεος μετ αυτων και οτι ηνοιξεν τοις εθνεσιν θυραν πιστεως
transliteration: paragenomenoi de kai sunagagontev thn ekklhsian anhggeilan osa epoihsen o yeov met autwn kai oti hnoixen toiv eynesin yuran pistewv
draft_translation: And when they had come, and had gathered the assembly together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith to the nations.
ukjv_translation: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized were-come perfect; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: διετριβον δε εκει χρονον ουκ ολιγον συν τοις μαθηταις
transliteration: dietribon de ekei cronon ouk oligon sun toiv mayhtaiv
draft_translation: And there they remained no little time with the disciples.
ukjv_translation: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

greek_text: και τινες κατελθοντες απο της ιουδαιας εδιδασκον τους αδελφους οτι εαν μη περιτεμνησθε τω εθει μωυσεως ου δυνασθε σωθηναι
transliteration: kai tinev katelyontev apo thv ioudaiav edidaskon touv adelfouv oti ean mh peritemnhsye tw eyei mwusewv ou dunasye swyhnai
draft_translation: And certain men who came down from Judea taught the brothers, and said, Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.
ukjv_translation: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except all of you be circumcised after the manner of Moses, all of you cannot be saved.

greek_text: γενομενης ουν στασεως και συζητησεως ουκ ολιγης τω παυλω και τω βαρναβα προς αυτους εταξαν αναβαινειν παυλον και βαρναβαν και τινας αλλους εξ αυτων προς τους αποστολους και πρεσβυτερους εις ιερουσαλημ περι του ζητηματος τουτου
transliteration: genomenhv oun stasewv kai suzhthsewv ouk olighv tw paulw kai tw barnaba prov autouv etaxan anabainein paulon kai barnaban kai tinav allouv ex autwn prov touv apostolouv kai presbuterouv eiv ierousalhm peri tou zhthmatov toutou
draft_translation: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and debate with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and certain others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
ukjv_translation: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

greek_text: οι μεν ουν προπεμφθεντες υπο της εκκλησιας διηρχοντο την φοινικην και σαμαρειαν εκδιηγουμενοι την επιστροφην των εθνων και εποιουν χαραν μεγαλην πασιν τοις αδελφοις
transliteration: oi men oun propemfyentev upo thv ekklhsiav dihrconto thn foinikhn kai samareian ekdihgoumenoi thn epistrofhn twn eynwn kai epoioun caran megalhn pasin toiv adelfoiv
draft_translation: And being brought on their way by the assembly, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the nations: and they caused great joy to all the brothers.
ukjv_translation: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: παραγενομενοι δε εις ιερουσαλημ απεδεχθησαν υπο της εκκλησιας και των αποστολων και των πρεσβυτερων ανηγγειλαν τε οσα ο θεος εποιησεν μετ αυτων
transliteration: paragenomenoi de eiv ierousalhm apedecyhsan upo thv ekklhsiav kai twn apostolwn kai twn presbuterwn anhggeilan te osa o yeov epoihsen met autwn
draft_translation: And when they had come to Jerusalem, they were received of the assembly, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
ukjv_translation: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
review_notes: modernized were-come perfect; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: εξανεστησαν δε τινες των απο της αιρεσεως των φαρισαιων πεπιστευκοτες λεγοντες οτι δει περιτεμνειν αυτους παραγγελλειν τε τηρειν τον νομον μωυσεως
transliteration: exanesthsan de tinev twn apo thv airesewv twn farisaiwn pepisteukotev legontev oti dei peritemnein autouv paraggellein te threin ton nomon mwusewv
draft_translation: But certain of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying that it was necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
ukjv_translation: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

greek_text: συνηχθησαν δε οι αποστολοι και οι πρεσβυτεροι ιδειν περι του λογου τουτου
transliteration: sunhcyhsan de oi apostoloi kai oi presbuteroi idein peri tou logou toutou
draft_translation: And the apostles and elders came together to consider this matter.
ukjv_translation: And the apostles and elders came together in order to consider of this matter. (o. logos)

greek_text: πολλης δε συζητησεως γενομενης αναστας πετρος ειπεν προς αυτους ανδρες αδελφοι υμεις επιστασθε οτι αφ ημερων αρχαιων ο θεος εν ημιν εξελεξατο δια του στοματος μου ακουσαι τα εθνη τον λογον του ευαγγελιου και πιστευσαι
transliteration: pollhv de suzhthsewv genomenhv anastav petrov eipen prov autouv andrev adelfoi umeiv epistasye oti af hmerwn arcaiwn o yeov en hmin exelexato dia tou stomatov mou akousai ta eynh ton logon tou euaggeliou kai pisteusai
draft_translation: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said to them, Men and brothers, you know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the nations by my mouth should hear the word of the good news, and believe.
ukjv_translation: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, all of you know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word (o. logos) of the gospel, and believe.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ethne as nations; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και ο καρδιογνωστης θεος εμαρτυρησεν αυτοις δους αυτοις το πνευμα το αγιον καθως και ημιν
transliteration: kai o kardiognwsthv yeov emarturhsen autoiv douv autoiv to pneuma to agion kaywv kai hmin
draft_translation: And God, who knows the hearts, bore witness to them, giving them the Holy Spirit, even as he did to us;
ukjv_translation: And God, which knows the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) even as he did unto us;

greek_text: και ουδεν διεκρινεν μεταξυ ημων τε και αυτων τη πιστει καθαρισας τας καρδιας αυτων
transliteration: kai ouden diekrinen metaxu hmwn te kai autwn th pistei kayarisav tav kardiav autwn
draft_translation: And made no distinction between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
ukjv_translation: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

greek_text: νυν ουν τι πειραζετε τον θεον επιθειναι ζυγον επι τον τραχηλον των μαθητων ον ουτε οι πατερες ημων ουτε ημεις ισχυσαμεν βαστασαι
transliteration: nun oun ti peirazete ton yeon epiyeinai zugon epi ton trachlon twn mayhtwn on oute oi paterev hmwn oute hmeiv iscusamen bastasai
draft_translation: Now therefore why do you test God, by putting a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
ukjv_translation: Now therefore why tempt all of you God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

greek_text: αλλα δια της χαριτος κυριου ιησου χριστου πιστευομεν σωθηναι καθ ον τροπον κακεινοι
transliteration: alla dia thv caritov kuriou ihsou cristou pisteuomen swyhnai kay on tropon kakeinoi
draft_translation: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, in the same manner as they.
ukjv_translation: But we believe that through the grace of the LORD Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

greek_text: εσιγησεν δε παν το πληθος και ηκουον βαρναβα και παυλου εξηγουμενων οσα εποιησεν ο θεος σημεια και τερατα εν τοις εθνεσιν δι αυτων
transliteration: esighsen de pan to plhyov kai hkouon barnaba kai paulou exhgoumenwn osa epoihsen o yeov shmeia kai terata en toiv eynesin di autwn
draft_translation: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had worked among the nations by them.
ukjv_translation: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
review_notes: modernized wrought; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: μετα δε το σιγησαι αυτους απεκριθη ιακωβος λεγων ανδρες αδελφοι ακουσατε μου
transliteration: meta de to sighsai autouv apekriyh iakwbov legwn andrev adelfoi akousate mou
draft_translation: And after they were silent, James answered, saying, Men and brothers, Listen to me:
ukjv_translation: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
review_notes: fixed had-were artifact; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized hearken; modernized held-their-peace idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: συμεων εξηγησατο καθως πρωτον ο θεος επεσκεψατο λαβειν εξ εθνων λαον επι τω ονοματι αυτου
transliteration: sumewn exhghsato kaywv prwton o yeov epeskeqato labein ex eynwn laon epi tw onomati autou
draft_translation: Simeon has declared how God at the first did visit the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.
ukjv_translation: Simeon has declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

greek_text: και τουτω συμφωνουσιν οι λογοι των προφητων καθως γεγραπται
transliteration: kai toutw sumfwnousin oi logoi twn profhtwn kaywv gegraptai
draft_translation: And with this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
ukjv_translation: And to this agree the words (o. logos) of the prophets; as it is written,

greek_text: μετα ταυτα αναστρεψω και ανοικοδομησω την σκηνην δαβιδ την πεπτωκυιαν και τα κατεσκαμμενα αυτης ανοικοδομησω και ανορθωσω αυτην
transliteration: meta tauta anastreqw kai anoikodomhsw thn skhnhn dabid thn peptwkuian kai ta kateskammena authv anoikodomhsw kai anorywsw authn
draft_translation: After this I will return, and will build again the tent of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again its ruins, and I will set it upright:
ukjv_translation: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

greek_text: οπως αν εκζητησωσιν οι καταλοιποι των ανθρωπων τον κυριον και παντα τα εθνη εφ ους επικεκληται το ονομα μου επ αυτους λεγει κυριος ο ποιων ταυτα παντα
transliteration: opwv an ekzhthswsin oi kataloipoi twn anyrwpwn ton kurion kai panta ta eynh ef ouv epikeklhtai to onoma mou ep autouv legei kuriov o poiwn tauta panta
draft_translation: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the nations, upon whom my name is called, says the Lord, who does all these things.
ukjv_translation: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, says the Lord, who does all these things.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: γνωστα απ αιωνος εστιν τω θεω παντα τα εργα αυτου
transliteration: gnwsta ap aiwnov estin tw yew panta ta erga autou
draft_translation: Known to God from ancient times are all his works.
ukjv_translation: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

greek_text: διο εγω κρινω μη παρενοχλειν τοις απο των εθνων επιστρεφουσιν επι τον θεον
transliteration: dio egw krinw mh parenoclein toiv apo twn eynwn epistrefousin epi ton yeon
draft_translation: Therefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the nations are turned to God:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
review_notes: modernized wherefore; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: αλλα επιστειλαι αυτοις του απεχεσθαι απο των αλισγηματων των ειδωλων και της πορνειας και του πνικτου και του αιματος
transliteration: alla episteilai autoiv tou apecesyai apo twn alisghmatwn twn eidwlwn kai thv porneiav kai tou pniktou kai tou aimatov
draft_translation: But that we write to them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from sexual immorality, and from things strangled, and from blood.
ukjv_translation: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized porneia wording

greek_text: μωσης γαρ εκ γενεων αρχαιων κατα πολιν τους κηρυσσοντας αυτον εχει εν ταις συναγωγαις κατα παν σαββατον αναγινωσκομενος
transliteration: mwshv gar ek genewn arcaiwn kata polin touv khrussontav auton ecei en taiv sunagwgaiv kata pan sabbaton anaginwskomenov
draft_translation: For Moses of old time has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.
ukjv_translation: For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
review_notes: modernized Sabbath-day wording; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: τοτε εδοξεν τοις αποστολοις και τοις πρεσβυτεροις συν ολη τη εκκλησια εκλεξαμενους ανδρας εξ αυτων πεμψαι εις αντιοχειαν συν τω παυλω και βαρναβα ιουδαν τον επικαλουμενον βαρσαβαν και σιλαν ανδρας ηγουμενους εν τοις αδελφοις
transliteration: tote edoxen toiv apostoloiv kai toiv presbuteroiv sun olh th ekklhsia eklexamenouv andrav ex autwn pemqai eiv antioceian sun tw paulw kai barnaba ioudan ton epikaloumenon barsaban kai silan andrav hgoumenouv en toiv adelfoiv
draft_translation: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole assembly, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brothers:
ukjv_translation: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
review_notes: rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: γραψαντες δια χειρος αυτων ταδε οι αποστολοι και οι πρεσβυτεροι και οι αδελφοι τοις κατα την αντιοχειαν και συριαν και κιλικιαν αδελφοις τοις εξ εθνων χαιρειν
transliteration: graqantev dia ceirov autwn tade oi apostoloi kai oi presbuteroi kai oi adelfoi toiv kata thn antioceian kai surian kai kilikian adelfoiv toiv ex eynwn cairein
draft_translation: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brothers send greeting to the brothers who are of the nations in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.
ukjv_translation: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.
review_notes: fixed brothers casing; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: επειδη ηκουσαμεν οτι τινες εξ ημων εξελθοντες εταραξαν υμας λογοις ανασκευαζοντες τας ψυχας υμων λεγοντες περιτεμνεσθαι και τηρειν τον νομον οις ου διεστειλαμεθα
transliteration: epeidh hkousamen oti tinev ex hmwn exelyontev etaraxan umav logoiv anaskeuazontev tav qucav umwn legontev peritemnesyai kai threin ton nomon oiv ou diesteilameya
draft_translation: Since we have heard that certain ones who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, You must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
ukjv_translation: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, (o. logos) subverting your souls, saying, All of you must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

greek_text: εδοξεν ημιν γενομενοις ομοθυμαδον εκλεξαμενους ανδρας πεμψαι προς υμας συν τοις αγαπητοις ημων βαρναβα και παυλω
transliteration: edoxen hmin genomenoiv omoyumadon eklexamenouv andrav pemqai prov umav sun toiv agaphtoiv hmwn barnaba kai paulw
draft_translation: It seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
ukjv_translation: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

greek_text: ανθρωποις παραδεδωκοσιν τας ψυχας αυτων υπερ του ονοματος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: anyrwpoiv paradedwkosin tav qucav autwn uper tou onomatov tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

greek_text: απεσταλκαμεν ουν ιουδαν και σιλαν και αυτους δια λογου απαγγελλοντας τα αυτα
transliteration: apestalkamen oun ioudan kai silan kai autouv dia logou apaggellontav ta auta
draft_translation: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also report the same things by word of mouth.
ukjv_translation: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth. (o. logos)

greek_text: εδοξεν γαρ τω αγιω πνευματι και ημιν μηδεν πλεον επιτιθεσθαι υμιν βαρος πλην των επαναγκες τουτων
transliteration: edoxen gar tw agiw pneumati kai hmin mhden pleon epitiyesyai umin barov plhn twn epanagkev toutwn
draft_translation: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
ukjv_translation: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

greek_text: απεχεσθαι ειδωλοθυτων και αιματος και πνικτου και πορνειας εξ ων διατηρουντες εαυτους ευ πραξετε ερρωσθε
transliteration: apecesyai eidwloyutwn kai aimatov kai pniktou kai porneiav ex wn diathrountev eautouv eu praxete errwsye
draft_translation: That you abstain from foods offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from sexual immorality: from which if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.
ukjv_translation: That all of you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if all of you keep yourselves, all of you shall do well. Fare all of you well.
review_notes: modernized meats; modernized porneia wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οι μεν ουν απολυθεντες ηλθον εις αντιοχειαν και συναγαγοντες το πληθος επεδωκαν την επιστολην
transliteration: oi men oun apoluyentev hlyon eiv antioceian kai sunagagontev to plhyov epedwkan thn epistolhn
draft_translation: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter:
ukjv_translation: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

greek_text: αναγνοντες δε εχαρησαν επι τη παρακλησει
transliteration: anagnontev de ecarhsan epi th paraklhsei
draft_translation: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the encouragement.
ukjv_translation: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

greek_text: ιουδας δε και σιλας και αυτοι προφηται οντες δια λογου πολλου παρεκαλεσαν τους αδελφους και επεστηριξαν
transliteration: ioudav de kai silav kai autoi profhtai ontev dia logou pollou parekalesan touv adelfouv kai epesthrixan
draft_translation: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.
ukjv_translation: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, (o. logos) and confirmed them.

greek_text: ποιησαντες δε χρονον απελυθησαν μετ ειρηνης απο των αδελφων προς τους αποστολους
transliteration: poihsantev de cronon apeluyhsan met eirhnhv apo twn adelfwn prov touv apostolouv
draft_translation: And after they had spent some time there, they were let go in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
ukjv_translation: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

greek_text: εδοξεν δε τω σιλα επιμειναι αυτου
transliteration: edoxen de tw sila epimeinai autou
draft_translation: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: παυλος δε και βαρναβας διετριβον εν αντιοχεια διδασκοντες και ευαγγελιζομενοι μετα και ετερων πολλων τον λογον του κυριου
transliteration: paulov de kai barnabav dietribon en antioceia didaskontev kai euaggelizomenoi meta kai eterwn pollwn ton logon tou kuriou
draft_translation: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
ukjv_translation: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word (o. logos) of the Lord, with many others also.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μετα δε τινας ημερας ειπεν παυλος προς βαρναβαν επιστρεψαντες δη επισκεψωμεθα τους αδελφους ημων κατα πασαν πολιν εν αις κατηγγειλαμεν τον λογον του κυριου πως εχουσιν
transliteration: meta de tinav hmerav eipen paulov prov barnaban epistreqantev dh episkeqwmeya touv adelfouv hmwn kata pasan polin en aiv kathggeilamen ton logon tou kuriou pwv ecousin
draft_translation: And some days after Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brothers in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
ukjv_translation: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word (o. logos) of the LORD, and see how they do.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: βαρναβας δε εβουλευσατο συμπαραλαβειν τον ιωαννην τον καλουμενον μαρκον
transliteration: barnabav de ebouleusato sumparalabein ton iwannhn ton kaloumenon markon
draft_translation: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, who was called Mark.
ukjv_translation: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

greek_text: παυλος δε ηξιου τον αποσταντα απ αυτων απο παμφυλιας και μη συνελθοντα αυτοις εις το εργον μη συμπαραλαβειν τουτον
transliteration: paulov de hxiou ton apostanta ap autwn apo pamfuliav kai mh sunelyonta autoiv eiv to ergon mh sumparalabein touton
draft_translation: But Paul thought it best not to take with them the one who departed from them from Pamphylia, and did not go with them to the work.
ukjv_translation: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

greek_text: εγενετο ουν παροξυσμος ωστε αποχωρισθηναι αυτους απ αλληλων τον τε βαρναβαν παραλαβοντα τον μαρκον εκπλευσαι εις κυπρον
transliteration: egeneto oun paroxusmov wste apocwrisyhnai autouv ap allhlwn ton te barnaban paralabonta ton markon ekpleusai eiv kupron
draft_translation: And there was a sharp disagreement, so that they separated from one another: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed to Cyprus;
ukjv_translation: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

greek_text: παυλος δε επιλεξαμενος σιλαν εξηλθεν παραδοθεις τη χαριτι του θεου υπο των αδελφων
transliteration: paulov de epilexamenov silan exhlyen paradoyeiv th cariti tou yeou upo twn adelfwn
draft_translation: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brothers to the grace of God.
ukjv_translation: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: διηρχετο δε την συριαν και κιλικιαν επιστηριζων τας εκκλησιας
transliteration: dihrceto de thn surian kai kilikian episthrizwn tav ekklhsiav
draft_translation: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the assemblies.
ukjv_translation: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

greek_text: κατηντησεν δε εις δερβην και λυστραν και ιδου μαθητης τις ην εκει ονοματι τιμοθεος υιος γυναικος τινος ιουδαιας πιστης πατρος δε ελληνος
transliteration: kathnthsen de eiv derbhn kai lustran kai idou mayhthv tiv hn ekei onomati timoyeov uiov gunaikov tinov ioudaiav pisthv patrov de ellhnov
draft_translation: Then he came to Derbe and Lystra: and, look, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a certain believing Jewish woman; but his father was a Greek:
ukjv_translation: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

greek_text: ος εμαρτυρειτο υπο των εν λυστροις και ικονιω αδελφων
transliteration: ov emartureito upo twn en lustroiv kai ikoniw adelfwn
draft_translation: He was well spoken of by the brothers that were at Lystra and Iconium.
ukjv_translation: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

greek_text: τουτον ηθελησεν ο παυλος συν αυτω εξελθειν και λαβων περιετεμεν αυτον δια τους ιουδαιους τους οντας εν τοις τοποις εκεινοις ηδεισαν γαρ απαντες τον πατερα αυτου οτι ελλην υπηρχεν
transliteration: touton hyelhsen o paulov sun autw exelyein kai labwn perietemen auton dia touv ioudaiouv touv ontav en toiv topoiv ekeinoiv hdeisan gar apantev ton patera autou oti ellhn uphrcen
draft_translation: Paul wanted this one to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those places: for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
ukjv_translation: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

greek_text: ως δε διεπορευοντο τας πολεις παρεδιδουν αυτοις φυλασσειν τα δογματα τα κεκριμενα υπο των αποστολων και των πρεσβυτερων των εν ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: wv de dieporeuonto tav poleiv paredidoun autoiv fulassein ta dogmata ta kekrimena upo twn apostolwn kai twn presbuterwn twn en ierousalhm
draft_translation: And as they went through the cities, they delivered to them the decrees to keep, that were decided by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees in order to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

greek_text: αι μεν ουν εκκλησιαι εστερεουντο τη πιστει και επερισσευον τω αριθμω καθ ημεραν
transliteration: ai men oun ekklhsiai estereounto th pistei kai eperisseuon tw ariymw kay hmeran
draft_translation: And so were the assemblies established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
ukjv_translation: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

greek_text: διελθοντες δε την φρυγιαν και την γαλατικην χωραν κωλυθεντες υπο του αγιου πνευματος λαλησαι τον λογον εν τη ασια
transliteration: dielyontev de thn frugian kai thn galatikhn cwran kwluyentev upo tou agiou pneumatov lalhsai ton logon en th asia
draft_translation: Now when they had gone through Phrygia and the Galatian region, and were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia,
ukjv_translation: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) to preach the word (o. logos) in Asia,

greek_text: ελθοντες κατα την μυσιαν επειραζον κατα την βιθυνιαν πορευεσθαι και ουκ ειασεν αυτους το πνευμα
transliteration: elyontev kata thn musian epeirazon kata thn biyunian poreuesyai kai ouk eiasen autouv to pneuma
draft_translation: After they had come to Mysia, they attempted to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit did not allow them.
ukjv_translation: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit (o. pneuma) suffered them not.

greek_text: παρελθοντες δε την μυσιαν κατεβησαν εις τρωαδα
transliteration: parelyontev de thn musian katebhsan eiv trwada
draft_translation: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
ukjv_translation: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και οραμα δια της νυκτος ωφθη τω παυλω ανηρ τις ην μακεδων εστως παρακαλων αυτον και λεγων διαβας εις μακεδονιαν βοηθησον ημιν
transliteration: kai orama dia thv nuktov wfyh tw paulw anhr tiv hn makedwn estwv parakalwn auton kai legwn diabav eiv makedonian bohyhson hmin
draft_translation: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; A man of Macedonia stood and urged him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
ukjv_translation: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

greek_text: ως δε το οραμα ειδεν ευθεως εζητησαμεν εξελθειν εις την μακεδονιαν συμβιβαζοντες οτι προσκεκληται ημας ο κυριος ευαγγελισασθαι αυτους
transliteration: wv de to orama eiden euyewv ezhthsamen exelyein eiv thn makedonian sumbibazontev oti proskeklhtai hmav o kuriov euaggelisasyai autouv
draft_translation: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us in order to preach the good news to them.
ukjv_translation: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us in order to preach the gospel unto them.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αναχθεντες ουν απο της τρωαδος ευθυδρομησαμεν εις σαμοθρακην τη τε επιουση εις νεαπολιν
transliteration: anacyentev oun apo thv trwadov euyudromhsamen eiv samoyrakhn th te epioush eiv neapolin
draft_translation: Therefore setting sail from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothrace, and the next day to Neapolis;
ukjv_translation: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

greek_text: εκειθεν τε εις φιλιππους ητις εστιν πρωτη της μεριδος της μακεδονιας πολις κολωνια ημεν δε εν ταυτη τη πολει διατριβοντες ημερας τινας
transliteration: ekeiyen te eiv filippouv htiv estin prwth thv meridov thv makedoniav poliv kolwnia hmen de en tauth th polei diatribontev hmerav tinav
draft_translation: And from there to Philippi, which is a leading city of that part of Macedonia, a colony: and we were staying in that city certain days.
ukjv_translation: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

greek_text: τη τε ημερα των σαββατων εξηλθομεν εξω της πολεως παρα ποταμον ου ενομιζετο προσευχη ειναι και καθισαντες ελαλουμεν ταις συνελθουσαις γυναιξιν
transliteration: th te hmera twn sabbatwn exhlyomen exw thv polewv para potamon ou enomizeto proseuch einai kai kayisantev elaloumen taiv sunelyousaiv gunaixin
draft_translation: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was known to be made; and we sat down, and spoke to the women who resorted there.

transliteration: kai yewreite kai akouete oti ou monon efesou alla scedon pashv thv asiav o paulov outov peisav metesthsen ikanon oclon legwn oti ouk eisin yeoi oi dia ceirwn ginomenoi
draft_translation: Moreover you see and hear, that not only at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are not gods which are made with hands:
ukjv_translation: Moreover all of you see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

greek_text: ου μονον δε τουτο κινδυνευει ημιν το μερος εις απελεγμον ελθειν αλλα και το της μεγαλης θεας αρτεμιδος ιερον εις ουδεν λογισθηναι μελλειν τε και καθαιρεισθαι την μεγαλειοτητα αυτης ην ολη η ασια και η οικουμενη σεβεται
transliteration: ou monon de touto kinduneuei hmin to merov eiv apelegmon elyein alla kai to thv megalhv yeav artemidov ieron eiv ouden logisyhnai mellein te kai kayaireisyai thn megaleiothta authv hn olh h asia kai h oikoumenh sebetai
draft_translation: So that not only is this our trade in danger of coming into disrepute; but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis should be counted as nothing, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.
ukjv_translation: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nothing; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.

greek_text: ακουσαντες δε και γενομενοι πληρεις θυμου εκραζον λεγοντες μεγαλη η αρτεμις εφεσιων
transliteration: akousantev de kai genomenoi plhreiv yumou ekrazon legontev megalh h artemiv efesiwn
draft_translation: And when they heard these things, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians.
ukjv_translation: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

greek_text: και επλησθη η πολις ολη συγχυσεως ωρμησαν τε ομοθυμαδον εις το θεατρον συναρπασαντες γαιον και αρισταρχον μακεδονας συνεκδημους του παυλου
transliteration: kai eplhsyh h poliv olh sugcusewv wrmhsan te omoyumadon eiv to yeatron sunarpasantev gaion kai aristarcon makedonav sunekdhmouv tou paulou
draft_translation: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theater.
ukjv_translation: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

greek_text: του δε παυλου βουλομενου εισελθειν εις τον δημον ουκ ειων αυτον οι μαθηται
transliteration: tou de paulou boulomenou eiselyein eiv ton dhmon ouk eiwn auton oi mayhtai
draft_translation: And when Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples did not allow him.
ukjv_translation: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

greek_text: τινες δε και των ασιαρχων οντες αυτω φιλοι πεμψαντες προς αυτον παρεκαλουν μη δουναι εαυτον εις το θεατρον
transliteration: tinev de kai twn asiarcwn ontev autw filoi pemqantev prov auton parekaloun mh dounai eauton eiv to yeatron
draft_translation: And certain of the chief of Asia, who were his friends, sent to him, desiring him that he would not venture himself into the theatre.
ukjv_translation: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
review_notes: fixed him-that relative artifact; modernized adventure-as-venture; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: αλλοι μεν ουν αλλο τι εκραζον ην γαρ η εκκλησια συγκεχυμενη και οι πλειους ουκ ηδεισαν τινος ενεκεν συνεληλυθεισαν
transliteration: alloi men oun allo ti ekrazon hn gar h ekklhsia sugkecumenh kai oi pleiouv ouk hdeisan tinov eneken sunelhluyeisan
draft_translation: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and most did not know why they had come together.
ukjv_translation: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

greek_text: εκ δε του οχλου προεβιβασαν αλεξανδρον προβαλλοντων αυτον των ιουδαιων ο δε αλεξανδρος κατασεισας την χειρα ηθελεν απολογεισθαι τω δημω
transliteration: ek de tou oclou proebibasan alexandron proballontwn auton twn ioudaiwn o de alexandrov kataseisav thn ceira hyelen apologeisyai tw dhmw
draft_translation: And they brought Alexander out of the crowd, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and wanted to make a defense to the people.
ukjv_translation: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

greek_text: επιγνοντων δε οτι ιουδαιος εστιν φωνη εγενετο μια εκ παντων ως επι ωρας δυο κραζοντων μεγαλη η αρτεμις εφεσιων
transliteration: epignontwn de oti ioudaiov estin fwnh egeneto mia ek pantwn wv epi wrav duo krazontwn megalh h artemiv efesiwn
draft_translation: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians.
ukjv_translation: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

greek_text: καταστειλας δε ο γραμματευς τον οχλον φησιν ανδρες εφεσιοι τις γαρ εστιν ανθρωπος ος ου γινωσκει την εφεσιων πολιν νεωκορον ουσαν της μεγαλης θεας αρτεμιδος και του διοπετους
transliteration: katasteilav de o grammateuv ton oclon fhsin andrev efesioi tiv gar estin anyrwpov ov ou ginwskei thn efesiwn polin newkoron ousan thv megalhv yeav artemidov kai tou diopetouv
draft_translation: And when the public clerk had appeased the people, he said, You men of Ephesus, what man is there that does not know how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
ukjv_translation: And when the public clerk had appeased the people, he said, All of you men of Ephesus, what man is there that knows not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
review_notes: modernized knows-not idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αναντιρρητων ουν οντων τουτων δεον εστιν υμας κατεσταλμενους υπαρχειν και μηδεν προπετες πραττειν
transliteration: anantirrhtwn oun ontwn toutwn deon estin umav katestalmenouv uparcein kai mhden propetev prattein
draft_translation: Seeing then that these things cannot be contradicted, you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
ukjv_translation: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, all of you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

greek_text: ηγαγετε γαρ τους ανδρας τουτους ουτε ιεροσυλους ουτε βλασφημουντας την θεαν υμων
transliteration: hgagete gar touv andrav toutouv oute ierosulouv oute blasfhmountav thn yean umwn
draft_translation: For you have brought here these men, who are neither temple robbers, nor blasphemers of your goddess.
ukjv_translation: For all of you have brought here these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

greek_text: ει μεν ουν δημητριος και οι συν αυτω τεχνιται προς τινα λογον εχουσιν αγοραιοι αγονται και ανθυπατοι εισιν εγκαλειτωσαν αλληλοις
transliteration: ei men oun dhmhtriov kai oi sun autw tecnitai prov tina logon ecousin agoraioi agontai kai anyupatoi eisin egkaleitwsan allhloiv
draft_translation: Therefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen who are with him, have a matter against anyone, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls: let them accuse one another.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter (o. logos) against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them sue one another.

greek_text: ει δε τι περι ετερων επιζητειτε εν τη εννομω εκκλησια επιλυθησεται
transliteration: ei de ti peri eterwn epizhteite en th ennomw ekklhsia epiluyhsetai
draft_translation: But if you inquire anything concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

greek_text: και γαρ κινδυνευομεν εγκαλεισθαι στασεως περι της σημερον μηδενος αιτιου υπαρχοντος περι ου δυνησομεθα αποδουναι λογον της συστροφης ταυτης
transliteration: kai gar kinduneuomen egkaleisyai stasewv peri thv shmeron mhdenov aitiou uparcontov peri ou dunhsomeya apodounai logon thv sustrofhv tauthv
draft_translation: For we are in danger of being called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause by which we may give an account of this disorderly gathering.
ukjv_translation: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account (o. logos) of this concourse.

greek_text: και ταυτα ειπων απελυσεν την εκκλησιαν
transliteration: kai tauta eipwn apelusen thn ekklhsian
draft_translation: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
ukjv_translation: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

greek_text: μετα δε το παυσασθαι τον θορυβον προσκαλεσαμενος ο παυλος τους μαθητας και ασπασαμενος εξηλθεν πορευθηναι εις την μακεδονιαν
transliteration: meta de to pausasyai ton yorubon proskalesamenov o paulov touv mayhtav kai aspasamenov exhlyen poreuyhnai eiv thn makedonian
draft_translation: And after the uproar ceased, Paul called the disciples to him, and embraced them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
ukjv_translation: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed in order to go into Macedonia.

greek_text: διελθων δε τα μερη εκεινα και παρακαλεσας αυτους λογω πολλω ηλθεν εις την ελλαδα
transliteration: dielywn de ta merh ekeina kai parakalesav autouv logw pollw hlyen eiv thn ellada
