greek_text: ο μεν ουν αποτιναξας το θηριον εις το πυρ επαθεν ουδεν κακον
transliteration: o men oun apotinaxav to yhrion eiv to pur epayen ouden kakon
draft_translation: And he shook off the creature into the fire, and suffered no harm.
ukjv_translation: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

greek_text: οι δε προσεδοκων αυτον μελλειν πιμπρασθαι η καταπιπτειν αφνω νεκρον επι πολυ δε αυτων προσδοκωντων και θεωρουντων μηδεν ατοπον εις αυτον γινομενον μεταβαλλομενοι ελεγον θεον αυτον ειναι
transliteration: oi de prosedokwn auton mellein pimprasyai h katapiptein afnw nekron epi polu de autwn prosdokwntwn kai yewrountwn mhden atopon eiv auton ginomenon metaballomenoi elegon yeon auton einai
draft_translation: But they expected that he would have swollen up, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

greek_text: εν δε τοις περι τον τοπον εκεινον υπηρχεν χωρια τω πρωτω της νησου ονοματι ποπλιω ος αναδεξαμενος ημας τρεις ημερας φιλοφρονως εξενισεν
transliteration: en de toiv peri ton topon ekeinon uphrcen cwria tw prwtw thv nhsou onomati popliw ov anadexamenov hmav treiv hmerav filofronwv exenisen
draft_translation: Now in the places around that area were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us courteously three days.
ukjv_translation: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

greek_text: εγενετο δε τον πατερα του ποπλιου πυρετοις και δυσεντερια συνεχομενον κατακεισθαι προς ον ο παυλος εισελθων και προσευξαμενος επιθεις τας χειρας αυτω ιασατο αυτον
transliteration: egeneto de ton patera tou popliou puretoiv kai dusenteria sunecomenon katakeisyai prov on o paulov eiselywn kai proseuxamenov epiyeiv tav ceirav autw iasato auton
draft_translation: And it happened that the father of Publius lay sick with fever and dysentery: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a dysentery: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

greek_text: τουτου ουν γενομενου και οι λοιποι οι εχοντες ασθενειας εν τη νησω προσηρχοντο και εθεραπευοντο
transliteration: toutou oun genomenou kai oi loipoi oi econtev asyeneiav en th nhsw proshrconto kai eyerapeuonto
draft_translation: So when this was done, others also, who had diseases on the island, came and were healed:
ukjv_translation: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

greek_text: οι και πολλαις τιμαις ετιμησαν ημας και αναγομενοις επεθεντο τα προς την χρειαν
transliteration: oi kai pollaiv timaiv etimhsan hmav kai anagomenoiv epeyento ta prov thn creian
draft_translation: Who also honored us with many honors; and when we departed, they supplied us with what was necessary.
ukjv_translation: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

greek_text: μετα δε τρεις μηνας ανηχθημεν εν πλοιω παρακεχειμακοτι εν τη νησω αλεξανδρινω παρασημω διοσκουροις
transliteration: meta de treiv mhnav anhcyhmen en ploiw parakeceimakoti en th nhsw alexandrinw parashmw dioskouroiv
draft_translation: And after three months we departed in an Alexandrian ship, which had wintered in the island, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
ukjv_translation: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

greek_text: και καταχθεντες εις συρακουσας επεμειναμεν ημερας τρεις
transliteration: kai katacyentev eiv surakousav epemeinamen hmerav treiv
draft_translation: And landing at Syracuse, we stayed three days.
ukjv_translation: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

greek_text: οθεν περιελθοντες κατηντησαμεν εις ρηγιον και μετα μιαν ημεραν επιγενομενου νοτου δευτεραιοι ηλθομεν εις ποτιολους
transliteration: oyen perielyontev kathnthsamen eiv rhgion kai meta mian hmeran epigenomenou notou deuteraioi hlyomen eiv potiolouv
draft_translation: And from there we sailed around, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and the next day we came to Puteoli:
ukjv_translation: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

greek_text: ου ευροντες αδελφους παρεκληθημεν επ αυτοις επιμειναι ημερας επτα και ουτως εις την ρωμην ηλθομεν
transliteration: ou eurontev adelfouv pareklhyhmen ep autoiv epimeinai hmerav epta kai outwv eiv thn rwmhn hlyomen
draft_translation: Where we found brothers, and were asked to stay with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
ukjv_translation: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

greek_text: κακειθεν οι αδελφοι ακουσαντες τα περι ημων εξηλθον εις απαντησιν ημιν αχρις αππιου φορου και τριων ταβερνων ους ιδων ο παυλος ευχαριστησας τω θεω ελαβεν θαρσος
transliteration: kakeiyen oi adelfoi akousantev ta peri hmwn exhlyon eiv apanthsin hmin acriv appiou forou kai triwn tabernwn ouv idwn o paulov eucaristhsav tw yew elaben yarsov
draft_translation: And from there, when the brothers heard of us, they came to meet us as far as the Forum of Appius and Three Taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
ukjv_translation: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

greek_text: οτε δε ηλθομεν εις ρωμην ο εκατονταρχος παρεδωκεν τους δεσμιους τω στρατοπεδαρχη τω δε παυλω επετραπη μενειν καθ εαυτον συν τω φυλασσοντι αυτον στρατιωτη
transliteration: ote de hlyomen eiv rwmhn o ekatontarcov paredwken touv desmiouv tw stratopedarch tw de paulw epetraph menein kay eauton sun tw fulassonti auton stratiwth
draft_translation: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was allowed to dwell by himself with a soldier who guarded him.
ukjv_translation: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

greek_text: εγενετο δε μετα ημερας τρεις συγκαλεσασθαι τον παυλον τους οντας των ιουδαιων πρωτους συνελθοντων δε αυτων ελεγεν προς αυτους ανδρες αδελφοι εγω ουδεν εναντιον ποιησας τω λαω η τοις εθεσιν τοις πατρωοις δεσμιος εξ ιεροσολυμων παρεδοθην εις τας χειρας των ρωμαιων
transliteration: egeneto de meta hmerav treiv sugkalesasyai ton paulon touv ontav twn ioudaiwn prwtouv sunelyontwn de autwn elegen prov autouv andrev adelfoi egw ouden enantion poihsav tw law h toiv eyesin toiv patrwoiv desmiov ex ierosolumwn paredoyhn eiv tav ceirav twn rwmaiwn
draft_translation: And it happened, that after three days Paul called the leading Jews together: and when they had come together, he said to them, Men, brothers, though I have done nothing against the people, or the customs of our fathers, yet I was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
ukjv_translation: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

greek_text: οιτινες ανακριναντες με εβουλοντο απολυσαι δια το μηδεμιαν αιτιαν θανατου υπαρχειν εν εμοι
transliteration: oitinev anakrinantev me eboulonto apolusai dia to mhdemian aitian yanatou uparcein en emoi
draft_translation: Who, when they had examined me, wanted to release me, because there was no cause of death in me.
ukjv_translation: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.

greek_text: αντιλεγοντων δε των ιουδαιων ηναγκασθην επικαλεσασθαι καισαρα ουχ ως του εθνους μου εχων τι κατηγορησαι
transliteration: antilegontwn de twn ioudaiwn hnagkasyhn epikalesasyai kaisara ouc wv tou eynouv mou ecwn ti kathgorhsai
draft_translation: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar; not that I had anything to accuse my nation of.
ukjv_translation: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

greek_text: δια ταυτην ουν την αιτιαν παρεκαλεσα υμας ιδειν και προσλαλησαι ενεκεν γαρ της ελπιδος του ισραηλ την αλυσιν ταυτην περικειμαι
transliteration: dia tauthn oun thn aitian parekalesa umav idein kai proslalhsai eneken gar thv elpidov tou israhl thn alusin tauthn perikeimai
draft_translation: For this cause therefore I called for you, to see you and speak with you: because for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
ukjv_translation: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

greek_text: οι δε προς αυτον ειπον ημεις ουτε γραμματα περι σου εδεξαμεθα απο της ιουδαιας ουτε παραγενομενος τις των αδελφων απηγγειλεν η ελαλησεν τι περι σου πονηρον
transliteration: oi de prov auton eipon hmeiv oute grammata peri sou edexameya apo thv ioudaiav oute paragenomenov tiv twn adelfwn aphggeilen h elalhsen ti peri sou ponhron
draft_translation: And they said to him, We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers who came report or speak any evil of you.
ukjv_translation: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning you, neither any of the brethren that came showed or spoke any harm of you.

greek_text: αξιουμεν δε παρα σου ακουσαι α φρονεις περι μεν γαρ της αιρεσεως ταυτης γνωστον εστιν ημιν οτι πανταχου αντιλεγεται
transliteration: axioumen de para sou akousai a froneiv peri men gar thv airesewv tauthv gnwston estin hmin oti pantacou antilegetai
draft_translation: But we desire to hear from you what you think: for concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.
ukjv_translation: But we desire to hear of you what you think: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

greek_text: ταξαμενοι δε αυτω ημεραν ηκον προς αυτον εις την ξενιαν πλειονες οις εξετιθετο διαμαρτυρομενος την βασιλειαν του θεου πειθων τε αυτους τα περι του ιησου απο τε του νομου μωσεως και των προφητων απο πρωι εως εσπερας
transliteration: taxamenoi de autw hmeran hkon prov auton eiv thn xenian pleionev oiv exetiyeto diamarturomenov thn basileian tou yeou peiywn te autouv ta peri tou ihsou apo te tou nomou mwsewv kai twn profhtwn apo prwi ewv esperav
draft_translation: And when they had appointed him a day, many came to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
ukjv_translation: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

greek_text: και οι μεν επειθοντο τοις λεγομενοις οι δε ηπιστουν
transliteration: kai oi men epeiyonto toiv legomenoiv oi de hpistoun
draft_translation: And some were persuaded by the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
ukjv_translation: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.

greek_text: ασυμφωνοι δε οντες προς αλληλους απελυοντο ειποντος του παυλου ρημα εν οτι καλως το πνευμα το αγιον ελαλησεν δια ησαιου του προφητου προς τους πατερας ημων
transliteration: asumfwnoi de ontev prov allhlouv apeluonto eipontov tou paulou rhma en oti kalwv to pneuma to agion elalhsen dia hsaiou tou profhtou prov touv paterav hmwn
draft_translation: And when they did not agree among themselves, they departed, after Paul had spoken one word, Well spoke the Holy Spirit through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
ukjv_translation: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, (o. rhema) Well spoke the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) by Isaiah the prophet unto our fathers,

greek_text: λεγον πορευθητι προς τον λαον τουτον και ειπε ακοη ακουσετε και ου μη συνητε και βλεποντες βλεψετε και ου μη ιδητε
transliteration: legon poreuyhti prov ton laon touton kai eipe akoh akousete kai ou mh sunhte kai blepontev bleqete kai ou mh idhte
draft_translation: Saying, Go to this people, and say, Hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and not perceive:
ukjv_translation: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing all of you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing all of you shall see, and not perceive:

greek_text: επαχυνθη γαρ η καρδια του λαου τουτου και τοις ωσιν βαρεως ηκουσαν και τους οφθαλμους αυτων εκαμμυσαν μηποτε ιδωσιν τοις οφθαλμοις και τοις ωσιν ακουσωσιν και τη καρδια συνωσιν και επιστρεψωσιν και ιασωμαι αυτους
transliteration: epacunyh gar h kardia tou laou toutou kai toiv wsin barewv hkousan kai touv ofyalmouv autwn ekammusan mhpote idwsin toiv ofyalmoiv kai toiv wsin akouswsin kai th kardia sunwsin kai epistreqwsin kai iaswmai autouv
draft_translation: For the heart of this people has become dull, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
ukjv_translation: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

greek_text: γνωστον ουν εστω υμιν οτι τοις εθνεσιν απεσταλη το σωτηριον του θεου αυτοι και ακουσονται
transliteration: gnwston oun estw umin oti toiv eynesin apestalh to swthrion tou yeou autoi kai akousontai
draft_translation: Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and that they will hear it.
ukjv_translation: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και ταυτα αυτου ειποντος απηλθον οι ιουδαιοι πολλην εχοντες εν εαυτοις συζητησιν
transliteration: kai tauta autou eipontov aphlyon oi ioudaioi pollhn econtev en eautoiv suzhthsin
draft_translation: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great dispute among themselves.
ukjv_translation: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.

greek_text: εμεινεν δε ο παυλος διετιαν ολην εν ιδιω μισθωματι και απεδεχετο παντας τους εισπορευομενους προς αυτον
transliteration: emeinen de o paulov dietian olhn en idiw misywmati kai apedeceto pantav touv eisporeuomenouv prov auton
draft_translation: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own rented house, and received all who came in to him,
ukjv_translation: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

greek_text: κηρυσσων την βασιλειαν του θεου και διδασκων τα περι του κυριου ιησου χριστου μετα πασης παρρησιας ακωλυτως
transliteration: khrusswn thn basileian tou yeou kai didaskwn ta peri tou kuriou ihsou cristou meta pashv parrhsiav akwlutwv
draft_translation: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no one forbidding him.
ukjv_translation: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: παυλος δουλος ιησου χριστου κλητος αποστολος αφωρισμενος εις ευαγγελιον θεου
transliteration: paulov doulov ihsou cristou klhtov apostolov afwrismenov eiv euaggelion yeou
draft_translation: Paul, slave of Jesus Christ, called apostle, set apart for God's good news,
ukjv_translation: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

greek_text: ο προεπηγγειλατο δια των προφητων αυτου εν γραφαις αγιαις
transliteration: o proephggeilato dia twn profhtwn autou en grafaiv agiaiv
draft_translation: which he promised beforehand through his prophets in holy Scriptures,
ukjv_translation: (Which he had promised before by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

greek_text: περι του υιου αυτου του γενομενου εκ σπερματος δαβιδ κατα σαρκα
transliteration: peri tou uiou autou tou genomenou ek spermatov dabid kata sarka
draft_translation: concerning his Son, who came from David's seed according to flesh,
ukjv_translation: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

greek_text: του ορισθεντος υιου θεου εν δυναμει κατα πνευμα αγιωσυνης εξ αναστασεως νεκρων ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων
transliteration: tou orisyentov uiou yeou en dunamei kata pneuma agiwsunhv ex anastasewv nekrwn ihsou cristou tou kuriou hmwn
draft_translation: who was marked out Son of God in power according to Spirit of holiness by resurrection of dead ones: Jesus Christ our Lord,
ukjv_translation: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit (o. pneuma) of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

greek_text: δι ου ελαβομεν χαριν και αποστολην εις υπακοην πιστεως εν πασιν τοις εθνεσιν υπερ του ονοματος αυτου
transliteration: di ou elabomen carin kai apostolhn eiv upakohn pistewv en pasin toiv eynesin uper tou onomatov autou
draft_translation: Through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name:
ukjv_translation: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

greek_text: εν οις εστε και υμεις κλητοι ιησου χριστου
transliteration: en oiv este kai umeiv klhtoi ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Among whom you also are called of Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: Among whom are all of you also the called of Jesus Christ:

greek_text: πασιν τοις ουσιν εν ρωμη αγαπητοις θεου κλητοις αγιοις χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: pasin toiv ousin en rwmh agaphtoiv yeou klhtoiv agioiv cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: To all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be holy ones: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized all-that-be wording; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: πρωτον μεν ευχαριστω τω θεω μου δια ιησου χριστου υπερ παντων υμων οτι η πιστις υμων καταγγελλεται εν ολω τω κοσμω
transliteration: prwton men eucaristw tw yew mou dia ihsou cristou uper pantwn umwn oti h pistiv umwn kataggelletai en olw tw kosmw
draft_translation: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
ukjv_translation: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: μαρτυς γαρ μου εστιν ο θεος ω λατρευω εν τω πνευματι μου εν τω ευαγγελιω του υιου αυτου ως αδιαλειπτως μνειαν υμων ποιουμαι
transliteration: martuv gar mou estin o yeov w latreuw en tw pneumati mou en tw euaggeliw tou uiou autou wv adialeiptwv mneian umwn poioumai
draft_translation: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the good news of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
ukjv_translation: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit (o. pneuma) in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: παντοτε επι των προσευχων μου δεομενος ειπως ηδη ποτε ευοδωθησομαι εν τω θεληματι του θεου ελθειν προς υμας
transliteration: pantote epi twn proseucwn mou deomenov eipwv hdh pote euodwyhsomai en tw yelhmati tou yeou elyein prov umav
draft_translation: Always making request in my prayers, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
ukjv_translation: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

greek_text: επιποθω γαρ ιδειν υμας ινα τι μεταδω χαρισμα υμιν πνευματικον εις το στηριχθηναι υμας
transliteration: epipoyw gar idein umav ina ti metadw carisma umin pneumatikon eiv to sthricyhnai umav
draft_translation: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, so that you may be established;
ukjv_translation: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end all of you may be established;

greek_text: τουτο δε εστιν συμπαρακληθηναι εν υμιν δια της εν αλληλοις πιστεως υμων τε και εμου
transliteration: touto de estin sumparaklhyhnai en umin dia thv en allhloiv pistewv umwn te kai emou
draft_translation: That is, to be encouraged together among you by the mutual faith of both you and me.
ukjv_translation: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

greek_text: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι οτι πολλακις προεθεμην ελθειν προς υμας και εκωλυθην αχρι του δευρο ινα καρπον τινα σχω και εν υμιν καθως και εν τοις λοιποις εθνεσιν
transliteration: ou yelw de umav agnoein adelfoi oti pollakiv proeyemhn elyein prov umav kai ekwluyhn acri tou deuro ina karpon tina scw kai en umin kaywv kai en toiv loipoiv eynesin
draft_translation: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that oftentimes I purposed to come to you, (but was let until now,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other nations.
ukjv_translation: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let until now,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: ελλησιν τε και βαρβαροις σοφοις τε και ανοητοις οφειλετης ειμι
transliteration: ellhsin te kai barbaroiv sofoiv te kai anohtoiv ofeilethv eimi
draft_translation: I am debtor both to Greeks and to barbarians; both to wise and to foolish.
ukjv_translation: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

greek_text: ουτως το κατ εμε προθυμον και υμιν τοις εν ρωμη ευαγγελισασθαι
transliteration: outwv to kat eme proyumon kai umin toiv en rwmh euaggelisasyai
draft_translation: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the good news to you that are at Rome also.
ukjv_translation: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

greek_text: ου γαρ επαισχυνομαι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου δυναμις γαρ θεου εστιν εις σωτηριαν παντι τω πιστευοντι ιουδαιω τε πρωτον και ελληνι
transliteration: ou gar epaiscunomai to euaggelion tou cristou dunamiv gar yeou estin eiv swthrian panti tw pisteuonti ioudaiw te prwton kai ellhni
draft_translation: For I am not ashamed of the good news of Christ: for it is the power of God to salvation to every one that believes; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
ukjv_translation: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believes; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: δικαιοσυνη γαρ θεου εν αυτω αποκαλυπτεται εκ πιστεως εις πιστιν καθως γεγραπται ο δε δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται
transliteration: dikaiosunh gar yeou en autw apokaluptetai ek pistewv eiv pistin kaywv gegraptai o de dikaiov ek pistewv zhsetai
draft_translation: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The righteous one shall live by faith.
ukjv_translation: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

greek_text: αποκαλυπτεται γαρ οργη θεου απ ουρανου επι πασαν ασεβειαν και αδικιαν ανθρωπων των την αληθειαν εν αδικια κατεχοντων
transliteration: apokaluptetai gar orgh yeou ap ouranou epi pasan asebeian kai adikian anyrwpwn twn thn alhyeian en adikia katecontwn
draft_translation: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of humans, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness;
ukjv_translation: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

greek_text: διοτι το γνωστον του θεου φανερον εστιν εν αυτοις ο γαρ θεος αυτοις εφανερωσεν
transliteration: dioti to gnwston tou yeou faneron estin en autoiv o gar yeov autoiv efanerwsen
draft_translation: Because that which is known of God is manifest in them; for God manifested it to them.
ukjv_translation: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God has showed it unto them.

greek_text: τα γαρ αορατα αυτου απο κτισεως κοσμου τοις ποιημασιν νοουμενα καθοραται η τε αιδιος αυτου δυναμις και θειοτης εις το ειναι αυτους αναπολογητους
transliteration: ta gar aorata autou apo ktisewv kosmou toiv poihmasin nooumena kayoratai h te aidiov autou dunamiv kai yeiothv eiv to einai autouv anapologhtouv
draft_translation: For his invisible things from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, both his eternal power and divinity; so that they are without excuse:
ukjv_translation: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

greek_text: διοτι γνοντες τον θεον ουχ ως θεον εδοξασαν η ευχαριστησαν αλλ εματαιωθησαν εν τοις διαλογισμοις αυτων και εσκοτισθη η ασυνετος αυτων καρδια
transliteration: dioti gnontev ton yeon ouc wv yeon edoxasan h eucaristhsan all emataiwyhsan en toiv dialogismoiv autwn kai eskotisyh h asunetov autwn kardia
draft_translation: Because, when they knew God, they did not glorify him as God, nor were thankful; but became vain in their reasonings, and their senseless heart was darkened.
ukjv_translation: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

greek_text: φασκοντες ειναι σοφοι εμωρανθησαν
transliteration: faskontev einai sofoi emwranyhsan
draft_translation: Claiming to be wise, they became fools,
ukjv_translation: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

greek_text: και ηλλαξαν την δοξαν του αφθαρτου θεου εν ομοιωματι εικονος φθαρτου ανθρωπου και πετεινων και τετραποδων και ερπετων
transliteration: kai hllaxan thn doxan tou afyartou yeou en omoiwmati eikonov fyartou anyrwpou kai peteinwn kai tetrapodwn kai erpetwn
draft_translation: And changed the glory of the incorruptible God into a likeness of an image of corruptible human, and of birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.
ukjv_translation: And changed the glory of the incorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.

greek_text: διο και παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εν ταις επιθυμιαις των καρδιων αυτων εις ακαθαρσιαν του ατιμαζεσθαι τα σωματα αυτων εν εαυτοις
transliteration: dio kai paredwken autouv o yeov en taiv epiyumiaiv twn kardiwn autwn eiv akayarsian tou atimazesyai ta swmata autwn en eautoiv
draft_translation: Therefore God also gave them up in the desires of their hearts to uncleanness, to dishonor their bodies among themselves:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

greek_text: οιτινες μετηλλαξαν την αληθειαν του θεου εν τω ψευδει και εσεβασθησαν και ελατρευσαν τη κτισει παρα τον κτισαντα ος εστιν ευλογητος εις τους αιωνας αμην
transliteration: oitinev methllaxan thn alhyeian tou yeou en tw qeudei kai esebasyhsan kai elatreusan th ktisei para ton ktisanta ov estin euloghtov eiv touv aiwnav amhn
draft_translation: Who exchanged the truth of God for the lie, and worshiped and served the creation rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

greek_text: δια τουτο παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εις παθη ατιμιας αι τε γαρ θηλειαι αυτων μετηλλαξαν την φυσικην χρησιν εις την παρα φυσιν
transliteration: dia touto paredwken autouv o yeov eiv payh atimiav ai te gar yhleiai autwn methllaxan thn fusikhn crhsin eiv thn para fusin
draft_translation: For this cause God gave them up to passions of dishonor: for even their women exchanged the natural use for that which is against nature:
ukjv_translation: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

greek_text: ομοιως τε και οι αρσενες αφεντες την φυσικην χρησιν της θηλειας εξεκαυθησαν εν τη ορεξει αυτων εις αλληλους αρσενες εν αρσεσιν την ασχημοσυνην κατεργαζομενοι και την αντιμισθιαν ην εδει της πλανης αυτων εν εαυτοις απολαμβανοντες
transliteration: omoiwv te kai oi arsenev afentev thn fusikhn crhsin thv yhleiav exekauyhsan en th orexei autwn eiv allhlouv arsenev en arsesin thn aschmosunhn katergazomenoi kai thn antimisyian hn edei thv planhv autwn en eautoiv apolambanontev
draft_translation: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is shameful, and receiving in themselves that repayment of their error which was due.
ukjv_translation: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
review_notes: modernized recompense/meet wording; rendered aschemosyne as shameful

greek_text: και καθως ουκ εδοκιμασαν τον θεον εχειν εν επιγνωσει παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εις αδοκιμον νουν ποιειν τα μη καθηκοντα
transliteration: kai kaywv ouk edokimasan ton yeon ecein en epignwsei paredwken autouv o yeov eiv adokimon noun poiein ta mh kayhkonta
draft_translation: And even as they did not approve having God in knowledge, God gave them over to an unapproved mind, to do things that are not fitting;
ukjv_translation: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

greek_text: πεπληρωμενους παση αδικια πορνεια πονηρια πλεονεξια κακια μεστους φθονου φονου εριδος δολου κακοηθειας ψιθυριστας
transliteration: peplhrwmenouv pash adikia porneia ponhria pleonexia kakia mestouv fyonou fonou eridov dolou kakohyeiav qiyuristav
draft_translation: Being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, ill will; whisperers,
ukjv_translation: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, ill will; whisperers,

greek_text: καταλαλους θεοστυγεις υβριστας υπερηφανους αλαζονας εφευρετας κακων γονευσιν απειθεις
transliteration: katalalouv yeostugeiv ubristav uperhfanouv alazonav efeuretav kakwn goneusin apeiyeiv
draft_translation: Slanderers, God-haters, insolent, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
ukjv_translation: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

greek_text: ασυνετους ασυνθετους αστοργους ασπονδους ανελεημονας
transliteration: asunetouv asunyetouv astorgouv aspondouv anelehmonav
draft_translation: Without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, implacable, merciless:
ukjv_translation: Without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, refusing to reconcile, unmerciful:

greek_text: οιτινες το δικαιωμα του θεου επιγνοντες οτι οι τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντες αξιοι θανατου εισιν ου μονον αυτα ποιουσιν αλλα και συνευδοκουσιν τοις πρασσουσιν
transliteration: oitinev to dikaiwma tou yeou epignontev oti oi ta toiauta prassontev axioi yanatou eisin ou monon auta poiousin alla kai suneudokousin toiv prassousin
draft_translation: Who, knowing the righteous decree of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do them, but also approve of those who practice them.
ukjv_translation: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

greek_text: διο αναπολογητος ει ω ανθρωπε πας ο κρινων εν ω γαρ κρινεις τον ετερον σεαυτον κατακρινεις τα γαρ αυτα πρασσεις ο κρινων
transliteration: dio anapologhtov ei w anyrwpe pav o krinwn en w gar krineiv ton eteron seauton katakrineiv ta gar auta prasseiv o krinwn
draft_translation: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, everyone who judges: for in what you judge another, you condemn yourself; for you who judge practice the same things.
ukjv_translation: Therefore you are inexcusable, O man, whosoever you are that judge: for wherein you judge another, you condemn yourself; for you that judge do the same things.

greek_text: οιδαμεν δε οτι το κριμα του θεου εστιν κατα αληθειαν επι τους τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντας
transliteration: oidamen de oti to krima tou yeou estin kata alhyeian epi touv ta toiauta prassontav
draft_translation: But we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
ukjv_translation: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

greek_text: λογιζη δε τουτο ω ανθρωπε ο κρινων τους τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντας και ποιων αυτα οτι συ εκφευξη το κριμα του θεου
transliteration: logizh de touto w anyrwpe o krinwn touv ta toiauta prassontav kai poiwn auta oti su ekfeuxh to krima tou yeou
draft_translation: And do you think this, O man, who judges those who practice such things and does the same, that you shall escape the judgment of God?
ukjv_translation: And think you this, O man, that judge them which do such things, and do the same, that you shall escape the judgment of God?

greek_text: η του πλουτου της χρηστοτητος αυτου και της ανοχης και της μακροθυμιας καταφρονεις αγνοων οτι το χρηστον του θεου εις μετανοιαν σε αγει
transliteration: h tou ploutou thv crhstothtov autou kai thv anochv kai thv makroyumiav katafroneiv agnown oti to crhston tou yeou eiv metanoian se agei
draft_translation: Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and tolerance and longsuffering, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?
ukjv_translation: Or despise you the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

greek_text: κατα δε την σκληροτητα σου και αμετανοητον καρδιαν θησαυριζεις σεαυτω οργην εν ημερα οργης και αποκαλυψεως δικαιοκρισιας του θεου
transliteration: kata de thn sklhrothta sou kai ametanohton kardian yhsaurizeiv seautw orghn en hmera orghv kai apokaluqewv dikaiokrisiav tou yeou
draft_translation: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you store up wrath for yourself in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
ukjv_translation: But after your hardness and refusing to repent heart treasure up unto yourself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

greek_text: ος αποδωσει εκαστω κατα τα εργα αυτου
transliteration: ov apodwsei ekastw kata ta erga autou
draft_translation: Who will repay each one according to his works:
ukjv_translation: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

greek_text: τοις μεν καθ υπομονην εργου αγαθου δοξαν και τιμην και αφθαρσιαν ζητουσιν ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: toiv men kay upomonhn ergou agayou doxan kai timhn kai afyarsian zhtousin zwhn aiwnion
draft_translation: To those who by endurance in good work seek glory and honor and incorruptibility, eternal life:
ukjv_translation: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

greek_text: τοις δε εξ εριθειας και απειθουσιν μεν τη αληθεια πειθομενοις δε τη αδικια θυμος και οργη
transliteration: toiv de ex eriyeiav kai apeiyousin men th alhyeia peiyomenoiv de th adikia yumov kai orgh
draft_translation: But to those from selfish ambition, who disobey the truth and obey unrighteousness, anger and wrath,
ukjv_translation: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

greek_text: θλιψις και στενοχωρια επι πασαν ψυχην ανθρωπου του κατεργαζομενου το κακον ιουδαιου τε πρωτον και ελληνος
transliteration: yliqiv kai stenocwria epi pasan quchn anyrwpou tou katergazomenou to kakon ioudaiou te prwton kai ellhnov
draft_translation: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that does evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
ukjv_translation: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that does evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: δοξα δε και τιμη και ειρηνη παντι τω εργαζομενω το αγαθον ιουδαιω τε πρωτον και ελληνι
transliteration: doxa de kai timh kai eirhnh panti tw ergazomenw to agayon ioudaiw te prwton kai ellhni
draft_translation: But glory, honor, and peace, to every man that works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
ukjv_translation: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν προσωποληψια παρα τω θεω
transliteration: ou gar estin proswpolhqia para tw yew
draft_translation: For there is no partiality with God.
ukjv_translation: For there is no respect of persons with God.

greek_text: οσοι γαρ ανομως ημαρτον ανομως και απολουνται και οσοι εν νομω ημαρτον δια νομου κριθησονται
transliteration: osoi gar anomwv hmarton anomwv kai apolountai kai osoi en nomw hmarton dia nomou kriyhsontai
draft_translation: For as many as sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as sinned in law shall be judged through law;
ukjv_translation: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

greek_text: ου γαρ οι ακροαται του νομου δικαιοι παρα τω θεω αλλ οι ποιηται του νομου δικαιωθησονται
transliteration: ou gar oi akroatai tou nomou dikaioi para tw yew all oi poihtai tou nomou dikaiwyhsontai
draft_translation: For the hearers of the law are not righteous before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
ukjv_translation: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

greek_text: οταν γαρ εθνη τα μη νομον εχοντα φυσει τα του νομου ποιη ουτοι νομον μη εχοντες εαυτοις εισιν νομος
transliteration: otan gar eynh ta mh nomon econta fusei ta tou nomou poih outoi nomon mh econtev eautoiv eisin nomov
draft_translation: For when the nations, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law to themselves:
ukjv_translation: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: οιτινες ενδεικνυνται το εργον του νομου γραπτον εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων συμμαρτυρουσης αυτων της συνειδησεως και μεταξυ αλληλων των λογισμων κατηγορουντων η και απολογουμενων
transliteration: oitinev endeiknuntai to ergon tou nomou grapton en taiv kardiaiv autwn summarturoushv autwn thv suneidhsewv kai metaxu allhlwn twn logismwn kathgorountwn h kai apologoumenwn
draft_translation: Who show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness with them, and between one another their thoughts accusing or even defending;
ukjv_translation: Which show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

greek_text: εν ημερα οτε κρινει ο θεος τα κρυπτα των ανθρωπων κατα το ευαγγελιον μου δια ιησου χριστου
transliteration: en hmera ote krinei o yeov ta krupta twn anyrwpwn kata to euaggelion mou dia ihsou cristou
draft_translation: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my good news.
ukjv_translation: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

greek_text: ιδε συ ιουδαιος επονομαζη και επαναπαυη τω νομω και καυχασαι εν θεω
transliteration: ide su ioudaiov eponomazh kai epanapauh tw nomw kai kaucasai en yew
draft_translation: Look, you are named a Jew, and rest on the law, and boast in God,
ukjv_translation: Behold, you are called a Jew, and rest in the law, and make your boast of God,

greek_text: και γινωσκεις το θελημα και δοκιμαζεις τα διαφεροντα κατηχουμενος εκ του νομου
transliteration: kai ginwskeiv to yelhma kai dokimazeiv ta diaferonta kathcoumenov ek tou nomou
draft_translation: And know his will, and discern the things that differ, being instructed out of the law;
ukjv_translation: And know his will, and approve the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

greek_text: πεποιθας τε σεαυτον οδηγον ειναι τυφλων φως των εν σκοτει
transliteration: pepoiyav te seauton odhgon einai tuflwn fwv twn en skotei
draft_translation: And are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light of those in darkness,
ukjv_translation: And are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

greek_text: παιδευτην αφρονων διδασκαλον νηπιων εχοντα την μορφωσιν της γνωσεως και της αληθειας εν τω νομω
transliteration: paideuthn afronwn didaskalon nhpiwn econta thn morfwsin thv gnwsewv kai thv alhyeiav en tw nomw
draft_translation: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, having the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
ukjv_translation: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which have the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

greek_text: ο ουν διδασκων ετερον σεαυτον ου διδασκεις ο κηρυσσων μη κλεπτειν κλεπτεις
transliteration: o oun didaskwn eteron seauton ou didaskeiv o khrusswn mh kleptein klepteiv
draft_translation: You therefore who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who preach not to steal, do you steal?
ukjv_translation: You therefore which teach another, teach you not yourself? you that preach a man should not steal, do you steal?

greek_text: ο λεγων μη μοιχευειν μοιχευεις ο βδελυσσομενος τα ειδωλα ιεροσυλεις
transliteration: o legwn mh moiceuein moiceueiv o bdelussomenov ta eidwla ierosuleiv
draft_translation: You who say not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you commit sacrilege?
ukjv_translation: You that says a man should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? you that abhor idols, do you commit sacrilege?

greek_text: ος εν νομω καυχασαι δια της παραβασεως του νομου τον θεον ατιμαζεις
transliteration: ov en nomw kaucasai dia thv parabasewv tou nomou ton yeon atimazeiv
draft_translation: You who boast in law, through transgression of the law do you dishonor God?
ukjv_translation: You that make your boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonour you God?

greek_text: το γαρ ονομα του θεου δι υμας βλασφημειται εν τοις εθνεσιν καθως γεγραπται
transliteration: to gar onoma tou yeou di umav blasfhmeitai en toiv eynesin kaywv gegraptai
draft_translation: For the name of God is blasphemed among the nations through you, as it is written.
ukjv_translation: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

greek_text: περιτομη μεν γαρ ωφελει εαν νομον πρασσης εαν δε παραβατης νομου ης η περιτομη σου ακροβυστια γεγονεν
transliteration: peritomh men gar wfelei ean nomon prasshv ean de parabathv nomou hv h peritomh sou akrobustia gegonen
draft_translation: For circumcision indeed profits, if you practice law: but if you are a transgressor of law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
ukjv_translation: For circumcision verily profits, if you keep the law: but if you be a breaker of the law, your circumcision is made uncircumcision.

greek_text: εαν ουν η ακροβυστια τα δικαιωματα του νομου φυλασση ουχι η ακροβυστια αυτου εις περιτομην λογισθησεται
transliteration: ean oun h akrobustia ta dikaiwmata tou nomou fulassh ouci h akrobustia autou eiv peritomhn logisyhsetai
draft_translation: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
ukjv_translation: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και κρινει η εκ φυσεως ακροβυστια τον νομον τελουσα σε τον δια γραμματος και περιτομης παραβατην νομου
transliteration: kai krinei h ek fusewv akrobustia ton nomon telousa se ton dia grammatov kai peritomhv parabathn nomou
draft_translation: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfill the law, judge you, who by the letter and circumcision do transgress the law?
ukjv_translation: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfill the law, judge you, who by the letter and circumcision do transgress the law?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ου γαρ ο εν τω φανερω ιουδαιος εστιν ουδε η εν τω φανερω εν σαρκι περιτομη
transliteration: ou gar o en tw fanerw ioudaiov estin oude h en tw fanerw en sarki peritomh
draft_translation: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
ukjv_translation: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αλλ ο εν τω κρυπτω ιουδαιος και περιτομη καρδιας εν πνευματι ου γραμματι ου ο επαινος ουκ εξ ανθρωπων αλλ εκ του θεου
transliteration: all o en tw kruptw ioudaiov kai peritomh kardiav en pneumati ou grammati ou o epainov ouk ex anyrwpwn all ek tou yeou
draft_translation: But he is a Jew in secret; and circumcision is of the heart, in spirit, not letter; whose praise is not from humans, but from God.
ukjv_translation: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, (o. pneuma) and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

greek_text: τι ουν το περισσον του ιουδαιου η τις η ωφελεια της περιτομης
transliteration: ti oun to perisson tou ioudaiou h tiv h wfeleia thv peritomhv
draft_translation: What then is the advantage of the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?
ukjv_translation: What advantage then has the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

greek_text: πολυ κατα παντα τροπον πρωτον μεν γαρ οτι επιστευθησαν τα λογια του θεου
transliteration: polu kata panta tropon prwton men gar oti episteuyhsan ta logia tou yeou
draft_translation: Much in every way: first indeed, because they were entrusted with the oracles of God.
ukjv_translation: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

greek_text: τι γαρ ει ηπιστησαν τινες μη η απιστια αυτων την πιστιν του θεου καταργησει
transliteration: ti gar ei hpisthsan tinev mh h apistia autwn thn pistin tou yeou katarghsei
draft_translation: For what if some were faithless? shall their faithlessness make the faithfulness of God ineffective?
ukjv_translation: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

greek_text: μη γενοιτο γινεσθω δε ο θεος αληθης πας δε ανθρωπος ψευστης καθως γεγραπται οπως αν δικαιωθης εν τοις λογοις σου και νικησης εν τω κρινεσθαι σε
transliteration: mh genoito ginesyw de o yeov alhyhv pav de anyrwpov qeusthv kaywv gegraptai opwv an dikaiwyhv en toiv logoiv sou kai nikhshv en tw krinesyai se
draft_translation: May it not be: yes, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That you might be justified in your sayings, and might overcome when you are judged.
ukjv_translation: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That you might be justified in your sayings, (o. logos) and might overcome when you are judged.
review_notes: modernized yea; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: ει δε η αδικια ημων θεου δικαιοσυνην συνιστησιν τι ερουμεν μη αδικος ο θεος ο επιφερων την οργην κατα ανθρωπον λεγω
transliteration: ei de h adikia hmwn yeou dikaiosunhn sunisthsin ti eroumen mh adikov o yeov o epiferwn thn orghn kata anyrwpon legw
draft_translation: But if our unrighteousness commends God's righteousness, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who brings wrath? I speak according to man.
ukjv_translation: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who takes vengeance? (I speak as a man)

greek_text: μη γενοιτο επει πως κρινει ο θεος τον κοσμον
transliteration: mh genoito epei pwv krinei o yeov ton kosmon
draft_translation: May it not be: for then how shall God judge the world?
ukjv_translation: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

greek_text: ει γαρ η αληθεια του θεου εν τω εμω ψευσματι επερισσευσεν εις την δοξαν αυτου τι ετι καγω ως αμαρτωλος κρινομαι
transliteration: ei gar h alhyeia tou yeou en tw emw qeusmati eperisseusen eiv thn doxan autou ti eti kagw wv amartwlov krinomai
draft_translation: For if the truth of God abounded through my lie to his glory, why am I still judged as a sinner?
ukjv_translation: For if the truth of God has more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

greek_text: και μη καθως βλασφημουμεθα και καθως φασιν τινες ημας λεγειν οτι ποιησωμεν τα κακα ινα ελθη τα αγαθα ων το κριμα ενδικον εστιν
transliteration: kai mh kaywv blasfhmoumeya kai kaywv fasin tinev hmav legein oti poihswmen ta kaka ina elyh ta agaya wn to krima endikon estin
draft_translation: And not rather, (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose judgment is just.
ukjv_translation: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; rendered krima/krisis as judgment

greek_text: τι ουν προεχομεθα ου παντως προητιασαμεθα γαρ ιουδαιους τε και ελληνας παντας υφ αμαρτιαν ειναι
transliteration: ti oun proecomeya ou pantwv prohtiasameya gar ioudaiouv te kai ellhnav pantav uf amartian einai
draft_translation: What then? are we better than they? No, by no means: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
ukjv_translation: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
review_notes: aligned emphatic negation idiom; modernized no-wise idiom

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται οτι ουκ εστιν δικαιος ουδε εις
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai oti ouk estin dikaiov oude eiv
draft_translation: As it is written, There is not a righteous one, not even one:
ukjv_translation: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

greek_text: ουκ εστιν ο συνιων ουκ εστιν ο εκζητων τον θεον
transliteration: ouk estin o suniwn ouk estin o ekzhtwn ton yeon
draft_translation: There is none who understands, there is none who seeks after God.
ukjv_translation: There is none that understands, there is none that seeks after God.

greek_text: παντες εξεκλιναν αμα ηχρειωθησαν ουκ εστιν ποιων χρηστοτητα ουκ εστιν εως ενος
transliteration: pantev exeklinan ama hcreiwyhsan ouk estin poiwn crhstothta ouk estin ewv enov
draft_translation: They all turned aside, together they became worthless; there is none who does goodness, not even one.
ukjv_translation: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become useless; there is none that does good, no, not one.

greek_text: ταφος ανεωγμενος ο λαρυγξ αυτων ταις γλωσσαις αυτων εδολιουσαν ιος ασπιδων υπο τα χειλη αυτων
transliteration: tafov anewgmenov o larugx autwn taiv glwssaiv autwn edoliousan iov aspidwn upo ta ceilh autwn
draft_translation: Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
ukjv_translation: Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

greek_text: ων το στομα αρας και πικριας γεμει
transliteration: wn to stoma arav kai pikriav gemei
draft_translation: Whose mouth is full of curse and bitterness:
ukjv_translation: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

greek_text: οξεις οι ποδες αυτων εκχεαι αιμα
transliteration: oxeiv oi podev autwn ekceai aima
draft_translation: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
ukjv_translation: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

greek_text: συντριμμα και ταλαιπωρια εν ταις οδοις αυτων
transliteration: suntrimma kai talaipwria en taiv odoiv autwn
draft_translation: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
ukjv_translation: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

greek_text: και οδον ειρηνης ουκ εγνωσαν
transliteration: kai odon eirhnhv ouk egnwsan
draft_translation: And the way of peace they have not known:
ukjv_translation: And the way of peace have they not known:

greek_text: ουκ εστιν φοβος θεου απεναντι των οφθαλμων αυτων
transliteration: ouk estin fobov yeou apenanti twn ofyalmwn autwn
draft_translation: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
ukjv_translation: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

greek_text: οιδαμεν δε οτι οσα ο νομος λεγει τοις εν τω νομω λαλει ινα παν στομα φραγη και υποδικος γενηται πας ο κοσμος τω θεω
transliteration: oidamen de oti osa o nomov legei toiv en tw nomw lalei ina pan stoma fragh kai upodikov genhtai pav o kosmov tw yew
draft_translation: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those in the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become liable to judgment before God.
ukjv_translation: Now we know that what things whatsoever the law says, it says to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

greek_text: διοτι εξ εργων νομου ου δικαιωθησεται πασα σαρξ ενωπιον αυτου δια γαρ νομου επιγνωσις αμαρτιας
transliteration: dioti ex ergwn nomou ou dikaiwyhsetai pasa sarx enwpion autou dia gar nomou epignwsiv amartiav
draft_translation: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
ukjv_translation: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: νυνι δε χωρις νομου δικαιοσυνη θεου πεφανερωται μαρτυρουμενη υπο του νομου και των προφητων
transliteration: nuni de cwriv nomou dikaiosunh yeou pefanerwtai marturoumenh upo tou nomou kai twn profhtwn
draft_translation: But now apart from law the righteousness of God has been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
ukjv_translation: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

greek_text: δικαιοσυνη δε θεου δια πιστεως ιησου χριστου εις παντας και επι παντας τους πιστευοντας ου γαρ εστιν διαστολη
transliteration: dikaiosunh de yeou dia pistewv ihsou cristou eiv pantav kai epi pantav touv pisteuontav ou gar estin diastolh
draft_translation: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ to all and upon all those who believe: for there is no difference:
ukjv_translation: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
review_notes: fixed non-person relative after righteousness; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: παντες γαρ ημαρτον και υστερουνται της δοξης του θεου
transliteration: pantev gar hmarton kai usterountai thv doxhv tou yeou
draft_translation: For all sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
ukjv_translation: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

greek_text: δικαιουμενοι δωρεαν τη αυτου χαριτι δια της απολυτρωσεως της εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: dikaioumenoi dwrean th autou cariti dia thv apolutrwsewv thv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

greek_text: ον προεθετο ο θεος ιλαστηριον δια της πιστεως εν τω αυτου αιματι εις ενδειξιν της δικαιοσυνης αυτου δια την παρεσιν των προγεγονοτων αμαρτηματων
transliteration: on proeyeto o yeov ilasthrion dia thv pistewv en tw autou aimati eiv endeixin thv dikaiosunhv autou dia thn paresin twn progegonotwn amarthmatwn
draft_translation: whom God set forth as propitiation through faith in his blood, for a display of his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins that had happened before, in the forbearance of God;
ukjv_translation: Whom God has set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

greek_text: εν τη ανοχη του θεου προς ενδειξιν της δικαιοσυνης αυτου εν τω νυν καιρω εις το ειναι αυτον δικαιον και δικαιουντα τον εκ πιστεως ιησου
transliteration: en th anoch tou yeou prov endeixin thv dikaiosunhv autou en tw nun kairw eiv to einai auton dikaion kai dikaiounta ton ek pistewv ihsou
draft_translation: In the forbearance of God, for a display of his righteousness in the present time, so that he might be righteous and the one justifying him who is of faith in Jesus.
ukjv_translation: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believes in Jesus.

greek_text: που ουν η καυχησις εξεκλεισθη δια ποιου νομου των εργων ουχι αλλα δια νομου πιστεως
transliteration: pou oun h kauchsiv exekleisyh dia poiou nomou twn ergwn ouci alla dia nomou pistewv
draft_translation: Where then is boasting? It was excluded. Through what law? of works? No, but through the law of faith.
ukjv_translation: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

greek_text: λογιζομεθα ουν πιστει δικαιουσθαι ανθρωπον χωρις εργων νομου
transliteration: logizomeya oun pistei dikaiousyai anyrwpon cwriv ergwn nomou
draft_translation: Therefore we reckon that a human is justified by faith apart from works of law.
ukjv_translation: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

greek_text: η ιουδαιων ο θεος μονον ουχι δε και εθνων ναι και εθνων
transliteration: h ioudaiwn o yeov monon ouci de kai eynwn nai kai eynwn
draft_translation: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the nations? Yes, of the nations also:
ukjv_translation: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

greek_text: επειπερ εις ο θεος ος δικαιωσει περιτομην εκ πιστεως και ακροβυστιαν δια της πιστεως
transliteration: epeiper eiv o yeov ov dikaiwsei peritomhn ek pistewv kai akrobustian dia thv pistewv
draft_translation: Seeing it is one God, who shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
ukjv_translation: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

greek_text: νομον ουν καταργουμεν δια της πιστεως μη γενοιτο αλλα νομον ιστωμεν
transliteration: nomon oun katargoumen dia thv pistewv mh genoito alla nomon istwmen
draft_translation: Do we then make void the law through faith? May it not be. Rather, we establish the law.
ukjv_translation: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν αβρααμ τον πατερα ημων ευρηκεναι κατα σαρκα
transliteration: ti oun eroumen abraam ton patera hmwn eurhkenai kata sarka
draft_translation: What then shall we say that Abraham our father has found according to the flesh?
ukjv_translation: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, has found?

greek_text: ει γαρ αβρααμ εξ εργων εδικαιωθη εχει καυχημα αλλ ου προς τον θεον
transliteration: ei gar abraam ex ergwn edikaiwyh ecei kauchma all ou prov ton yeon
draft_translation: For if Abraham was justified from works, he has boasting; but not before God.
ukjv_translation: For if Abraham were justified by works, he has whereof to glory; but not before God.

greek_text: τι γαρ η γραφη λεγει επιστευσεν δε αβρααμ τω θεω και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: ti gar h grafh legei episteusen de abraam tw yew kai elogisyh autw eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: For what does the scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness.
ukjv_translation: For what says the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

greek_text: τω δε εργαζομενω ο μισθος ου λογιζεται κατα χαριν αλλα κατα το οφειλημα
transliteration: tw de ergazomenw o misyov ou logizetai kata carin alla kata to ofeilhma
draft_translation: Now to the one who works, the reward is not reckoned according to grace, but according to debt.
ukjv_translation: Now to him that works is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

greek_text: τω δε μη εργαζομενω πιστευοντι δε επι τον δικαιουντα τον ασεβη λογιζεται η πιστις αυτου εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: tw de mh ergazomenw pisteuonti de epi ton dikaiounta ton asebh logizetai h pistiv autou eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: But to the one who does not work, but believes on him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.
ukjv_translation: But to him that works not, but believes on him that justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

greek_text: καθαπερ και δαβιδ λεγει τον μακαρισμον του ανθρωπου ω ο θεος λογιζεται δικαιοσυνην χωρις εργων
transliteration: kayaper kai dabid legei ton makarismon tou anyrwpou w o yeov logizetai dikaiosunhn cwriv ergwn
draft_translation: Just as David also speaks of the blessedness of the human to whom God reckons righteousness apart from works,
ukjv_translation: Even as David also describes the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputes righteousness without works,

greek_text: μακαριοι ων αφεθησαν αι ανομιαι και ων επεκαλυφθησαν αι αμαρτιαι
transliteration: makarioi wn afeyhsan ai anomiai kai wn epekalufyhsan ai amartiai
draft_translation: Saying, Blessed are those whose lawless deeds were forgiven, and whose sins were covered.
ukjv_translation: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

greek_text: μακαριος ανηρ ω ου μη λογισηται κυριος αμαρτιαν
transliteration: makariov anhr w ou mh logishtai kuriov amartian
draft_translation: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord shall certainly not reckon sin.
ukjv_translation: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

greek_text: ο μακαρισμος ουν ουτος επι την περιτομην η και επι την ακροβυστιαν λεγομεν γαρ οτι ελογισθη τω αβρααμ η πιστις εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: o makarismov oun outov epi thn peritomhn h kai epi thn akrobustian legomen gar oti elogisyh tw abraam h pistiv eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: Comes this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
ukjv_translation: Comes this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: πως ουν ελογισθη εν περιτομη οντι η εν ακροβυστια ουκ εν περιτομη αλλ εν ακροβυστια
transliteration: pwv oun elogisyh en peritomh onti h en akrobustia ouk en peritomh all en akrobustia
draft_translation: How then was it reckoned? while he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
ukjv_translation: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

greek_text: και σημειον ελαβεν περιτομης σφραγιδα της δικαιοσυνης της πιστεως της εν τη ακροβυστια εις το ειναι αυτον πατερα παντων των πιστευοντων δι ακροβυστιας εις το λογισθηναι και αυτοις την δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: kai shmeion elaben peritomhv sfragida thv dikaiosunhv thv pistewv thv en th akrobustia eiv to einai auton patera pantwn twn pisteuontwn di akrobustiav eiv to logisyhnai kai autoiv thn dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith while in uncircumcision: so that he might be the father of all who believe through uncircumcision, so that righteousness might be reckoned to them also:
ukjv_translation: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

greek_text: και πατερα περιτομης τοις ουκ εκ περιτομης μονον αλλα και τοις στοιχουσιν τοις ιχνεσιν της εν τη ακροβυστια πιστεως του πατρος ημων αβρααμ
transliteration: kai patera peritomhv toiv ouk ek peritomhv monon alla kai toiv stoicousin toiv icnesin thv en th akrobustia pistewv tou patrov hmwn abraam
draft_translation: And the father of circumcision to those who are not of circumcision only, but also to those walking in the steps of the faith of our father Abraham while in uncircumcision.
ukjv_translation: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

greek_text: ου γαρ δια νομου η επαγγελια τω αβρααμ η τω σπερματι αυτου το κληρονομον αυτον ειναι του κοσμου αλλα δια δικαιοσυνης πιστεως
transliteration: ou gar dia nomou h epaggelia tw abraam h tw spermati autou to klhronomon auton einai tou kosmou alla dia dikaiosunhv pistewv
draft_translation: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
ukjv_translation: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

greek_text: ει γαρ οι εκ νομου κληρονομοι κεκενωται η πιστις και κατηργηται η επαγγελια
transliteration: ei gar oi ek nomou klhronomoi kekenwtai h pistiv kai kathrghtai h epaggelia
draft_translation: For if those of law are heirs, faith has been emptied, and the promise made ineffective:
ukjv_translation: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of no effect:

greek_text: ο γαρ νομος οργην κατεργαζεται ου γαρ ουκ εστιν νομος ουδε παραβασις
transliteration: o gar nomov orghn katergazetai ou gar ouk estin nomov oude parabasiv
draft_translation: For the law works wrath: for where there is no law, neither is there transgression.
ukjv_translation: Because the law works wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

greek_text: δια τουτο εκ πιστεως ινα κατα χαριν εις το ειναι βεβαιαν την επαγγελιαν παντι τω σπερματι ου τω εκ του νομου μονον αλλα και τω εκ πιστεως αβρααμ ος εστιν πατηρ παντων ημων
transliteration: dia touto ek pistewv ina kata carin eiv to einai bebaian thn epaggelian panti tw spermati ou tw ek tou nomou monon alla kai tw ek pistewv abraam ov estin pathr pantwn hmwn
draft_translation: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
ukjv_translation: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται οτι πατερα πολλων εθνων τεθεικα σε κατεναντι ου επιστευσεν θεου του ζωοποιουντος τους νεκρους και καλουντος τα μη οντα ως οντα
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai oti patera pollwn eynwn teyeika se katenanti ou episteusen yeou tou zwopoiountov touv nekrouv kai kalountov ta mh onta wv onta
draft_translation: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who gives life to the dead, and calls those things that are not as though they were.
ukjv_translation: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who replenishes life to the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

greek_text: ος παρ ελπιδα επ ελπιδι επιστευσεν εις το γενεσθαι αυτον πατερα πολλων εθνων κατα το ειρημενον ουτως εσται το σπερμα σου

draft_translation: Who contrary to hope believed upon hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to what was spoken, So shall your seed be.
ukjv_translation: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall your seed be.

greek_text: και μη ασθενησας τη πιστει ου κατενοησεν το εαυτου σωμα ηδη νενεκρωμενον εκατονταετης που υπαρχων και την νεκρωσιν της μητρας σαρρας
transliteration: kai mh asyenhsav th pistei ou katenohsen to eautou swma hdh nenekrwmenon ekatontaethv pou uparcwn kai thn nekrwsin thv mhtrav sarrav
draft_translation: And not being weak in faith, he did not consider his own body already dead, being about a hundred years old, nor the deadness of Sarah's womb:
ukjv_translation: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:

greek_text: εις δε την επαγγελιαν του θεου ου διεκριθη τη απιστια αλλ ενεδυναμωθη τη πιστει δους δοξαν τω θεω
transliteration: eiv de thn epaggelian tou yeou ou diekriyh th apistia all enedunamwyh th pistei douv doxan tw yew
draft_translation: And at the promise of God he did not waver in unbelief; but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God;
ukjv_translation: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

greek_text: και πληροφορηθεις οτι ο επηγγελται δυνατος εστιν και ποιησαι
transliteration: kai plhroforhyeiv oti o ephggeltai dunatov estin kai poihsai
draft_translation: And being fully assured that what he had promised, he was able also to do.
ukjv_translation: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

greek_text: διο και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: dio kai elogisyh autw eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: Therefore also it was reckoned to him for righteousness.
ukjv_translation: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

greek_text: ουκ εγραφη δε δι αυτον μονον οτι ελογισθη αυτω
transliteration: ouk egrafh de di auton monon oti elogisyh autw
draft_translation: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned to him;
ukjv_translation: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

greek_text: αλλα και δι ημας οις μελλει λογιζεσθαι τοις πιστευουσιν επι τον εγειραντα ιησουν τον κυριον ημων εκ νεκρων
transliteration: alla kai di hmav oiv mellei logizesyai toiv pisteuousin epi ton egeiranta ihsoun ton kurion hmwn ek nekrwn
draft_translation: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him who raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
ukjv_translation: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ος παρεδοθη δια τα παραπτωματα ημων και ηγερθη δια την δικαιωσιν ημων
transliteration: ov paredoyh dia ta paraptwmata hmwn kai hgeryh dia thn dikaiwsin hmwn
draft_translation: Who was delivered because of our trespasses, and was raised because of our justification.
ukjv_translation: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

greek_text: δικαιωθεντες ουν εκ πιστεως ειρηνην εχομεν προς τον θεον δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: dikaiwyentev oun ek pistewv eirhnhn ecomen prov ton yeon dia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Therefore, having been justified from faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

greek_text: δι ου και την προσαγωγην εσχηκαμεν τη πιστει εις την χαριν ταυτην εν η εστηκαμεν και καυχωμεθα επ ελπιδι της δοξης του θεου
transliteration: di ou kai thn prosagwghn eschkamen th pistei eiv thn carin tauthn en h esthkamen kai kaucwmeya ep elpidi thv doxhv tou yeou
draft_translation: Through whom also we have had access by faith into this grace in which we stand, and boast in hope of the glory of God.
ukjv_translation: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

greek_text: ου μονον δε αλλα και καυχωμεθα εν ταις θλιψεσιν ειδοτες οτι η θλιψις υπομονην κατεργαζεται
transliteration: ou monon de alla kai kaucwmeya en taiv yliqesin eidotev oti h yliqiv upomonhn katergazetai
draft_translation: And not only so, but we also boast in tribulations: knowing that tribulation works endurance;
ukjv_translation: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;

greek_text: η δε υπομονη δοκιμην η δε δοκιμη ελπιδα
transliteration: h de upomonh dokimhn h de dokimh elpida
draft_translation: And endurance, tested character; and tested character, hope:
ukjv_translation: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

greek_text: η δε ελπις ου καταισχυνει οτι η αγαπη του θεου εκκεχυται εν ταις καρδιαις ημων δια πνευματος αγιου του δοθεντος ημιν
transliteration: h de elpiv ou kataiscunei oti h agaph tou yeou ekkecutai en taiv kardiaiv hmwn dia pneumatov agiou tou doyentov hmin
draft_translation: And hope does not put to shame; because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit given to us.
ukjv_translation: And hope makes not ashamed; because the love (o. agape) of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) which is given unto us.

greek_text: ετι γαρ χριστος οντων ημων ασθενων κατα καιρον υπερ ασεβων απεθανεν
transliteration: eti gar cristov ontwn hmwn asyenwn kata kairon uper asebwn apeyanen
draft_translation: For while we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
ukjv_translation: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

greek_text: μολις γαρ υπερ δικαιου τις αποθανειται υπερ γαρ του αγαθου ταχα τις και τολμα αποθανειν
transliteration: moliv gar uper dikaiou tiv apoyaneitai uper gar tou agayou taca tiv kai tolma apoyanein
draft_translation: For scarcely will someone die for a righteous one: yet perhaps for the good one someone even dares to die.
ukjv_translation: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet possibly for a good man some would even dare to die.

greek_text: συνιστησιν δε την εαυτου αγαπην εις ημας ο θεος οτι ετι αμαρτωλων οντων ημων χριστος υπερ ημων απεθανεν
transliteration: sunisthsin de thn eautou agaphn eiv hmav o yeov oti eti amartwlwn ontwn hmwn cristov uper hmwn apeyanen
draft_translation: But God commends his own love toward us, because while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
ukjv_translation: But God commends his love (o. agape) toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

greek_text: πολλω ουν μαλλον δικαιωθεντες νυν εν τω αιματι αυτου σωθησομεθα δι αυτου απο της οργης
transliteration: pollw oun mallon dikaiwyentev nun en tw aimati autou swyhsomeya di autou apo thv orghv
draft_translation: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
ukjv_translation: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

greek_text: ει γαρ εχθροι οντες κατηλλαγημεν τω θεω δια του θανατου του υιου αυτου πολλω μαλλον καταλλαγεντες σωθησομεθα εν τη ζωη αυτου
transliteration: ei gar ecyroi ontev kathllaghmen tw yew dia tou yanatou tou uiou autou pollw mallon katallagentev swyhsomeya en th zwh autou
draft_translation: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

greek_text: δια τουτο ωσπερ δι ενος ανθρωπου η αμαρτια εις τον κοσμον εισηλθεν και δια της αμαρτιας ο θανατος και ουτως εις παντας ανθρωπους ο θανατος διηλθεν εφ ω παντες ημαρτον
transliteration: dia touto wsper di enov anyrwpou h amartia eiv ton kosmon eishlyen kai dia thv amartiav o yanatov kai outwv eiv pantav anyrwpouv o yanatov dihlyen ef w pantev hmarton
draft_translation: Therefore, just as through one human sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed to all humans, because all sinned:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

greek_text: αχρι γαρ νομου αμαρτια ην εν κοσμω αμαρτια δε ουκ ελλογειται μη οντος νομου
transliteration: acri gar nomou amartia hn en kosmw amartia de ouk ellogeitai mh ontov nomou
draft_translation: For until law sin was in the world: but sin is not charged when there is no law.
ukjv_translation: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

greek_text: αλλ εβασιλευσεν ο θανατος απο αδαμ μεχρι μωσεως και επι τους μη αμαρτησαντας επι τω ομοιωματι της παραβασεως αδαμ ος εστιν τυπος του μελλοντος
transliteration: all ebasileusen o yanatov apo adam mecri mwsewv kai epi touv mh amarthsantav epi tw omoiwmati thv parabasewv adam ov estin tupov tou mellontov
draft_translation: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those who had not sinned after the likeness of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him who was to come.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the embodiment of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
