review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized them-that relative; rendered homoioma as likeness

greek_text: αλλ ουχ ως το παραπτωμα ουτως και το χαρισμα ει γαρ τω του ενος παραπτωματι οι πολλοι απεθανον πολλω μαλλον η χαρις του θεου και η δωρεα εν χαριτι τη του ενος ανθρωπου ιησου χριστου εις τους πολλους επερισσευσεν
transliteration: all ouc wv to paraptwma outwv kai to carisma ei gar tw tou enov paraptwmati oi polloi apeyanon pollw mallon h cariv tou yeou kai h dwrea en cariti th tou enov anyrwpou ihsou cristou eiv touv pollouv eperisseusen
draft_translation: But not as the trespass, so also is the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by the one human Jesus Christ, abounded to the many.
ukjv_translation: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, has abounded unto many.

greek_text: και ουχ ως δι ενος αμαρτησαντος το δωρημα το μεν γαρ κριμα εξ ενος εις κατακριμα το δε χαρισμα εκ πολλων παραπτωματων εις δικαιωμα
transliteration: kai ouc wv di enov amarthsantov to dwrhma to men gar krima ex enov eiv katakrima to de carisma ek pollwn paraptwmatwn eiv dikaiwma
draft_translation: And not as through one who sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment from one was to condemnation, but the free gift from many trespasses was to justification.
ukjv_translation: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

greek_text: ει γαρ τω του ενος παραπτωματι ο θανατος εβασιλευσεν δια του ενος πολλω μαλλον οι την περισσειαν της χαριτος και της δωρεας της δικαιοσυνης λαμβανοντες εν ζωη βασιλευσουσιν δια του ενος ιησου χριστου
transliteration: ei gar tw tou enov paraptwmati o yanatov ebasileusen dia tou enov pollw mallon oi thn perisseian thv caritov kai thv dwreav thv dikaiosunhv lambanontev en zwh basileusousin dia tou enov ihsou cristou
draft_translation: For if by the trespass of the one death reigned through the one; much more those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

greek_text: αρα ουν ως δι ενος παραπτωματος εις παντας ανθρωπους εις κατακριμα ουτως και δι ενος δικαιωματος εις παντας ανθρωπους εις δικαιωσιν ζωης
transliteration: ara oun wv di enov paraptwmatov eiv pantav anyrwpouv eiv katakrima outwv kai di enov dikaiwmatov eiv pantav anyrwpouv eiv dikaiwsin zwhv
draft_translation: Therefore then, as through one trespass judgment came to all humans to condemnation; so also through one righteous act the free gift came to all humans to justification of life.
ukjv_translation: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

greek_text: ωσπερ γαρ δια της παρακοης του ενος ανθρωπου αμαρτωλοι κατεσταθησαν οι πολλοι ουτως και δια της υπακοης του ενος δικαιοι κατασταθησονται οι πολλοι
transliteration: wsper gar dia thv parakohv tou enov anyrwpou amartwloi katestayhsan oi polloi outwv kai dia thv upakohv tou enov dikaioi katastayhsontai oi polloi
draft_translation: For as through the disobedience of the one human the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one the many shall be made righteous.
ukjv_translation: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

greek_text: νομος δε παρεισηλθεν ινα πλεοναση το παραπτωμα ου δε επλεονασεν η αμαρτια υπερεπερισσευσεν η χαρις
transliteration: nomov de pareishlyen ina pleonash to paraptwma ou de epleonasen h amartia upereperisseusen h cariv
draft_translation: Moreover the law entered, that the offense might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
ukjv_translation: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

greek_text: ινα ωσπερ εβασιλευσεν η αμαρτια εν τω θανατω ουτως και η χαρις βασιλευση δια δικαιοσυνης εις ζωην αιωνιον δια ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων
transliteration: ina wsper ebasileusen h amartia en tw yanatw outwv kai h cariv basileush dia dikaiosunhv eiv zwhn aiwnion dia ihsou cristou tou kuriou hmwn
draft_translation: That as sin has reigned to death, even so might grace reign through righteousness to eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
ukjv_translation: That as sin has reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν επιμενουμεν τη αμαρτια ινα η χαρις πλεοναση
transliteration: ti oun eroumen epimenoumen th amartia ina h cariv pleonash
draft_translation: What then shall we say? Shall we remain in sin, that grace may abound?
ukjv_translation: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

greek_text: μη γενοιτο οιτινες απεθανομεν τη αμαρτια πως ετι ζησομεν εν αυτη
transliteration: mh genoito oitinev apeyanomen th amartia pwv eti zhsomen en auth
draft_translation: May it not be. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer in it?
ukjv_translation: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
review_notes: modernized therein; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: η αγνοειτε οτι οσοι εβαπτισθημεν εις χριστον ιησουν εις τον θανατον αυτου εβαπτισθημεν
transliteration: h agnoeite oti osoi ebaptisyhmen eiv criston ihsoun eiv ton yanaton autou ebaptisyhmen
draft_translation: Or do you not know that as many of us as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
ukjv_translation: Know all of you not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

greek_text: συνεταφημεν ουν αυτω δια του βαπτισματος εις τον θανατον ινα ωσπερ ηγερθη χριστος εκ νεκρων δια της δοξης του πατρος ουτως και ημεις εν καινοτητι ζωης περιπατησωμεν
transliteration: sunetafhmen oun autw dia tou baptismatov eiv ton yanaton ina wsper hgeryh cristov ek nekrwn dia thv doxhv tou patrov outwv kai hmeiv en kainothti zwhv peripathswmen
draft_translation: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
ukjv_translation: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ει γαρ συμφυτοι γεγοναμεν τω ομοιωματι του θανατου αυτου αλλα και της αναστασεως εσομεθα
transliteration: ei gar sumfutoi gegonamen tw omoiwmati tou yanatou autou alla kai thv anastasewv esomeya
draft_translation: For if we have become united together in the likeness of his death, we shall also be in the likeness of his resurrection:
ukjv_translation: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

greek_text: τουτο γινωσκοντες οτι ο παλαιος ημων ανθρωπος συνεσταυρωθη ινα καταργηθη το σωμα της αμαρτιας του μηκετι δουλευειν ημας τη αμαρτια
transliteration: touto ginwskontev oti o palaiov hmwn anyrwpov sunestaurwyh ina katarghyh to swma thv amartiav tou mhketi douleuein hmav th amartia
draft_translation: Knowing this, that our old human was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be made ineffective, that we should no longer be enslaved to sin.
ukjv_translation: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

greek_text: ο γαρ αποθανων δεδικαιωται απο της αμαρτιας
transliteration: o gar apoyanwn dedikaiwtai apo thv amartiav
draft_translation: For the one who died has been justified from sin.
ukjv_translation: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

greek_text: ει δε απεθανομεν συν χριστω πιστευομεν οτι και συζησομεν αυτω
transliteration: ei de apeyanomen sun cristw pisteuomen oti kai suzhsomen autw
draft_translation: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
ukjv_translation: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι χριστος εγερθεις εκ νεκρων ουκετι αποθνησκει θανατος αυτου ουκετι κυριευει
transliteration: eidotev oti cristov egeryeiv ek nekrwn ouketi apoynhskei yanatov autou ouketi kurieuei
draft_translation: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dies no more; death has no more dominion over him.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dies no more; death has no more dominion over him.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο γαρ απεθανεν τη αμαρτια απεθανεν εφαπαξ ο δε ζη ζη τω θεω
transliteration: o gar apeyanen th amartia apeyanen efapax o de zh zh tw yew
draft_translation: For the death that he died, he died to sin once for all: but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
ukjv_translation: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he lives, he lives unto God.

greek_text: ουτως και υμεις λογιζεσθε εαυτους νεκρους μεν ειναι τη αμαρτια ζωντας δε τω θεω εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
transliteration: outwv kai umeiv logizesye eautouv nekrouv men einai th amartia zwntav de tw yew en cristw ihsou tw kuriw hmwn
draft_translation: Likewise reckon you also yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
ukjv_translation: Likewise reckon all of you also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη ουν βασιλευετω η αμαρτια εν τω θνητω υμων σωματι εις το υπακουειν αυτη εν ταις επιθυμιαις αυτου
transliteration: mh oun basileuetw h amartia en tw ynhtw umwn swmati eiv to upakouein auth en taiv epiyumiaiv autou
draft_translation: Therefore let not sin reign in your mortal body, so that you obey it in its desires.
ukjv_translation: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that all of you should obey it in the lusts thereof.

greek_text: μηδε παριστανετε τα μελη υμων οπλα αδικιας τη αμαρτια αλλα παραστησατε εαυτους τω θεω ως εκ νεκρων ζωντας και τα μελη υμων οπλα δικαιοσυνης τω θεω
transliteration: mhde paristanete ta melh umwn opla adikiav th amartia alla parasthsate eautouv tw yew wv ek nekrwn zwntav kai ta melh umwn opla dikaiosunhv tw yew
draft_translation: Neither present your members as weapons of unrighteousness to sin: but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as weapons of righteousness to God.
ukjv_translation: Neither yield all of you your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

greek_text: αμαρτια γαρ υμων ου κυριευσει ου γαρ εστε υπο νομον αλλ υπο χαριν
transliteration: amartia gar umwn ou kurieusei ou gar este upo nomon all upo carin
draft_translation: For sin shall not have mastery over you: for you are not under law, but under grace.
ukjv_translation: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for all of you are not under the law, but under grace.

greek_text: τι ουν αμαρτησομεν οτι ουκ εσμεν υπο νομον αλλ υπο χαριν μη γενοιτο
transliteration: ti oun amarthsomen oti ouk esmen upo nomon all upo carin mh genoito
draft_translation: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? May it not be.
ukjv_translation: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

greek_text: ουκ οιδατε οτι ω παριστανετε εαυτους δουλους εις υπακοην δουλοι εστε ω υπακουετε ητοι αμαρτιας εις θανατον η υπακοης εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: ouk oidate oti w paristanete eautouv doulouv eiv upakohn douloi este w upakouete htoi amartiav eiv yanaton h upakohv eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: Do you not know, that to whom you yield yourselves slaves to obey, his slaves you are to whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
ukjv_translation: Know all of you not, that to whom all of you yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants all of you are to whom all of you obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized know-you-not question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: χαρις δε τω θεω οτι ητε δουλοι της αμαρτιας υπηκουσατε δε εκ καρδιας εις ον παρεδοθητε τυπον διδαχης
transliteration: cariv de tw yew oti hte douloi thv amartiav uphkousate de ek kardiav eiv on paredoyhte tupon didachv
draft_translation: But God be thanked, that you were the slaves of sin, but you have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
ukjv_translation: But God be thanked, that all of you were the servants of sin, but all of you have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ελευθερωθεντες δε απο της αμαρτιας εδουλωθητε τη δικαιοσυνη
transliteration: eleuyerwyentev de apo thv amartiav edoulwyhte th dikaiosunh
draft_translation: Being then made free from sin, you became the slaves of righteousness.
ukjv_translation: Being then made free from sin, all of you became the servants of righteousness.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ανθρωπινον λεγω δια την ασθενειαν της σαρκος υμων ωσπερ γαρ παρεστησατε τα μελη υμων δουλα τη ακαθαρσια και τη ανομια εις την ανομιαν ουτως νυν παραστησατε τα μελη υμων δουλα τη δικαιοσυνη εις αγιασμον
transliteration: anyrwpinon legw dia thn asyeneian thv sarkov umwn wsper gar paresthsate ta melh umwn doula th akayarsia kai th anomia eiv thn anomian outwv nun parasthsate ta melh umwn doula th dikaiosunh eiv agiasmon
draft_translation: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as you have yielded your members slaves to uncleanness and to iniquity to iniquity; even so now yield your members slaves to righteousness to holiness.
ukjv_translation: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as all of you have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: οτε γαρ δουλοι ητε της αμαρτιας ελευθεροι ητε τη δικαιοσυνη
transliteration: ote gar douloi hte thv amartiav eleuyeroi hte th dikaiosunh
draft_translation: For when you were the slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.
ukjv_translation: For when all of you were the servants of sin, all of you were free from righteousness.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: τινα ουν καρπον ειχετε τοτε εφ οις νυν επαισχυνεσθε το γαρ τελος εκεινων θανατος
transliteration: tina oun karpon eicete tote ef oiv nun epaiscunesye to gar telov ekeinwn yanatov
draft_translation: What fruit therefore did you have then in those things of which you are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
ukjv_translation: What fruit had all of you then in those things whereof all of you are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

greek_text: νυνι δε ελευθερωθεντες απο της αμαρτιας δουλωθεντες δε τω θεω εχετε τον καρπον υμων εις αγιασμον το δε τελος ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: nuni de eleuyerwyentev apo thv amartiav doulwyentev de tw yew ecete ton karpon umwn eiv agiasmon to de telov zwhn aiwnion
draft_translation: But now being made free from sin, and become slaves to God, you have your fruit to holiness, and the end eternal life.
ukjv_translation: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, all of you have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered aionios as eternal; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: τα γαρ οψωνια της αμαρτιας θανατος το δε χαρισμα του θεου ζωη αιωνιος εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
transliteration: ta gar oqwnia thv amartiav yanatov to de carisma tou yeou zwh aiwniov en cristw ihsou tw kuriw hmwn
draft_translation: For the wages of sin is death; but the gracious gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ukjv_translation: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

greek_text: η αγνοειτε αδελφοι γινωσκουσιν γαρ νομον λαλω οτι ο νομος κυριευει του ανθρωπου εφ οσον χρονον ζη
transliteration: h agnoeite adelfoi ginwskousin gar nomon lalw oti o nomov kurieuei tou anyrwpou ef oson cronon zh
draft_translation: Or do you not know, brothers, for I speak to those who know law, that the law rules over the human as long as he lives?
ukjv_translation: Know all of you not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law has dominion over a man as long as he lives?

greek_text: η γαρ υπανδρος γυνη τω ζωντι ανδρι δεδεται νομω εαν δε αποθανη ο ανηρ κατηργηται απο του νομου του ανδρος
transliteration: h gar upandrov gunh tw zwnti andri dedetai nomw ean de apoyanh o anhr kathrghtai apo tou nomou tou androv
draft_translation: For the married woman is bound by law to the living husband; but if the husband dies, she is released from the law of the husband.
ukjv_translation: For the woman which has an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he lives; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

greek_text: αρα ουν ζωντος του ανδρος μοιχαλις χρηματισει εαν γενηται ανδρι ετερω εαν δε αποθανη ο ανηρ ελευθερα εστιν απο του νομου του μη ειναι αυτην μοιχαλιδα γενομενην ανδρι ετερω
transliteration: ara oun zwntov tou androv moicaliv crhmatisei ean genhtai andri eterw ean de apoyanh o anhr eleuyera estin apo tou nomou tou mh einai authn moicalida genomenhn andri eterw
draft_translation: So then, while the husband lives, she shall be called an adulteress if she becomes another man's; but if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is not an adulteress, though she becomes another man's.
ukjv_translation: So then if, while her husband lives, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

greek_text: ωστε αδελφοι μου και υμεις εθανατωθητε τω νομω δια του σωματος του χριστου εις το γενεσθαι υμας ετερω τω εκ νεκρων εγερθεντι ινα καρποφορησωμεν τω θεω
transliteration: wste adelfoi mou kai umeiv eyanatwyhte tw nomw dia tou swmatov tou cristou eiv to genesyai umav eterw tw ek nekrwn egeryenti ina karpoforhswmen tw yew
draft_translation: Therefore, my brothers, you also were put to death to the law through the body of Christ; so that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bear fruit to God.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, my brethren, all of you also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that all of you should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

greek_text: οτε γαρ ημεν εν τη σαρκι τα παθηματα των αμαρτιων τα δια του νομου ενηργειτο εν τοις μελεσιν ημων εις το καρποφορησαι τω θανατω
transliteration: ote gar hmen en th sarki ta payhmata twn amartiwn ta dia tou nomou enhrgeito en toiv melesin hmwn eiv to karpoforhsai tw yanatw
draft_translation: For when we were in the flesh, the passions of sins which were through the law worked in our members to bear fruit to death.
ukjv_translation: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

greek_text: νυνι δε κατηργηθημεν απο του νομου αποθανοντος εν ω κατειχομεθα ωστε δουλευειν ημας εν καινοτητι πνευματος και ου παλαιοτητι γραμματος
transliteration: nuni de kathrghyhmen apo tou nomou apoyanontov en w kateicomeya wste douleuein hmav en kainothti pneumatov kai ou palaiothti grammatov
draft_translation: But now we have been released from the law, having died to that in which we were held, so that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in oldness of letter.
ukjv_translation: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, (o. pneuma) and not in the oldness of the letter.

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν ο νομος αμαρτια μη γενοιτο αλλα την αμαρτιαν ουκ εγνων ει μη δια νομου την τε γαρ επιθυμιαν ουκ ηδειν ει μη ο νομος ελεγεν ουκ επιθυμησεις
transliteration: ti oun eroumen o nomov amartia mh genoito alla thn amartian ouk egnwn ei mh dia nomou thn te gar epiyumian ouk hdein ei mh o nomov elegen ouk epiyumhseiv
draft_translation: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? May it not be. But I did not know sin except through the law: for I had not known desire, unless the law had said, You shall not covet.
ukjv_translation: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, You shall not covet.

greek_text: αφορμην δε λαβουσα η αμαρτια δια της εντολης κατειργασατο εν εμοι πασαν επιθυμιαν χωρις γαρ νομου αμαρτια νεκρα
transliteration: aformhn de labousa h amartia dia thv entolhv kateirgasato en emoi pasan epiyumian cwriv gar nomou amartia nekra
draft_translation: But sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, worked in me every desire. For apart from law sin was dead.
ukjv_translation: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

greek_text: εγω δε εζων χωρις νομου ποτε ελθουσης δε της εντολης η αμαρτια ανεζησεν εγω δε απεθανον
transliteration: egw de ezwn cwriv nomou pote elyoushv de thv entolhv h amartia anezhsen egw de apeyanon
draft_translation: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
ukjv_translation: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ευρεθη μοι η εντολη η εις ζωην αυτη εις θανατον
transliteration: kai eureyh moi h entolh h eiv zwhn auth eiv yanaton
draft_translation: And the commandment which was for life, this was found by me to be for death.
ukjv_translation: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

greek_text: η γαρ αμαρτια αφορμην λαβουσα δια της εντολης εξηπατησεν με και δι αυτης απεκτεινεν
transliteration: h gar amartia aformhn labousa dia thv entolhv exhpathsen me kai di authv apekteinen
draft_translation: For sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
ukjv_translation: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

greek_text: ωστε ο μεν νομος αγιος και η εντολη αγια και δικαια και αγαθη
transliteration: wste o men nomov agiov kai h entolh agia kai dikaia kai agayh
draft_translation: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

greek_text: το ουν αγαθον εμοι γεγονεν θανατος μη γενοιτο αλλα η αμαρτια ινα φανη αμαρτια δια του αγαθου μοι κατεργαζομενη θανατον ινα γενηται καθ υπερβολην αμαρτωλος η αμαρτια δια της εντολης
transliteration: to oun agayon emoi gegonen yanatov mh genoito alla h amartia ina fanh amartia dia tou agayou moi katergazomenh yanaton ina genhtai kay uperbolhn amartwlov h amartia dia thv entolhv
draft_translation: Was then that which is good made death to me? May it not be. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
ukjv_translation: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι ο νομος πνευματικος εστιν εγω δε σαρκικος ειμι πεπραμενος υπο την αμαρτιαν
transliteration: oidamen gar oti o nomov pneumatikov estin egw de sarkikov eimi pepramenov upo thn amartian
draft_translation: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
ukjv_translation: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

greek_text: ο γαρ κατεργαζομαι ου γινωσκω ου γαρ ο θελω τουτο πρασσω αλλ ο μισω τουτο ποιω
transliteration: o gar katergazomai ou ginwskw ou gar o yelw touto prassw all o misw touto poiw
draft_translation: For what I work out I do not know: for what I will, this I do not practice; but what I hate, this I do.
ukjv_translation: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

greek_text: ει δε ο ου θελω τουτο ποιω συμφημι τω νομω οτι καλος
transliteration: ei de o ou yelw touto poiw sumfhmi tw nomw oti kalov
draft_translation: If then I do what I do not will, I agree with the law that it is good.
ukjv_translation: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

greek_text: νυνι δε ουκετι εγω κατεργαζομαι αυτο αλλ η οικουσα εν εμοι αμαρτια
transliteration: nuni de ouketi egw katergazomai auto all h oikousa en emoi amartia
draft_translation: Now then it is no longer I who work it out, but sin dwelling in me.
ukjv_translation: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.

greek_text: οιδα γαρ οτι ουκ οικει εν εμοι τουτ εστιν εν τη σαρκι μου αγαθον το γαρ θελειν παρακειται μοι το δε κατεργαζεσθαι το καλον ουχ ευρισκω
transliteration: oida gar oti ouk oikei en emoi tout estin en th sarki mou agayon to gar yelein parakeitai moi to de katergazesyai to kalon ouc euriskw
draft_translation: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, good does not dwell: for to will is present with me; but to work out the good I do not find.
ukjv_translation: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwells no good thing: in order to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

greek_text: ου γαρ ο θελω ποιω αγαθον αλλ ο ου θελω κακον τουτο πρασσω
transliteration: ou gar o yelw poiw agayon all o ou yelw kakon touto prassw
draft_translation: For the good that I will, I do not do: but the evil that I do not will, this I practice.
ukjv_translation: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

greek_text: ει δε ο ου θελω εγω τουτο ποιω ουκετι εγω κατεργαζομαι αυτο αλλ η οικουσα εν εμοι αμαρτια
transliteration: ei de o ou yelw egw touto poiw ouketi egw katergazomai auto all h oikousa en emoi amartia
draft_translation: Now if what I do not will, this I do, it is no longer I who work it out, but sin dwelling in me.
ukjv_translation: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.

greek_text: ευρισκω αρα τον νομον τω θελοντι εμοι ποιειν το καλον οτι εμοι το κακον παρακειται
transliteration: euriskw ara ton nomon tw yelonti emoi poiein to kalon oti emoi to kakon parakeitai
draft_translation: I find then the law, that to me willing to do the good, evil lies near me.
ukjv_translation: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

greek_text: συνηδομαι γαρ τω νομω του θεου κατα τον εσω ανθρωπον
transliteration: sunhdomai gar tw nomw tou yeou kata ton esw anyrwpon
draft_translation: For I delight in the law of God according to the inner human:
ukjv_translation: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

greek_text: βλεπω δε ετερον νομον εν τοις μελεσιν μου αντιστρατευομενον τω νομω του νοος μου και αιχμαλωτιζοντα με τω νομω της αμαρτιας τω οντι εν τοις μελεσιν μου
transliteration: blepw de eteron nomon en toiv melesin mou antistrateuomenon tw nomw tou noov mou kai aicmalwtizonta me tw nomw thv amartiav tw onti en toiv melesin mou
draft_translation: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and making me captive to the law of sin which is in my members.
ukjv_translation: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

greek_text: ταλαιπωρος εγω ανθρωπος τις με ρυσεται εκ του σωματος του θανατου τουτου
transliteration: talaipwrov egw anyrwpov tiv me rusetai ek tou swmatov tou yanatou toutou
draft_translation: O wretched human that I am! who shall rescue me from the body of this death?
ukjv_translation: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

greek_text: ευχαριστω τω θεω δια ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων αρα ουν αυτος εγω τω μεν νοι δουλευω νομω θεου τη δε σαρκι νομω αμαρτιας
transliteration: eucaristw tw yew dia ihsou cristou tou kuriou hmwn ara oun autov egw tw men noi douleuw nomw yeou th de sarki nomw amartiav
draft_translation: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve God's law; but with the flesh, sin's law.
ukjv_translation: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

greek_text: ουδεν αρα νυν κατακριμα τοις εν χριστω ιησου μη κατα σαρκα περιπατουσιν αλλα κατα πνευμα
transliteration: ouden ara nun katakrima toiv en cristw ihsou mh kata sarka peripatousin alla kata pneuma
draft_translation: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to flesh, but according to Spirit.
ukjv_translation: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: ο γαρ νομος του πνευματος της ζωης εν χριστω ιησου ηλευθερωσεν με απο του νομου της αμαρτιας και του θανατου
transliteration: o gar nomov tou pneumatov thv zwhv en cristw ihsou hleuyerwsen me apo tou nomou thv amartiav kai tou yanatou
draft_translation: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
ukjv_translation: For the law of the Spirit (o. pneuma) of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: το γαρ αδυνατον του νομου εν ω ησθενει δια της σαρκος ο θεος τον εαυτου υιον πεμψας εν ομοιωματι σαρκος αμαρτιας και περι αμαρτιας κατεκρινεν την αμαρτιαν εν τη σαρκι
transliteration: to gar adunaton tou nomou en w hsyenei dia thv sarkov o yeov ton eautou uion pemqav en omoiwmati sarkov amartiav kai peri amartiav katekrinen thn amartian en th sarki
draft_translation: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
ukjv_translation: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ινα το δικαιωμα του νομου πληρωθη εν ημιν τοις μη κατα σαρκα περιπατουσιν αλλα κατα πνευμα
transliteration: ina to dikaiwma tou nomou plhrwyh en hmin toiv mh kata sarka peripatousin alla kata pneuma
draft_translation: That the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to flesh, but according to Spirit.
ukjv_translation: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: οι γαρ κατα σαρκα οντες τα της σαρκος φρονουσιν οι δε κατα πνευμα τα του πνευματος
transliteration: oi gar kata sarka ontev ta thv sarkov fronousin oi de kata pneuma ta tou pneumatov
draft_translation: For those who are according to flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those according to Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
ukjv_translation: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit (o. pneuma) the things of the Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: το γαρ φρονημα της σαρκος θανατος το δε φρονημα του πνευματος ζωη και ειρηνη
transliteration: to gar fronhma thv sarkov yanatov to de fronhma tou pneumatov zwh kai eirhnh
draft_translation: For the mind of the flesh is death; but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace.
ukjv_translation: In order to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually (o. pneuma) minded is life and peace.

greek_text: διοτι το φρονημα της σαρκος εχθρα εις θεον τω γαρ νομω του θεου ουχ υποτασσεται ουδε γαρ δυναται
transliteration: dioti to fronhma thv sarkov ecyra eiv yeon tw gar nomw tou yeou ouc upotassetai oude gar dunatai
draft_translation: Because the mind of the flesh is enmity toward God: for it is not subject to the law of God, nor indeed can it be.
ukjv_translation: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

greek_text: οι δε εν σαρκι οντες θεω αρεσαι ου δυνανται
transliteration: oi de en sarki ontev yew aresai ou dunantai
draft_translation: And those who are in flesh cannot please God.
ukjv_translation: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

greek_text: υμεις δε ουκ εστε εν σαρκι αλλ εν πνευματι ειπερ πνευμα θεου οικει εν υμιν ει δε τις πνευμα χριστου ουκ εχει ουτος ουκ εστιν αυτου
transliteration: umeiv de ouk este en sarki all en pneumati eiper pneuma yeou oikei en umin ei de tiv pneuma cristou ouk ecei outov ouk estin autou
draft_translation: But you are not in flesh, but in Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, this one is not his.
ukjv_translation: But all of you are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) if so be that the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit (o. pneuma) of Christ, he is none of his.

greek_text: ει δε χριστος εν υμιν το μεν σωμα νεκρον δι αμαρτιαν το δε πνευμα ζωη δια δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: ei de cristov en umin to men swma nekron di amartian to de pneuma zwh dia dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: And if Christ is in you, the body indeed is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
ukjv_translation: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit (o. pneuma) is life because of righteousness.

greek_text: ει δε το πνευμα του εγειραντος ιησουν εκ νεκρων οικει εν υμιν ο εγειρας τον χριστον εκ νεκρων ζωοποιησει και τα θνητα σωματα υμων δια του ενοικουντος αυτου πνευματος εν υμιν
transliteration: ei de to pneuma tou egeirantov ihsoun ek nekrwn oikei en umin o egeirav ton criston ek nekrwn zwopoihsei kai ta ynhta swmata umwn dia tou enoikountov autou pneumatov en umin
draft_translation: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, the one who raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwells in you.
ukjv_translation: But if the Spirit (o. pneuma) of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit (o. pneuma) that dwells in you.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αρα ουν αδελφοι οφειλεται εσμεν ου τη σαρκι του κατα σαρκα ζην
transliteration: ara oun adelfoi ofeiletai esmen ou th sarki tou kata sarka zhn
draft_translation: Therefore then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to flesh.
ukjv_translation: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

greek_text: ει γαρ κατα σαρκα ζητε μελλετε αποθνησκειν ει δε πνευματι τας πραξεις του σωματος θανατουτε ζησεσθε
transliteration: ei gar kata sarka zhte mellete apoynhskein ei de pneumati tav praxeiv tou swmatov yanatoute zhsesye
draft_translation: For if you live according to flesh, you are about to die: but if by Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you shall live.
ukjv_translation: For if all of you live after the flesh, all of you shall die: but if all of you through the Spirit (o. pneuma) do mortify the deeds of the body, all of you shall live.

greek_text: οσοι γαρ πνευματι θεου αγονται ουτοι εισιν υιοι θεου
transliteration: osoi gar pneumati yeou agontai outoi eisin uioi yeou
draft_translation: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.
ukjv_translation: For as many as are led by the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God, they are the sons of God.

greek_text: ου γαρ ελαβετε πνευμα δουλειας παλιν εις φοβον αλλ ελαβετε πνευμα υιοθεσιας εν ω κραζομεν αββα ο πατηρ
transliteration: ou gar elabete pneuma douleiav palin eiv fobon all elabete pneuma uioyesiav en w krazomen abba o pathr
draft_translation: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery again to fear; but you received the Spirit of adoption as sons, in whom we cry, Abba, Father.
ukjv_translation: For all of you have not received the spirit (o. pneuma) of bondage again to fear; but all of you have received the Spirit (o. pneuma) of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

greek_text: αυτο το πνευμα συμμαρτυρει τω πνευματι ημων οτι εσμεν τεκνα θεου
transliteration: auto to pneuma summarturei tw pneumati hmwn oti esmen tekna yeou
draft_translation: The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit, that we are children of God:
ukjv_translation: The Spirit (o. pneuma) itself bears witness with our spirit, (o. pneuma) that we are the children of God:

greek_text: ει δε τεκνα και κληρονομοι κληρονομοι μεν θεου συγκληρονομοι δε χριστου ειπερ συμπασχομεν ινα και συνδοξασθωμεν
transliteration: ei de tekna kai klhronomoi klhronomoi men yeou sugklhronomoi de cristou eiper sumpascomen ina kai sundoxasywmen
draft_translation: And if children, also heirs; heirs indeed of God, and co-heirs of Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified together.
ukjv_translation: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

greek_text: λογιζομαι γαρ οτι ουκ αξια τα παθηματα του νυν καιρου προς την μελλουσαν δοξαν αποκαλυφθηναι εις ημας
transliteration: logizomai gar oti ouk axia ta payhmata tou nun kairou prov thn mellousan doxan apokalufyhnai eiv hmav
draft_translation: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy compared with the coming glory to be revealed to us.
ukjv_translation: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

greek_text: η γαρ αποκαραδοκια της κτισεως την αποκαλυψιν των υιων του θεου απεκδεχεται
transliteration: h gar apokaradokia thv ktisewv thn apokaluqin twn uiwn tou yeou apekdecetai
draft_translation: For the eager expectation of the creation waits for the revelation of the sons of God.
ukjv_translation: For the earn expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of God.

greek_text: τη γαρ ματαιοτητι η κτισις υπεταγη ουχ εκουσα αλλα δια τον υποταξαντα επ ελπιδι
transliteration: th gar mataiothti h ktisiv upetagh ouc ekousa alla dia ton upotaxanta ep elpidi
draft_translation: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not willingly, but because of the one who subjected it, upon hope,
ukjv_translation: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who has subjected the same in hope,

greek_text: οτι και αυτη η κτισις ελευθερωθησεται απο της δουλειας της φθορας εις την ελευθεριαν της δοξης των τεκνων του θεου
transliteration: oti kai auth h ktisiv eleuyerwyhsetai apo thv douleiav thv fyorav eiv thn eleuyerian thv doxhv twn teknwn tou yeou
draft_translation: Because the creation itself also shall be freed from the slavery of corruption into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.
ukjv_translation: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

greek_text: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι πασα η κτισις συστεναζει και συνωδινει αχρι του νυν
transliteration: oidamen gar oti pasa h ktisiv sustenazei kai sunwdinei acri tou nun
draft_translation: For we know that the whole creation groans together and travails together until now.
ukjv_translation: For we know that the whole creation groans and labors in pain together until now.

greek_text: ου μονον δε αλλα και αυτοι την απαρχην του πνευματος εχοντες και ημεις αυτοι εν εαυτοις στεναζομεν υιοθεσιαν απεκδεχομενοι την απολυτρωσιν του σωματος ημων
transliteration: ou monon de alla kai autoi thn aparchn tou pneumatov econtev kai hmeiv autoi en eautoiv stenazomen uioyesian apekdecomenoi thn apolutrwsin tou swmatov hmwn
draft_translation: And not only this, but we ourselves also, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, eagerly waiting for adoption as sons, the redemption of our body.
ukjv_translation: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the first-fruits of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to know, the redemption of our body.

greek_text: τη γαρ ελπιδι εσωθημεν ελπις δε βλεπομενη ουκ εστιν ελπις ο γαρ βλεπει τις τι και ελπιζει
transliteration: th gar elpidi eswyhmen elpiv de blepomenh ouk estin elpiv o gar blepei tiv ti kai elpizei
draft_translation: For in hope we were saved: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what anyone sees, why does he also hope for it?
ukjv_translation: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man sees, why does he yet hope for?

greek_text: ει δε ο ου βλεπομεν ελπιζομεν δι υπομονης απεκδεχομεθα
transliteration: ei de o ou blepomen elpizomen di upomonhv apekdecomeya
draft_translation: But if we hope for what we do not see, through endurance we eagerly wait for it.
ukjv_translation: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

greek_text: ωσαυτως δε και το πνευμα συναντιλαμβανεται ταις ασθενειαις ημων το γαρ τι προσευξωμεθα καθο δει ουκ οιδαμεν αλλ αυτο το πνευμα υπερεντυγχανει υπερ ημων στεναγμοις αλαλητοις
transliteration: wsautwv de kai to pneuma sunantilambanetai taiv asyeneiaiv hmwn to gar ti proseuxwmeya kayo dei ouk oidamen all auto to pneuma uperentugcanei uper hmwn stenagmoiv alalhtoiv
draft_translation: Likewise also the Spirit helps our weaknesses: for we do not know what we should pray as we ought: but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with unspoken groanings.
ukjv_translation: Likewise the Spirit (o. pneuma) also helps our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit (o. pneuma) itself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

greek_text: ο δε ερευνων τας καρδιας οιδεν τι το φρονημα του πνευματος οτι κατα θεον εντυγχανει υπερ αγιων
transliteration: o de ereunwn tav kardiav oiden ti to fronhma tou pneumatov oti kata yeon entugcanei uper agiwn
draft_translation: And the one who searches the hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because he makes intercession for the holy ones according to the will of God.
ukjv_translation: And he that searches the hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) because he makes intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: οιδαμεν δε οτι τοις αγαπωσιν τον θεον παντα συνεργει εις αγαθον τοις κατα προθεσιν κλητοις ουσιν
transliteration: oidamen de oti toiv agapwsin ton yeon panta sunergei eiv agayon toiv kata proyesin klhtoiv ousin
draft_translation: And we know that to those who love God all things work together for good, to those who are called according to purpose.
ukjv_translation: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

greek_text: οτι ους προεγνω και προωρισεν συμμορφους της εικονος του υιου αυτου εις το ειναι αυτον πρωτοτοκον εν πολλοις αδελφοις
transliteration: oti ouv proegnw kai prowrisen summorfouv thv eikonov tou uiou autou eiv to einai auton prwtotokon en polloiv adelfoiv
draft_translation: Because whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, so that he might be firstborn among many brothers.
ukjv_translation: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

greek_text: ους δε προωρισεν τουτους και εκαλεσεν και ους εκαλεσεν τουτους και εδικαιωσεν ους δε εδικαιωσεν τουτους και εδοξασεν
transliteration: ouv de prowrisen toutouv kai ekalesen kai ouv ekalesen toutouv kai edikaiwsen ouv de edikaiwsen toutouv kai edoxasen
draft_translation: And whom he predestined, these he also called: and whom he called, these he also justified: and whom he justified, these he also glorified.
ukjv_translation: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν προς ταυτα ει ο θεος υπερ ημων τις καθ ημων
transliteration: ti oun eroumen prov tauta ei o yeov uper hmwn tiv kay hmwn
draft_translation: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
ukjv_translation: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

greek_text: ος γε του ιδιου υιου ουκ εφεισατο αλλ υπερ ημων παντων παρεδωκεν αυτον πως ουχι και συν αυτω τα παντα ημιν χαρισεται
transliteration: ov ge tou idiou uiou ouk efeisato all uper hmwn pantwn paredwken auton pwv ouci kai sun autw ta panta hmin carisetai
draft_translation: He who did not spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not also with him freely give us all things?
ukjv_translation: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

greek_text: τις εγκαλεσει κατα εκλεκτων θεου θεος ο δικαιων
transliteration: tiv egkalesei kata eklektwn yeou yeov o dikaiwn
draft_translation: Who shall bring a charge against God's elect? God is the one justifying.
ukjv_translation: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifies.

greek_text: τις ο κατακρινων χριστος ο αποθανων μαλλον δε και εγερθεις ος και εστιν εν δεξια του θεου ος και εντυγχανει υπερ ημων
transliteration: tiv o katakrinwn cristov o apoyanwn mallon de kai egeryeiv ov kai estin en dexia tou yeou ov kai entugcanei uper hmwn
draft_translation: Who is the one condemning? Christ is the one who died, rather also was raised, who also is at the right hand of God, who also intercedes for us.
ukjv_translation: Who is he that condemns? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that has risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

greek_text: τις ημας χωρισει απο της αγαπης του χριστου θλιψις η στενοχωρια η διωγμος η λιμος η γυμνοτης η κινδυνος η μαχαιρα
transliteration: tiv hmav cwrisei apo thv agaphv tou cristou yliqiv h stenocwria h diwgmov h limov h gumnothv h kindunov h macaira
draft_translation: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?
ukjv_translation: Who shall separate us from the love (o. agape) of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται οτι ενεκα σου θανατουμεθα ολην την ημεραν ελογισθημεν ως προβατα σφαγης
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai oti eneka sou yanatoumeya olhn thn hmeran elogisyhmen wv probata sfaghv
draft_translation: As it is written, For your sake we are put to death all the day long; we were reckoned as sheep of slaughter.
ukjv_translation: As it is written, For your sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

greek_text: αλλ εν τουτοις πασιν υπερνικωμεν δια του αγαπησαντος ημας
transliteration: all en toutoiv pasin upernikwmen dia tou agaphsantov hmav
draft_translation: But in all these things we more than conquer through him who loved us.
ukjv_translation: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

greek_text: πεπεισμαι γαρ οτι ουτε θανατος ουτε ζωη ουτε αγγελοι ουτε αρχαι ουτε δυναμεις ουτε ενεστωτα ουτε μελλοντα
transliteration: pepeismai gar oti oute yanatov oute zwh oute aggeloi oute arcai oute dunameiv oute enestwta oute mellonta
draft_translation: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor rulers, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
ukjv_translation: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

greek_text: ουτε υψωμα ουτε βαθος ουτε τις κτισις ετερα δυνησεται ημας χωρισαι απο της αγαπης του θεου της εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
transliteration: oute uqwma oute bayov oute tiv ktisiv etera dunhsetai hmav cwrisai apo thv agaphv tou yeou thv en cristw ihsou tw kuriw hmwn
draft_translation: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ukjv_translation: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love (o. agape) of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
review_notes: fixed non-person relative after love; modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αληθειαν λεγω εν χριστω ου ψευδομαι συμμαρτυρουσης μοι της συνειδησεως μου εν πνευματι αγιω
transliteration: alhyeian legw en cristw ou qeudomai summarturoushv moi thv suneidhsewv mou en pneumati agiw
draft_translation: I speak truth in Christ, I do not lie, my conscience bearing witness with me in the Holy Spirit,
ukjv_translation: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma)

greek_text: οτι λυπη μοι εστιν μεγαλη και αδιαλειπτος οδυνη τη καρδια μου
transliteration: oti luph moi estin megalh kai adialeiptov odunh th kardia mou
draft_translation: That I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
ukjv_translation: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

greek_text: ηυχομην γαρ αυτος εγω αναθεμα ειναι απο του χριστου υπερ των αδελφων μου των συγγενων μου κατα σαρκα
transliteration: hucomhn gar autov egw anayema einai apo tou cristou uper twn adelfwn mou twn suggenwn mou kata sarka
draft_translation: For I could wish that I myself were accursed away from Christ for my brothers, my kinsmen according to flesh:
ukjv_translation: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

greek_text: οιτινες εισιν ισραηλιται ων η υιοθεσια και η δοξα και αι διαθηκαι και η νομοθεσια και η λατρεια και αι επαγγελιαι
transliteration: oitinev eisin israhlitai wn h uioyesia kai h doxa kai ai diayhkai kai h nomoyesia kai h latreia kai ai epaggeliai
draft_translation: Who are Israelites; to whom belong the adoption as sons, and the glory, and the covenants, and the lawgiving, and the service, and the promises;
ukjv_translation: Who are Israelites; to whom pertains the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

greek_text: ων οι πατερες και εξ ων ο χριστος το κατα σαρκα ο ων επι παντων θεος ευλογητος εις τους αιωνας αμην
transliteration: wn oi paterev kai ex wn o cristov to kata sarka o wn epi pantwn yeov euloghtov eiv touv aiwnav amhn
draft_translation: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

greek_text: ουχ οιον δε οτι εκπεπτωκεν ο λογος του θεου ου γαρ παντες οι εξ ισραηλ ουτοι ισραηλ
transliteration: ouc oion de oti ekpeptwken o logov tou yeou ou gar pantev oi ex israhl outoi israhl
draft_translation: But it is not as though the word of God has fallen. For not all those from Israel are Israel:
ukjv_translation: Not as though the word (o. logos) of God has taken no effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

greek_text: ουδ οτι εισιν σπερμα αβρααμ παντες τεκνα αλλ εν ισαακ κληθησεται σοι σπερμα
transliteration: oud oti eisin sperma abraam pantev tekna all en isaak klhyhsetai soi sperma
draft_translation: Nor because they are Abraham's seed are they all children: but, In Isaac your seed shall be called.
ukjv_translation: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall your seed be called.

greek_text: τουτ εστιν ου τα τεκνα της σαρκος ταυτα τεκνα του θεου αλλα τα τεκνα της επαγγελιας λογιζεται εις σπερμα
transliteration: tout estin ou ta tekna thv sarkov tauta tekna tou yeou alla ta tekna thv epaggeliav logizetai eiv sperma
draft_translation: That is, the children of the flesh, these are not children of God: but the children of the promise are reckoned as seed.
ukjv_translation: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

greek_text: επαγγελιας γαρ ο λογος ουτος κατα τον καιρον τουτον ελευσομαι και εσται τη σαρρα υιος
transliteration: epaggeliav gar o logov outov kata ton kairon touton eleusomai kai estai th sarra uiov
draft_translation: For this is the word of promise, At this time I will come, and Sarah shall have a son.
ukjv_translation: For this is the word (o. logos) of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.

greek_text: ου μονον δε αλλα και ρεβεκκα εξ ενος κοιτην εχουσα ισαακ του πατρος ημων
transliteration: ou monon de alla kai rebekka ex enov koithn ecousa isaak tou patrov hmwn
draft_translation: And not only this; but Rebekah also, having conceived by one, our father Isaac;
ukjv_translation: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

greek_text: μηπω γαρ γεννηθεντων μηδε πραξαντων τι αγαθον η κακον ινα η κατ εκλογην του θεου προθεσις μενη ουκ εξ εργων αλλ εκ του καλουντος
transliteration: mhpw gar gennhyentwn mhde praxantwn ti agayon h kakon ina h kat ekloghn tou yeou proyesiv menh ouk ex ergwn all ek tou kalountov
draft_translation: For the children not yet having been born, nor having done anything good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might remain, not from works, but from the one who calls,
ukjv_translation: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calls;)

greek_text: ερρηθη αυτη οτι ο μειζων δουλευσει τω ελασσονι
transliteration: errhyh auth oti o meizwn douleusei tw elassoni
draft_translation: It was said to her, The greater shall serve the lesser.
ukjv_translation: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται τον ιακωβ ηγαπησα τον δε ησαυ εμισησα
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai ton iakwb hgaphsa ton de hsau emishsa
draft_translation: As it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.
ukjv_translation: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν μη αδικια παρα τω θεω μη γενοιτο
transliteration: ti oun eroumen mh adikia para tw yew mh genoito
draft_translation: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it not be.
ukjv_translation: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

greek_text: τω γαρ μωση λεγει ελεησω ον αν ελεω και οικτειρησω ον αν οικτειρω
transliteration: tw gar mwsh legei elehsw on an elew kai oikteirhsw on an oikteirw
draft_translation: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.
ukjv_translation: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

greek_text: αρα ουν ου του θελοντος ουδε του τρεχοντος αλλα του ελεουντος θεου
transliteration: ara oun ou tou yelontov oude tou trecontov alla tou eleountov yeou
draft_translation: So then it is not of the one willing, nor of the one running, but of God showing mercy.
ukjv_translation: So then it is not of him that wills, nor of him that runs, but of God that shows mercy.

greek_text: λεγει γαρ η γραφη τω φαραω οτι εις αυτο τουτο εξηγειρα σε οπως ενδειξωμαι εν σοι την δυναμιν μου και οπως διαγγελη το ονομα μου εν παση τη γη
transliteration: legei gar h grafh tw faraw oti eiv auto touto exhgeira se opwv endeixwmai en soi thn dunamin mou kai opwv diaggelh to onoma mou en pash th gh
draft_translation: For the scripture says to Pharaoh, For this very purpose I raised you up, that I might show my power in you, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.
ukjv_translation: For the scripture says unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised you up, that I might show my power in you, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

greek_text: αρα ουν ον θελει ελεει ον δε θελει σκληρυνει
transliteration: ara oun on yelei eleei on de yelei sklhrunei
draft_translation: Therefore then he has mercy on whom he wills, and whom he wills he hardens.
ukjv_translation: Therefore has he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardens.

greek_text: ερεις ουν μοι τι ετι μεμφεται τω γαρ βουληματι αυτου τις ανθεστηκεν
transliteration: ereiv oun moi ti eti memfetai tw gar boulhmati autou tiv anyesthken
draft_translation: You will say then to me, Why does he still find fault? For who has resisted his will?
ukjv_translation: You will say then unto me, Why does he yet find fault? For who has resisted his will?

greek_text: μενουνγε ω ανθρωπε συ τις ει ο ανταποκρινομενος τω θεω μη ερει το πλασμα τω πλασαντι τι με εποιησας ουτως
transliteration: menounge w anyrwpe su tiv ei o antapokrinomenov tw yew mh erei to plasma tw plasanti ti me epoihsav outwv
draft_translation: On the contrary, O human, who are you answering back to God? Shall the thing formed say to the one who formed it, Why did you make me thus?
ukjv_translation: On the contrary; O man, who are you that reply against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why have you made me thus?

greek_text: η ουκ εχει εξουσιαν ο κεραμευς του πηλου εκ του αυτου φυραματος ποιησαι ο μεν εις τιμην σκευος ο δε εις ατιμιαν
transliteration: h ouk ecei exousian o kerameuv tou phlou ek tou autou furamatov poihsai o men eiv timhn skeuov o de eiv atimian
draft_translation: Or does the potter not have authority over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
ukjv_translation: Has not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

greek_text: ει δε θελων ο θεος ενδειξασθαι την οργην και γνωρισαι το δυνατον αυτου ηνεγκεν εν πολλη μακροθυμια σκευη οργης κατηρτισμενα εις απωλειαν
transliteration: ei de yelwn o yeov endeixasyai thn orghn kai gnwrisai to dunaton autou hnegken en pollh makroyumia skeuh orghv kathrtismena eiv apwleian
draft_translation: But if God, willing to show wrath and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering vessels of wrath fitted for destruction:
ukjv_translation: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

greek_text: και ινα γνωριση τον πλουτον της δοξης αυτου επι σκευη ελεους α προητοιμασεν εις δοξαν
transliteration: kai ina gnwrish ton plouton thv doxhv autou epi skeuh eleouv a prohtoimasen eiv doxan
draft_translation: And that he might make known the riches of his glory upon vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
ukjv_translation: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had before prepared unto glory,

greek_text: ους και εκαλεσεν ημας ου μονον εξ ιουδαιων αλλα και εξ εθνων
transliteration: ouv kai ekalesen hmav ou monon ex ioudaiwn alla kai ex eynwn
draft_translation: Even us, whom he has called, not of the Jews only, but also of the nations?
ukjv_translation: Even us, whom he has called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

greek_text: ως και εν τω ωσηε λεγει καλεσω τον ου λαον μου λαον μου και την ουκ ηγαπημενην ηγαπημενην
transliteration: wv kai en tw wshe legei kalesw ton ou laon mou laon mou kai thn ouk hgaphmenhn hgaphmenhn
draft_translation: As he says also in Hosea, I will call the one not my people, My people; and the one not beloved, Beloved.
ukjv_translation: As he says also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

greek_text: και εσται εν τω τοπω ου ερρηθη αυτοις ου λαος μου υμεις εκει κληθησονται υιοι θεου ζωντος
transliteration: kai estai en tw topw ou errhyh autoiv ou laov mou umeiv ekei klhyhsontai uioi yeou zwntov
draft_translation: And it shall be, in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people; there they shall be called sons of the living God.
ukjv_translation: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, All of you are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

greek_text: ησαιας δε κραζει υπερ του ισραηλ εαν η ο αριθμος των υιων ισραηλ ως η αμμος της θαλασσης το καταλειμμα σωθησεται
transliteration: hsaiav de krazei uper tou israhl ean h o ariymov twn uiwn israhl wv h ammov thv yalasshv to kataleimma swyhsetai
draft_translation: Isaiah also cries concerning Israel, Though the number of the sons of Israel be as the sand of the sea, the remnant shall be saved:
ukjv_translation: Isaiah also cries concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

greek_text: λογον γαρ συντελων και συντεμνων εν δικαιοσυνη οτι λογον συντετμημενον ποιησει κυριος επι της γης
transliteration: logon gar suntelwn kai suntemnwn en dikaiosunh oti logon suntetmhmenon poihsei kuriov epi thv ghv
draft_translation: For the Lord will complete and cut short the matter in righteousness; because the Lord will make a matter cut short upon the earth.
ukjv_translation: For he will finish the work, (o. logos) and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work (o. logos) will the Lord make upon the earth.

greek_text: και καθως προειρηκεν ησαιας ει μη κυριος σαβαωθ εγκατελιπεν ημιν σπερμα ως σοδομα αν εγενηθημεν και ως γομορρα αν ωμοιωθημεν
transliteration: kai kaywv proeirhken hsaiav ei mh kuriov sabawy egkatelipen hmin sperma wv sodoma an egenhyhmen kai wv gomorra an wmoiwyhmen
draft_translation: And as Isaiah said before, Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us seed, we would have become as Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.
ukjv_translation: And as Isaiah said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

greek_text: τι ουν ερουμεν οτι εθνη τα μη διωκοντα δικαιοσυνην κατελαβεν δικαιοσυνην δικαιοσυνην δε την εκ πιστεως
transliteration: ti oun eroumen oti eynh ta mh diwkonta dikaiosunhn katelaben dikaiosunhn dikaiosunhn de thn ek pistewv
draft_translation: What shall we say then? That the nations, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
ukjv_translation: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

greek_text: ισραηλ δε διωκων νομον δικαιοσυνης εις νομον δικαιοσυνης ουκ εφθασεν
transliteration: israhl de diwkwn nomon dikaiosunhv eiv nomon dikaiosunhv ouk efyasen
draft_translation: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.
ukjv_translation: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: δια τι οτι ουκ εκ πιστεως αλλ ως εξ εργων νομου προσεκοψαν γαρ τω λιθω του προσκομματος
transliteration: dia ti oti ouk ek pistewv all wv ex ergwn nomou prosekoqan gar tw liyw tou proskommatov
draft_translation: Why? Because they sought it not from faith, but as from works of law. For they stumbled at the stone of stumbling;
ukjv_translation: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumbling stone;

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται ιδου τιθημι εν σιων λιθον προσκομματος και πετραν σκανδαλου και πας ο πιστευων επ αυτω ου καταισχυνθησεται
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai idou tiyhmi en siwn liyon proskommatov kai petran skandalou kai pav o pisteuwn ep autw ou kataiscunyhsetai
draft_translation: As it is written, Look, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and rock of stumbling: and whoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.
ukjv_translation: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumbling stone and rock of offence: and whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.

greek_text: αδελφοι η μεν ευδοκια της εμης καρδιας και η δεησις η προς τον θεον υπερ του ισραηλ εστιν εις σωτηριαν
transliteration: adelfoi h men eudokia thv emhv kardiav kai h dehsiv h prov ton yeon uper tou israhl estin eiv swthrian
draft_translation: Brothers, the good pleasure of my heart and my prayer to God for Israel is for salvation.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

greek_text: μαρτυρω γαρ αυτοις οτι ζηλον θεου εχουσιν αλλ ου κατ επιγνωσιν
transliteration: marturw gar autoiv oti zhlon yeou ecousin all ou kat epignwsin
draft_translation: For I bear them witness that they have zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
ukjv_translation: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

greek_text: αγνοουντες γαρ την του θεου δικαιοσυνην και την ιδιαν δικαιοσυνην ζητουντες στησαι τη δικαιοσυνη του θεου ουχ υπεταγησαν
transliteration: agnoountev gar thn tou yeou dikaiosunhn kai thn idian dikaiosunhn zhtountev sthsai th dikaiosunh tou yeou ouc upetaghsan
draft_translation: For being ignorant of the righteousness of God, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they did not submit to the righteousness of God.
ukjv_translation: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

greek_text: τελος γαρ νομου χριστος εις δικαιοσυνην παντι τω πιστευοντι
transliteration: telov gar nomou cristov eiv dikaiosunhn panti tw pisteuonti
draft_translation: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believes.
ukjv_translation: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believes.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: μωσης γαρ γραφει την δικαιοσυνην την εκ του νομου οτι ο ποιησας αυτα ανθρωπος ζησεται εν αυτοις
transliteration: mwshv gar grafei thn dikaiosunhn thn ek tou nomou oti o poihsav auta anyrwpov zhsetai en autoiv
draft_translation: For Moses writes of the righteousness which is from law, The human who does these things shall live in them.
ukjv_translation: For Moses describes the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which does those things shall live by them.

greek_text: η δε εκ πιστεως δικαιοσυνη ουτως λεγει μη ειπης εν τη καρδια σου τις αναβησεται εις τον ουρανον τουτ εστιν χριστον καταγαγειν
transliteration: h de ek pistewv dikaiosunh outwv legei mh eiphv en th kardia sou tiv anabhsetai eiv ton ouranon tout estin criston katagagein
draft_translation: But the righteousness from faith speaks thus, Do not say in your heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? that is, to bring Christ down:
ukjv_translation: But the righteousness which is of faith speaks likewise, Say not in yours heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

greek_text: η τις καταβησεται εις την αβυσσον τουτ εστιν χριστον εκ νεκρων αναγαγειν
transliteration: h tiv katabhsetai eiv thn abusson tout estin criston ek nekrwn anagagein
draft_translation: Or, Who shall descend into the abyss? that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.
ukjv_translation: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

greek_text: αλλα τι λεγει εγγυς σου το ρημα εστιν εν τω στοματι σου και εν τη καρδια σου τουτ εστιν το ρημα της πιστεως ο κηρυσσομεν
transliteration: alla ti legei egguv sou to rhma estin en tw stomati sou kai en th kardia sou tout estin to rhma thv pistewv o khrussomen
draft_translation: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart: that is, the word of faith which we preach;
ukjv_translation: But what says it? The word (o. rhema) is nigh you, even in your mouth, and in your heart: that is, the word (o. rhema) of faith, which we preach;

greek_text: οτι εαν ομολογησης εν τω στοματι σου κυριον ιησουν και πιστευσης εν τη καρδια σου οτι ο θεος αυτον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων σωθηση
transliteration: oti ean omologhshv en tw stomati sou kurion ihsoun kai pisteushv en th kardia sou oti o yeov auton hgeiren ek nekrwn swyhsh
draft_translation: That if you shall confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus, and shall believe in your heart that God has raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.
ukjv_translation: That if you shall confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus, and shall believe in yours heart that God has raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.
review_notes: modernized yours before noun; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: καρδια γαρ πιστευεται εις δικαιοσυνην στοματι δε ομολογειται εις σωτηριαν
transliteration: kardia gar pisteuetai eiv dikaiosunhn stomati de omologeitai eiv swthrian
draft_translation: For with the heart one believes to righteousness; and with the mouth one confesses to salvation.
ukjv_translation: For with the heart man believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

greek_text: λεγει γαρ η γραφη πας ο πιστευων επ αυτω ου καταισχυνθησεται
transliteration: legei gar h grafh pav o pisteuwn ep autw ou kataiscunyhsetai
draft_translation: For the scripture says, Everyone who believes on him shall not be put to shame.
ukjv_translation: For the scripture says, Whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν διαστολη ιουδαιου τε και ελληνος ο γαρ αυτος κυριος παντων πλουτων εις παντας τους επικαλουμενους αυτον
transliteration: ou gar estin diastolh ioudaiou te kai ellhnov o gar autov kuriov pantwn ploutwn eiv pantav touv epikaloumenouv auton
draft_translation: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek: for the same Lord of all is rich toward all who call upon him.
ukjv_translation: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

greek_text: πας γαρ ος αν επικαλεσηται το ονομα κυριου σωθησεται
transliteration: pav gar ov an epikaleshtai to onoma kuriou swyhsetai
draft_translation: For whoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

greek_text: πως ουν επικαλεσονται εις ον ουκ επιστευσαν πως δε πιστευσουσιν ου ουκ ηκουσαν πως δε ακουσουσιν χωρις κηρυσσοντος
transliteration: pwv oun epikalesontai eiv on ouk episteusan pwv de pisteusousin ou ouk hkousan pwv de akousousin cwriv khrussontov
draft_translation: How then shall they call upon him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without one preaching?
ukjv_translation: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

greek_text: πως δε κηρυξουσιν εαν μη αποσταλωσιν καθως γεγραπται ως ωραιοι οι ποδες των ευαγγελιζομενων ειρηνην των ευαγγελιζομενων τα αγαθα
transliteration: pwv de khruxousin ean mh apostalwsin kaywv gegraptai wv wraioi oi podev twn euaggelizomenwn eirhnhn twn euaggelizomenwn ta agaya
draft_translation: And how shall they preach, unless they are sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
ukjv_translation: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; modernized them-that relative; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αλλ ου παντες υπηκουσαν τω ευαγγελιω ησαιας γαρ λεγει κυριε τις επιστευσεν τη ακοη ημων
transliteration: all ou pantev uphkousan tw euaggeliw hsaiav gar legei kurie tiv episteusen th akoh hmwn
draft_translation: But they have not all obeyed the good news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has believed our report?
ukjv_translation: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has believed our report?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αρα η πιστις εξ ακοης η δε ακοη δια ρηματος θεου
transliteration: ara h pistiv ex akohv h de akoh dia rhmatov yeou
draft_translation: So then faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of God.
ukjv_translation: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word (o. rhema) of God.

greek_text: αλλα λεγω μη ουκ ηκουσαν μενουνγε εις πασαν την γην εξηλθεν ο φθογγος αυτων και εις τα περατα της οικουμενης τα ρηματα αυτων
transliteration: alla legw mh ouk hkousan menounge eiv pasan thn ghn exhlyen o fyoggov autwn kai eiv ta perata thv oikoumenhv ta rhmata autwn
draft_translation: But I say, Did they not hear? Yes indeed, Their sound went out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the inhabited world.
ukjv_translation: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words (o. rhema) unto the ends of the world.

greek_text: αλλα λεγω μη ουκ εγνω ισραηλ πρωτος μωσης λεγει εγω παραζηλωσω υμας επ ουκ εθνει επι εθνει ασυνετω παροργιω υμας
transliteration: alla legw mh ouk egnw israhl prwtov mwshv legei egw parazhlwsw umav ep ouk eynei epi eynei asunetw parorgiw umav
draft_translation: But I say, Did Israel not know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy by those who are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
ukjv_translation: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

greek_text: ησαιας δε αποτολμα και λεγει ευρεθην τοις εμε μη ζητουσιν εμφανης εγενομην τοις εμε μη επερωτωσιν
transliteration: hsaiav de apotolma kai legei eureyhn toiv eme mh zhtousin emfanhv egenomhn toiv eme mh eperwtwsin
draft_translation: But Isaiah is very bold, and says, I was found by those not seeking me; I became manifest to those not asking for me.
ukjv_translation: But Isaiah is very bold, and says, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

greek_text: προς δε τον ισραηλ λεγει ολην την ημεραν εξεπετασα τας χειρας μου προς λαον απειθουντα και αντιλεγοντα
transliteration: prov de ton israhl legei olhn thn hmeran exepetasa tav ceirav mou prov laon apeiyounta kai antilegonta
draft_translation: But to Israel he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands to a disobedient and contradicting people.
ukjv_translation: But to Israel he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

greek_text: λεγω ουν μη απωσατο ο θεος τον λαον αυτου μη γενοιτο και γαρ εγω ισραηλιτης ειμι εκ σπερματος αβρααμ φυλης βενιαμιν
transliteration: legw oun mh apwsato o yeov ton laon autou mh genoito kai gar egw israhlithv eimi ek spermatov abraam fulhv beniamin
draft_translation: I say then, Has God cast away his people? May it not be. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
ukjv_translation: I say then, Has God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

greek_text: ουκ απωσατο ο θεος τον λαον αυτου ον προεγνω η ουκ οιδατε εν ηλια τι λεγει η γραφη ως εντυγχανει τω θεω κατα του ισραηλ λεγων
transliteration: ouk apwsato o yeov ton laon autou on proegnw h ouk oidate en hlia ti legei h grafh wv entugcanei tw yew kata tou israhl legwn
draft_translation: God has not cast away his people whom he foreknew. Do you not know what the scripture says of Elijah? how he makes intercession to God against Israel saying,
ukjv_translation: God has not cast away his people which he foreknew. Know all of you not what the scripture says of Elijah? how he makes intercession to God against Israel saying,
review_notes: fixed whom relative after people; modernized know-you-not question; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: κυριε τους προφητας σου απεκτειναν και τα θυσιαστηρια σου κατεσκαψαν καγω υπελειφθην μονος και ζητουσιν την ψυχην μου
transliteration: kurie touv profhtav sou apekteinan kai ta yusiasthria sou kateskaqan kagw upeleifyhn monov kai zhtousin thn quchn mou
draft_translation: Lord, they have killed your prophets, and dug down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
ukjv_translation: Lord, they have killed your prophets, and dug down yours altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
review_notes: modernized yours before noun; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: αλλα τι λεγει αυτω ο χρηματισμος κατελιπον εμαυτω επτακισχιλιους ανδρας οιτινες ουκ εκαμψαν γονυ τη βααλ
transliteration: alla ti legei autw o crhmatismov katelipon emautw eptakisciliouv andrav oitinev ouk ekamqan gonu th baal
draft_translation: But what does the divine answer say to him? I left for myself seven thousand men who did not bow the knee to Baal.
ukjv_translation: But what says the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

greek_text: ουτως ουν και εν τω νυν καιρω λειμμα κατ εκλογην χαριτος γεγονεν
transliteration: outwv oun kai en tw nun kairw leimma kat ekloghn caritov gegonen
draft_translation: So then also in the present time a remnant according to election of grace has come to be.
ukjv_translation: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

greek_text: ει δε χαριτι ουκετι εξ εργων επει η χαρις ουκετι γινεται χαρις ει δε εξ εργων ουκετι εστιν χαρις επει το εργον ουκετι εστιν εργον
transliteration: ei de cariti ouketi ex ergwn epei h cariv ouketi ginetai cariv ei de ex ergwn ouketi estin cariv epei to ergon ouketi estin ergon
