draft_translation: And if by grace, no longer from works: otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if from works, it is no longer grace: otherwise work is no longer work.
ukjv_translation: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then it is no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

greek_text: τι ουν ο επιζητει ισραηλ τουτου ουκ επετυχεν η δε εκλογη επετυχεν οι δε λοιποι επωρωθησαν
transliteration: ti oun o epizhtei israhl toutou ouk epetucen h de eklogh epetucen oi de loipoi epwrwyhsan
draft_translation: What then? Israel did not obtain what it seeks; but the election obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
ukjv_translation: What then? Israel has not obtained that which he seeks for; but the election has obtained it, and the rest were blinded.

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται εδωκεν αυτοις ο θεος πνευμα κατανυξεως οφθαλμους του μη βλεπειν και ωτα του μη ακουειν εως της σημερον ημερας
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai edwken autoiv o yeov pneuma katanuxewv ofyalmouv tou mh blepein kai wta tou mh akouein ewv thv shmeron hmerav
draft_translation: As it is written, God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes not to see, and ears not to hear, until this day.
ukjv_translation: (According as it is written, God has given them the spirit (o. pneuma) of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

greek_text: και δαβιδ λεγει γενηθητω η τραπεζα αυτων εις παγιδα και εις θηραν και εις σκανδαλον και εις ανταποδομα αυτοις
transliteration: kai dabid legei genhyhtw h trapeza autwn eiv pagida kai eiv yhran kai eiv skandalon kai eiv antapodoma autoiv
draft_translation: And David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompense to them:
ukjv_translation: And David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompence unto them:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized recompence spelling

greek_text: σκοτισθητωσαν οι οφθαλμοι αυτων του μη βλεπειν και τον νωτον αυτων δια παντος συγκαμψον
transliteration: skotisyhtwsan oi ofyalmoi autwn tou mh blepein kai ton nwton autwn dia pantov sugkamqon
draft_translation: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bend their back continually.
ukjv_translation: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back always.

greek_text: λεγω ουν μη επταισαν ινα πεσωσιν μη γενοιτο αλλα τω αυτων παραπτωματι η σωτηρια τοις εθνεσιν εις το παραζηλωσαι αυτους
transliteration: legw oun mh eptaisan ina peswsin mh genoito alla tw autwn paraptwmati h swthria toiv eynesin eiv to parazhlwsai autouv
draft_translation: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? May it not be: but rather through their fall salvation has come to the nations, in order to provoke them to jealousy.
ukjv_translation: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation has come unto the Gentiles, in order to provoke them to jealousy.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: ει δε το παραπτωμα αυτων πλουτος κοσμου και το ηττημα αυτων πλουτος εθνων ποσω μαλλον το πληρωμα αυτων
transliteration: ei de to paraptwma autwn ploutov kosmou kai to htthma autwn ploutov eynwn posw mallon to plhrwma autwn
draft_translation: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the nations; how much more their fullness?
ukjv_translation: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

greek_text: υμιν γαρ λεγω τοις εθνεσιν εφ οσον μεν ειμι εγω εθνων αποστολος την διακονιαν μου δοξαζω
transliteration: umin gar legw toiv eynesin ef oson men eimi egw eynwn apostolov thn diakonian mou doxazw
draft_translation: For I speak to you who are of the nations, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the nations, I magnify my ministry:
ukjv_translation: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

greek_text: ει πως παραζηλωσω μου την σαρκα και σωσω τινας εξ αυτων
transliteration: ei pwv parazhlwsw mou thn sarka kai swsw tinav ex autwn
draft_translation: If somehow I may provoke my flesh to jealousy, and may save some of them.
ukjv_translation: If by any means I may provoke to awaken jealousy in them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

greek_text: ει γαρ η αποβολη αυτων καταλλαγη κοσμου τις η προσληψις ει μη ζωη εκ νεκρων
transliteration: ei gar h apobolh autwn katallagh kosmou tiv h proslhqiv ei mh zwh ek nekrwn
draft_translation: For if their rejection is reconciliation of the world, what shall their reception be, except life from the dead?
ukjv_translation: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

greek_text: ει δε η απαρχη αγια και το φυραμα και ει η ριζα αγια και οι κλαδοι
transliteration: ei de h aparch agia kai to furama kai ei h riza agia kai oi kladoi
draft_translation: And if the firstfruit is holy, so also the lump: and if the root is holy, so also the branches.
ukjv_translation: For if the first-fruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

greek_text: ει δε τινες των κλαδων εξεκλασθησαν συ δε αγριελαιος ων ενεκεντρισθης εν αυτοις και συγκοινωνος της ριζης και της πιοτητος της ελαιας εγενου
transliteration: ei de tinev twn kladwn exeklasyhsan su de agrielaiov wn enekentrisyhv en autoiv kai sugkoinwnov thv rizhv kai thv piothtov thv elaiav egenou
draft_translation: And if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive shoot, were grafted in among them, and became a fellow-partaker of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
ukjv_translation: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them, and with them partake of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

greek_text: μη κατακαυχω των κλαδων ει δε κατακαυχασαι ου συ την ριζαν βασταζεις αλλ η ριζα σε
transliteration: mh katakaucw twn kladwn ei de katakaucasai ou su thn rizan bastazeiv all h riza se
draft_translation: Do not boast against the branches. But if you boast, you do not bear the root, but the root bears you.
ukjv_translation: Boast not against the branches. But if you boast, you bear not the root, but the root you.

greek_text: ερεις ουν εξεκλασθησαν οι κλαδοι ινα εγω εγκεντρισθω
transliteration: ereiv oun exeklasyhsan oi kladoi ina egw egkentrisyw
draft_translation: You will say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.
ukjv_translation: You will say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.

greek_text: καλως τη απιστια εξεκλασθησαν συ δε τη πιστει εστηκας μη υψηλοφρονει αλλα φοβου
transliteration: kalwv th apistia exeklasyhsan su de th pistei esthkav mh uqhlofronei alla fobou
draft_translation: Rightly; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Do not be high-minded, but fear:
ukjv_translation: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Be not high-minded, but fear:

greek_text: ει γαρ ο θεος των κατα φυσιν κλαδων ουκ εφεισατο μηπως ουδε σου φεισηται
transliteration: ei gar o yeov twn kata fusin kladwn ouk efeisato mhpwv oude sou feishtai
draft_translation: For if God did not spare the natural branches, perhaps he will not spare you either.
ukjv_translation: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not you.

greek_text: ιδε ουν χρηστοτητα και αποτομιαν θεου επι μεν τους πεσοντας αποτομιαν επι δε σε χρηστοτητα εαν επιμεινης τη χρηστοτητι επει και συ εκκοπηση
transliteration: ide oun crhstothta kai apotomian yeou epi men touv pesontav apotomian epi de se crhstothta ean epimeinhv th crhstothti epei kai su ekkophsh
draft_translation: Look therefore at the kindness and severity of God: upon those who fell, severity; but toward you, kindness, if you continue in kindness: otherwise you also shall be cut off.
ukjv_translation: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness: otherwise you also shall be cut off.

greek_text: και εκεινοι δε εαν μη επιμεινωσιν τη απιστια εγκεντρισθησονται δυνατος γαρ εστιν ο θεος παλιν εγκεντρισαι αυτους
transliteration: kai ekeinoi de ean mh epimeinwsin th apistia egkentrisyhsontai dunatov gar estin o yeov palin egkentrisai autouv
draft_translation: And they also, if they do not remain in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.
ukjv_translation: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.

greek_text: ει γαρ συ εκ της κατα φυσιν εξεκοπης αγριελαιου και παρα φυσιν ενεκεντρισθης εις καλλιελαιον ποσω μαλλον ουτοι οι κατα φυσιν εγκεντρισθησονται τη ιδια ελαια
transliteration: ei gar su ek thv kata fusin exekophv agrielaiou kai para fusin enekentrisyhv eiv kallielaion posw mallon outoi oi kata fusin egkentrisyhsontai th idia elaia
draft_translation: For if you were cut out of the olive tree wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree: how much more shall these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
ukjv_translation: For if you were cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

greek_text: ου γαρ θελω υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι το μυστηριον τουτο ινα μη ητε παρ εαυτοις φρονιμοι οτι πωρωσις απο μερους τω ισραηλ γεγονεν αχρις ου το πληρωμα των εθνων εισελθη
transliteration: ou gar yelw umav agnoein adelfoi to musthrion touto ina mh hte par eautoiv fronimoi oti pwrwsiv apo merouv tw israhl gegonen acriv ou to plhrwma twn eynwn eiselyh
draft_translation: For I would not, brothers, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the nations comes in.
ukjv_translation: For I would not, brethren, that all of you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest all of you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles be come in.

greek_text: και ουτως πας ισραηλ σωθησεται καθως γεγραπται ηξει εκ σιων ο ρυομενος και αποστρεψει ασεβειας απο ιακωβ
transliteration: kai outwv pav israhl swyhsetai kaywv gegraptai hxei ek siwn o ruomenov kai apostreqei asebeiav apo iakwb
draft_translation: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, The Deliverer shall come out of Zion, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
ukjv_translation: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

greek_text: και αυτη αυτοις η παρ εμου διαθηκη οταν αφελωμαι τας αμαρτιας αυτων
transliteration: kai auth autoiv h par emou diayhkh otan afelwmai tav amartiav autwn
draft_translation: And this is the covenant from me to them, when I take away their sins.
ukjv_translation: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

greek_text: κατα μεν το ευαγγελιον εχθροι δι υμας κατα δε την εκλογην αγαπητοι δια τους πατερας
transliteration: kata men to euaggelion ecyroi di umav kata de thn ekloghn agaphtoi dia touv paterav
draft_translation: As concerning the good news, they are enemies for your sakes: but as concerning the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.
ukjv_translation: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as concerning the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.

greek_text: αμεταμελητα γαρ τα χαρισματα και η κλησις του θεου
transliteration: ametamelhta gar ta carismata kai h klhsiv tou yeou
draft_translation: For the gracious gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
ukjv_translation: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

greek_text: ωσπερ γαρ και υμεις ποτε ηπειθησατε τω θεω νυν δε ηλεηθητε τη τουτων απειθεια
transliteration: wsper gar kai umeiv pote hpeiyhsate tw yew nun de hlehyhte th toutwn apeiyeia
draft_translation: For just as you once disobeyed God, but now obtained mercy by their disobedience:
ukjv_translation: For as all of you in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

greek_text: ουτως και ουτοι νυν ηπειθησαν τω υμετερω ελεει ινα και αυτοι ελεηθωσιν
transliteration: outwv kai outoi nun hpeiyhsan tw umeterw eleei ina kai autoi elehywsin
draft_translation: So also these now disobeyed, that by your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
ukjv_translation: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

greek_text: συνεκλεισεν γαρ ο θεος τους παντας εις απειθειαν ινα τους παντας ελεηση
transliteration: sunekleisen gar o yeov touv pantav eiv apeiyeian ina touv pantav elehsh
draft_translation: For God shut up all into disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
ukjv_translation: For God has concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

greek_text: ω βαθος πλουτου και σοφιας και γνωσεως θεου ως ανεξερευνητα τα κριματα αυτου και ανεξιχνιαστοι αι οδοι αυτου
transliteration: w bayov ploutou kai sofiav kai gnwsewv yeou wv anexereunhta ta krimata autou kai anexicniastoi ai odoi autou
draft_translation: O depth of riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and untraceable his ways!
ukjv_translation: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

greek_text: τις γαρ εγνω νουν κυριου η τις συμβουλος αυτου εγενετο
transliteration: tiv gar egnw noun kuriou h tiv sumboulov autou egeneto
draft_translation: For who has known the mind of the Lord? or who has been his counselor?
ukjv_translation: For who has known the mind of the Lord? or who has been his counsellor?
review_notes: modernized counsellor spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: η τις προεδωκεν αυτω και ανταποδοθησεται αυτω
transliteration: h tiv proedwken autw kai antapodoyhsetai autw
draft_translation: Or who first gave to him, and it shall be repaid to him?
ukjv_translation: Or who has first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

greek_text: οτι εξ αυτου και δι αυτου και εις αυτον τα παντα αυτω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην
transliteration: oti ex autou kai di autou kai eiv auton ta panta autw h doxa eiv touv aiwnav amhn
draft_translation: For from him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to him be glory forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

greek_text: παρακαλω ουν υμας αδελφοι δια των οικτιρμων του θεου παραστησαι τα σωματα υμων θυσιαν ζωσαν αγιαν ευαρεστον τω θεω την λογικην λατρειαν υμων
transliteration: parakalw oun umav adelfoi dia twn oiktirmwn tou yeou parasthsai ta swmata umwn yusian zwsan agian euareston tw yew thn logikhn latreian umwn
draft_translation: Therefore I exhort you, brothers, through the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God, your reasonable service.
ukjv_translation: I plead to you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that all of you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

greek_text: και μη συσχηματιζεσθε τω αιωνι τουτω αλλα μεταμορφουσθε τη ανακαινωσει του νοος υμων εις το δοκιμαζειν υμας τι το θελημα του θεου το αγαθον και ευαρεστον και τελειον
transliteration: kai mh suschmatizesye tw aiwni toutw alla metamorfousye th anakainwsei tou noov umwn eiv to dokimazein umav ti to yelhma tou yeou to agayon kai euareston kai teleion
draft_translation: And do not be conformed to this age: but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what the will of God is, the good and acceptable and perfect.
ukjv_translation: And be not conformed to this world: but be all of you transformed by the renewing of your mind, that all of you may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

greek_text: λεγω γαρ δια της χαριτος της δοθεισης μοι παντι τω οντι εν υμιν μη υπερφρονειν παρ ο δει φρονειν αλλα φρονειν εις το σωφρονειν εκαστω ως ο θεος εμερισεν μετρον πιστεως
transliteration: legw gar dia thv caritov thv doyeishv moi panti tw onti en umin mh uperfronein par o dei fronein alla fronein eiv to swfronein ekastw wv o yeov emerisen metron pistewv
draft_translation: For I say, through the grace given to me, to everyone who is among you, not to think more highly than he ought to think; but to think so as to be sober-minded, as God divided to each a measure of faith.
ukjv_translation: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God has dealt to every man the measure of faith.

greek_text: καθαπερ γαρ εν ενι σωματι μελη πολλα εχομεν τα δε μελη παντα ου την αυτην εχει πραξιν
transliteration: kayaper gar en eni swmati melh polla ecomen ta de melh panta ou thn authn ecei praxin
draft_translation: For just as in one body we have many members, and all the members do not have the same function:
ukjv_translation: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

greek_text: ουτως οι πολλοι εν σωμα εσμεν εν χριστω ο δε καθ εις αλληλων μελη
transliteration: outwv oi polloi en swma esmen en cristw o de kay eiv allhlwn melh
draft_translation: So we, the many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.
ukjv_translation: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

greek_text: εχοντες δε χαρισματα κατα την χαριν την δοθεισαν ημιν διαφορα ειτε προφητειαν κατα την αναλογιαν της πιστεως
transliteration: econtev de carismata kata thn carin thn doyeisan hmin diafora eite profhteian kata thn analogian thv pistewv
draft_translation: And having gifts differing according to the grace given to us, whether prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;
ukjv_translation: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

greek_text: ειτε διακονιαν εν τη διακονια ειτε ο διδασκων εν τη διδασκαλια
transliteration: eite diakonian en th diakonia eite o didaskwn en th didaskalia
draft_translation: Or ministry, in ministry; or the one who teaches, in teaching;
ukjv_translation: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teaches, on teaching;

greek_text: ειτε ο παρακαλων εν τη παρακλησει ο μεταδιδους εν απλοτητι ο προισταμενος εν σπουδη ο ελεων εν ιλαροτητι
transliteration: eite o parakalwn en th paraklhsei o metadidouv en aplothti o proistamenov en spoudh o elewn en ilarothti
draft_translation: Or the one who exhorts, in exhortation: the one who gives, in simplicity; the one who leads, in diligence; the one who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.
ukjv_translation: Or he that exhorts, on exhortation: he that gives, let him do it with simplicity; he that rules, with diligence; he that shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

greek_text: η αγαπη ανυποκριτος αποστυγουντες το πονηρον κολλωμενοι τω αγαθω
transliteration: h agaph anupokritov apostugountev to ponhron kollwmenoi tw agayw
draft_translation: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor what is evil; cling to what is good.
ukjv_translation: Let love (o. agape) be without dissimulation. Detest that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

greek_text: τη φιλαδελφια εις αλληλους φιλοστοργοι τη τιμη αλληλους προηγουμενοι
transliteration: th filadelfia eiv allhlouv filostorgoi th timh allhlouv prohgoumenoi
draft_translation: In brotherly love be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor leading one another;
ukjv_translation: Be kindly affectionate one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

greek_text: τη σπουδη μη οκνηροι τω πνευματι ζεοντες τω κυριω δουλευοντες
transliteration: th spoudh mh oknhroi tw pneumati zeontev tw kuriw douleuontev
draft_translation: In diligence not lazy; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
ukjv_translation: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; (o. pneuma) serving the Lord;

greek_text: τη ελπιδι χαιροντες τη θλιψει υπομενοντες τη προσευχη προσκαρτερουντες
transliteration: th elpidi cairontev th yliqei upomenontev th proseuch proskarterountev
draft_translation: Rejoicing in hope; enduring in tribulation; persevering in prayer;
ukjv_translation: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

greek_text: ταις χρειαις των αγιων κοινωνουντες την φιλοξενιαν διωκοντες
transliteration: taiv creiaiv twn agiwn koinwnountev thn filoxenian diwkontev
draft_translation: Distributing to the necessity of holy ones; given to hospitality.
ukjv_translation: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

greek_text: ευλογειτε τους διωκοντας υμας ευλογειτε και μη καταρασθε
transliteration: eulogeite touv diwkontav umav eulogeite kai mh katarasye
draft_translation: Bless those who persecute you: bless, and do not curse.
ukjv_translation: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

greek_text: χαιρειν μετα χαιροντων και κλαιειν μετα κλαιοντων
transliteration: cairein meta cairontwn kai klaiein meta klaiontwn
draft_translation: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.
ukjv_translation: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

greek_text: το αυτο εις αλληλους φρονουντες μη τα υψηλα φρονουντες αλλα τοις ταπεινοις συναπαγομενοι μη γινεσθε φρονιμοι παρ εαυτοις
transliteration: to auto eiv allhlouv fronountev mh ta uqhla fronountev alla toiv tapeinoiv sunapagomenoi mh ginesye fronimoi par eautoiv
draft_translation: Being of the same mind toward one another. Not minding high things, but being carried along with the lowly. Do not become wise with yourselves.
ukjv_translation: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

greek_text: μηδενι κακον αντι κακου αποδιδοντες προνοουμενοι καλα ενωπιον παντων ανθρωπων
transliteration: mhdeni kakon anti kakou apodidontev pronooumenoi kala enwpion pantwn anyrwpwn
draft_translation: Repaying evil for evil to no one. Providing good things before all humans.
ukjv_translation: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

greek_text: ει δυνατον το εξ υμων μετα παντων ανθρωπων ειρηνευοντες
transliteration: ei dunaton to ex umwn meta pantwn anyrwpwn eirhneuontev
draft_translation: If possible, as much as depends on you, live peaceably with all humans.
ukjv_translation: If it be possible, as much as lies in you, live peaceably with all men.

greek_text: μη εαυτους εκδικουντες αγαπητοι αλλα δοτε τοπον τη οργη γεγραπται γαρ εμοι εκδικησις εγω ανταποδωσω λεγει κυριος
transliteration: mh eautouv ekdikountev agaphtoi alla dote topon th orgh gegraptai gar emoi ekdikhsiv egw antapodwsw legei kuriov
draft_translation: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but give place to wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says the Lord.

greek_text: εαν ουν πεινα ο εχθρος σου ψωμιζε αυτον εαν διψα ποτιζε αυτον τουτο γαρ ποιων ανθρακας πυρος σωρευσεις επι την κεφαλην αυτου
transliteration: ean oun peina o ecyrov sou qwmize auton ean diqa potize auton touto gar poiwn anyrakav purov swreuseiv epi thn kefalhn autou
draft_translation: Therefore if your enemy hungers, feed him; if he thirsts, give him drink: for in doing this you shall heap coals of fire on his head.
ukjv_translation: Therefore if yours enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.

greek_text: μη νικω υπο του κακου αλλα νικα εν τω αγαθω το κακον
transliteration: mh nikw upo tou kakou alla nika en tw agayw to kakon
draft_translation: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
ukjv_translation: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

greek_text: πασα ψυχη εξουσιαις υπερεχουσαις υποτασσεσθω ου γαρ εστιν εξουσια ει μη απο θεου αι δε ουσαι εξουσιαι υπο του θεου τεταγμεναι εισιν
transliteration: pasa quch exousiaiv uperecousaiv upotassesyw ou gar estin exousia ei mh apo yeou ai de ousai exousiai upo tou yeou tetagmenai eisin
draft_translation: Let every soul be subject to the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that exist are ordained of God.
ukjv_translation: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized powers-that-be wording

greek_text: ωστε ο αντιτασσομενος τη εξουσια τη του θεου διαταγη ανθεστηκεν οι δε ανθεστηκοτες εαυτοις κριμα ληψονται
transliteration: wste o antitassomenov th exousia th tou yeou diatagh anyesthken oi de anyesthkotev eautoiv krima lhqontai
draft_translation: Whoever therefore resists the power, resists the ordinance of God: and those who resist shall receive to themselves judgment.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever therefore resists the power, resists the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; modernized whosoever; rendered krima/krisis as judgment

greek_text: οι γαρ αρχοντες ουκ εισιν φοβος των αγαθων εργων αλλα των κακων θελεις δε μη φοβεισθαι την εξουσιαν το αγαθον ποιει και εξεις επαινον εξ αυτης
transliteration: oi gar arcontev ouk eisin fobov twn agaywn ergwn alla twn kakwn yeleiv de mh fobeisyai thn exousian to agayon poiei kai exeiv epainon ex authv
draft_translation: For rulers are not a terror to good work, but to evil. Do you want not to fear the authority? do what is good, and you shall have praise from it:
ukjv_translation: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Will you then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and you shall have praise of the same:

greek_text: θεου γαρ διακονος εστιν σοι εις το αγαθον εαν δε το κακον ποιης φοβου ου γαρ εικη την μαχαιραν φορει θεου γαρ διακονος εστιν εκδικος εις οργην τω το κακον πρασσοντι
transliteration: yeou gar diakonov estin soi eiv to agayon ean de to kakon poihv fobou ou gar eikh thn macairan forei yeou gar diakonov estin ekdikov eiv orghn tw to kakon prassonti
draft_translation: For he is God's servant to you for good. But if you do evil, fear; for he does not bear the sword in vain: for he is God's servant, an avenger for wrath to the one who practices evil.
ukjv_translation: For he is the minister of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid; for he bears not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that does evil.

greek_text: διο αναγκη υποτασσεσθαι ου μονον δια την οργην αλλα και δια την συνειδησιν
transliteration: dio anagkh upotassesyai ou monon dia thn orghn alla kai dia thn suneidhsin
draft_translation: Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath, but also because of conscience.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore all of you must essentially be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

greek_text: δια τουτο γαρ και φορους τελειτε λειτουργοι γαρ θεου εισιν εις αυτο τουτο προσκαρτερουντες
transliteration: dia touto gar kai forouv teleite leitourgoi gar yeou eisin eiv auto touto proskarterountev
draft_translation: For because of this you also pay taxes: for they are God's public servants, attending continually to this very thing.
ukjv_translation: For for this cause pay all of you tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

greek_text: αποδοτε ουν πασιν τας οφειλας τω τον φορον τον φορον τω το τελος το τελος τω τον φοβον τον φοβον τω την τιμην την τιμην
transliteration: apodote oun pasin tav ofeilav tw ton foron ton foron tw to telov to telov tw ton fobon ton fobon tw thn timhn thn timhn
draft_translation: Render therefore to all what is owed: tax to whom tax, custom to whom custom, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.
ukjv_translation: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

greek_text: μηδενι μηδεν οφειλετε ει μη το αγαπαν αλληλους ο γαρ αγαπων τον ετερον νομον πεπληρωκεν
transliteration: mhdeni mhden ofeilete ei mh to agapan allhlouv o gar agapwn ton eteron nomon peplhrwken
draft_translation: Owe nothing to anyone, except to love one another: for the one who loves the other has fulfilled the law.
ukjv_translation: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loves another has fulfilled the law.

greek_text: το γαρ ου μοιχευσεις ου φονευσεις ου κλεψεις ου ψευδομαρτυρησεις ουκ επιθυμησεις και ει τις ετερα εντολη εν τουτω τω λογω ανακεφαλαιουται εν τω αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως εαυτον
transliteration: to gar ou moiceuseiv ou foneuseiv ou kleqeiv ou qeudomarturhseiv ouk epiyumhseiv kai ei tiv etera entolh en toutw tw logw anakefalaioutai en tw agaphseiv ton plhsion sou wv eauton
draft_translation: For this, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness, You shall not covet; and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
ukjv_translation: For this, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not kill, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness, You shall not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, (o. logos) namely, You shall love your neighbour as yourself.

greek_text: η αγαπη τω πλησιον κακον ουκ εργαζεται πληρωμα ουν νομου η αγαπη
transliteration: h agaph tw plhsion kakon ouk ergazetai plhrwma oun nomou h agaph
draft_translation: Love works no evil to the neighbor: therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
ukjv_translation: Love (o. agape) works no ill to his neighbour: therefore love (o. agape) is the fulfilling of the law.

greek_text: και τουτο ειδοτες τον καιρον οτι ωρα ημας ηδη εξ υπνου εγερθηναι νυν γαρ εγγυτερον ημων η σωτηρια η οτε επιστευσαμεν
transliteration: kai touto eidotev ton kairon oti wra hmav hdh ex upnou egeryhnai nun gar egguteron hmwn h swthria h ote episteusamen
draft_translation: And this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for us to be raised out of sleep: for now our salvation is nearer than when we believed.
ukjv_translation: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

greek_text: η νυξ προεκοψεν η δε ημερα ηγγικεν αποθωμεθα ουν τα εργα του σκοτους και ενδυσωμεθα τα οπλα του φωτος
transliteration: h nux proekoqen h de hmera hggiken apoywmeya oun ta erga tou skotouv kai enduswmeya ta opla tou fwtov
draft_translation: The night advanced, and the day has drawn near: therefore let us put off the works of darkness, and let us put on the weapons of light.
ukjv_translation: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

greek_text: ως εν ημερα ευσχημονως περιπατησωμεν μη κωμοις και μεθαις μη κοιταις και ασελγειαις μη εριδι και ζηλω
transliteration: wv en hmera euschmonwv peripathswmen mh kwmoiv kai meyaiv mh koitaiv kai aselgeiaiv mh eridi kai zhlw
draft_translation: Let us walk decently, as in the day; not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and licentiousness, not in strife and envy.
ukjv_translation: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

greek_text: αλλ ενδυσασθε τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον και της σαρκος προνοιαν μη ποιεισθε εις επιθυμιας
transliteration: all endusasye ton kurion ihsoun criston kai thv sarkov pronoian mh poieisye eiv epiyumiav
draft_translation: But put you on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfill the lusts of it.
ukjv_translation: But put all of you on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfill the lusts thereof.
review_notes: modernized thereof; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τον δε ασθενουντα τη πιστει προσλαμβανεσθε μη εις διακρισεις διαλογισμων
transliteration: ton de asyenounta th pistei proslambanesye mh eiv diakriseiv dialogismwn
draft_translation: Receive the one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes of reasonings.
ukjv_translation: Him that is weak in the faith receive all of you, but not to doubtful disputations.

greek_text: ος μεν πιστευει φαγειν παντα ο δε ασθενων λαχανα εσθιει
transliteration: ov men pisteuei fagein panta o de asyenwn lacana esyiei
draft_translation: One indeed believes he may eat all things: but the weak one eats vegetables.
ukjv_translation: For one believes that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eats herbs.

greek_text: ο εσθιων τον μη εσθιοντα μη εξουθενειτω και ο μη εσθιων τον εσθιοντα μη κρινετω ο θεος γαρ αυτον προσελαβετο
transliteration: o esyiwn ton mh esyionta mh exouyeneitw kai o mh esyiwn ton esyionta mh krinetw o yeov gar auton proselabeto
draft_translation: Let not the one who eats despise the one who does not eat; and let not the one who does not eat judge the one who eats: for God received him.
ukjv_translation: Let not him that eats despise him that eats not; and let not him which eats not judge him that eats: for God has received him.

greek_text: συ τις ει ο κρινων αλλοτριον οικετην τω ιδιω κυριω στηκει η πιπτει σταθησεται δε δυνατος γαρ εστιν ο θεος στησαι αυτον
transliteration: su tiv ei o krinwn allotrion oikethn tw idiw kuriw sthkei h piptei stayhsetai de dunatov gar estin o yeov sthsai auton
draft_translation: Who are you who judge another's household servant? to his own lord he stands or falls. But he shall be made to stand: for God is able to make him stand.
ukjv_translation: Who are you that judge another man's servant? to his own master he stands or falls. Yea, he shall be held up: for God is able to make him stand.

greek_text: ος μεν κρινει ημεραν παρ ημεραν ος δε κρινει πασαν ημεραν εκαστος εν τω ιδιω νοι πληροφορεισθω
transliteration: ov men krinei hmeran par hmeran ov de krinei pasan hmeran ekastov en tw idiw noi plhroforeisyw
draft_translation: One judges one day above another: another judges every day alike. Let each be fully assured in his own mind.
ukjv_translation: One man esteems one day above another: another esteems every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

greek_text: ο φρονων την ημεραν κυριω φρονει και ο μη φρονων την ημεραν κυριω ου φρονει ο εσθιων κυριω εσθιει ευχαριστει γαρ τω θεω και ο μη εσθιων κυριω ουκ εσθιει και ευχαριστει τω θεω
transliteration: o fronwn thn hmeran kuriw fronei kai o mh fronwn thn hmeran kuriw ou fronei o esyiwn kuriw esyiei eucaristei gar tw yew kai o mh esyiwn kuriw ouk esyiei kai eucaristei tw yew
draft_translation: the one who regards the day, regards it to the Lord; and the one who does not regard the day, to the Lord he does not regard it. the one who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks; and the one who does not eat, to the Lord he does not eat, and gives God thanks.
ukjv_translation: He that regards the day, regards it unto the Lord; and he that regards not the day, to the Lord he does not regard it. He that eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he that eats not, to the Lord he eats not, and gives God thanks.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized eats-not wording; modernized he-that relative; modernized regards-not wording; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ουδεις γαρ ημων εαυτω ζη και ουδεις εαυτω αποθνησκει
transliteration: oudeiv gar hmwn eautw zh kai oudeiv eautw apoynhskei
draft_translation: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
ukjv_translation: For none of us lives to himself, and no man dies to himself.

greek_text: εαν τε γαρ ζωμεν τω κυριω ζωμεν εαν τε αποθνησκωμεν τω κυριω αποθνησκομεν εαν τε ουν ζωμεν εαν τε αποθνησκωμεν του κυριου εσμεν
transliteration: ean te gar zwmen tw kuriw zwmen ean te apoynhskwmen tw kuriw apoynhskomen ean te oun zwmen ean te apoynhskwmen tou kuriou esmen
draft_translation: For if we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord: therefore whether we live or die, we are the Lord's.
ukjv_translation: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

greek_text: εις τουτο γαρ χριστος και απεθανεν και ανεστη και ανεζησεν ινα και νεκρων και ζωντων κυριευση
transliteration: eiv touto gar cristov kai apeyanen kai anesth kai anezhsen ina kai nekrwn kai zwntwn kurieush
draft_translation: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord both of dead and living.
ukjv_translation: In order to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

greek_text: συ δε τι κρινεις τον αδελφον σου η και συ τι εξουθενεις τον αδελφον σου παντες γαρ παραστησομεθα τω βηματι του χριστου
transliteration: su de ti krineiv ton adelfon sou h kai su ti exouyeneiv ton adelfon sou pantev gar parasthsomeya tw bhmati tou cristou
draft_translation: But why do you judge your brother? or why do you set at nothing your brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
ukjv_translation: But why do you judge your brother? or why do you set at nothing your brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: γεγραπται γαρ ζω εγω λεγει κυριος οτι εμοι καμψει παν γονυ και πασα γλωσσα εξομολογησεται τω θεω
transliteration: gegraptai gar zw egw legei kuriov oti emoi kamqei pan gonu kai pasa glwssa exomologhsetai tw yew
draft_translation: For it is written, As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
ukjv_translation: For it is written, As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

greek_text: αρα ουν εκαστος ημων περι εαυτου λογον δωσει τω θεω
transliteration: ara oun ekastov hmwn peri eautou logon dwsei tw yew
draft_translation: So then each of us shall give account concerning himself to God.
ukjv_translation: So then every one of us shall give account (o. logos) of himself to God.

greek_text: μηκετι ουν αλληλους κρινωμεν αλλα τουτο κρινατε μαλλον το μη τιθεναι προσκομμα τω αδελφω η σκανδαλον
transliteration: mhketi oun allhlouv krinwmen alla touto krinate mallon to mh tiyenai proskomma tw adelfw h skandalon
draft_translation: Therefore let us no longer judge one another: but judge this rather, not to put a stumbling block or snare before the brother.
ukjv_translation: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

greek_text: οιδα και πεπεισμαι εν κυριω ιησου οτι ουδεν κοινον δι εαυτου ει μη τω λογιζομενω τι κοινον ειναι εκεινω κοινον
transliteration: oida kai pepeismai en kuriw ihsou oti ouden koinon di eautou ei mh tw logizomenw ti koinon einai ekeinw koinon
draft_translation: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him who esteems anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
ukjv_translation: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteems any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized him-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ει δε δια βρωμα ο αδελφος σου λυπειται ουκετι κατα αγαπην περιπατεις μη τω βρωματι σου εκεινον απολλυε υπερ ου χριστος απεθανεν
transliteration: ei de dia brwma o adelfov sou lupeitai ouketi kata agaphn peripateiv mh tw brwmati sou ekeinon apollue uper ou cristov apeyanen
draft_translation: But if your brother is grieved because of food, you no longer walk according to love. Do not destroy with your food that one for whom Christ died.
ukjv_translation: But if your brother be grieved with your food, now walk you not charitably. (o. agape) Destroy not him with your food, for whom Christ died.

greek_text: μη βλασφημεισθω ουν υμων το αγαθον
transliteration: mh blasfhmeisyw oun umwn to agayon
draft_translation: Therefore do not let your good be blasphemed:
ukjv_translation: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου βρωσις και ποσις αλλα δικαιοσυνη και ειρηνη και χαρα εν πνευματι αγιω
transliteration: ou gar estin h basileia tou yeou brwsiv kai posiv alla dikaiosunh kai eirhnh kai cara en pneumati agiw
draft_translation: For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: ο γαρ εν τουτοις δουλευων τω χριστω ευαρεστος τω θεω και δοκιμος τοις ανθρωποις
transliteration: o gar en toutoiv douleuwn tw cristw euarestov tw yew kai dokimov toiv anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: For the one who serves Christ in these things is pleasing to God, and approved by humans.
ukjv_translation: For he that in these things serves Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

greek_text: αρα ουν τα της ειρηνης διωκωμεν και τα της οικοδομης της εις αλληλους
transliteration: ara oun ta thv eirhnhv diwkwmen kai ta thv oikodomhv thv eiv allhlouv
draft_translation: Therefore then let us pursue the things of peace, and the things of edification for one another.
ukjv_translation: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

greek_text: μη ενεκεν βρωματος καταλυε το εργον του θεου παντα μεν καθαρα αλλα κακον τω ανθρωπω τω δια προσκομματος εσθιοντι
transliteration: mh eneken brwmatov katalue to ergon tou yeou panta men kayara alla kakon tw anyrwpw tw dia proskommatov esyionti
draft_translation: Do not tear down the work of God because of food. All things indeed are clean; but it is evil to the human who eats through stumbling.
ukjv_translation: For food destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eats with offence.

greek_text: καλον το μη φαγειν κρεα μηδε πιειν οινον μηδε εν ω ο αδελφος σου προσκοπτει η σκανδαλιζεται η ασθενει
transliteration: kalon to mh fagein krea mhde piein oinon mhde en w o adelfov sou proskoptei h skandalizetai h asyenei
draft_translation: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor anything by which your brother stumbles, or is stumbled, or is made weak.
ukjv_translation: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby your brother stumbles, or is offended, or is made weak.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized whereby; rendered skandalizo as stumble

greek_text: συ πιστιν εχεις κατα σαυτον εχε ενωπιον του θεου μακαριος ο μη κρινων εαυτον εν ω δοκιμαζει
transliteration: su pistin eceiv kata sauton ece enwpion tou yeou makariov o mh krinwn eauton en w dokimazei
draft_translation: Do you have faith? have it to yourself before God. Blessed is the one who does not judge himself in what he approves.
ukjv_translation: Have you faith? have it to yourself before God. Happy is he that condemns not himself in that thing which he allows.

greek_text: ο δε διακρινομενος εαν φαγη κατακεκριται οτι ουκ εκ πιστεως παν δε ο ουκ εκ πιστεως αμαρτια εστιν
transliteration: o de diakrinomenov ean fagh katakekritai oti ouk ek pistewv pan de o ouk ek pistewv amartia estin
draft_translation: But the one who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it is not from faith: for whatever is not from faith is sin.
ukjv_translation: And he that doubts is damned if he eat, because he eats not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

greek_text: οφειλομεν δε ημεις οι δυνατοι τα ασθενηματα των αδυνατων βασταζειν και μη εαυτοις αρεσκειν
transliteration: ofeilomen de hmeiv oi dunatoi ta asyenhmata twn adunatwn bastazein kai mh eautoiv areskein
draft_translation: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
ukjv_translation: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

greek_text: εκαστος γαρ ημων τω πλησιον αρεσκετω εις το αγαθον προς οικοδομην
transliteration: ekastov gar hmwn tw plhsion aresketw eiv to agayon prov oikodomhn
draft_translation: For let each of us please his neighbor for good, toward edification.
ukjv_translation: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

greek_text: και γαρ ο χριστος ουχ εαυτω ηρεσεν αλλα καθως γεγραπται οι ονειδισμοι των ονειδιζοντων σε επεπεσον επ εμε
transliteration: kai gar o cristov ouc eautw hresen alla kaywv gegraptai oi oneidismoi twn oneidizontwn se epepeson ep eme
draft_translation: For even Christ did not please himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.
ukjv_translation: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached you fell on me.

greek_text: οσα γαρ προεγραφη εις την ημετεραν διδασκαλιαν προεγραφη ινα δια της υπομονης και της παρακλησεως των γραφων την ελπιδα εχωμεν
transliteration: osa gar proegrafh eiv thn hmeteran didaskalian proegrafh ina dia thv upomonhv kai thv paraklhsewv twn grafwn thn elpida ecwmen
draft_translation: For whatever things were written before were written for our instruction, that through endurance and encouragement of the scriptures we might have hope.
ukjv_translation: For whatsoever things were written in old times were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

greek_text: ο δε θεος της υπομονης και της παρακλησεως δωη υμιν το αυτο φρονειν εν αλληλοις κατα χριστον ιησουν
transliteration: o de yeov thv upomonhv kai thv paraklhsewv dwh umin to auto fronein en allhloiv kata criston ihsoun
draft_translation: Now may the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to be of the same mind among one another according to Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

greek_text: ινα ομοθυμαδον εν ενι στοματι δοξαζητε τον θεον και πατερα του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: ina omoyumadon en eni stomati doxazhte ton yeon kai patera tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: That with one accord and one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: That all of you may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

greek_text: διο προσλαμβανεσθε αλληλους καθως και ο χριστος προσελαβετο ημας εις δοξαν θεου
transliteration: dio proslambanesye allhlouv kaywv kai o cristov proselabeto hmav eiv doxan yeou
draft_translation: Therefore receive one another, just as Christ also received us, to the glory of God.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore receive all of you one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

greek_text: λεγω δε ιησουν χριστον διακονον γεγενησθαι περιτομης υπερ αληθειας θεου εις το βεβαιωσαι τας επαγγελιας των πατερων
transliteration: legw de ihsoun criston diakonon gegenhsyai peritomhv uper alhyeiav yeou eiv to bebaiwsai tav epaggeliav twn paterwn
draft_translation: Now I say that Jesus Christ has become a servant of the circumcision on behalf of the truth of God, to confirm the promises of the fathers:
ukjv_translation: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

greek_text: τα δε εθνη υπερ ελεους δοξασαι τον θεον καθως γεγραπται δια τουτο εξομολογησομαι σοι εν εθνεσιν και τω ονοματι σου ψαλω
transliteration: ta de eynh uper eleouv doxasai ton yeon kaywv gegraptai dia touto exomologhsomai soi en eynesin kai tw onomati sou qalw
draft_translation: And that the nations might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the nations, and sing to your name.
ukjv_translation: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the Gentiles, and sing unto your name.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και παλιν λεγει ευφρανθητε εθνη μετα του λαου αυτου
transliteration: kai palin legei eufranyhte eynh meta tou laou autou
draft_translation: And again he says, Rejoice, you nations, with his people.
ukjv_translation: And again he says, Rejoice, all of you Gentiles, with his people.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και παλιν αινειτε τον κυριον παντα τα εθνη και επαινεσατε αυτον παντες οι λαοι
transliteration: kai palin aineite ton kurion panta ta eynh kai epainesate auton pantev oi laoi
draft_translation: And again, Praise the Lord, all you nations; and extol him, all you people.
ukjv_translation: And again, Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles; and extol him, all you people.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και παλιν ησαιας λεγει εσται η ριζα του ιεσσαι και ο ανισταμενος αρχειν εθνων επ αυτω εθνη ελπιουσιν
transliteration: kai palin hsaiav legei estai h riza tou iessai kai o anistamenov arcein eynwn ep autw eynh elpiousin
draft_translation: And again, Isaiah says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and the one who shall rise to reign over the nations; in him shall the nations trust.
ukjv_translation: And again, Isaiah says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: ο δε θεος της ελπιδος πληρωσαι υμας πασης χαρας και ειρηνης εν τω πιστευειν εις το περισσευειν υμας εν τη ελπιδι εν δυναμει πνευματος αγιου
transliteration: o de yeov thv elpidov plhrwsai umav pashv carav kai eirhnhv en tw pisteuein eiv to perisseuein umav en th elpidi en dunamei pneumatov agiou
draft_translation: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that all of you may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: πεπεισμαι δε αδελφοι μου και αυτος εγω περι υμων οτι και αυτοι μεστοι εστε αγαθωσυνης πεπληρωμενοι πασης γνωσεως δυναμενοι και αλληλους νουθετειν
transliteration: pepeismai de adelfoi mou kai autov egw peri umwn oti kai autoi mestoi este agaywsunhv peplhrwmenoi pashv gnwsewv dunamenoi kai allhlouv nouyetein
draft_translation: And I myself also am persuaded concerning you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
ukjv_translation: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that all of you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

greek_text: τολμηροτερον δε εγραψα υμιν αδελφοι απο μερους ως επαναμιμνησκων υμας δια την χαριν την δοθεισαν μοι υπο του θεου
transliteration: tolmhroteron de egraqa umin adelfoi apo merouv wv epanamimnhskwn umav dia thn carin thn doyeisan moi upo tou yeou
draft_translation: Nevertheless, brothers, I wrote more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace given to me by God,
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

greek_text: εις το ειναι με λειτουργον ιησου χριστου εις τα εθνη ιερουργουντα το ευαγγελιον του θεου ινα γενηται η προσφορα των εθνων ευπροσδεκτος ηγιασμενη εν πνευματι αγιω
transliteration: eiv to einai me leitourgon ihsou cristou eiv ta eynh ierourgounta to euaggelion tou yeou ina genhtai h prosfora twn eynwn euprosdektov hgiasmenh en pneumati agiw
draft_translation: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the nations, ministering the good news of God, that the offering up of the nations might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ethne as nations; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: εχω ουν καυχησιν εν χριστω ιησου τα προς θεον
transliteration: ecw oun kauchsin en cristw ihsou ta prov yeon
draft_translation: Therefore I have boasting in Christ Jesus in the things toward God.
ukjv_translation: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

greek_text: ου γαρ τολμησω λαλειν τι ων ου κατειργασατο χριστος δι εμου εις υπακοην εθνων λογω και εργω
transliteration: ou gar tolmhsw lalein ti wn ou kateirgasato cristov di emou eiv upakohn eynwn logw kai ergw
draft_translation: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ has not worked by me, to make the nations obedient, by word and deed,
ukjv_translation: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ has not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word (o. logos) and deed,
review_notes: modernized wrought; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: εν δυναμει σημειων και τερατων εν δυναμει πνευματος θεου ωστε με απο ιερουσαλημ και κυκλω μεχρι του ιλλυρικου πεπληρωκεναι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου
transliteration: en dunamei shmeiwn kai teratwn en dunamei pneumatov yeou wste me apo ierousalhm kai kuklw mecri tou illurikou peplhrwkenai to euaggelion tou cristou
draft_translation: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about to Illyricum, I have fully preached the good news of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουτως δε φιλοτιμουμενον ευαγγελιζεσθαι ουχ οπου ωνομασθη χριστος ινα μη επ αλλοτριον θεμελιον οικοδομω
transliteration: outwv de filotimoumenon euaggelizesyai ouc opou wnomasyh cristov ina mh ep allotrion yemelion oikodomw
draft_translation: Yes, so have I strived to preach the good news, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
ukjv_translation: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
review_notes: modernized yea; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αλλα καθως γεγραπται οις ουκ ανηγγελη περι αυτου οψονται και οι ουκ ακηκοασιν συνησουσιν
transliteration: alla kaywv gegraptai oiv ouk anhggelh peri autou oqontai kai oi ouk akhkoasin sunhsousin
draft_translation: But as it is written, Those to whom it was not announced concerning him shall see: and those who have not heard shall understand.
ukjv_translation: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

greek_text: διο και ενεκοπτομην τα πολλα του ελθειν προς υμας
transliteration: dio kai enekoptomhn ta polla tou elyein prov umav
draft_translation: For this reason also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
ukjv_translation: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

greek_text: νυνι δε μηκετι τοπον εχων εν τοις κλιμασιν τουτοις επιποθιαν δε εχων του ελθειν προς υμας απο πολλων ετων
transliteration: nuni de mhketi topon ecwn en toiv klimasin toutoiv epipoyian de ecwn tou elyein prov umav apo pollwn etwn
draft_translation: But now having no more place in these regions, and having a longing for many years to come to you;
ukjv_translation: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

greek_text: ως εαν πορευωμαι εις την σπανιαν ελευσομαι προς υμας ελπιζω γαρ διαπορευομενος θεασασθαι υμας και υφ υμων προπεμφθηναι εκει εαν υμων πρωτον απο μερους εμπλησθω
transliteration: wv ean poreuwmai eiv thn spanian eleusomai prov umav elpizw gar diaporeuomenov yeasasyai umav kai uf umwn propemfyhnai ekei ean umwn prwton apo merouv emplhsyw
draft_translation: Whenever I go into Spain, I will come to you: for I hope, while passing through, to see you, and to be sent forward there by you, if first I may be filled in part with you.
ukjv_translation: Whenever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way in that direction by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

greek_text: νυνι δε πορευομαι εις ιερουσαλημ διακονων τοις αγιοις
transliteration: nuni de poreuomai eiv ierousalhm diakonwn toiv agioiv
draft_translation: But now I go to Jerusalem to minister to the holy ones.
ukjv_translation: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ευδοκησαν γαρ μακεδονια και αχαια κοινωνιαν τινα ποιησασθαι εις τους πτωχους των αγιων των εν ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: eudokhsan gar makedonia kai acaia koinwnian tina poihsasyai eiv touv ptwcouv twn agiwn twn en ierousalhm
draft_translation: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor holy ones who are at Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ευδοκησαν γαρ και οφειλεται αυτων εισιν ει γαρ τοις πνευματικοις αυτων εκοινωνησαν τα εθνη οφειλουσιν και εν τοις σαρκικοις λειτουργησαι αυτοις
transliteration: eudokhsan gar kai ofeiletai autwn eisin ei gar toiv pneumatikoiv autwn ekoinwnhsan ta eynh ofeilousin kai en toiv sarkikoiv leitourghsai autoiv
draft_translation: It has pleased them truly; and their debtors they are. For if the nations have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in carnal things.
ukjv_translation: It has pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized verily; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: τουτο ουν επιτελεσας και σφραγισαμενος αυτοις τον καρπον τουτον απελευσομαι δι υμων εις την σπανιαν
transliteration: touto oun epitelesav kai sfragisamenov autoiv ton karpon touton apeleusomai di umwn eiv thn spanian
draft_translation: Therefore when I have completed this, and sealed this fruit to them, I will depart by you into Spain.
ukjv_translation: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

greek_text: οιδα δε οτι ερχομενος προς υμας εν πληρωματι ευλογιας του ευαγγελιου του χριστου ελευσομαι
transliteration: oida de oti ercomenov prov umav en plhrwmati eulogiav tou euaggeliou tou cristou eleusomai
draft_translation: And I am sure that, when I come to you, I shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the good news of Christ.
ukjv_translation: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου και δια της αγαπης του πνευματος συναγωνισασθαι μοι εν ταις προσευχαις υπερ εμου προς τον θεον
transliteration: parakalw de umav adelfoi dia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou kai dia thv agaphv tou pneumatov sunagwnisasyai moi en taiv proseucaiv uper emou prov ton yeon
draft_translation: Now I plead to you, brothers, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
ukjv_translation: Now I plead to you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love (o. agape) of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) that all of you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ινα ρυσθω απο των απειθουντων εν τη ιουδαια και ινα η διακονια μου η εις ιερουσαλημ ευπροσδεκτος γενηται τοις αγιοις
transliteration: ina rusyw apo twn apeiyountwn en th ioudaia kai ina h diakonia mou h eiv ierousalhm euprosdektov genhtai toiv agioiv
draft_translation: That I may be delivered from those who do not believe in Judea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the holy ones;
ukjv_translation: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; rendered hagioi as holy ones; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: ινα εν χαρα ελθω προς υμας δια θεληματος θεου και συναναπαυσωμαι υμιν
transliteration: ina en cara elyw prov umav dia yelhmatov yeou kai sunanapauswmai umin
draft_translation: That I may come to you with joy by the will of God, and may rest together with you.
ukjv_translation: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

greek_text: ο δε θεος της ειρηνης μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: o de yeov thv eirhnhv meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

greek_text: συνιστημι δε υμιν φοιβην την αδελφην ημων ουσαν διακονον της εκκλησιας της εν κεγχρεαις
transliteration: sunisthmi de umin foibhn thn adelfhn hmwn ousan diakonon thv ekklhsiav thv en kegcreaiv
draft_translation: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, which is a servant of the assembly which is at Cenchrea:
ukjv_translation: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: ινα αυτην προσδεξησθε εν κυριω αξιως των αγιων και παραστητε αυτη εν ω αν υμων χρηζη πραγματι και γαρ αυτη προστατις πολλων εγενηθη και αυτου εμου
transliteration: ina authn prosdexhsye en kuriw axiwv twn agiwn kai parasthte auth en w an umwn crhzh pragmati kai gar auth prostativ pollwn egenhyh kai autou emou
draft_translation: That you receive her in the Lord, as becomes holy ones, and that you assist her in whatever business she has need of you: for she has been a supporter of many, and of myself also.
ukjv_translation: That all of you receive her in the Lord, as becomes saints, and that all of you assist her in whatsoever business she has need of you: for she has been a supporter of many, and of myself also.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ασπασασθε πρισκιλλαν και ακυλαν τους συνεργους μου εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: aspasasye priskillan kai akulan touv sunergouv mou en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

greek_text: οιτινες υπερ της ψυχης μου τον εαυτων τραχηλον υπεθηκαν οις ουκ εγω μονος ευχαριστω αλλα και πασαι αι εκκλησιαι των εθνων
transliteration: oitinev uper thv quchv mou ton eautwn trachlon upeyhkan oiv ouk egw monov eucaristw alla kai pasai ai ekklhsiai twn eynwn
draft_translation: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the nations.
ukjv_translation: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και την κατ οικον αυτων εκκλησιαν ασπασασθε επαινετον τον αγαπητον μου ος εστιν απαρχη της αχαιας εις χριστον
transliteration: kai thn kat oikon autwn ekklhsian aspasasye epaineton ton agaphton mou ov estin aparch thv acaiav eiv criston
draft_translation: Likewise greet the assembly that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the first-fruits of Achaia to Christ.
ukjv_translation: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the first-fruits of Achaia unto Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ασπασασθε μαριαμ ητις πολλα εκοπιασεν εις ημας
transliteration: aspasasye mariam htiv polla ekopiasen eiv hmav
draft_translation: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
ukjv_translation: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

greek_text: ασπασασθε ανδρονικον και ιουνιαν τους συγγενεις μου και συναιχμαλωτους μου οιτινες εισιν επισημοι εν τοις αποστολοις οι και προ εμου γεγονασιν εν χριστω
transliteration: aspasasye andronikon kai iounian touv suggeneiv mou kai sunaicmalwtouv mou oitinev eisin epishmoi en toiv apostoloiv oi kai pro emou gegonasin en cristw
draft_translation: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
ukjv_translation: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

greek_text: ασπασασθε αμπλιαν τον αγαπητον μου εν κυριω
transliteration: aspasasye amplian ton agaphton mou en kuriw
draft_translation: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

greek_text: ασπασασθε ουρβανον τον συνεργον ημων εν χριστω και σταχυν τον αγαπητον μου
transliteration: aspasasye ourbanon ton sunergon hmwn en cristw kai stacun ton agaphton mou
draft_translation: Greet Urbane, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
ukjv_translation: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

greek_text: ασπασασθε απελλην τον δοκιμον εν χριστω ασπασασθε τους εκ των αριστοβουλου
transliteration: aspasasye apellhn ton dokimon en cristw aspasasye touv ek twn aristoboulou
draft_translation: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those from Aristobulus.
ukjv_translation: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.

greek_text: ασπασασθε ηροδιωνα τον συγγενη μου ασπασασθε τους εκ των ναρκισσου τους οντας εν κυριω
transliteration: aspasasye hrodiwna ton suggenh mou aspasasye touv ek twn narkissou touv ontav en kuriw
draft_translation: Salute Herodion my relative. Greet those who are of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
review_notes: modernized kinsman; modernized residual be wording; modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ασπασασθε τρυφαιναν και τρυφωσαν τας κοπιωσας εν κυριω ασπασασθε περσιδα την αγαπητην ητις πολλα εκοπιασεν εν κυριω
transliteration: aspasasye trufainan kai trufwsan tav kopiwsav en kuriw aspasasye persida thn agaphthn htiv polla ekopiasen en kuriw
draft_translation: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which labored much in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ασπασασθε ρουφον τον εκλεκτον εν κυριω και την μητερα αυτου και εμου
transliteration: aspasasye roufon ton eklekton en kuriw kai thn mhtera autou kai emou
draft_translation: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
ukjv_translation: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

greek_text: ασπασασθε ασυγκριτον φλεγοντα ερμαν πατροβαν ερμην και τους συν αυτοις αδελφους
transliteration: aspasasye asugkriton flegonta erman patroban ermhn kai touv sun autoiv adelfouv
draft_translation: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers who are with them.
ukjv_translation: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

greek_text: ασπασασθε φιλολογον και ιουλιαν νηρεα και την αδελφην αυτου και ολυμπαν και τους συν αυτοις παντας αγιους
transliteration: aspasasye filologon kai ioulian nhrea kai thn adelfhn autou kai olumpan kai touv sun autoiv pantav agiouv
draft_translation: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the holy ones who are with them.
ukjv_translation: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ασπασασθε αλληλους εν φιληματι αγιω ασπαζονται υμας αι εκκλησιαι του χριστου
transliteration: aspasasye allhlouv en filhmati agiw aspazontai umav ai ekklhsiai tou cristou
draft_translation: Salute one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ salute you.
ukjv_translation: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι σκοπειν τους τας διχοστασιας και τα σκανδαλα παρα την διδαχην ην υμεις εμαθετε ποιουντας και εκκλινατε απ αυτων
transliteration: parakalw de umav adelfoi skopein touv tav dicostasiav kai ta skandala para thn didachn hn umeiv emayete poiountav kai ekklinate ap autwn
draft_translation: Now I exhort you, brothers, to mark those causing divisions and snares contrary to the teaching which you learned; and turn away from them.
ukjv_translation: Now I plead to you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which all of you have learned; and avoid them.

greek_text: οι γαρ τοιουτοι τω κυριω ημων ιησου χριστω ου δουλευουσιν αλλα τη εαυτων κοιλια και δια της χρηστολογιας και ευλογιας εξαπατωσιν τας καρδιας των ακακων
transliteration: oi gar toioutoi tw kuriw hmwn ihsou cristw ou douleuousin alla th eautwn koilia kai dia thv crhstologiav kai eulogiav exapatwsin tav kardiav twn akakwn
draft_translation: For those who are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
ukjv_translation: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: η γαρ υμων υπακοη εις παντας αφικετο χαιρω ουν το εφ υμιν θελω δε υμας σοφους μεν ειναι εις το αγαθον ακεραιους δε εις το κακον
transliteration: h gar umwn upakoh eiv pantav afiketo cairw oun to ef umin yelw de umav sofouv men einai eiv to agayon akeraiouv de eiv to kakon
draft_translation: For your obedience reached all. I rejoice therefore over you: but I want you to be wise as to what is good, and innocent as to what is evil.
ukjv_translation: For your obedience has come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

greek_text: ο δε θεος της ειρηνης συντριψει τον σαταναν υπο τους ποδας υμων εν ταχει η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων αμην
transliteration: o de yeov thv eirhnhv suntriqei ton satanan upo touv podav umwn en tacei h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou mey umwn amhn
draft_translation: And the God of peace shall crush Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
ukjv_translation: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

greek_text: ασπαζονται υμας τιμοθεος ο συνεργος μου και λουκιος και ιασων και σωσιπατρος οι συγγενεις μου
transliteration: aspazontai umav timoyeov o sunergov mou kai loukiov kai iaswn kai swsipatrov oi suggeneiv mou
draft_translation: Timothy my fellow worker greets you, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
ukjv_translation: Timotheus my fellow worker, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

greek_text: ασπαζομαι υμας εγω τερτιος ο γραψας την επιστολην εν κυριω
transliteration: aspazomai umav egw tertiov o graqav thn epistolhn en kuriw
draft_translation: I Tertius, who wrote the letter, greet you in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

greek_text: ασπαζεται υμας γαιος ο ξενος μου και της εκκλησιας ολης ασπαζεται υμας εραστος ο οικονομος της πολεως και κουαρτος ο αδελφος
transliteration: aspazetai umav gaiov o xenov mou kai thv ekklhsiav olhv aspazetai umav erastov o oikonomov thv polewv kai kouartov o adelfov
draft_translation: Gaius my host, and of the whole assembly, salutes you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city salutes you, and Quartus a brother.
ukjv_translation: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, salutes you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city salutes you, and Quartus a brother.
review_notes: modernized mine before noun; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

greek_text: τω δε δυναμενω υμας στηριξαι κατα το ευαγγελιον μου και το κηρυγμα ιησου χριστου κατα αποκαλυψιν μυστηριου χρονοις αιωνιοις σεσιγημενου
transliteration: tw de dunamenw umav sthrixai kata to euaggelion mou kai to khrugma ihsou cristou kata apokaluqin musthriou cronoiv aiwnioiv sesighmenou
draft_translation: Now to him who is of power to establish you according to my good news, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
ukjv_translation: Now to him that is of power to establish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: φανερωθεντος δε νυν δια τε γραφων προφητικων κατ επιταγην του αιωνιου θεου εις υπακοην πιστεως εις παντα τα εθνη γνωρισθεντος
transliteration: fanerwyentov de nun dia te grafwn profhtikwn kat epitaghn tou aiwniou yeou eiv upakohn pistewv eiv panta ta eynh gnwrisyentov
draft_translation: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
ukjv_translation: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

greek_text: μονω σοφω θεω δια ιησου χριστου η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην
transliteration: monw sofw yew dia ihsou cristou h doxa eiv touv aiwnav amhn
draft_translation: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.

greek_text: [ΠΑΥΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΟΥ Η ΠΡΟΣ ΚΟΡΙΝΘΙΟΥΣ ΕΠΙΣΤΟΛΗ ΠΡΩΤΗ] παυλος κλητος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου και σωσθενης ο αδελφος
transliteration: [PAULOU TOU APOSTOLOU H PROS KORINYIOUS EPISTOLH PRWTH] paulov klhtov apostolov ihsou cristou dia yelhmatov yeou kai swsyenhv o adelfov
draft_translation: Paul called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
ukjv_translation: Paul called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τη εκκλησια του θεου τη ουση εν κορινθω ηγιασμενοις εν χριστω ιησου κλητοις αγιοις συν πασιν τοις επικαλουμενοις το ονομα του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εν παντι τοπω αυτων τε και ημων
transliteration: th ekklhsia tou yeou th oush en korinyw hgiasmenoiv en cristw ihsou klhtoiv agioiv sun pasin toiv epikaloumenoiv to onoma tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou en panti topw autwn te kai hmwn
draft_translation: To the assembly of God who is at Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be holy ones, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
ukjv_translation: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both their's and our's:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; modernized possessive pronoun spelling; modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου παντοτε περι υμων επι τη χαριτι του θεου τη δοθειση υμιν εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: eucaristw tw yew mou pantote peri umwn epi th cariti tou yeou th doyeish umin en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
ukjv_translation: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
review_notes: fixed non-person relative after grace; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: οτι εν παντι επλουτισθητε εν αυτω εν παντι λογω και παση γνωσει
transliteration: oti en panti eploutisyhte en autw en panti logw kai pash gnwsei
draft_translation: That in everything you were enriched in him, in every word and all knowledge;
ukjv_translation: That in every thing all of you are enriched by him, in all utterance, (o. logos) and in all knowledge;

greek_text: καθως το μαρτυριον του χριστου εβεβαιωθη εν υμιν
transliteration: kaywv to marturion tou cristou ebebaiwyh en umin
draft_translation: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
ukjv_translation: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
