ukjv_translation: But if any man think that he behaves himself indecent toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sins not: let them marry.

greek_text: ος δε εστηκεν εδραιος εν τη καρδια μη εχων αναγκην εξουσιαν δε εχει περι του ιδιου θεληματος και τουτο κεκρικεν εν τη καρδια αυτου του τηρειν την εαυτου παρθενον καλως ποιει
transliteration: ov de esthken edraiov en th kardia mh ecwn anagkhn exousian de ecei peri tou idiou yelhmatov kai touto kekriken en th kardia autou tou threin thn eautou paryenon kalwv poiei
draft_translation: But the one who stands firm in his heart, having no necessity, but has authority over his own will, and has judged this in his heart, to keep his own virgin, does well.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless he that stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own will, and has so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, does well.

greek_text: ωστε και ο εκγαμιζων καλως ποιει ο δε μη εκγαμιζων κρεισσον ποιει
transliteration: wste kai o ekgamizwn kalwv poiei o de mh ekgamizwn kreisson poiei
draft_translation: So then both the one who gives her in marriage does well, and the one who does not give her in marriage does better.
ukjv_translation: So then he that gives her in marriage does well; but he that gives her not in marriage does better.

greek_text: γυνη δεδεται νομω εφ οσον χρονον ζη ο ανηρ αυτης εαν δε κοιμηθη ο ανηρ αυτης ελευθερα εστιν ω θελει γαμηθηναι μονον εν κυριω
transliteration: gunh dedetai nomw ef oson cronon zh o anhr authv ean de koimhyh o anhr authv eleuyera estin w yelei gamhyhnai monon en kuriw
draft_translation: A wife is bound by law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband falls asleep, she is free to be married to whom she wills; only in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

greek_text: μακαριωτερα δε εστιν εαν ουτως μεινη κατα την εμην γνωμην δοκω δε καγω πνευμα θεου εχειν
transliteration: makariwtera de estin ean outwv meinh kata thn emhn gnwmhn dokw de kagw pneuma yeou ecein
draft_translation: But she is more blessed if she remains thus, according to my judgment: and I think that I also have the Spirit of God.
ukjv_translation: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God.

greek_text: περι δε των ειδωλοθυτων οιδαμεν οτι παντες γνωσιν εχομεν η γνωσις φυσιοι η δε αγαπη οικοδομει
transliteration: peri de twn eidwloyutwn oidamen oti pantev gnwsin ecomen h gnwsiv fusioi h de agaph oikodomei
draft_translation: Now concerning idol-offerings, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
ukjv_translation: Now as concerning things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love (o. agape) edifies.

greek_text: ει δε τις δοκει ειδεναι τι ουδεπω ουδεν εγνωκεν καθως δει γνωναι
transliteration: ei de tiv dokei eidenai ti oudepw ouden egnwken kaywv dei gnwnai
draft_translation: And if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he has not yet known anything as he ought to know.
ukjv_translation: And if any man think that he knows any thing, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.

greek_text: ει δε τις αγαπα τον θεον ουτος εγνωσται υπ αυτου
transliteration: ei de tiv agapa ton yeon outov egnwstai up autou
draft_translation: But if anyone loves God, this one is known by him.
ukjv_translation: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.

greek_text: περι της βρωσεως ουν των ειδωλοθυτων οιδαμεν οτι ουδεν ειδωλον εν κοσμω και οτι ουδεις θεος ετερος ει μη εις
transliteration: peri thv brwsewv oun twn eidwloyutwn oidamen oti ouden eidwlon en kosmw kai oti oudeiv yeov eterov ei mh eiv
draft_translation: Therefore concerning the eating of idol-offerings, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is no other God except one.
ukjv_translation: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

greek_text: και γαρ ειπερ εισιν λεγομενοι θεοι ειτε εν ουρανω ειτε επι της γης ωσπερ εισιν θεοι πολλοι και κυριοι πολλοι
transliteration: kai gar eiper eisin legomenoi yeoi eite en ouranw eite epi thv ghv wsper eisin yeoi polloi kai kurioi polloi
draft_translation: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth, as there are many gods and many lords,
ukjv_translation: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

greek_text: αλλ ημιν εις θεος ο πατηρ εξ ου τα παντα και ημεις εις αυτον και εις κυριος ιησους χριστος δι ου τα παντα και ημεις δι αυτου
transliteration: all hmin eiv yeov o pathr ex ou ta panta kai hmeiv eiv auton kai eiv kuriov ihsouv cristov di ou ta panta kai hmeiv di autou
draft_translation: Yet to us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we through him.
ukjv_translation: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

greek_text: αλλ ουκ εν πασιν η γνωσις τινες δε τη συνειδησει του ειδωλου εως αρτι ως ειδωλοθυτον εσθιουσιν και η συνειδησις αυτων ασθενης ουσα μολυνεται
transliteration: all ouk en pasin h gnwsiv tinev de th suneidhsei tou eidwlou ewv arti wv eidwloyuton esyiousin kai h suneidhsiv autwn asyenhv ousa molunetai
draft_translation: But knowledge is not in all: for some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat it as an idol-offering; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

greek_text: βρωμα δε ημας ου παριστησιν τω θεω ουτε γαρ εαν φαγωμεν περισσευομεν ουτε εαν μη φαγωμεν υστερουμεθα
transliteration: brwma de hmav ou paristhsin tw yew oute gar ean fagwmen perisseuomen oute ean mh fagwmen usteroumeya
draft_translation: But food does not present us to God: for neither if we eat do we abound, nor if we do not eat do we lack.
ukjv_translation: But food commends us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.

greek_text: βλεπετε δε μηπως η εξουσια υμων αυτη προσκομμα γενηται τοις ασθενουσιν
transliteration: blepete de mhpwv h exousia umwn auth proskomma genhtai toiv asyenousin
draft_translation: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to those who are weak.
ukjv_translation: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of your's become a stumbling block to them that are weak.
review_notes: modernized possessive pronoun spelling; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: εαν γαρ τις ιδη σε τον εχοντα γνωσιν εν ειδωλειω κατακειμενον ουχι η συνειδησις αυτου ασθενους οντος οικοδομηθησεται εις το τα ειδωλοθυτα εσθιειν
transliteration: ean gar tiv idh se ton econta gnwsin en eidwleiw katakeimenon ouci h suneidhsiv autou asyenouv ontov oikodomhyhsetai eiv to ta eidwloyuta esyiein
draft_translation: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge reclining in an idol's temple, shall not his conscience, being weak, be built up to eat idol-offerings?
ukjv_translation: For if any man see you which have knowledge sit to eat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

greek_text: και απολειται ο ασθενων αδελφος επι τη ση γνωσει δι ον χριστος απεθανεν
transliteration: kai apoleitai o asyenwn adelfov epi th sh gnwsei di on cristov apeyanen
draft_translation: And by your knowledge the weak brother shall perish, for whom Christ died.
ukjv_translation: And through your knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?

greek_text: ουτως δε αμαρτανοντες εις τους αδελφους και τυπτοντες αυτων την συνειδησιν ασθενουσαν εις χριστον αμαρτανετε
transliteration: outwv de amartanontev eiv touv adelfouv kai tuptontev autwn thn suneidhsin asyenousan eiv criston amartanete
draft_translation: But sinning in this way against the brothers, and striking their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
ukjv_translation: But when all of you sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, all of you sin against Christ.

greek_text: διοπερ ει βρωμα σκανδαλιζει τον αδελφον μου ου μη φαγω κρεα εις τον αιωνα ινα μη τον αδελφον μου σκανδαλισω
transliteration: dioper ei brwma skandalizei ton adelfon mou ou mh fagw krea eiv ton aiwna ina mh ton adelfon mou skandalisw
draft_translation: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will certainly not eat meat forever, so that I may not cause my brother to stumble.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, if food make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world stands, lest I make my brother to offend.

greek_text: ουκ ειμι αποστολος ουκ ειμι ελευθερος ουχι ιησουν χριστον τον κυριον ημων εωρακα ου το εργον μου υμεις εστε εν κυριω
transliteration: ouk eimi apostolov ouk eimi eleuyerov ouci ihsoun criston ton kurion hmwn ewraka ou to ergon mou umeiv este en kuriw
draft_translation: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not you my work in the Lord?
ukjv_translation: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not all of you my work in the Lord?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ει αλλοις ουκ ειμι αποστολος αλλα γε υμιν ειμι η γαρ σφραγις της εμης αποστολης υμεις εστε εν κυριω
transliteration: ei alloiv ouk eimi apostolov alla ge umin eimi h gar sfragiv thv emhv apostolhv umeiv este en kuriw
draft_translation: If I am not an apostle to others, yet indeed I am to you: for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are all of you in the Lord.

greek_text: η εμη απολογια τοις εμε ανακρινουσιν αυτη εστιν
transliteration: h emh apologia toiv eme anakrinousin auth estin
draft_translation: My defense to those who examine me is this,
ukjv_translation: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,

greek_text: μη ουκ εχομεν εξουσιαν φαγειν και πιειν
transliteration: mh ouk ecomen exousian fagein kai piein
draft_translation: Do we not have a right to eat and to drink?
ukjv_translation: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

greek_text: μη ουκ εχομεν εξουσιαν αδελφην γυναικα περιαγειν ως και οι λοιποι αποστολοι και οι αδελφοι του κυριου και κηφας
transliteration: mh ouk ecomen exousian adelfhn gunaika periagein wv kai oi loipoi apostoloi kai oi adelfoi tou kuriou kai khfav
draft_translation: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
ukjv_translation: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: η μονος εγω και βαρναβας ουκ εχομεν εξουσιαν του μη εργαζεσθαι
transliteration: h monov egw kai barnabav ouk ecomen exousian tou mh ergazesyai
draft_translation: Or do only I and Barnabas not have a right not to work?
ukjv_translation: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

greek_text: τις στρατευεται ιδιοις οψωνιοις ποτε τις φυτευει αμπελωνα και εκ του καρπου αυτου ουκ εσθιει η τις ποιμαινει ποιμνην και εκ του γαλακτος της ποιμνης ουκ εσθιει
transliteration: tiv strateuetai idioiv oqwnioiv pote tiv futeuei ampelwna kai ek tou karpou autou ouk esyiei h tiv poimainei poimnhn kai ek tou galaktov thv poimnhv ouk esyiei
draft_translation: Who ever serves as a soldier at his own wages? who plants a vineyard, and does not eat of its fruit? or who shepherds a flock, and does not eat of the milk of the flock?
ukjv_translation: Who goes a warfare any time at his own charges? who plants a vineyard, and eats not of the fruit thereof? or who feeds a flock, and eats not of the milk of the flock?

greek_text: μη κατα ανθρωπον ταυτα λαλω η ουχι και ο νομος ταυτα λεγει
transliteration: mh kata anyrwpon tauta lalw h ouci kai o nomov tauta legei
draft_translation: Say I these things as a man? or does not the law say the same also?
ukjv_translation: Say I these things as a man? or says not the law the same also?

greek_text: εν γαρ τω μωσεως νομω γεγραπται ου φιμωσεις βουν αλοωντα μη των βοων μελει τω θεω
transliteration: en gar tw mwsewv nomw gegraptai ou fimwseiv boun alownta mh twn bown melei tw yew
draft_translation: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not suppress the mouth of the ox that treads out the grain. Does God take care for oxen?
ukjv_translation: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not suppress the mouth of the ox that treads out the corn. Does God take care for oxen?

greek_text: η δι ημας παντως λεγει δι ημας γαρ εγραφη οτι επ ελπιδι οφειλει ο αροτριων αροτριαν και ο αλοων της ελπιδος αυτου μετεχειν επ ελπιδι
transliteration: h di hmav pantwv legei di hmav gar egrafh oti ep elpidi ofeilei o arotriwn arotrian kai o alown thv elpidov autou metecein ep elpidi
draft_translation: Or does he say it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes it was written, that the one who plows ought to plow in hope, and the one who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
ukjv_translation: Or says he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that plows should plow in hope; and that he that threshes in hope should be partaker of his hope.

greek_text: ει ημεις υμιν τα πνευματικα εσπειραμεν μεγα ει ημεις υμων τα σαρκικα θερισομεν
transliteration: ei hmeiv umin ta pneumatika espeiramen mega ei hmeiv umwn ta sarkika yerisomen
draft_translation: If we sowed spiritual things to you, is it a great thing if we shall reap your material things?
ukjv_translation: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

greek_text: ει αλλοι της εξουσιας υμων μετεχουσιν ου μαλλον ημεις αλλ ουκ εχρησαμεθα τη εξουσια ταυτη αλλα παντα στεγομεν ινα μη εγκοπην τινα δωμεν τω ευαγγελιω του χριστου
transliteration: ei alloi thv exousiav umwn metecousin ou mallon hmeiv all ouk ecrhsameya th exousia tauth alla panta stegomen ina mh egkophn tina dwmen tw euaggeliw tou cristou
draft_translation: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the good news of Christ.
ukjv_translation: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

greek_text: ουκ οιδατε οτι οι τα ιερα εργαζομενοι εκ του ιερου εσθιουσιν οι τω θυσιαστηριω προσεδρευοντες τω θυσιαστηριω συμμεριζονται
transliteration: ouk oidate oti oi ta iera ergazomenoi ek tou ierou esyiousin oi tw yusiasthriw prosedreuontev tw yusiasthriw summerizontai
draft_translation: Do you not know that those who work in sacred things eat from the temple, and those who attend at the altar share with the altar?
ukjv_translation: Do all of you not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

greek_text: ουτως και ο κυριος διεταξεν τοις το ευαγγελιον καταγγελλουσιν εκ του ευαγγελιου ζην
transliteration: outwv kai o kuriov dietaxen toiv to euaggelion kataggellousin ek tou euaggeliou zhn
draft_translation: Even so has the Lord ordained that those who preach the good news should live of the good news.
ukjv_translation: Even so has the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
review_notes: modernized they-which relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: εγω δε ουδενι εχρησαμην τουτων ουκ εγραψα δε ταυτα ινα ουτως γενηται εν εμοι καλον γαρ μοι μαλλον αποθανειν η το καυχημα μου ινα τις κενωση
transliteration: egw de oudeni ecrhsamhn toutwn ouk egraqa de tauta ina outwv genhtai en emoi kalon gar moi mallon apoyanein h to kauchma mou ina tiv kenwsh
draft_translation: But I have used none of these things: nor did I write these things that it should be so done to me; for it would be better for me to die, than that anyone should make my boasting empty.
ukjv_translation: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

greek_text: εαν γαρ ευαγγελιζωμαι ουκ εστιν μοι καυχημα αναγκη γαρ μοι επικειται ουαι δε μοι εστιν εαν μη ευαγγελιζωμαι
transliteration: ean gar euaggelizwmai ouk estin moi kauchma anagkh gar moi epikeitai ouai de moi estin ean mh euaggelizwmai
draft_translation: For though I preach the good news, I have nothing to boast of: for necessity is laid upon me; yes, woe is to me, if I preach not the good news!
ukjv_translation: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized yea; rendered euangelion as good news; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: ει γαρ εκων τουτο πρασσω μισθον εχω ει δε ακων οικονομιαν πεπιστευμαι
transliteration: ei gar ekwn touto prassw misyon ecw ei de akwn oikonomian pepisteumai
draft_translation: For if I practice this willingly, I have a reward: but if unwillingly, a stewardship has been entrusted to me.
ukjv_translation: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

greek_text: τις ουν μοι εστιν ο μισθος ινα ευαγγελιζομενος αδαπανον θησω το ευαγγελιον του χριστου εις το μη καταχρησασθαι τη εξουσια μου εν τω ευαγγελιω
transliteration: tiv oun moi estin o misyov ina euaggelizomenov adapanon yhsw to euaggelion tou cristou eiv to mh katacrhsasyai th exousia mou en tw euaggeliw
draft_translation: What is my reward then? truly that, when I preach the good news, I may make the good news of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the good news.
ukjv_translation: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
review_notes: modernized verily; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ελευθερος γαρ ων εκ παντων πασιν εμαυτον εδουλωσα ινα τους πλειονας κερδησω
transliteration: eleuyerov gar wn ek pantwn pasin emauton edoulwsa ina touv pleionav kerdhsw
draft_translation: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself slave to all, that I might gain the more.
ukjv_translation: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: και εγενομην τοις ιουδαιοις ως ιουδαιος ινα ιουδαιους κερδησω τοις υπο νομον ως υπο νομον ινα τους υπο νομον κερδησω
transliteration: kai egenomhn toiv ioudaioiv wv ioudaiov ina ioudaiouv kerdhsw toiv upo nomon wv upo nomon ina touv upo nomon kerdhsw
draft_translation: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those under law, as under law, that I might gain those under law;
ukjv_translation: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

greek_text: τοις ανομοις ως ανομος μη ων ανομος θεω αλλ εννομος χριστω ινα κερδησω ανομους
transliteration: toiv anomoiv wv anomov mh wn anomov yew all ennomov cristw ina kerdhsw anomouv
draft_translation: To those without law, as without law, not being lawless to God, but under Christ's law, that I might gain those without law.
ukjv_translation: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

greek_text: εγενομην τοις ασθενεσιν ως ασθενης ινα τους ασθενεις κερδησω τοις πασιν γεγονα τα παντα ινα παντως τινας σωσω
transliteration: egenomhn toiv asyenesin wv asyenhv ina touv asyeneiv kerdhsw toiv pasin gegona ta panta ina pantwv tinav swsw
draft_translation: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak: to all I have become all things, that by all means I might save some.
ukjv_translation: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

greek_text: τουτο δε ποιω δια το ευαγγελιον ινα συγκοινωνος αυτου γενωμαι
transliteration: touto de poiw dia to euaggelion ina sugkoinwnov autou genwmai
draft_translation: And this I do for the sake of the good news, that I might be partaker of it with you.
ukjv_translation: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
review_notes: fixed good-news possessive artifact; modernized thereof; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουκ οιδατε οτι οι εν σταδιω τρεχοντες παντες μεν τρεχουσιν εις δε λαμβανει το βραβειον ουτως τρεχετε ινα καταλαβητε
transliteration: ouk oidate oti oi en stadiw trecontev pantev men trecousin eiv de lambanei to brabeion outwv trecete ina katalabhte
draft_translation: Do you not know that those who run in a stadium all run, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.
ukjv_translation: Know all of you not that they which run in a race run all, but one receives the prize? So run, that all of you may obtain.

greek_text: πας δε ο αγωνιζομενος παντα εγκρατευεται εκεινοι μεν ουν ινα φθαρτον στεφανον λαβωσιν ημεις δε αφθαρτον
transliteration: pav de o agwnizomenov panta egkrateuetai ekeinoi men oun ina fyarton stefanon labwsin hmeiv de afyarton
draft_translation: And everyone who competes exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a perishable wreath; but we an imperishable.
ukjv_translation: And every man that strives for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

greek_text: εγω τοινυν ουτως τρεχω ως ουκ αδηλως ουτως πυκτευω ως ουκ αερα δερων
transliteration: egw toinun outwv trecw wv ouk adhlwv outwv pukteuw wv ouk aera derwn
draft_translation: Therefore I run in this way, not uncertainly; I fight in this way, not as beating air:
ukjv_translation: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beats the air:

greek_text: αλλ υπωπιαζω μου το σωμα και δουλαγωγω μηπως αλλοις κηρυξας αυτος αδοκιμος γενωμαι
transliteration: all upwpiazw mou to swma kai doulagwgw mhpwv alloiv khruxav autov adokimov genwmai
draft_translation: But I discipline my body and enslave it, lest somehow, after preaching to others, I myself should become disapproved.
ukjv_translation: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

greek_text: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι οτι οι πατερες ημων παντες υπο την νεφελην ησαν και παντες δια της θαλασσης διηλθον
transliteration: ou yelw de umav agnoein adelfoi oti oi paterev hmwn pantev upo thn nefelhn hsan kai pantev dia thv yalasshv dihlyon
draft_translation: Now I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
ukjv_translation: Moreover, brethren, I would not that all of you should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

greek_text: και παντες εις τον μωσην εβαπτισαντο εν τη νεφελη και εν τη θαλασση
transliteration: kai pantev eiv ton mwshn ebaptisanto en th nefelh kai en th yalassh
draft_translation: And all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
ukjv_translation: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

greek_text: και παντες το αυτο βρωμα πνευματικον εφαγον
transliteration: kai pantev to auto brwma pneumatikon efagon
draft_translation: And all ate the same spiritual food;
ukjv_translation: And did all eat the same spiritual food;

greek_text: και παντες το αυτο πομα πνευματικον επιον επινον γαρ εκ πνευματικης ακολουθουσης πετρας η δε πετρα ην ο χριστος
transliteration: kai pantev to auto poma pneumatikon epion epinon gar ek pneumatikhv akolouyoushv petrav h de petra hn o cristov
draft_translation: And all drank the same spiritual drink: for they drank from a spiritual Rock following them: and the Rock was Christ.
ukjv_translation: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

greek_text: αλλ ουκ εν τοις πλειοσιν αυτων ευδοκησεν ο θεος κατεστρωθησαν γαρ εν τη ερημω
transliteration: all ouk en toiv pleiosin autwn eudokhsen o yeov katestrwyhsan gar en th erhmw
draft_translation: But with most of them God was not well pleased: for they were strewn in the wilderness.
ukjv_translation: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

greek_text: ταυτα δε τυποι ημων εγενηθησαν εις το μη ειναι ημας επιθυμητας κακων καθως κακεινοι επεθυμησαν
transliteration: tauta de tupoi hmwn egenhyhsan eiv to mh einai hmav epiyumhtav kakwn kaywv kakeinoi epeyumhsan
draft_translation: Now these things became types for us, so that we should not be desirers of evil things, as they also desired.
ukjv_translation: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

greek_text: μηδε ειδωλολατραι γινεσθε καθως τινες αυτων ως γεγραπται εκαθισεν ο λαος φαγειν και πιειν και ανεστησαν παιζειν
transliteration: mhde eidwlolatrai ginesye kaywv tinev autwn wv gegraptai ekayisen o laov fagein kai piein kai anesthsan paizein
draft_translation: Neither become idolaters, as some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
ukjv_translation: Neither be all of you idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

greek_text: μηδε πορνευωμεν καθως τινες αυτων επορνευσαν και επεσον εν μια ημερα εικοσιτρεις χιλιαδες
transliteration: mhde porneuwmen kaywv tinev autwn eporneusan kai epeson en mia hmera eikositreiv ciliadev
draft_translation: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
ukjv_translation: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

greek_text: μηδε εκπειραζωμεν τον χριστον καθως και τινες αυτων επειρασαν και υπο των οφεων απωλοντο
transliteration: mhde ekpeirazwmen ton criston kaywv kai tinev autwn epeirasan kai upo twn ofewn apwlonto
draft_translation: Neither let us test Christ, as some of them also tested, and were destroyed by the serpents.
ukjv_translation: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

greek_text: μηδε γογγυζετε καθως και τινες αυτων εγογγυσαν και απωλοντο υπο του ολοθρευτου
transliteration: mhde gogguzete kaywv kai tinev autwn egoggusan kai apwlonto upo tou oloyreutou
draft_translation: Neither murmur, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed by the destroyer.
ukjv_translation: Neither murmur all of you, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

greek_text: ταυτα δε παντα τυποι συνεβαινον εκεινοις εγραφη δε προς νουθεσιαν ημων εις ους τα τελη των αιωνων κατηντησεν
transliteration: tauta de panta tupoi sunebainon ekeinoiv egrafh de prov nouyesian hmwn eiv ouv ta telh twn aiwnwn kathnthsen
draft_translation: Now all these things happened to them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages have come.
ukjv_translation: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized are-come perfect; rendered aion as age

greek_text: ωστε ο δοκων εσταναι βλεπετω μη πεση
transliteration: wste o dokwn estanai blepetw mh pesh
draft_translation: Therefore let the one who thinks he stands watch lest he fall.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore let him that thinks he stands take heed lest he fall.

greek_text: πειρασμος υμας ουκ ειληφεν ει μη ανθρωπινος πιστος δε ο θεος ος ουκ εασει υμας πειρασθηναι υπερ ο δυνασθε αλλα ποιησει συν τω πειρασμω και την εκβασιν του δυνασθαι υμας υπενεγκειν
transliteration: peirasmov umav ouk eilhfen ei mh anyrwpinov pistov de o yeov ov ouk easei umav peirasyhnai uper o dunasye alla poihsei sun tw peirasmw kai thn ekbasin tou dunasyai umav upenegkein
draft_translation: No temptation has taken you except what is human: but God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will also make the way out, so that you may be able to bear it.
ukjv_translation: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that all of you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that all of you may be able to bear it.

greek_text: διοπερ αγαπητοι μου φευγετε απο της ειδωλολατρειας
transliteration: dioper agaphtoi mou feugete apo thv eidwlolatreiav
draft_translation: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

greek_text: ως φρονιμοις λεγω κρινατε υμεις ο φημι
transliteration: wv fronimoiv legw krinate umeiv o fhmi
draft_translation: I speak as to sensible ones; you judge what I say.
ukjv_translation: I speak as to wise men; judge all of you what I say.

greek_text: το ποτηριον της ευλογιας ο ευλογουμεν ουχι κοινωνια του αιματος του χριστου εστιν τον αρτον ον κλωμεν ουχι κοινωνια του σωματος του χριστου εστιν
transliteration: to pothrion thv eulogiav o eulogoumen ouci koinwnia tou aimatov tou cristou estin ton arton on klwmen ouci koinwnia tou swmatov tou cristou estin
draft_translation: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
ukjv_translation: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: οτι εις αρτος εν σωμα οι πολλοι εσμεν οι γαρ παντες εκ του ενος αρτου μετεχομεν
transliteration: oti eiv artov en swma oi polloi esmen oi gar pantev ek tou enov artou metecomen
draft_translation: Because we, the many, are one bread, one body: for we all partake from the one bread.
ukjv_translation: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

greek_text: βλεπετε τον ισραηλ κατα σαρκα ουχι οι εσθιοντες τας θυσιας κοινωνοι του θυσιαστηριου εισιν
transliteration: blepete ton israhl kata sarka ouci oi esyiontev tav yusiav koinwnoi tou yusiasthriou eisin
draft_translation: Look at Israel according to flesh: are not those who eat the sacrifices partners of the altar?
ukjv_translation: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

greek_text: τι ουν φημι οτι ειδωλον τι εστιν η οτι ειδωλοθυτον τι εστιν
transliteration: ti oun fhmi oti eidwlon ti estin h oti eidwloyuton ti estin
draft_translation: What then do I say? that an idol is anything, or that an idol-offering is anything?
ukjv_translation: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

greek_text: αλλ οτι α θυει τα εθνη δαιμονιοις θυει και ου θεω ου θελω δε υμας κοινωνους των δαιμονιων γινεσθαι
transliteration: all oti a yuei ta eynh daimonioiv yuei kai ou yew ou yelw de umav koinwnouv twn daimoniwn ginesyai
draft_translation: But I say, that the things which the nations sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God: and I would not that you should have fellowship with demons.
ukjv_translation: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that all of you should have fellowship with devils.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered daimonion as demon; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: ου δυνασθε ποτηριον κυριου πινειν και ποτηριον δαιμονιων ου δυνασθε τραπεζης κυριου μετεχειν και τραπεζης δαιμονιων
transliteration: ou dunasye pothrion kuriou pinein kai pothrion daimoniwn ou dunasye trapezhv kuriou metecein kai trapezhv daimoniwn
draft_translation: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of demons: you cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of demons.
ukjv_translation: All of you cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: all of you cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: η παραζηλουμεν τον κυριον μη ισχυροτεροι αυτου εσμεν
transliteration: h parazhloumen ton kurion mh iscuroteroi autou esmen
draft_translation: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
ukjv_translation: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

greek_text: παντα μοι εξεστιν αλλ ου παντα συμφερει παντα μοι εξεστιν αλλ ου παντα οικοδομει
transliteration: panta moi exestin all ou panta sumferei panta moi exestin all ou panta oikodomei
draft_translation: All things are lawful to me, but not all things are profitable: all things are lawful to me, but not all things build up.
ukjv_translation: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

greek_text: μηδεις το εαυτου ζητειτω αλλα το του ετερου εκαστος
transliteration: mhdeiv to eautou zhteitw alla to tou eterou ekastov
draft_translation: Let no one seek his own, but each the other's.
ukjv_translation: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.

greek_text: παν το εν μακελλω πωλουμενον εσθιετε μηδεν ανακρινοντες δια την συνειδησιν
transliteration: pan to en makellw pwloumenon esyiete mhden anakrinontev dia thn suneidhsin
draft_translation: Eat whatever is sold in the meat market, examining nothing because of conscience:
ukjv_translation: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

greek_text: του γαρ κυριου η γη και το πληρωμα αυτης
transliteration: tou gar kuriou h gh kai to plhrwma authv
draft_translation: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fullness of it.
ukjv_translation: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof.
review_notes: modernized thereof; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ει δε τις καλει υμας των απιστων και θελετε πορευεσθαι παν το παρατιθεμενον υμιν εσθιετε μηδεν ανακρινοντες δια την συνειδησιν
transliteration: ei de tiv kalei umav twn apistwn kai yelete poreuesyai pan to paratiyemenon umin esyiete mhden anakrinontev dia thn suneidhsin
draft_translation: And if anyone of the unbelievers calls you, and you wish to go, eat whatever is set before you, examining nothing because of conscience.
ukjv_translation: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and all of you be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

greek_text: εαν δε τις υμιν ειπη τουτο ειδωλοθυτον εστιν μη εσθιετε δι εκεινον τον μηνυσαντα και την συνειδησιν του γαρ κυριου η γη και το πληρωμα αυτης
transliteration: ean de tiv umin eiph touto eidwloyuton estin mh esyiete di ekeinon ton mhnusanta kai thn suneidhsin tou gar kuriou h gh kai to plhrwma authv
draft_translation: But if anyone say to you, This is offered in sacrifice to idols, do not eat for his sake that showed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fullness of it:
ukjv_translation: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that showed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof:
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized eat-not wording; modernized thereof; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: συνειδησιν δε λεγω ουχι την εαυτου αλλα την του ετερου ινα τι γαρ η ελευθερια μου κρινεται υπο αλλης συνειδησεως
transliteration: suneidhsin de legw ouci thn eautou alla thn tou eterou ina ti gar h eleuyeria mou krinetai upo allhv suneidhsewv
draft_translation: But conscience, I say, not your own, but that of the other: for why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
ukjv_translation: Conscience, I say, not yours own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?

greek_text: ει δε εγω χαριτι μετεχω τι βλασφημουμαι υπερ ου εγω ευχαριστω
transliteration: ei de egw cariti metecw ti blasfhmoumai uper ou egw eucaristw
draft_translation: For if I partake by grace, why am I blasphemed for that for which I give thanks?
ukjv_translation: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

greek_text: ειτε ουν εσθιετε ειτε πινετε ειτε τι ποιειτε παντα εις δοξαν θεου ποιειτε
transliteration: eite oun esyiete eite pinete eite ti poieite panta eiv doxan yeou poieite
draft_translation: Therefore whether you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
ukjv_translation: Whether therefore all of you eat, or drink, or whatsoever all of you do, do all to the glory of God.

greek_text: απροσκοποι γινεσθε και ιουδαιοις και ελλησιν και τη εκκλησια του θεου
transliteration: aproskopoi ginesye kai ioudaioiv kai ellhsin kai th ekklhsia tou yeou
draft_translation: Give none offense, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the assembly of God:
ukjv_translation: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
review_notes: modernized offence spelling; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: καθως καγω παντα πασιν αρεσκω μη ζητων το εμαυτου συμφερον αλλα το των πολλων ινα σωθωσιν
transliteration: kaywv kagw panta pasin areskw mh zhtwn to emautou sumferon alla to twn pollwn ina swywsin
draft_translation: Just as I also please all in all things, not seeking my own profit, but that of the many, that they may be saved.
ukjv_translation: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

greek_text: μιμηται μου γινεσθε καθως καγω χριστου
transliteration: mimhtai mou ginesye kaywv kagw cristou
draft_translation: Become imitators of me, just as I also am of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Be all of you followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

greek_text: επαινω δε υμας αδελφοι οτι παντα μου μεμνησθε και καθως παρεδωκα υμιν τας παραδοσεις κατεχετε
transliteration: epainw de umav adelfoi oti panta mou memnhsye kai kaywv paredwka umin tav paradoseiv katecete
draft_translation: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold the traditions, just as I delivered them to you.
ukjv_translation: Now I praise you, brethren, that all of you remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

greek_text: θελω δε υμας ειδεναι οτι παντος ανδρος η κεφαλη ο χριστος εστιν κεφαλη δε γυναικος ο ανηρ κεφαλη δε χριστου ο θεος
transliteration: yelw de umav eidenai oti pantov androv h kefalh o cristov estin kefalh de gunaikov o anhr kefalh de cristou o yeov
draft_translation: But I want you to know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of woman is man; and the head of Christ is God.
ukjv_translation: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

greek_text: πας ανηρ προσευχομενος η προφητευων κατα κεφαλης εχων καταισχυνει την κεφαλην αυτου
transliteration: pav anhr proseucomenov h profhteuwn kata kefalhv ecwn kataiscunei thn kefalhn autou
draft_translation: Every man praying or prophesying, having something down over his head, dishonors his head.
ukjv_translation: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonours his head.

greek_text: πασα δε γυνη προσευχομενη η προφητευουσα ακατακαλυπτω τη κεφαλη καταισχυνει την κεφαλην εαυτης εν γαρ εστιν και το αυτο τη εξυρημενη
transliteration: pasa de gunh proseucomenh h profhteuousa akatakaluptw th kefalh kataiscunei thn kefalhn eauthv en gar estin kai to auto th exurhmenh
draft_translation: But every woman praying or prophesying with the head uncovered dishonors her own head: for it is one and the same as the one having been shaved.
ukjv_translation: But every woman that prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonours her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

greek_text: ει γαρ ου κατακαλυπτεται γυνη και κειρασθω ει δε αισχρον γυναικι το κειρασθαι η ξυρασθαι κατακαλυπτεσθω
transliteration: ei gar ou katakaluptetai gunh kai keirasyw ei de aiscron gunaiki to keirasyai h xurasyai katakaluptesyw
draft_translation: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.
ukjv_translation: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

greek_text: ανηρ μεν γαρ ουκ οφειλει κατακαλυπτεσθαι την κεφαλην εικων και δοξα θεου υπαρχων γυνη δε δοξα ανδρος εστιν
transliteration: anhr men gar ouk ofeilei katakaluptesyai thn kefalhn eikwn kai doxa yeou uparcwn gunh de doxa androv estin
draft_translation: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, being the image and glory of God: but woman is the glory of man.
ukjv_translation: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν ανηρ εκ γυναικος αλλα γυνη εξ ανδρος
transliteration: ou gar estin anhr ek gunaikov alla gunh ex androv
draft_translation: For man is not from woman, but woman from man.
ukjv_translation: For the man is not of the woman: but the woman of the man.

greek_text: και γαρ ουκ εκτισθη ανηρ δια την γυναικα αλλα γυνη δια τον ανδρα
transliteration: kai gar ouk ektisyh anhr dia thn gunaika alla gunh dia ton andra
draft_translation: For also man was not created because of the woman, but woman because of the man.
ukjv_translation: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

greek_text: δια τουτο οφειλει η γυνη εξουσιαν εχειν επι της κεφαλης δια τους αγγελους
transliteration: dia touto ofeilei h gunh exousian ecein epi thv kefalhv dia touv aggelouv
draft_translation: Because of this the woman ought to have authority on her head because of the angels.
ukjv_translation: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

greek_text: πλην ουτε ανηρ χωρις γυναικος ουτε γυνη χωρις ανδρος εν κυριω
transliteration: plhn oute anhr cwriv gunaikov oute gunh cwriv androv en kuriw
draft_translation: Nevertheless neither is man apart from woman, nor woman apart from man, in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

greek_text: ωσπερ γαρ η γυνη εκ του ανδρος ουτως και ο ανηρ δια της γυναικος τα δε παντα εκ του θεου
transliteration: wsper gar h gunh ek tou androv outwv kai o anhr dia thv gunaikov ta de panta ek tou yeou
draft_translation: For just as the woman is from the man, so also the man is through the woman; but all things are from God.
ukjv_translation: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

greek_text: εν υμιν αυτοις κρινατε πρεπον εστιν γυναικα ακατακαλυπτον τω θεω προσευχεσθαι
transliteration: en umin autoiv krinate prepon estin gunaika akatakalupton tw yew proseucesyai
draft_translation: Judge among yourselves: is it proper for a woman to pray to God uncovered?
ukjv_translation: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

greek_text: η ουδε αυτη η φυσις διδασκει υμας οτι ανηρ μεν εαν κομα ατιμια αυτω εστιν
transliteration: h oude auth h fusiv didaskei umav oti anhr men ean koma atimia autw estin
draft_translation: Does not even nature itself teach you, that if a man has long hair, it is dishonor to him?
ukjv_translation: Does not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

greek_text: γυνη δε εαν κομα δοξα αυτη εστιν οτι η κομη αντι περιβολαιου δεδοται αυτη
transliteration: gunh de ean koma doxa auth estin oti h komh anti peribolaiou dedotai auth
draft_translation: But if a woman has long hair, it is glory to her: for her hair has been given to her for a covering.
ukjv_translation: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

greek_text: ει δε τις δοκει φιλονεικος ειναι ημεις τοιαυτην συνηθειαν ουκ εχομεν ουδε αι εκκλησιαι του θεου
transliteration: ei de tiv dokei filoneikov einai hmeiv toiauthn sunhyeian ouk ecomen oude ai ekklhsiai tou yeou
draft_translation: But if anyone seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the assemblies of God.
ukjv_translation: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: τουτο δε παραγγελλων ουκ επαινω οτι ουκ εις το κρειττον αλλ εις το ηττον συνερχεσθε
transliteration: touto de paraggellwn ouk epainw oti ouk eiv to kreitton all eiv to htton sunercesye
draft_translation: Now commanding this, I do not praise you, because you come together not for the better, but for the worse.
ukjv_translation: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that all of you come together not for the better, but for the worse.

greek_text: πρωτον μεν γαρ συνερχομενων υμων εν τη εκκλησια ακουω σχισματα εν υμιν υπαρχειν και μερος τι πιστευω
transliteration: prwton men gar sunercomenwn umwn en th ekklhsia akouw scismata en umin uparcein kai merov ti pisteuw
draft_translation: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that there is divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
ukjv_translation: For first of all, when all of you come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
review_notes: modernized there-be idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: δει γαρ και αιρεσεις εν υμιν ειναι ινα οι δοκιμοι φανεροι γενωνται εν υμιν
transliteration: dei gar kai aireseiv en umin einai ina oi dokimoi faneroi genwntai en umin
draft_translation: For there must also be factions among you, that the approved may become manifest among you.
ukjv_translation: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

greek_text: συνερχομενων ουν υμων επι το αυτο ουκ εστιν κυριακον δειπνον φαγειν
transliteration: sunercomenwn oun umwn epi to auto ouk estin kuriakon deipnon fagein
draft_translation: Therefore when you come together in the same place, it is not to eat the Lord's supper.
ukjv_translation: When all of you come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

greek_text: εκαστος γαρ το ιδιον δειπνον προλαμβανει εν τω φαγειν και ος μεν πεινα ος δε μεθυει
transliteration: ekastov gar to idion deipnon prolambanei en tw fagein kai ov men peina ov de meyuei
draft_translation: For in eating, each takes his own supper beforehand: and one is hungry, and another is drunk.
ukjv_translation: For in eating every one takes before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

greek_text: μη γαρ οικιας ουκ εχετε εις το εσθιειν και πινειν η της εκκλησιας του θεου καταφρονειτε και καταισχυνετε τους μη εχοντας τι υμιν ειπω επαινεσω υμας εν τουτω ουκ επαινω
transliteration: mh gar oikiav ouk ecete eiv to esyiein kai pinein h thv ekklhsiav tou yeou katafroneite kai kataiscunete touv mh econtav ti umin eipw epainesw umav en toutw ouk epainw
draft_translation: What? have you not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise you the assembly of God, and shame those who have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
ukjv_translation: What? have all of you not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise all of you the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: εγω γαρ παρελαβον απο του κυριου ο και παρεδωκα υμιν οτι ο κυριος ιησους εν τη νυκτι η παρεδιδοτο ελαβεν αρτον
transliteration: egw gar parelabon apo tou kuriou o kai paredwka umin oti o kuriov ihsouv en th nukti h paredidoto elaben arton
draft_translation: For I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus, in the night in which he was delivered up, took bread:
ukjv_translation: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

greek_text: και ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και ειπεν λαβετε φαγετε τουτο μου εστιν το σωμα το υπερ υμων κλωμενον τουτο ποιειτε εις την εμην αναμνησιν
transliteration: kai eucaristhsav eklasen kai eipen labete fagete touto mou estin to swma to uper umwn klwmenon touto poieite eiv thn emhn anamnhsin
draft_translation: And having given thanks, he broke it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: do this in remembrance of me.
ukjv_translation: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

greek_text: ωσαυτως και το ποτηριον μετα το δειπνησαι λεγων τουτο το ποτηριον η καινη διαθηκη εστιν εν τω εμω αιματι τουτο ποιειτε οσακις αν πινητε εις την εμην αναμνησιν
transliteration: wsautwv kai to pothrion meta to deipnhsai legwn touto to pothrion h kainh diayhkh estin en tw emw aimati touto poieite osakiv an pinhte eiv thn emhn anamnhsin
draft_translation: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood: this do you, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me.
ukjv_translation: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do all of you, as often as all of you drink it, in remembrance of me.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered diatheke as covenant

greek_text: οσακις γαρ αν εσθιητε τον αρτον τουτον και το ποτηριον τουτο πινητε τον θανατον του κυριου καταγγελλετε αχρις ου αν ελθη
transliteration: osakiv gar an esyihte ton arton touton kai to pothrion touto pinhte ton yanaton tou kuriou kataggellete acriv ou an elyh
draft_translation: For as often as you eat this bread, and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.
ukjv_translation: For as often as all of you eat this bread, and drink this cup, all of you do show the Lord's death till he comes.

greek_text: ωστε ος αν εσθιη τον αρτον τουτον η πινη το ποτηριον του κυριου αναξιως ενοχος εσται του σωματος και αιματος του κυριου
transliteration: wste ov an esyih ton arton touton h pinh to pothrion tou kuriou anaxiwv enocov estai tou swmatov kai aimatov tou kuriou
draft_translation: Therefore whoever eats this bread, or drinks the cup of the Lord unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

greek_text: δοκιμαζετω δε ανθρωπος εαυτον και ουτως εκ του αρτου εσθιετω και εκ του ποτηριου πινετω
transliteration: dokimazetw de anyrwpov eauton kai outwv ek tou artou esyietw kai ek tou pothriou pinetw
draft_translation: But let a human examine himself, and so let him eat from the bread, and drink from the cup.
ukjv_translation: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

greek_text: ο γαρ εσθιων και πινων αναξιως κριμα εαυτω εσθιει και πινει μη διακρινων το σωμα του κυριου
transliteration: o gar esyiwn kai pinwn anaxiwv krima eautw esyiei kai pinei mh diakrinwn to swma tou kuriou
draft_translation: For the one who eats and drinks unworthily, eats and drinks judgment to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
ukjv_translation: For he that eats and drinks unworthily, eats and drinks damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered krima/krisis as judgment

greek_text: δια τουτο εν υμιν πολλοι ασθενεις και αρρωστοι και κοιμωνται ικανοι
transliteration: dia touto en umin polloi asyeneiv kai arrwstoi kai koimwntai ikanoi
draft_translation: Because of this many among you are weak and sick, and many sleep.
ukjv_translation: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

greek_text: ει γαρ εαυτους διεκρινομεν ουκ αν εκρινομεθα
transliteration: ei gar eautouv diekrinomen ouk an ekrinomeya
draft_translation: For if we judged ourselves, we would not be judged.
ukjv_translation: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

greek_text: κρινομενοι δε υπο κυριου παιδευομεθα ινα μη συν τω κοσμω κατακριθωμεν
transliteration: krinomenoi de upo kuriou paideuomeya ina mh sun tw kosmw katakriywmen
draft_translation: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
ukjv_translation: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

greek_text: ωστε αδελφοι μου συνερχομενοι εις το φαγειν αλληλους εκδεχεσθε
transliteration: wste adelfoi mou sunercomenoi eiv to fagein allhlouv ekdecesye
draft_translation: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, my brethren, when all of you come together to eat, tarry one for another.

greek_text: ει δε τις πεινα εν οικω εσθιετω ινα μη εις κριμα συνερχησθε τα δε λοιπα ως αν ελθω διαταξομαι
transliteration: ei de tiv peina en oikw esyietw ina mh eiv krima sunerchsye ta de loipa wv an elyw diataxomai
draft_translation: And if anyone hungers, let him eat at home; that you may not come together for judgment. And the rest I will set in order when I come.
ukjv_translation: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that all of you come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

greek_text: περι δε των πνευματικων αδελφοι ου θελω υμας αγνοειν
transliteration: peri de twn pneumatikwn adelfoi ou yelw umav agnoein
draft_translation: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant.
ukjv_translation: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

greek_text: οιδατε οτι εθνη ητε προς τα ειδωλα τα αφωνα ως αν ηγεσθε απαγομενοι
transliteration: oidate oti eynh hte prov ta eidwla ta afwna wv an hgesye apagomenoi
draft_translation: You know that you were of the nations, carried away to these voiceless idols, even as you were led.
ukjv_translation: All of you know that all of you were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as all of you were led.

greek_text: διο γνωριζω υμιν οτι ουδεις εν πνευματι θεου λαλων λεγει αναθεμα ιησουν και ουδεις δυναται ειπειν κυριον ιησουν ει μη εν πνευματι αγιω
transliteration: dio gnwrizw umin oti oudeiv en pneumati yeou lalwn legei anayema ihsoun kai oudeiv dunatai eipein kurion ihsoun ei mh en pneumati agiw
draft_translation: Therefore I give you to understand, that no one speaking by the Spirit of God calls Jesus accursed: and that no one can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God calls Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; modernized wherefore; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: διαιρεσεις δε χαρισματων εισιν το δε αυτο πνευμα
transliteration: diaireseiv de carismatwn eisin to de auto pneuma
draft_translation: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: και διαιρεσεις διακονιων εισιν και ο αυτος κυριος
transliteration: kai diaireseiv diakoniwn eisin kai o autov kuriov
draft_translation: And there are varieties of services, but the same Lord.
ukjv_translation: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

greek_text: και διαιρεσεις ενεργηματων εισιν ο δε αυτος εστιν θεος ο ενεργων τα παντα εν πασιν
transliteration: kai diaireseiv energhmatwn eisin o de autov estin yeov o energwn ta panta en pasin
draft_translation: And there are varieties of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
ukjv_translation: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which works all in all.

greek_text: εκαστω δε διδοται η φανερωσις του πνευματος προς το συμφερον
transliteration: ekastw de didotai h fanerwsiv tou pneumatov prov to sumferon
draft_translation: But to each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for profit.
ukjv_translation: But the manifestation of the Spirit (o. pneuma) is given to every man to profit likewise.

greek_text: ω μεν γαρ δια του πνευματος διδοται λογος σοφιας αλλω δε λογος γνωσεως κατα το αυτο πνευμα
transliteration: w men gar dia tou pneumatov didotai logov sofiav allw de logov gnwsewv kata to auto pneuma
draft_translation: For to one is given through the Spirit a word of wisdom; and to another a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit;
ukjv_translation: In order to one is given by the Spirit (o. pneuma) the word (o. logos) of wisdom; to another the word (o. logos) of knowledge by the same Spirit; (o. pneuma)

greek_text: ετερω δε πιστις εν τω αυτω πνευματι αλλω δε χαρισματα ιαματων εν τω αυτω πνευματι
transliteration: eterw de pistiv en tw autw pneumati allw de carismata iamatwn en tw autw pneumati
draft_translation: And to another faith in the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings in the same Spirit;
ukjv_translation: To another faith by the same Spirit; (o. pneuma) to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit; (o. pneuma)

greek_text: αλλω δε ενεργηματα δυναμεων αλλω δε προφητεια αλλω δε διακρισεις πνευματων ετερω δε γενη γλωσσων αλλω δε ερμηνεια γλωσσων
transliteration: allw de energhmata dunamewn allw de profhteia allw de diakriseiv pneumatwn eterw de genh glwsswn allw de ermhneia glwsswn
draft_translation: And to another workings of powers; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits; and to another kinds of tongues; and to another interpretation of tongues:
ukjv_translation: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; (o. pneuma) to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

greek_text: παντα δε ταυτα ενεργει το εν και το αυτο πνευμα διαιρουν ιδια εκαστω καθως βουλεται
transliteration: panta de tauta energei to en kai to auto pneuma diairoun idia ekastw kaywv bouletai
draft_translation: But all these things the one and the same Spirit works, distributing individually to each as he wills.
ukjv_translation: But all these works that one and the very same Spirit, (o. pneuma) dividing to every man severally as he will.

greek_text: καθαπερ γαρ το σωμα εν εστιν και μελη εχει πολλα παντα δε τα μελη του σωματος του ενος πολλα οντα εν εστιν σωμα ουτως και ο χριστος
transliteration: kayaper gar to swma en estin kai melh ecei polla panta de ta melh tou swmatov tou enov polla onta en estin swma outwv kai o cristov
draft_translation: For just as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
ukjv_translation: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

greek_text: και γαρ εν ενι πνευματι ημεις παντες εις εν σωμα εβαπτισθημεν ειτε ιουδαιοι ειτε ελληνες ειτε δουλοι ειτε ελευθεροι και παντες εις εν πνευμα εποτισθημεν
transliteration: kai gar en eni pneumati hmeiv pantev eiv en swma ebaptisyhmen eite ioudaioi eite ellhnev eite douloi eite eleuyeroi kai pantev eiv en pneuma epotisyhmen
draft_translation: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we are Jews or Gentiles, whether we are slave or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
ukjv_translation: For by one Spirit (o. pneuma) are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: και γαρ το σωμα ουκ εστιν εν μελος αλλα πολλα
transliteration: kai gar to swma ouk estin en melov alla polla
draft_translation: For also the body is not one member, but many.
ukjv_translation: For the body is not one member, but many.

greek_text: εαν ειπη ο πους οτι ουκ ειμι χειρ ουκ ειμι εκ του σωματος ου παρα τουτο ουκ εστιν εκ του σωματος
transliteration: ean eiph o pouv oti ouk eimi ceir ouk eimi ek tou swmatov ou para touto ouk estin ek tou swmatov
draft_translation: If the foot should say, Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body; is it not therefore of the body?
ukjv_translation: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

greek_text: και εαν ειπη το ους οτι ουκ ειμι οφθαλμος ουκ ειμι εκ του σωματος ου παρα τουτο ουκ εστιν εκ του σωματος
transliteration: kai ean eiph to ouv oti ouk eimi ofyalmov ouk eimi ek tou swmatov ou para touto ouk estin ek tou swmatov
draft_translation: And if the ear should say, Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body; is it not therefore of the body?
ukjv_translation: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

greek_text: ει ολον το σωμα οφθαλμος που η ακοη ει ολον ακοη που η οσφρησις
transliteration: ei olon to swma ofyalmov pou h akoh ei olon akoh pou h osfrhsiv
draft_translation: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
ukjv_translation: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

greek_text: νυνι δε ο θεος εθετο τα μελη εν εκαστον αυτων εν τω σωματι καθως ηθελησεν
transliteration: nuni de o yeov eyeto ta melh en ekaston autwn en tw swmati kaywv hyelhsen
draft_translation: But now God set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he willed.
ukjv_translation: But now has God set the members every one of them in the body, as it has pleased him.

greek_text: ει δε ην τα παντα εν μελος που το σωμα
transliteration: ei de hn ta panta en melov pou to swma
draft_translation: And if they were all one member, where would the body be?
ukjv_translation: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

greek_text: νυν δε πολλα μεν μελη εν δε σωμα
transliteration: nun de polla men melh en de swma
draft_translation: But now there are many members, yet one body.
ukjv_translation: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

greek_text: ου δυναται δε οφθαλμος ειπειν τη χειρι χρειαν σου ουκ εχω η παλιν η κεφαλη τοις ποσιν χρειαν υμων ουκ εχω
transliteration: ou dunatai de ofyalmov eipein th ceiri creian sou ouk ecw h palin h kefalh toiv posin creian umwn ouk ecw
draft_translation: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of you: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
ukjv_translation: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of you: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

greek_text: αλλα πολλω μαλλον τα δοκουντα μελη του σωματος ασθενεστερα υπαρχειν αναγκαια εστιν
transliteration: alla pollw mallon ta dokounta melh tou swmatov asyenestera uparcein anagkaia estin
draft_translation: But much rather, the members of the body that seem to be weaker are necessary:
ukjv_translation: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

greek_text: και α δοκουμεν ατιμοτερα ειναι του σωματος τουτοις τιμην περισσοτεραν περιτιθεμεν και τα ασχημονα ημων ευσχημοσυνην περισσοτεραν εχει
transliteration: kai a dokoumen atimotera einai tou swmatov toutoiv timhn perissoteran peritiyemen kai ta aschmona hmwn euschmosunhn perissoteran ecei
draft_translation: And those members of the body which we think to be less honorable, on these we place more abundant honor; and our indecent parts have more abundant modesty.
ukjv_translation: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our indecent parts have more abundant loveliness.

greek_text: τα δε ευσχημονα ημων ου χρειαν εχει αλλ ο θεος συνεκερασεν το σωμα τω υστερουντι περισσοτεραν δους τιμην
transliteration: ta de euschmona hmwn ou creian ecei all o yeov sunekerasen to swma tw usterounti perissoteran douv timhn
draft_translation: But our presentable parts have no need: but God blended the body together, giving more abundant honor to the part that lacked,
ukjv_translation: For our comely parts have no need: but God has tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked.

greek_text: ινα μη η σχισμα εν τω σωματι αλλα το αυτο υπερ αλληλων μεριμνωσιν τα μελη
transliteration: ina mh h scisma en tw swmati alla to auto uper allhlwn merimnwsin ta melh
draft_translation: That there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
ukjv_translation: That there should be no division in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

greek_text: και ειτε πασχει εν μελος συμπασχει παντα τα μελη ειτε δοξαζεται εν μελος συγχαιρει παντα τα μελη
transliteration: kai eite pascei en melov sumpascei panta ta melh eite doxazetai en melov sugcairei panta ta melh
draft_translation: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer together; or if one member is glorified, all the members rejoice together.
ukjv_translation: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

greek_text: υμεις δε εστε σωμα χριστου και μελη εκ μερους
transliteration: umeiv de este swma cristou kai melh ek merouv
draft_translation: Now you are Christ's body, and members in part.
ukjv_translation: Now all of you are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

greek_text: και ους μεν εθετο ο θεος εν τη εκκλησια πρωτον αποστολους δευτερον προφητας τριτον διδασκαλους επειτα δυναμεις ειτα χαρισματα ιαματων αντιληψεις κυβερνησεις γενη γλωσσων
transliteration: kai ouv men eyeto o yeov en th ekklhsia prwton apostolouv deuteron profhtav triton didaskalouv epeita dunameiv eita carismata iamatwn antilhqeiv kubernhseiv genh glwsswn
draft_translation: And God has set some in the assembly, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
ukjv_translation: And God has set some in the church, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

greek_text: μη παντες αποστολοι μη παντες προφηται μη παντες διδασκαλοι μη παντες δυναμεις
transliteration: mh pantev apostoloi mh pantev profhtai mh pantev didaskaloi mh pantev dunameiv
draft_translation: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all powers?
ukjv_translation: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

greek_text: μη παντες χαρισματα εχουσιν ιαματων μη παντες γλωσσαις λαλουσιν μη παντες διερμηνευουσιν
transliteration: mh pantev carismata ecousin iamatwn mh pantev glwssaiv lalousin mh pantev diermhneuousin
draft_translation: Do all have gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
ukjv_translation: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

greek_text: ζηλουτε δε τα χαρισματα τα κρειττονα και ετι καθ υπερβολην οδον υμιν δεικνυμι
transliteration: zhloute de ta carismata ta kreittona kai eti kay uperbolhn odon umin deiknumi
draft_translation: But earnestly desire the better gifts: and yet I show you a way beyond measure.
ukjv_translation: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet show I unto you a more excellent way.

greek_text: εαν ταις γλωσσαις των ανθρωπων λαλω και των αγγελων αγαπην δε μη εχω γεγονα χαλκος ηχων η κυμβαλον αλαλαζον
transliteration: ean taiv glwssaiv twn anyrwpwn lalw kai twn aggelwn agaphn de mh ecw gegona calkov hcwn h kumbalon alalazon
draft_translation: If I speak with the tongues of humans and of angels, but do not have love, I have become sounding bronze or a clanging cymbal.
ukjv_translation: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not love, (o. agape) I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

greek_text: και εαν εχω προφητειαν και ειδω τα μυστηρια παντα και πασαν την γνωσιν και εαν εχω πασαν την πιστιν ωστε ορη μεθιστανειν αγαπην δε μη εχω ουδεν ειμι
transliteration: kai ean ecw profhteian kai eidw ta musthria panta kai pasan thn gnwsin kai ean ecw pasan thn pistin wste orh meyistanein agaphn de mh ecw ouden eimi
draft_translation: And if I have prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
ukjv_translation: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not love, (o. agape) I am nothing.

greek_text: και εαν ψωμισω παντα τα υπαρχοντα μου και εαν παραδω το σωμα μου ινα καυθησωμαι αγαπην δε μη εχω ουδεν ωφελουμαι
transliteration: kai ean qwmisw panta ta uparconta mou kai ean paradw to swma mou ina kauyhswmai agaphn de mh ecw ouden wfeloumai
draft_translation: And if I dole out all my possessions, and if I deliver my body so that I may be burned, but do not have love, I am profited nothing.
ukjv_translation: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not love, (o. agape) it profits me nothing.

greek_text: η αγαπη μακροθυμει χρηστευεται η αγαπη ου ζηλοι η αγαπη ου περπερευεται ου φυσιουται
transliteration: h agaph makroyumei crhsteuetai h agaph ou zhloi h agaph ou perpereuetai ou fusioutai
draft_translation: Love is longsuffering, is kind; love does not envy; love does not boast, is not puffed up,
ukjv_translation: Love (o. agape) suffers long, and is kind; love (o. agape) envies not; love (o. agape) vaunts not itself, is not puffed up,

greek_text: ουκ ασχημονει ου ζητει τα εαυτης ου παροξυνεται ου λογιζεται το κακον
transliteration: ouk aschmonei ou zhtei ta eauthv ou paroxunetai ou logizetai to kakon
draft_translation: Does not behave disgracefully, does not seek its own, is not provoked, does not reckon evil;
ukjv_translation: Does not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil;

greek_text: ου χαιρει επι τη αδικια συγχαιρει δε τη αληθεια
transliteration: ou cairei epi th adikia sugcairei de th alhyeia
draft_translation: Does not rejoice over unrighteousness, but rejoices together with the truth;
ukjv_translation: Rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth;

greek_text: παντα στεγει παντα πιστευει παντα ελπιζει παντα υπομενει
transliteration: panta stegei panta pisteuei panta elpizei panta upomenei
draft_translation: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
ukjv_translation: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

greek_text: η αγαπη ουδεποτε εκπιπτει ειτε δε προφητειαι καταργηθησονται ειτε γλωσσαι παυσονται ειτε γνωσις καταργηθησεται
transliteration: h agaph oudepote ekpiptei eite de profhteiai katarghyhsontai eite glwssai pausontai eite gnwsiv katarghyhsetai
draft_translation: Love never falls; but whether prophecies, they shall be made ineffective; whether tongues, they shall cease; whether knowledge, it shall be made ineffective.
ukjv_translation: Love (o. agape) never fails: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

greek_text: εκ μερους γαρ γινωσκομεν και εκ μερους προφητευομεν
transliteration: ek merouv gar ginwskomen kai ek merouv profhteuomen
draft_translation: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
ukjv_translation: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

greek_text: οταν δε ελθη το τελειον τοτε το εκ μερους καταργηθησεται
transliteration: otan de elyh to teleion tote to ek merouv katarghyhsetai
draft_translation: But when the complete comes, then that which is in part shall be made ineffective.
ukjv_translation: But when that which is perfect has come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

greek_text: οτε ημην νηπιος ως νηπιος ελαλουν ως νηπιος εφρονουν ως νηπιος ελογιζομην οτε δε γεγονα ανηρ κατηργηκα τα του νηπιου
transliteration: ote hmhn nhpiov wv nhpiov elaloun wv nhpiov efronoun wv nhpiov elogizomhn ote de gegona anhr kathrghka ta tou nhpiou
draft_translation: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
ukjv_translation: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

greek_text: βλεπομεν γαρ αρτι δι εσοπτρου εν αινιγματι τοτε δε προσωπον προς προσωπον αρτι γινωσκω εκ μερους τοτε δε επιγνωσομαι καθως και επεγνωσθην
transliteration: blepomen gar arti di esoptrou en ainigmati tote de proswpon prov proswpon arti ginwskw ek merouv tote de epignwsomai kaywv kai epegnwsyhn
draft_translation: For now we see through a mirror in an enigma; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then I shall know fully, just as also I was fully known.
ukjv_translation: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

greek_text: νυνι δε μενει πιστις ελπις αγαπη τα τρια ταυτα μειζων δε τουτων η αγαπη
transliteration: nuni de menei pistiv elpiv agaph ta tria tauta meizwn de toutwn h agaph
draft_translation: And now faith, hope, love remain, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
ukjv_translation: And now abides faith, hope, love, (o. agape) these three; but the greatest of these is love. (o. agape)

greek_text: διωκετε την αγαπην ζηλουτε δε τα πνευματικα μαλλον δε ινα προφητευητε
transliteration: diwkete thn agaphn zhloute de ta pneumatika mallon de ina profhteuhte
draft_translation: Pursue love, and desire spiritual things, but rather that you may prophesy.
ukjv_translation: Follow after love, (o. agape) and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that all of you may prophesy.

greek_text: ο γαρ λαλων γλωσση ουκ ανθρωποις λαλει αλλα τω θεω ουδεις γαρ ακουει πνευματι δε λαλει μυστηρια
transliteration: o gar lalwn glwssh ouk anyrwpoiv lalei alla tw yew oudeiv gar akouei pneumati de lalei musthria
draft_translation: For the one who speaks in a tongue does not speak to humans, but to God: for no one hears; but in spirit he speaks mysteries.
ukjv_translation: For he that speaks in an unknown tongue speaks not unto men, but unto God: for no man understands him; nevertheless in the spirit (o. pneuma) he speaks mysteries.

greek_text: ο δε προφητευων ανθρωποις λαλει οικοδομην και παρακλησιν και παραμυθιαν
transliteration: o de profhteuwn anyrwpoiv lalei oikodomhn kai paraklhsin kai paramuyian
draft_translation: But the one who prophesies speaks to humans for building up, and exhortation, and comfort.
ukjv_translation: But he that prophesies speaks unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

greek_text: ο λαλων γλωσση εαυτον οικοδομει ο δε προφητευων εκκλησιαν οικοδομει
transliteration: o lalwn glwssh eauton oikodomei o de profhteuwn ekklhsian oikodomei
draft_translation: the one who speaks in an unknown tongue edifies himself; but the one who prophesies edifies the assembly.
ukjv_translation: He that speaks in an unknown tongue edifies himself; but he that prophesies edifies the church.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: θελω δε παντας υμας λαλειν γλωσσαις μαλλον δε ινα προφητευητε μειζων γαρ ο προφητευων η ο λαλων γλωσσαις εκτος ει μη διερμηνευη ινα η εκκλησια οικοδομην λαβη
transliteration: yelw de pantav umav lalein glwssaiv mallon de ina profhteuhte meizwn gar o profhteuwn h o lalwn glwssaiv ektov ei mh diermhneuh ina h ekklhsia oikodomhn labh
draft_translation: I would that you all spoke with tongues but rather that you prophesied: for greater is the one who prophesies than the one who speaks with tongues, except he interpret, that the assembly may receive edifying.
ukjv_translation: I would that all of you all spoke with tongues but rather that all of you prophesied: for greater is he that prophesies than he that speaks with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: νυνι δε αδελφοι εαν ελθω προς υμας γλωσσαις λαλων τι υμας ωφελησω εαν μη υμιν λαλησω η εν αποκαλυψει η εν γνωσει η εν προφητεια η εν διδαχη
transliteration: nuni de adelfoi ean elyw prov umav glwssaiv lalwn ti umav wfelhsw ean mh umin lalhsw h en apokaluqei h en gnwsei h en profhteia h en didach
draft_translation: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what shall I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophecy, or in teaching?
ukjv_translation: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

greek_text: ομως τα αψυχα φωνην διδοντα ειτε αυλος ειτε κιθαρα εαν διαστολην τοις φθογγοις μη δω πως γνωσθησεται το αυλουμενον η το κιθαριζομενον
transliteration: omwv ta aquca fwnhn didonta eite aulov eite kiyara ean diastolhn toiv fyoggoiv mh dw pwv gnwsyhsetai to auloumenon h to kiyarizomenon
draft_translation: Even lifeless things giving sound, whether pipe or harp, unless they give distinction in the sounds, how shall what is piped or harped be known?
ukjv_translation: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

greek_text: και γαρ εαν αδηλον φωνην σαλπιγξ δω τις παρασκευασεται εις πολεμον
transliteration: kai gar ean adhlon fwnhn salpigx dw tiv paraskeuasetai eiv polemon
draft_translation: For also if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who shall prepare himself for war?
ukjv_translation: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

greek_text: ουτως και υμεις δια της γλωσσης εαν μη ευσημον λογον δωτε πως γνωσθησεται το λαλουμενον εσεσθε γαρ εις αερα λαλουντες
