transliteration: outwv kai umeiv dia thv glwsshv ean mh eushmon logon dwte pwv gnwsyhsetai to laloumenon esesye gar eiv aera lalountev
draft_translation: So also you, unless through the tongue you give an intelligible word, how shall what is spoken be known? for you will be speaking into air.
ukjv_translation: So likewise all of you, except all of you utter by the tongue words (o. logos) easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for all of you shall speak into the air.

greek_text: τοσαυτα ει τυχοι γενη φωνων εστιν εν κοσμω και ουδεν αφωνον
transliteration: tosauta ei tucoi genh fwnwn estin en kosmw kai ouden afwnon
draft_translation: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none without voice.
ukjv_translation: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

greek_text: εαν ουν μη ειδω την δυναμιν της φωνης εσομαι τω λαλουντι βαρβαρος και ο λαλων εν εμοι βαρβαρος
transliteration: ean oun mh eidw thn dunamin thv fwnhv esomai tw lalounti barbarov kai o lalwn en emoi barbarov
draft_translation: Therefore if I do not know the force of the voice, I shall be a foreigner to the one speaking, and the one speaking will be a foreigner to me.
ukjv_translation: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaks a barbarian, and he that speaks shall be a barbarian unto me.

greek_text: ουτως και υμεις επει ζηλωται εστε πνευματων προς την οικοδομην της εκκλησιας ζητειτε ινα περισσευητε
transliteration: outwv kai umeiv epei zhlwtai este pneumatwn prov thn oikodomhn thv ekklhsiav zhteite ina perisseuhte
draft_translation: Even so you, since you are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that you may excel to the edifying of the assembly.
ukjv_translation: Even so all of you, forasmuch as all of you are zealous of spiritual (o. pneuma) gifts, seek that all of you may excel to the edifying of the church.
review_notes: cleaned forasmuch-as modernization artifact; modernized forasmuch; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: διοπερ ο λαλων γλωσση προσευχεσθω ινα διερμηνευη
transliteration: dioper o lalwn glwssh proseucesyw ina diermhneuh
draft_translation: Therefore let the one who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore let him that speaks in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

greek_text: εαν γαρ προσευχωμαι γλωσση το πνευμα μου προσευχεται ο δε νους μου ακαρπος εστιν
transliteration: ean gar proseucwmai glwssh to pneuma mou proseucetai o de nouv mou akarpov estin
draft_translation: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
ukjv_translation: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit (o. pneuma) prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

greek_text: τι ουν εστιν προσευξομαι τω πνευματι προσευξομαι δε και τω νοι ψαλω τω πνευματι ψαλω δε και τω νοι
transliteration: ti oun estin proseuxomai tw pneumati proseuxomai de kai tw noi qalw tw pneumati qalw de kai tw noi
draft_translation: What then is it? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray also with the mind: I will sing with the spirit, but I will sing also with the mind.
ukjv_translation: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, (o. pneuma) and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, (o. pneuma) and I will sing with the understanding also.

greek_text: επει εαν ευλογησης τω πνευματι ο αναπληρων τον τοπον του ιδιωτου πως ερει το αμην επι τη ση ευχαριστια επειδη τι λεγεις ουκ οιδεν
transliteration: epei ean euloghshv tw pneumati o anaplhrwn ton topon tou idiwtou pwv erei to amhn epi th sh eucaristia epeidh ti legeiv ouk oiden
draft_translation: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how shall the one filling the place of the uninstructed say Amen at your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you say?
ukjv_translation: Else when you shall bless with the spirit, (o. pneuma) how shall he that occupies the room of the unlearned say Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he understands not what you says?

greek_text: συ μεν γαρ καλως ευχαριστεις αλλ ο ετερος ουκ οικοδομειται
transliteration: su men gar kalwv eucaristeiv all o eterov ouk oikodomeitai
draft_translation: For you indeed give thanks well, but the other is not built up.
ukjv_translation: For you verily give thanks well, but the other is not edified.

greek_text: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου παντων υμων μαλλον γλωσσαις λαλων
transliteration: eucaristw tw yew mou pantwn umwn mallon glwssaiv lalwn
draft_translation: I thank my God, speaking in tongues more than you all:
ukjv_translation: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than all of you all:

greek_text: αλλ εν εκκλησια θελω πεντε λογους δια του νοος μου λαλησαι ινα και αλλους κατηχησω η μυριους λογους εν γλωσση
transliteration: all en ekklhsia yelw pente logouv dia tou noov mou lalhsai ina kai allouv kathchsw h muriouv logouv en glwssh
draft_translation: Yet in the assembly I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
ukjv_translation: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words (o. logos) with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words (o. logos) in an unknown tongue.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: αδελφοι μη παιδια γινεσθε ταις φρεσιν αλλα τη κακια νηπιαζετε ταις δε φρεσιν τελειοι γινεσθε
transliteration: adelfoi mh paidia ginesye taiv fresin alla th kakia nhpiazete taiv de fresin teleioi ginesye
draft_translation: Brothers, do not become children in understanding: but in evil be infants, and in understanding become mature.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, be not children in understanding: nevertheless in malice be all of you children, but in understanding be men.

greek_text: εν τω νομω γεγραπται οτι εν ετερογλωσσοις και εν χειλεσιν ετεροις λαλησω τω λαω τουτω και ουδ ουτως εισακουσονται μου λεγει κυριος
transliteration: en tw nomw gegraptai oti en eteroglwssoiv kai en ceilesin eteroiv lalhsw tw law toutw kai oud outwv eisakousontai mou legei kuriov
draft_translation: In the law it is written, By other-tongued people and by other lips I will speak to this people; and not even so will they hear me, says the Lord.
ukjv_translation: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, says the LORD.

greek_text: ωστε αι γλωσσαι εις σημειον εισιν ου τοις πιστευουσιν αλλα τοις απιστοις η δε προφητεια ου τοις απιστοις αλλα τοις πιστευουσιν
transliteration: wste ai glwssai eiv shmeion eisin ou toiv pisteuousin alla toiv apistoiv h de profhteia ou toiv apistoiv alla toiv pisteuousin
draft_translation: So then tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving: but prophecy is not for the unbelieving, but for those who believe.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serves not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

greek_text: εαν ουν συνελθη η εκκλησια ολη επι το αυτο και παντες γλωσσαις λαλωσιν εισελθωσιν δε ιδιωται η απιστοι ουκ ερουσιν οτι μαινεσθε
transliteration: ean oun sunelyh h ekklhsia olh epi to auto kai pantev glwssaiv lalwsin eiselywsin de idiwtai h apistoi ouk erousin oti mainesye
draft_translation: If therefore the whole assembly be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that you are mad?
ukjv_translation: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that all of you are mad?
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: εαν δε παντες προφητευωσιν εισελθη δε τις απιστος η ιδιωτης ελεγχεται υπο παντων ανακρινεται υπο παντων
transliteration: ean de pantev profhteuwsin eiselyh de tiv apistov h idiwthv elegcetai upo pantwn anakrinetai upo pantwn
draft_translation: But if all prophesy, and some unbeliever or uninstructed one comes in, he is convicted by all, he is examined by all:
ukjv_translation: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believes not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

greek_text: και ουτως τα κρυπτα της καρδιας αυτου φανερα γινεται και ουτως πεσων επι προσωπον προσκυνησει τω θεω απαγγελλων οτι ο θεος οντως εν υμιν εστιν
transliteration: kai outwv ta krupta thv kardiav autou fanera ginetai kai outwv peswn epi proswpon proskunhsei tw yew apaggellwn oti o yeov ontwv en umin estin
draft_translation: And thus the secrets of his heart become manifest; and so falling on his face he will worship God, reporting that God truly is among you.
ukjv_translation: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you truthfully.

greek_text: τι ουν εστιν αδελφοι οταν συνερχησθε εκαστος υμων ψαλμον εχει διδαχην εχει γλωσσαν εχει αποκαλυψιν εχει ερμηνειαν εχει παντα προς οικοδομην γενεσθω
transliteration: ti oun estin adelfoi otan sunerchsye ekastov umwn qalmon ecei didachn ecei glwssan ecei apokaluqin ecei ermhneian ecei panta prov oikodomhn genesyw
draft_translation: What then is it, brothers? Whenever you come together, each of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.
ukjv_translation: How is it then, brethren? when all of you come together, every one of you has a psalm, has a doctrine, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

greek_text: ειτε γλωσση τις λαλει κατα δυο η το πλειστον τρεις και ανα μερος και εις διερμηνευετω
transliteration: eite glwssh tiv lalei kata duo h to pleiston treiv kai ana merov kai eiv diermhneuetw
draft_translation: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let it be by two, or at the most three, and by turn; and let one interpret.
ukjv_translation: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

greek_text: εαν δε μη η διερμηνευτης σιγατω εν εκκλησια εαυτω δε λαλειτω και τω θεω
transliteration: ean de mh h diermhneuthv sigatw en ekklhsia eautw de laleitw kai tw yew
draft_translation: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silence in the assembly; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
ukjv_translation: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
review_notes: modernized if-there-be idiom; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: προφηται δε δυο η τρεις λαλειτωσαν και οι αλλοι διακρινετωσαν
transliteration: profhtai de duo h treiv laleitwsan kai oi alloi diakrinetwsan
draft_translation: And let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern.
ukjv_translation: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

greek_text: εαν δε αλλω αποκαλυφθη καθημενω ο πρωτος σιγατω
transliteration: ean de allw apokalufyh kayhmenw o prwtov sigatw
draft_translation: If anything be revealed to another that sits by, let the first be silent.
ukjv_translation: If any thing be revealed to another that sits by, let the first hold his peace.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized hold-his-peace idiom

greek_text: δυνασθε γαρ καθ ενα παντες προφητευειν ινα παντες μανθανωσιν και παντες παρακαλωνται
transliteration: dunasye gar kay ena pantev profhteuein ina pantev manyanwsin kai pantev parakalwntai
draft_translation: For you can all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.
ukjv_translation: For all of you may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

greek_text: και πνευματα προφητων προφηταις υποτασσεται
transliteration: kai pneumata profhtwn profhtaiv upotassetai
draft_translation: And spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
ukjv_translation: And the spirits (o. pneuma) of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

greek_text: ου γαρ εστιν ακαταστασιας ο θεος αλλ ειρηνης ως εν πασαις ταις εκκλησιαις των αγιων
transliteration: ou gar estin akatastasiav o yeov all eirhnhv wv en pasaiv taiv ekklhsiaiv twn agiwn
draft_translation: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all assemblies of the holy ones.
ukjv_translation: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
review_notes: rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: αι γυναικες υμων εν ταις εκκλησιαις σιγατωσαν ου γαρ επιτετραπται αυταις λαλειν αλλ υποτασσεσθαι καθως και ο νομος λεγει
transliteration: ai gunaikev umwn en taiv ekklhsiaiv sigatwsan ou gar epitetraptai autaiv lalein all upotassesyai kaywv kai o nomov legei
draft_translation: Let your women keep silence in the assemblies: for it is not permitted to them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also says the law.
ukjv_translation: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also says the law.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ει δε τι μαθειν θελουσιν εν οικω τους ιδιους ανδρας επερωτατωσαν αισχρον γαρ εστιν γυναιξιν εν εκκλησια λαλειν
transliteration: ei de ti mayein yelousin en oikw touv idiouv andrav eperwtatwsan aiscron gar estin gunaixin en ekklhsia lalein
draft_translation: And if they will learn anything, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the assembly.
ukjv_translation: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: η αφ υμων ο λογος του θεου εξηλθεν η εις υμας μονους κατηντησεν
transliteration: h af umwn o logov tou yeou exhlyen h eiv umav monouv kathnthsen
draft_translation: Or did the word of God go out from you? or did it come to you only?
ukjv_translation: What? came the word (o. logos) of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

greek_text: ει τις δοκει προφητης ειναι η πνευματικος επιγινωσκετω α γραφω υμιν οτι του κυριου εισιν εντολαι
transliteration: ei tiv dokei profhthv einai h pneumatikov epiginwsketw a grafw umin oti tou kuriou eisin entolai
draft_translation: If anyone think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write to you are the commandments of the Lord.
ukjv_translation: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ει δε τις αγνοει αγνοειτω
transliteration: ei de tiv agnoei agnoeitw
draft_translation: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
ukjv_translation: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

greek_text: ωστε αδελφοι ζηλουτε το προφητευειν και το λαλειν γλωσσαις μη κωλυετε
transliteration: wste adelfoi zhloute to profhteuein kai to lalein glwssaiv mh kwluete
draft_translation: So then, brothers, desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

greek_text: παντα ευσχημονως και κατα ταξιν γινεσθω
transliteration: panta euschmonwv kai kata taxin ginesyw
draft_translation: Let all things be done respectably and according to order.
ukjv_translation: Let all things be done decently and in order.

greek_text: γνωριζω δε υμιν αδελφοι το ευαγγελιον ο ευηγγελισαμην υμιν ο και παρελαβετε εν ω και εστηκατε
transliteration: gnwrizw de umin adelfoi to euaggelion o euhggelisamhn umin o kai parelabete en w kai esthkate
draft_translation: Moreover, brothers, I declare to you the good news which I preached to you, which also you have received, and in which you stand;
ukjv_translation: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also all of you have received, and wherein all of you stand;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherein; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: δι ου και σωζεσθε τινι λογω ευηγγελισαμην υμιν ει κατεχετε εκτος ει μη εικη επιστευσατε
transliteration: di ou kai swzesye tini logw euhggelisamhn umin ei katecete ektov ei mh eikh episteusate
draft_translation: Through which also you are saved, if you hold fast what word I preached to you, unless you believed in vain.
ukjv_translation: By which also all of you are saved, if all of you keep in memory what (o. logos) I preached unto you, unless all of you have believed in vain.

greek_text: παρεδωκα γαρ υμιν εν πρωτοις ο και παρελαβον οτι χριστος απεθανεν υπερ των αμαρτιων ημων κατα τας γραφας
transliteration: paredwka gar umin en prwtoiv o kai parelabon oti cristov apeyanen uper twn amartiwn hmwn kata tav grafav
draft_translation: For I delivered to you among the first things what I also received, that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
ukjv_translation: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

greek_text: και οτι εταφη και οτι εγηγερται τη τριτη ημερα κατα τας γραφας
transliteration: kai oti etafh kai oti eghgertai th trith hmera kata tav grafav
draft_translation: And that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the third day according to the scriptures:
ukjv_translation: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

greek_text: και οτι ωφθη κηφα ειτα τοις δωδεκα
transliteration: kai oti wfyh khfa eita toiv dwdeka
draft_translation: And that he was seen by Cephas, then by the twelve:
ukjv_translation: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

greek_text: επειτα ωφθη επανω πεντακοσιοις αδελφοις εφαπαξ εξ ων οι πλειους μενουσιν εως αρτι τινες δε και εκοιμηθησαν
transliteration: epeita wfyh epanw pentakosioiv adelfoiv efapax ex wn oi pleiouv menousin ewv arti tinev de kai ekoimhyhsan
draft_translation: Then he was seen by over five hundred brothers at once; of whom the greater part remain until now, but some have fallen asleep.
ukjv_translation: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

greek_text: επειτα ωφθη ιακωβω ειτα τοις αποστολοις πασιν
transliteration: epeita wfyh iakwbw eita toiv apostoloiv pasin
draft_translation: Then he was seen by James; then by all the apostles.
ukjv_translation: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

greek_text: εσχατον δε παντων ωσπερει τω εκτρωματι ωφθη καμοι
transliteration: escaton de pantwn wsperei tw ektrwmati wfyh kamoi
draft_translation: And last of all, as if to the untimely birth, he was seen also by me.
ukjv_translation: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

greek_text: εγω γαρ ειμι ο ελαχιστος των αποστολων ος ουκ ειμι ικανος καλεισθαι αποστολος διοτι εδιωξα την εκκλησιαν του θεου
transliteration: egw gar eimi o elacistov twn apostolwn ov ouk eimi ikanov kaleisyai apostolov dioti ediwxa thn ekklhsian tou yeou
draft_translation: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not fitting to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
ukjv_translation: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
review_notes: modernized meet-as-fitting; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: χαριτι δε θεου ειμι ο ειμι και η χαρις αυτου η εις εμε ου κενη εγενηθη αλλα περισσοτερον αυτων παντων εκοπιασα ουκ εγω δε αλλ η χαρις του θεου η συν εμοι
transliteration: cariti de yeou eimi o eimi kai h cariv autou h eiv eme ou kenh egenhyh alla perissoteron autwn pantwn ekopiasa ouk egw de all h cariv tou yeou h sun emoi
draft_translation: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I labored more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
ukjv_translation: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
review_notes: fixed non-person relative after grace; modernized labour spelling; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: ειτε ουν εγω ειτε εκεινοι ουτως κηρυσσομεν και ουτως επιστευσατε
transliteration: eite oun egw eite ekeinoi outwv khrussomen kai outwv episteusate
draft_translation: Therefore whether I or those, thus we preach, and thus you believed.
ukjv_translation: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so all of you believed.

greek_text: ει δε χριστος κηρυσσεται οτι εκ νεκρων εγηγερται πως λεγουσιν τινες εν υμιν οτι αναστασις νεκρων ουκ εστιν
transliteration: ei de cristov khrussetai oti ek nekrwn eghgertai pwv legousin tinev en umin oti anastasiv nekrwn ouk estin
draft_translation: But if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
ukjv_translation: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

greek_text: ει δε αναστασις νεκρων ουκ εστιν ουδε χριστος εγηγερται
transliteration: ei de anastasiv nekrwn ouk estin oude cristov eghgertai
draft_translation: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised:
ukjv_translation: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

greek_text: ει δε χριστος ουκ εγηγερται κενον αρα το κηρυγμα ημων κενη δε και η πιστις υμων
transliteration: ei de cristov ouk eghgertai kenon ara to khrugma hmwn kenh de kai h pistiv umwn
draft_translation: And if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is empty, and your faith also empty.
ukjv_translation: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

greek_text: ευρισκομεθα δε και ψευδομαρτυρες του θεου οτι εμαρτυρησαμεν κατα του θεου οτι ηγειρεν τον χριστον ον ουκ ηγειρεν ειπερ αρα νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται
transliteration: euriskomeya de kai qeudomarturev tou yeou oti emarturhsamen kata tou yeou oti hgeiren ton criston on ouk hgeiren eiper ara nekroi ouk egeirontai
draft_translation: And we are also found false witnesses against God, because we testified against God that he raised Christ, whom he did not raise, if indeed the dead are not raised.
ukjv_translation: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

greek_text: ει γαρ νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται ουδε χριστος εγηγερται
transliteration: ei gar nekroi ouk egeirontai oude cristov eghgertai
draft_translation: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised:
ukjv_translation: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

greek_text: ει δε χριστος ουκ εγηγερται ματαια η πιστις υμων ετι εστε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων
transliteration: ei de cristov ouk eghgertai mataia h pistiv umwn eti este en taiv amartiaiv umwn
draft_translation: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
ukjv_translation: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; all of you are yet in your sins.

greek_text: αρα και οι κοιμηθεντες εν χριστω απωλοντο
transliteration: ara kai oi koimhyentev en cristw apwlonto
draft_translation: Then also those who have fallen asleep in Christ perished.
ukjv_translation: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

greek_text: ει εν τη ζωη ταυτη ηλπικοτες εσμεν εν χριστω μονον ελεεινοτεροι παντων ανθρωπων εσμεν
transliteration: ei en th zwh tauth hlpikotev esmen en cristw monon eleeinoteroi pantwn anyrwpwn esmen
draft_translation: If in this life only we have hoped in Christ, we are more pitiable than all humans.
ukjv_translation: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

greek_text: νυνι δε χριστος εγηγερται εκ νεκρων απαρχη των κεκοιμημενων εγενετο
transliteration: nuni de cristov eghgertai ek nekrwn aparch twn kekoimhmenwn egeneto
draft_translation: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, and became the firstfruit of those who have fallen asleep.
ukjv_translation: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the first-fruits of them that slept.

greek_text: επειδη γαρ δι ανθρωπου ο θανατος και δι ανθρωπου αναστασις νεκρων
transliteration: epeidh gar di anyrwpou o yanatov kai di anyrwpou anastasiv nekrwn
draft_translation: For since through a human came death, through a human also came resurrection of the dead.
ukjv_translation: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

greek_text: ωσπερ γαρ εν τω αδαμ παντες αποθνησκουσιν ουτως και εν τω χριστω παντες ζωοποιηθησονται
transliteration: wsper gar en tw adam pantev apoynhskousin outwv kai en tw cristw pantev zwopoihyhsontai
draft_translation: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
ukjv_translation: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εκαστος δε εν τω ιδιω ταγματι απαρχη χριστος επειτα οι χριστου εν τη παρουσια αυτου
transliteration: ekastov de en tw idiw tagmati aparch cristov epeita oi cristou en th parousia autou
draft_translation: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruit; afterward those who are Christ's at his coming.
ukjv_translation: But every man in his own order: Christ the first-fruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

greek_text: ειτα το τελος οταν παραδω την βασιλειαν τω θεω και πατρι οταν καταργηση πασαν αρχην και πασαν εξουσιαν και δυναμιν
transliteration: eita to telov otan paradw thn basileian tw yew kai patri otan katarghsh pasan archn kai pasan exousian kai dunamin
draft_translation: Then the end, when he delivers up the kingdom to God and Father; when he makes ineffective every rule and every authority and power.
ukjv_translation: Then comes the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

greek_text: δει γαρ αυτον βασιλευειν αχρις ου αν θη παντας τους εχθρους υπο τους ποδας αυτου
transliteration: dei gar auton basileuein acriv ou an yh pantav touv ecyrouv upo touv podav autou
draft_translation: For he must reign until he puts all enemies under his feet.
ukjv_translation: For he must reign, till he has put all enemies under his feet.

greek_text: εσχατος εχθρος καταργειται ο θανατος
transliteration: escatov ecyrov katargeitai o yanatov
draft_translation: The last enemy being made ineffective is death.
ukjv_translation: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

greek_text: παντα γαρ υπεταξεν υπο τους ποδας αυτου οταν δε ειπη οτι παντα υποτετακται δηλον οτι εκτος του υποταξαντος αυτω τα παντα
transliteration: panta gar upetaxen upo touv podav autou otan de eiph oti panta upotetaktai dhlon oti ektov tou upotaxantov autw ta panta
draft_translation: For he subjected all things under his feet. But when he says that all things have been subjected, it is evident that it is except the one who subjected all things to him.
ukjv_translation: For he has put all things under his feet. But when he says all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

greek_text: οταν δε υποταγη αυτω τα παντα τοτε και αυτος ο υιος υποταγησεται τω υποταξαντι αυτω τα παντα ινα η ο θεος τα παντα εν πασιν
transliteration: otan de upotagh autw ta panta tote kai autov o uiov upotaghsetai tw upotaxanti autw ta panta ina h o yeov ta panta en pasin
draft_translation: And when all things shall be subjected to him, then the Son himself also shall be subjected to the one who subjected all things to him, that God may be all things in all.
ukjv_translation: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

greek_text: επει τι ποιησουσιν οι βαπτιζομενοι υπερ των νεκρων ει ολως νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται τι και βαπτιζονται υπερ των νεκρων
transliteration: epei ti poihsousin oi baptizomenoi uper twn nekrwn ei olwv nekroi ouk egeirontai ti kai baptizontai uper twn nekrwn
draft_translation: Otherwise what will those who are baptized for the dead do, if the dead are not raised at all? why then are they baptized for the dead?
ukjv_translation: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

greek_text: τι και ημεις κινδυνευομεν πασαν ωραν
transliteration: ti kai hmeiv kinduneuomen pasan wran
draft_translation: And why are we also in danger every hour?
ukjv_translation: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

greek_text: καθ ημεραν αποθνησκω νη την υμετεραν καυχησιν ην εχω εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
transliteration: kay hmeran apoynhskw nh thn umeteran kauchsin hn ecw en cristw ihsou tw kuriw hmwn
draft_translation: Daily I die, by your boasting which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ukjv_translation: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.

greek_text: ει κατα ανθρωπον εθηριομαχησα εν εφεσω τι μοι το οφελος ει νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται φαγωμεν και πιωμεν αυριον γαρ αποθνησκομεν
transliteration: ei kata anyrwpon eyhriomachsa en efesw ti moi to ofelov ei nekroi ouk egeirontai fagwmen kai piwmen aurion gar apoynhskomen
draft_translation: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantages it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for tomorrow we die.
ukjv_translation: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantages it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; in order to morrow we die.

greek_text: μη πλανασθε φθειρουσιν ηθη χρησθ ομιλιαι κακαι
transliteration: mh planasye fyeirousin hyh crhsy omiliai kakai
draft_translation: Do not be deceived: evil company corrupts good morals.
ukjv_translation: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
review_notes: modernized be-not imperative; modernized communications-good-manners idiom

greek_text: εκνηψατε δικαιως και μη αμαρτανετε αγνωσιαν γαρ θεου τινες εχουσιν προς εντροπην υμιν λεγω
transliteration: eknhqate dikaiwv kai mh amartanete agnwsian gar yeou tinev ecousin prov entrophn umin legw
draft_translation: Sober up righteously, and do not sin; for some have ignorance of God: I speak this to your shame.
ukjv_translation: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

greek_text: αλλ ερει τις πως εγειρονται οι νεκροι ποιω δε σωματι ερχονται
transliteration: all erei tiv pwv egeirontai oi nekroi poiw de swmati ercontai
draft_translation: But someone will say, How are the dead raised? and with what body do they come?
ukjv_translation: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

greek_text: αφρον συ ο σπειρεις ου ζωοποιειται εαν μη αποθανη
transliteration: afron su o speireiv ou zwopoieitai ean mh apoyanh
draft_translation: You fool, that which you sow is not made alive, except it die:
ukjv_translation: You fool, that which you sow is not quickened, except it die:

greek_text: και ο σπειρεις ου το σωμα το γενησομενον σπειρεις αλλα γυμνον κοκκον ει τυχοι σιτου η τινος των λοιπων
transliteration: kai o speireiv ou to swma to genhsomenon speireiv alla gumnon kokkon ei tucoi sitou h tinov twn loipwn
draft_translation: And what you sow, you do not sow the body that shall be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat, or of some of the rest:
ukjv_translation: And that which you sow, you sow not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

greek_text: ο δε θεος αυτω διδωσιν σωμα καθως ηθελησεν και εκαστω των σπερματων το ιδιον σωμα
transliteration: o de yeov autw didwsin swma kaywv hyelhsen kai ekastw twn spermatwn to idion swma
draft_translation: But God gives it a body just as he willed, and to each of the seeds its own body.
ukjv_translation: But God gives it a body as it has pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

greek_text: ου πασα σαρξ η αυτη σαρξ αλλα αλλη μεν σαρξ ανθρωπων αλλη δε σαρξ κτηνων αλλη δε ιχθυων αλλη δε πτηνων
transliteration: ou pasa sarx h auth sarx alla allh men sarx anyrwpwn allh de sarx kthnwn allh de icyuwn allh de pthnwn
draft_translation: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fish, and another of birds.
ukjv_translation: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

greek_text: και σωματα επουρανια και σωματα επιγεια αλλ ετερα μεν η των επουρανιων δοξα ετερα δε η των επιγειων
transliteration: kai swmata epourania kai swmata epigeia all etera men h twn epouraniwn doxa etera de h twn epigeiwn
draft_translation: And there are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies: but one indeed is the glory of the heavenly, and another that of the earthly.
ukjv_translation: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

greek_text: αλλη δοξα ηλιου και αλλη δοξα σεληνης και αλλη δοξα αστερων αστηρ γαρ αστερος διαφερει εν δοξη
transliteration: allh doxa hliou kai allh doxa selhnhv kai allh doxa asterwn asthr gar asterov diaferei en doxh
draft_translation: One glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of stars: for star differs from star in glory.
ukjv_translation: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differs from another star in glory.

greek_text: ουτως και η αναστασις των νεκρων σπειρεται εν φθορα εγειρεται εν αφθαρσια
transliteration: outwv kai h anastasiv twn nekrwn speiretai en fyora egeiretai en afyarsia
draft_translation: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
ukjv_translation: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

greek_text: σπειρεται εν ατιμια εγειρεται εν δοξη σπειρεται εν ασθενεια εγειρεται εν δυναμει
transliteration: speiretai en atimia egeiretai en doxh speiretai en asyeneia egeiretai en dunamei
draft_translation: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
ukjv_translation: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

greek_text: σπειρεται σωμα ψυχικον εγειρεται σωμα πνευματικον εστιν σωμα ψυχικον και εστιν σωμα πνευματικον
transliteration: speiretai swma qucikon egeiretai swma pneumatikon estin swma qucikon kai estin swma pneumatikon
draft_translation: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
ukjv_translation: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

greek_text: ουτως και γεγραπται εγενετο ο πρωτος ανθρωπος αδαμ εις ψυχην ζωσαν ο εσχατος αδαμ εις πνευμα ζωοποιουν
transliteration: outwv kai gegraptai egeneto o prwtov anyrwpov adam eiv quchn zwsan o escatov adam eiv pneuma zwopoioun
draft_translation: And so it is written, The first human, Adam, became a living soul; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
ukjv_translation: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a life-giving spirit. (o. pneuma)

greek_text: αλλ ου πρωτον το πνευματικον αλλα το ψυχικον επειτα το πνευματικον
transliteration: all ou prwton to pneumatikon alla to qucikon epeita to pneumatikon
draft_translation: But not first the spiritual, but the natural; afterward the spiritual.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

greek_text: ο πρωτος ανθρωπος εκ γης χοικος ο δευτερος ανθρωπος ο κυριος εξ ουρανου
transliteration: o prwtov anyrwpov ek ghv coikov o deuterov anyrwpov o kuriov ex ouranou
draft_translation: The first human is from earth, made of dust; the second human is the Lord from heaven.
ukjv_translation: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.

greek_text: οιος ο χοικος τοιουτοι και οι χοικοι και οιος ο επουρανιος τοιουτοι και οι επουρανιοι
transliteration: oiov o coikov toioutoi kai oi coikoi kai oiov o epouraniov toioutoi kai oi epouranioi
draft_translation: As the one made of dust is, such also are those made of dust; and as the heavenly one is, such also are the heavenly.
ukjv_translation: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

greek_text: και καθως εφορεσαμεν την εικονα του χοικου φορεσομεν και την εικονα του επουρανιου
transliteration: kai kaywv eforesamen thn eikona tou coikou foresomen kai thn eikona tou epouraniou
draft_translation: And just as we bore the image of the one made of dust, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly one.
ukjv_translation: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

greek_text: τουτο δε φημι αδελφοι οτι σαρξ και αιμα βασιλειαν θεου κληρονομησαι ου δυνανται ουδε η φθορα την αφθαρσιαν κληρονομει
transliteration: touto de fhmi adelfoi oti sarx kai aima basileian yeou klhronomhsai ou dunantai oude h fyora thn afyarsian klhronomei
draft_translation: But this I say, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit God's kingdom; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.
ukjv_translation: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

greek_text: ιδου μυστηριον υμιν λεγω παντες μεν ου κοιμηθησομεθα παντες δε αλλαγησομεθα
transliteration: idou musthrion umin legw pantev men ou koimhyhsomeya pantev de allaghsomeya
draft_translation: Behold, I tell you a mystery; we shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
ukjv_translation: Behold, I show you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

greek_text: εν ατομω εν ριπη οφθαλμου εν τη εσχατη σαλπιγγι σαλπισει γαρ και οι νεκροι εγερθησονται αφθαρτοι και ημεις αλλαγησομεθα
transliteration: en atomw en riph ofyalmou en th escath salpiggi salpisei gar kai oi nekroi egeryhsontai afyartoi kai hmeiv allaghsomeya
draft_translation: In an instant, in the blink of an eye, at the last trumpet: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
ukjv_translation: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

greek_text: δει γαρ το φθαρτον τουτο ενδυσασθαι αφθαρσιαν και το θνητον τουτο ενδυσασθαι αθανασιαν
transliteration: dei gar to fyarton touto endusasyai afyarsian kai to ynhton touto endusasyai ayanasian
draft_translation: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
ukjv_translation: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

greek_text: οταν δε το φθαρτον τουτο ενδυσηται αφθαρσιαν και το θνητον τουτο ενδυσηται αθανασιαν τοτε γενησεται ο λογος ο γεγραμμενος κατεποθη ο θανατος εις νικος
transliteration: otan de to fyarton touto endushtai afyarsian kai to ynhton touto endushtai ayanasian tote genhsetai o logov o gegrammenov katepoyh o yanatov eiv nikov
draft_translation: And when this corruptible shall put on incorruption, and this mortal shall put on immortality, then the word that is written shall come to be: Death was swallowed up into victory.
ukjv_translation: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying (o. logos) that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

greek_text: που σου θανατε το κεντρον που σου αδη το νικος
transliteration: pou sou yanate to kentron pou sou adh to nikov
draft_translation: Where is your sting, O death? Where is your victory, O Hades?
ukjv_translation: O death, where is your sting? O grave, where is your victory?

greek_text: το δε κεντρον του θανατου η αμαρτια η δε δυναμις της αμαρτιας ο νομος
transliteration: to de kentron tou yanatou h amartia h de dunamiv thv amartiav o nomov
draft_translation: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
ukjv_translation: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τω δε θεω χαρις τω διδοντι ημιν το νικος δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: tw de yew cariv tw didonti hmin to nikov dia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: But thanks be to God, which gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ωστε αδελφοι μου αγαπητοι εδραιοι γινεσθε αμετακινητοι περισσευοντες εν τω εργω του κυριου παντοτε ειδοτες οτι ο κοπος υμων ουκ εστιν κενος εν κυριω
transliteration: wste adelfoi mou agaphtoi edraioi ginesye ametakinhtoi perisseuontev en tw ergw tou kuriou pantote eidotev oti o kopov umwn ouk estin kenov en kuriw
draft_translation: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, since you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be all of you steadfast, immoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as all of you know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
review_notes: cleaned forasmuch-as modernization artifact; modernized be-you imperative; modernized forasmuch; modernized immoveable spelling; modernized labour spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: περι δε της λογιας της εις τους αγιους ωσπερ διεταξα ταις εκκλησιαις της γαλατιας ουτως και υμεις ποιησατε
transliteration: peri de thv logiav thv eiv touv agiouv wsper dietaxa taiv ekklhsiaiv thv galatiav outwv kai umeiv poihsate
draft_translation: Now concerning the collection for the holy ones, as I have given order to the assemblies of Galatia, even so do you.
ukjv_translation: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do all of you.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: κατα μιαν σαββατων εκαστος υμων παρ εαυτω τιθετω θησαυριζων ο τι αν ευοδωται ινα μη οταν ελθω τοτε λογιαι γινωνται
transliteration: kata mian sabbatwn ekastov umwn par eautw tiyetw yhsaurizwn o ti an euodwtai ina mh otan elyw tote logiai ginwntai
draft_translation: On the first day of the week let each of you put aside by himself, storing up whatever he may prosper, so that there may be no collections when I come.
ukjv_translation: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God has prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

greek_text: οταν δε παραγενωμαι ους εαν δοκιμασητε δι επιστολων τουτους πεμψω απενεγκειν την χαριν υμων εις ιερουσαλημ
transliteration: otan de paragenwmai ouv ean dokimashte di epistolwn toutouv pemqw apenegkein thn carin umwn eiv ierousalhm
draft_translation: And when I arrive, whomever you approve by letters, these I will send to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
ukjv_translation: And when I come, whomsoever all of you shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

greek_text: εαν δε η αξιον του καμε πορευεσθαι συν εμοι πορευσονται
transliteration: ean de h axion tou kame poreuesyai sun emoi poreusontai
draft_translation: And if it is worthy for me also to go, they shall go with me.
ukjv_translation: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

greek_text: ελευσομαι δε προς υμας οταν μακεδονιαν διελθω μακεδονιαν γαρ διερχομαι
transliteration: eleusomai de prov umav otan makedonian dielyw makedonian gar diercomai
draft_translation: And I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia: for I am passing through Macedonia.
ukjv_translation: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

greek_text: προς υμας δε τυχον παραμενω η και παραχειμασω ινα υμεις με προπεμψητε ου εαν πορευωμαι
transliteration: prov umav de tucon paramenw h kai paraceimasw ina umeiv me propemqhte ou ean poreuwmai
draft_translation: And perhaps I will remain with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me forward wherever I go.
ukjv_translation: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that all of you may bring me on my journey anywhere I go.

greek_text: ου θελω γαρ υμας αρτι εν παροδω ιδειν ελπιζω δε χρονον τινα επιμειναι προς υμας εαν ο κυριος επιτρεπη
transliteration: ou yelw gar umav arti en parodw idein elpizw de cronon tina epimeinai prov umav ean o kuriov epitreph
draft_translation: For I do not want to see you now in passing; but I hope to remain with you some time, if the Lord permits.
ukjv_translation: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

greek_text: επιμενω δε εν εφεσω εως της πεντηκοστης
transliteration: epimenw de en efesw ewv thv penthkosthv
draft_translation: But I remain in Ephesus until Pentecost.
ukjv_translation: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

greek_text: θυρα γαρ μοι ανεωγεν μεγαλη και ενεργης και αντικειμενοι πολλοι
transliteration: yura gar moi anewgen megalh kai energhv kai antikeimenoi polloi
draft_translation: For a great and effective door has opened to me, and many are opposing.
ukjv_translation: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

greek_text: εαν δε ελθη τιμοθεος βλεπετε ινα αφοβως γενηται προς υμας το γαρ εργον κυριου εργαζεται ως και εγω
transliteration: ean de elyh timoyeov blepete ina afobwv genhtai prov umav to gar ergon kuriou ergazetai wv kai egw
draft_translation: And if Timothy comes, see that he may be with you without fear: for he works the work of the Lord, as I also do.
ukjv_translation: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he works the work of the Lord, as I also do.

greek_text: μη τις ουν αυτον εξουθενηση προπεμψατε δε αυτον εν ειρηνη ινα ελθη προς με εκδεχομαι γαρ αυτον μετα των αδελφων
transliteration: mh tiv oun auton exouyenhsh propemqate de auton en eirhnh ina elyh prov me ekdecomai gar auton meta twn adelfwn
draft_translation: Therefore let no one despise him: but send him forward in peace, that he may come to me: for I await him with the brothers.
ukjv_translation: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

greek_text: περι δε απολλω του αδελφου πολλα παρεκαλεσα αυτον ινα ελθη προς υμας μετα των αδελφων και παντως ουκ ην θελημα ινα νυν ελθη ελευσεται δε οταν ευκαιρηση
transliteration: peri de apollw tou adelfou polla parekalesa auton ina elyh prov umav meta twn adelfwn kai pantwv ouk hn yelhma ina nun elyh eleusetai de otan eukairhsh
draft_translation: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I urged him much that he should come to you with the brothers: and it was altogether not his will to come now; but he will come when he has opportunity.
ukjv_translation: As concerning our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

greek_text: γρηγορειτε στηκετε εν τη πιστει ανδριζεσθε κραταιουσθε
transliteration: grhgoreite sthkete en th pistei andrizesye krataiousye
draft_translation: Watch, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strengthened.
ukjv_translation: Watch all of you, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

greek_text: παντα υμων εν αγαπη γινεσθω
transliteration: panta umwn en agaph ginesyw
draft_translation: Let all your things be done in love.
ukjv_translation: Let all your things be done with love. (o. agape)

greek_text: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι οιδατε την οικιαν στεφανα οτι εστιν απαρχη της αχαιας και εις διακονιαν τοις αγιοις εταξαν εαυτους
transliteration: parakalw de umav adelfoi oidate thn oikian stefana oti estin aparch thv acaiav kai eiv diakonian toiv agioiv etaxan eautouv
draft_translation: I plead to you, (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the holy ones,)
ukjv_translation: I plead to (all of you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

greek_text: ινα και υμεις υποτασσησθε τοις τοιουτοις και παντι τω συνεργουντι και κοπιωντι
transliteration: ina kai umeiv upotasshsye toiv toioutoiv kai panti tw sunergounti kai kopiwnti
draft_translation: That you also submit yourselves to such ones, and to everyone working together and laboring.
ukjv_translation: That all of you submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helps with us, and labours.

greek_text: χαιρω δε επι τη παρουσια στεφανα και φουρτουνατου και αχαικου οτι το υμων υστερημα ουτοι ανεπληρωσαν
transliteration: cairw de epi th parousia stefana kai fourtounatou kai acaikou oti to umwn usterhma outoi aneplhrwsan
draft_translation: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: because these supplied what was lacking from you.
ukjv_translation: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

greek_text: ανεπαυσαν γαρ το εμον πνευμα και το υμων επιγινωσκετε ουν τους τοιουτους
transliteration: anepausan gar to emon pneuma kai to umwn epiginwskete oun touv toioutouv
draft_translation: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge you those who are such.
ukjv_translation: For they have refreshed my spirit (o. pneuma) and your's: therefore acknowledge all of you them that are such.
review_notes: modernized possessive pronoun spelling; modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ασπαζονται υμας αι εκκλησιαι της ασιας ασπαζονται υμας εν κυριω πολλα ακυλας και πρισκιλλα συν τη κατ οικον αυτων εκκλησια
transliteration: aspazontai umav ai ekklhsiai thv asiav aspazontai umav en kuriw polla akulav kai priskilla sun th kat oikon autwn ekklhsia
draft_translation: The assemblies of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the assembly that is in their house.
ukjv_translation: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ασπαζονται υμας οι αδελφοι παντες ασπασασθε αλληλους εν φιληματι αγιω
transliteration: aspazontai umav oi adelfoi pantev aspasasye allhlouv en filhmati agiw
draft_translation: All the brothers greet you. Greet you one another with a holy kiss.
ukjv_translation: All the brethren greet you. Greet all of you one another with an holy kiss.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ο ασπασμος τη εμη χειρι παυλου
transliteration: o aspasmov th emh ceiri paulou
draft_translation: The greeting with my hand, Paul's.
ukjv_translation: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

greek_text: ει τις ου φιλει τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον ητω αναθεμα μαραν αθα
transliteration: ei tiv ou filei ton kurion ihsoun criston htw anayema maran aya
draft_translation: If anyone love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
ukjv_translation: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou ihsou cristou mey umwn
draft_translation: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

greek_text: η αγαπη μου μετα παντων υμων εν χριστω ιησου αμην
transliteration: h agaph mou meta pantwn umwn en cristw ihsou amhn
draft_translation: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
ukjv_translation: My love (o. agape) be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

greek_text: [ΠΑΥΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΟΥ Η ΠΡΟΣ ΚΟΡΙΝΘΙΟΥΣ ΕΠΙΣΤΟΛΗ ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ] παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος τη εκκλησια του θεου τη ουση εν κορινθω συν τοις αγιοις πασιν τοις ουσιν εν ολη τη αχαια
transliteration: [PAULOU TOU APOSTOLOU H PROS KORINYIOUS EPISTOLH DEUTERA] paulov apostolov ihsou cristou dia yelhmatov yeou kai timoyeov o adelfov th ekklhsia tou yeou th oush en korinyw sun toiv agioiv pasin toiv ousin en olh th acaia
draft_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God who is at Corinth, with all the holy ones who are in all Achaia:
ukjv_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

greek_text: ευλογητος ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο πατηρ των οικτιρμων και θεος πασης παρακλησεως
transliteration: euloghtov o yeov kai pathr tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou o pathr twn oiktirmwn kai yeov pashv paraklhsewv
draft_translation: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and God of all comfort;
ukjv_translation: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

greek_text: ο παρακαλων ημας επι παση τη θλιψει ημων εις το δυνασθαι ημας παρακαλειν τους εν παση θλιψει δια της παρακλησεως ης παρακαλουμεθα αυτοι υπο του θεου
transliteration: o parakalwn hmav epi pash th yliqei hmwn eiv to dunasyai hmav parakalein touv en pash yliqei dia thv paraklhsewv hv parakaloumeya autoi upo tou yeou
draft_translation: Who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we are able to comfort those in every affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
ukjv_translation: Who comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

greek_text: οτι καθως περισσευει τα παθηματα του χριστου εις ημας ουτως δια χριστου περισσευει και η παρακλησις ημων
transliteration: oti kaywv perisseuei ta payhmata tou cristou eiv hmav outwv dia cristou perisseuei kai h paraklhsiv hmwn
draft_translation: Because just as the sufferings of Christ abound toward us, so through Christ our comfort also abounds.
ukjv_translation: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also abounds by Christ.

greek_text: ειτε δε θλιβομεθα υπερ της υμων παρακλησεως και σωτηριας της ενεργουμενης εν υπομονη των αυτων παθηματων ων και ημεις πασχομεν ειτε παρακαλουμεθα υπερ της υμων παρακλησεως και σωτηριας και η ελπις ημων βεβαια υπερ υμων
transliteration: eite de ylibomeya uper thv umwn paraklhsewv kai swthriav thv energoumenhv en upomonh twn autwn payhmatwn wn kai hmeiv pascomen eite parakaloumeya uper thv umwn paraklhsewv kai swthriav kai h elpiv hmwn bebaia uper umwn
draft_translation: And whether we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation, which works in endurance of the same sufferings which we also suffer; or whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort and salvation, and our hope for you is firm.
ukjv_translation: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι ωσπερ κοινωνοι εστε των παθηματων ουτως και της παρακλησεως
transliteration: eidotev oti wsper koinwnoi este twn payhmatwn outwv kai thv paraklhsewv
draft_translation: Knowing that just as you are partners of the sufferings, so also of the comfort.
ukjv_translation: And our hope of you is steadfast, knowing, that as all of you are partakers of the sufferings, so shall all of you be also of the consolation.

greek_text: ου γαρ θελομεν υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι υπερ της θλιψεως ημων της γενομενης ημιν εν τη ασια οτι καθ υπερβολην εβαρηθημεν υπερ δυναμιν ωστε εξαπορηθηναι ημας και του ζην
transliteration: ou gar yelomen umav agnoein adelfoi uper thv yliqewv hmwn thv genomenhv hmin en th asia oti kay uperbolhn ebarhyhmen uper dunamin wste exaporhyhnai hmav kai tou zhn
draft_translation: For we would not, brothers, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, so that we despaired even of life:
ukjv_translation: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
review_notes: modernized insomuch-that idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αλλα αυτοι εν εαυτοις το αποκριμα του θανατου εσχηκαμεν ινα μη πεποιθοτες ωμεν εφ εαυτοις αλλ επι τω θεω τω εγειροντι τους νεκρους
transliteration: alla autoi en eautoiv to apokrima tou yanatou eschkamen ina mh pepoiyotev wmen ef eautoiv all epi tw yew tw egeironti touv nekrouv
draft_translation: But we ourselves have had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead:
ukjv_translation: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raises the dead:

greek_text: ος εκ τηλικουτου θανατου ερρυσατο ημας και ρυεται εις ον ηλπικαμεν οτι και ετι ρυσεται
transliteration: ov ek thlikoutou yanatou errusato hmav kai ruetai eiv on hlpikamen oti kai eti rusetai
draft_translation: Who delivered us from so great a death, and delivers; in whom we have hoped that he will also still deliver;
ukjv_translation: Who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

greek_text: συνυπουργουντων και υμων υπερ ημων τη δεησει ινα εκ πολλων προσωπων το εις ημας χαρισμα δια πολλων ευχαριστηθη υπερ ημων
transliteration: sunupourgountwn kai umwn uper hmwn th dehsei ina ek pollwn proswpwn to eiv hmav carisma dia pollwn eucaristhyh uper hmwn
draft_translation: You also working together on our behalf by petition, that from many faces thanks may be given on our behalf for the gracious gift to us through many.
ukjv_translation: All of you also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

greek_text: η γαρ καυχησις ημων αυτη εστιν το μαρτυριον της συνειδησεως ημων οτι εν απλοτητι και ειλικρινεια θεου ουκ εν σοφια σαρκικη αλλ εν χαριτι θεου ανεστραφημεν εν τω κοσμω περισσοτερως δε προς υμας
transliteration: h gar kauchsiv hmwn auth estin to marturion thv suneidhsewv hmwn oti en aplothti kai eilikrineia yeou ouk en sofia sarkikh all en cariti yeou anestrafhmen en tw kosmw perissoterwv de prov umav
draft_translation: For this is our boasting, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom, but in God's grace, we conducted ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
ukjv_translation: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

greek_text: ου γαρ αλλα γραφομεν υμιν αλλ η α αναγινωσκετε η και επιγινωσκετε ελπιζω δε οτι και εως τελους επιγνωσεσθε
transliteration: ou gar alla grafomen umin all h a anaginwskete h kai epiginwskete elpizw de oti kai ewv telouv epignwsesye
draft_translation: For we write no other things to you than what you read or also fully know; and I hope that you will also fully know to the end;
ukjv_translation: For we write no other things unto you, than what all of you read or acknowledge; and I trust all of you shall acknowledge even to the end;

greek_text: καθως και επεγνωτε ημας απο μερους οτι καυχημα υμων εσμεν καθαπερ και υμεις ημων εν τη ημερα του κυριου ιησου
transliteration: kaywv kai epegnwte hmav apo merouv oti kauchma umwn esmen kayaper kai umeiv hmwn en th hmera tou kuriou ihsou
draft_translation: Just as you also fully knew us in part, that we are your boast, just as you also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
ukjv_translation: As also all of you have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as all of you also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.

greek_text: και ταυτη τη πεποιθησει εβουλομην προς υμας ελθειν προτερον ινα δευτεραν χαριν εχητε
transliteration: kai tauth th pepoiyhsei eboulomhn prov umav elyein proteron ina deuteran carin echte
draft_translation: And in this confidence I resolved to come to you before, that you might have a second benefit;
ukjv_translation: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that all of you might have a second benefit;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized was-minded idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και δι υμων διελθειν εις μακεδονιαν και παλιν απο μακεδονιας ελθειν προς υμας και υφ υμων προπεμφθηναι εις την ιουδαιαν
transliteration: kai di umwn dielyein eiv makedonian kai palin apo makedoniav elyein prov umav kai uf umwn propemfyhnai eiv thn ioudaian
draft_translation: And through you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and by you to be sent forward into Judea.
ukjv_translation: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

greek_text: τουτο ουν βουλευομενος μη τι αρα τη ελαφρια εχρησαμην η α βουλευομαι κατα σαρκα βουλευομαι ινα η παρ εμοι το ναι ναι και το ου ου
transliteration: touto oun bouleuomenov mh ti ara th elafria ecrhsamhn h a bouleuomai kata sarka bouleuomai ina h par emoi to nai nai kai to ou ou
draft_translation: Therefore when planning this, did I then use lightness? or what I plan, do I plan according to flesh, that with me there should be yes yes and no no?
ukjv_translation: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use levity? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

greek_text: πιστος δε ο θεος οτι ο λογος ημων ο προς υμας ουκ εγενετο ναι και ου
transliteration: pistov de o yeov oti o logov hmwn o prov umav ouk egeneto nai kai ou
draft_translation: But faithful is God, that our word toward you was not yes and no.
ukjv_translation: But as God is true, our word (o. logos) toward you was not yea and nay.

greek_text: ο γαρ του θεου υιος ιησους χριστος ο εν υμιν δι ημων κηρυχθεις δι εμου και σιλουανου και τιμοθεου ουκ εγενετο ναι και ου αλλα ναι εν αυτω γεγονεν
transliteration: o gar tou yeou uiov ihsouv cristov o en umin di hmwn khrucyeiv di emou kai silouanou kai timoyeou ouk egeneto nai kai ou alla nai en autw gegonen
draft_translation: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you through us, through me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yes and no, but in him has become yes.
ukjv_translation: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

greek_text: οσαι γαρ επαγγελιαι θεου εν αυτω το ναι και εν αυτω το αμην τω θεω προς δοξαν δι ημων
transliteration: osai gar epaggeliai yeou en autw to nai kai en autw to amhn tw yew prov doxan di hmwn
draft_translation: For as many as are promises of God, in him is the yes, and in him the Amen, to God for glory through us.
ukjv_translation: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

greek_text: ο δε βεβαιων ημας συν υμιν εις χριστον και χρισας ημας θεος
transliteration: o de bebaiwn hmav sun umin eiv criston kai crisav hmav yeov
draft_translation: Now the one who establishes us with you into Christ, and anointed us, is God;
ukjv_translation: Now he which establishes us with you in Christ, and has anointed us, is God;

greek_text: ο και σφραγισαμενος ημας και δους τον αρραβωνα του πνευματος εν ταις καρδιαις ημων
transliteration: o kai sfragisamenov hmav kai douv ton arrabwna tou pneumatov en taiv kardiaiv hmwn
draft_translation: Who also sealed us, and gave the pledge of the Spirit in our hearts.
ukjv_translation: Who has also sealed us, and given the earn of the Spirit (o. pneuma) in our hearts.

greek_text: εγω δε μαρτυρα τον θεον επικαλουμαι επι την εμην ψυχην οτι φειδομενος υμων ουκετι ηλθον εις κορινθον
transliteration: egw de martura ton yeon epikaloumai epi thn emhn quchn oti feidomenov umwn ouketi hlyon eiv korinyon
draft_translation: But I invoke God as witness upon my soul, that sparing you I did not yet come to Corinth.
ukjv_translation: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

greek_text: ουχ οτι κυριευομεν υμων της πιστεως αλλα συνεργοι εσμεν της χαρας υμων τη γαρ πιστει εστηκατε
transliteration: ouc oti kurieuomen umwn thv pistewv alla sunergoi esmen thv carav umwn th gar pistei esthkate
draft_translation: Not that we lord over your faith, but we are fellow workers of your joy: for by faith you stand.
ukjv_translation: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith all of you stand.

greek_text: εκρινα δε εμαυτω τουτο το μη παλιν ελθειν εν λυπη προς υμας
transliteration: ekrina de emautw touto to mh palin elyein en luph prov umav
draft_translation: But I determined this for myself, not to come again to you in sorrow.
ukjv_translation: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

greek_text: ει γαρ εγω λυπω υμας και τις εστιν ο ευφραινων με ει μη ο λυπουμενος εξ εμου
transliteration: ei gar egw lupw umav kai tiv estin o eufrainwn me ei mh o lupoumenov ex emou
draft_translation: For if I grieve you, then who is the one making me glad, except the one being grieved by me?
ukjv_translation: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that makes me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

greek_text: και εγραψα υμιν τουτο αυτο ινα μη ελθων λυπην εχω αφ ων εδει με χαιρειν πεποιθως επι παντας υμας οτι η εμη χαρα παντων υμων εστιν
transliteration: kai egraqa umin touto auto ina mh elywn luphn ecw af wn edei me cairein pepoiywv epi pantav umav oti h emh cara pantwn umwn estin
draft_translation: And I wrote this same thing to you, lest when I came I should have sorrow from those from whom I ought to rejoice, being confident in you all, that my joy is of you all.
ukjv_translation: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

greek_text: εκ γαρ πολλης θλιψεως και συνοχης καρδιας εγραψα υμιν δια πολλων δακρυων ουχ ινα λυπηθητε αλλα την αγαπην ινα γνωτε ην εχω περισσοτερως εις υμας
transliteration: ek gar pollhv yliqewv kai sunochv kardiav egraqa umin dia pollwn dakruwn ouc ina luphyhte alla thn agaphn ina gnwte hn ecw perissoterwv eiv umav
draft_translation: For out of much affliction and distress of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly toward you.
ukjv_translation: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that all of you should be grieved, but that all of you might know the love (o. agape) which I have more abundantly unto you.

greek_text: ει δε τις λελυπηκεν ουκ εμε λελυπηκεν αλλ απο μερους ινα μη επιβαρω παντας υμας
transliteration: ei de tiv leluphken ouk eme leluphken all apo merouv ina mh epibarw pantav umav
draft_translation: But if anyone has grieved, he has not grieved me, except in part, that I may not burden you all.
ukjv_translation: But if any have caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part: that I may not burden you all.

greek_text: ικανον τω τοιουτω η επιτιμια αυτη η υπο των πλειονων
transliteration: ikanon tw toioutw h epitimia auth h upo twn pleionwn
draft_translation: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment by the many.
ukjv_translation: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

greek_text: ωστε τουναντιον μαλλον υμας χαρισασθαι και παρακαλεσαι μηπως τη περισσοτερα λυπη καταποθη ο τοιουτος
transliteration: wste tounantion mallon umav carisasyai kai parakalesai mhpwv th perissotera luph katapoyh o toioutov
draft_translation: So that contrariwise you ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with excessive sorrow.
ukjv_translation: So that contrariwise all of you ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
review_notes: modernized overmuch; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: διο παρακαλω υμας κυρωσαι εις αυτον αγαπην
transliteration: dio parakalw umav kurwsai eiv auton agaphn
draft_translation: Therefore I exhort you to confirm love toward him.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore I plead to you that all of you would confirm your love (o. agape) toward him.

greek_text: εις τουτο γαρ και εγραψα ινα γνω την δοκιμην υμων ει εις παντα υπηκοοι εστε
transliteration: eiv touto gar kai egraqa ina gnw thn dokimhn umwn ei eiv panta uphkooi este
draft_translation: For to this also I wrote, that I might know your proof, whether you are obedient in all things.
ukjv_translation: In order to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether all of you be obedient in all things.

greek_text: ω δε τι χαριζεσθε και εγω και γαρ εγω ει τι κεχαρισμαι ω κεχαρισμαι δι υμας εν προσωπω χριστου
transliteration: w de ti carizesye kai egw kai gar egw ei ti kecarismai w kecarismai di umav en proswpw cristou
draft_translation: But to whom you forgive anything, I also forgive: for if I also have forgiven anything, to whom I forgave it, I did it for your sakes in the person of Christ;
ukjv_translation: To whom all of you forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

greek_text: ινα μη πλεονεκτηθωμεν υπο του σατανα ου γαρ αυτου τα νοηματα αγνοουμεν
transliteration: ina mh pleonekthywmen upo tou satana ou gar autou ta nohmata agnooumen
draft_translation: So that we may not be taken advantage of by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his thoughts.
ukjv_translation: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

greek_text: ελθων δε εις την τρωαδα εις το ευαγγελιον του χριστου και θυρας μοι ανεωγμενης εν κυριω
transliteration: elywn de eiv thn trwada eiv to euaggelion tou cristou kai yurav moi anewgmenhv en kuriw
draft_translation: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's good news, and a door was opened to me of the Lord,
ukjv_translation: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουκ εσχηκα ανεσιν τω πνευματι μου τω μη ευρειν με τιτον τον αδελφον μου αλλα αποταξαμενος αυτοις εξηλθον εις μακεδονιαν
transliteration: ouk eschka anesin tw pneumati mou tw mh eurein me titon ton adelfon mou alla apotaxamenov autoiv exhlyon eiv makedonian
draft_translation: I had no rest in my spirit, because I did not find Titus my brother: but taking leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
ukjv_translation: I had no rest in my spirit, (o. pneuma) because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

greek_text: τω δε θεω χαρις τω παντοτε θριαμβευοντι ημας εν τω χριστω και την οσμην της γνωσεως αυτου φανερουντι δι ημων εν παντι τοπω
transliteration: tw de yew cariv tw pantote yriambeuonti hmav en tw cristw kai thn osmhn thv gnwsewv autou fanerounti di hmwn en panti topw
draft_translation: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and manifests through us the fragrance of his knowledge in every place.
ukjv_translation: Now thanks be unto God, which always causes us to triumph in Christ, and makes manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

greek_text: οτι χριστου ευωδια εσμεν τω θεω εν τοις σωζομενοις και εν τοις απολλυμενοις
transliteration: oti cristou euwdia esmen tw yew en toiv swzomenoiv kai en toiv apollumenoiv
draft_translation: Because we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God among those being saved and among those perishing:
ukjv_translation: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

greek_text: οις μεν οσμη θανατου εις θανατον οις δε οσμη ζωης εις ζωην και προς ταυτα τις ικανος
transliteration: oiv men osmh yanatou eiv yanaton oiv de osmh zwhv eiv zwhn kai prov tauta tiv ikanov
draft_translation: To the one, a fragrance of death to death; and to the other, a fragrance of life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
ukjv_translation: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

greek_text: ου γαρ εσμεν ως οι πολλοι καπηλευοντες τον λογον του θεου αλλ ως εξ ειλικρινειας αλλ ως εκ θεου κατενωπιον του θεου εν χριστω λαλουμεν
transliteration: ou gar esmen wv oi polloi kaphleuontev ton logon tou yeou all wv ex eilikrineiav all wv ek yeou katenwpion tou yeou en cristw laloumen
draft_translation: For we are not as the many, peddling the word of God: but as from sincerity, but as from God, before God, we speak in Christ.
ukjv_translation: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word (o. logos) of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

greek_text: αρχομεθα παλιν εαυτους συνιστανειν η μη χρηζομεν ως τινες συστατικων επιστολων προς υμας η εξ υμων συστατικων
transliteration: arcomeya palin eautouv sunistanein h mh crhzomen wv tinev sustatikwn epistolwn prov umav h ex umwn sustatikwn
draft_translation: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or do we need, as some, commendatory letters to you, or commendatory letters from you?
ukjv_translation: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

greek_text: η επιστολη ημων υμεις εστε εγγεγραμμενη εν ταις καρδιαις ημων γινωσκομενη και αναγινωσκομενη υπο παντων ανθρωπων
transliteration: h epistolh hmwn umeiv este eggegrammenh en taiv kardiaiv hmwn ginwskomenh kai anaginwskomenh upo pantwn anyrwpwn
draft_translation: You are our letter, having been written in our hearts, known and read by all humans:
ukjv_translation: All of you are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

greek_text: φανερουμενοι οτι εστε επιστολη χριστου διακονηθεισα υφ ημων εγγεγραμμενη ου μελανι αλλα πνευματι θεου ζωντος ουκ εν πλαξιν λιθιναις αλλ εν πλαξιν καρδιας σαρκιναις
transliteration: faneroumenoi oti este epistolh cristou diakonhyeisa uf hmwn eggegrammenh ou melani alla pneumati yeou zwntov ouk en plaxin liyinaiv all en plaxin kardiav sarkinaiv
draft_translation: Being made manifest that you are a letter of Christ, ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not on stone tablets, but on fleshly tablets of the heart.
ukjv_translation: Forasmuch as all of you are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit (o. pneuma) of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

greek_text: πεποιθησιν δε τοιαυτην εχομεν δια του χριστου προς τον θεον
transliteration: pepoiyhsin de toiauthn ecomen dia tou cristou prov ton yeon
draft_translation: And such confidence we have through Christ toward God:
ukjv_translation: And such trust have we through Christ toward God:

greek_text: ουχ οτι ικανοι εσμεν αφ εαυτων λογισασθαι τι ως εξ εαυτων αλλ η ικανοτης ημων εκ του θεου
transliteration: ouc oti ikanoi esmen af eautwn logisasyai ti wv ex eautwn all h ikanothv hmwn ek tou yeou
draft_translation: Not that we are sufficient from ourselves to reckon anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;
ukjv_translation: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

greek_text: ος και ικανωσεν ημας διακονους καινης διαθηκης ου γραμματος αλλα πνευματος το γαρ γραμμα αποκτεινει το δε πνευμα ζωοποιει
transliteration: ov kai ikanwsen hmav diakonouv kainhv diayhkhv ou grammatov alla pneumatov to gar gramma apokteinei to de pneuma zwopoiei
draft_translation: Who also has made us able ministers of the new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.
ukjv_translation: Who also has made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: (o. pneuma) for the letter kills, but the spirit (o. pneuma) gives life.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered diatheke as covenant

greek_text: ει δε η διακονια του θανατου εν γραμμασιν εντετυπωμενη εν λιθοις εγενηθη εν δοξη ωστε μη δυνασθαι ατενισαι τους υιους ισραηλ εις το προσωπον μωσεως δια την δοξαν του προσωπου αυτου την καταργουμενην
transliteration: ei de h diakonia tou yanatou en grammasin entetupwmenh en liyoiv egenhyh en doxh wste mh dunasyai atenisai touv uiouv israhl eiv to proswpon mwsewv dia thn doxan tou proswpou autou thn katargoumenhn
draft_translation: But if the ministry of death, in letters imprinted in stones, came in glory, so that the sons of Israel could not look intently at the face of Moses because of the glory of his face, which was being made ineffective:
ukjv_translation: But if the ministration of death, written and engraved in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not steadfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

greek_text: πως ουχι μαλλον η διακονια του πνευματος εσται εν δοξη
transliteration: pwv ouci mallon h diakonia tou pneumatov estai en doxh
