draft_translation: How shall not the ministry of the Spirit be more in glory?
ukjv_translation: How shall not the ministration of the spirit (o. pneuma) be rather glorious?

greek_text: ει γαρ η διακονια της κατακρισεως δοξα πολλω μαλλον περισσευει η διακονια της δικαιοσυνης εν δοξη
transliteration: ei gar h diakonia thv katakrisewv doxa pollw mallon perisseuei h diakonia thv dikaiosunhv en doxh
draft_translation: For if the ministry of condemnation is glory, much more does the ministry of righteousness abound in glory.
ukjv_translation: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more does the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

greek_text: και γαρ ουδε δεδοξασται το δεδοξασμενον εν τουτω τω μερει ενεκεν της υπερβαλλουσης δοξης
transliteration: kai gar oude dedoxastai to dedoxasmenon en toutw tw merei eneken thv uperballoushv doxhv
draft_translation: For indeed that which had been glorified has not been glorified in this respect, because of the surpassing glory.
ukjv_translation: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excels.

greek_text: ει γαρ το καταργουμενον δια δοξης πολλω μαλλον το μενον εν δοξη
transliteration: ei gar to katargoumenon dia doxhv pollw mallon to menon en doxh
draft_translation: For if that which is being made ineffective came through glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
ukjv_translation: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remains is glorious.

greek_text: εχοντες ουν τοιαυτην ελπιδα πολλη παρρησια χρωμεθα
transliteration: econtev oun toiauthn elpida pollh parrhsia crwmeya
draft_translation: Therefore having such hope, we use much boldness:
ukjv_translation: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

greek_text: και ου καθαπερ μωσης ετιθει καλυμμα επι το προσωπον εαυτου προς το μη ατενισαι τους υιους ισραηλ εις το τελος του καταργουμενου
transliteration: kai ou kayaper mwshv etiyei kalumma epi to proswpon eautou prov to mh atenisai touv uiouv israhl eiv to telov tou katargoumenou
draft_translation: And not as Moses was putting a veil over his own face, so that the sons of Israel would not look intently at the end of that which was being made ineffective:
ukjv_translation: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not steadfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

greek_text: αλλ επωρωθη τα νοηματα αυτων αχρι γαρ της σημερον το αυτο καλυμμα επι τη αναγνωσει της παλαιας διαθηκης μενει μη ανακαλυπτομενον ο τι εν χριστω καταργειται
transliteration: all epwrwyh ta nohmata autwn acri gar thv shmeron to auto kalumma epi th anagnwsei thv palaiav diayhkhv menei mh anakaluptomenon o ti en cristw katargeitai
draft_translation: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remains the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old covenant; which vail is done away in Christ.
ukjv_translation: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remains the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

greek_text: αλλ εως σημερον ηνικα αναγινωσκεται μωσης καλυμμα επι την καρδιαν αυτων κειται
transliteration: all ewv shmeron hnika anaginwsketai mwshv kalumma epi thn kardian autwn keitai
draft_translation: But until today, whenever Moses is read, a veil lies upon their heart.
ukjv_translation: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

greek_text: ηνικα δ αν επιστρεψη προς κυριον περιαιρειται το καλυμμα
transliteration: hnika d an epistreqh prov kurion periaireitai to kalumma
draft_translation: But whenever it turns toward the Lord, the veil is removed.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

greek_text: ο δε κυριος το πνευμα εστιν ου δε το πνευμα κυριου εκει ελευθερια
transliteration: o de kuriov to pneuma estin ou de to pneuma kuriou ekei eleuyeria
draft_translation: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
ukjv_translation: Now the Lord is that Spirit: (o. pneuma) and where the Spirit (o. pneuma) of the Lord is, there is liberty.

greek_text: ημεις δε παντες ανακεκαλυμμενω προσωπω την δοξαν κυριου κατοπτριζομενοι την αυτην εικονα μεταμορφουμεθα απο δοξης εις δοξαν καθαπερ απο κυριου πνευματος
transliteration: hmeiv de pantev anakekalummenw proswpw thn doxan kuriou katoptrizomenoi thn authn eikona metamorfoumeya apo doxhv eiv doxan kayaper apo kuriou pneumatov
draft_translation: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, just as from the Lord Spirit.
ukjv_translation: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit (o. pneuma) of the LORD.

greek_text: δια τουτο εχοντες την διακονιαν ταυτην καθως ηλεηθημεν ουκ εκκακουμεν
transliteration: dia touto econtev thn diakonian tauthn kaywv hlehyhmen ouk ekkakoumen
draft_translation: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we do not faint;
ukjv_translation: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

greek_text: αλλ απειπαμεθα τα κρυπτα της αισχυνης μη περιπατουντες εν πανουργια μηδε δολουντες τον λογον του θεου αλλα τη φανερωσει της αληθειας συνιστωντες εαυτους προς πασαν συνειδησιν ανθρωπων ενωπιον του θεου
transliteration: all apeipameya ta krupta thv aiscunhv mh peripatountev en panourgia mhde dolountev ton logon tou yeou alla th fanerwsei thv alhyeiav sunistwntev eautouv prov pasan suneidhsin anyrwpwn enwpion tou yeou
draft_translation: But we renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor falsifying the word of God, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every human conscience before God.
ukjv_translation: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word (o. logos) of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

greek_text: ει δε και εστιν κεκαλυμμενον το ευαγγελιον ημων εν τοις απολλυμενοις εστιν κεκαλυμμενον
transliteration: ei de kai estin kekalummenon to euaggelion hmwn en toiv apollumenoiv estin kekalummenon
draft_translation: But if our good news be hid, it is hid to those who are lost:
ukjv_translation: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: εν οις ο θεος του αιωνος τουτου ετυφλωσεν τα νοηματα των απιστων εις το μη αυγασαι αυτοις τον φωτισμον του ευαγγελιου της δοξης του χριστου ος εστιν εικων του θεου
transliteration: en oiv o yeov tou aiwnov toutou etuflwsen ta nohmata twn apistwn eiv to mh augasai autoiv ton fwtismon tou euaggeliou thv doxhv tou cristou ov estin eikwn tou yeou
draft_translation: In whom the god of this age has blinded the minds of those who do not believe, lest the light of the glorious good news of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine to them.
ukjv_translation: In whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized believe-not idiom; modernized them-which relative; rendered euangelion as good news; rendered this aion as this age

greek_text: ου γαρ εαυτους κηρυσσομεν αλλα χριστον ιησουν κυριον εαυτους δε δουλους υμων δια ιησουν
transliteration: ou gar eautouv khrussomen alla criston ihsoun kurion eautouv de doulouv umwn dia ihsoun
draft_translation: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your slaves for Jesus' sake.
ukjv_translation: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: οτι ο θεος ο ειπων εκ σκοτους φως λαμψαι ος ελαμψεν εν ταις καρδιαις ημων προς φωτισμον της γνωσεως της δοξης του θεου εν προσωπω ιησου χριστου
transliteration: oti o yeov o eipwn ek skotouv fwv lamqai ov elamqen en taiv kardiaiv hmwn prov fwtismon thv gnwsewv thv doxhv tou yeou en proswpw ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Because God, the one who said light should shine out of darkness, shone in our hearts for illumination of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, has shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

greek_text: εχομεν δε τον θησαυρον τουτον εν οστρακινοις σκευεσιν ινα η υπερβολη της δυναμεως η του θεου και μη εξ ημων
transliteration: ecomen de ton yhsauron touton en ostrakinoiv skeuesin ina h uperbolh thv dunamewv h tou yeou kai mh ex hmwn
draft_translation: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the surpassing power may be of God, and not from us.
ukjv_translation: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

greek_text: εν παντι θλιβομενοι αλλ ου στενοχωρουμενοι απορουμενοι αλλ ουκ εξαπορουμενοι
transliteration: en panti ylibomenoi all ou stenocwroumenoi aporoumenoi all ouk exaporoumenoi
draft_translation: In everything afflicted, but not crushed; perplexed, but not despairing;
ukjv_translation: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

greek_text: διωκομενοι αλλ ουκ εγκαταλειπομενοι καταβαλλομενοι αλλ ουκ απολλυμενοι
transliteration: diwkomenoi all ouk egkataleipomenoi kataballomenoi all ouk apollumenoi
draft_translation: Persecuted, but not abandoned; thrown down, but not destroyed;
ukjv_translation: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

greek_text: παντοτε την νεκρωσιν του κυριου ιησου εν τω σωματι περιφεροντες ινα και η ζωη του ιησου εν τω σωματι ημων φανερωθη
transliteration: pantote thn nekrwsin tou kuriou ihsou en tw swmati periferontev ina kai h zwh tou ihsou en tw swmati hmwn fanerwyh
draft_translation: Always carrying around in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that also the life of Jesus may be manifested in our body.
ukjv_translation: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

greek_text: αει γαρ ημεις οι ζωντες εις θανατον παραδιδομεθα δια ιησουν ινα και η ζωη του ιησου φανερωθη εν τη θνητη σαρκι ημων
transliteration: aei gar hmeiv oi zwntev eiv yanaton paradidomeya dia ihsoun ina kai h zwh tou ihsou fanerwyh en th ynhth sarki hmwn
draft_translation: For we who live are always delivered to death because of Jesus, that also the life of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
ukjv_translation: For we which live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

greek_text: ωστε ο μεν θανατος εν ημιν ενεργειται η δε ζωη εν υμιν
transliteration: wste o men yanatov en hmin energeitai h de zwh en umin
draft_translation: So then death works in us, but life in you.
ukjv_translation: So then death works in us, but life in you.

greek_text: εχοντες δε το αυτο πνευμα της πιστεως κατα το γεγραμμενον επιστευσα διο ελαλησα και ημεις πιστευομεν διο και λαλουμεν
transliteration: econtev de to auto pneuma thv pistewv kata to gegrammenon episteusa dio elalhsa kai hmeiv pisteuomen dio kai laloumen
draft_translation: But having the same spirit of faith, according to what has been written, I believed, therefore I spoke; we also believe, therefore we also speak;
ukjv_translation: We having the same spirit (o. pneuma) of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι ο εγειρας τον κυριον ιησουν και ημας δια ιησου εγερει και παραστησει συν υμιν
transliteration: eidotev oti o egeirav ton kurion ihsoun kai hmav dia ihsou egerei kai parasthsei sun umin
draft_translation: Knowing that the one who raised the Lord Jesus shall also raise us through Jesus, and shall present us with you.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

greek_text: τα γαρ παντα δι υμας ινα η χαρις πλεονασασα δια των πλειονων την ευχαριστιαν περισσευση εις την δοξαν του θεου
transliteration: ta gar panta di umav ina h cariv pleonasasa dia twn pleionwn thn eucaristian perisseush eiv thn doxan tou yeou
draft_translation: For all things are because of you, that grace, having increased through the many, may make thanksgiving abound to the glory of God.
ukjv_translation: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

greek_text: διο ουκ εκκακουμεν αλλ ει και ο εξω ημων ανθρωπος διαφθειρεται αλλ ο εσωθεν ανακαινουται ημερα και ημερα
transliteration: dio ouk ekkakoumen all ei kai o exw hmwn anyrwpov diafyeiretai all o eswyen anakainoutai hmera kai hmera
draft_translation: For this reason we do not faint; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
ukjv_translation: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
review_notes: modernized faint-not idiom; modernized for-which-cause idiom

greek_text: το γαρ παραυτικα ελαφρον της θλιψεως ημων καθ υπερβολην εις υπερβολην αιωνιον βαρος δοξης κατεργαζεται ημιν
transliteration: to gar parautika elafron thv yliqewv hmwn kay uperbolhn eiv uperbolhn aiwnion barov doxhv katergazetai hmin
draft_translation: For the momentary lightness of our affliction works for us an eternal weight of glory, exceedingly to excess;
ukjv_translation: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, works for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

greek_text: μη σκοπουντων ημων τα βλεπομενα αλλα τα μη βλεπομενα τα γαρ βλεπομενα προσκαιρα τα δε μη βλεπομενα αιωνια
transliteration: mh skopountwn hmwn ta blepomena alla ta mh blepomena ta gar blepomena proskaira ta de mh blepomena aiwnia
draft_translation: While we do not look at the things being seen, but at the things not being seen: for the things being seen are temporary, but the things not being seen are eternal.
ukjv_translation: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

greek_text: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι εαν η επιγειος ημων οικια του σκηνους καταλυθη οικοδομην εκ θεου εχομεν οικιαν αχειροποιητον αιωνιον εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: oidamen gar oti ean h epigeiov hmwn oikia tou skhnouv kataluyh oikodomhn ek yeou ecomen oikian aceiropoihton aiwnion en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
ukjv_translation: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

greek_text: και γαρ εν τουτω στεναζομεν το οικητηριον ημων το εξ ουρανου επενδυσασθαι επιποθουντες
transliteration: kai gar en toutw stenazomen to oikhthrion hmwn to ex ouranou ependusasyai epipoyountev
draft_translation: For also in this we groan, longing to be clothed over with our dwelling which is from heaven:
ukjv_translation: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

greek_text: ειγε και ενδυσαμενοι ου γυμνοι ευρεθησομεθα
transliteration: eige kai endusamenoi ou gumnoi eureyhsomeya
draft_translation: If indeed being clothed we shall not be found naked.
ukjv_translation: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

greek_text: και γαρ οι οντες εν τω σκηνει στεναζομεν βαρουμενοι εφ ω ου θελομεν εκδυσασθαι αλλ επενδυσασθαι ινα καταποθη το θνητον υπο της ζωης
transliteration: kai gar oi ontev en tw skhnei stenazomen baroumenoi ef w ou yelomen ekdusasyai all ependusasyai ina katapoyh to ynhton upo thv zwhv
draft_translation: For also we who are in this tent groan, being burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed, but to be clothed over, so that the mortal may be swallowed up by life.
ukjv_translation: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

greek_text: ο δε κατεργασαμενος ημας εις αυτο τουτο θεος ο και δους ημιν τον αρραβωνα του πνευματος
transliteration: o de katergasamenov hmav eiv auto touto yeov o kai douv hmin ton arrabwna tou pneumatov
draft_translation: Now the one who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who also has given to us the pledge of the Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Now he that has wrought us for the very same thing is God, who also has given unto us the earn of the Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized he-that relative; modernized wrought; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered arrabon as pledge; rendered katergazomai as prepare

greek_text: θαρρουντες ουν παντοτε και ειδοτες οτι ενδημουντες εν τω σωματι εκδημουμεν απο του κυριου
transliteration: yarrountev oun pantote kai eidotev oti endhmountev en tw swmati ekdhmoumen apo tou kuriou
draft_translation: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
ukjv_translation: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
review_notes: modernized whilst; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: δια πιστεως γαρ περιπατουμεν ου δια ειδους
transliteration: dia pistewv gar peripatoumen ou dia eidouv
draft_translation: For we walk by faith, not by appearance.
ukjv_translation: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

greek_text: θαρρουμεν δε και ευδοκουμεν μαλλον εκδημησαι εκ του σωματος και ενδημησαι προς τον κυριον
transliteration: yarroumen de kai eudokoumen mallon ekdhmhsai ek tou swmatov kai endhmhsai prov ton kurion
draft_translation: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
ukjv_translation: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

greek_text: διο και φιλοτιμουμεθα ειτε ενδημουντες ειτε εκδημουντες ευαρεστοι αυτω ειναι
transliteration: dio kai filotimoumeya eite endhmountev eite ekdhmountev euarestoi autw einai
draft_translation: Therefore we labor, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

greek_text: τους γαρ παντας ημας φανερωθηναι δει εμπροσθεν του βηματος του χριστου ινα κομισηται εκαστος τα δια του σωματος προς α επραξεν ειτε αγαθον ειτε κακον
transliteration: touv gar pantav hmav fanerwyhnai dei emprosyen tou bhmatov tou cristou ina komishtai ekastov ta dia tou swmatov prov a epraxen eite agayon eite kakon
draft_translation: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he has done, whether it be good or bad.
ukjv_translation: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he has done, whether it be good or bad.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειδοτες ουν τον φοβον του κυριου ανθρωπους πειθομεν θεω δε πεφανερωμεθα ελπιζω δε και εν ταις συνειδησεσιν υμων πεφανερωσθαι
transliteration: eidotev oun ton fobon tou kuriou anyrwpouv peiyomen yew de pefanerwmeya elpizw de kai en taiv suneidhsesin umwn pefanerwsyai
draft_translation: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest to God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
ukjv_translation: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ου γαρ παλιν εαυτους συνιστανομεν υμιν αλλα αφορμην διδοντες υμιν καυχηματος υπερ ημων ινα εχητε προς τους εν προσωπω καυχωμενους και ου καρδια
transliteration: ou gar palin eautouv sunistanomen umin alla aformhn didontev umin kauchmatov uper hmwn ina echte prov touv en proswpw kaucwmenouv kai ou kardia
draft_translation: For we commend not ourselves again to you, but give you occasion to boast on our behalf, that you may have somewhat to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.
ukjv_translation: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that all of you may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: ειτε γαρ εξεστημεν θεω ειτε σωφρονουμεν υμιν
transliteration: eite gar exesthmen yew eite swfronoumen umin
draft_translation: For whether we are beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we are sober, it is for your cause.
ukjv_translation: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

greek_text: η γαρ αγαπη του χριστου συνεχει ημας κριναντας τουτο οτι ει εις υπερ παντων απεθανεν αρα οι παντες απεθανον
transliteration: h gar agaph tou cristou sunecei hmav krinantav touto oti ei eiv uper pantwn apeyanen ara oi pantev apeyanon
draft_translation: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
ukjv_translation: For the love (o. agape) of Christ constrains us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και υπερ παντων απεθανεν ινα οι ζωντες μηκετι εαυτοις ζωσιν αλλα τω υπερ αυτων αποθανοντι και εγερθεντι
transliteration: kai uper pantwn apeyanen ina oi zwntev mhketi eautoiv zwsin alla tw uper autwn apoyanonti kai egeryenti
draft_translation: And that he died for all, that those who live should not from now on live to themselves, but to him who died for them, and rose again.
ukjv_translation: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized henceforth; modernized him-which relative; modernized they-which relative

greek_text: ωστε ημεις απο του νυν ουδενα οιδαμεν κατα σαρκα ει δε και εγνωκαμεν κατα σαρκα χριστον αλλα νυν ουκετι γινωσκομεν
transliteration: wste hmeiv apo tou nun oudena oidamen kata sarka ei de kai egnwkamen kata sarka criston alla nun ouketi ginwskomen
draft_translation: Therefore from now on know we no one after the flesh: yes, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now from now on know we him no more.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
review_notes: modernized henceforth; modernized no-man idiom; modernized wherefore; modernized yea

greek_text: ωστε ει τις εν χριστω καινη κτισις τα αρχαια παρηλθεν ιδου γεγονεν καινα τα παντα
transliteration: wste ei tiv en cristw kainh ktisiv ta arcaia parhlyen idou gegonen kaina ta panta
draft_translation: Therefore if anyone be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; look, all things are become new.
ukjv_translation: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

greek_text: τα δε παντα εκ του θεου του καταλλαξαντος ημας εαυτω δια ιησου χριστου και δοντος ημιν την διακονιαν της καταλλαγης
transliteration: ta de panta ek tou yeou tou katallaxantov hmav eautw dia ihsou cristou kai dontov hmin thn diakonian thv katallaghv
draft_translation: But all things are from God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
ukjv_translation: And all things are of God, who has reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

greek_text: ως οτι θεος ην εν χριστω κοσμον καταλλασσων εαυτω μη λογιζομενος αυτοις τα παραπτωματα αυτων και θεμενος εν ημιν τον λογον της καταλλαγης
transliteration: wv oti yeov hn en cristw kosmon katallasswn eautw mh logizomenov autoiv ta paraptwmata autwn kai yemenov en hmin ton logon thv katallaghv
draft_translation: To know, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, not imputing their trespasses to them; and has committed to us the word of reconciliation.
ukjv_translation: To know, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and has committed unto us the word (o. logos) of reconciliation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: υπερ χριστου ουν πρεσβευομεν ως του θεου παρακαλουντος δι ημων δεομεθα υπερ χριστου καταλλαγητε τω θεω
transliteration: uper cristou oun presbeuomen wv tou yeou parakalountov di hmwn deomeya uper cristou katallaghte tw yew
draft_translation: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did plead to you by us: we plead with you in Christ's place, be reconciled to God.
ukjv_translation: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did plead to you by us: we pray you in Christ's position, be all of you reconciled to God.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; modernized pray-you wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τον γαρ μη γνοντα αμαρτιαν υπερ ημων αμαρτιαν εποιησεν ινα ημεις γινωμεθα δικαιοσυνη θεου εν αυτω
transliteration: ton gar mh gnonta amartian uper hmwn amartian epoihsen ina hmeiv ginwmeya dikaiosunh yeou en autw
draft_translation: For he made the one who did not know sin to be sin for us, so that we might become righteousness of God in him.
ukjv_translation: For he has made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

greek_text: συνεργουντες δε και παρακαλουμεν μη εις κενον την χαριν του θεου δεξασθαι υμας
transliteration: sunergountev de kai parakaloumen mh eiv kenon thn carin tou yeou dexasyai umav
draft_translation: We then, as workers together with him, plead to you also that you receive not the grace of God in vain.
ukjv_translation: We then, as workers together with him, plead to you also that all of you receive not the grace of God in vain.

greek_text: λεγει γαρ καιρω δεκτω επηκουσα σου και εν ημερα σωτηριας εβοηθησα σοι ιδου νυν καιρος ευπροσδεκτος ιδου νυν ημερα σωτηριας
transliteration: legei gar kairw dektw ephkousa sou kai en hmera swthriav ebohyhsa soi idou nun kairov euprosdektov idou nun hmera swthriav
draft_translation: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I helped you: look, now is the accepted time; look, now is the day of salvation.)
ukjv_translation: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I helped you: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

greek_text: μηδεμιαν εν μηδενι διδοντες προσκοπην ινα μη μωμηθη η διακονια
transliteration: mhdemian en mhdeni didontev proskophn ina mh mwmhyh h diakonia
draft_translation: Giving no offense in anything, that the ministry not be blamed:
ukjv_translation: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized be-not clause; modernized offence spelling

greek_text: αλλ εν παντι συνιστωντες εαυτους ως θεου διακονοι εν υπομονη πολλη εν θλιψεσιν εν αναγκαις εν στενοχωριαις
transliteration: all en panti sunistwntev eautouv wv yeou diakonoi en upomonh pollh en yliqesin en anagkaiv en stenocwriaiv
draft_translation: But in everything commending ourselves as servants of God, in much endurance, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
ukjv_translation: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

greek_text: εν πληγαις εν φυλακαις εν ακαταστασιαις εν κοποις εν αγρυπνιαις εν νηστειαις
transliteration: en plhgaiv en fulakaiv en akatastasiaiv en kopoiv en agrupniaiv en nhsteiaiv
draft_translation: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
ukjv_translation: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

greek_text: εν αγνοτητι εν γνωσει εν μακροθυμια εν χρηστοτητι εν πνευματι αγιω εν αγαπη ανυποκριτω
transliteration: en agnothti en gnwsei en makroyumia en crhstothti en pneumati agiw en agaph anupokritw
draft_translation: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, by love sincere,
ukjv_translation: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) by love (o. agape) sincere,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εν λογω αληθειας εν δυναμει θεου δια των οπλων της δικαιοσυνης των δεξιων και αριστερων
transliteration: en logw alhyeiav en dunamei yeou dia twn oplwn thv dikaiosunhv twn dexiwn kai aristerwn
draft_translation: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
ukjv_translation: By the word (o. logos) of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δια δοξης και ατιμιας δια δυσφημιας και ευφημιας ως πλανοι και αληθεις
transliteration: dia doxhv kai atimiav dia dusfhmiav kai eufhmiav wv planoi kai alhyeiv
draft_translation: By honor and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
ukjv_translation: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

greek_text: ως αγνοουμενοι και επιγινωσκομενοι ως αποθνησκοντες και ιδου ζωμεν ως παιδευομενοι και μη θανατουμενοι
transliteration: wv agnooumenoi kai epiginwskomenoi wv apoynhskontev kai idou zwmen wv paideuomenoi kai mh yanatoumenoi
draft_translation: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, look, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
ukjv_translation: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

greek_text: ως λυπουμενοι αει δε χαιροντες ως πτωχοι πολλους δε πλουτιζοντες ως μηδεν εχοντες και παντα κατεχοντες
transliteration: wv lupoumenoi aei de cairontev wv ptwcoi pollouv de ploutizontev wv mhden econtev kai panta katecontev
draft_translation: As sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
ukjv_translation: As sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: το στομα ημων ανεωγεν προς υμας κορινθιοι η καρδια ημων πεπλατυνται
transliteration: to stoma hmwn anewgen prov umav korinyioi h kardia hmwn peplatuntai
draft_translation: O you Corinthians, our mouth is open to you, our heart is enlarged.
ukjv_translation: O all of you Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ου στενοχωρεισθε εν ημιν στενοχωρεισθε δε εν τοις σπλαγχνοις υμων
transliteration: ou stenocwreisye en hmin stenocwreisye de en toiv splagcnoiv umwn
draft_translation: You are not straitened in us, but you are straitened in your own inward parts.
ukjv_translation: All of you are not straitened in us, but all of you are straitened in your own bowels.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered splanchna as inward parts

greek_text: την δε αυτην αντιμισθιαν ως τεκνοις λεγω πλατυνθητε και υμεις
transliteration: thn de authn antimisyian wv teknoiv legw platunyhte kai umeiv
draft_translation: Now for a recompense in the same, (I speak as to my children,) be also enlarged.
ukjv_translation: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be all of you also enlarged.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized be-you imperative; modernized recompence spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη γινεσθε ετεροζυγουντες απιστοις τις γαρ μετοχη δικαιοσυνη και ανομια τις δε κοινωνια φωτι προς σκοτος
transliteration: mh ginesye eterozugountev apistoiv tiv gar metoch dikaiosunh kai anomia tiv de koinwnia fwti prov skotov
draft_translation: do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion has light with darkness?
ukjv_translation: Be all of you not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion has light with darkness?
review_notes: modernized be-you-not imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τις δε συμφωνησις χριστω προς βελιαλ η τις μερις πιστω μετα απιστου
transliteration: tiv de sumfwnhsiv cristw prov belial h tiv meriv pistw meta apistou
draft_translation: And what concord has Christ with Belial? or what part has the one who believes with an infidel?
ukjv_translation: And what concord has Christ with Belial? or what part has he that believes with an infidel?

greek_text: τις δε συγκαταθεσις ναω θεου μετα ειδωλων υμεις γαρ ναος θεου εστε ζωντος καθως ειπεν ο θεος οτι ενοικησω εν αυτοις και εμπεριπατησω και εσομαι αυτων θεος και αυτοι εσονται μοι λαος
transliteration: tiv de sugkatayesiv naw yeou meta eidwlwn umeiv gar naov yeou este zwntov kaywv eipen o yeov oti enoikhsw en autoiv kai emperipathsw kai esomai autwn yeov kai autoi esontai moi laov
draft_translation: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? for you are the temple of the living God; as God has said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
ukjv_translation: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? for all of you are the temple of the living God; as God has said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

greek_text: διο εξελθετε εκ μεσου αυτων και αφορισθητε λεγει κυριος και ακαθαρτου μη απτεσθε καγω εισδεξομαι υμας
transliteration: dio exelyete ek mesou autwn kai aforisyhte legei kuriov kai akayartou mh aptesye kagw eisdexomai umav
draft_translation: Therefore come out from among them, and be separate, says the Lord, and do not touch the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore come out from among them, and be all of you separate, says the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; modernized touch-not idiom; modernized wherefore; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εσομαι υμιν εις πατερα και υμεις εσεσθε μοι εις υιους και θυγατερας λεγει κυριος παντοκρατωρ
transliteration: kai esomai umin eiv patera kai umeiv esesye moi eiv uiouv kai yugaterav legei kuriov pantokratwr
draft_translation: And will be a Father to you, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
ukjv_translation: And will be a Father unto you, and all of you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ταυτας ουν εχοντες τας επαγγελιας αγαπητοι καθαρισωμεν εαυτους απο παντος μολυσμου σαρκος και πνευματος επιτελουντες αγιωσυνην εν φοβω θεου
transliteration: tautav oun econtev tav epaggeliav agaphtoi kayariswmen eautouv apo pantov molusmou sarkov kai pneumatov epitelountev agiwsunhn en fobw yeou
draft_translation: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
ukjv_translation: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, (o. pneuma) perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: χωρησατε ημας ουδενα ηδικησαμεν ουδενα εφθειραμεν ουδενα επλεονεκτησαμεν
transliteration: cwrhsate hmav oudena hdikhsamen oudena efyeiramen oudena epleonekthsamen
draft_translation: Receive us; we have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have defrauded no one.
ukjv_translation: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

greek_text: ου προς κατακρισιν λεγω προειρηκα γαρ οτι εν ταις καρδιαις ημων εστε εις το συναποθανειν και συζην
transliteration: ou prov katakrisin legw proeirhka gar oti en taiv kardiaiv hmwn este eiv to sunapoyanein kai suzhn
draft_translation: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die and live with you.
ukjv_translation: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that all of you are in our hearts to die and live with you.

greek_text: πολλη μοι παρρησια προς υμας πολλη μοι καυχησις υπερ υμων πεπληρωμαι τη παρακλησει υπερπερισσευομαι τη χαρα επι παση τη θλιψει ημων
transliteration: pollh moi parrhsia prov umav pollh moi kauchsiv uper umwn peplhrwmai th paraklhsei uperperisseuomai th cara epi pash th yliqei hmwn
draft_translation: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceedingly joyful in all our tribulation.
ukjv_translation: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

greek_text: και γαρ ελθοντων ημων εις μακεδονιαν ουδεμιαν εσχηκεν ανεσιν η σαρξ ημων αλλ εν παντι θλιβομενοι εξωθεν μαχαι εσωθεν φοβοι
transliteration: kai gar elyontwn hmwn eiv makedonian oudemian eschken anesin h sarx hmwn all en panti ylibomenoi exwyen macai eswyen foboi
draft_translation: For, when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
ukjv_translation: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

greek_text: αλλ ο παρακαλων τους ταπεινους παρεκαλεσεν ημας ο θεος εν τη παρουσια τιτου
transliteration: all o parakalwn touv tapeinouv parekalesen hmav o yeov en th parousia titou
draft_translation: But God, who comforts the lowly, comforted us by the presence of Titus;
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless God, that comforts those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

greek_text: ου μονον δε εν τη παρουσια αυτου αλλα και εν τη παρακλησει η παρεκληθη εφ υμιν αναγγελλων ημιν την υμων επιποθησιν τον υμων οδυρμον τον υμων ζηλον υπερ εμου ωστε με μαλλον χαρηναι
transliteration: ou monon de en th parousia autou alla kai en th paraklhsei h pareklhyh ef umin anaggellwn hmin thn umwn epipoyhsin ton umwn odurmon ton umwn zhlon uper emou wste me mallon carhnai
draft_translation: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation with which he was comforted in you, when he told us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced the more.
ukjv_translation: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earn desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
review_notes: fixed earn artifact; modernized wherewith; rendered zelos as zeal

greek_text: οτι ει και ελυπησα υμας εν τη επιστολη ου μεταμελομαι ει και μετεμελομην βλεπω γαρ οτι η επιστολη εκεινη ει και προς ωραν ελυπησεν υμας
transliteration: oti ei kai eluphsa umav en th epistolh ou metamelomai ei kai metemelomhn blepw gar oti h epistolh ekeinh ei kai prov wran eluphsen umav
draft_translation: For even if I grieved you with the letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it: for I see that that letter grieved you, even if for a short time.
ukjv_translation: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle has made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

greek_text: νυν χαιρω ουχ οτι ελυπηθητε αλλ οτι ελυπηθητε εις μετανοιαν ελυπηθητε γαρ κατα θεον ινα εν μηδενι ζημιωθητε εξ ημων
transliteration: nun cairw ouc oti eluphyhte all oti eluphyhte eiv metanoian eluphyhte gar kata yeon ina en mhdeni zhmiwyhte ex hmwn
draft_translation: Now I rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you sorrowed to repentance: for you were made sorry after a godly manner, that you might receive damage by us in nothing.
ukjv_translation: Now I rejoice, not that all of you were made sorry, but that all of you sorrowed to repentance: for all of you were made sorry after a godly manner, that all of you might receive damage by us in nothing.

greek_text: η γαρ κατα θεον λυπη μετανοιαν εις σωτηριαν αμεταμελητον κατεργαζεται η δε του κοσμου λυπη θανατον κατεργαζεται
transliteration: h gar kata yeon luph metanoian eiv swthrian ametamelhton katergazetai h de tou kosmou luph yanaton katergazetai
draft_translation: For sorrow according to God works repentance to salvation without regret, but the sorrow of the world works death.
ukjv_translation: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world works death.

greek_text: ιδου γαρ αυτο τουτο το κατα θεον λυπηθηναι υμας ποσην κατειργασατο υμιν σπουδην αλλα απολογιαν αλλα αγανακτησιν αλλα φοβον αλλα επιποθησιν αλλα ζηλον αλλ εκδικησιν εν παντι συνεστησατε εαυτους αγνους ειναι εν τω πραγματι
transliteration: idou gar auto touto to kata yeon luphyhnai umav poshn kateirgasato umin spoudhn alla apologian alla aganakthsin alla fobon alla epipoyhsin alla zhlon all ekdikhsin en panti sunesthsate eautouv agnouv einai en tw pragmati
draft_translation: For look this very same thing, that you sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it worked in you, yes, what clearing of yourselves, yes, what indignation, yes, what fear, yes, what vehement desire, yes, what zeal, yes, what revenge! In all things you have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
ukjv_translation: For behold this very same thing, that all of you sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things all of you have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
review_notes: modernized behold; modernized wrought; modernized yea; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αρα ει και εγραψα υμιν ουχ εινεκεν του αδικησαντος ουδε εινεκεν του αδικηθεντος αλλ εινεκεν του φανερωθηναι την σπουδην ημων την υπερ υμων προς υμας ενωπιον του θεου
transliteration: ara ei kai egraqa umin ouc eineken tou adikhsantov oude eineken tou adikhyentov all eineken tou fanerwyhnai thn spoudhn hmwn thn uper umwn prov umav enwpion tou yeou
draft_translation: Therefore, though I wrote to you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear to you.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore

greek_text: δια τουτο παρακεκλημεθα επι τη παρακλησει υμων περισσοτερως δε μαλλον εχαρημεν επι τη χαρα τιτου οτι αναπεπαυται το πνευμα αυτου απο παντων υμων
transliteration: dia touto parakeklhmeya epi th paraklhsei umwn perissoterwv de mallon ecarhmen epi th cara titou oti anapepautai to pneuma autou apo pantwn umwn
draft_translation: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yes, and exceedingly more rejoice did we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
ukjv_translation: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly more rejoice did we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit (o. pneuma) was refreshed by you all.
review_notes: modernized yea; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οτι ει τι αυτω υπερ υμων κεκαυχημαι ου κατησχυνθην αλλ ως παντα εν αληθεια ελαλησαμεν υμιν ουτως και η καυχησις ημων η επι τιτου αληθεια εγενηθη
transliteration: oti ei ti autw uper umwn kekauchmai ou kathscunyhn all wv panta en alhyeia elalhsamen umin outwv kai h kauchsiv hmwn h epi titou alhyeia egenhyh
draft_translation: For if I have boasted anything to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
ukjv_translation: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

greek_text: και τα σπλαγχνα αυτου περισσοτερως εις υμας εστιν αναμιμνησκομενου την παντων υμων υπακοην ως μετα φοβου και τρομου εδεξασθε αυτον
transliteration: kai ta splagcna autou perissoterwv eiv umav estin anamimnhskomenou thn pantwn umwn upakohn wv meta fobou kai tromou edexasye auton
draft_translation: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, while he remembers the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.
ukjv_translation: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembers the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling all of you received him.
review_notes: modernized whilst; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: χαιρω ουν οτι εν παντι θαρρω εν υμιν
transliteration: cairw oun oti en panti yarrw en umin
draft_translation: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
ukjv_translation: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: γνωριζομεν δε υμιν αδελφοι την χαριν του θεου την δεδομενην εν ταις εκκλησιαις της μακεδονιας
transliteration: gnwrizomen de umin adelfoi thn carin tou yeou thn dedomenhn en taiv ekklhsiaiv thv makedoniav
draft_translation: Moreover, brothers, we do you to know of the grace of God bestowed on the assemblies of Macedonia;
ukjv_translation: Moreover, brethren, we do you to know of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
review_notes: rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: οτι εν πολλη δοκιμη θλιψεως η περισσεια της χαρας αυτων και η κατα βαθους πτωχεια αυτων επερισσευσεν εις τον πλουτον της απλοτητος αυτων
transliteration: oti en pollh dokimh yliqewv h perisseia thv carav autwn kai h kata bayouv ptwceia autwn eperisseusen eiv ton plouton thv aplothtov autwn
draft_translation: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.
ukjv_translation: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

greek_text: οτι κατα δυναμιν μαρτυρω και υπερ δυναμιν αυθαιρετοι
transliteration: oti kata dunamin marturw kai uper dunamin auyairetoi
draft_translation: In order to their power, I bear record, yes, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
ukjv_translation: In order to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

greek_text: μετα πολλης παρακλησεως δεομενοι ημων την χαριν και την κοινωνιαν της διακονιας της εις τους αγιους δεξασθαι ημας
transliteration: meta pollhv paraklhsewv deomenoi hmwn thn carin kai thn koinwnian thv diakoniav thv eiv touv agiouv dexasyai hmav
draft_translation: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the holy ones.
ukjv_translation: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

greek_text: και ου καθως ηλπισαμεν αλλ εαυτους εδωκαν πρωτον τω κυριω και ημιν δια θεληματος θεου
transliteration: kai ou kaywv hlpisamen all eautouv edwkan prwton tw kuriw kai hmin dia yelhmatov yeou
draft_translation: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us by the will of God.
ukjv_translation: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: εις το παρακαλεσαι ημας τιτον ινα καθως προενηρξατο ουτως και επιτελεση εις υμας και την χαριν ταυτην
transliteration: eiv to parakalesai hmav titon ina kaywv proenhrxato outwv kai epitelesh eiv umav kai thn carin tauthn
draft_translation: so that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
ukjv_translation: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

greek_text: αλλ ωσπερ εν παντι περισσευετε πιστει και λογω και γνωσει και παση σπουδη και τη εξ υμων εν ημιν αγαπη ινα και εν ταυτη τη χαριτι περισσευητε
transliteration: all wsper en panti perisseuete pistei kai logw kai gnwsei kai pash spoudh kai th ex umwn en hmin agaph ina kai en tauth th cariti perisseuhte
draft_translation: Therefore, as you abound in everything, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that you abound in this grace also.
ukjv_translation: Therefore, as all of you abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, (o. logos) and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love (o. agape) to us, see that all of you abound in this grace also.
review_notes: modernized everything spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ου κατ επιταγην λεγω αλλα δια της ετερων σπουδης και το της υμετερας αγαπης γνησιον δοκιμαζων
transliteration: ou kat epitaghn legw alla dia thv eterwn spoudhv kai to thv umeterav agaphv gnhsion dokimazwn
draft_translation: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
ukjv_translation: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love. (o. agape)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: γινωσκετε γαρ την χαριν του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου οτι δι υμας επτωχευσεν πλουσιος ων ινα υμεις τη εκεινου πτωχεια πλουτησητε
transliteration: ginwskete gar thn carin tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou oti di umav eptwceusen plousiov wn ina umeiv th ekeinou ptwceia plouthshte
draft_translation: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might be rich.
ukjv_translation: For all of you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that all of you through his poverty might be rich.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και γνωμην εν τουτω διδωμι τουτο γαρ υμιν συμφερει οιτινες ου μονον το ποιησαι αλλα και το θελειν προενηρξασθε απο περυσι
transliteration: kai gnwmhn en toutw didwmi touto gar umin sumferei oitinev ou monon to poihsai alla kai to yelein proenhrxasye apo perusi
draft_translation: And in this I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
ukjv_translation: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

greek_text: νυνι δε και το ποιησαι επιτελεσατε οπως καθαπερ η προθυμια του θελειν ουτως και το επιτελεσαι εκ του εχειν
transliteration: nuni de kai to poihsai epitelesate opwv kayaper h proyumia tou yelein outwv kai to epitelesai ek tou ecein
draft_translation: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which you have.
ukjv_translation: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which all of you have.

greek_text: ει γαρ η προθυμια προκειται καθο εαν εχη τις ευπροσδεκτος ου καθο ουκ εχει
transliteration: ei gar h proyumia prokeitai kayo ean ech tiv euprosdektov ou kayo ouk ecei
draft_translation: For if there is first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man has, and not according to that he has not.
ukjv_translation: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man has, and not according to that he has not.

greek_text: ου γαρ ινα αλλοις ανεσις υμιν δε θλιψις αλλ εξ ισοτητος εν τω νυν καιρω το υμων περισσευμα εις το εκεινων υστερημα
transliteration: ou gar ina alloiv anesiv umin de yliqiv all ex isothtov en tw nun kairw to umwn perisseuma eiv to ekeinwn usterhma
draft_translation: For it is not that others have relief and you affliction, but by equality; at the present time your abundance is for their lack,
ukjv_translation: For I mean not that other men be eased, and all of you burdened:

greek_text: ινα και το εκεινων περισσευμα γενηται εις το υμων υστερημα οπως γενηται ισοτης
transliteration: ina kai to ekeinwn perisseuma genhtai eiv to umwn usterhma opwv genhtai isothv
draft_translation: so that also their abundance may be for your lack, so that there may be equality:
ukjv_translation: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their lack, that their abundance also may be a supply for your lack: that there may be equality:

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται ο το πολυ ουκ επλεονασεν και ο το ολιγον ουκ ηλαττονησεν
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai o to polu ouk epleonasen kai o to oligon ouk hlattonhsen
draft_translation: As it is written, the one who had gathered much had nothing over; and the one who had gathered little had no lack.
ukjv_translation: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

greek_text: χαρις δε τω θεω τω διδοντι την αυτην σπουδην υπερ υμων εν τη καρδια τιτου
transliteration: cariv de tw yew tw didonti thn authn spoudhn uper umwn en th kardia titou
draft_translation: But thanks be to God, who put the same diligence into the heart of Titus for you.
ukjv_translation: But thanks be to God, which put the same earn care into the heart of Titus for you.
review_notes: fixed earn artifact; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: οτι την μεν παρακλησιν εδεξατο σπουδαιοτερος δε υπαρχων αυθαιρετος εξηλθεν προς υμας
transliteration: oti thn men paraklhsin edexato spoudaioterov de uparcwn auyairetov exhlyen prov umav
draft_translation: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went to you.
ukjv_translation: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

greek_text: συνεπεμψαμεν δε μετ αυτου τον αδελφον ου ο επαινος εν τω ευαγγελιω δια πασων των εκκλησιων
transliteration: sunepemqamen de met autou ton adelfon ou o epainov en tw euaggeliw dia paswn twn ekklhsiwn
draft_translation: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the good news throughout all the assemblies;
ukjv_translation: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
review_notes: rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ου μονον δε αλλα και χειροτονηθεις υπο των εκκλησιων συνεκδημος ημων συν τη χαριτι ταυτη τη διακονουμενη υφ ημων προς την αυτου του κυριου δοξαν και προθυμιαν υμων
transliteration: ou monon de alla kai ceirotonhyeiv upo twn ekklhsiwn sunekdhmov hmwn sun th cariti tauth th diakonoumenh uf hmwn prov thn autou tou kuriou doxan kai proyumian umwn
draft_translation: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the assemblies to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
ukjv_translation: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: στελλομενοι τουτο μη τις ημας μωμησηται εν τη αδροτητι ταυτη τη διακονουμενη υφ ημων
transliteration: stellomenoi touto mh tiv hmav mwmhshtai en th adrothti tauth th diakonoumenh uf hmwn
draft_translation: Avoiding this, that no one should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
ukjv_translation: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

greek_text: προνοουμενοι καλα ου μονον ενωπιον κυριου αλλα και ενωπιον ανθρωπων
transliteration: pronooumenoi kala ou monon enwpion kuriou alla kai enwpion anyrwpwn
draft_translation: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
ukjv_translation: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

greek_text: συνεπεμψαμεν δε αυτοις τον αδελφον ημων ον εδοκιμασαμεν εν πολλοις πολλακις σπουδαιον οντα νυνι δε πολυ σπουδαιοτερον πεποιθησει πολλη τη εις υμας
transliteration: sunepemqamen de autoiv ton adelfon hmwn on edokimasamen en polloiv pollakiv spoudaion onta nuni de polu spoudaioteron pepoiyhsei pollh th eiv umav
draft_translation: And we sent with them our brother, whom we often proved in many things to be diligent, but now much more diligent by great confidence toward you.
ukjv_translation: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

greek_text: ειτε υπερ τιτου κοινωνος εμος και εις υμας συνεργος ειτε αδελφοι ημων αποστολοι εκκλησιων δοξα χριστου
transliteration: eite uper titou koinwnov emov kai eiv umav sunergov eite adelfoi hmwn apostoloi ekklhsiwn doxa cristou
draft_translation: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellow-helper concerning you: or our brothers be inquired of, they are the messengers of the assemblies, and the glory of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellow-helper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
review_notes: modernized enquire spelling; modernized enquired spelling; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: την ουν ενδειξιν της αγαπης υμων και ημων καυχησεως υπερ υμων εις αυτους ενδειξασθε και εις προσωπον των εκκλησιων
transliteration: thn oun endeixin thv agaphv umwn kai hmwn kauchsewv uper umwn eiv autouv endeixasye kai eiv proswpon twn ekklhsiwn
draft_translation: Therefore show you to them, and before the assemblies, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore show all of you to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, (o. agape) and of our boasting on your behalf.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: περι μεν γαρ της διακονιας της εις τους αγιους περισσον μοι εστιν το γραφειν υμιν
transliteration: peri men gar thv diakoniav thv eiv touv agiouv perisson moi estin to grafein umin
draft_translation: For as concerning the ministering to the holy ones, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
ukjv_translation: For as concerning the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

greek_text: οιδα γαρ την προθυμιαν υμων ην υπερ υμων καυχωμαι μακεδοσιν οτι αχαια παρεσκευασται απο περυσι και ο εξ υμων ζηλος ηρεθισεν τους πλειονας
transliteration: oida gar thn proyumian umwn hn uper umwn kaucwmai makedosin oti acaia pareskeuastai apo perusi kai o ex umwn zhlov hreyisen touv pleionav
draft_translation: For I know your readiness, for which I boast about you to Macedonians, that Achaia has been ready since last year; and your zeal stirred up the majority.
ukjv_translation: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has provoked very many.

greek_text: επεμψα δε τους αδελφους ινα μη το καυχημα ημων το υπερ υμων κενωθη εν τω μερει τουτω ινα καθως ελεγον παρεσκευασμενοι ητε
transliteration: epemqa de touv adelfouv ina mh to kauchma hmwn to uper umwn kenwyh en tw merei toutw ina kaywv elegon pareskeuasmenoi hte
draft_translation: Yet have I sent the brothers, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, you may be ready:
ukjv_translation: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, all of you may be ready:
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: μηπως εαν ελθωσιν συν εμοι μακεδονες και ευρωσιν υμας απαρασκευαστους καταισχυνθωμεν ημεις ινα μη λεγωμεν υμεις εν τη υποστασει ταυτη της καυχησεως
transliteration: mhpwv ean elywsin sun emoi makedonev kai eurwsin umav aparaskeuastouv kataiscunywmen hmeiv ina mh legwmen umeiv en th upostasei tauth thv kauchsewv
draft_translation: Lest by any means if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
ukjv_translation: Lest lest by any means if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, all of you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
review_notes: fixed duplicate lest artifact; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αναγκαιον ουν ηγησαμην παρακαλεσαι τους αδελφους ινα προελθωσιν εις υμας και προκαταρτισωσιν την προκατηγγελμενην ευλογιαν υμων ταυτην ετοιμην ειναι ουτως ως ευλογιαν και μη ωσπερ πλεονεξιαν
transliteration: anagkaion oun hghsamhn parakalesai touv adelfouv ina proelywsin eiv umav kai prokatartiswsin thn prokathggelmenhn eulogian umwn tauthn etoimhn einai outwv wv eulogian kai mh wsper pleonexian
draft_translation: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brothers, that they would go before to you, and make up beforehand your bounty, of which you had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
ukjv_translation: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof all of you had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whereof; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: τουτο δε ο σπειρων φειδομενως φειδομενως και θερισει και ο σπειρων επ ευλογιαις επ ευλογιαις και θερισει
transliteration: touto de o speirwn feidomenwv feidomenwv kai yerisei kai o speirwn ep eulogiaiv ep eulogiaiv kai yerisei
draft_translation: But this I say, the one who sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and the one who sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
ukjv_translation: But this I say, He which sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

greek_text: εκαστος καθως προαιρειται τη καρδια μη εκ λυπης η εξ αναγκης ιλαρον γαρ δοτην αγαπα ο θεος
transliteration: ekastov kaywv proaireitai th kardia mh ek luphv h ex anagkhv ilaron gar dothn agapa o yeov
draft_translation: Let each one give as he purposes in the heart, not from sorrow or from necessity: for God loves a cheerful giver.
ukjv_translation: Every man according as he purposes in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loves a cheerful giver.

greek_text: δυνατος δε ο θεος πασαν χαριν περισσευσαι εις υμας ινα εν παντι παντοτε πασαν αυταρκειαν εχοντες περισσευητε εις παν εργον αγαθον
transliteration: dunatov de o yeov pasan carin perisseusai eiv umav ina en panti pantote pasan autarkeian econtev perisseuhte eiv pan ergon agayon
draft_translation: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
ukjv_translation: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that all of you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

greek_text: καθως γεγραπται εσκορπισεν εδωκεν τοις πενησιν η δικαιοσυνη αυτου μενει εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: kaywv gegraptai eskorpisen edwken toiv penhsin h dikaiosunh autou menei eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: (As it is written, He has scattered; he has given to the poor: his righteousness remains forever.
ukjv_translation: (As it is written, He has dispersed abroad; he has given to the poor: his righteousness remains for ever.
review_notes: modernized abroad idiom; modernized forever spelling

greek_text: ο δε επιχορηγων σπερμα τω σπειροντι και αρτον εις βρωσιν χορηγησαι και πληθυναι τον σπορον υμων και αυξησαι τα γεννηματα της δικαιοσυνης υμων
transliteration: o de epicorhgwn sperma tw speironti kai arton eiv brwsin corhghsai kai plhyunai ton sporon umwn kai auxhsai ta gennhmata thv dikaiosunhv umwn
draft_translation: Now may the one who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food supply and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;
ukjv_translation: Now he that ministers seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

greek_text: εν παντι πλουτιζομενοι εις πασαν απλοτητα ητις κατεργαζεται δι ημων ευχαριστιαν τω θεω
transliteration: en panti ploutizomenoi eiv pasan aplothta htiv katergazetai di hmwn eucaristian tw yew
draft_translation: Being enriched in everything to all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving to God.
ukjv_translation: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving to God.

greek_text: οτι η διακονια της λειτουργιας ταυτης ου μονον εστιν προσαναπληρουσα τα υστερηματα των αγιων αλλα και περισσευουσα δια πολλων ευχαριστιων τω θεω
transliteration: oti h diakonia thv leitourgiav tauthv ou monon estin prosanaplhrousa ta usterhmata twn agiwn alla kai perisseuousa dia pollwn eucaristiwn tw yew
draft_translation: For the administration of this service not only supplies the lack of the holy ones, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings to God;
ukjv_translation: For the administration of this service not only supplies the lack of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: δια της δοκιμης της διακονιας ταυτης δοξαζοντες τον θεον επι τη υποταγη της ομολογιας υμων εις το ευαγγελιον του χριστου και απλοτητι της κοινωνιας εις αυτους και εις παντας
transliteration: dia thv dokimhv thv diakoniav tauthv doxazontev ton yeon epi th upotagh thv omologiav umwn eiv to euaggelion tou cristou kai aplothti thv koinwniav eiv autouv kai eiv pantav
draft_translation: While by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection to the good news of Christ, and for your liberal distribution to them, and to all men;
ukjv_translation: While by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και αυτων δεησει υπερ υμων επιποθουντων υμας δια την υπερβαλλουσαν χαριν του θεου εφ υμιν
transliteration: kai autwn dehsei uper umwn epipoyountwn umav dia thn uperballousan carin tou yeou ef umin
draft_translation: and in their prayer for you, longing for you because of the surpassing grace of God upon you.
ukjv_translation: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

greek_text: χαρις δε τω θεω επι τη ανεκδιηγητω αυτου δωρεα
transliteration: cariv de tw yew epi th anekdihghtw autou dwrea
draft_translation: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.
ukjv_translation: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

greek_text: αυτος δε εγω παυλος παρακαλω υμας δια της πραοτητος και επιεικειας του χριστου ος κατα προσωπον μεν ταπεινος εν υμιν απων δε θαρρω εις υμας
transliteration: autov de egw paulov parakalw umav dia thv praothtov kai epieikeiav tou cristou ov kata proswpon men tapeinov en umin apwn de yarrw eiv umav
draft_translation: Now I Paul myself plead with you through the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in person am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
ukjv_translation: Now I Paul myself plead to you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

greek_text: δεομαι δε το μη παρων θαρρησαι τη πεποιθησει η λογιζομαι τολμησαι επι τινας τους λογιζομενους ημας ως κατα σαρκα περιπατουντας
transliteration: deomai de to mh parwn yarrhsai th pepoiyhsei h logizomai tolmhsai epi tinav touv logizomenouv hmav wv kata sarka peripatountav
draft_translation: But I plead to you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, with which I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
ukjv_translation: But I plead to you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

greek_text: εν σαρκι γαρ περιπατουντες ου κατα σαρκα στρατευομεθα
transliteration: en sarki gar peripatountev ou kata sarka strateuomeya
draft_translation: For though we walk in flesh, we do not wage war according to flesh:
ukjv_translation: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

greek_text: τα γαρ οπλα της στρατειας ημων ου σαρκικα αλλα δυνατα τω θεω προς καθαιρεσιν οχυρωματων
transliteration: ta gar opla thv strateiav hmwn ou sarkika alla dunata tw yew prov kayairesin ocurwmatwn
draft_translation: For the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but powerful by God for pulling down strongholds;
ukjv_translation: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

greek_text: λογισμους καθαιρουντες και παν υψωμα επαιρομενον κατα της γνωσεως του θεου και αιχμαλωτιζοντες παν νοημα εις την υπακοην του χριστου
transliteration: logismouv kayairountev kai pan uqwma epairomenon kata thv gnwsewv tou yeou kai aicmalwtizontev pan nohma eiv thn upakohn tou cristou
draft_translation: casting down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ;
ukjv_translation: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

greek_text: και εν ετοιμω εχοντες εκδικησαι πασαν παρακοην οταν πληρωθη υμων η υπακοη
transliteration: kai en etoimw econtev ekdikhsai pasan parakohn otan plhrwyh umwn h upakoh
draft_translation: and being ready to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience is completed.
ukjv_translation: And being alert to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

greek_text: τα κατα προσωπον βλεπετε ει τις πεποιθεν εαυτω χριστου ειναι τουτο λογιζεσθω παλιν αφ εαυτου οτι καθως αυτος χριστου ουτως και ημεις χριστου
transliteration: ta kata proswpon blepete ei tiv pepoiyen eautw cristou einai touto logizesyw palin af eautou oti kaywv autov cristou outwv kai hmeiv cristou
draft_translation: Do you look on things after the outward appearance? If anyone trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
ukjv_translation: Do all of you look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εαν τε γαρ και περισσοτερον τι καυχησωμαι περι της εξουσιας ημων ης εδωκεν ο κυριος ημιν εις οικοδομην και ουκ εις καθαιρεσιν υμων ουκ αισχυνθησομαι
transliteration: ean te gar kai perissoteron ti kauchswmai peri thv exousiav hmwn hv edwken o kuriov hmin eiv oikodomhn kai ouk eiv kayairesin umwn ouk aiscunyhsomai
draft_translation: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord has given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
ukjv_translation: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord has given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

greek_text: ινα μη δοξω ως αν εκφοβειν υμας δια των επιστολων
transliteration: ina mh doxw wv an ekfobein umav dia twn epistolwn
draft_translation: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
ukjv_translation: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: οτι αι μεν επιστολαι φησιν βαρειαι και ισχυραι η δε παρουσια του σωματος ασθενης και ο λογος εξουθενημενος
transliteration: oti ai men epistolai fhsin bareiai kai iscurai h de parousia tou swmatov asyenhv kai o logov exouyenhmenov
draft_translation: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
ukjv_translation: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech (o. logos) contemptible.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τουτο λογιζεσθω ο τοιουτος οτι οιοι εσμεν τω λογω δι επιστολων αποντες τοιουτοι και παροντες τω εργω
transliteration: touto logizesyw o toioutov oti oioi esmen tw logw di epistolwn apontev toioutoi kai parontev tw ergw
draft_translation: Let such a one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
ukjv_translation: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word (o. logos) by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
review_notes: modernized such-an-one idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ου γαρ τολμωμεν εγκριναι η συγκριναι εαυτους τισιν των εαυτους συνιστανοντων αλλα αυτοι εν εαυτοις εαυτους μετρουντες και συγκρινοντες εαυτους εαυτοις ου συνιουσιν
transliteration: ou gar tolmwmen egkrinai h sugkrinai eautouv tisin twn eautouv sunistanontwn alla autoi en eautoiv eautouv metrountev kai sugkrinontev eautouv eautoiv ou suniousin
draft_translation: For we do not dare to class or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves; but they, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, do not understand.
ukjv_translation: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

greek_text: ημεις δε ουχι εις τα αμετρα καυχησομεθα αλλα κατα το μετρον του κανονος ου εμερισεν ημιν ο θεος μετρου εφικεσθαι αχρι και υμων
transliteration: hmeiv de ouci eiv ta ametra kauchsomeya alla kata to metron tou kanonov ou emerisen hmin o yeov metrou efikesyai acri kai umwn
draft_translation: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God has distributed to us, a measure to reach even to you.
ukjv_translation: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God has distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

greek_text: ου γαρ ως μη εφικνουμενοι εις υμας υπερεκτεινομεν εαυτους αχρι γαρ και υμων εφθασαμεν εν τω ευαγγελιω του χριστου
transliteration: ou gar wv mh efiknoumenoi eiv umav uperekteinomen eautouv acri gar kai umwn efyasamen en tw euaggeliw tou cristou
draft_translation: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not to you: for we have come as far as to you also in preaching the good news of Christ:
ukjv_translation: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized are-come perfect; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουκ εις τα αμετρα καυχωμενοι εν αλλοτριοις κοποις ελπιδα δε εχοντες αυξανομενης της πιστεως υμων εν υμιν μεγαλυνθηναι κατα τον κανονα ημων εις περισσειαν
transliteration: ouk eiv ta ametra kaucwmenoi en allotrioiv kopoiv elpida de econtev auxanomenhv thv pistewv umwn en umin megalunyhnai kata ton kanona hmwn eiv perisseian
draft_translation: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labors; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
ukjv_translation: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

greek_text: εις τα υπερεκεινα υμων ευαγγελισασθαι ουκ εν αλλοτριω κανονι εις τα ετοιμα καυχησασθαι
transliteration: eiv ta uperekeina umwn euaggelisasyai ouk en allotriw kanoni eiv ta etoima kauchsasyai
draft_translation: To preach the good news in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
ukjv_translation: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

greek_text: ο δε καυχωμενος εν κυριω καυχασθω
transliteration: o de kaucwmenov en kuriw kaucasyw
draft_translation: But the one who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: But he that glories, let him glory in the Lord.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: ου γαρ ο εαυτον συνιστων εκεινος εστιν δοκιμος αλλ ον ο κυριος συνιστησιν
transliteration: ou gar o eauton sunistwn ekeinov estin dokimov all on o kuriov sunisthsin
draft_translation: For not the one who commends himself is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
ukjv_translation: For not he that commends himself is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οφελον ανειχεσθε μου μικρον τη αφροσυνη αλλα και ανεχεσθε μου
transliteration: ofelon aneicesye mou mikron th afrosunh alla kai anecesye mou
draft_translation: Would to God you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
ukjv_translation: Would to God all of you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

greek_text: ζηλω γαρ υμας θεου ζηλω ηρμοσαμην γαρ υμας ενι ανδρι παρθενον αγνην παραστησαι τω χριστω
