transliteration: zhlw gar umav yeou zhlw hrmosamhn gar umav eni andri paryenon agnhn parasthsai tw cristw
draft_translation: For I am jealous for you with God's jealousy: for I joined you to one husband, to present a pure virgin to Christ.
ukjv_translation: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

greek_text: φοβουμαι δε μηπως ως ο οφις ευαν εξηπατησεν εν τη πανουργια αυτου ουτως φθαρη τα νοηματα υμων απο της απλοτητος της εις τον χριστον
transliteration: foboumai de mhpwv wv o ofiv euan exhpathsen en th panourgia autou outwv fyarh ta nohmata umwn apo thv aplothtov thv eiv ton criston
draft_translation: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent misled Eve through his craftiness, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
ukjv_translation: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent misled Eve through his subtlety, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

greek_text: ει μεν γαρ ο ερχομενος αλλον ιησουν κηρυσσει ον ουκ εκηρυξαμεν η πνευμα ετερον λαμβανετε ο ουκ ελαβετε η ευαγγελιον ετερον ο ουκ εδεξασθε καλως ηνειχεσθε
transliteration: ei men gar o ercomenov allon ihsoun khrussei on ouk ekhruxamen h pneuma eteron lambanete o ouk elabete h euaggelion eteron o ouk edexasye kalwv hneicesye
draft_translation: For if the one who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if you receive another spirit, which you have not received, or another good news, which you have not accepted, you might well bear with him.
ukjv_translation: For if he that comes preaches another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if all of you receive another spirit, (o. pneuma) which all of you have not received, or another gospel, which all of you have not accepted, all of you might well bear with him.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: λογιζομαι γαρ μηδεν υστερηκεναι των υπερ λιαν αποστολων
transliteration: logizomai gar mhden usterhkenai twn uper lian apostolwn
draft_translation: For I suppose I was not behind the foremost apostles.
ukjv_translation: For I suppose I was not a thing behind the very chiefest apostles.

greek_text: ει δε και ιδιωτης τω λογω αλλ ου τη γνωσει αλλ εν παντι φανερωθεντες εν πασιν εις υμας
transliteration: ei de kai idiwthv tw logw all ou th gnwsei all en panti fanerwyentev en pasin eiv umav
draft_translation: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things.
ukjv_translation: But though I be rude in speech, (o. logos) yet not in knowledge; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: η αμαρτιαν εποιησα εμαυτον ταπεινων ινα υμεις υψωθητε οτι δωρεαν το του θεου ευαγγελιον ευηγγελισαμην υμιν
transliteration: h amartian epoihsa emauton tapeinwn ina umeiv uqwyhte oti dwrean to tou yeou euaggelion euhggelisamhn umin
draft_translation: Have I committed an offense in abasing myself that you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the good news of God freely?
ukjv_translation: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that all of you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
review_notes: modernized offence spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αλλας εκκλησιας εσυλησα λαβων οψωνιον προς την υμων διακονιαν
transliteration: allav ekklhsiav esulhsa labwn oqwnion prov thn umwn diakonian
draft_translation: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages of them, to do you service.
ukjv_translation: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

greek_text: και παρων προς υμας και υστερηθεις ου κατεναρκησα ουδενος το γαρ υστερημα μου προσανεπληρωσαν οι αδελφοι ελθοντες απο μακεδονιας και εν παντι αβαρη υμιν εμαυτον ετηρησα και τηρησω
transliteration: kai parwn prov umav kai usterhyeiv ou katenarkhsa oudenov to gar usterhma mou prosaneplhrwsan oi adelfoi elyontev apo makedoniav kai en panti abarh umin emauton ethrhsa kai thrhsw
draft_translation: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no one: for that which was lacking to me the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome to you, and so will I keep myself.
ukjv_translation: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized no-man idiom; modernized personal which as who; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: εστιν αληθεια χριστου εν εμοι οτι η καυχησις αυτη ου φραγησεται εις εμε εν τοις κλιμασιν της αχαιας
transliteration: estin alhyeia cristou en emoi oti h kauchsiv auth ou fraghsetai eiv eme en toiv klimasin thv acaiav
draft_translation: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
ukjv_translation: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

greek_text: δια τι οτι ουκ αγαπω υμας ο θεος οιδεν
transliteration: dia ti oti ouk agapw umav o yeov oiden
draft_translation: Therefore? because I love you not? God knows.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knows.

greek_text: ο δε ποιω και ποιησω ινα εκκοψω την αφορμην των θελοντων αφορμην ινα εν ω καυχωνται ευρεθωσιν καθως και ημεις
transliteration: o de poiw kai poihsw ina ekkoqw thn aformhn twn yelontwn aformhn ina en w kaucwntai eureywsin kaywv kai hmeiv
draft_translation: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from those who desire occasion; that in which they glory, they may be found even as we.
ukjv_translation: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

greek_text: οι γαρ τοιουτοι ψευδαποστολοι εργαται δολιοι μετασχηματιζομενοι εις αποστολους χριστου
transliteration: oi gar toioutoi qeudapostoloi ergatai dolioi metaschmatizomenoi eiv apostolouv cristou
draft_translation: For such ones are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ.
ukjv_translation: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

greek_text: και ου θαυμαστον αυτος γαρ ο σατανας μετασχηματιζεται εις αγγελον φωτος
transliteration: kai ou yaumaston autov gar o satanav metaschmatizetai eiv aggelon fwtov
draft_translation: And no wonder; for Satan himself transforms himself into an angel of light.
ukjv_translation: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

greek_text: ου μεγα ουν ει και οι διακονοι αυτου μετασχηματιζονται ως διακονοι δικαιοσυνης ων το τελος εσται κατα τα εργα αυτων
transliteration: ou mega oun ei kai oi diakonoi autou metaschmatizontai wv diakonoi dikaiosunhv wn to telov estai kata ta erga autwn
draft_translation: Therefore it is no great thing if his servants also transform themselves as servants of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
ukjv_translation: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

greek_text: παλιν λεγω μη τις με δοξη αφρονα ειναι ει δε μη γε καν ως αφρονα δεξασθε με ινα μικρον τι καγω καυχησωμαι
transliteration: palin legw mh tiv me doxh afrona einai ei de mh ge kan wv afrona dexasye me ina mikron ti kagw kauchswmai
draft_translation: I say again, Let no one think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
ukjv_translation: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

greek_text: ο λαλω ου λαλω κατα κυριον αλλ ως εν αφροσυνη εν ταυτη τη υποστασει της καυχησεως
transliteration: o lalw ou lalw kata kurion all wv en afrosunh en tauth th upostasei thv kauchsewv
draft_translation: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
ukjv_translation: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

greek_text: επει πολλοι καυχωνται κατα την σαρκα καγω καυχησομαι
transliteration: epei polloi kaucwntai kata thn sarka kagw kauchsomai
draft_translation: Seeing that many boast according to flesh, I also will boast.
ukjv_translation: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

greek_text: ηδεως γαρ ανεχεσθε των αφρονων φρονιμοι οντες
transliteration: hdewv gar anecesye twn afronwn fronimoi ontev
draft_translation: For you bear with fools gladly, seeing you yourselves are wise.
ukjv_translation: For all of you suffer fools gladly, seeing all of you yourselves are wise.
review_notes: modernized suffer-as-bear-with wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ανεχεσθε γαρ ει τις υμας καταδουλοι ει τις κατεσθιει ει τις λαμβανει ει τις επαιρεται ει τις υμας εις προσωπον δερει
transliteration: anecesye gar ei tiv umav katadouloi ei tiv katesyiei ei tiv lambanei ei tiv epairetai ei tiv umav eiv proswpon derei
draft_translation: For you bear with it, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man strike you on the face.
ukjv_translation: For all of you suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man strike you on the face.
review_notes: modernized suffer-as-bear-with wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: κατα ατιμιαν λεγω ως οτι ημεις ησθενησαμεν εν ω δ αν τις τολμα εν αφροσυνη λεγω τολμω καγω
transliteration: kata atimian legw wv oti hmeiv hsyenhsamen en w d an tiv tolma en afrosunh legw tolmw kagw
draft_translation: I speak according to dishonor, as though we had been weak. But in whatever anyone is bold, I speak in foolishness, I also am bold.
ukjv_translation: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Nevertheless whatever that anyone is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

greek_text: εβραιοι εισιν καγω ισραηλιται εισιν καγω σπερμα αβρααμ εισιν καγω
transliteration: ebraioi eisin kagw israhlitai eisin kagw sperma abraam eisin kagw
draft_translation: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
ukjv_translation: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: διακονοι χριστου εισιν παραφρονων λαλω υπερ εγω εν κοποις περισσοτερως εν πληγαις υπερβαλλοντως εν φυλακαις περισσοτερως εν θανατοις πολλακις
transliteration: diakonoi cristou eisin parafronwn lalw uper egw en kopoiv perissoterwv en plhgaiv uperballontwv en fulakaiv perissoterwv en yanatoiv pollakiv
draft_translation: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labors more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths often.
ukjv_translation: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths often.

greek_text: υπο ιουδαιων πεντακις τεσσαρακοντα παρα μιαν ελαβον
transliteration: upo ioudaiwn pentakiv tessarakonta para mian elabon
draft_translation: By Jews five times I received forty stripes minus one.
ukjv_translation: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

greek_text: τρις ερραβδισθην απαξ ελιθασθην τρις εναυαγησα νυχθημερον εν τω βυθω πεποιηκα
transliteration: triv errabdisyhn apax eliyasyhn triv enauaghsa nucyhmeron en tw buyw pepoihka
draft_translation: Three times I was beaten with rods; once I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked; I have spent a night and a day in the deep;
ukjv_translation: Three times was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, three times I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

greek_text: οδοιποριαις πολλακις κινδυνοις ποταμων κινδυνοις ληστων κινδυνοις εκ γενους κινδυνοις εξ εθνων κινδυνοις εν πολει κινδυνοις εν ερημια κινδυνοις εν θαλασση κινδυνοις εν ψευδαδελφοις
transliteration: odoiporiaiv pollakiv kindunoiv potamwn kindunoiv lhstwn kindunoiv ek genouv kindunoiv ex eynwn kindunoiv en polei kindunoiv en erhmia kindunoiv en yalassh kindunoiv en qeudadelfoiv
draft_translation: In journeys often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by the nations, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brothers;
ukjv_translation: In journeys often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
review_notes: modernized mine-own idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: εν κοπω και μοχθω εν αγρυπνιαις πολλακις εν λιμω και διψει εν νηστειαις πολλακις εν ψυχει και γυμνοτητι
transliteration: en kopw kai mocyw en agrupniaiv pollakiv en limw kai diqei en nhsteiaiv pollakiv en qucei kai gumnothti
draft_translation: In labor and hardship, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
ukjv_translation: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

greek_text: χωρις των παρεκτος η επισυστασις μου η καθ ημεραν η μεριμνα πασων των εκκλησιων
transliteration: cwriv twn parektov h episustasiv mou h kay hmeran h merimna paswn twn ekklhsiwn
draft_translation: Beside those things that are without, that which comes upon me daily, the care of all the assemblies.
ukjv_translation: Beside those things that are without, that which comes upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

greek_text: τις ασθενει και ουκ ασθενω τις σκανδαλιζεται και ουκ εγω πυρουμαι
transliteration: tiv asyenei kai ouk asyenw tiv skandalizetai kai ouk egw puroumai
draft_translation: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is stumbled, and I burn not?
ukjv_translation: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

greek_text: ει καυχασθαι δει τα της ασθενειας μου καυχησομαι
transliteration: ei kaucasyai dei ta thv asyeneiav mou kauchsomai
draft_translation: If I must boast, I will boast in the things of my weakness.
ukjv_translation: If I must essentially glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
review_notes: cleaned must-essentially source artifact; modernized mine before noun; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου οιδεν ο ων ευλογητος εις τους αιωνας οτι ου ψευδομαι
transliteration: o yeov kai pathr tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou oiden o wn euloghtov eiv touv aiwnav oti ou qeudomai
draft_translation: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forevermore, knows that I lie not.
ukjv_translation: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knows that I lie not.
review_notes: modernized forevermore spelling; modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: εν δαμασκω ο εθναρχης αρετα του βασιλεως εφρουρει την δαμασκηνων πολιν πιασαι με θελων
transliteration: en damaskw o eynarchv areta tou basilewv efrourei thn damaskhnwn polin piasai me yelwn
draft_translation: In Damascus, the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of the Damascenes, wanting to seize me:
ukjv_translation: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

greek_text: και δια θυριδος εν σαργανη εχαλασθην δια του τειχους και εξεφυγον τας χειρας αυτου
transliteration: kai dia yuridov en sarganh ecalasyhn dia tou teicouv kai exefugon tav ceirav autou
draft_translation: and through a window I was let down in a basket through the wall, and escaped his hands.
ukjv_translation: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

greek_text: καυχασθαι δη ου συμφερει μοι ελευσομαι γαρ εις οπτασιας και αποκαλυψεις κυριου
transliteration: kaucasyai dh ou sumferei moi eleusomai gar eiv optasiav kai apokaluqeiv kuriou
draft_translation: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
ukjv_translation: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

greek_text: οιδα ανθρωπον εν χριστω προ ετων δεκατεσσαρων ειτε εν σωματι ουκ οιδα ειτε εκτος του σωματος ουκ οιδα ο θεος οιδεν αρπαγεντα τον τοιουτον εως τριτου ουρανου
transliteration: oida anyrwpon en cristw pro etwn dekatessarwn eite en swmati ouk oida eite ektov tou swmatov ouk oida o yeov oiden arpagenta ton toiouton ewv tritou ouranou
draft_translation: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;) such a one caught up to the third heaven.
ukjv_translation: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

greek_text: και οιδα τον τοιουτον ανθρωπον ειτε εν σωματι ειτε εκτος του σωματος ουκ οιδα ο θεος οιδεν
transliteration: kai oida ton toiouton anyrwpon eite en swmati eite ektov tou swmatov ouk oida o yeov oiden
draft_translation: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;)
ukjv_translation: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;)
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: οτι ηρπαγη εις τον παραδεισον και ηκουσεν αρρητα ρηματα α ουκ εξον ανθρωπω λαλησαι
transliteration: oti hrpagh eiv ton paradeison kai hkousen arrhta rhmata a ouk exon anyrwpw lalhsai
draft_translation: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
ukjv_translation: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, (o. rhema) which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: υπερ του τοιουτου καυχησομαι υπερ δε εμαυτου ου καυχησομαι ει μη εν ταις ασθενειαις μου
transliteration: uper tou toioutou kauchsomai uper de emautou ou kauchsomai ei mh en taiv asyeneiaiv mou
draft_translation: Of such a one I will boast; but of myself I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
ukjv_translation: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
review_notes: modernized mine before noun; modernized such-an-one idiom; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: εαν γαρ θελησω καυχησασθαι ουκ εσομαι αφρων αληθειαν γαρ ερω φειδομαι δε μη τις εις εμε λογισηται υπερ ο βλεπει με η ακουει τι εξ εμου
transliteration: ean gar yelhsw kauchsasyai ouk esomai afrwn alhyeian gar erw feidomai de mh tiv eiv eme logishtai uper o blepei me h akouei ti ex emou
draft_translation: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest anyone should think of me above that which he sees me to be, or that he hears of me.
ukjv_translation: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he sees me to be, or that he hears of me.

greek_text: και τη υπερβολη των αποκαλυψεων ινα μη υπεραιρωμαι εδοθη μοι σκολοψ τη σαρκι αγγελος σαταν ινα με κολαφιζη ινα μη υπεραιρωμαι
transliteration: kai th uperbolh twn apokaluqewn ina mh uperairwmai edoyh moi skoloq th sarki aggelov satan ina me kolafizh ina mh uperairwmai
draft_translation: And by the surpassing greatness of the revelations, lest I should be exalted above measure, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan, that he might buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
ukjv_translation: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

greek_text: υπερ τουτου τρις τον κυριον παρεκαλεσα ινα αποστη απ εμου
transliteration: uper toutou triv ton kurion parekalesa ina aposth ap emou
draft_translation: For this thing I begged the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.
ukjv_translation: For this thing I besought the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.
review_notes: modernized besought; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και ειρηκεν μοι αρκει σοι η χαρις μου η γαρ δυναμις μου εν ασθενεια τελειουται ηδιστα ουν μαλλον καυχησομαι εν ταις ασθενειαις μου ινα επισκηνωση επ εμε η δυναμις του χριστου
transliteration: kai eirhken moi arkei soi h cariv mou h gar dunamiv mou en asyeneia teleioutai hdista oun mallon kauchsomai en taiv asyeneiaiv mou ina episkhnwsh ep eme h dunamiv tou cristou
draft_translation: And he said to me, My grace is sufficient for you: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather boast in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
ukjv_translation: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for you: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: διο ευδοκω εν ασθενειαις εν υβρεσιν εν αναγκαις εν διωγμοις εν στενοχωριαις υπερ χριστου οταν γαρ ασθενω τοτε δυνατος ειμι
transliteration: dio eudokw en asyeneiaiv en ubresin en anagkaiv en diwgmoiv en stenocwriaiv uper cristou otan gar asyenw tote dunatov eimi
draft_translation: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ: for when I am weak, then I am strong.
ukjv_translation: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

greek_text: γεγονα αφρων καυχωμενος υμεις με ηναγκασατε εγω γαρ ωφειλον υφ υμων συνιστασθαι ουδεν γαρ υστερησα των υπερ λιαν αποστολων ει και ουδεν ειμι
transliteration: gegona afrwn kaucwmenov umeiv me hnagkasate egw gar wfeilon uf umwn sunistasyai ouden gar usterhsa twn uper lian apostolwn ei kai ouden eimi
draft_translation: I am become a fool in glorying; you have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the foremost apostles, though I be nothing.
ukjv_translation: I am become a fool in glorying; all of you have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
review_notes: modernized chiefest; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τα μεν σημεια του αποστολου κατειργασθη εν υμιν εν παση υπομονη εν σημειοις και τερασιν και δυναμεσιν
transliteration: ta men shmeia tou apostolou kateirgasyh en umin en pash upomonh en shmeioiv kai terasin kai dunamesin
draft_translation: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
ukjv_translation: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

greek_text: τι γαρ εστιν ο ηττηθητε υπερ τας λοιπας εκκλησιας ει μη οτι αυτος εγω ου κατεναρκησα υμων χαρισασθε μοι την αδικιαν ταυτην
transliteration: ti gar estin o htthyhte uper tav loipav ekklhsiav ei mh oti autov egw ou katenarkhsa umwn carisasye moi thn adikian tauthn
draft_translation: For what is it in which you were inferior to other assemblies, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
ukjv_translation: For what is it wherein all of you were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
review_notes: modernized wherein; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ιδου τριτον ετοιμως εχω ελθειν προς υμας και ου καταναρκησω υμων ου γαρ ζητω τα υμων αλλ υμας ου γαρ οφειλει τα τεκνα τοις γονευσιν θησαυριζειν αλλ οι γονεις τοις τεκνοις
transliteration: idou triton etoimwv ecw elyein prov umav kai ou katanarkhsw umwn ou gar zhtw ta umwn all umav ou gar ofeilei ta tekna toiv goneusin yhsaurizein all oi goneiv toiv teknoiv
draft_translation: Look, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
ukjv_translation: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not your's but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
review_notes: modernized behold; modernized possessive pronoun spelling

greek_text: εγω δε ηδιστα δαπανησω και εκδαπανηθησομαι υπερ των ψυχων υμων ει και περισσοτερως υμας αγαπων ηττον αγαπωμαι
transliteration: egw de hdista dapanhsw kai ekdapanhyhsomai uper twn qucwn umwn ei kai perissoterwv umav agapwn htton agapwmai
draft_translation: And I will very gladly spend and be fully spent for your souls; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I am loved.
ukjv_translation: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

greek_text: εστω δε εγω ου κατεβαρησα υμας αλλ υπαρχων πανουργος δολω υμας ελαβον
transliteration: estw de egw ou katebarhsa umav all uparcwn panourgov dolw umav elabon
draft_translation: But be it so, I did not burden you: but, being crafty, I took you by deceit.
ukjv_translation: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

greek_text: μη τινα ων απεσταλκα προς υμας δι αυτου επλεονεκτησα υμας
transliteration: mh tina wn apestalka prov umav di autou epleonekthsa umav
draft_translation: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent to you?
ukjv_translation: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

greek_text: παρεκαλεσα τιτον και συναπεστειλα τον αδελφον μη τι επλεονεκτησεν υμας τιτος ου τω αυτω πνευματι περιεπατησαμεν ου τοις αυτοις ιχνεσιν
transliteration: parekalesa titon kai sunapesteila ton adelfon mh ti epleonekthsen umav titov ou tw autw pneumati periepathsamen ou toiv autoiv icnesin
draft_translation: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
ukjv_translation: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? (o. pneuma) walked we not in the same steps?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παλιν δοκειτε οτι υμιν απολογουμεθα κατενωπιον του θεου εν χριστω λαλουμεν τα δε παντα αγαπητοι υπερ της υμων οικοδομης
transliteration: palin dokeite oti umin apologoumeya katenwpion tou yeou en cristw laloumen ta de panta agaphtoi uper thv umwn oikodomhv
draft_translation: Again, Do you think that we excuse ourselves to you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
ukjv_translation: Again, think all of you that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized inverted question; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: φοβουμαι γαρ μηπως ελθων ουχ οιους θελω ευρω υμας καγω ευρεθω υμιν οιον ου θελετε μηπως ερεις ζηλοι θυμοι εριθειαι καταλαλιαι ψιθυρισμοι φυσιωσεις ακαταστασιαι
transliteration: foboumai gar mhpwv elywn ouc oiouv yelw eurw umav kagw eureyw umin oion ou yelete mhpwv ereiv zhloi yumoi eriyeiai katalaliai qiyurismoi fusiwseiv akatastasiai
draft_translation: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found to you such as you would not: lest there is debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
ukjv_translation: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as all of you would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized there-be idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη παλιν ελθοντα με ταπεινωση ο θεος μου προς υμας και πενθησω πολλους των προημαρτηκοτων και μη μετανοησαντων επι τη ακαθαρσια και πορνεια και ασελγεια η επραξαν
transliteration: mh palin elyonta me tapeinwsh o yeov mou prov umav kai penyhsw pollouv twn prohmarthkotwn kai mh metanohsantwn epi th akayarsia kai porneia kai aselgeia h epraxan
draft_translation: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall mourn for many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lasciviousness which they have committed.
ukjv_translation: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall mourn for many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

greek_text: τριτον τουτο ερχομαι προς υμας επι στοματος δυο μαρτυρων και τριων σταθησεται παν ρημα
transliteration: triton touto ercomai prov umav epi stomatov duo marturwn kai triwn stayhsetai pan rhma
draft_translation: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
ukjv_translation: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word (o. rhema) be established.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: προειρηκα και προλεγω ως παρων το δευτερον και απων νυν γραφω τοις προημαρτηκοσιν και τοις λοιποις πασιν οτι εαν ελθω εις το παλιν ου φεισομαι
transliteration: proeirhka kai prolegw wv parwn to deuteron kai apwn nun grafw toiv prohmarthkosin kai toiv loipoiv pasin oti ean elyw eiv to palin ou feisomai
draft_translation: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to those who in time past have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
ukjv_translation: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which in time past have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

greek_text: επει δοκιμην ζητειτε του εν εμοι λαλουντος χριστου ος εις υμας ουκ ασθενει αλλα δυνατει εν υμιν
transliteration: epei dokimhn zhteite tou en emoi lalountov cristou ov eiv umav ouk asyenei alla dunatei en umin
draft_translation: Since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which toward you is not weak, but is mighty in you.
ukjv_translation: Since all of you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which toward you is not weak, but is mighty in you.

greek_text: και γαρ ει εσταυρωθη εξ ασθενειας αλλα ζη εκ δυναμεως θεου και γαρ και ημεις ασθενουμεν εν αυτω αλλα ζησομεθα συν αυτω εκ δυναμεως θεου εις υμας
transliteration: kai gar ei estaurwyh ex asyeneiav alla zh ek dunamewv yeou kai gar kai hmeiv asyenoumen en autw alla zhsomeya sun autw ek dunamewv yeou eiv umav
draft_translation: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
ukjv_translation: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εαυτους πειραζετε ει εστε εν τη πιστει εαυτους δοκιμαζετε η ουκ επιγινωσκετε εαυτους οτι ιησους χριστος εν υμιν εστιν ει μη τι αδοκιμοι εστε
transliteration: eautouv peirazete ei este en th pistei eautouv dokimazete h ouk epiginwskete eautouv oti ihsouv cristov en umin estin ei mh ti adokimoi este
draft_translation: Examine yourselves, whether you be in the faith; prove your own selves. Do you not know yourselves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except you be reprobates?
ukjv_translation: Examine yourselves, whether all of you be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know all of you not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except all of you be reprobates?
review_notes: modernized know-you-not question; modernized own-selves wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ελπιζω δε οτι γνωσεσθε οτι ημεις ουκ εσμεν αδοκιμοι
transliteration: elpizw de oti gnwsesye oti hmeiv ouk esmen adokimoi
draft_translation: But I trust that you shall know that we are not reprobates.
ukjv_translation: But I trust that all of you shall know that we are not reprobates.

greek_text: ευχομαι δε προς τον θεον μη ποιησαι υμας κακον μηδεν ουχ ινα ημεις δοκιμοι φανωμεν αλλ ινα υμεις το καλον ποιητε ημεις δε ως αδοκιμοι ωμεν
transliteration: eucomai de prov ton yeon mh poihsai umav kakon mhden ouc ina hmeiv dokimoi fanwmen all ina umeiv to kalon poihte hmeiv de wv adokimoi wmen
draft_translation: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that you should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
ukjv_translation: Now I pray to God that all of you do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that all of you should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

greek_text: ου γαρ δυναμεθα τι κατα της αληθειας αλλ υπερ της αληθειας
transliteration: ou gar dunameya ti kata thv alhyeiav all uper thv alhyeiav
draft_translation: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
ukjv_translation: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: χαιρομεν γαρ οταν ημεις ασθενωμεν υμεις δε δυνατοι ητε τουτο δε και ευχομεθα την υμων καταρτισιν
transliteration: cairomen gar otan hmeiv asyenwmen umeiv de dunatoi hte touto de kai eucomeya thn umwn katartisin
draft_translation: For we are glad, when we are weak, and you are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
ukjv_translation: For we are glad, when we are weak, and all of you are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

greek_text: δια τουτο ταυτα απων γραφω ινα παρων μη αποτομως χρησωμαι κατα την εξουσιαν ην εδωκεν μοι ο κυριος εις οικοδομην και ουκ εις καθαιρεσιν
transliteration: dia touto tauta apwn grafw ina parwn mh apotomwv crhswmai kata thn exousian hn edwken moi o kuriov eiv oikodomhn kai ouk eiv kayairesin
draft_translation: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord has given me to edification, and not to destruction.
ukjv_translation: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord has given me to edification, and not to destruction.

greek_text: λοιπον αδελφοι χαιρετε καταρτιζεσθε παρακαλεισθε το αυτο φρονειτε ειρηνευετε και ο θεος της αγαπης και ειρηνης εσται μεθ υμων
transliteration: loipon adelfoi cairete katartizesye parakaleisye to auto froneite eirhneuete kai o yeov thv agaphv kai eirhnhv estai mey umwn
draft_translation: Finally, brothers, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
ukjv_translation: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love (o. agape) and peace shall be with you.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ασπασασθε αλληλους εν αγιω φιληματι
transliteration: aspasasye allhlouv en agiw filhmati
draft_translation: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
ukjv_translation: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

greek_text: ασπαζονται υμας οι αγιοι παντες
transliteration: aspazontai umav oi agioi pantev
draft_translation: All the holy ones salute you.
ukjv_translation: All the saints salute you.

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ιησου χριστου και η αγαπη του θεου και η κοινωνια του αγιου πνευματος μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou ihsou cristou kai h agaph tou yeou kai h koinwnia tou agiou pneumatov meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love (o. agape) of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) be with you all. Amen.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παυλος αποστολος ουκ απ ανθρωπων ουδε δι ανθρωπου αλλα δια ιησου χριστου και θεου πατρος του εγειραντος αυτον εκ νεκρων
transliteration: paulov apostolov ouk ap anyrwpwn oude di anyrwpou alla dia ihsou cristou kai yeou patrov tou egeirantov auton ek nekrwn
draft_translation: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
ukjv_translation: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και οι συν εμοι παντες αδελφοι ταις εκκλησιαις της γαλατιας
transliteration: kai oi sun emoi pantev adelfoi taiv ekklhsiaiv thv galatiav
draft_translation: And all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
ukjv_translation: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
review_notes: fixed brothers casing; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov kai kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
ukjv_translation: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

greek_text: του δοντος εαυτον υπερ των αμαρτιων ημων οπως εξεληται ημας εκ του ενεστωτος αιωνος πονηρου κατα το θελημα του θεου και πατρος ημων
transliteration: tou dontov eauton uper twn amartiwn hmwn opwv exelhtai hmav ek tou enestwtov aiwnov ponhrou kata to yelhma tou yeou kai patrov hmwn
draft_translation: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father:
ukjv_translation: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

greek_text: ω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
transliteration: w h doxa eiv touv aiwnav twn aiwnwn amhn
draft_translation: To whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

greek_text: θαυμαζω οτι ουτως ταχεως μετατιθεσθε απο του καλεσαντος υμας εν χαριτι χριστου εις ετερον ευαγγελιον
transliteration: yaumazw oti outwv tacewv metatiyesye apo tou kalesantov umav en cariti cristou eiv eteron euaggelion
draft_translation: I marvel that you are so soon removed from him who called you into the grace of Christ to another good news:
ukjv_translation: I marvel that all of you are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ο ουκ εστιν αλλο ει μη τινες εισιν οι ταρασσοντες υμας και θελοντες μεταστρεψαι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου
transliteration: o ouk estin allo ei mh tinev eisin oi tarassontev umav kai yelontev metastreqai to euaggelion tou cristou
draft_translation: Which is not another; but there is some that trouble you, and would pervert the good news of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
review_notes: modernized there-be idiom; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αλλα και εαν ημεις η αγγελος εξ ουρανου ευαγγελιζηται υμιν παρ ο ευηγγελισαμεθα υμιν αναθεμα εστω
transliteration: alla kai ean hmeiv h aggelov ex ouranou euaggelizhtai umin par o euhggelisameya umin anayema estw
draft_translation: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other good news to you than that which we have preached to you, let him be accursed.
ukjv_translation: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ως προειρηκαμεν και αρτι παλιν λεγω ει τις υμας ευαγγελιζεται παρ ο παρελαβετε αναθεμα εστω
transliteration: wv proeirhkamen kai arti palin legw ei tiv umav euaggelizetai par o parelabete anayema estw
draft_translation: As we said before, so say I now again, if anyone preach any other good news to you than that you have received, let him be accursed.
ukjv_translation: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that all of you have received, let him be accursed.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αρτι γαρ ανθρωπους πειθω η τον θεον η ζητω ανθρωποις αρεσκειν ει γαρ ετι ανθρωποις ηρεσκον χριστου δουλος ουκ αν ημην
transliteration: arti gar anyrwpouv peiyw h ton yeon h zhtw anyrwpoiv areskein ei gar eti anyrwpoiv hreskon cristou doulov ouk an hmhn
draft_translation: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the slave of Christ.
ukjv_translation: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

greek_text: γνωριζω δε υμιν αδελφοι το ευαγγελιον το ευαγγελισθεν υπ εμου οτι ουκ εστιν κατα ανθρωπον
transliteration: gnwrizw de umin adelfoi to euaggelion to euaggelisyen up emou oti ouk estin kata anyrwpon
draft_translation: But I certify you, brothers, that the good news which was preached of me is not after man.
ukjv_translation: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
review_notes: rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουδε γαρ εγω παρα ανθρωπου παρελαβον αυτο ουτε εδιδαχθην αλλα δι αποκαλυψεως ιησου χριστου
transliteration: oude gar egw para anyrwpou parelabon auto oute edidacyhn alla di apokaluqewv ihsou cristou
draft_translation: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but by revelation of Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

greek_text: ηκουσατε γαρ την εμην αναστροφην ποτε εν τω ιουδαισμω οτι καθ υπερβολην εδιωκον την εκκλησιαν του θεου και επορθουν αυτην
transliteration: hkousate gar thn emhn anastrofhn pote en tw ioudaismw oti kay uperbolhn ediwkon thn ekklhsian tou yeou kai eporyoun authn
draft_translation: For you have heard of my conduct in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and wasted it:
ukjv_translation: For all of you have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
review_notes: modernized conversation as conduct; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και προεκοπτον εν τω ιουδαισμω υπερ πολλους συνηλικιωτας εν τω γενει μου περισσοτερως ζηλωτης υπαρχων των πατρικων μου παραδοσεων
transliteration: kai proekopton en tw ioudaismw uper pollouv sunhlikiwtav en tw genei mou perissoterwv zhlwthv uparcwn twn patrikwn mou paradosewn
draft_translation: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
ukjv_translation: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

greek_text: οτε δε ευδοκησεν ο θεος ο αφορισας με εκ κοιλιας μητρος μου και καλεσας δια της χαριτος αυτου
transliteration: ote de eudokhsen o yeov o aforisav me ek koiliav mhtrov mou kai kalesav dia thv caritov autou
draft_translation: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
ukjv_translation: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αποκαλυψαι τον υιον αυτου εν εμοι ινα ευαγγελιζωμαι αυτον εν τοις εθνεσιν ευθεως ου προσανεθεμην σαρκι και αιματι
transliteration: apokaluqai ton uion autou en emoi ina euaggelizwmai auton en toiv eynesin euyewv ou prosaneyemhn sarki kai aimati
draft_translation: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the nations; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
ukjv_translation: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

greek_text: ουδε ανηλθον εις ιεροσολυμα προς τους προ εμου αποστολους αλλ απηλθον εις αραβιαν και παλιν υπεστρεψα εις δαμασκον
transliteration: oude anhlyon eiv ierosoluma prov touv pro emou apostolouv all aphlyon eiv arabian kai palin upestreqa eiv damaskon
draft_translation: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.
ukjv_translation: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-which relative

greek_text: επειτα μετα ετη τρια ανηλθον εις ιεροσολυμα ιστορησαι πετρον και επεμεινα προς αυτον ημερας δεκαπεντε
transliteration: epeita meta eth tria anhlyon eiv ierosoluma istorhsai petron kai epemeina prov auton hmerav dekapente
draft_translation: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and remained with him fifteen days.
ukjv_translation: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

greek_text: ετερον δε των αποστολων ουκ ειδον ει μη ιακωβον τον αδελφον του κυριου
transliteration: eteron de twn apostolwn ouk eidon ei mh iakwbon ton adelfon tou kuriou
draft_translation: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
ukjv_translation: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

greek_text: α δε γραφω υμιν ιδου ενωπιον του θεου οτι ου ψευδομαι
transliteration: a de grafw umin idou enwpion tou yeou oti ou qeudomai
draft_translation: Now the things which I write to you, look, before God, I lie not.
ukjv_translation: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold

greek_text: επειτα ηλθον εις τα κλιματα της συριας και της κιλικιας
transliteration: epeita hlyon eiv ta klimata thv suriav kai thv kilikiav
draft_translation: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
ukjv_translation: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ημην δε αγνοουμενος τω προσωπω ταις εκκλησιαις της ιουδαιας ταις εν χριστω
transliteration: hmhn de agnooumenov tw proswpw taiv ekklhsiaiv thv ioudaiav taiv en cristw
draft_translation: And was unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ:
ukjv_translation: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: μονον δε ακουοντες ησαν οτι ο διωκων ημας ποτε νυν ευαγγελιζεται την πιστιν ην ποτε επορθει
transliteration: monon de akouontev hsan oti o diwkwn hmav pote nun euaggelizetai thn pistin hn pote eporyei
draft_translation: But they had heard only, That the one who persecuted us in times past now preaches the faith which once he destroyed.
ukjv_translation: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preaches the faith which once he destroyed.

greek_text: και εδοξαζον εν εμοι τον θεον
transliteration: kai edoxazon en emoi ton yeon
draft_translation: And they glorified God in me.
ukjv_translation: And they glorified God in me.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: επειτα δια δεκατεσσαρων ετων παλιν ανεβην εις ιεροσολυμα μετα βαρναβα συμπαραλαβων και τιτον
transliteration: epeita dia dekatessarwn etwn palin anebhn eiv ierosoluma meta barnaba sumparalabwn kai titon
draft_translation: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
ukjv_translation: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

greek_text: ανεβην δε κατα αποκαλυψιν και ανεθεμην αυτοις το ευαγγελιον ο κηρυσσω εν τοις εθνεσιν κατ ιδιαν δε τοις δοκουσιν μηπως εις κενον τρεχω η εδραμον
transliteration: anebhn de kata apokaluqin kai aneyemhn autoiv to euaggelion o khrussw en toiv eynesin kat idian de toiv dokousin mhpwv eiv kenon trecw h edramon
draft_translation: And I went up by revelation, and communicated to those who good news which I preach among the nations, but privately to those who were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
ukjv_translation: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; modernized them-which relative; rendered ethne as nations; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αλλ ουδε τιτος ο συν εμοι ελλην ων ηναγκασθη περιτμηθηναι
transliteration: all oude titov o sun emoi ellhn wn hnagkasyh peritmhyhnai
draft_translation: But not even Titus, who was with me, being Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
ukjv_translation: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

greek_text: δια δε τους παρεισακτους ψευδαδελφους οιτινες παρεισηλθον κατασκοπησαι την ελευθεριαν ημων ην εχομεν εν χριστω ιησου ινα ημας καταδουλωσωνται
transliteration: dia de touv pareisaktouv qeudadelfouv oitinev pareishlyon kataskophsai thn eleuyerian hmwn hn ecomen en cristw ihsou ina hmav katadoulwswntai
draft_translation: And that because of false brothers unexpectedly brought in, who came in privately to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
ukjv_translation: And that because of false brethren unexpectedly brought in, who came in privately to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

greek_text: οις ουδε προς ωραν ειξαμεν τη υποταγη ινα η αληθεια του ευαγγελιου διαμεινη προς υμας
transliteration: oiv oude prov wran eixamen th upotagh ina h alhyeia tou euaggeliou diameinh prov umav
draft_translation: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the good news might continue with you.
ukjv_translation: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

greek_text: απο δε των δοκουντων ειναι τι οποιοι ποτε ησαν ουδεν μοι διαφερει προσωπον θεος ανθρωπου ου λαμβανει εμοι γαρ οι δοκουντες ουδεν προσανεθεντο
transliteration: apo de twn dokountwn einai ti opoioi pote hsan ouden moi diaferei proswpon yeov anyrwpou ou lambanei emoi gar oi dokountev ouden prosaneyento
draft_translation: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatever they were, it makes no matter to me: God accepts no one's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
ukjv_translation: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it makes no matter to me: God accepts no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

greek_text: αλλα τουναντιον ιδοντες οτι πεπιστευμαι το ευαγγελιον της ακροβυστιας καθως πετρος της περιτομης
transliteration: alla tounantion idontev oti pepisteumai to euaggelion thv akrobustiav kaywv petrov thv peritomhv
draft_translation: But contrariwise, when they saw that the good news of the uncircumcision was committed to me, as the good news of the circumcision was to Peter;
ukjv_translation: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ο γαρ ενεργησας πετρω εις αποστολην της περιτομης ενηργησεν και εμοι εις τα εθνη
transliteration: o gar energhsav petrw eiv apostolhn thv peritomhv enhrghsen kai emoi eiv ta eynh
draft_translation: (For the one who worked effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the nations:)
ukjv_translation: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized wrought; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και γνοντες την χαριν την δοθεισαν μοι ιακωβος και κηφας και ιωαννης οι δοκουντες στυλοι ειναι δεξιας εδωκαν εμοι και βαρναβα κοινωνιας ινα ημεις εις τα εθνη αυτοι δε εις την περιτομην
transliteration: kai gnontev thn carin thn doyeisan moi iakwbov kai khfav kai iwannhv oi dokountev stuloi einai dexiav edwkan emoi kai barnaba koinwniav ina hmeiv eiv ta eynh autoi de eiv thn peritomhn
draft_translation: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go to the nations, and they to the circumcision.
ukjv_translation: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: μονον των πτωχων ινα μνημονευωμεν ο και εσπουδασα αυτο τουτο ποιησαι
transliteration: monon twn ptwcwn ina mnhmoneuwmen o kai espoudasa auto touto poihsai
draft_translation: Only that we should remember the poor, the very thing I also was eager to do.
ukjv_translation: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

greek_text: οτε δε ηλθεν πετρος εις αντιοχειαν κατα προσωπον αυτω αντεστην οτι κατεγνωσμενος ην
transliteration: ote de hlyen petrov eiv antioceian kata proswpon autw antesthn oti kategnwsmenov hn
draft_translation: But when Peter had come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
ukjv_translation: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

greek_text: προ του γαρ ελθειν τινας απο ιακωβου μετα των εθνων συνησθιεν οτε δε ηλθον υπεστελλεν και αφωριζεν εαυτον φοβουμενος τους εκ περιτομης
transliteration: pro tou gar elyein tinav apo iakwbou meta twn eynwn sunhsyien ote de hlyon upestellen kai afwrizen eauton foboumenov touv ek peritomhv
draft_translation: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the nations: but when they had come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
ukjv_translation: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
review_notes: modernized them-which relative; modernized were-come perfect; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και συνυπεκριθησαν αυτω και οι λοιποι ιουδαιοι ωστε και βαρναβας συναπηχθη αυτων τη υποκρισει
transliteration: kai sunupekriyhsan autw kai oi loipoi ioudaioi wste kai barnabav sunaphcyh autwn th upokrisei
draft_translation: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; so that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
ukjv_translation: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

greek_text: αλλ οτε ειδον οτι ουκ ορθοποδουσιν προς την αληθειαν του ευαγγελιου ειπον τω πετρω εμπροσθεν παντων ει συ ιουδαιος υπαρχων εθνικως ζης και ουκ ιουδαικως τι τα εθνη αναγκαζεις ιουδαιζειν
transliteration: all ote eidon oti ouk oryopodousin prov thn alhyeian tou euaggeliou eipon tw petrw emprosyen pantwn ei su ioudaiov uparcwn eynikwv zhv kai ouk ioudaikwv ti ta eynh anagkazeiv ioudaizein
draft_translation: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the good news, I said to Peter before them all, If you, being a Jew, live after the manner of nations, and not as do the Jews, why compell you the nations to live as do the Jews?
ukjv_translation: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If you, being a Jew, live after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compell you the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ημεις φυσει ιουδαιοι και ουκ εξ εθνων αμαρτωλοι
transliteration: hmeiv fusei ioudaioi kai ouk ex eynwn amartwloi
draft_translation: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the nations,
ukjv_translation: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι ου δικαιουται ανθρωπος εξ εργων νομου εαν μη δια πιστεως ιησου χριστου και ημεις εις χριστον ιησουν επιστευσαμεν ινα δικαιωθωμεν εκ πιστεως χριστου και ουκ εξ εργων νομου διοτι ου δικαιωθησεται εξ εργων νομου πασα σαρξ
transliteration: eidotev oti ou dikaioutai anyrwpov ex ergwn nomou ean mh dia pistewv ihsou cristou kai hmeiv eiv criston ihsoun episteusamen ina dikaiwywmen ek pistewv cristou kai ouk ex ergwn nomou dioti ou dikaiwyhsetai ex ergwn nomou pasa sarx
draft_translation: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ει δε ζητουντες δικαιωθηναι εν χριστω ευρεθημεν και αυτοι αμαρτωλοι αρα χριστος αμαρτιας διακονος μη γενοιτο
transliteration: ei de zhtountev dikaiwyhnai en cristw eureyhmen kai autoi amartwloi ara cristov amartiav diakonov mh genoito
draft_translation: But if, while seeking to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, then is Christ a servant of sin? May it not be.
ukjv_translation: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

greek_text: ει γαρ α κατελυσα ταυτα παλιν οικοδομω παραβατην εμαυτον συνιστημι
transliteration: ei gar a katelusa tauta palin oikodomw parabathn emauton sunisthmi
draft_translation: For if I build again the things that I destroyed, I establish myself as a transgressor.
ukjv_translation: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

greek_text: εγω γαρ δια νομου νομω απεθανον ινα θεω ζησω
transliteration: egw gar dia nomou nomw apeyanon ina yew zhsw
draft_translation: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live to God.
ukjv_translation: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

greek_text: χριστω συνεσταυρωμαι ζω δε ουκετι εγω ζη δε εν εμοι χριστος ο δε νυν ζω εν σαρκι εν πιστει ζω τη του υιου του θεου του αγαπησαντος με και παραδοντος εαυτον υπερ εμου
transliteration: cristw sunestaurwmai zw de ouketi egw zh de en emoi cristov o de nun zw en sarki en pistei zw th tou uiou tou yeou tou agaphsantov me kai paradontov eauton uper emou
draft_translation: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ lives in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
ukjv_translation: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ lives in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ουκ αθετω την χαριν του θεου ει γαρ δια νομου δικαιοσυνη αρα χριστος δωρεαν απεθανεν
transliteration: ouk ayetw thn carin tou yeou ei gar dia nomou dikaiosunh ara cristov dwrean apeyanen
draft_translation: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
ukjv_translation: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ω ανοητοι γαλαται τις υμας εβασκανεν τη αληθεια μη πειθεσθαι οις κατ οφθαλμους ιησους χριστος προεγραφη εν υμιν εσταυρωμενος
transliteration: w anohtoi galatai tiv umav ebaskanen th alhyeia mh peiyesyai oiv kat ofyalmouv ihsouv cristov proegrafh en umin estaurwmenov
draft_translation: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, that you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ has been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
ukjv_translation: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, that all of you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ has been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

greek_text: τουτο μονον θελω μαθειν αφ υμων εξ εργων νομου το πνευμα ελαβετε η εξ ακοης πιστεως
transliteration: touto monon yelw mayein af umwn ex ergwn nomou to pneuma elabete h ex akohv pistewv
draft_translation: This only would I learn of you, Received you the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
ukjv_translation: This only would I learn of you, Received all of you the Spirit (o. pneuma) by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουτως ανοητοι εστε εναρξαμενοι πνευματι νυν σαρκι επιτελεισθε
transliteration: outwv anohtoi este enarxamenoi pneumati nun sarki epiteleisye
draft_translation: Are you so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are you now made perfect by the flesh?
ukjv_translation: Are all of you so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) are all of you now made perfect by the flesh?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τοσαυτα επαθετε εικη ειγε και εικη
transliteration: tosauta epayete eikh eige kai eikh
draft_translation: Have you suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
ukjv_translation: Have all of you suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

greek_text: ο ουν επιχορηγων υμιν το πνευμα και ενεργων δυναμεις εν υμιν εξ εργων νομου η εξ ακοης πιστεως
transliteration: o oun epicorhgwn umin to pneuma kai energwn dunameiv en umin ex ergwn nomou h ex akohv pistewv
draft_translation: He therefore that supplies to you the Spirit, and works miracles among you, does he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
ukjv_translation: He therefore that ministers to you the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and works miracles among you, does he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered epichoregeo as supply

greek_text: καθως αβρααμ επιστευσεν τω θεω και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
transliteration: kaywv abraam episteusen tw yew kai elogisyh autw eiv dikaiosunhn
draft_translation: Just as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness.
ukjv_translation: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

greek_text: γινωσκετε αρα οτι οι εκ πιστεως ουτοι εισιν υιοι αβρααμ
transliteration: ginwskete ara oti oi ek pistewv outoi eisin uioi abraam
draft_translation: Know you therefore that those who are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
ukjv_translation: Know all of you therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
review_notes: modernized they-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: προιδουσα δε η γραφη οτι εκ πιστεως δικαιοι τα εθνη ο θεος προευηγγελισατο τω αβρααμ οτι ευλογηθησονται εν σοι παντα τα εθνη
transliteration: proidousa de h grafh oti ek pistewv dikaioi ta eynh o yeov proeuhggelisato tw abraam oti euloghyhsontai en soi panta ta eynh
draft_translation: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the nations through faith, preached before the good news to Abraham, saying, In you shall all nations be blessed.
ukjv_translation: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In you shall all nations be blessed.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ωστε οι εκ πιστεως ευλογουνται συν τω πιστω αβρααμ
transliteration: wste oi ek pistewv eulogountai sun tw pistw abraam
draft_translation: So then those who are of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
ukjv_translation: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; modernized they-which relative

greek_text: οσοι γαρ εξ εργων νομου εισιν υπο καταραν εισιν γεγραπται γαρ επικαταρατος πας ος ουκ εμμενει εν πασιν τοις γεγραμμενοις εν τω βιβλιω του νομου του ποιησαι αυτα
transliteration: osoi gar ex ergwn nomou eisin upo kataran eisin gegraptai gar epikataratov pav ov ouk emmenei en pasin toiv gegrammenoiv en tw bibliw tou nomou tou poihsai auta
draft_translation: For as many as are from works of law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is everyone who does not continue in all things written in the book of the law, to do them.
ukjv_translation: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continues not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

greek_text: οτι δε εν νομω ουδεις δικαιουται παρα τω θεω δηλον οτι ο δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται
transliteration: oti de en nomw oudeiv dikaioutai para tw yew dhlon oti o dikaiov ek pistewv zhsetai
draft_translation: But that no one is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
ukjv_translation: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

greek_text: ο δε νομος ουκ εστιν εκ πιστεως αλλ ο ποιησας αυτα ανθρωπος ζησεται εν αυτοις
transliteration: o de nomov ouk estin ek pistewv all o poihsav auta anyrwpov zhsetai en autoiv
draft_translation: And the law is not from faith: but, The man who does them shall live in them.
ukjv_translation: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that does them shall live in them.

greek_text: χριστος ημας εξηγορασεν εκ της καταρας του νομου γενομενος υπερ ημων καταρα γεγραπται γαρ επικαταρατος πας ο κρεμαμενος επι ξυλου
transliteration: cristov hmav exhgorasen ek thv katarav tou nomou genomenov uper hmwn katara gegraptai gar epikataratov pav o kremamenov epi xulou
draft_translation: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree:
ukjv_translation: Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangs on a tree:

greek_text: ινα εις τα εθνη η ευλογια του αβρααμ γενηται εν χριστω ιησου ινα την επαγγελιαν του πνευματος λαβωμεν δια της πιστεως
transliteration: ina eiv ta eynh h eulogia tou abraam genhtai en cristw ihsou ina thn epaggelian tou pneumatov labwmen dia thv pistewv
draft_translation: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the nations through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
ukjv_translation: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit (o. pneuma) through faith.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: αδελφοι κατα ανθρωπον λεγω ομως ανθρωπου κεκυρωμενην διαθηκην ουδεις αθετει η επιδιατασσεται
transliteration: adelfoi kata anyrwpon legw omwv anyrwpou kekurwmenhn diayhkhn oudeiv ayetei h epidiatassetai
draft_translation: Brothers, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no one nullifies, or adds thereto.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man nullifies, or adds thereto.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: τω δε αβρααμ ερρηθησαν αι επαγγελιαι και τω σπερματι αυτου ου λεγει και τοις σπερμασιν ως επι πολλων αλλ ως εφ ενος και τω σπερματι σου ος εστιν χριστος
transliteration: tw de abraam errhyhsan ai epaggeliai kai tw spermati autou ou legei kai toiv spermasin wv epi pollwn all wv ef enov kai tw spermati sou ov estin cristov
draft_translation: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He does not say, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to your seed, which is Christ.
ukjv_translation: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He says not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to your seed, which is Christ.

greek_text: τουτο δε λεγω διαθηκην προκεκυρωμενην υπο του θεου εις χριστον ο μετα ετη τετρακοσια και τριακοντα γεγονως νομος ουκ ακυροι εις το καταργησαι την επαγγελιαν
transliteration: touto de legw diayhkhn prokekurwmenhn upo tou yeou eiv criston o meta eth tetrakosia kai triakonta gegonwv nomov ouk akuroi eiv to katarghsai thn epaggelian
draft_translation: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot nullify, that it should make the promise of no effect.
ukjv_translation: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot nullify, that it should make the promise of no effect.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ει γαρ εκ νομου η κληρονομια ουκετι εξ επαγγελιας τω δε αβρααμ δι επαγγελιας κεχαρισται ο θεος
transliteration: ei gar ek nomou h klhronomia ouketi ex epaggeliav tw de abraam di epaggeliav kecaristai o yeov
draft_translation: For if the inheritance is from law, it is no longer from promise: but God has graciously granted it to Abraham through promise.
ukjv_translation: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

greek_text: τι ουν ο νομος των παραβασεων χαριν προσετεθη αχρις ου ελθη το σπερμα ω επηγγελται διαταγεις δι αγγελων εν χειρι μεσιτου
transliteration: ti oun o nomov twn parabasewn carin proseteyh acriv ou elyh to sperma w ephggeltai diatageiv di aggelwn en ceiri mesitou
draft_translation: Therefore then serves the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore then serves the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

greek_text: ο δε μεσιτης ενος ουκ εστιν ο δε θεος εις εστιν
transliteration: o de mesithv enov ouk estin o de yeov eiv estin
draft_translation: Now a mediator is not of one, but God is one.
ukjv_translation: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

greek_text: ο ουν νομος κατα των επαγγελιων του θεου μη γενοιτο ει γαρ εδοθη νομος ο δυναμενος ζωοποιησαι οντως αν εκ νομου ην η δικαιοσυνη
transliteration: o oun nomov kata twn epaggeliwn tou yeou mh genoito ei gar edoyh nomov o dunamenov zwopoihsai ontwv an ek nomou hn h dikaiosunh
draft_translation: Is the law then against the promises of God? May it not be: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, truly righteousness should have been by the law.
ukjv_translation: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
review_notes: modernized verily; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: αλλα συνεκλεισεν η γραφη τα παντα υπο αμαρτιαν ινα η επαγγελια εκ πιστεως ιησου χριστου δοθη τοις πιστευουσιν
transliteration: alla sunekleisen h grafh ta panta upo amartian ina h epaggelia ek pistewv ihsou cristou doyh toiv pisteuousin
draft_translation: But the scripture has concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
ukjv_translation: But the scripture has concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

greek_text: προ του δε ελθειν την πιστιν υπο νομον εφρουρουμεθα συγκεκλεισμενοι εις την μελλουσαν πιστιν αποκαλυφθηναι
transliteration: pro tou de elyein thn pistin upo nomon efrouroumeya sugkekleismenoi eiv thn mellousan pistin apokalufyhnai
draft_translation: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up to the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
ukjv_translation: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

greek_text: ωστε ο νομος παιδαγωγος ημων γεγονεν εις χριστον ινα εκ πιστεως δικαιωθωμεν
transliteration: wste o nomov paidagwgov hmwn gegonen eiv criston ina ek pistewv dikaiwywmen
draft_translation: Therefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore

greek_text: ελθουσης δε της πιστεως ουκετι υπο παιδαγωγον εσμεν
transliteration: elyoushv de thv pistewv ouketi upo paidagwgon esmen
draft_translation: But after faith came, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
ukjv_translation: But after that faith has come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

greek_text: παντες γαρ υιοι θεου εστε δια της πιστεως εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: pantev gar uioi yeou este dia thv pistewv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: For you are all the sons of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: For all of you are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
review_notes: kept huios as sons where Greek has sons of God; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οσοι γαρ εις χριστον εβαπτισθητε χριστον ενεδυσασθε
transliteration: osoi gar eiv criston ebaptisyhte criston enedusasye
draft_translation: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
ukjv_translation: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ουκ ενι ιουδαιος ουδε ελλην ουκ ενι δουλος ουδε ελευθερος ουκ ενι αρσεν και θηλυ παντες γαρ υμεις εις εστε εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: ouk eni ioudaiov oude ellhn ouk eni doulov oude eleuyerov ouk eni arsen kai yhlu pantev gar umeiv eiv este en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male nor female: for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for all of you are all one in Christ Jesus.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ει δε υμεις χριστου αρα του αβρααμ σπερμα εστε και κατ επαγγελιαν κληρονομοι
transliteration: ei de umeiv cristou ara tou abraam sperma este kai kat epaggelian klhronomoi
draft_translation: And If you are Christ's, then are you Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
ukjv_translation: And if all of you be Christ's, then are all of you Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: λεγω δε εφ οσον χρονον ο κληρονομος νηπιος εστιν ουδεν διαφερει δουλου κυριος παντων ων
transliteration: legw de ef oson cronon o klhronomov nhpiov estin ouden diaferei doulou kuriov pantwn wn
draft_translation: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differs nothing from a slave, though he be Lord of all;
ukjv_translation: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differs nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: αλλα υπο επιτροπους εστιν και οικονομους αχρι της προθεσμιας του πατρος
transliteration: alla upo epitropouv estin kai oikonomouv acri thv proyesmiav tou patrov
draft_translation: But he is under guardians and stewards until the time appointed by the father.
ukjv_translation: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

greek_text: ουτως και ημεις οτε ημεν νηπιοι υπο τα στοιχεια του κοσμου ημεν δεδουλωμενοι
transliteration: outwv kai hmeiv ote hmen nhpioi upo ta stoiceia tou kosmou hmen dedoulwmenoi
draft_translation: So also we, when we were children, were enslaved under the elements of the world:
ukjv_translation: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

greek_text: οτε δε ηλθεν το πληρωμα του χρονου εξαπεστειλεν ο θεος τον υιον αυτου γενομενον εκ γυναικος γενομενον υπο νομον
transliteration: ote de hlyen to plhrwma tou cronou exapesteilen o yeov ton uion autou genomenon ek gunaikov genomenon upo nomon
draft_translation: But when the fullness of the time had come, God sent forth his Son, having come from a woman, having come under law,
ukjv_translation: But when the fullness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

greek_text: ινα τους υπο νομον εξαγοραση ινα την υιοθεσιαν απολαβωμεν
transliteration: ina touv upo nomon exagorash ina thn uioyesian apolabwmen
