draft_translation: To redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
ukjv_translation: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

greek_text: οτι δε εστε υιοι εξαπεστειλεν ο θεος το πνευμα του υιου αυτου εις τας καρδιας υμων κραζον αββα ο πατηρ
transliteration: oti de este uioi exapesteilen o yeov to pneuma tou uiou autou eiv tav kardiav umwn krazon abba o pathr
draft_translation: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
ukjv_translation: And because all of you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit (o. pneuma) of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ωστε ουκετι ει δουλος αλλ υιος ει δε υιος και κληρονομος θεου δια χριστου
transliteration: wste ouketi ei doulov all uiov ei de uiov kai klhronomov yeou dia cristou
draft_translation: Therefore you are no more a slave, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore you are no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: αλλα τοτε μεν ουκ ειδοτες θεον εδουλευσατε τοις μη φυσει ουσιν θεοις
transliteration: alla tote men ouk eidotev yeon edouleusate toiv mh fusei ousin yeoiv
draft_translation: Nevertheless then, when you did not know God, you did service to those who by nature are no gods.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless then, when all of you knew not God, all of you did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized knew-not idiom; modernized them-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: νυν δε γνοντες θεον μαλλον δε γνωσθεντες υπο θεου πως επιστρεφετε παλιν επι τα ασθενη και πτωχα στοιχεια οις παλιν ανωθεν δουλευειν θελετε
transliteration: nun de gnontev yeon mallon de gnwsyentev upo yeou pwv epistrefete palin epi ta asyenh kai ptwca stoiceia oiv palin anwyen douleuein yelete
draft_translation: But now, after that you have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn you again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which you desire again to be in bondage?
ukjv_translation: But now, after that all of you have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn all of you again to the weak and beggarly elements, unto which all of you desire again to be in bondage?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ημερας παρατηρεισθε και μηνας και καιρους και ενιαυτους
transliteration: hmerav parathreisye kai mhnav kai kairouv kai eniautouv
draft_translation: You observe days, and months, and times, and years.
ukjv_translation: All of you observe days, and months, and times, and years.

greek_text: φοβουμαι υμας μηπως εικη κεκοπιακα εις υμας
transliteration: foboumai umav mhpwv eikh kekopiaka eiv umav
draft_translation: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labor in vain.
ukjv_translation: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

greek_text: γινεσθε ως εγω οτι καγω ως υμεις αδελφοι δεομαι υμων ουδεν με ηδικησατε
transliteration: ginesye wv egw oti kagw wv umeiv adelfoi deomai umwn ouden me hdikhsate
draft_translation: Brothers, I plead to you, be as I am; for I am as you are: you have not injured me at all.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, I plead to you, be as I am; for I am as all of you are: all of you have not injured me at all.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: οιδατε δε οτι δι ασθενειαν της σαρκος ευηγγελισαμην υμιν το προτερον
transliteration: oidate de oti di asyeneian thv sarkov euhggelisamhn umin to proteron
draft_translation: You know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the good news to you at the first.
ukjv_translation: All of you know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και τον πειρασμον μου τον εν τη σαρκι μου ουκ εξουθενησατε ουδε εξεπτυσατε αλλ ως αγγελον θεου εδεξασθε με ως χριστον ιησουν
transliteration: kai ton peirasmon mou ton en th sarki mou ouk exouyenhsate oude exeptusate all wv aggelon yeou edexasye me wv criston ihsoun
draft_translation: And my temptation which was in my flesh you despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: And my temptation which was in my flesh all of you despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

greek_text: τις ουν ην ο μακαρισμος υμων μαρτυρω γαρ υμιν οτι ει δυνατον τους οφθαλμους υμων εξορυξαντες αν εδωκατε μοι
transliteration: tiv oun hn o makarismov umwn marturw gar umin oti ei dunaton touv ofyalmouv umwn exoruxantev an edwkate moi
draft_translation: Where is then the blessedness you spoke of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
ukjv_translation: Where is then the blessedness all of you spoke of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, all of you would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

greek_text: ωστε εχθρος υμων γεγονα αληθευων υμιν
transliteration: wste ecyrov umwn gegona alhyeuwn umin
draft_translation: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
ukjv_translation: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

greek_text: ζηλουσιν υμας ου καλως αλλα εκκλεισαι υμας θελουσιν ινα αυτους ζηλουτε
transliteration: zhlousin umav ou kalwv alla ekkleisai umav yelousin ina autouv zhloute
draft_translation: They zealously affect you, but not well; yes, they would exclude you, that you might affect them.
ukjv_translation: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that all of you might affect them.
review_notes: modernized yea; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: καλον δε το ζηλουσθαι εν καλω παντοτε και μη μονον εν τω παρειναι με προς υμας
transliteration: kalon de to zhlousyai en kalw pantote kai mh monon en tw pareinai me prov umav
draft_translation: But it is good to be zealous always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
ukjv_translation: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

greek_text: τεκνια μου ους παλιν ωδινω αχρις ου μορφωθη χριστος εν υμιν
transliteration: teknia mou ouv palin wdinw acriv ou morfwyh cristov en umin
draft_translation: My little children, for whom I travail in birth again until Christ is formed in you,
ukjv_translation: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

greek_text: ηθελον δε παρειναι προς υμας αρτι και αλλαξαι την φωνην μου οτι απορουμαι εν υμιν
transliteration: hyelon de pareinai prov umav arti kai allaxai thn fwnhn mou oti aporoumai en umin
draft_translation: I desired to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I am perplexed about you.
ukjv_translation: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

greek_text: λεγετε μοι οι υπο νομον θελοντες ειναι τον νομον ουκ ακουετε
transliteration: legete moi oi upo nomon yelontev einai ton nomon ouk akouete
draft_translation: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, do you not hear the law?
ukjv_translation: Tell me, all of you that desire to be under the law, do all of you not hear the law?

greek_text: γεγραπται γαρ οτι αβρααμ δυο υιους εσχεν ενα εκ της παιδισκης και ενα εκ της ελευθερας
transliteration: gegraptai gar oti abraam duo uiouv escen ena ek thv paidiskhv kai ena ek thv eleuyerav
draft_translation: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, one from the bondwoman and one from the freewoman.
ukjv_translation: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

greek_text: αλλ ο μεν εκ της παιδισκης κατα σαρκα γεγεννηται ο δε εκ της ελευθερας δια της επαγγελιας
transliteration: all o men ek thv paidiskhv kata sarka gegennhtai o de ek thv eleuyerav dia thv epaggeliav
draft_translation: But the one from the bondwoman was born according to flesh; but the one from the freewoman through promise.
ukjv_translation: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

greek_text: ατινα εστιν αλληγορουμενα αυται γαρ εισιν αι δυο διαθηκαι μια μεν απο ορους σινα εις δουλειαν γεννωσα ητις εστιν αγαρ
transliteration: atina estin allhgoroumena autai gar eisin ai duo diayhkai mia men apo orouv sina eiv douleian gennwsa htiv estin agar
draft_translation: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which genders to bondage, which is Hagar.
ukjv_translation: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which genders to bondage, which is Agar.

greek_text: το γαρ αγαρ σινα ορος εστιν εν τη αραβια συστοιχει δε τη νυν ιερουσαλημ δουλευει δε μετα των τεκνων αυτης
transliteration: to gar agar sina orov estin en th arabia sustoicei de th nun ierousalhm douleuei de meta twn teknwn authv
draft_translation: For this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
ukjv_translation: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

greek_text: η δε ανω ιερουσαλημ ελευθερα εστιν ητις εστιν μητηρ παντων ημων
transliteration: h de anw ierousalhm eleuyera estin htiv estin mhthr pantwn hmwn
draft_translation: But the Jerusalem above is free, which is mother of us all.
ukjv_translation: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

greek_text: γεγραπται γαρ ευφρανθητι στειρα η ου τικτουσα ρηξον και βοησον η ουκ ωδινουσα οτι πολλα τα τεκνα της ερημου μαλλον η της εχουσης τον ανδρα
transliteration: gegraptai gar eufranyhti steira h ou tiktousa rhxon kai bohson h ouk wdinousa oti polla ta tekna thv erhmou mallon h thv ecoushv ton andra
draft_translation: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that travail not: for the desolate has many more children than she who has a husband.
ukjv_translation: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that travail not: for the desolate has many more children than she which has an husband.

greek_text: ημεις δε αδελφοι κατα ισαακ επαγγελιας τεκνα εσμεν
transliteration: hmeiv de adelfoi kata isaak epaggeliav tekna esmen
draft_translation: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
ukjv_translation: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

greek_text: αλλ ωσπερ τοτε ο κατα σαρκα γεννηθεις εδιωκεν τον κατα πνευμα ουτως και νυν
transliteration: all wsper tote o kata sarka gennhyeiv ediwken ton kata pneuma outwv kai nun
draft_translation: But as then the one who was born after the flesh persecuted him who was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
ukjv_translation: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, (o. pneuma) even so it is now.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αλλα τι λεγει η γραφη εκβαλε την παιδισκην και τον υιον αυτης ου γαρ μη κληρονομηση ο υιος της παιδισκης μετα του υιου της ελευθερας
transliteration: alla ti legei h grafh ekbale thn paidiskhn kai ton uion authv ou gar mh klhronomhsh o uiov thv paidiskhv meta tou uiou thv eleuyerav
draft_translation: But what does the scripture say? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not inherit with the son of the freewoman.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless what says the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

greek_text: αρα αδελφοι ουκ εσμεν παιδισκης τεκνα αλλα της ελευθερας
transliteration: ara adelfoi ouk esmen paidiskhv tekna alla thv eleuyerav
draft_translation: So then, brothers, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
ukjv_translation: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

greek_text: τη ελευθερια ουν η χριστος ημας ηλευθερωσεν στηκετε και μη παλιν ζυγω δουλειας ενεχεσθε
transliteration: th eleuyeria oun h cristov hmav hleuyerwsen sthkete kai mh palin zugw douleiav enecesye
draft_translation: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ has made us free, and do not be entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
ukjv_translation: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ has made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

greek_text: ιδε εγω παυλος λεγω υμιν οτι εαν περιτεμνησθε χριστος υμας ουδεν ωφελησει
transliteration: ide egw paulov legw umin oti ean peritemnhsye cristov umav ouden wfelhsei
draft_translation: Look, I Paul say to you, that if you are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
ukjv_translation: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if all of you be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized behold; modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μαρτυρομαι δε παλιν παντι ανθρωπω περιτεμνομενω οτι οφειλετης εστιν ολον τον νομον ποιησαι
transliteration: marturomai de palin panti anyrwpw peritemnomenw oti ofeilethv estin olon ton nomon poihsai
draft_translation: And I testify again to every man who is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
ukjv_translation: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

greek_text: κατηργηθητε απο του χριστου οιτινες εν νομω δικαιουσθε της χαριτος εξεπεσατε
transliteration: kathrghyhte apo tou cristou oitinev en nomw dikaiousye thv caritov exepesate
draft_translation: Christ is become of no effect to you, whoever of you are justified by the law; you are fallen from grace.
ukjv_translation: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; all of you are fallen from grace.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ημεις γαρ πνευματι εκ πιστεως ελπιδα δικαιοσυνης απεκδεχομεθα
transliteration: hmeiv gar pneumati ek pistewv elpida dikaiosunhv apekdecomeya
draft_translation: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
ukjv_translation: For we through the Spirit (o. pneuma) wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εν γαρ χριστω ιησου ουτε περιτομη τι ισχυει ουτε ακροβυστια αλλα πιστις δι αγαπης ενεργουμενη
transliteration: en gar cristw ihsou oute peritomh ti iscuei oute akrobustia alla pistiv di agaphv energoumenh
draft_translation: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision avails anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith which works by love.
ukjv_translation: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision avails any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which works by love. (o. agape)
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ετρεχετε καλως τις υμας ανεκοψεν τη αληθεια μη πειθεσθαι
transliteration: etrecete kalwv tiv umav anekoqen th alhyeia mh peiyesyai
draft_translation: You did run well; who did hinder you that you should not obey the truth?
ukjv_translation: All of you did run well; who did hinder you that all of you should not obey the truth?

greek_text: η πεισμονη ουκ εκ του καλουντος υμας
transliteration: h peismonh ouk ek tou kalountov umav
draft_translation: This persuasion does not come of him who calls you.
ukjv_translation: This persuasion comes not of him that calls you.
review_notes: modernized comes-not wording; modernized him-that relative

greek_text: μικρα ζυμη ολον το φυραμα ζυμοι
transliteration: mikra zumh olon to furama zumoi
draft_translation: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
ukjv_translation: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εγω πεποιθα εις υμας εν κυριω οτι ουδεν αλλο φρονησετε ο δε ταρασσων υμας βαστασει το κριμα οστις αν η
transliteration: egw pepoiya eiv umav en kuriw oti ouden allo fronhsete o de tarasswn umav bastasei to krima ostiv an h
draft_translation: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that you will be none otherwise minded: but the one who troubles you shall bear his judgment, whoever he be.
ukjv_translation: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that all of you will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubles you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized whosoever; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εγω δε αδελφοι ει περιτομην ετι κηρυσσω τι ετι διωκομαι αρα κατηργηται το σκανδαλον του σταυρου
transliteration: egw de adelfoi ei peritomhn eti khrussw ti eti diwkomai ara kathrghtai to skandalon tou staurou
draft_translation: And I, brothers, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the stumbling block of the cross ceased.
ukjv_translation: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
review_notes: modernized offence spelling; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered skandalon as stumbling block

greek_text: οφελον και αποκοψονται οι αναστατουντες υμας
transliteration: ofelon kai apokoqontai oi anastatountev umav
draft_translation: I wish those who unsettle you would even cut themselves off.
ukjv_translation: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

greek_text: υμεις γαρ επ ελευθερια εκληθητε αδελφοι μονον μη την ελευθεριαν εις αφορμην τη σαρκι αλλα δια της αγαπης δουλευετε αλληλοις
transliteration: umeiv gar ep eleuyeria eklhyhte adelfoi monon mh thn eleuyerian eiv aformhn th sarki alla dia thv agaphv douleuete allhloiv
draft_translation: For, brothers, you have been called to liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
ukjv_translation: For, brethren, all of you have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love (o. agape) serve one another.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ο γαρ πας νομος εν ενι λογω πληρουται εν τω αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως εαυτον
transliteration: o gar pav nomov en eni logw plhroutai en tw agaphseiv ton plhsion sou wv eauton
draft_translation: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
ukjv_translation: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, (o. logos) even in this; You shall love your neighbour as yourself.
review_notes: modernized neighbour spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ει δε αλληλους δακνετε και κατεσθιετε βλεπετε μη υπο αλληλων αναλωθητε
transliteration: ei de allhlouv daknete kai katesyiete blepete mh upo allhlwn analwyhte
draft_translation: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you not be consumed one of another.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you bite and devour one another, take heed that all of you be not consumed one of another.
review_notes: modernized be-not clause; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: λεγω δε πνευματι περιπατειτε και επιθυμιαν σαρκος ου μη τελεσητε
transliteration: legw de pneumati peripateite kai epiyumian sarkov ou mh teleshte
draft_translation: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
ukjv_translation: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and all of you shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: η γαρ σαρξ επιθυμει κατα του πνευματος το δε πνευμα κατα της σαρκος ταυτα δε αντικειται αλληλοις ινα μη α αν θελητε ταυτα ποιητε
transliteration: h gar sarx epiyumei kata tou pneumatov to de pneuma kata thv sarkov tauta de antikeitai allhloiv ina mh a an yelhte tauta poihte
draft_translation: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that you cannot do the things that you would.
ukjv_translation: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and the Spirit (o. pneuma) against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that all of you cannot do the things that all of you would.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ει δε πνευματι αγεσθε ουκ εστε υπο νομον
transliteration: ei de pneumati agesye ouk este upo nomon
draft_translation: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you be led of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) all of you are not under the law.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: φανερα δε εστιν τα εργα της σαρκος ατινα εστιν μοιχεια πορνεια ακαθαρσια ασελγεια
transliteration: fanera de estin ta erga thv sarkov atina estin moiceia porneia akayarsia aselgeia
draft_translation: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
ukjv_translation: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

greek_text: ειδωλολατρεια φαρμακεια εχθραι ερεις ζηλοι θυμοι εριθειαι διχοστασιαι αιρεσεις
transliteration: eidwlolatreia farmakeia ecyrai ereiv zhloi yumoi eriyeiai dicostasiai aireseiv
draft_translation: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, worldly jealousies, wrath, strife, divisions, factions,
ukjv_translation: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, worldy jealousies, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
review_notes: fixed worldly typo; modernized seditions/heresies wording

greek_text: φθονοι φονοι μεθαι κωμοι και τα ομοια τουτοις α προλεγω υμιν καθως και προειπον οτι οι τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντες βασιλειαν θεου ου κληρονομησουσιν
transliteration: fyonoi fonoi meyai kwmoi kai ta omoia toutoiv a prolegw umin kaywv kai proeipon oti oi ta toiauta prassontev basileian yeou ou klhronomhsousin
draft_translation: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that those who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
ukjv_translation: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

greek_text: ο δε καρπος του πνευματος εστιν αγαπη χαρα ειρηνη μακροθυμια χρηστοτης αγαθωσυνη πιστις
transliteration: o de karpov tou pneumatov estin agaph cara eirhnh makroyumia crhstothv agaywsunh pistiv
draft_translation: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
ukjv_translation: But the fruit of the Spirit (o. pneuma) is love, (o. agape) joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πραοτης εγκρατεια κατα των τοιουτων ουκ εστιν νομος
transliteration: praothv egkrateia kata twn toioutwn ouk estin nomov
draft_translation: Meekness, self-control: against such there is no law.
ukjv_translation: Meekness, wilful restrain: against such there is no law.

greek_text: οι δε του χριστου την σαρκα εσταυρωσαν συν τοις παθημασιν και ταις επιθυμιαις
transliteration: oi de tou cristou thn sarka estaurwsan sun toiv payhmasin kai taiv epiyumiaiv
draft_translation: And those who are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
ukjv_translation: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

greek_text: ει ζωμεν πνευματι πνευματι και στοιχωμεν
transliteration: ei zwmen pneumati pneumati kai stoicwmen
draft_translation: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
ukjv_translation: If we live in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) let us also walk in the Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μη γινωμεθα κενοδοξοι αλληλους προκαλουμενοι αλληλοις φθονουντες
transliteration: mh ginwmeya kenodoxoi allhlouv prokaloumenoi allhloiv fyonountev
draft_translation: Let us not become vain-glorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
ukjv_translation: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

greek_text: αδελφοι εαν και προληφθη ανθρωπος εν τινι παραπτωματι υμεις οι πνευματικοι καταρτιζετε τον τοιουτον εν πνευματι πραοτητος σκοπων σεαυτον μη και συ πειρασθης
transliteration: adelfoi ean kai prolhfyh anyrwpov en tini paraptwmati umeiv oi pneumatikoi katartizete ton toiouton en pneumati praothtov skopwn seauton mh kai su peirasyhv
draft_translation: Brothers, if a man be overtaken in a fault, you which are spiritual, restore such a one in the spirit of meekness; considering yourself, lest you also be tempted.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, all of you which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit (o. pneuma) of meekness; considering yourself, lest you also be tempted.
review_notes: modernized such-an-one idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αλληλων τα βαρη βασταζετε και ουτως αναπληρωσατε τον νομον του χριστου
transliteration: allhlwn ta barh bastazete kai outwv anaplhrwsate ton nomon tou cristou
draft_translation: Bear you one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Bear all of you one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

greek_text: ει γαρ δοκει τις ειναι τι μηδεν ων εαυτον φρεναπατα
transliteration: ei gar dokei tiv einai ti mhden wn eauton frenapata
draft_translation: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself.
ukjv_translation: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

greek_text: το δε εργον εαυτου δοκιμαζετω εκαστος και τοτε εις εαυτον μονον το καυχημα εξει και ουκ εις τον ετερον
transliteration: to de ergon eautou dokimazetw ekastov kai tote eiv eauton monon to kauchma exei kai ouk eiv ton eteron
draft_translation: But let each one prove his own work, and then he shall have boasting in himself alone, and not in another.
ukjv_translation: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

greek_text: εκαστος γαρ το ιδιον φορτιον βαστασει
transliteration: ekastov gar to idion fortion bastasei
draft_translation: For each one shall bear his own load.
ukjv_translation: For every man shall bear his own burden.

greek_text: κοινωνειτω δε ο κατηχουμενος τον λογον τω κατηχουντι εν πασιν αγαθοις
transliteration: koinwneitw de o kathcoumenov ton logon tw kathcounti en pasin agayoiv
draft_translation: Let him who is taught in the word communicate to him who teaches in all good things.
ukjv_translation: Let him that is taught in the word (o. logos) communicate unto him that teaches in all good things.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μη πλανασθε θεος ου μυκτηριζεται ο γαρ εαν σπειρη ανθρωπος τουτο και θερισει
transliteration: mh planasye yeov ou mukthrizetai o gar ean speirh anyrwpov touto kai yerisei
draft_translation: Do not be deceived; God is not mocked: for whatever a man sows, that shall he also reap.
ukjv_translation: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man sows, that shall he also reap.

greek_text: οτι ο σπειρων εις την σαρκα εαυτου εκ της σαρκος θερισει φθοραν ο δε σπειρων εις το πνευμα εκ του πνευματος θερισει ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: oti o speirwn eiv thn sarka eautou ek thv sarkov yerisei fyoran o de speirwn eiv to pneuma ek tou pneumatov yerisei zwhn aiwnion
draft_translation: For the one who sows to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but the one who sows to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life eternal.
ukjv_translation: For he that sows to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that sows to the Spirit (o. pneuma) shall of the Spirit (o. pneuma) reap life everlasting.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: το δε καλον ποιουντες μη εκκακωμεν καιρω γαρ ιδιω θερισομεν μη εκλυομενοι
transliteration: to de kalon poiountev mh ekkakwmen kairw gar idiw yerisomen mh ekluomenoi
draft_translation: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we do not faint.
ukjv_translation: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

greek_text: αρα ουν ως καιρον εχομεν εργαζωμεθα το αγαθον προς παντας μαλιστα δε προς τους οικειους της πιστεως
transliteration: ara oun wv kairon ecomen ergazwmeya to agayon prov pantav malista de prov touv oikeiouv thv pistewv
draft_translation: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good to all men, especially to them who are of the household of faith.
ukjv_translation: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

greek_text: ιδετε πηλικοις υμιν γραμμασιν εγραψα τη εμη χειρι
transliteration: idete phlikoiv umin grammasin egraqa th emh ceiri
draft_translation: You see how large a letter I have written to you with my own hand.
ukjv_translation: All of you see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized mine-own idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οσοι θελουσιν ευπροσωπησαι εν σαρκι ουτοι αναγκαζουσιν υμας περιτεμνεσθαι μονον ινα μη τω σταυρω του χριστου διωκωνται
transliteration: osoi yelousin euproswphsai en sarki outoi anagkazousin umav peritemnesyai monon ina mh tw staurw tou cristou diwkwntai
draft_translation: As many as desire to make a good appearance in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
ukjv_translation: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
review_notes: modernized constrain wording; modernized fair-show idiom

greek_text: ουδε γαρ οι περιτεμνομενοι αυτοι νομον φυλασσουσιν αλλα θελουσιν υμας περιτεμνεσθαι ινα εν τη υμετερα σαρκι καυχησωνται
transliteration: oude gar oi peritemnomenoi autoi nomon fulassousin alla yelousin umav peritemnesyai ina en th umetera sarki kauchswntai
draft_translation: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
ukjv_translation: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

greek_text: εμοι δε μη γενοιτο καυχασθαι ει μη εν τω σταυρω του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου δι ου εμοι κοσμος εσταυρωται καγω τω κοσμω
transliteration: emoi de mh genoito kaucasyai ei mh en tw staurw tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou di ou emoi kosmov estaurwtai kagw tw kosmw
draft_translation: But may it not be that I should glory, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.
ukjv_translation: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized save-in idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered me genoito directly

greek_text: εν γαρ χριστω ιησου ουτε περιτομη τι ισχυει ουτε ακροβυστια αλλα καινη κτισις
transliteration: en gar cristw ihsou oute peritomh ti iscuei oute akrobustia alla kainh ktisiv
draft_translation: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision avails anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
ukjv_translation: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision avails any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

greek_text: και οσοι τω κανονι τουτω στοιχησουσιν ειρηνη επ αυτους και ελεος και επι τον ισραηλ του θεου
transliteration: kai osoi tw kanoni toutw stoichsousin eirhnh ep autouv kai eleov kai epi ton israhl tou yeou
draft_translation: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
ukjv_translation: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: του λοιπου κοπους μοι μηδεις παρεχετω εγω γαρ τα στιγματα του κυριου ιησου εν τω σωματι μου βασταζω
transliteration: tou loipou kopouv moi mhdeiv parecetw egw gar ta stigmata tou kuriou ihsou en tw swmati mou bastazw
draft_translation: from now on let no one trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
ukjv_translation: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
review_notes: modernized from-henceforth idiom; modernized no-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα του πνευματος υμων αδελφοι αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta tou pneumatov umwn adelfoi amhn
draft_translation: Brothers, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. (o. pneuma) Amen.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου τοις αγιοις τοις ουσιν εν εφεσω και πιστοις εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: paulov apostolov ihsou cristou dia yelhmatov yeou toiv agioiv toiv ousin en efesw kai pistoiv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the holy ones who are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

greek_text: ευλογητος ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο ευλογησας ημας εν παση ευλογια πνευματικη εν τοις επουρανιοις εν χριστω
transliteration: euloghtov o yeov kai pathr tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou o euloghsav hmav en pash eulogia pneumatikh en toiv epouranioiv en cristw
draft_translation: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
ukjv_translation: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

greek_text: καθως εξελεξατο ημας εν αυτω προ καταβολης κοσμου ειναι ημας αγιους και αμωμους κατενωπιον αυτου εν αγαπη
transliteration: kaywv exelexato hmav en autw pro katabolhv kosmou einai hmav agiouv kai amwmouv katenwpion autou en agaph
draft_translation: According as he has chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
ukjv_translation: According as he has chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love: (o. agape)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: προορισας ημας εις υιοθεσιαν δια ιησου χριστου εις αυτον κατα την ευδοκιαν του θεληματος αυτου
transliteration: proorisav hmav eiv uioyesian dia ihsou cristou eiv auton kata thn eudokian tou yelhmatov autou
draft_translation: Having predestinated us to the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
ukjv_translation: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

greek_text: εις επαινον δοξης της χαριτος αυτου εν η εχαριτωσεν ημας εν τω ηγαπημενω
transliteration: eiv epainon doxhv thv caritov autou en h ecaritwsen hmav en tw hgaphmenw
draft_translation: To the praise of the glory of his grace, in which he has made us accepted in the beloved.
ukjv_translation: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he has made us accepted in the beloved.

greek_text: εν ω εχομεν την απολυτρωσιν δια του αιματος αυτου την αφεσιν των παραπτωματων κατα τον πλουτον της χαριτος αυτου
transliteration: en w ecomen thn apolutrwsin dia tou aimatov autou thn afesin twn paraptwmatwn kata ton plouton thv caritov autou
draft_translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
ukjv_translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ης επερισσευσεν εις ημας εν παση σοφια και φρονησει
transliteration: hv eperisseusen eiv hmav en pash sofia kai fronhsei
draft_translation: in which he has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
ukjv_translation: Wherein he has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

greek_text: γνωρισας ημιν το μυστηριον του θεληματος αυτου κατα την ευδοκιαν αυτου ην προεθετο εν αυτω
transliteration: gnwrisav hmin to musthrion tou yelhmatov autou kata thn eudokian autou hn proeyeto en autw
draft_translation: Having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself:
ukjv_translation: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself:

greek_text: εις οικονομιαν του πληρωματος των καιρων ανακεφαλαιωσασθαι τα παντα εν τω χριστω τα τε εν τοις ουρανοις και τα επι της γης
transliteration: eiv oikonomian tou plhrwmatov twn kairwn anakefalaiwsasyai ta panta en tw cristw ta te en toiv ouranoiv kai ta epi thv ghv
draft_translation: For the dispensation of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him:
ukjv_translation: That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

greek_text: εν αυτω εν ω και εκληρωθημεν προορισθεντες κατα προθεσιν του τα παντα ενεργουντος κατα την βουλην του θεληματος αυτου
transliteration: en autw en w kai eklhrwyhmen proorisyentev kata proyesin tou ta panta energountov kata thn boulhn tou yelhmatov autou
draft_translation: In whom also we obtained an inheritance, being predestined according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his will:
ukjv_translation: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his own will:

greek_text: εις το ειναι ημας εις επαινον της δοξης αυτου τους προηλπικοτας εν τω χριστω
transliteration: eiv to einai hmav eiv epainon thv doxhv autou touv prohlpikotav en tw cristw
draft_translation: that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who first hoped in Christ.
ukjv_translation: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

greek_text: εν ω και υμεις ακουσαντες τον λογον της αληθειας το ευαγγελιον της σωτηριας υμων εν ω και πιστευσαντες εσφραγισθητε τω πνευματι της επαγγελιας τω αγιω
transliteration: en w kai umeiv akousantev ton logon thv alhyeiav to euaggelion thv swthriav umwn en w kai pisteusantev esfragisyhte tw pneumati thv epaggeliav tw agiw
draft_translation: In whom you also trusted, after that you heard the word of truth, the good news of your salvation: in whom also after that you believed, you were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
ukjv_translation: In whom all of you also trusted, after that all of you heard the word (o. logos) of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that all of you believed, all of you were sealed with that holy Spirit (o. pneuma) of promise,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ος εστιν αρραβων της κληρονομιας ημων εις απολυτρωσιν της περιποιησεως εις επαινον της δοξης αυτου
transliteration: ov estin arrabwn thv klhronomiav hmwn eiv apolutrwsin thv peripoihsewv eiv epainon thv doxhv autou
draft_translation: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of his glory.
ukjv_translation: Which is the earn of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
review_notes: fixed Spirit relative pronoun; modernized archaic directional unto; rendered arrabon as pledge

greek_text: δια τουτο καγω ακουσας την καθ υμας πιστιν εν τω κυριω ιησου και την αγαπην την εις παντας τους αγιους
transliteration: dia touto kagw akousav thn kay umav pistin en tw kuriw ihsou kai thn agaphn thn eiv pantav touv agiouv
draft_translation: Therefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love to all the holy ones,
ukjv_translation: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love (o. agape) unto all the saints,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ου παυομαι ευχαριστων υπερ υμων μνειαν υμων ποιουμενος επι των προσευχων μου
transliteration: ou pauomai eucaristwn uper umwn mneian umwn poioumenov epi twn proseucwn mou
draft_translation: I do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
ukjv_translation: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

greek_text: ινα ο θεος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο πατηρ της δοξης δωη υμιν πνευμα σοφιας και αποκαλυψεως εν επιγνωσει αυτου
transliteration: ina o yeov tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou o pathr thv doxhv dwh umin pneuma sofiav kai apokaluqewv en epignwsei autou
draft_translation: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
ukjv_translation: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit (o. pneuma) of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πεφωτισμενους τους οφθαλμους της διανοιας υμων εις το ειδεναι υμας τις εστιν η ελπις της κλησεως αυτου και τις ο πλουτος της δοξης της κληρονομιας αυτου εν τοις αγιοις
transliteration: pefwtismenouv touv ofyalmouv thv dianoiav umwn eiv to eidenai umav tiv estin h elpiv thv klhsewv autou kai tiv o ploutov thv doxhv thv klhronomiav autou en toiv agioiv
draft_translation: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the holy ones,
ukjv_translation: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that all of you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: και τι το υπερβαλλον μεγεθος της δυναμεως αυτου εις ημας τους πιστευοντας κατα την ενεργειαν του κρατους της ισχυος αυτου
transliteration: kai ti to uperballon megeyov thv dunamewv autou eiv hmav touv pisteuontav kata thn energeian tou kratouv thv iscuov autou
draft_translation: And what is the surpassing greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of the might of his strength,
ukjv_translation: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

greek_text: ην ενηργησεν εν τω χριστω εγειρας αυτον εκ νεκρων και εκαθισεν εν δεξια αυτου εν τοις επουρανιοις
transliteration: hn enhrghsen en tw cristw egeirav auton ek nekrwn kai ekayisen en dexia autou en toiv epouranioiv
draft_translation: Which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
ukjv_translation: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

greek_text: υπερανω πασης αρχης και εξουσιας και δυναμεως και κυριοτητος και παντος ονοματος ονομαζομενου ου μονον εν τω αιωνι τουτω αλλα και εν τω μελλοντι
transliteration: uperanw pashv archv kai exousiav kai dunamewv kai kuriothtov kai pantov onomatov onomazomenou ou monon en tw aiwni toutw alla kai en tw mellonti
draft_translation: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come:
ukjv_translation: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
review_notes: rendered this aion as this age

greek_text: και παντα υπεταξεν υπο τους ποδας αυτου και αυτον εδωκεν κεφαλην υπερ παντα τη εκκλησια
transliteration: kai panta upetaxen upo touv podav autou kai auton edwken kefalhn uper panta th ekklhsia
draft_translation: And has put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the assembly,
ukjv_translation: And has put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

greek_text: ητις εστιν το σωμα αυτου το πληρωμα του παντα εν πασιν πληρουμενου
transliteration: htiv estin to swma autou to plhrwma tou panta en pasin plhroumenou
draft_translation: Which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
ukjv_translation: Which is his body, the fullness of him that fills all in all.

greek_text: και υμας οντας νεκρους τοις παραπτωμασιν και ταις αμαρτιαις
transliteration: kai umav ontav nekrouv toiv paraptwmasin kai taiv amartiaiv
draft_translation: And you, being dead in trespasses and sins;
ukjv_translation: And you has he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
review_notes: removed supplied quickened not present in verse

greek_text: εν αις ποτε περιεπατησατε κατα τον αιωνα του κοσμου τουτου κατα τον αρχοντα της εξουσιας του αερος του πνευματος του νυν ενεργουντος εν τοις υιοις της απειθειας
transliteration: en aiv pote periepathsate kata ton aiwna tou kosmou toutou kata ton arconta thv exousiav tou aerov tou pneumatov tou nun energountov en toiv uioiv thv apeiyeiav
draft_translation: in which in time past you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience:
ukjv_translation: Wherein in time past all of you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit (o. pneuma) that now works in the children of disobedience:
review_notes: modernized wherein; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εν οις και ημεις παντες ανεστραφημεν ποτε εν ταις επιθυμιαις της σαρκος ημων ποιουντες τα θεληματα της σαρκος και των διανοιων και ημεν τεκνα φυσει οργης ως και οι λοιποι
transliteration: en oiv kai hmeiv pantev anestrafhmen pote en taiv epiyumiaiv thv sarkov hmwn poiountev ta yelhmata thv sarkov kai twn dianoiwn kai hmen tekna fusei orghv wv kai oi loipoi
draft_translation: Among whom also we all had our conduct in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
ukjv_translation: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

greek_text: ο δε θεος πλουσιος ων εν ελεει δια την πολλην αγαπην αυτου ην ηγαπησεν ημας
transliteration: o de yeov plousiov wn en eleei dia thn pollhn agaphn autou hn hgaphsen hmav
draft_translation: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
ukjv_translation: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love (o. agape) wherewith he loved us,
review_notes: modernized wherewith; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και οντας ημας νεκρους τοις παραπτωμασιν συνεζωοποιησεν τω χριστω χαριτι εστε σεσωσμενοι
transliteration: kai ontav hmav nekrouv toiv paraptwmasin sunezwopoihsen tw cristw cariti este seswsmenoi
draft_translation: Even when we were dead in sins, he made us alive together with Christ, (by grace you are saved;)
ukjv_translation: Even when we were dead in sins, has quickened us together with Christ, (by grace all of you are saved;)
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered syzoopoieo as made alive together

greek_text: και συνηγειρεν και συνεκαθισεν εν τοις επουρανιοις εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: kai sunhgeiren kai sunekayisen en toiv epouranioiv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: And has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: And has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ινα ενδειξηται εν τοις αιωσιν τοις επερχομενοις τον υπερβαλλοντα πλουτον της χαριτος αυτου εν χρηστοτητι εφ ημας εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: ina endeixhtai en toiv aiwsin toiv epercomenoiv ton uperballonta plouton thv caritov autou en crhstothti ef hmav en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: That in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: That in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τη γαρ χαριτι εστε σεσωσμενοι δια της πιστεως και τουτο ουκ εξ υμων θεου το δωρον
transliteration: th gar cariti este seswsmenoi dia thv pistewv kai touto ouk ex umwn yeou to dwron
draft_translation: For by grace are you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
ukjv_translation: For by grace are all of you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

greek_text: ουκ εξ εργων ινα μη τις καυχησηται
transliteration: ouk ex ergwn ina mh tiv kauchshtai
draft_translation: Not of works, lest anyone should boast.
ukjv_translation: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

greek_text: αυτου γαρ εσμεν ποιημα κτισθεντες εν χριστω ιησου επι εργοις αγαθοις οις προητοιμασεν ο θεος ινα εν αυτοις περιπατησωμεν
transliteration: autou gar esmen poihma ktisyentev en cristw ihsou epi ergoiv agayoiv oiv prohtoimasen o yeov ina en autoiv peripathswmen
draft_translation: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them.
ukjv_translation: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them.

greek_text: διο μνημονευετε οτι υμεις ποτε τα εθνη εν σαρκι οι λεγομενοι ακροβυστια υπο της λεγομενης περιτομης εν σαρκι χειροποιητου
transliteration: dio mnhmoneuete oti umeiv pote ta eynh en sarki oi legomenoi akrobustia upo thv legomenhv peritomhv en sarki ceiropoihtou
draft_translation: Therefore remember, that you being in time past nations in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
ukjv_translation: Wherefore remember, that all of you being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: οτι ητε εν τω καιρω εκεινω χωρις χριστου απηλλοτριωμενοι της πολιτειας του ισραηλ και ξενοι των διαθηκων της επαγγελιας ελπιδα μη εχοντες και αθεοι εν τω κοσμω
transliteration: oti hte en tw kairw ekeinw cwriv cristou aphllotriwmenoi thv politeiav tou israhl kai xenoi twn diayhkwn thv epaggeliav elpida mh econtev kai ayeoi en tw kosmw
draft_translation: That at that time you were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
ukjv_translation: That at that time all of you were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

greek_text: νυνι δε εν χριστω ιησου υμεις οι ποτε οντες μακραν εγγυς εγενηθητε εν τω αιματι του χριστου
transliteration: nuni de en cristw ihsou umeiv oi pote ontev makran egguv egenhyhte en tw aimati tou cristou
draft_translation: But now in Christ Jesus you who sometimes were far off are made near by the blood of Christ.
ukjv_translation: But now in Christ Jesus all of you who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

ukjv_translation: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplies, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, makes increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love. (o. agape)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τουτο ουν λεγω και μαρτυρομαι εν κυριω μηκετι υμας περιπατειν καθως και τα λοιπα εθνη περιπατει εν ματαιοτητι του νοος αυτων
transliteration: touto oun legw kai marturomai en kuriw mhketi umav peripatein kaywv kai ta loipa eynh peripatei en mataiothti tou noov autwn
draft_translation: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you from now on walk not as other nations walk, in the vanity of their mind,
ukjv_translation: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that all of you henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
review_notes: modernized henceforth; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: εσκοτισμενοι τη διανοια οντες απηλλοτριωμενοι της ζωης του θεου δια την αγνοιαν την ουσαν εν αυτοις δια την πωρωσιν της καρδιας αυτων
transliteration: eskotismenoi th dianoia ontev aphllotriwmenoi thv zwhv tou yeou dia thn agnoian thn ousan en autoiv dia thn pwrwsin thv kardiav autwn
draft_translation: being darkened in understanding, being alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart:
ukjv_translation: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

greek_text: οιτινες απηλγηκοτες εαυτους παρεδωκαν τη ασελγεια εις εργασιαν ακαθαρσιας πασης εν πλεονεξια
transliteration: oitinev aphlghkotev eautouv paredwkan th aselgeia eiv ergasian akayarsiav pashv en pleonexia
draft_translation: Who being past feeling have given themselves over to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
ukjv_translation: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

greek_text: υμεις δε ουχ ουτως εμαθετε τον χριστον
transliteration: umeiv de ouc outwv emayete ton criston
draft_translation: But you have not so learned Christ;
ukjv_translation: But all of you have not so learned Christ;

greek_text: ειγε αυτον ηκουσατε και εν αυτω εδιδαχθητε καθως εστιν αληθεια εν τω ιησου
transliteration: eige auton hkousate kai en autw edidacyhte kaywv estin alhyeia en tw ihsou
draft_translation: If indeed you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
ukjv_translation: If so be that all of you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered eige as if indeed

greek_text: αποθεσθαι υμας κατα την προτεραν αναστροφην τον παλαιον ανθρωπον τον φθειρομενον κατα τας επιθυμιας της απατης
transliteration: apoyesyai umav kata thn proteran anastrofhn ton palaion anyrwpon ton fyeiromenon kata tav epiyumiav thv apathv
draft_translation: That you put off concerning the former conduct the old man, who is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
ukjv_translation: That all of you put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
review_notes: modernized conversation as conduct; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ανανεουσθαι δε τω πνευματι του νοος υμων
transliteration: ananeousyai de tw pneumati tou noov umwn
draft_translation: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
ukjv_translation: And be renewed in the spirit (o. pneuma) of your mind;
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και ενδυσασθαι τον καινον ανθρωπον τον κατα θεον κτισθεντα εν δικαιοσυνη και οσιοτητι της αληθειας
transliteration: kai endusasyai ton kainon anyrwpon ton kata yeon ktisyenta en dikaiosunh kai osiothti thv alhyeiav
draft_translation: And that you put on the new man, who after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
ukjv_translation: And that all of you put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: διο αποθεμενοι το ψευδος λαλειτε αληθειαν εκαστος μετα του πλησιον αυτου οτι εσμεν αλληλων μελη
transliteration: dio apoyemenoi to qeudov laleite alhyeian ekastov meta tou plhsion autou oti esmen allhlwn melh
draft_translation: Therefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

greek_text: οργιζεσθε και μη αμαρτανετε ο ηλιος μη επιδυετω επι τω παροργισμω υμων
transliteration: orgizesye kai mh amartanete o hliov mh epiduetw epi tw parorgismw umwn
draft_translation: Be angry, and do not sin: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
ukjv_translation: Be all of you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; modernized sin-not idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μητε διδοτε τοπον τω διαβολω
transliteration: mhte didote topon tw diabolw
draft_translation: Neither give place to the devil.
ukjv_translation: Neither give place to the devil.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο κλεπτων μηκετι κλεπτετω μαλλον δε κοπιατω εργαζομενος το αγαθον ταις χερσιν ινα εχη μεταδιδοναι τω χρειαν εχοντι
transliteration: o kleptwn mhketi kleptetw mallon de kopiatw ergazomenov to agayon taiv cersin ina ech metadidonai tw creian econti
draft_translation: Let him who stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him who needs.
ukjv_translation: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needs.
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: πας λογος σαπρος εκ του στοματος υμων μη εκπορευεσθω αλλ ει τις αγαθος προς οικοδομην της χρειας ινα δω χαριν τοις ακουουσιν
transliteration: pav logov saprov ek tou stomatov umwn mh ekporeuesyw all ei tiv agayov prov oikodomhn thv creiav ina dw carin toiv akouousin
draft_translation: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace to the hearers.
ukjv_translation: Let no corrupt communication (o. logos) proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και μη λυπειτε το πνευμα το αγιον του θεου εν ω εσφραγισθητε εις ημεραν απολυτρωσεως
transliteration: kai mh lupeite to pneuma to agion tou yeou en w esfragisyhte eiv hmeran apolutrwsewv
draft_translation: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, by which you are sealed to the day of redemption.
ukjv_translation: And grieve not the holy Spirit (o. pneuma) of God, whereby all of you are sealed unto the day of redemption.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whereby; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: πασα πικρια και θυμος και οργη και κραυγη και βλασφημια αρθητω αφ υμων συν παση κακια
transliteration: pasa pikria kai yumov kai orgh kai kraugh kai blasfhmia aryhtw af umwn sun pash kakia
draft_translation: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and evil speaking, be removed from you, with all malice:
ukjv_translation: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
review_notes: aligned apoluo with release; fixed be-release artifact; modernized clamour spelling

greek_text: γινεσθε δε εις αλληλους χρηστοι ευσπλαγχνοι χαριζομενοι εαυτοις καθως και ο θεος εν χριστω εχαρισατο υμιν
transliteration: ginesye de eiv allhlouv crhstoi eusplagcnoi carizomenoi eautoiv kaywv kai o yeov en cristw ecarisato umin
draft_translation: And be kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.
ukjv_translation: And be all of you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: γινεσθε ουν μιμηται του θεου ως τεκνα αγαπητα
transliteration: ginesye oun mimhtai tou yeou wv tekna agaphta
draft_translation: Be therefore followers of God, as dear children;
ukjv_translation: Be all of you therefore followers of God, as dear children;
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και περιπατειτε εν αγαπη καθως και ο χριστος ηγαπησεν ημας και παρεδωκεν εαυτον υπερ ημων προσφοραν και θυσιαν τω θεω εις οσμην ευωδιας
transliteration: kai peripateite en agaph kaywv kai o cristov hgaphsen hmav kai paredwken eauton uper hmwn prosforan kai yusian tw yew eiv osmhn euwdiav
draft_translation: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling taste.
ukjv_translation: And walk in love, (o. agape) as Christ also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savour.
review_notes: modernized savour; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πορνεια δε και πασα ακαθαρσια η πλεονεξια μηδε ονομαζεσθω εν υμιν καθως πρεπει αγιοις
transliteration: porneia de kai pasa akayarsia h pleonexia mhde onomazesyw en umin kaywv prepei agioiv
draft_translation: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes holy ones;
ukjv_translation: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes saints;
review_notes: modernized porneia wording; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: και αισχροτης και μωρολογια η ευτραπελια τα ουκ ανηκοντα αλλα μαλλον ευχαριστια
transliteration: kai aiscrothv kai mwrologia h eutrapelia ta ouk anhkonta alla mallon eucaristia
draft_translation: And filthiness, and foolish talking, or jesting, which are not fitting: but rather thanksgiving.
ukjv_translation: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

greek_text: τουτο γαρ εστε γινωσκοντες οτι πας πορνος η ακαθαρτος η πλεονεκτης ος εστιν ειδωλολατρης ουκ εχει κληρονομιαν εν τη βασιλεια του χριστου και θεου
transliteration: touto gar este ginwskontev oti pav pornov h akayartov h pleonekthv ov estin eidwlolatrhv ouk ecei klhronomian en th basileia tou cristou kai yeou
draft_translation: For this you know, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
ukjv_translation: For this all of you know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
review_notes: modernized whoremonger; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μηδεις υμας απατατω κενοις λογοις δια ταυτα γαρ ερχεται η οργη του θεου επι τους υιους της απειθειας
transliteration: mhdeiv umav apatatw kenoiv logoiv dia tauta gar ercetai h orgh tou yeou epi touv uiouv thv apeiyeiav
draft_translation: Let no one deceive you with vain words: for because of these things comes the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
ukjv_translation: Let no man deceive you with vain words: (o. logos) for because of these things comes the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μη ουν γινεσθε συμμετοχοι αυτων
transliteration: mh oun ginesye summetocoi autwn
draft_translation: Do not therefore be partakers with them.
ukjv_translation: Be not all of you therefore partakers with them.
review_notes: modernized be-not-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ητε γαρ ποτε σκοτος νυν δε φως εν κυριω ως τεκνα φωτος περιπατειτε
transliteration: hte gar pote skotov nun de fwv en kuriw wv tekna fwtov peripateite
draft_translation: For you were sometimes darkness, but now are you light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
ukjv_translation: For all of you were sometimes darkness, but now are all of you light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ο γαρ καρπος του πνευματος εν παση αγαθωσυνη και δικαιοσυνη και αληθεια
transliteration: o gar karpov tou pneumatov en pash agaywsunh kai dikaiosunh kai alhyeia
draft_translation: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
ukjv_translation: (For the fruit of the Spirit (o. pneuma) is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δοκιμαζοντες τι εστιν ευαρεστον τω κυριω
transliteration: dokimazontev ti estin euareston tw kuriw
draft_translation: Proving what is acceptable to the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και μη συγκοινωνειτε τοις εργοις τοις ακαρποις του σκοτους μαλλον δε και ελεγχετε
transliteration: kai mh sugkoinwneite toiv ergoiv toiv akarpoiv tou skotouv mallon de kai elegcete
draft_translation: And do not have fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
ukjv_translation: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

greek_text: τα γαρ κρυφη γινομενα υπ αυτων αισχρον εστιν και λεγειν
transliteration: ta gar krufh ginomena up autwn aiscron estin kai legein
draft_translation: For the secret things being done by them are shameful even to speak of.
ukjv_translation: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

greek_text: τα δε παντα ελεγχομενα υπο του φωτος φανερουται παν γαρ το φανερουμενον φως εστιν
transliteration: ta de panta elegcomena upo tou fwtov faneroutai pan gar to faneroumenon fwv estin
draft_translation: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatever does make manifest is light.
ukjv_translation: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever does make manifest is light.

greek_text: διο λεγει εγειραι ο καθευδων και αναστα εκ των νεκρων και επιφαυσει σοι ο χριστος
transliteration: dio legei egeirai o kayeudwn kai anasta ek twn nekrwn kai epifausei soi o cristov
draft_translation: Therefore he says, Awake you that sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore he says, Awake you that sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light.

greek_text: βλεπετε ουν πως ακριβως περιπατειτε μη ως ασοφοι αλλ ως σοφοι
transliteration: blepete oun pwv akribwv peripateite mh wv asofoi all wv sofoi
draft_translation: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
ukjv_translation: See then that all of you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

greek_text: εξαγοραζομενοι τον καιρον οτι αι ημεραι πονηραι εισιν
transliteration: exagorazomenoi ton kairon oti ai hmerai ponhrai eisin
draft_translation: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
ukjv_translation: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: δια τουτο μη γινεσθε αφρονες αλλα συνιεντες τι το θελημα του κυριου
transliteration: dia touto mh ginesye afronev alla sunientev ti to yelhma tou kuriou
draft_translation: Therefore do not be unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore be all of you not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
review_notes: modernized be-you-not imperative; modernized wherefore; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και μη μεθυσκεσθε οινω εν ω εστιν ασωτια αλλα πληρουσθε εν πνευματι
transliteration: kai mh meyuskesye oinw en w estin aswtia alla plhrousye en pneumati
draft_translation: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
ukjv_translation: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit; (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized be-not imperative; modernized wherein; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: λαλουντες εαυτοις ψαλμοις και υμνοις και ωδαις πνευματικαις αδοντες και ψαλλοντες εν τη καρδια υμων τω κυριω
transliteration: lalountev eautoiv qalmoiv kai umnoiv kai wdaiv pneumatikaiv adontev kai qallontev en th kardia umwn tw kuriw
draft_translation: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
ukjv_translation: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

greek_text: ευχαριστουντες παντοτε υπερ παντων εν ονοματι του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου τω θεω και πατρι
transliteration: eucaristountev pantote uper pantwn en onomati tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou tw yew kai patri
draft_translation: Giving thanks always for all things to God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
ukjv_translation: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: υποτασσομενοι αλληλοις εν φοβω θεου
transliteration: upotassomenoi allhloiv en fobw yeou
draft_translation: Submitting to one another in the fear of God.
ukjv_translation: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

greek_text: αι γυναικες τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν υποτασσεσθε ως τω κυριω
transliteration: ai gunaikev toiv idioiv andrasin upotassesye wv tw kuriw
draft_translation: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οτι ο ανηρ εστιν κεφαλη της γυναικος ως και ο χριστος κεφαλη της εκκλησιας και αυτος εστιν σωτηρ του σωματος
transliteration: oti o anhr estin kefalh thv gunaikov wv kai o cristov kefalh thv ekklhsiav kai autov estin swthr tou swmatov
draft_translation: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the assembly: and he is the Savior of the body.
ukjv_translation: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: αλλ ωσπερ η εκκλησια υποτασσεται τω χριστω ουτως και αι γυναικες τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν εν παντι
transliteration: all wsper h ekklhsia upotassetai tw cristw outwv kai ai gunaikev toiv idioiv andrasin en panti
draft_translation: Therefore as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything.
ukjv_translation: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized everything spelling; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: οι ανδρες αγαπατε τας γυναικας εαυτων καθως και ο χριστος ηγαπησεν την εκκλησιαν και εαυτον παρεδωκεν υπερ αυτης
transliteration: oi andrev agapate tav gunaikav eautwn kaywv kai o cristov hgaphsen thn ekklhsian kai eauton paredwken uper authv
draft_translation: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself for it;
ukjv_translation: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

greek_text: ινα αυτην αγιαση καθαρισας τω λουτρω του υδατος εν ρηματι
transliteration: ina authn agiash kayarisav tw loutrw tou udatov en rhmati
draft_translation: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
ukjv_translation: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, (o. rhema)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ινα παραστηση αυτην εαυτω ενδοξον την εκκλησιαν μη εχουσαν σπιλον η ρυτιδα η τι των τοιουτων αλλ ινα η αγια και αμωμος
transliteration: ina parasthsh authn eautw endoxon thn ekklhsian mh ecousan spilon h rutida h ti twn toioutwn all ina h agia kai amwmov
draft_translation: That he might present it to himself a glorious assembly, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
ukjv_translation: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

greek_text: ουτως οφειλουσιν οι ανδρες αγαπαν τας εαυτων γυναικας ως τα εαυτων σωματα ο αγαπων την εαυτου γυναικα εαυτον αγαπα
transliteration: outwv ofeilousin oi andrev agapan tav eautwn gunaikav wv ta eautwn swmata o agapwn thn eautou gunaika eauton agapa
draft_translation: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. the one who loves his wife loves himself.
ukjv_translation: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself.

greek_text: ουδεις γαρ ποτε την εαυτου σαρκα εμισησεν αλλ εκτρεφει και θαλπει αυτην καθως και ο κυριος την εκκλησιαν
transliteration: oudeiv gar pote thn eautou sarka emishsen all ektrefei kai yalpei authn kaywv kai o kuriov thn ekklhsian
draft_translation: For no one ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord the assembly:
ukjv_translation: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord the church:
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: οτι μελη εσμεν του σωματος αυτου εκ της σαρκος αυτου και εκ των οστεων αυτου
transliteration: oti melh esmen tou swmatov autou ek thv sarkov autou kai ek twn ostewn autou
draft_translation: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
ukjv_translation: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αντι τουτου καταλειψει ανθρωπος τον πατερα αυτου και την μητερα και προσκολληθησεται προς την γυναικα αυτου και εσονται οι δυο εις σαρκα μιαν
transliteration: anti toutou kataleiqei anyrwpov ton patera autou kai thn mhtera kai proskollhyhsetai prov thn gunaika autou kai esontai oi duo eiv sarka mian
draft_translation: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
ukjv_translation: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

greek_text: το μυστηριον τουτο μεγα εστιν εγω δε λεγω εις χριστον και εις την εκκλησιαν
transliteration: to musthrion touto mega estin egw de legw eiv criston kai eiv thn ekklhsian
draft_translation: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
ukjv_translation: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

greek_text: πλην και υμεις οι καθ ενα εκαστος την εαυτου γυναικα ουτως αγαπατω ως εαυτον η δε γυνη ινα φοβηται τον ανδρα
transliteration: plhn kai umeiv oi kay ena ekastov thn eautou gunaika outwv agapatw wv eauton h de gunh ina fobhtai ton andra
draft_translation: Nevertheless also you, each one, let each love his own wife in this way as himself; and let the wife reverence her husband.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

greek_text: τα τεκνα υπακουετε τοις γονευσιν υμων εν κυριω τουτο γαρ εστιν δικαιον
transliteration: ta tekna upakouete toiv goneusin umwn en kuriw touto gar estin dikaion
draft_translation: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
ukjv_translation: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

greek_text: τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα ητις εστιν εντολη πρωτη εν επαγγελια
transliteration: tima ton patera sou kai thn mhtera htiv estin entolh prwth en epaggelia
draft_translation: Honor your father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
ukjv_translation: Honour your father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;

greek_text: ινα ευ σοι γενηται και εση μακροχρονιος επι της γης
transliteration: ina eu soi genhtai kai esh makrocroniov epi thv ghv
draft_translation: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
ukjv_translation: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και οι πατερες μη παροργιζετε τα τεκνα υμων αλλ εκτρεφετε αυτα εν παιδεια και νουθεσια κυριου
