transliteration: kai oi paterev mh parorgizete ta tekna umwn all ektrefete auta en paideia kai nouyesia kuriou
draft_translation: And, you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
ukjv_translation: And, all of you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οι δουλοι υπακουετε τοις κυριοις κατα σαρκα μετα φοβου και τρομου εν απλοτητι της καρδιας υμων ως τω χριστω
transliteration: oi douloi upakouete toiv kurioiv kata sarka meta fobou kai tromou en aplothti thv kardiav umwn wv tw cristw
draft_translation: Slaves, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;
ukjv_translation: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: μη κατ οφθαλμοδουλειαν ως ανθρωπαρεσκοι αλλ ως δουλοι του χριστου ποιουντες το θελημα του θεου εκ ψυχης
transliteration: mh kat ofyalmodouleian wv anyrwpareskoi all wv douloi tou cristou poiountev to yelhma tou yeou ek quchv
draft_translation: Not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but as the slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
ukjv_translation: Not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

greek_text: μετ ευνοιας δουλευοντες ως τω κυριω και ουκ ανθρωποις
transliteration: met eunoiav douleuontev wv tw kuriw kai ouk anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
ukjv_translation: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι ο εαν τι εκαστος ποιηση αγαθον τουτο κομιειται παρα του κυριου ειτε δουλος ειτε ελευθερος
transliteration: eidotev oti o ean ti ekastov poihsh agayon touto komieitai para tou kuriou eite doulov eite eleuyerov
draft_translation: Knowing that whatever good thing anyone does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be slave or free.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized whatsoever; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: και οι κυριοι τα αυτα ποιειτε προς αυτους ανιεντες την απειλην ειδοτες οτι και υμων αυτων ο κυριος εστιν εν ουρανοις και προσωποληψια ουκ εστιν παρ αυτω
transliteration: kai oi kurioi ta auta poieite prov autouv anientev thn apeilhn eidotev oti kai umwn autwn o kuriov estin en ouranoiv kai proswpolhqia ouk estin par autw
draft_translation: And, you masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
ukjv_translation: And, all of you masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: το λοιπον αδελφοι μου ενδυναμουσθε εν κυριω και εν τω κρατει της ισχυος αυτου
transliteration: to loipon adelfoi mou endunamousye en kuriw kai en tw kratei thv iscuov autou
draft_translation: Finally, my brothers, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
ukjv_translation: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ενδυσασθε την πανοπλιαν του θεου προς το δυνασθαι υμας στηναι προς τας μεθοδειας του διαβολου
transliteration: endusasye thn panoplian tou yeou prov to dunasyai umav sthnai prov tav meyodeiav tou diabolou
draft_translation: Put on the whole armour of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
ukjv_translation: Put on the whole armour of God, that all of you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

greek_text: οτι ουκ εστιν ημιν η παλη προς αιμα και σαρκα αλλα προς τας αρχας προς τας εξουσιας προς τους κοσμοκρατορας του σκοτους του αιωνος τουτου προς τα πνευματικα της πονηριας εν τοις επουρανιοις
transliteration: oti ouk estin hmin h palh prov aima kai sarka alla prov tav arcav prov tav exousiav prov touv kosmokratorav tou skotouv tou aiwnov toutou prov ta pneumatika thv ponhriav en toiv epouranioiv
draft_translation: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
ukjv_translation: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
review_notes: modernized wrestle-not wording; rendered this aion as this age

greek_text: δια τουτο αναλαβετε την πανοπλιαν του θεου ινα δυνηθητε αντιστηναι εν τη ημερα τη πονηρα και απαντα κατεργασαμενοι στηναι
transliteration: dia touto analabete thn panoplian tou yeou ina dunhyhte antisthnai en th hmera th ponhra kai apanta katergasamenoi sthnai
draft_translation: Therefore take to you the whole armour of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that all of you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: στητε ουν περιζωσαμενοι την οσφυν υμων εν αληθεια και ενδυσαμενοι τον θωρακα της δικαιοσυνης
transliteration: sthte oun perizwsamenoi thn osfun umwn en alhyeia kai endusamenoi ton ywraka thv dikaiosunhv
draft_translation: Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness;
ukjv_translation: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

greek_text: και υποδησαμενοι τους ποδας εν ετοιμασια του ευαγγελιου της ειρηνης
transliteration: kai upodhsamenoi touv podav en etoimasia tou euaggeliou thv eirhnhv
draft_translation: And your feet shod with the preparation of the good news of peace;
ukjv_translation: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

greek_text: επι πασιν αναλαβοντες τον θυρεον της πιστεως εν ω δυνησεσθε παντα τα βελη του πονηρου τα πεπυρωμενα σβεσαι
transliteration: epi pasin analabontev ton yureon thv pistewv en w dunhsesye panta ta belh tou ponhrou ta pepurwmena sbesai
draft_translation: Above all, taking the shield of faith, with which you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
ukjv_translation: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith all of you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
review_notes: modernized wherewith; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και την περικεφαλαιαν του σωτηριου δεξασθε και την μαχαιραν του πνευματος ο εστιν ρημα θεου
transliteration: kai thn perikefalaian tou swthriou dexasye kai thn macairan tou pneumatov o estin rhma yeou
draft_translation: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
ukjv_translation: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) which is the word (o. rhema) of God:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δια πασης προσευχης και δεησεως προσευχομενοι εν παντι καιρω εν πνευματι και εις αυτο τουτο αγρυπνουντες εν παση προσκαρτερησει και δεησει περι παντων των αγιων
transliteration: dia pashv proseuchv kai dehsewv proseucomenoi en panti kairw en pneumati kai eiv auto touto agrupnountev en pash proskarterhsei kai dehsei peri pantwn twn agiwn
draft_translation: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching to this with all perseverance and supplication for all holy ones;
ukjv_translation: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
review_notes: modernized thereunto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: και υπερ εμου ινα μοι δοθειη λογος εν ανοιξει του στοματος μου εν παρρησια γνωρισαι το μυστηριον του ευαγγελιου
transliteration: kai uper emou ina moi doyeih logov en anoixei tou stomatov mou en parrhsia gnwrisai to musthrion tou euaggeliou
draft_translation: And for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the good news,
ukjv_translation: And for me, that utterance (o. logos) may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: υπερ ου πρεσβευω εν αλυσει ινα εν αυτω παρρησιασωμαι ως δει με λαλησαι
transliteration: uper ou presbeuw en alusei ina en autw parrhsiaswmai wv dei me lalhsai
draft_translation: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
ukjv_translation: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

greek_text: ινα δε ειδητε και υμεις τα κατ εμε τι πρασσω παντα υμιν γνωρισει τυχικος ο αγαπητος αδελφος και πιστος διακονος εν κυριω
transliteration: ina de eidhte kai umeiv ta kat eme ti prassw panta umin gnwrisei tucikov o agaphtov adelfov kai pistov diakonov en kuriw
draft_translation: But that you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
ukjv_translation: But that all of you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ον επεμψα προς υμας εις αυτο τουτο ινα γνωτε τα περι ημων και παρακαλεση τας καρδιας υμων
transliteration: on epemqa prov umav eiv auto touto ina gnwte ta peri hmwn kai parakalesh tav kardiav umwn
draft_translation: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
ukjv_translation: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that all of you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειρηνη τοις αδελφοις και αγαπη μετα πιστεως απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: eirhnh toiv adelfoiv kai agaph meta pistewv apo yeou patrov kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Peace be to the brethren, and love (o. agape) with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: η χαρις μετα παντων των αγαπωντων τον κυριον ημων ιησουν χριστον εν αφθαρσια
transliteration: h cariv meta pantwn twn agapwntwn ton kurion hmwn ihsoun criston en afyarsia
draft_translation: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: παυλος και τιμοθεος δουλοι ιησου χριστου πασιν τοις αγιοις εν χριστω ιησου τοις ουσιν εν φιλιπποις συν επισκοποις και διακονοις
transliteration: paulov kai timoyeov douloi ihsou cristou pasin toiv agioiv en cristw ihsou toiv ousin en filippoiv sun episkopoiv kai diakonoiv
draft_translation: Paul and Timothy, the slaves of Jesus Christ, to all the holy ones in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
ukjv_translation: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered diakonos as servant; rendered doulos-family wording as slave; rendered episkopos as overseer; rendered hagioi as holy ones; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου επι παση τη μνεια υμων
transliteration: eucaristw tw yew mou epi pash th mneia umwn
draft_translation: I thank my God at every remembrance of you,
ukjv_translation: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

greek_text: παντοτε εν παση δεησει μου υπερ παντων υμων μετα χαρας την δεησιν ποιουμενος
transliteration: pantote en pash dehsei mou uper pantwn umwn meta carav thn dehsin poioumenov
draft_translation: always in every prayer of mine for you all, making my prayer with joy,
ukjv_translation: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

greek_text: επι τη κοινωνια υμων εις το ευαγγελιον απο πρωτης ημερας αχρι του νυν
transliteration: epi th koinwnia umwn eiv to euaggelion apo prwthv hmerav acri tou nun
draft_translation: For your fellowship in the good news from the first day until now;
ukjv_translation: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

greek_text: πεποιθως αυτο τουτο οτι ο εναρξαμενος εν υμιν εργον αγαθον επιτελεσει αχρις ημερας ιησου χριστου
transliteration: pepoiywv auto touto oti o enarxamenov en umin ergon agayon epitelesei acriv hmerav ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Being confident of this very thing, that the one who has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

greek_text: καθως εστιν δικαιον εμοι τουτο φρονειν υπερ παντων υμων δια το εχειν με εν τη καρδια υμας εν τε τοις δεσμοις μου και τη απολογια και βεβαιωσει του ευαγγελιου συγκοινωνους μου της χαριτος παντας υμας οντας
transliteration: kaywv estin dikaion emoi touto fronein uper pantwn umwn dia to ecein me en th kardia umav en te toiv desmoiv mou kai th apologia kai bebaiwsei tou euaggeliou sugkoinwnouv mou thv caritov pantav umav ontav
draft_translation: Even as it is fitting for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the good news, you all are partakers of my grace.
ukjv_translation: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, all of you all are partakers of my grace.
review_notes: modernized meet-as-fitting; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: μαρτυς γαρ μου εστιν ο θεος ως επιποθω παντας υμας εν σπλαγχνοις ιησου χριστου
transliteration: martuv gar mou estin o yeov wv epipoyw pantav umav en splagcnoiv ihsou cristou
draft_translation: For God is my witness, how I long for you all in the deep affection of Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

greek_text: και τουτο προσευχομαι ινα η αγαπη υμων ετι μαλλον και μαλλον περισσευη εν επιγνωσει και παση αισθησει
transliteration: kai touto proseucomai ina h agaph umwn eti mallon kai mallon perisseuh en epignwsei kai pash aisyhsei
draft_translation: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
ukjv_translation: And this I pray, that your love (o. agape) may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εις το δοκιμαζειν υμας τα διαφεροντα ινα ητε ειλικρινεις και απροσκοποι εις ημεραν χριστου
transliteration: eiv to dokimazein umav ta diaferonta ina hte eilikrineiv kai aproskopoi eiv hmeran cristou
draft_translation: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense till the day of Christ.
ukjv_translation: That all of you may approve things that are excellent; that all of you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.
review_notes: modernized offence spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: πεπληρωμενοι καρπων δικαιοσυνης των δια ιησου χριστου εις δοξαν και επαινον θεου
transliteration: peplhrwmenoi karpwn dikaiosunhv twn dia ihsou cristou eiv doxan kai epainon yeou
draft_translation: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
ukjv_translation: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

greek_text: γινωσκειν δε υμας βουλομαι αδελφοι οτι τα κατ εμε μαλλον εις προκοπην του ευαγγελιου εληλυθεν
transliteration: ginwskein de umav boulomai adelfoi oti ta kat eme mallon eiv prokophn tou euaggeliou elhluyen
draft_translation: But I would you should understand, brothers, that the things which happened to me have fallen out rather to the furtherance of the good news;
ukjv_translation: But I would all of you should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ωστε τους δεσμους μου φανερους εν χριστω γενεσθαι εν ολω τω πραιτωριω και τοις λοιποις πασιν
transliteration: wste touv desmouv mou fanerouv en cristw genesyai en olw tw praitwriw kai toiv loipoiv pasin
draft_translation: so that my bonds became manifest in Christ in the whole praetorium, and to all the rest;
ukjv_translation: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

greek_text: και τους πλειονας των αδελφων εν κυριω πεποιθοτας τοις δεσμοις μου περισσοτερως τολμαν αφοβως τον λογον λαλειν
transliteration: kai touv pleionav twn adelfwn en kuriw pepoiyotav toiv desmoiv mou perissoterwv tolman afobwv ton logon lalein
draft_translation: And many of the brothers in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
ukjv_translation: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word (o. logos) without fear.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: τινες μεν και δια φθονον και εριν τινες δε και δι ευδοκιαν τον χριστον κηρυσσουσιν
transliteration: tinev men kai dia fyonon kai erin tinev de kai di eudokian ton criston khrussousin
draft_translation: Some indeed also preach Christ through envy and strife, but some also through good will:
ukjv_translation: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

greek_text: οι μεν εξ εριθειας τον χριστον καταγγελλουσιν ουχ αγνως οιομενοι θλιψιν επιφερειν τοις δεσμοις μου
transliteration: oi men ex eriyeiav ton criston kataggellousin ouc agnwv oiomenoi yliqin epiferein toiv desmoiv mou
draft_translation: Those from selfish ambition proclaim Christ, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
ukjv_translation: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

greek_text: οι δε εξ αγαπης ειδοτες οτι εις απολογιαν του ευαγγελιου κειμαι
transliteration: oi de ex agaphv eidotev oti eiv apologian tou euaggeliou keimai
draft_translation: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the good news.
ukjv_translation: But the other of love, (o. agape) knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: τι γαρ πλην παντι τροπω ειτε προφασει ειτε αληθεια χριστος καταγγελλεται και εν τουτω χαιρω αλλα και χαρησομαι
transliteration: ti gar plhn panti tropw eite profasei eite alhyeia cristov kataggelletai kai en toutw cairw alla kai carhsomai
draft_translation: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I in it do rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.
ukjv_translation: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

greek_text: οιδα γαρ οτι τουτο μοι αποβησεται εις σωτηριαν δια της υμων δεησεως και επιχορηγιας του πνευματος ιησου χριστου
transliteration: oida gar oti touto moi apobhsetai eiv swthrian dia thv umwn dehsewv kai epicorhgiav tou pneumatov ihsou cristou
draft_translation: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
ukjv_translation: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit (o. pneuma) of Jesus Christ,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: κατα την αποκαραδοκιαν και ελπιδα μου οτι εν ουδενι αισχυνθησομαι αλλ εν παση παρρησια ως παντοτε και νυν μεγαλυνθησεται χριστος εν τω σωματι μου ειτε δια ζωης ειτε δια θανατου
transliteration: kata thn apokaradokian kai elpida mou oti en oudeni aiscunyhsomai all en pash parrhsia wv pantote kai nun megalunyhsetai cristov en tw swmati mou eite dia zwhv eite dia yanatou
draft_translation: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
ukjv_translation: According to my earn expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

greek_text: εμοι γαρ το ζην χριστος και το αποθανειν κερδος
transliteration: emoi gar to zhn cristov kai to apoyanein kerdov
draft_translation: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
ukjv_translation: In order to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

greek_text: ει δε το ζην εν σαρκι τουτο μοι καρπος εργου και τι αιρησομαι ου γνωριζω
transliteration: ei de to zhn en sarki touto moi karpov ergou kai ti airhsomai ou gnwrizw
draft_translation: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labor: yet what I shall choose I do not know.
ukjv_translation: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I know not.
review_notes: modernized know-not idiom; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: συνεχομαι γαρ εκ των δυο την επιθυμιαν εχων εις το αναλυσαι και συν χριστω ειναι πολλω μαλλον κρεισσον
transliteration: sunecomai gar ek twn duo thn epiyumian ecwn eiv to analusai kai sun cristw einai pollw mallon kreisson
draft_translation: For I am pressed between two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
ukjv_translation: For I am in a strait between two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

greek_text: το δε επιμενειν εν τη σαρκι αναγκαιοτερον δι υμας
transliteration: to de epimenein en th sarki anagkaioteron di umav
draft_translation: But to remain in the flesh is more necessary for you.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more necessary for you.

greek_text: και τουτο πεποιθως οιδα οτι μενω και συμπαραμενω πασιν υμιν εις την υμων προκοπην και χαραν της πιστεως
transliteration: kai touto pepoiywv oida oti menw kai sumparamenw pasin umin eiv thn umwn prokophn kai caran thv pistewv
draft_translation: And being confident of this, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy of the faith;
ukjv_translation: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

greek_text: ινα το καυχημα υμων περισσευη εν χριστω ιησου εν εμοι δια της εμης παρουσιας παλιν προς υμας
transliteration: ina to kauchma umwn perisseuh en cristw ihsou en emoi dia thv emhv parousiav palin prov umav
draft_translation: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
ukjv_translation: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

greek_text: μονον αξιως του ευαγγελιου του χριστου πολιτευεσθε ινα ειτε ελθων και ιδων υμας ειτε απων ακουσω τα περι υμων οτι στηκετε εν ενι πνευματι μια ψυχη συναθλουντες τη πιστει του ευαγγελιου
transliteration: monon axiwv tou euaggeliou tou cristou politeuesye ina eite elywn kai idwn umav eite apwn akousw ta peri umwn oti sthkete en eni pneumati mia quch sunaylountev th pistei tou euaggeliou
draft_translation: Only let your conduct be as it becomes the good news of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the good news;
ukjv_translation: Only let your conversation be as it becomes the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that all of you stand fast in one spirit, (o. pneuma) with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
review_notes: modernized conversation as conduct; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και μη πτυρομενοι εν μηδενι υπο των αντικειμενων ητις αυτοις μεν εστιν ενδειξις απωλειας υμιν δε σωτηριας και τουτο απο θεου
transliteration: kai mh pturomenoi en mhdeni upo twn antikeimenwn htiv autoiv men estin endeixiv apwleiav umin de swthriav kai touto apo yeou
draft_translation: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
ukjv_translation: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

greek_text: οτι υμιν εχαρισθη το υπερ χριστου ου μονον το εις αυτον πιστευειν αλλα και το υπερ αυτου πασχειν
transliteration: oti umin ecarisyh to uper cristou ou monon to eiv auton pisteuein alla kai to uper autou pascein
draft_translation: For to you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
ukjv_translation: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

greek_text: τον αυτον αγωνα εχοντες οιον ειδετε εν εμοι και νυν ακουετε εν εμοι
transliteration: ton auton agwna econtev oion eidete en emoi kai nun akouete en emoi
draft_translation: Having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
ukjv_translation: Having the same conflict which all of you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

greek_text: ει τις ουν παρακλησις εν χριστω ει τι παραμυθιον αγαπης ει τις κοινωνια πνευματος ει τινα σπλαγχνα και οικτιρμοι
transliteration: ei tiv oun paraklhsiv en cristw ei ti paramuyion agaphv ei tiv koinwnia pneumatov ei tina splagcna kai oiktirmoi
draft_translation: If therefore there is any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any deep affections and mercies,
ukjv_translation: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, (o. agape) if any fellowship of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) if any bowels and mercies,

greek_text: πληρωσατε μου την χαραν ινα το αυτο φρονητε την αυτην αγαπην εχοντες συμψυχοι το εν φρονουντες
transliteration: plhrwsate mou thn caran ina to auto fronhte thn authn agaphn econtev sumqucoi to en fronountev
draft_translation: Fulfill you my joy, that you be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
ukjv_translation: Fulfill all of you my joy, that all of you be likeminded, having the same love, (o. agape) being of one accord, of one mind.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μηδεν κατα εριθειαν η κενοδοξιαν αλλα τη ταπεινοφροσυνη αλληλους ηγουμενοι υπερεχοντας εαυτων
transliteration: mhden kata eriyeian h kenodoxian alla th tapeinofrosunh allhlouv hgoumenoi uperecontav eautwn
draft_translation: Let nothing be done through strife or conceit; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
ukjv_translation: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

greek_text: μη τα εαυτων εκαστος σκοπειτε αλλα και τα ετερων εκαστος
transliteration: mh ta eautwn ekastov skopeite alla kai ta eterwn ekastov
draft_translation: Let each not look to his own things, but each also to the things of others.
ukjv_translation: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

greek_text: τουτο γαρ φρονεισθω εν υμιν ο και εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: touto gar froneisyw en umin o kai en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: For let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

greek_text: ος εν μορφη θεου υπαρχων ουχ αρπαγμον ηγησατο το ειναι ισα θεω
transliteration: ov en morfh yeou uparcwn ouc arpagmon hghsato to einai isa yew
draft_translation: who, existing in the form of God, did not consider being equal with God a thing to be seized:
ukjv_translation: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

greek_text: αλλ εαυτον εκενωσεν μορφην δουλου λαβων εν ομοιωματι ανθρωπων γενομενος
transliteration: all eauton ekenwsen morfhn doulou labwn en omoiwmati anyrwpwn genomenov
draft_translation: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a slave, and was made in the likeness of men:
ukjv_translation: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

greek_text: και σχηματι ευρεθεις ως ανθρωπος εταπεινωσεν εαυτον γενομενος υπηκοος μεχρι θανατου θανατου δε σταυρου
transliteration: kai schmati eureyeiv wv anyrwpov etapeinwsen eauton genomenov uphkoov mecri yanatou yanatou de staurou
draft_translation: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient to death, even the death of the cross.
ukjv_translation: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

greek_text: διο και ο θεος αυτον υπερυψωσεν και εχαρισατο αυτω ονομα το υπερ παν ονομα
transliteration: dio kai o yeov auton uperuqwsen kai ecarisato autw onoma to uper pan onoma
draft_translation: Therefore God also has highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore God also has highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

greek_text: ινα εν τω ονοματι ιησου παν γονυ καμψη επουρανιων και επιγειων και καταχθονιων
transliteration: ina en tw onomati ihsou pan gonu kamqh epouraniwn kai epigeiwn kai katacyoniwn
draft_translation: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth;
ukjv_translation: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

greek_text: και πασα γλωσσα εξομολογησηται οτι κυριος ιησους χριστος εις δοξαν θεου πατρος
transliteration: kai pasa glwssa exomologhshtai oti kuriov ihsouv cristov eiv doxan yeou patrov
draft_translation: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
ukjv_translation: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

greek_text: ωστε αγαπητοι μου καθως παντοτε υπηκουσατε μη ως εν τη παρουσια μου μονον αλλα νυν πολλω μαλλον εν τη απουσια μου μετα φοβου και τρομου την εαυτων σωτηριαν κατεργαζεσθε
transliteration: wste agaphtoi mou kaywv pantote uphkousate mh wv en th parousia mou monon alla nun pollw mallon en th apousia mou meta fobou kai tromou thn eautwn swthrian katergazesye
draft_translation: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, my beloved, as all of you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ο θεος γαρ εστιν ο ενεργων εν υμιν και το θελειν και το ενεργειν υπερ της ευδοκιας
transliteration: o yeov gar estin o energwn en umin kai to yelein kai to energein uper thv eudokiav
draft_translation: For it is God who works in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
ukjv_translation: For it is God which works in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

greek_text: παντα ποιειτε χωρις γογγυσμων και διαλογισμων
transliteration: panta poieite cwriv goggusmwn kai dialogismwn
draft_translation: Do all things without grumblings and reasonings:
ukjv_translation: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

greek_text: ινα γενησθε αμεμπτοι και ακεραιοι τεκνα θεου αμωμητα εν μεσω γενεας σκολιας και διεστραμμενης εν οις φαινεσθε ως φωστηρες εν κοσμω
transliteration: ina genhsye amemptoi kai akeraioi tekna yeou amwmhta en mesw geneav skoliav kai diestrammenhv en oiv fainesye wv fwsthrev en kosmw
draft_translation: That you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom you shine as lights in the world;
ukjv_translation: That all of you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom all of you shine as lights in the world;

greek_text: λογον ζωης επεχοντες εις καυχημα εμοι εις ημεραν χριστου οτι ουκ εις κενον εδραμον ουδε εις κενον εκοπιασα
transliteration: logon zwhv epecontev eiv kauchma emoi eiv hmeran cristou oti ouk eiv kenon edramon oude eiv kenon ekopiasa
draft_translation: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither labored in vain.
ukjv_translation: Holding forth the word (o. logos) of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αλλ ει και σπενδομαι επι τη θυσια και λειτουργια της πιστεως υμων χαιρω και συγχαιρω πασιν υμιν
transliteration: all ei kai spendomai epi th yusia kai leitourgia thv pistewv umwn cairw kai sugcairw pasin umin
draft_translation: Yes, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
ukjv_translation: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

greek_text: το δ αυτο και υμεις χαιρετε και συγχαιρετε μοι
transliteration: to d auto kai umeiv cairete kai sugcairete moi
draft_translation: For the same cause also do you joy, and rejoice with me.
ukjv_translation: For the same cause also do all of you joy, and rejoice with me.

greek_text: ελπιζω δε εν κυριω ιησου τιμοθεον ταχεως πεμψαι υμιν ινα καγω ευψυχω γνους τα περι υμων
transliteration: elpizw de en kuriw ihsou timoyeon tacewv pemqai umin ina kagw euqucw gnouv ta peri umwn
draft_translation: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
ukjv_translation: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: ουδενα γαρ εχω ισοψυχον οστις γνησιως τα περι υμων μεριμνησει
transliteration: oudena gar ecw isoqucon ostiv gnhsiwv ta peri umwn merimnhsei
draft_translation: For I have no one likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
ukjv_translation: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

greek_text: οι παντες γαρ τα εαυτων ζητουσιν ου τα του χριστου ιησου
transliteration: oi pantev gar ta eautwn zhtousin ou ta tou cristou ihsou
draft_translation: For all seek their own things, not the things of Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

greek_text: την δε δοκιμην αυτου γινωσκετε οτι ως πατρι τεκνον συν εμοι εδουλευσεν εις το ευαγγελιον
transliteration: thn de dokimhn autou ginwskete oti wv patri teknon sun emoi edouleusen eiv to euaggelion
draft_translation: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the good news.
ukjv_translation: But all of you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: τουτον μεν ουν ελπιζω πεμψαι ως αν απιδω τα περι εμε εξαυτης
transliteration: touton men oun elpizw pemqai wv an apidw ta peri eme exauthv
draft_translation: Him therefore I hope to send soon, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
ukjv_translation: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

greek_text: πεποιθα δε εν κυριω οτι και αυτος ταχεως ελευσομαι
transliteration: pepoiya de en kuriw oti kai autov tacewv eleusomai
draft_translation: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
ukjv_translation: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

greek_text: αναγκαιον δε ηγησαμην επαφροδιτον τον αδελφον και συνεργον και συστρατιωτην μου υμων δε αποστολον και λειτουργον της χρειας μου πεμψαι προς υμας
transliteration: anagkaion de hghsamhn epafroditon ton adelfon kai sunergon kai sustratiwthn mou umwn de apostolon kai leitourgon thv creiav mou pemqai prov umav
draft_translation: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labor, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and the one who ministered to my wants.
ukjv_translation: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: επειδη επιποθων ην παντας υμας και αδημονων διοτι ηκουσατε οτι ησθενησεν
transliteration: epeidh epipoywn hn pantav umav kai adhmonwn dioti hkousate oti hsyenhsen
draft_translation: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because you had heard that he had been sick.
ukjv_translation: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that all of you had heard that he had been sick.
review_notes: modernized because-that wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και γαρ ησθενησεν παραπλησιον θανατω αλλ ο θεος αυτον ηλεησεν ουκ αυτον δε μονον αλλα και εμε ινα μη λυπην επι λυπη σχω
transliteration: kai gar hsyenhsen paraplhsion yanatw all o yeov auton hlehsen ouk auton de monon alla kai eme ina mh luphn epi luph scw
draft_translation: For indeed he was sick near to death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
ukjv_translation: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized nigh

greek_text: σπουδαιοτερως ουν επεμψα αυτον ινα ιδοντες αυτον παλιν χαρητε καγω αλυποτερος ω
transliteration: spoudaioterwv oun epemqa auton ina idontev auton palin carhte kagw alupoterov w
draft_translation: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
ukjv_translation: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when all of you see him again, all of you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

greek_text: προσδεχεσθε ουν αυτον εν κυριω μετα πασης χαρας και τους τοιουτους εντιμους εχετε
transliteration: prosdecesye oun auton en kuriw meta pashv carav kai touv toioutouv entimouv ecete
draft_translation: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
ukjv_translation: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

greek_text: οτι δια το εργον του χριστου μεχρι θανατου ηγγισεν παραβουλευσαμενος τη ψυχη ινα αναπληρωση το υμων υστερημα της προς με λειτουργιας
transliteration: oti dia to ergon tou cristou mecri yanatou hggisen parabouleusamenov th quch ina anaplhrwsh to umwn usterhma thv prov me leitourgiav
draft_translation: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
ukjv_translation: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized nigh

greek_text: το λοιπον αδελφοι μου χαιρετε εν κυριω τα αυτα γραφειν υμιν εμοι μεν ουκ οκνηρον υμιν δε ασφαλες
transliteration: to loipon adelfoi mou cairete en kuriw ta auta grafein umin emoi men ouk oknhron umin de asfalev
draft_translation: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
ukjv_translation: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: βλεπετε τους κυνας βλεπετε τους κακους εργατας βλεπετε την κατατομην
transliteration: blepete touv kunav blepete touv kakouv ergatav blepete thn katatomhn
draft_translation: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the mutilation.
ukjv_translation: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

greek_text: ημεις γαρ εσμεν η περιτομη οι πνευματι θεω λατρευοντες και καυχωμενοι εν χριστω ιησου και ουκ εν σαρκι πεποιθοτες
transliteration: hmeiv gar esmen h peritomh oi pneumati yew latreuontev kai kaucwmenoi en cristw ihsou kai ouk en sarki pepoiyotev
draft_translation: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
ukjv_translation: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, (o. pneuma) and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: καιπερ εγω εχων πεποιθησιν και εν σαρκι ει τις δοκει αλλος πεποιθεναι εν σαρκι εγω μαλλον
transliteration: kaiper egw ecwn pepoiyhsin kai en sarki ei tiv dokei allov pepoiyenai en sarki egw mallon
draft_translation: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has of which he might trust in the flesh, I more:
ukjv_translation: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

greek_text: περιτομη οκταημερος εκ γενους ισραηλ φυλης βενιαμιν εβραιος εξ εβραιων κατα νομον φαρισαιος
transliteration: peritomh oktahmerov ek genouv israhl fulhv beniamin ebraiov ex ebraiwn kata nomon farisaiov
draft_translation: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of the Hebrews; as concerning the law, a Pharisee;
ukjv_translation: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as concerning the law, a Pharisee;

greek_text: κατα ζηλον διωκων την εκκλησιαν κατα δικαιοσυνην την εν νομω γενομενος αμεμπτος
transliteration: kata zhlon diwkwn thn ekklhsian kata dikaiosunhn thn en nomw genomenov amemptov
draft_translation: Concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
ukjv_translation: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

greek_text: αλλ ατινα ην μοι κερδη ταυτα ηγημαι δια τον χριστον ζημιαν
transliteration: all atina hn moi kerdh tauta hghmai dia ton criston zhmian
draft_translation: But whatever things were gains to me, these I have counted loss because of Christ.
ukjv_translation: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

greek_text: αλλα μενουνγε και ηγουμαι παντα ζημιαν ειναι δια το υπερεχον της γνωσεως χριστου ιησου του κυριου μου δι ον τα παντα εζημιωθην και ηγουμαι σκυβαλα ειναι ινα χριστον κερδησω
transliteration: alla menounge kai hgoumai panta zhmian einai dia to uperecon thv gnwsewv cristou ihsou tou kuriou mou di on ta panta ezhmiwyhn kai hgoumai skubala einai ina criston kerdhsw
draft_translation: Yes doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
ukjv_translation: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
review_notes: modernized yea; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και ευρεθω εν αυτω μη εχων εμην δικαιοσυνην την εκ νομου αλλα την δια πιστεως χριστου την εκ θεου δικαιοσυνην επι τη πιστει
transliteration: kai eureyw en autw mh ecwn emhn dikaiosunhn thn ek nomou alla thn dia pistewv cristou thn ek yeou dikaiosunhn epi th pistei
draft_translation: And be found in him, not having my own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
ukjv_translation: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

greek_text: του γνωναι αυτον και την δυναμιν της αναστασεως αυτου και την κοινωνιαν των παθηματων αυτου συμμορφουμενος τω θανατω αυτου
transliteration: tou gnwnai auton kai thn dunamin thv anastasewv autou kai thn koinwnian twn payhmatwn autou summorfoumenov tw yanatw autou
draft_translation: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable to his death;
ukjv_translation: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

greek_text: ει πως καταντησω εις την εξαναστασιν των νεκρων
transliteration: ei pwv katanthsw eiv thn exanastasin twn nekrwn
draft_translation: If by any means I might attain to the resurrection of the dead.
ukjv_translation: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

greek_text: ουχ οτι ηδη ελαβον η ηδη τετελειωμαι διωκω δε ει και καταλαβω εφ ω και κατεληφθην υπο του χριστου ιησου
transliteration: ouc oti hdh elabon h hdh teteleiwmai diwkw de ei kai katalabw ef w kai katelhfyhn upo tou cristou ihsou
draft_translation: Not that I already obtained, or have already been perfected: but I press on, if also I may lay hold of that for which also I was laid hold of by Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

greek_text: αδελφοι εγω εμαυτον ου λογιζομαι κατειληφεναι εν δε τα μεν οπισω επιλανθανομενος τοις δε εμπροσθεν επεκτεινομενος
transliteration: adelfoi egw emauton ou logizomai kateilhfenai en de ta men opisw epilanyanomenov toiv de emprosyen epekteinomenov
draft_translation: Brothers, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth to those things which are before,
ukjv_translation: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: κατα σκοπον διωκω επι το βραβειον της ανω κλησεως του θεου εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: kata skopon diwkw epi to brabeion thv anw klhsewv tou yeou en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward calling of God in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

greek_text: οσοι ουν τελειοι τουτο φρονωμεν και ει τι ετερως φρονειτε και τουτο ο θεος υμιν αποκαλυψει
transliteration: osoi oun teleioi touto fronwmen kai ei ti eterwv froneite kai touto o yeov umin apokaluqei
draft_translation: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in anything you be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this to you.
ukjv_translation: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing all of you be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
review_notes: modernized anything spelling; modernized archaic directional unto; modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: πλην εις ο εφθασαμεν τω αυτω στοιχειν κανονι το αυτο φρονειν
transliteration: plhn eiv o efyasamen tw autw stoicein kanoni to auto fronein
draft_translation: Nevertheless, to what we have attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

greek_text: συμμιμηται μου γινεσθε αδελφοι και σκοπειτε τους ουτως περιπατουντας καθως εχετε τυπον ημας
transliteration: summimhtai mou ginesye adelfoi kai skopeite touv outwv peripatountav kaywv ecete tupon hmav
draft_translation: Brothers, be followers together of me, and mark those who walk so as you have us for an example.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as all of you have us for an example.
review_notes: modernized them-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: πολλοι γαρ περιπατουσιν ους πολλακις ελεγον υμιν νυν δε και κλαιων λεγω τους εχθρους του σταυρου του χριστου
transliteration: polloi gar peripatousin ouv pollakiv elegon umin nun de kai klaiwn legw touv ecyrouv tou staurou tou cristou
draft_translation: (For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now also tell you weeping, as enemies of the cross of Christ:
ukjv_translation: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

greek_text: ων το τελος απωλεια ων ο θεος η κοιλια και η δοξα εν τη αισχυνη αυτων οι τα επιγεια φρονουντες
transliteration: wn to telov apwleia wn o yeov h koilia kai h doxa en th aiscunh autwn oi ta epigeia fronountev
draft_translation: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
ukjv_translation: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ημων γαρ το πολιτευμα εν ουρανοις υπαρχει εξ ου και σωτηρα απεκδεχομεθα κυριον ιησουν χριστον
transliteration: hmwn gar to politeuma en ouranoiv uparcei ex ou kai swthra apekdecomeya kurion ihsoun criston
draft_translation: For our conduct is in heaven; from where also we look for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
review_notes: fixed from-whence artifact; modernized Saviour spelling; modernized conversation as conduct; modernized whence; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ος μετασχηματισει το σωμα της ταπεινωσεως ημων εις το γενεσθαι αυτο συμμορφον τω σωματι της δοξης αυτου κατα την ενεργειαν του δυνασθαι αυτον και υποταξαι εαυτω τα παντα
transliteration: ov metaschmatisei to swma thv tapeinwsewv hmwn eiv to genesyai auto summorfon tw swmati thv doxhv autou kata thn energeian tou dunasyai auton kai upotaxai eautw ta panta
draft_translation: who will transform our body of humiliation, that it may be conformed to his body of glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subdue all things to himself.
ukjv_translation: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized shall-change wording; modernized whereby; rendered soma tapeinoseos as body of humiliation; rendered symmorphos as conformed

greek_text: ωστε αδελφοι μου αγαπητοι και επιποθητοι χαρα και στεφανος μου ουτως στηκετε εν κυριω αγαπητοι
transliteration: wste adelfoi mou agaphtoi kai epipoyhtoi cara kai stefanov mou outwv sthkete en kuriw agaphtoi
draft_translation: Therefore, my brothers dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
ukjv_translation: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ευοδιαν παρακαλω και συντυχην παρακαλω το αυτο φρονειν εν κυριω
transliteration: euodian parakalw kai suntuchn parakalw to auto fronein en kuriw
draft_translation: I plead to Euodias, and plead to Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: I plead to Euodias, and plead to Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

greek_text: και ερωτω και σε συζυγε γνησιε συλλαμβανου αυταις αιτινες εν τω ευαγγελιω συνηθλησαν μοι μετα και κλημεντος και των λοιπων συνεργων μου ων τα ονοματα εν βιβλω ζωης
transliteration: kai erwtw kai se suzuge gnhsie sullambanou autaiv aitinev en tw euaggeliw sunhylhsan moi meta kai klhmentov kai twn loipwn sunergwn mou wn ta onomata en biblw zwhv
draft_translation: And I implore you also, true yokefellow, help those women who labored with me in the good news, with Clement also, and with other my fellow laborers, whose names are in the book of life.
ukjv_translation: And I implore you also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellow labourers, whose names are in the book of life.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; modernized personal which as who; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: χαιρετε εν κυριω παντοτε παλιν ερω χαιρετε
transliteration: cairete en kuriw pantote palin erw cairete
draft_translation: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.
ukjv_translation: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.

greek_text: το επιεικες υμων γνωσθητω πασιν ανθρωποις ο κυριος εγγυς
transliteration: to epieikev umwn gnwsyhtw pasin anyrwpoiv o kuriov egguv
draft_translation: Let your moderation be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
ukjv_translation: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: μηδεν μεριμνατε αλλ εν παντι τη προσευχη και τη δεησει μετα ευχαριστιας τα αιτηματα υμων γνωριζεσθω προς τον θεον
transliteration: mhden merimnate all en panti th proseuch kai th dehsei meta eucaristiav ta aithmata umwn gnwrizesyw prov ton yeon
draft_translation: Be careful for nothing; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
ukjv_translation: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized everything spelling

greek_text: και η ειρηνη του θεου η υπερεχουσα παντα νουν φρουρησει τας καρδιας υμων και τα νοηματα υμων εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: kai h eirhnh tou yeou h uperecousa panta noun frourhsei tav kardiav umwn kai ta nohmata umwn en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: And the peace of God, who passes all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: And the peace of God, which passes all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

greek_text: το λοιπον αδελφοι οσα εστιν αληθη οσα σεμνα οσα δικαια οσα αγνα οσα προσφιλη οσα ευφημα ει τις αρετη και ει τις επαινος ταυτα λογιζεσθε
transliteration: to loipon adelfoi osa estin alhyh osa semna osa dikaia osa agna osa prosfilh osa eufhma ei tiv areth kai ei tiv epainov tauta logizesye
draft_translation: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honest, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think on these things.
ukjv_translation: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
review_notes: modernized if-there-be idiom; modernized whatsoever; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: α και εμαθετε και παρελαβετε και ηκουσατε και ειδετε εν εμοι ταυτα πρασσετε και ο θεος της ειρηνης εσται μεθ υμων
transliteration: a kai emayete kai parelabete kai hkousate kai eidete en emoi tauta prassete kai o yeov thv eirhnhv estai mey umwn
draft_translation: Those things, which you have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
ukjv_translation: Those things, which all of you have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

greek_text: εχαρην δε εν κυριω μεγαλως οτι ηδη ποτε ανεθαλετε το υπερ εμου φρονειν εφ ω και εφρονειτε ηκαιρεισθε δε
transliteration: ecarhn de en kuriw megalwv oti hdh pote aneyalete to uper emou fronein ef w kai efroneite hkaireisye de
draft_translation: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again; in which you were also careful, but you lacked opportunity.
ukjv_translation: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again; wherein all of you were also careful, but all of you lacked opportunity.
review_notes: modernized wherein; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουχ οτι καθ υστερησιν λεγω εγω γαρ εμαθον εν οις ειμι αυταρκης ειναι
transliteration: ouc oti kay usterhsin legw egw gar emayon en oiv eimi autarkhv einai
draft_translation: Not that I speak in respect of lack: for I have learned, in whatever state I am, with it to be content.
ukjv_translation: Not that I speak in respect of lack: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

greek_text: οιδα και ταπεινουσθαι οιδα και περισσευειν εν παντι και εν πασιν μεμυημαι και χορταζεσθαι και πειναν και περισσευειν και υστερεισθαι
transliteration: oida kai tapeinousyai oida kai perisseuein en panti kai en pasin memuhmai kai cortazesyai kai peinan kai perisseuein kai ustereisyai
draft_translation: I know both how to be brought low, and I know how to abound: everywhere and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
ukjv_translation: I know both how to be brought low, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

greek_text: παντα ισχυω εν τω ενδυναμουντι με χριστω
transliteration: panta iscuw en tw endunamounti me cristw
draft_translation: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
ukjv_translation: I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me.

greek_text: πλην καλως εποιησατε συγκοινωνησαντες μου τη θλιψει
transliteration: plhn kalwv epoihsate sugkoinwnhsantev mou th yliqei
draft_translation: Notwithstanding you have well done, that you did communicate with my affliction.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding all of you have well done, that all of you did communicate with my affliction.

greek_text: οιδατε δε και υμεις φιλιππησιοι οτι εν αρχη του ευαγγελιου οτε εξηλθον απο μακεδονιας ουδεμια μοι εκκλησια εκοινωνησεν εις λογον δοσεως και ληψεως ει μη υμεις μονοι
transliteration: oidate de kai umeiv filipphsioi oti en arch tou euaggeliou ote exhlyon apo makedoniav oudemia moi ekklhsia ekoinwnhsen eiv logon dosewv kai lhqewv ei mh umeiv monoi
draft_translation: Now you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the good news, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but you only.
ukjv_translation: Now all of you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning (o. logos) giving and receiving, but all of you only.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: οτι και εν θεσσαλονικη και απαξ και δις εις την χρειαν μοι επεμψατε
transliteration: oti kai en yessalonikh kai apax kai div eiv thn creian moi epemqate
draft_translation: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity.
ukjv_translation: For even in Thessalonica all of you sent once and again unto my necessity.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουχ οτι επιζητω το δομα αλλ επιζητω τον καρπον τον πλεοναζοντα εις λογον υμων
transliteration: ouc oti epizhtw to doma all epizhtw ton karpon ton pleonazonta eiv logon umwn
draft_translation: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
ukjv_translation: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account. (o. logos)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: απεχω δε παντα και περισσευω πεπληρωμαι δεξαμενος παρα επαφροδιτου τα παρ υμων οσμην ευωδιας θυσιαν δεκτην ευαρεστον τω θεω
transliteration: apecw de panta kai perisseuw peplhrwmai dexamenov para epafroditou ta par umwn osmhn euwdiav yusian dekthn euareston tw yew
draft_translation: But I have all things, and abound: I am full, having received from Epaphroditus the things from you, an aroma of sweet smell, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
ukjv_translation: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God.

greek_text: ο δε θεος μου πληρωσει πασαν χρειαν υμων κατα τον πλουτον αυτου εν δοξη εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: o de yeov mou plhrwsei pasan creian umwn kata ton plouton autou en doxh en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: But my God shall fill every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

greek_text: τω δε θεω και πατρι ημων η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
transliteration: tw de yew kai patri hmwn h doxa eiv touv aiwnav twn aiwnwn amhn
draft_translation: Now to God and our Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forever spelling

greek_text: ασπασασθε παντα αγιον εν χριστω ιησου ασπαζονται υμας οι συν εμοι αδελφοι
transliteration: aspasasye panta agion en cristw ihsou aspazontai umav oi sun emoi adelfoi
draft_translation: Salute every holy one in Christ Jesus. the brothers who are with me greet you.
ukjv_translation: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
review_notes: fixed brothers casing; modernized personal which as who; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered hagios as holy one

greek_text: ασπαζονται υμας παντες οι αγιοι μαλιστα δε οι εκ της καισαρος οικιας
transliteration: aspazontai umav pantev oi agioi malista de oi ek thv kaisarov oikiav
draft_translation: All the holy ones salute you, chiefly those who are of Caesar's household.
ukjv_translation: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

greek_text: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος
transliteration: paulov apostolov ihsou cristou dia yelhmatov yeou kai timoyeov o adelfov
draft_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
ukjv_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

greek_text: τοις εν κολοσσαις αγιοις και πιστοις αδελφοις εν χριστω χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: toiv en kolossaiv agioiv kai pistoiv adelfoiv en cristw cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: To the holy ones and faithful brothers in Christ who are at Colosse: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω και πατρι του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου παντοτε περι υμων προσευχομενοι
transliteration: eucaristoumen tw yew kai patri tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou pantote peri umwn proseucomenoi
draft_translation: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
ukjv_translation: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

greek_text: ακουσαντες την πιστιν υμων εν χριστω ιησου και την αγαπην την εις παντας τους αγιους
transliteration: akousantev thn pistin umwn en cristw ihsou kai thn agaphn thn eiv pantav touv agiouv
draft_translation: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have to all the holy ones,
ukjv_translation: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the (o. agape) love which all of you have to all the saints,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: δια την ελπιδα την αποκειμενην υμιν εν τοις ουρανοις ην προηκουσατε εν τω λογω της αληθειας του ευαγγελιου
transliteration: dia thn elpida thn apokeimenhn umin en toiv ouranoiv hn prohkousate en tw logw thv alhyeiav tou euaggeliou
draft_translation: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the good news;
ukjv_translation: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof all of you heard before in the (o. logos) word of the truth of the gospel;
review_notes: modernized whereof; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: του παροντος εις υμας καθως και εν παντι τω κοσμω και εστιν καρποφορουμενον καθως και εν υμιν αφ ης ημερας ηκουσατε και επεγνωτε την χαριν του θεου εν αληθεια
transliteration: tou parontov eiv umav kaywv kai en panti tw kosmw kai estin karpoforoumenon kaywv kai en umin af hv hmerav hkousate kai epegnwte thn carin tou yeou en alhyeia
draft_translation: Which has come to you, as it is in all the world; and produces fruit, as it does also in you, since the day you heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
ukjv_translation: Which has come unto you, as it is in all the world; and brings forth fruit, as it does also in you, since the day all of you heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered general brings-forth as produces

greek_text: καθως και εμαθετε απο επαφρα του αγαπητου συνδουλου ημων ος εστιν πιστος υπερ υμων διακονος του χριστου
transliteration: kaywv kai emayete apo epafra tou agaphtou sundoulou hmwn ov estin pistov uper umwn diakonov tou cristou
draft_translation: As you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellow slave, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
ukjv_translation: As all of you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellow servant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ο και δηλωσας ημιν την υμων αγαπην εν πνευματι
transliteration: o kai dhlwsav hmin thn umwn agaphn en pneumati
draft_translation: Who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Who also declared unto us your (o. agape) love in the (o. pneuma) Spirit.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δια τουτο και ημεις αφ ης ημερας ηκουσαμεν ου παυομεθα υπερ υμων προσευχομενοι και αιτουμενοι ινα πληρωθητε την επιγνωσιν του θεληματος αυτου εν παση σοφια και συνεσει πνευματικη
transliteration: dia touto kai hmeiv af hv hmerav hkousamen ou pauomeya uper umwn proseucomenoi kai aitoumenoi ina plhrwyhte thn epignwsin tou yelhmatov autou en pash sofia kai sunesei pneumatikh
draft_translation: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
ukjv_translation: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that all of you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

greek_text: περιπατησαι υμας αξιως του κυριου εις πασαν αρεσκειαν εν παντι εργω αγαθω καρποφορουντες και αυξανομενοι εις την επιγνωσιν του θεου
transliteration: peripathsai umav axiwv tou kuriou eiv pasan areskeian en panti ergw agayw karpoforountev kai auxanomenoi eiv thn epignwsin tou yeou
draft_translation: That you might walk worthy of the Lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
ukjv_translation: That all of you might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εν παση δυναμει δυναμουμενοι κατα το κρατος της δοξης αυτου εις πασαν υπομονην και μακροθυμιαν μετα χαρας
transliteration: en pash dunamei dunamoumenoi kata to kratov thv doxhv autou eiv pasan upomonhn kai makroyumian meta carav
draft_translation: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, to all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
ukjv_translation: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

greek_text: ευχαριστουντες τω πατρι τω ικανωσαντι ημας εις την μεριδα του κληρου των αγιων εν τω φωτι
transliteration: eucaristountev tw patri tw ikanwsanti hmav eiv thn merida tou klhrou twn agiwn en tw fwti
draft_translation: Giving thanks to the Father, who has made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the holy ones in light:
ukjv_translation: Giving thanks unto the Father, which has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized meet-as-fitting; modernized personal which as who; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: ος ερρυσατο ημας εκ της εξουσιας του σκοτους και μετεστησεν εις την βασιλειαν του υιου της αγαπης αυτου
transliteration: ov errusato hmav ek thv exousiav tou skotouv kai metesthsen eiv thn basileian tou uiou thv agaphv autou
draft_translation: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
ukjv_translation: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his (o. agape) dear Son:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εν ω εχομεν την απολυτρωσιν δια του αιματος αυτου την αφεσιν των αμαρτιων
transliteration: en w ecomen thn apolutrwsin dia tou aimatov autou thn afesin twn amartiwn
draft_translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
ukjv_translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ος εστιν εικων του θεου του αορατου πρωτοτοκος πασης κτισεως
transliteration: ov estin eikwn tou yeou tou aoratou prwtotokov pashv ktisewv
draft_translation: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation:
ukjv_translation: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

greek_text: οτι εν αυτω εκτισθη τα παντα τα εν τοις ουρανοις και τα επι της γης τα ορατα και τα αορατα ειτε θρονοι ειτε κυριοτητες ειτε αρχαι ειτε εξουσιαι τα παντα δι αυτου και εις αυτον εκτισται
transliteration: oti en autw ektisyh ta panta ta en toiv ouranoiv kai ta epi thv ghv ta orata kai ta aorata eite yronoi eite kuriothtev eite arcai eite exousiai ta panta di autou kai eiv auton ektistai
draft_translation: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are on earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
ukjv_translation: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

greek_text: και αυτος εστιν προ παντων και τα παντα εν αυτω συνεστηκεν
transliteration: kai autov estin pro pantwn kai ta panta en autw sunesthken
draft_translation: And he is before all things, and all things hold together in him.
ukjv_translation: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

greek_text: και αυτος εστιν η κεφαλη του σωματος της εκκλησιας ος εστιν αρχη πρωτοτοκος εκ των νεκρων ινα γενηται εν πασιν αυτος πρωτευων
transliteration: kai autov estin h kefalh tou swmatov thv ekklhsiav ov estin arch prwtotokov ek twn nekrwn ina genhtai en pasin autov prwteuwn
draft_translation: And he is the head of the body, the assembly: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
ukjv_translation: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

greek_text: οτι εν αυτω ευδοκησεν παν το πληρωμα κατοικησαι
transliteration: oti en autw eudokhsen pan to plhrwma katoikhsai
draft_translation: For in him all the fullness was pleased to dwell;
ukjv_translation: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fullness dwell;

greek_text: και δι αυτου αποκαταλλαξαι τα παντα εις αυτον ειρηνοποιησας δια του αιματος του σταυρου αυτου δι αυτου ειτε τα επι της γης ειτε τα εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: kai di autou apokatallaxai ta panta eiv auton eirhnopoihsav dia tou aimatov tou staurou autou di autou eite ta epi thv ghv eite ta en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things to himself; by him, I say, whether they be things on earth, or things in heaven.
ukjv_translation: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized in-earth wording

greek_text: και υμας ποτε οντας απηλλοτριωμενους και εχθρους τη διανοια εν τοις εργοις τοις πονηροις νυνι δε αποκατηλλαξεν
transliteration: kai umav pote ontav aphllotriwmenouv kai ecyrouv th dianoia en toiv ergoiv toiv ponhroiv nuni de apokathllaxen
draft_translation: And you, once being alienated and enemies in mind in wicked works, yet now he has reconciled
ukjv_translation: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled

greek_text: εν τω σωματι της σαρκος αυτου δια του θανατου παραστησαι υμας αγιους και αμωμους και ανεγκλητους κατενωπιον αυτου
transliteration: en tw swmati thv sarkov autou dia tou yanatou parasthsai umav agiouv kai amwmouv kai anegklhtouv katenwpion autou
draft_translation: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and blameless and above reproach in his sight:
ukjv_translation: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and irreproachable in his sight:

greek_text: ειγε επιμενετε τη πιστει τεθεμελιωμενοι και εδραιοι και μη μετακινουμενοι απο της ελπιδος του ευαγγελιου ου ηκουσατε του κηρυχθεντος εν παση τη κτισει τη υπο τον ουρανον ου εγενομην εγω παυλος διακονος
transliteration: eige epimenete th pistei teyemeliwmenoi kai edraioi kai mh metakinoumenoi apo thv elpidov tou euaggeliou ou hkousate tou khrucyentov en pash th ktisei th upo ton ouranon ou egenomhn egw paulov diakonov
draft_translation: If you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the good news, which you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; of which I Paul am made a minister;
ukjv_translation: If all of you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which all of you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
review_notes: modernized whereof; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ος νυν χαιρω εν τοις παθημασιν μου υπερ υμων και ανταναπληρω τα υστερηματα των θλιψεων του χριστου εν τη σαρκι μου υπερ του σωματος αυτου ο εστιν η εκκλησια
transliteration: ov nun cairw en toiv payhmasin mou uper umwn kai antanaplhrw ta usterhmata twn yliqewn tou cristou en th sarki mou uper tou swmatov autou o estin h ekklhsia
