draft_translation: I now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the assembly:
ukjv_translation: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
review_notes: fixed first-person relative artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: ης εγενομην εγω διακονος κατα την οικονομιαν του θεου την δοθεισαν μοι εις υμας πληρωσαι τον λογον του θεου
transliteration: hv egenomhn egw diakonov kata thn oikonomian tou yeou thn doyeisan moi eiv umav plhrwsai ton logon tou yeou
draft_translation: of which I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;
ukjv_translation: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the (o. logos) word of God;
review_notes: fixed non-person relative after dispensation; modernized personal which as who; modernized whereof; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: το μυστηριον το αποκεκρυμμενον απο των αιωνων και απο των γενεων νυνι δε εφανερωθη τοις αγιοις αυτου
transliteration: to musthrion to apokekrummenon apo twn aiwnwn kai apo twn genewn nuni de efanerwyh toiv agioiv autou
draft_translation: Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his holy ones:
ukjv_translation: Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

greek_text: οις ηθελησεν ο θεος γνωρισαι τις ο πλουτος της δοξης του μυστηριου τουτου εν τοις εθνεσιν ος εστιν χριστος εν υμιν η ελπις της δοξης
transliteration: oiv hyelhsen o yeov gnwrisai tiv o ploutov thv doxhv tou musthriou toutou en toiv eynesin ov estin cristov en umin h elpiv thv doxhv
draft_translation: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the nations; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
ukjv_translation: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

greek_text: ον ημεις καταγγελλομεν νουθετουντες παντα ανθρωπον και διδασκοντες παντα ανθρωπον εν παση σοφια ινα παραστησωμεν παντα ανθρωπον τελειον εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: on hmeiv kataggellomen nouyetountev panta anyrwpon kai didaskontev panta anyrwpon en pash sofia ina parasthswmen panta anyrwpon teleion en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: Whom we proclaim, admonishing every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man complete in Christ Jesus:
ukjv_translation: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

greek_text: εις ο και κοπιω αγωνιζομενος κατα την ενεργειαν αυτου την ενεργουμενην εν εμοι εν δυναμει
transliteration: eiv o kai kopiw agwnizomenov kata thn energeian autou thn energoumenhn en emoi en dunamei
draft_translation: To which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
ukjv_translation: Unto which I also labour, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: θελω γαρ υμας ειδεναι ηλικον αγωνα εχω περι υμων και των εν λαοδικεια και οσοι ουχ εωρακασιν το προσωπον μου εν σαρκι
transliteration: yelw gar umav eidenai hlikon agwna ecw peri umwn kai twn en laodikeia kai osoi ouc ewrakasin to proswpon mou en sarki
draft_translation: For I would that you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
ukjv_translation: For I would that all of you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

greek_text: ινα παρακληθωσιν αι καρδιαι αυτων συμβιβασθεντων εν αγαπη και εις παντα πλουτον της πληροφοριας της συνεσεως εις επιγνωσιν του μυστηριου του θεου και πατρος και του χριστου
transliteration: ina paraklhywsin ai kardiai autwn sumbibasyentwn en agaph kai eiv panta plouton thv plhroforiav thv sunesewv eiv epignwsin tou musthriou tou yeou kai patrov kai tou cristou
draft_translation: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
ukjv_translation: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in (o. agape) love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εν ω εισιν παντες οι θησαυροι της σοφιας και της γνωσεως αποκρυφοι
transliteration: en w eisin pantev oi yhsauroi thv sofiav kai thv gnwsewv apokrufoi
draft_translation: In whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
ukjv_translation: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

greek_text: τουτο δε λεγω ινα μη τις υμας παραλογιζηται εν πιθανολογια
transliteration: touto de legw ina mh tiv umav paralogizhtai en piyanologia
draft_translation: And this I say, lest anyone should beguile you with enticing words.
ukjv_translation: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

greek_text: ει γαρ και τη σαρκι απειμι αλλα τω πνευματι συν υμιν ειμι χαιρων και βλεπων υμων την ταξιν και το στερεωμα της εις χριστον πιστεως υμων
transliteration: ei gar kai th sarki apeimi alla tw pneumati sun umin eimi cairwn kai blepwn umwn thn taxin kai to sterewma thv eiv criston pistewv umwn
draft_translation: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
ukjv_translation: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the (o. pneuma) spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ως ουν παρελαβετε τον χριστον ιησουν τον κυριον εν αυτω περιπατειτε
transliteration: wv oun parelabete ton criston ihsoun ton kurion en autw peripateite
draft_translation: As you have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk you in him:
ukjv_translation: As all of you have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk all of you in him:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ερριζωμενοι και εποικοδομουμενοι εν αυτω και βεβαιουμενοι εν τη πιστει καθως εδιδαχθητε περισσευοντες εν αυτη εν ευχαριστια
transliteration: errizwmenoi kai epoikodomoumenoi en autw kai bebaioumenoi en th pistei kaywv edidacyhte perisseuontev en auth en eucaristia
draft_translation: Rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.
ukjv_translation: Rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as all of you have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
review_notes: modernized therein; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: βλεπετε μη τις υμας εσται ο συλαγωγων δια της φιλοσοφιας και κενης απατης κατα την παραδοσιν των ανθρωπων κατα τα στοιχεια του κοσμου και ου κατα χριστον
transliteration: blepete mh tiv umav estai o sulagwgwn dia thv filosofiav kai kenhv apathv kata thn paradosin twn anyrwpwn kata ta stoiceia tou kosmou kai ou kata criston
draft_translation: Beware lest anyone spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
ukjv_translation: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

greek_text: οτι εν αυτω κατοικει παν το πληρωμα της θεοτητος σωματικως
transliteration: oti en autw katoikei pan to plhrwma thv yeothtov swmatikwv
draft_translation: For in him dwells all the fullness of the Deity bodily.
ukjv_translation: For in him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.

greek_text: και εστε εν αυτω πεπληρωμενοι ος εστιν η κεφαλη πασης αρχης και εξουσιας
transliteration: kai este en autw peplhrwmenoi ov estin h kefalh pashv archv kai exousiav
draft_translation: And you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
ukjv_translation: And all of you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

greek_text: εν ω και περιετμηθητε περιτομη αχειροποιητω εν τη απεκδυσει του σωματος των αμαρτιων της σαρκος εν τη περιτομη του χριστου
transliteration: en w kai perietmhyhte peritomh aceiropoihtw en th apekdusei tou swmatov twn amartiwn thv sarkov en th peritomh tou cristou
draft_translation: In whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
ukjv_translation: In whom also all of you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

greek_text: συνταφεντες αυτω εν τω βαπτισματι εν ω και συνηγερθητε δια της πιστεως της ενεργειας του θεου του εγειραντος αυτον εκ των νεκρων
transliteration: suntafentev autw en tw baptismati en w kai sunhgeryhte dia thv pistewv thv energeiav tou yeou tou egeirantov auton ek twn nekrwn
draft_translation: Buried with him in baptism, in which also you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who has raised him from the dead.
ukjv_translation: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also all of you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who has raised him from the dead.
review_notes: modernized wherein; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και υμας νεκρους οντας εν τοις παραπτωμασιν και τη ακροβυστια της σαρκος υμων συνεζωοποιησεν συν αυτω χαρισαμενος υμιν παντα τα παραπτωματα
transliteration: kai umav nekrouv ontav en toiv paraptwmasin kai th akrobustia thv sarkov umwn sunezwopoihsen sun autw carisamenov umin panta ta paraptwmata
draft_translation: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, he made alive together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
ukjv_translation: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
review_notes: rendered syzoopoieo as made alive together

greek_text: εξαλειψας το καθ ημων χειρογραφον τοις δογμασιν ο ην υπεναντιον ημιν και αυτο ηρκεν εκ του μεσου προσηλωσας αυτο τω σταυρω
transliteration: exaleiqav to kay hmwn ceirografon toiv dogmasin o hn upenantion hmin kai auto hrken ek tou mesou proshlwsav auto tw staurw
draft_translation: Having blotted out the handwriting in ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and he has taken it out of the midst, nailing it to the cross;
ukjv_translation: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

greek_text: απεκδυσαμενος τας αρχας και τας εξουσιας εδειγματισεν εν παρρησια θριαμβευσας αυτους εν αυτω
transliteration: apekdusamenov tav arcav kai tav exousiav edeigmatisen en parrhsia yriambeusav autouv en autw
draft_translation: And having stripped off principalities and powers, he made a public show of them, triumphing over them in it.
ukjv_translation: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

greek_text: μη ουν τις υμας κρινετω εν βρωσει η εν ποσει η εν μερει εορτης η νουμηνιας η σαββατων
transliteration: mh oun tiv umav krinetw en brwsei h en posei h en merei eorthv h noumhniav h sabbatwn
draft_translation: Let no one therefore judge you in food, or in drink, or in respect of a holy day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
ukjv_translation: Let no man therefore judge you in food, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
review_notes: modernized holy day spelling; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: α εστιν σκια των μελλοντων το δε σωμα του χριστου
transliteration: a estin skia twn mellontwn to de swma tou cristou
draft_translation: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: μηδεις υμας καταβραβευετω θελων εν ταπεινοφροσυνη και θρησκεια των αγγελων α μη εωρακεν εμβατευων εικη φυσιουμενος υπο του νοος της σαρκος αυτου
transliteration: mhdeiv umav katabrabeuetw yelwn en tapeinofrosunh kai yrhskeia twn aggelwn a mh ewraken embateuwn eikh fusioumenov upo tou noov thv sarkov autou
draft_translation: Let no one beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshiping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
ukjv_translation: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; modernized worshipping spelling

greek_text: και ου κρατων την κεφαλην εξ ου παν το σωμα δια των αφων και συνδεσμων επιχορηγουμενον και συμβιβαζομενον αυξει την αυξησιν του θεου
transliteration: kai ou kratwn thn kefalhn ex ou pan to swma dia twn afwn kai sundesmwn epicorhgoumenon kai sumbibazomenon auxei thn auxhsin tou yeou
draft_translation: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment supplied, and knit together, increases with the increase of God.
ukjv_translation: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increases with the increase of God.

greek_text: ει ουν απεθανετε συν τω χριστω απο των στοιχειων του κοσμου τι ως ζωντες εν κοσμω δογματιζεσθε
transliteration: ei oun apeyanete sun tw cristw apo twn stoiceiwn tou kosmou ti wv zwntev en kosmw dogmatizesye
draft_translation: Therefore if you be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are you subject to ordinances,
ukjv_translation: Wherefore if all of you be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are all of you subject to ordinances,
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη αψη μηδε γευση μηδε θιγης
transliteration: mh aqh mhde geush mhde yighv
draft_translation: (do not touch; do not taste; do not handle;
ukjv_translation: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
review_notes: modernized handle-not idiom; modernized taste-not idiom; modernized touch-not idiom

greek_text: α εστιν παντα εις φθοραν τη αποχρησει κατα τα ενταλματα και διδασκαλιας των ανθρωπων
transliteration: a estin panta eiv fyoran th apocrhsei kata ta entalmata kai didaskaliav twn anyrwpwn
draft_translation: which all are for corruption with use), according to the commandments and teachings of men?
ukjv_translation: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

greek_text: ατινα εστιν λογον μεν εχοντα σοφιας εν εθελοθρησκεια και ταπεινοφροσυνη και αφειδια σωματος ουκ εν τιμη τινι προς πλησμονην της σαρκος
transliteration: atina estin logon men econta sofiav en eyeloyrhskeia kai tapeinofrosunh kai afeidia swmatov ouk en timh tini prov plhsmonhn thv sarkov
draft_translation: Which things have indeed a show of wisdom religious outlook, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honor to the satisfying of the flesh.
ukjv_translation: Which things have indeed a (o. logos) show of wisdom religious outlook, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
review_notes: modernized honour spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ει ουν συνηγερθητε τω χριστω τα ανω ζητειτε ου ο χριστος εστιν εν δεξια του θεου καθημενος
transliteration: ei oun sunhgeryhte tw cristw ta anw zhteite ou o cristov estin en dexia tou yeou kayhmenov
draft_translation: If you then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sits on the right hand of God.
ukjv_translation: If all of you then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sits on the right hand of God.

greek_text: τα ανω φρονειτε μη τα επι της γης
transliteration: ta anw froneite mh ta epi thv ghv
draft_translation: Mind the things above, not the things on the earth.
ukjv_translation: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

greek_text: απεθανετε γαρ και η ζωη υμων κεκρυπται συν τω χριστω εν τω θεω
transliteration: apeyanete gar kai h zwh umwn kekruptai sun tw cristw en tw yew
draft_translation: For you are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
ukjv_translation: For all of you are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

greek_text: οταν ο χριστος φανερωθη η ζωη ημων τοτε και υμεις συν αυτω φανερωθησεσθε εν δοξη
transliteration: otan o cristov fanerwyh h zwh hmwn tote kai umeiv sun autw fanerwyhsesye en doxh
draft_translation: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall you also appear with him in glory.
ukjv_translation: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall all of you also appear with him in glory.

greek_text: νεκρωσατε ουν τα μελη υμων τα επι της γης πορνειαν ακαθαρσιαν παθος επιθυμιαν κακην και την πλεονεξιαν ητις εστιν ειδωλολατρεια
transliteration: nekrwsate oun ta melh umwn ta epi thv ghv porneian akayarsian payov epiyumian kakhn kai thn pleonexian htiv estin eidwlolatreia
draft_translation: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth; sexual immorality, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
ukjv_translation: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
review_notes: modernized concupiscence; modernized porneia wording; rendered nekroo as put to death; rendered pathos as passion

greek_text: δι α ερχεται η οργη του θεου επι τους υιους της απειθειας
transliteration: di a ercetai h orgh tou yeou epi touv uiouv thv apeiyeiav
draft_translation: Because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience:
ukjv_translation: For which things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience:

greek_text: εν οις και υμεις περιεπατησατε ποτε οτε εζητε εν αυτοις
transliteration: en oiv kai umeiv periepathsate pote ote ezhte en autoiv
draft_translation: in which you also walked some time, when you lived in them.
ukjv_translation: In the which all of you also walked some time, when all of you lived in them.
review_notes: modernized in-the-which wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: νυνι δε αποθεσθε και υμεις τα παντα οργην θυμον κακιαν βλασφημιαν αισχρολογιαν εκ του στοματος υμων
transliteration: nuni de apoyesye kai umeiv ta panta orghn yumon kakian blasfhmian aiscrologian ek tou stomatov umwn
draft_translation: But now you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
ukjv_translation: But now all of you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

greek_text: μη ψευδεσθε εις αλληλους απεκδυσαμενοι τον παλαιον ανθρωπον συν ταις πραξεσιν αυτου
transliteration: mh qeudesye eiv allhlouv apekdusamenoi ton palaion anyrwpon sun taiv praxesin autou
draft_translation: Lie not one to another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his deeds;
ukjv_translation: Lie not one to another, seeing that all of you have put off the old man with his deeds;

greek_text: και ενδυσαμενοι τον νεον τον ανακαινουμενον εις επιγνωσιν κατ εικονα του κτισαντος αυτον
transliteration: kai endusamenoi ton neon ton anakainoumenon eiv epignwsin kat eikona tou ktisantov auton
draft_translation: And have put on the new man, who is renewed in knowledge after the image of him who created him:
ukjv_translation: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: οπου ουκ ενι ελλην και ιουδαιος περιτομη και ακροβυστια βαρβαρος σκυθης δουλος ελευθερος αλλα τα παντα και εν πασιν χριστος
transliteration: opou ouk eni ellhn kai ioudaiov peritomh kai akrobustia barbarov skuyhv doulov eleuyerov alla ta panta kai en pasin cristov
draft_translation: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, slave nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
ukjv_translation: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Savages, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
review_notes: rendered Skythes as Scythian; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ενδυσασθε ουν ως εκλεκτοι του θεου αγιοι και ηγαπημενοι σπλαγχνα οικτιρμων χρηστοτητα ταπεινοφροσυνην πραοτητα μακροθυμιαν
transliteration: endusasye oun wv eklektoi tou yeou agioi kai hgaphmenoi splagcna oiktirmwn crhstothta tapeinofrosunhn praothta makroyumian
draft_translation: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, inward parts of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
ukjv_translation: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

greek_text: ανεχομενοι αλληλων και χαριζομενοι εαυτοις εαν τις προς τινα εχη μομφην καθως και ο χριστος εχαρισατο υμιν ουτως και υμεις
transliteration: anecomenoi allhlwn kai carizomenoi eautoiv ean tiv prov tina ech momfhn kaywv kai o cristov ecarisato umin outwv kai umeiv
draft_translation: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if anyone have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do you.
ukjv_translation: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do all of you.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: επι πασιν δε τουτοις την αγαπην ητις εστιν συνδεσμος της τελειοτητος
transliteration: epi pasin de toutoiv thn agaphn htiv estin sundesmov thv teleiothtov
draft_translation: And above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfection.
ukjv_translation: And above all these things put on (o. agape) love, which is the bond of perfection.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και η ειρηνη του θεου βραβευετω εν ταις καρδιαις υμων εις ην και εκληθητε εν ενι σωματι και ευχαριστοι γινεσθε
transliteration: kai h eirhnh tou yeou brabeuetw en taiv kardiaiv umwn eiv hn kai eklhyhte en eni swmati kai eucaristoi ginesye
draft_translation: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also you are called in one body; and be thankful.
ukjv_translation: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also all of you are called in one body; and be all of you thankful.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ο λογος του χριστου ενοικειτω εν υμιν πλουσιως εν παση σοφια διδασκοντες και νουθετουντες εαυτους ψαλμοις και υμνοις και ωδαις πνευματικαις εν χαριτι αδοντες εν τη καρδια υμων τω κυριω
transliteration: o logov tou cristou enoikeitw en umin plousiwv en pash sofia didaskontev kai nouyetountev eautouv qalmoiv kai umnoiv kai wdaiv pneumatikaiv en cariti adontev en th kardia umwn tw kuriw
draft_translation: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Let the (o. logos) word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και παν ο τι αν ποιητε εν λογω η εν εργω παντα εν ονοματι κυριου ιησου ευχαριστουντες τω θεω και πατρι δι αυτου
transliteration: kai pan o ti an poihte en logw h en ergw panta en onomati kuriou ihsou eucaristountev tw yew kai patri di autou
draft_translation: And whatever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
ukjv_translation: And whatsoever all of you do in (o. logos) word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
review_notes: modernized whatsoever; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: αι γυναικες υποτασσεσθε τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν ως ανηκεν εν κυριω
transliteration: ai gunaikev upotassesye toiv idioiv andrasin wv anhken en kuriw
draft_translation: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οι ανδρες αγαπατε τας γυναικας και μη πικραινεσθε προς αυτας
transliteration: oi andrev agapate tav gunaikav kai mh pikrainesye prov autav
draft_translation: Husbands, love your wives, and do not be bitter against them.
ukjv_translation: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

greek_text: τα τεκνα υπακουετε τοις γονευσιν κατα παντα τουτο γαρ εστιν ευαρεστον τω κυριω
transliteration: ta tekna upakouete toiv goneusin kata panta touto gar estin euareston tw kuriw
draft_translation: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing to the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οι πατερες μη ερεθιζετε τα τεκνα υμων ινα μη αθυμωσιν
transliteration: oi paterev mh ereyizete ta tekna umwn ina mh ayumwsin
draft_translation: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they be discouraged.
ukjv_translation: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

greek_text: οι δουλοι υπακουετε κατα παντα τοις κατα σαρκα κυριοις μη εν οφθαλμοδουλειαις ως ανθρωπαρεσκοι αλλ εν απλοτητι καρδιας φοβουμενοι τον θεον
transliteration: oi douloi upakouete kata panta toiv kata sarka kurioiv mh en ofyalmodouleiaiv wv anyrwpareskoi all en aplothti kardiav foboumenoi ton yeon
draft_translation: Slaves, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;
ukjv_translation: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;

greek_text: και παν ο τι εαν ποιητε εκ ψυχης εργαζεσθε ως τω κυριω και ουκ ανθρωποις
transliteration: kai pan o ti ean poihte ek quchv ergazesye wv tw kuriw kai ouk anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: And whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not to men;
ukjv_translation: And whatsoever all of you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whatsoever; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειδοτες οτι απο κυριου αποληψεσθε την ανταποδοσιν της κληρονομιας τω γαρ κυριω χριστω δουλευετε
transliteration: eidotev oti apo kuriou apolhqesye thn antapodosin thv klhronomiav tw gar kuriw cristw douleuete
draft_translation: Knowing that of the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for you serve the Lord Christ.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that of the Lord all of you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for all of you serve the Lord Christ.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ο δε αδικων κομιειται ο ηδικησεν και ουκ εστιν προσωποληψια
transliteration: o de adikwn komieitai o hdikhsen kai ouk estin proswpolhqia
draft_translation: But the one who does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.
ukjv_translation: But he that does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.

greek_text: οι κυριοι το δικαιον και την ισοτητα τοις δουλοις παρεχεσθε ειδοτες οτι και υμεις εχετε κυριον εν ουρανοις
transliteration: oi kurioi to dikaion kai thn isothta toiv douloiv parecesye eidotev oti kai umeiv ecete kurion en ouranoiv
draft_translation: Masters, give to your slaves that which is just and equal; knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
ukjv_translation: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that all of you also have a Master in heaven.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: τη προσευχη προσκαρτερειτε γρηγορουντες εν αυτη εν ευχαριστια
transliteration: th proseuch proskartereite grhgorountev en auth en eucaristia
draft_translation: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving;
ukjv_translation: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

greek_text: προσευχομενοι αμα και περι ημων ινα ο θεος ανοιξη ημιν θυραν του λογου λαλησαι το μυστηριον του χριστου δι ο και δεδεμαι
transliteration: proseucomenoi ama kai peri hmwn ina o yeov anoixh hmin yuran tou logou lalhsai to musthrion tou cristou di o kai dedemai
draft_translation: Likewise praying also for us, that God would open to us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
ukjv_translation: Likewise praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of (o. logos) utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ινα φανερωσω αυτο ως δει με λαλησαι
transliteration: ina fanerwsw auto wv dei me lalhsai
draft_translation: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
ukjv_translation: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εν σοφια περιπατειτε προς τους εξω τον καιρον εξαγοραζομενοι
transliteration: en sofia peripateite prov touv exw ton kairon exagorazomenoi
draft_translation: Walk in wisdom toward those who are without, redeeming the time.
ukjv_translation: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

greek_text: ο λογος υμων παντοτε εν χαριτι αλατι ηρτυμενος ειδεναι πως δει υμας ενι εκαστω αποκρινεσθαι
transliteration: o logov umwn pantote en cariti alati hrtumenov eidenai pwv dei umav eni ekastw apokrinesyai
draft_translation: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer every man.
ukjv_translation: Let your (o. logos) speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that all of you may know how all of you ought to answer every man.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τα κατ εμε παντα γνωρισει υμιν τυχικος ο αγαπητος αδελφος και πιστος διακονος και συνδουλος εν κυριω
transliteration: ta kat eme panta gnwrisei umin tucikov o agaphtov adelfov kai pistov diakonov kai sundoulov en kuriw
draft_translation: All my state shall Tychicus declare to you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellow slave in the Lord:
ukjv_translation: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ον επεμψα προς υμας εις αυτο τουτο ινα γνω τα περι υμων και παρακαλεση τας καρδιας υμων
transliteration: on epemqa prov umav eiv auto touto ina gnw ta peri umwn kai parakalesh tav kardiav umwn
draft_translation: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
ukjv_translation: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

greek_text: συν ονησιμω τω πιστω και αγαπητω αδελφω ος εστιν εξ υμων παντα υμιν γνωριουσιν τα ωδε
transliteration: sun onhsimw tw pistw kai agaphtw adelfw ov estin ex umwn panta umin gnwriousin ta wde
draft_translation: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known to you all things which are done here.
ukjv_translation: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

greek_text: ασπαζεται υμας αρισταρχος ο συναιχμαλωτος μου και μαρκος ο ανεψιος βαρναβα περι ου ελαβετε εντολας εαν ελθη προς υμας δεξασθε αυτον
transliteration: aspazetai umav aristarcov o sunaicmalwtov mou kai markov o aneqiov barnaba peri ou elabete entolav ean elyh prov umav dexasye auton
draft_translation: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner salutes you, and Mark, sister's (concerning whom you received commandments: if he comes to you, receive him;)
ukjv_translation: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner salutes you, and Marcus, sister's (concerning whom all of you received commandments: if he comes unto you, receive him;)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: και ιησους ο λεγομενος ιουστος οι οντες εκ περιτομης ουτοι μονοι συνεργοι εις την βασιλειαν του θεου οιτινες εγενηθησαν μοι παρηγορια
transliteration: kai ihsouv o legomenov ioustov oi ontev ek peritomhv outoi monoi sunergoi eiv thn basileian tou yeou oitinev egenhyhsan moi parhgoria
draft_translation: And Jesus, who is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers to the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.
ukjv_translation: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: ασπαζεται υμας επαφρας ο εξ υμων δουλος χριστου παντοτε αγωνιζομενος υπερ υμων εν ταις προσευχαις ινα στητε τελειοι και πεπληρωμενοι εν παντι θεληματι του θεου
transliteration: aspazetai umav epafrav o ex umwn doulov cristou pantote agwnizomenov uper umwn en taiv proseucaiv ina sthte teleioi kai peplhrwmenoi en panti yelhmati tou yeou
draft_translation: Epaphras, who is one of you, a slave of Christ, salutes you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
ukjv_translation: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that all of you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: μαρτυρω γαρ αυτω οτι εχει ζηλον πολυν υπερ υμων και των εν λαοδικεια και των εν ιεραπολει
transliteration: marturw gar autw oti ecei zhlon polun uper umwn kai twn en laodikeia kai twn en ierapolei
draft_translation: For I bear him record, that he has a great zeal for you, and those who are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
ukjv_translation: For I bear him record, that he has a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

greek_text: ασπαζεται υμας λουκας ο ιατρος ο αγαπητος και δημας
transliteration: aspazetai umav loukav o iatrov o agaphtov kai dhmav
draft_translation: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
ukjv_translation: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ασπασασθε τους εν λαοδικεια αδελφους και νυμφαν και την κατ οικον αυτου εκκλησιαν
transliteration: aspasasye touv en laodikeia adelfouv kai numfan kai thn kat oikon autou ekklhsian
draft_translation: Salute the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly which is in his house.
ukjv_translation: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
review_notes: fixed brothers casing; modernized personal which as who; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και οταν αναγνωσθη παρ υμιν η επιστολη ποιησατε ινα και εν τη λαοδικεων εκκλησια αναγνωσθη και την εκ λαοδικειας ινα και υμεις αναγνωτε
transliteration: kai otan anagnwsyh par umin h epistolh poihsate ina kai en th laodikewn ekklhsia anagnwsyh kai thn ek laodikeiav ina kai umeiv anagnwte
draft_translation: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
ukjv_translation: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that all of you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και ειπατε αρχιππω βλεπε την διακονιαν ην παρελαβες εν κυριω ινα αυτην πληροις
transliteration: kai eipate arcippw blepe thn diakonian hn parelabev en kuriw ina authn plhroiv
draft_translation: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.
ukjv_translation: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.

greek_text: ο ασπασμος τη εμη χειρι παυλου μνημονευετε μου των δεσμων η χαρις μεθ υμων αμην
transliteration: o aspasmov th emh ceiri paulou mnhmoneuete mou twn desmwn h cariv mey umwn amhn
draft_translation: The greeting by my hand, Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

greek_text: [ΠΑΥΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΟΥ Η ΠΡΟΣ ΘΕΣΣΑΛΟΝΙΚΕΙΣ ΕΠΙΣΤΟΛΗ ΠΡΩΤΗ] παυλος και σιλουανος και τιμοθεος τη εκκλησια θεσσαλονικεων εν θεω πατρι και κυριω ιησου χριστω χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: [PAULOU TOU APOSTOLOU H PROS YESSALONIKEIS EPISTOLH PRWTH] paulov kai silouanov kai timoyeov th ekklhsia yessalonikewn en yew patri kai kuriw ihsou cristw cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω παντοτε περι παντων υμων μνειαν υμων ποιουμενοι επι των προσευχων ημων
transliteration: eucaristoumen tw yew pantote peri pantwn umwn mneian umwn poioumenoi epi twn proseucwn hmwn
draft_translation: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
ukjv_translation: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αδιαλειπτως μνημονευοντες υμων του εργου της πιστεως και του κοπου της αγαπης και της υπομονης της ελπιδος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εμπροσθεν του θεου και πατρος ημων
transliteration: adialeiptwv mnhmoneuontev umwn tou ergou thv pistewv kai tou kopou thv agaphv kai thv upomonhv thv elpidov tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou emprosyen tou yeou kai patrov hmwn
draft_translation: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labor of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
ukjv_translation: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, (o. agape) and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ειδοτες αδελφοι ηγαπημενοι υπο θεου την εκλογην υμων
transliteration: eidotev adelfoi hgaphmenoi upo yeou thn ekloghn umwn
draft_translation: Knowing, brothers beloved, your election of God.
ukjv_translation: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

greek_text: οτι το ευαγγελιον ημων ουκ εγενηθη εις υμας εν λογω μονον αλλα και εν δυναμει και εν πνευματι αγιω και εν πληροφορια πολλη καθως οιδατε οιοι εγενηθημεν εν υμιν δι υμας
transliteration: oti to euaggelion hmwn ouk egenhyh eiv umav en logw monon alla kai en dunamei kai en pneumati agiw kai en plhroforia pollh kaywv oidate oioi egenhyhmen en umin di umav
draft_translation: For our good news came not to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and in much assurance; as you know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
ukjv_translation: For our gospel came not unto you in word (o. logos) only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and in much assurance; as all of you know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και υμεις μιμηται ημων εγενηθητε και του κυριου δεξαμενοι τον λογον εν θλιψει πολλη μετα χαρας πνευματος αγιου
transliteration: kai umeiv mimhtai hmwn egenhyhte kai tou kuriou dexamenoi ton logon en yliqei pollh meta carav pneumatov agiou
draft_translation: And you became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: And all of you became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word (o. logos) in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ωστε γενεσθαι υμας τυπους πασιν τοις πιστευουσιν εν τη μακεδονια και τη αχαια
transliteration: wste genesyai umav tupouv pasin toiv pisteuousin en th makedonia kai th acaia
draft_translation: So that you were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
ukjv_translation: So that all of you were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

greek_text: αφ υμων γαρ εξηχηται ο λογος του κυριου ου μονον εν τη μακεδονια και αχαια αλλα και εν παντι τοπω η πιστις υμων η προς τον θεον εξεληλυθεν ωστε μη χρειαν ημας εχειν λαλειν τι
transliteration: af umwn gar exhchtai o logov tou kuriou ou monon en th makedonia kai acaia alla kai en panti topw h pistiv umwn h prov ton yeon exelhluyen wste mh creian hmav ecein lalein ti
draft_translation: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God is spread widely; so that we need not to speak anything.
ukjv_translation: For from you sounded out the word (o. logos) of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
review_notes: modernized abroad idiom; modernized anything spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αυτοι γαρ περι ημων απαγγελλουσιν οποιαν εισοδον εσχομεν προς υμας και πως επεστρεψατε προς τον θεον απο των ειδωλων δουλευειν θεω ζωντι και αληθινω
transliteration: autoi gar peri hmwn apaggellousin opoian eisodon escomen prov umav kai pwv epestreqate prov ton yeon apo twn eidwlwn douleuein yew zwnti kai alhyinw
draft_translation: For they themselves show of us what manner of entering in we had to you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
ukjv_translation: For they themselves show of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how all of you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και αναμενειν τον υιον αυτου εκ των ουρανων ον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων ιησουν τον ρυομενον ημας απο της οργης της ερχομενης
transliteration: kai anamenein ton uion autou ek twn ouranwn on hgeiren ek nekrwn ihsoun ton ruomenon hmav apo thv orghv thv ercomenhv
draft_translation: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, who delivered us from the wrath to come.
ukjv_translation: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

greek_text: αυτοι γαρ οιδατε αδελφοι την εισοδον ημων την προς υμας οτι ου κενη γεγονεν
transliteration: autoi gar oidate adelfoi thn eisodon hmwn thn prov umav oti ou kenh gegonen
draft_translation: For yourselves, brothers, know our entrance in to you, that it was not in vain:
ukjv_translation: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αλλα και προπαθοντες και υβρισθεντες καθως οιδατε εν φιλιπποις επαρρησιασαμεθα εν τω θεω ημων λαλησαι προς υμας το ευαγγελιον του θεου εν πολλω αγωνι
transliteration: alla kai propayontev kai ubrisyentev kaywv oidate en filippoiv eparrhsiasameya en tw yew hmwn lalhsai prov umav to euaggelion tou yeou en pollw agwni
draft_translation: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as you know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak to you the good news of God with much contention.
ukjv_translation: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as all of you know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: η γαρ παρακλησις ημων ουκ εκ πλανης ουδε εξ ακαθαρσιας ουτε εν δολω
transliteration: h gar paraklhsiv hmwn ouk ek planhv oude ex akayarsiav oute en dolw
draft_translation: For our exhortation was not from error, nor from uncleanness, nor in deceit:
ukjv_translation: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

greek_text: αλλα καθως δεδοκιμασμεθα υπο του θεου πιστευθηναι το ευαγγελιον ουτως λαλουμεν ουχ ως ανθρωποις αρεσκοντες αλλα τω θεω τω δοκιμαζοντι τας καρδιας ημων
transliteration: alla kaywv dedokimasmeya upo tou yeou pisteuyhnai to euaggelion outwv laloumen ouc wv anyrwpoiv areskontev alla tw yew tw dokimazonti tav kardiav hmwn
draft_translation: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the good news, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tries our hearts.
ukjv_translation: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which tries our hearts.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: ουτε γαρ ποτε εν λογω κολακειας εγενηθημεν καθως οιδατε ουτε εν προφασει πλεονεξιας θεος μαρτυς
transliteration: oute gar pote en logw kolakeiav egenhyhmen kaywv oidate oute en profasei pleonexiav yeov martuv
draft_translation: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as you know, nor a pretext of covetousness; God is witness:
ukjv_translation: For neither at any time used we flattering words, (o. logos) as all of you know, nor a coat of covetousness; God is witness:

greek_text: ουτε ζητουντες εξ ανθρωπων δοξαν ουτε αφ υμων ουτε απ αλλων δυναμενοι εν βαρει ειναι ως χριστου αποστολοι
transliteration: oute zhtountev ex anyrwpwn doxan oute af umwn oute ap allwn dunamenoi en barei einai wv cristou apostoloi
draft_translation: Nor seeking glory from men, neither from you nor from others, though we could be burdensome as apostles of Christ.
ukjv_translation: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

greek_text: αλλ εγενηθημεν ηπιοι εν μεσω υμων ως αν τροφος θαλπη τα εαυτης τεκνα
transliteration: all egenhyhmen hpioi en mesw umwn wv an trofov yalph ta eauthv tekna
draft_translation: But we were gentle among you, as a nursing mother cherishes her own children:
ukjv_translation: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherishes her children:

greek_text: ουτως ιμειρομενοι υμων ευδοκουμεν μεταδουναι υμιν ου μονον το ευαγγελιον του θεου αλλα και τας εαυτων ψυχας διοτι αγαπητοι ημιν γεγενησθε
transliteration: outwv imeiromenoi umwn eudokoumen metadounai umin ou monon to euaggelion tou yeou alla kai tav eautwn qucav dioti agaphtoi hmin gegenhsye
draft_translation: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted to you, not the good news of God only, but also our own souls, because you were dear to us.
ukjv_translation: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because all of you were dear unto us.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: μνημονευετε γαρ αδελφοι τον κοπον ημων και τον μοχθον νυκτος γαρ και ημερας εργαζομενοι προς το μη επιβαρησαι τινα υμων εκηρυξαμεν εις υμας το ευαγγελιον του θεου
transliteration: mnhmoneuete gar adelfoi ton kopon hmwn kai ton mocyon nuktov gar kai hmerav ergazomenoi prov to mh epibarhsai tina umwn ekhruxamen eiv umav to euaggelion tou yeou
draft_translation: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail: for laboring night and day, because we would not be chargeable to any of you, we preached to you the good news of God.
ukjv_translation: For all of you remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized labour spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: υμεις μαρτυρες και ο θεος ως οσιως και δικαιως και αμεμπτως υμιν τοις πιστευουσιν εγενηθημεν
transliteration: umeiv marturev kai o yeov wv osiwv kai dikaiwv kai amemptwv umin toiv pisteuousin egenhyhmen
draft_translation: You are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
ukjv_translation: All of you are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

greek_text: καθαπερ οιδατε ως ενα εκαστον υμων ως πατηρ τεκνα εαυτου παρακαλουντες υμας και παραμυθουμενοι
transliteration: kayaper oidate wv ena ekaston umwn wv pathr tekna eautou parakalountev umav kai paramuyoumenoi
draft_translation: As you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father does his children,
ukjv_translation: As all of you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father does his children,

greek_text: και μαρτυρουμενοι εις το περιπατησαι υμας αξιως του θεου του καλουντος υμας εις την εαυτου βασιλειαν και δοξαν
transliteration: kai marturoumenoi eiv to peripathsai umav axiwv tou yeou tou kalountov umav eiv thn eautou basileian kai doxan
draft_translation: That you would walk worthy of God, who has called you to his kingdom and glory.
ukjv_translation: That all of you would walk worthy of God, who has called you unto his kingdom and glory.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: δια τουτο και ημεις ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω αδιαλειπτως οτι παραλαβοντες λογον ακοης παρ ημων του θεου εδεξασθε ου λογον ανθρωπων αλλα καθως εστιν αληθως λογον θεου ος και ενεργειται εν υμιν τοις πιστευουσιν
transliteration: dia touto kai hmeiv eucaristoumen tw yew adialeiptwv oti paralabontev logon akohv par hmwn tou yeou edexasye ou logon anyrwpwn alla kaywv estin alhywv logon yeou ov kai energeitai en umin toiv pisteuousin
draft_translation: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when you received the word of God who you heard of us, you received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, who effectually works also in you that believe.
ukjv_translation: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when all of you received the word (o. logos) of God which all of you heard of us, all of you received it not as the word (o. logos) of men, but as it is in truth, the word (o. logos) of God, which effectually works also in you that believe.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: υμεις γαρ μιμηται εγενηθητε αδελφοι των εκκλησιων του θεου των ουσων εν τη ιουδαια εν χριστω ιησου οτι ταυτα επαθετε και υμεις υπο των ιδιων συμφυλετων καθως και αυτοι υπο των ιουδαιων
transliteration: umeiv gar mimhtai egenhyhte adelfoi twn ekklhsiwn tou yeou twn ouswn en th ioudaia en cristw ihsou oti tauta epayete kai umeiv upo twn idiwn sumfuletwn kaywv kai autoi upo twn ioudaiwn
draft_translation: For you, brothers, became followers of the assemblies of God who in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for you also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
ukjv_translation: For all of you, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for all of you also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized Judea spelling

greek_text: των και τον κυριον αποκτειναντων ιησουν και τους ιδιους προφητας και ημας εκδιωξαντων και θεω μη αρεσκοντων και πασιν ανθρωποις εναντιων
transliteration: twn kai ton kurion apokteinantwn ihsoun kai touv idiouv profhtav kai hmav ekdiwxantwn kai yew mh areskontwn kai pasin anyrwpoiv enantiwn
draft_translation: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
ukjv_translation: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

greek_text: κωλυοντων ημας τοις εθνεσιν λαλησαι ινα σωθωσιν εις το αναπληρωσαι αυτων τας αμαρτιας παντοτε εφθασεν δε επ αυτους η οργη εις τελος
transliteration: kwluontwn hmav toiv eynesin lalhsai ina swywsin eiv to anaplhrwsai autwn tav amartiav pantote efyasen de ep autouv h orgh eiv telov
draft_translation: Forbidding us to speak to the nations that they might be saved, to fill up their sins always: for the wrath has come upon them to the uttermost.
ukjv_translation: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins always: for the wrath has come upon them to the uttermost.

greek_text: ημεις δε αδελφοι απορφανισθεντες αφ υμων προς καιρον ωρας προσωπω ου καρδια περισσοτερως εσπουδασαμεν το προσωπον υμων ιδειν εν πολλη επιθυμια
transliteration: hmeiv de adelfoi aporfanisyentev af umwn prov kairon wrav proswpw ou kardia perissoterwv espoudasamen to proswpon umwn idein en pollh epiyumia
draft_translation: But we, brothers, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
ukjv_translation: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

greek_text: διο ηθελησαμεν ελθειν προς υμας εγω μεν παυλος και απαξ και δις και ενεκοψεν ημας ο σατανας
transliteration: dio hyelhsamen elyein prov umav egw men paulov kai apax kai div kai enekoqen hmav o satanav
draft_translation: Therefore we would have come to you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore

greek_text: τις γαρ ημων ελπις η χαρα η στεφανος καυχησεως η ουχι και υμεις εμπροσθεν του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εν τη αυτου παρουσια
transliteration: tiv gar hmwn elpiv h cara h stefanov kauchsewv h ouci kai umeiv emprosyen tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou en th autou parousia
draft_translation: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even you in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
ukjv_translation: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even all of you in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: υμεις γαρ εστε η δοξα ημων και η χαρα
transliteration: umeiv gar este h doxa hmwn kai h cara
draft_translation: For you are our glory and joy.
ukjv_translation: For all of you are our glory and joy.

greek_text: διο μηκετι στεγοντες ευδοκησαμεν καταλειφθηναι εν αθηναις μονοι
transliteration: dio mhketi stegontev eudokhsamen kataleifyhnai en ayhnaiv monoi
draft_translation: Therefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
ukjv_translation: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

greek_text: και επεμψαμεν τιμοθεον τον αδελφον ημων και διακονον του θεου και συνεργον ημων εν τω ευαγγελιω του χριστου εις το στηριξαι υμας και παρακαλεσαι υμας περι της πιστεως υμων
transliteration: kai epemqamen timoyeon ton adelfon hmwn kai diakonon tou yeou kai sunergon hmwn en tw euaggeliw tou cristou eiv to sthrixai umav kai parakalesai umav peri thv pistewv umwn
draft_translation: And sent Timothy, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the good news of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
ukjv_translation: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellow labourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; rendered euangelion as good news; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: τω μηδενα σαινεσθαι εν ταις θλιψεσιν ταυταις αυτοι γαρ οιδατε οτι εις τουτο κειμεθα
transliteration: tw mhdena sainesyai en taiv yliqesin tautaiv autoi gar oidate oti eiv touto keimeya
draft_translation: That no one should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
ukjv_translation: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

greek_text: και γαρ οτε προς υμας ημεν προελεγομεν υμιν οτι μελλομεν θλιβεσθαι καθως και εγενετο και οιδατε
transliteration: kai gar ote prov umav hmen proelegomen umin oti mellomen ylibesyai kaywv kai egeneto kai oidate
draft_translation: For truly, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it happened, and you know.
ukjv_translation: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and all of you know.
review_notes: modernized came-to-pass idiom; modernized verily; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: δια τουτο καγω μηκετι στεγων επεμψα εις το γνωναι την πιστιν υμων μηπως επειρασεν υμας ο πειραζων και εις κενον γενηται ο κοπος ημων
transliteration: dia touto kagw mhketi stegwn epemqa eiv to gnwnai thn pistin umwn mhpwv epeirasen umav o peirazwn kai eiv kenon genhtai o kopov hmwn
draft_translation: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labor be in vain.
ukjv_translation: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

greek_text: αρτι δε ελθοντος τιμοθεου προς ημας αφ υμων και ευαγγελισαμενου ημιν την πιστιν και την αγαπην υμων και οτι εχετε μνειαν ημων αγαθην παντοτε επιποθουντες ημας ιδειν καθαπερ και ημεις υμας
transliteration: arti de elyontov timoyeou prov hmav af umwn kai euaggelisamenou hmin thn pistin kai thn agaphn umwn kai oti ecete mneian hmwn agayhn pantote epipoyountev hmav idein kayaper kai hmeiv umav
draft_translation: But now when Timothy came from you to us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and love, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
ukjv_translation: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and love, (o. agape) and that all of you have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: δια τουτο παρεκληθημεν αδελφοι εφ υμιν επι παση τη θλιψει και αναγκη ημων δια της υμων πιστεως
transliteration: dia touto pareklhyhmen adelfoi ef umin epi pash th yliqei kai anagkh hmwn dia thv umwn pistewv
draft_translation: Therefore, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
ukjv_translation: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

greek_text: οτι νυν ζωμεν εαν υμεις στηκητε εν κυριω
transliteration: oti nun zwmen ean umeiv sthkhte en kuriw
draft_translation: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: For now we live, if all of you stand fast in the Lord.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τινα γαρ ευχαριστιαν δυναμεθα τω θεω ανταποδουναι περι υμων επι παση τη χαρα η χαιρομεν δι υμας εμπροσθεν του θεου ημων
transliteration: tina gar eucaristian dunameya tw yew antapodounai peri umwn epi pash th cara h cairomen di umav emprosyen tou yeou hmwn
draft_translation: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy with which we joy for your sakes before our God;
ukjv_translation: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

greek_text: νυκτος και ημερας υπερ εκπερισσου δεομενοι εις το ιδειν υμων το προσωπον και καταρτισαι τα υστερηματα της πιστεως υμων
transliteration: nuktov kai hmerav uper ekperissou deomenoi eiv to idein umwn to proswpon kai katartisai ta usterhmata thv pistewv umwn
draft_translation: Night and day praying exceedingly to see your face, and to complete the things lacking in your faith?
ukjv_translation: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

greek_text: αυτος δε ο θεος και πατηρ ημων και ο κυριος ημων ιησους χριστος κατευθυναι την οδον ημων προς υμας
transliteration: autov de o yeov kai pathr hmwn kai o kuriov hmwn ihsouv cristov kateuyunai thn odon hmwn prov umav
draft_translation: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
ukjv_translation: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: υμας δε ο κυριος πλεονασαι και περισσευσαι τη αγαπη εις αλληλους και εις παντας καθαπερ και ημεις εις υμας
transliteration: umav de o kuriov pleonasai kai perisseusai th agaph eiv allhlouv kai eiv pantav kayaper kai hmeiv eiv umav
draft_translation: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
ukjv_translation: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love (o. agape) one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εις το στηριξαι υμων τας καρδιας αμεμπτους εν αγιωσυνη εμπροσθεν του θεου και πατρος ημων εν τη παρουσια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων των αγιων αυτου
transliteration: eiv to sthrixai umwn tav kardiav amemptouv en agiwsunh emprosyen tou yeou kai patrov hmwn en th parousia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta pantwn twn agiwn autou
draft_translation: To the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his holy ones.
ukjv_translation: To the end he may establish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
review_notes: modernized unblameable; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: το λοιπον ουν αδελφοι ερωτωμεν υμας και παρακαλουμεν εν κυριω ιησου καθως παρελαβετε παρ ημων το πως δει υμας περιπατειν και αρεσκειν θεω ινα περισσευητε μαλλον
transliteration: to loipon oun adelfoi erwtwmen umav kai parakaloumen en kuriw ihsou kaywv parelabete par hmwn to pwv dei umav peripatein kai areskein yew ina perisseuhte mallon
draft_translation: Furthermore then we plead to you, brothers, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as you have received of us how you ought to walk and to please God, so you would abound more and more.
ukjv_translation: Furthermore then we plead to you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as all of you have received of us how all of you ought to walk and to please God, so all of you would abound more and more.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: οιδατε γαρ τινας παραγγελιας εδωκαμεν υμιν δια του κυριου ιησου
transliteration: oidate gar tinav paraggeliav edwkamen umin dia tou kuriou ihsou
draft_translation: For you know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
ukjv_translation: For all of you know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τουτο γαρ εστιν θελημα του θεου ο αγιασμος υμων απεχεσθαι υμας απο της πορνειας
transliteration: touto gar estin yelhma tou yeou o agiasmov umwn apecesyai umav apo thv porneiav
draft_translation: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that you should abstain from sexual immorality:
ukjv_translation: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that all of you should abstain from fornication:
review_notes: modernized porneia wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειδεναι εκαστον υμων το εαυτου σκευος κτασθαι εν αγιασμω και τιμη
transliteration: eidenai ekaston umwn to eautou skeuov ktasyai en agiasmw kai timh
draft_translation: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honor;
ukjv_translation: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

greek_text: μη εν παθει επιθυμιας καθαπερ και τα εθνη τα μη ειδοτα τον θεον
transliteration: mh en payei epiyumiav kayaper kai ta eynh ta mh eidota ton yeon
draft_translation: Not in the lust of desire, even as the nations who do not know God:
ukjv_translation: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
review_notes: modernized concupiscence; modernized know-not idiom; modernized personal which as who; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: το μη υπερβαινειν και πλεονεκτειν εν τω πραγματι τον αδελφον αυτου διοτι εκδικος ο κυριος περι παντων τουτων καθως και προειπαμεν υμιν και διεμαρτυραμεθα
transliteration: to mh uperbainein kai pleonektein en tw pragmati ton adelfon autou dioti ekdikov o kuriov peri pantwn toutwn kaywv kai proeipamen umin kai diemarturameya
draft_translation: That no one go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
ukjv_translation: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
review_notes: modernized because-that wording; modernized no-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ου γαρ εκαλεσεν ημας ο θεος επι ακαθαρσια αλλ εν αγιασμω
transliteration: ou gar ekalesen hmav o yeov epi akayarsia all en agiasmw
draft_translation: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but to holiness.
ukjv_translation: For God has not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

greek_text: τοιγαρουν ο αθετων ουκ ανθρωπον αθετει αλλα τον θεον τον και δοντα το πνευμα αυτου το αγιον εις ημας
transliteration: toigaroun o ayetwn ouk anyrwpon ayetei alla ton yeon ton kai donta to pneuma autou to agion eiv hmav
draft_translation: He therefore that despises, despises not man, but God, who has also given to us his holy Spirit.
ukjv_translation: He therefore that despises, despises not man, but God, who has also given unto us his holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: περι δε της φιλαδελφιας ου χρειαν εχετε γραφειν υμιν αυτοι γαρ υμεις θεοδιδακτοι εστε εις το αγαπαν αλληλους
transliteration: peri de thv filadelfiav ou creian ecete grafein umin autoi gar umeiv yeodidaktoi este eiv to agapan allhlouv
draft_translation: But as concerning brotherly love you need not that I write to you: for you yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
ukjv_translation: But as concerning brotherly love all of you need not that I write unto you: for all of you yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και γαρ ποιειτε αυτο εις παντας τους αδελφους τους εν ολη τη μακεδονια παρακαλουμεν δε υμας αδελφοι περισσευειν μαλλον
transliteration: kai gar poieite auto eiv pantav touv adelfouv touv en olh th makedonia parakaloumen de umav adelfoi perisseuein mallon
draft_translation: And indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia: but we plead to you, brothers, that you increase more and more;
ukjv_translation: And indeed all of you do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we plead to you, brethren, that all of you increase more and more;
review_notes: fixed brothers casing; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: και φιλοτιμεισθαι ησυχαζειν και πρασσειν τα ιδια και εργαζεσθαι ταις ιδιαις χερσιν υμων καθως υμιν παρηγγειλαμεν
transliteration: kai filotimeisyai hsucazein kai prassein ta idia kai ergazesyai taiv idiaiv cersin umwn kaywv umin parhggeilamen
draft_translation: And that you study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
ukjv_translation: And that all of you study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

greek_text: ινα περιπατητε ευσχημονως προς τους εξω και μηδενος χρειαν εχητε
transliteration: ina peripathte euschmonwv prov touv exw kai mhdenov creian echte
draft_translation: That you may walk honestly toward those who are without, and that you may have lack of nothing.
ukjv_translation: That all of you may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that all of you may have lack of nothing.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι περι των κεκοιμημενων ινα μη λυπησθε καθως και οι λοιποι οι μη εχοντες ελπιδα
transliteration: ou yelw de umav agnoein adelfoi peri twn kekoimhmenwn ina mh luphsye kaywv kai oi loipoi oi mh econtev elpida
draft_translation: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who are asleep, that you sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
ukjv_translation: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that all of you sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
review_notes: modernized them-which relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ει γαρ πιστευομεν οτι ιησους απεθανεν και ανεστη ουτως και ο θεος τους κοιμηθεντας δια του ιησου αξει συν αυτω
transliteration: ei gar pisteuomen oti ihsouv apeyanen kai anesth outwv kai o yeov touv koimhyentav dia tou ihsou axei sun autw
draft_translation: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so those also who sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
ukjv_translation: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
review_notes: modernized personal relative wording; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: τουτο γαρ υμιν λεγομεν εν λογω κυριου οτι ημεις οι ζωντες οι περιλειπομενοι εις την παρουσιαν του κυριου ου μη φθασωμεν τους κοιμηθεντας
transliteration: touto gar umin legomen en logw kuriou oti hmeiv oi zwntev oi perileipomenoi eiv thn parousian tou kuriou ou mh fyaswmen touv koimhyentav
draft_translation: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain to the coming of the Lord shall not prevent those who are asleep.
ukjv_translation: For this we say unto you by the word (o. logos) of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-which relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οτι αυτος ο κυριος εν κελευσματι εν φωνη αρχαγγελου και εν σαλπιγγι θεου καταβησεται απ ουρανου και οι νεκροι εν χριστω αναστησονται πρωτον
transliteration: oti autov o kuriov en keleusmati en fwnh arcaggelou kai en salpiggi yeou katabhsetai ap ouranou kai oi nekroi en cristw anasthsontai prwton
draft_translation: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
ukjv_translation: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

greek_text: επειτα ημεις οι ζωντες οι περιλειπομενοι αμα συν αυτοις αρπαγησομεθα εν νεφελαις εις απαντησιν του κυριου εις αερα και ουτως παντοτε συν κυριω εσομεθα
transliteration: epeita hmeiv oi zwntev oi perileipomenoi ama sun autoiv arpaghsomeya en nefelaiv eiv apanthsin tou kuriou eiv aera kai outwv pantote sun kuriw esomeya
draft_translation: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

greek_text: ωστε παρακαλειτε αλληλους εν τοις λογοις τουτοις
transliteration: wste parakaleite allhlouv en toiv logoiv toutoiv
draft_translation: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore comfort one another with these words. (o. logos)
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: περι δε των χρονων και των καιρων αδελφοι ου χρειαν εχετε υμιν γραφεσθαι
transliteration: peri de twn cronwn kai twn kairwn adelfoi ou creian ecete umin grafesyai
draft_translation: But of the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that I write to you.
ukjv_translation: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, all of you have no need that I write unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αυτοι γαρ ακριβως οιδατε οτι η ημερα κυριου ως κλεπτης εν νυκτι ουτως ερχεται
transliteration: autoi gar akribwv oidate oti h hmera kuriou wv klepthv en nukti outwv ercetai
draft_translation: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.
ukjv_translation: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.

greek_text: οταν γαρ λεγωσιν ειρηνη και ασφαλεια τοτε αιφνιδιος αυτοις εφισταται ολεθρος ωσπερ η ωδιν τη εν γαστρι εχουση και ου μη εκφυγωσιν
transliteration: otan gar legwsin eirhnh kai asfaleia tote aifnidiov autoiv efistatai oleyrov wsper h wdin th en gastri ecoush kai ou mh ekfugwsin
draft_translation: For when they say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction comes upon them, as birth pains upon a pregnant woman; and they shall not escape.
ukjv_translation: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction comes upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

greek_text: υμεις δε αδελφοι ουκ εστε εν σκοτει ινα η ημερα υμας ως κλεπτης καταλαβη
transliteration: umeiv de adelfoi ouk este en skotei ina h hmera umav wv klepthv katalabh
draft_translation: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the day should overtake you as a thief.
ukjv_translation: But all of you, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
review_notes: fixed that-that-day artifact; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: παντες υμεις υιοι φωτος εστε και υιοι ημερας ουκ εσμεν νυκτος ουδε σκοτους
transliteration: pantev umeiv uioi fwtov este kai uioi hmerav ouk esmen nuktov oude skotouv
draft_translation: You are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
ukjv_translation: All of you are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

greek_text: αρα ουν μη καθευδωμεν ως και οι λοιποι αλλα γρηγορωμεν και νηφωμεν
transliteration: ara oun mh kayeudwmen wv kai oi loipoi alla grhgorwmen kai nhfwmen
draft_translation: Therefore let us not sleep, as the rest do; but let us watch and be sober.
ukjv_translation: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

greek_text: οι γαρ καθευδοντες νυκτος καθευδουσιν και οι μεθυσκομενοι νυκτος μεθυουσιν
transliteration: oi gar kayeudontev nuktov kayeudousin kai oi meyuskomenoi nuktov meyuousin
draft_translation: For those who sleep sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunken in the night.
ukjv_translation: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; modernized they-that relative

greek_text: ημεις δε ημερας οντες νηφωμεν ενδυσαμενοι θωρακα πιστεως και αγαπης και περικεφαλαιαν ελπιδα σωτηριας
transliteration: hmeiv de hmerav ontev nhfwmen endusamenoi ywraka pistewv kai agaphv kai perikefalaian elpida swthriav
draft_translation: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
