ukjv_translation: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; (o. agape) and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οτι ουκ εθετο ημας ο θεος εις οργην αλλ εις περιποιησιν σωτηριας δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: oti ouk eyeto hmav o yeov eiv orghn all eiv peripoihsin swthriav dia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
ukjv_translation: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

greek_text: του αποθανοντος υπερ ημων ινα ειτε γρηγορωμεν ειτε καθευδωμεν αμα συν αυτω ζησωμεν
transliteration: tou apoyanontov uper hmwn ina eite grhgorwmen eite kayeudwmen ama sun autw zhswmen
draft_translation: Who died for us, that, whether we watch or sleep, we should live together with him.
ukjv_translation: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

greek_text: διο παρακαλειτε αλληλους και οικοδομειτε εις τον ενα καθως και ποιειτε
transliteration: dio parakaleite allhlouv kai oikodomeite eiv ton ena kaywv kai poieite
draft_translation: Therefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also you do.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also all of you do.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ερωτωμεν δε υμας αδελφοι ειδεναι τους κοπιωντας εν υμιν και προισταμενους υμων εν κυριω και νουθετουντας υμας
transliteration: erwtwmen de umav adelfoi eidenai touv kopiwntav en umin kai proistamenouv umwn en kuriw kai nouyetountav umav
draft_translation: And we plead to you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
ukjv_translation: And we plead to you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; modernized them-which relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: και ηγεισθαι αυτους υπερ εκπερισσου εν αγαπη δια το εργον αυτων ειρηνευετε εν εαυτοις
transliteration: kai hgeisyai autouv uper ekperissou en agaph dia to ergon autwn eirhneuete en eautoiv
draft_translation: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
ukjv_translation: And to esteem them very highly in love (o. agape) for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παρακαλουμεν δε υμας αδελφοι νουθετειτε τους ατακτους παραμυθεισθε τους ολιγοψυχους αντεχεσθε των ασθενων μακροθυμειτε προς παντας
transliteration: parakaloumen de umav adelfoi nouyeteite touv ataktouv paramuyeisye touv oligoqucouv antecesye twn asyenwn makroyumeite prov pantav
draft_translation: Now we exhort you, brothers, warn those who are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
ukjv_translation: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ορατε μη τις κακον αντι κακου τινι αποδω αλλα παντοτε το αγαθον διωκετε και εις αλληλους και εις παντας
transliteration: orate mh tiv kakon anti kakou tini apodw alla pantote to agayon diwkete kai eiv allhlouv kai eiv pantav
draft_translation: See that none render evil for evil to anyone; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
ukjv_translation: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized archaic directional unto

greek_text: παντοτε χαιρετε
transliteration: pantote cairete
draft_translation: Rejoice always.
ukjv_translation: Rejoice evermore.

greek_text: αδιαλειπτως προσευχεσθε
transliteration: adialeiptwv proseucesye
draft_translation: Pray without ceasing.
ukjv_translation: Pray without ceasing.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εν παντι ευχαριστειτε τουτο γαρ θελημα θεου εν χριστω ιησου εις υμας
transliteration: en panti eucaristeite touto gar yelhma yeou en cristw ihsou eiv umav
draft_translation: In everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
ukjv_translation: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

greek_text: το πνευμα μη σβεννυτε
transliteration: to pneuma mh sbennute
draft_translation: Quench not the Spirit.
ukjv_translation: Quench not the Spirit. (o. pneuma)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: προφητειας μη εξουθενειτε
transliteration: profhteiav mh exouyeneite
draft_translation: Do not despise prophecies.
ukjv_translation: Despise not prophesyings.

greek_text: παντα δοκιμαζετε το καλον κατεχετε
transliteration: panta dokimazete to kalon katecete
draft_translation: Test all things; hold fast the good.
ukjv_translation: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

greek_text: απο παντος ειδους πονηρου απεχεσθε
transliteration: apo pantov eidouv ponhrou apecesye
draft_translation: Abstain from every form of evil.
ukjv_translation: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

greek_text: αυτος δε ο θεος της ειρηνης αγιασαι υμας ολοτελεις και ολοκληρον υμων το πνευμα και η ψυχη και το σωμα αμεμπτως εν τη παρουσια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου τηρηθειη
transliteration: autov de o yeov thv eirhnhv agiasai umav oloteleiv kai oloklhron umwn to pneuma kai h quch kai to swma amemptwv en th parousia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou thrhyeih
draft_translation: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit (o. pneuma) and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πιστος ο καλων υμας ος και ποιησει
transliteration: pistov o kalwn umav ov kai poihsei
draft_translation: Faithful is the one who calls you, who also will do it.
ukjv_translation: Faithful is he that calls you, who also will do it.

greek_text: αδελφοι προσευχεσθε περι ημων
transliteration: adelfoi proseucesye peri hmwn
draft_translation: Brothers, pray for us.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, pray for us.

greek_text: ασπασασθε τους αδελφους παντας εν φιληματι αγιω
transliteration: aspasasye touv adelfouv pantav en filhmati agiw
draft_translation: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
ukjv_translation: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ορκιζω υμας τον κυριον αναγνωσθηναι την επιστολην πασιν τοις αγιοις αδελφοις
transliteration: orkizw umav ton kurion anagnwsyhnai thn epistolhn pasin toiv agioiv adelfoiv
draft_translation: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brothers.
ukjv_translation: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou mey umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

greek_text: [ΠΑΥΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΟΥ Η ΠΡΟΣ ΘΕΣΣΑΛΟΝΙΚΕΙΣ ΕΠΙΣΤΟΛΗ ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ] παυλος και σιλουανος και τιμοθεος τη εκκλησια θεσσαλονικεων εν θεω πατρι ημων και κυριω ιησου χριστω
transliteration: [PAULOU TOU APOSTOLOU H PROS YESSALONIKEIS EPISTOLH DEUTERA] paulov kai silouanov kai timoyeov th ekklhsia yessalonikewn en yew patri hmwn kai kuriw ihsou cristw
draft_translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ekklesia as assembly; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ευχαριστειν οφειλομεν τω θεω παντοτε περι υμων αδελφοι καθως αξιον εστιν οτι υπεραυξανει η πιστις υμων και πλεοναζει η αγαπη ενος εκαστου παντων υμων εις αλληλους
transliteration: eucaristein ofeilomen tw yew pantote peri umwn adelfoi kaywv axion estin oti uperauxanei h pistiv umwn kai pleonazei h agaph enov ekastou pantwn umwn eiv allhlouv
draft_translation: We are bound to thank God always for you, brothers, as it is fitting, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of every one of you all toward each other abounds;
ukjv_translation: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith grows exceedingly, and the love (o. agape) of every one of you all toward each other abounds;
review_notes: modernized because-that wording; modernized meet-as-fitting; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ωστε ημας αυτους εν υμιν καυχασθαι εν ταις εκκλησιαις του θεου υπερ της υπομονης υμων και πιστεως εν πασιν τοις διωγμοις υμων και ταις θλιψεσιν αις ανεχεσθε
transliteration: wste hmav autouv en umin kaucasyai en taiv ekklhsiaiv tou yeou uper thv upomonhv umwn kai pistewv en pasin toiv diwgmoiv umwn kai taiv yliqesin aiv anecesye
draft_translation: So that we ourselves boast in you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you endure:
ukjv_translation: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that all of you endure:
review_notes: removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered ekklesia as assembly; rendered kauchaomai as boast

greek_text: ενδειγμα της δικαιας κρισεως του θεου εις το καταξιωθηναι υμας της βασιλειας του θεου υπερ ης και πασχετε
transliteration: endeigma thv dikaiav krisewv tou yeou eiv to kataxiwyhnai umav thv basileiav tou yeou uper hv kai pascete
draft_translation: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you also suffer:
ukjv_translation: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that all of you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which all of you also suffer:

greek_text: ειπερ δικαιον παρα θεω ανταποδουναι τοις θλιβουσιν υμας θλιψιν
transliteration: eiper dikaion para yew antapodounai toiv ylibousin umav yliqin
draft_translation: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to those who trouble you;
ukjv_translation: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

greek_text: και υμιν τοις θλιβομενοις ανεσιν μεθ ημων εν τη αποκαλυψει του κυριου ιησου απ ουρανου μετ αγγελων δυναμεως αυτου
transliteration: kai umin toiv ylibomenoiv anesin mey hmwn en th apokaluqei tou kuriou ihsou ap ouranou met aggelwn dunamewv autou
draft_translation: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
ukjv_translation: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

greek_text: εν πυρι φλογος διδοντος εκδικησιν τοις μη ειδοσιν θεον και τοις μη υπακουουσιν τω ευαγγελιω του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: en puri flogov didontov ekdikhsin toiv mh eidosin yeon kai toiv mh upakouousin tw euaggeliw tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: In flaming fire taking vengeance on those who do not know God, and that obey not the good news of our Lord Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
review_notes: modernized know-not idiom; modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: οιτινες δικην τισουσιν ολεθρον αιωνιον απο προσωπου του κυριου και απο της δοξης της ισχυος αυτου
transliteration: oitinev dikhn tisousin oleyron aiwnion apo proswpou tou kuriou kai apo thv doxhv thv iscuov autou
draft_translation: Who shall be punished with eternal destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
ukjv_translation: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: οταν ελθη ενδοξασθηναι εν τοις αγιοις αυτου και θαυμασθηναι εν πασιν τοις πιστευουσιν οτι επιστευθη το μαρτυριον ημων εφ υμας εν τη ημερα εκεινη
transliteration: otan elyh endoxasyhnai en toiv agioiv autou kai yaumasyhnai en pasin toiv pisteuousin oti episteuyh to marturion hmwn ef umav en th hmera ekeinh
draft_translation: When he shall come to be glorified in his holy ones, and to be admired in all those who believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
ukjv_translation: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: εις ο και προσευχομεθα παντοτε περι υμων ινα υμας αξιωση της κλησεως ο θεος ημων και πληρωση πασαν ευδοκιαν αγαθωσυνης και εργον πιστεως εν δυναμει
transliteration: eiv o kai proseucomeya pantote peri umwn ina umav axiwsh thv klhsewv o yeov hmwn kai plhrwsh pasan eudokian agaywsunhv kai ergon pistewv en dunamei
draft_translation: Therefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfill all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfill all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

greek_text: οπως ενδοξασθη το ονομα του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εν υμιν και υμεις εν αυτω κατα την χαριν του θεου ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: opwv endoxasyh to onoma tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou en umin kai umeiv en autw kata thn carin tou yeou hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and all of you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ερωτωμεν δε υμας αδελφοι υπερ της παρουσιας του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου και ημων επισυναγωγης επ αυτον
transliteration: erwtwmen de umav adelfoi uper thv parousiav tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou kai hmwn episunagwghv ep auton
draft_translation: Now we plead to you, brothers, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together to him,
ukjv_translation: Now we plead to you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: εις το μη ταχεως σαλευθηναι υμας απο του νοος μητε θροεισθαι μητε δια πνευματος μητε δια λογου μητε δι επιστολης ως δι ημων ως οτι ενεστηκεν η ημερα του χριστου
transliteration: eiv to mh tacewv saleuyhnai umav apo tou noov mhte yroeisyai mhte dia pneumatov mhte dia logou mhte di epistolhv wv di hmwn wv oti enesthken h hmera tou cristou
draft_translation: That you be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
ukjv_translation: That all of you be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, (o. pneuma) nor by word, (o. logos) nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη τις υμας εξαπατηση κατα μηδενα τροπον οτι εαν μη ελθη η αποστασια πρωτον και αποκαλυφθη ο ανθρωπος της αμαρτιας ο υιος της απωλειας
transliteration: mh tiv umav exapathsh kata mhdena tropon oti ean mh elyh h apostasia prwton kai apokalufyh o anyrwpov thv amartiav o uiov thv apwleiav
draft_translation: Let no one deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of destruction;
ukjv_translation: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; rendered apoleia as destruction

greek_text: ο αντικειμενος και υπεραιρομενος επι παν το λεγομενον θεον η σεβασμα ωστε αυτον εις τον ναον του θεου ως θεον καθισαι αποδεικνυντα εαυτον οτι εστιν θεος
transliteration: o antikeimenov kai uperairomenov epi pan to legomenon yeon h sebasma wste auton eiv ton naon tou yeou wv yeon kayisai apodeiknunta eauton oti estin yeov
draft_translation: Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God, or that is worshiped; so that he as God sits in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.
ukjv_translation: Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sits in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.

greek_text: ου μνημονευετε οτι ετι ων προς υμας ταυτα ελεγον υμιν
transliteration: ou mnhmoneuete oti eti wn prov umav tauta elegon umin
draft_translation: Remember you not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
ukjv_translation: Remember all of you not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

greek_text: και νυν το κατεχον οιδατε εις το αποκαλυφθηναι αυτον εν τω εαυτου καιρω
transliteration: kai nun to katecon oidate eiv to apokalufyhnai auton en tw eautou kairw
draft_translation: And now you know what withholds that he might be revealed in his time.
ukjv_translation: And now all of you know what withholds that he might be revealed in his time.

greek_text: το γαρ μυστηριον ηδη ενεργειται της ανομιας μονον ο κατεχων αρτι εως εκ μεσου γενηται
transliteration: to gar musthrion hdh energeitai thv anomiav monon o katecwn arti ewv ek mesou genhtai
draft_translation: For the mystery of iniquity already works: only there is the one restraining now, until he comes out of the midst.
ukjv_translation: For the mystery of iniquity does already work: only he who now lets will let, until he be taken out of the way.

greek_text: και τοτε αποκαλυφθησεται ο ανομος ον ο κυριος αναλωσει τω πνευματι του στοματος αυτου και καταργησει τη επιφανεια της παρουσιας αυτου
transliteration: kai tote apokalufyhsetai o anomov on o kuriov analwsei tw pneumati tou stomatov autou kai katarghsei th epifaneia thv parousiav autou
draft_translation: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
ukjv_translation: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit (o. pneuma) of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ου εστιν η παρουσια κατ ενεργειαν του σατανα εν παση δυναμει και σημειοις και τερασιν ψευδους
transliteration: ou estin h parousia kat energeian tou satana en pash dunamei kai shmeioiv kai terasin qeudouv
draft_translation: whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and wonders of falsehood,
ukjv_translation: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

greek_text: και εν παση απατη της αδικιας εν τοις απολλυμενοις ανθ ων την αγαπην της αληθειας ουκ εδεξαντο εις το σωθηναι αυτους
transliteration: kai en pash apath thv adikiav en toiv apollumenoiv any wn thn agaphn thv alhyeiav ouk edexanto eiv to swyhnai autouv
draft_translation: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in those who perish; because they did not receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
ukjv_translation: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love (o. agape) of the truth, that they might be saved.
review_notes: modernized residual verb-not wording; modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και δια τουτο πεμψει αυτοις ο θεος ενεργειαν πλανης εις το πιστευσαι αυτους τω ψευδει
transliteration: kai dia touto pemqei autoiv o yeov energeian planhv eiv to pisteusai autouv tw qeudei
draft_translation: And because of this God shall send them a working of error, that they should believe the lie:
ukjv_translation: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

greek_text: ινα κριθωσιν παντες οι μη πιστευσαντες τη αληθεια αλλ ευδοκησαντες εν τη αδικια
transliteration: ina kriywsin pantev oi mh pisteusantev th alhyeia all eudokhsantev en th adikia
draft_translation: That they all might be damned who did not believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
ukjv_translation: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

greek_text: ημεις δε οφειλομεν ευχαριστειν τω θεω παντοτε περι υμων αδελφοι ηγαπημενοι υπο κυριου οτι ειλετο υμας ο θεος απ αρχης εις σωτηριαν εν αγιασμω πνευματος και πιστει αληθειας
transliteration: hmeiv de ofeilomen eucaristein tw yew pantote peri umwn adelfoi hgaphmenoi upo kuriou oti eileto umav o yeov ap archv eiv swthrian en agiasmw pneumatov kai pistei alhyeiav
draft_translation: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
ukjv_translation: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit (o. pneuma) and belief of the truth:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: εις ο εκαλεσεν υμας δια του ευαγγελιου ημων εις περιποιησιν δοξης του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: eiv o ekalesen umav dia tou euaggeliou hmwn eiv peripoihsin doxhv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: To which he called you by our good news, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Unto which he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: αρα ουν αδελφοι στηκετε και κρατειτε τας παραδοσεις ας εδιδαχθητε ειτε δια λογου ειτε δι επιστολης ημων
transliteration: ara oun adelfoi sthkete kai krateite tav paradoseiv av edidacyhte eite dia logou eite di epistolhv hmwn
draft_translation: Therefore, brothers, stand fast, and hold the traditions which you have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
ukjv_translation: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which all of you have been taught, whether by word, (o. logos) or our epistle.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αυτος δε ο κυριος ημων ιησους χριστος και ο θεος και πατηρ ημων ο αγαπησας ημας και δους παρακλησιν αιωνιαν και ελπιδα αγαθην εν χαριτι
transliteration: autov de o kuriov hmwn ihsouv cristov kai o yeov kai pathr hmwn o agaphsav hmav kai douv paraklhsin aiwnian kai elpida agayhn en cariti
draft_translation: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, who has loved us, and has given us eternal consolation and good hope through grace,
ukjv_translation: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which has loved us, and has given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: παρακαλεσαι υμων τας καρδιας και στηριξαι υμας εν παντι λογω και εργω αγαθω
transliteration: parakalesai umwn tav kardiav kai sthrixai umav en panti logw kai ergw agayw
draft_translation: Comfort your hearts, and establish you in every good word and work.
ukjv_translation: Comfort your hearts, and establish you in every good word (o. logos) and work.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: το λοιπον προσευχεσθε αδελφοι περι ημων ινα ο λογος του κυριου τρεχη και δοξαζηται καθως και προς υμας
transliteration: to loipon proseucesye adelfoi peri hmwn ina o logov tou kuriou trech kai doxazhtai kaywv kai prov umav
draft_translation: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
ukjv_translation: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word (o. logos) of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: και ινα ρυσθωμεν απο των ατοπων και πονηρων ανθρωπων ου γαρ παντων η πιστις
transliteration: kai ina rusywmen apo twn atopwn kai ponhrwn anyrwpwn ou gar pantwn h pistiv
draft_translation: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men: for the faith is not of all.
ukjv_translation: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

greek_text: πιστος δε εστιν ο κυριος ος στηριξει υμας και φυλαξει απο του πονηρου
transliteration: pistov de estin o kuriov ov sthrixei umav kai fulaxei apo tou ponhrou
draft_translation: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and keep you from evil.
ukjv_translation: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and keep you from evil.

greek_text: πεποιθαμεν δε εν κυριω εφ υμας οτι α παραγγελλομεν υμιν και ποιειτε και ποιησετε
transliteration: pepoiyamen de en kuriw ef umav oti a paraggellomen umin kai poieite kai poihsete
draft_translation: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.
ukjv_translation: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that all of you both do and will do the things which we command you.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ο δε κυριος κατευθυναι υμων τας καρδιας εις την αγαπην του θεου και εις την υπομονην του χριστου
transliteration: o de kuriov kateuyunai umwn tav kardiav eiv thn agaphn tou yeou kai eiv thn upomonhn tou cristou
draft_translation: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
ukjv_translation: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love (o. agape) of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παραγγελλομεν δε υμιν αδελφοι εν ονοματι του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου στελλεσθαι υμας απο παντος αδελφου ατακτως περιπατουντος και μη κατα την παραδοσιν ην παρελαβεν παρ ημων
transliteration: paraggellomen de umin adelfoi en onomati tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou stellesyai umav apo pantov adelfou ataktwv peripatountov kai mh kata thn paradosin hn parelaben par hmwn
draft_translation: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother that walks disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
ukjv_translation: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you withdraw yourselves from every brother that walks disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αυτοι γαρ οιδατε πως δει μιμεισθαι ημας οτι ουκ ητακτησαμεν εν υμιν
transliteration: autoi gar oidate pwv dei mimeisyai hmav oti ouk htakthsamen en umin
draft_translation: For yourselves know how you ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
ukjv_translation: For yourselves know how all of you ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

greek_text: ουδε δωρεαν αρτον εφαγομεν παρα τινος αλλ εν κοπω και μοχθω νυκτα και ημεραν εργαζομενοι προς το μη επιβαρησαι τινα υμων
transliteration: oude dwrean arton efagomen para tinov all en kopw kai mocyw nukta kai hmeran ergazomenoi prov to mh epibarhsai tina umwn
draft_translation: Neither did we eat anyone's bread for nothing; but worked with labor and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
ukjv_translation: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nothing; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized labour spelling; modernized wrought

greek_text: ουχ οτι ουκ εχομεν εξουσιαν αλλ ινα εαυτους τυπον δωμεν υμιν εις το μιμεισθαι ημας
transliteration: ouc oti ouk ecomen exousian all ina eautouv tupon dwmen umin eiv to mimeisyai hmav
draft_translation: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an example to you to follow us.
ukjv_translation: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an example unto you to follow us.

greek_text: και γαρ οτε ημεν προς υμας τουτο παρηγγελλομεν υμιν οτι ει τις ου θελει εργαζεσθαι μηδε εσθιετω
transliteration: kai gar ote hmen prov umav touto parhggellomen umin oti ei tiv ou yelei ergazesyai mhde esyietw
draft_translation: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.
ukjv_translation: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

greek_text: ακουομεν γαρ τινας περιπατουντας εν υμιν ατακτως μηδεν εργαζομενους αλλα περιεργαζομενους
transliteration: akouomen gar tinav peripatountav en umin ataktwv mhden ergazomenouv alla periergazomenouv
draft_translation: For we hear that some walk among you disorderly, not working at all, but being busybodies.
ukjv_translation: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

greek_text: τοις δε τοιουτοις παραγγελλομεν και παρακαλουμεν δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ινα μετα ησυχιας εργαζομενοι τον εαυτων αρτον εσθιωσιν
transliteration: toiv de toioutoiv paraggellomen kai parakaloumen dia tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou ina meta hsuciav ergazomenoi ton eautwn arton esyiwsin
draft_translation: Now those who are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
ukjv_translation: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
review_notes: modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: υμεις δε αδελφοι μη εκκακησητε καλοποιουντες
transliteration: umeiv de adelfoi mh ekkakhshte kalopoiountev
draft_translation: But you, brothers, do not be weary in well doing.
ukjv_translation: But all of you, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
review_notes: modernized be-not imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ει δε τις ουχ υπακουει τω λογω ημων δια της επιστολης τουτον σημειουσθε και μη συναναμιγνυσθε αυτω ινα εντραπη
transliteration: ei de tiv ouc upakouei tw logw hmwn dia thv epistolhv touton shmeiousye kai mh sunanamignusye autw ina entraph
draft_translation: And if anyone obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
ukjv_translation: And if any man obey not our word (o. logos) by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και μη ως εχθρον ηγεισθε αλλα νουθετειτε ως αδελφον
transliteration: kai mh wv ecyron hgeisye alla nouyeteite wv adelfon
draft_translation: And do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
ukjv_translation: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

greek_text: αυτος δε ο κυριος της ειρηνης δωη υμιν την ειρηνην δια παντος εν παντι τροπω ο κυριος μετα παντων υμων
transliteration: autov de o kuriov thv eirhnhv dwh umin thn eirhnhn dia pantov en panti tropw o kuriov meta pantwn umwn
draft_translation: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
ukjv_translation: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

greek_text: ο ασπασμος τη εμη χειρι παυλου ο εστιν σημειον εν παση επιστολη ουτως γραφω
transliteration: o aspasmov th emh ceiri paulou o estin shmeion en pash epistolh outwv grafw
draft_translation: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
ukjv_translation: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

greek_text: [ΠΑΥΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΟΥ Η ΠΡΟΣ ΤΙΜΟΘΕΟΝ ΕΠΙΣΤΟΛΗ ΠΡΩΤΗ] παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου κατ επιταγην θεου σωτηρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου της ελπιδος ημων
transliteration: [PAULOU TOU APOSTOLOU H PROS TIMOYEON EPISTOLH PRWTH] paulov apostolov ihsou cristou kat epitaghn yeou swthrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou thv elpidov hmwn
draft_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Savior, and Lord Jesus Christ, who is our hope;
ukjv_translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; modernized personal which as who; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: τιμοθεω γνησιω τεκνω εν πιστει χαρις ελεος ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων
transliteration: timoyew gnhsiw teknw en pistei cariv eleov eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai ihsou cristou tou kuriou hmwn
draft_translation: To Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
ukjv_translation: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: καθως παρεκαλεσα σε προσμειναι εν εφεσω πορευομενος εις μακεδονιαν ινα παραγγειλης τισιν μη ετεροδιδασκαλειν
transliteration: kaywv parekalesa se prosmeinai en efesw poreuomenov eiv makedonian ina paraggeilhv tisin mh eterodidaskalein
draft_translation: As I begged you to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
ukjv_translation: As I besought you to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

greek_text: μηδε προσεχειν μυθοις και γενεαλογιαις απεραντοις αιτινες ζητησεις παρεχουσιν μαλλον η οικοδομιαν θεου την εν πιστει
transliteration: mhde prosecein muyoiv kai genealogiaiv aperantoiv aitinev zhthseiv parecousin mallon h oikodomian yeou thn en pistei
draft_translation: nor to give heed to myths and endless genealogies, which produce disputes rather than godly edification which is in faith.
ukjv_translation: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

greek_text: το δε τελος της παραγγελιας εστιν αγαπη εκ καθαρας καρδιας και συνειδησεως αγαθης και πιστεως ανυποκριτου
transliteration: to de telov thv paraggeliav estin agaph ek kayarav kardiav kai suneidhsewv agayhv kai pistewv anupokritou
draft_translation: Now the end of the commandment is love out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith sincere:
ukjv_translation: Now the end of the commandment is love (o. agape) out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith sincere:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ων τινες αστοχησαντες εξετραπησαν εις ματαιολογιαν
transliteration: wn tinev astochsantev exetraphsan eiv mataiologian
draft_translation: From which some having miss the mark have turned aside to vain arguments;
ukjv_translation: From which some having miss the mark have turned aside unto vain arguments;

greek_text: θελοντες ειναι νομοδιδασκαλοι μη νοουντες μητε α λεγουσιν μητε περι τινων διαβεβαιουνται
transliteration: yelontev einai nomodidaskaloi mh noountev mhte a legousin mhte peri tinwn diabebaiountai
draft_translation: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor of which they affirm.
ukjv_translation: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

greek_text: οιδαμεν δε οτι καλος ο νομος εαν τις αυτω νομιμως χρηται
transliteration: oidamen de oti kalov o nomov ean tiv autw nomimwv crhtai
draft_translation: But we know that the law is good, if anyone uses it lawfully;
ukjv_translation: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

greek_text: ειδως τουτο οτι δικαιω νομος ου κειται ανομοις δε και ανυποτακτοις ασεβεσιν και αμαρτωλοις ανοσιοις και βεβηλοις πατραλωαις και μητραλωαις ανδροφονοις
transliteration: eidwv touto oti dikaiw nomov ou keitai anomoiv de kai anupotaktoiv asebesin kai amartwloiv anosioiv kai bebhloiv patralwaiv kai mhtralwaiv androfonoiv
draft_translation: Knowing this, that law is not laid down for a righteous one, but for lawless and unruly, for ungodly and sinners, for unholy and profane, for father-killers and mother-killers, for murderers,
ukjv_translation: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

greek_text: πορνοις αρσενοκοιταις ανδραποδισταις ψευσταις επιορκοις και ει τι ετερον τη υγιαινουση διδασκαλια αντικειται
transliteration: pornoiv arsenokoitaiv andrapodistaiv qeustaiv epiorkoiv kai ei ti eteron th ugiainoush didaskalia antikeitai
draft_translation: For sexually immoral, for those who defile themselves with mankind, for men-stealers, for liars, for promise breakers, and if there is any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
ukjv_translation: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for men-stealers (p. slave traders, kidnappers), for liars, for promise breakers, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
review_notes: modernized if-there-be idiom; modernized pornos wording; modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: κατα το ευαγγελιον της δοξης του μακαριου θεου ο επιστευθην εγω
transliteration: kata to euaggelion thv doxhv tou makariou yeou o episteuyhn egw
draft_translation: According to the glorious good news of the blessed God, who was committed to my trust.
ukjv_translation: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: και χαριν εχω τω ενδυναμωσαντι με χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων οτι πιστον με ηγησατο θεμενος εις διακονιαν
transliteration: kai carin ecw tw endunamwsanti me cristw ihsou tw kuriw hmwn oti piston me hghsato yemenov eiv diakonian
draft_translation: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
ukjv_translation: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

greek_text: τον προτερον οντα βλασφημον και διωκτην και υβριστην αλλ ηλεηθην οτι αγνοων εποιησα εν απιστια
transliteration: ton proteron onta blasfhmon kai diwkthn kai ubristhn all hlehyhn oti agnown epoihsa en apistia
draft_translation: I who was formerly a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and an insolent man: but I obtained mercy, because being ignorant I acted in unbelief.
ukjv_translation: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and prone to cause hurt: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

greek_text: υπερεπλεονασεν δε η χαρις του κυριου ημων μετα πιστεως και αγαπης της εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: uperepleonasen de h cariv tou kuriou hmwn meta pistewv kai agaphv thv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love (o. agape) which is in Christ Jesus.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πιστος ο λογος και πασης αποδοχης αξιος οτι χριστος ιησους ηλθεν εις τον κοσμον αμαρτωλους σωσαι ων πρωτος ειμι εγω
transliteration: pistov o logov kai pashv apodochv axiov oti cristov ihsouv hlyen eiv ton kosmon amartwlouv swsai wn prwtov eimi egw
draft_translation: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
ukjv_translation: This is a faithful saying, (o. logos) and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αλλα δια τουτο ηλεηθην ινα εν εμοι πρωτω ενδειξηται ιησους χριστος την πασαν μακροθυμιαν προς υποτυπωσιν των μελλοντων πιστευειν επ αυτω εις ζωην αιωνιον
transliteration: alla dia touto hlehyhn ina en emoi prwtw endeixhtai ihsouv cristov thn pasan makroyumian prov upotupwsin twn mellontwn pisteuein ep autw eiv zwhn aiwnion
draft_translation: Nevertheless for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to those who should hereafter believe on him to life eternal.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
review_notes: modernized them-which relative; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: τω δε βασιλει των αιωνων αφθαρτω αορατω μονω σοφω θεω τιμη και δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
transliteration: tw de basilei twn aiwnwn afyartw aoratw monw sofw yew timh kai doxa eiv touv aiwnav twn aiwnwn amhn
draft_translation: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forever spelling; modernized honour spelling

greek_text: ταυτην την παραγγελιαν παρατιθεμαι σοι τεκνον τιμοθεε κατα τας προαγουσας επι σε προφητειας ινα στρατευη εν αυταις την καλην στρατειαν
transliteration: tauthn thn paraggelian paratiyemai soi teknon timoyee kata tav proagousav epi se profhteiav ina strateuh en autaiv thn kalhn strateian
draft_translation: This charge I commit to you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on you, that you by them might war a good warfare;
ukjv_translation: This charge I commit unto you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on you, that you by them might war a good warfare;

greek_text: εχων πιστιν και αγαθην συνειδησιν ην τινες απωσαμενοι περι την πιστιν εναυαγησαν
transliteration: ecwn pistin kai agayhn suneidhsin hn tinev apwsamenoi peri thn pistin enauaghsan
draft_translation: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
ukjv_translation: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

greek_text: ων εστιν υμεναιος και αλεξανδρος ους παρεδωκα τω σατανα ινα παιδευθωσιν μη βλασφημειν
transliteration: wn estin umenaiov kai alexandrov ouv paredwka tw satana ina paideuywsin mh blasfhmein
draft_translation: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered to Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
ukjv_translation: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

greek_text: παρακαλω ουν πρωτον παντων ποιεισθαι δεησεις προσευχας εντευξεις ευχαριστιας υπερ παντων ανθρωπων
transliteration: parakalw oun prwton pantwn poieisyai dehseiv proseucav enteuxeiv eucaristiav uper pantwn anyrwpwn
draft_translation: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all men;
ukjv_translation: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

greek_text: υπερ βασιλεων και παντων των εν υπεροχη οντων ινα ηρεμον και ησυχιον βιον διαγωμεν εν παση ευσεβεια και σεμνοτητι
transliteration: uper basilewn kai pantwn twn en uperoch ontwn ina hremon kai hsucion bion diagwmen en pash eusebeia kai semnothti
draft_translation: For kings, and for all who are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and tranquil life in all godliness and dignity.
ukjv_translation: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

greek_text: τουτο γαρ καλον και αποδεκτον ενωπιον του σωτηρος ημων θεου
transliteration: touto gar kalon kai apodekton enwpion tou swthrov hmwn yeou
draft_translation: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;
ukjv_translation: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

greek_text: ος παντας ανθρωπους θελει σωθηναι και εις επιγνωσιν αληθειας ελθειν
transliteration: ov pantav anyrwpouv yelei swyhnai kai eiv epignwsin alhyeiav elyein
draft_translation: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
ukjv_translation: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

greek_text: εις γαρ θεος εις και μεσιτης θεου και ανθρωπων ανθρωπος χριστος ιησους
transliteration: eiv gar yeov eiv kai mesithv yeou kai anyrwpwn anyrwpov cristov ihsouv
draft_translation: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
ukjv_translation: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο δους εαυτον αντιλυτρον υπερ παντων το μαρτυριον καιροις ιδιοις
transliteration: o douv eauton antilutron uper pantwn to marturion kairoiv idioiv
draft_translation: Who gave himself a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times.
ukjv_translation: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

greek_text: εις ο ετεθην εγω κηρυξ και αποστολος αληθειαν λεγω εν χριστω ου ψευδομαι διδασκαλος εθνων εν πιστει και αληθεια
transliteration: eiv o eteyhn egw khrux kai apostolov alhyeian legw en cristw ou qeudomai didaskalov eynwn en pistei kai alhyeia
draft_translation: To which I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the nations in faith and verity.
ukjv_translation: Unto which I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: βουλομαι ουν προσευχεσθαι τους ανδρας εν παντι τοπω επαιροντας οσιους χειρας χωρις οργης και διαλογισμου
transliteration: boulomai oun proseucesyai touv andrav en panti topw epairontav osiouv ceirav cwriv orghv kai dialogismou
draft_translation: I will therefore that men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
ukjv_translation: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

greek_text: ωσαυτως και τας γυναικας εν καταστολη κοσμιω μετα αιδους και σωφροσυνης κοσμειν εαυτας μη εν πλεγμασιν η χρυσω η μαργαριταις η ιματισμω πολυτελει
transliteration: wsautwv kai tav gunaikav en katastolh kosmiw meta aidouv kai swfrosunhv kosmein eautav mh en plegmasin h crusw h margaritaiv h imatismw polutelei
draft_translation: Likewise also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with reverence and sobriety; not with braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
ukjv_translation: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with reverence and sobriety; not with braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

greek_text: αλλ ο πρεπει γυναιξιν επαγγελλομεναις θεοσεβειαν δι εργων αγαθων
transliteration: all o prepei gunaixin epaggellomenaiv yeosebeian di ergwn agaywn
draft_translation: but with what befits women professing godliness, through good works.
ukjv_translation: But (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.

greek_text: γυνη εν ησυχια μανθανετω εν παση υποταγη
transliteration: gunh en hsucia manyanetw en pash upotagh
draft_translation: Let a woman learn in quietness with all submission.
ukjv_translation: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

greek_text: γυναικι δε διδασκειν ουκ επιτρεπω ουδε αυθεντειν ανδρος αλλ ειναι εν ησυχια
transliteration: gunaiki de didaskein ouk epitrepw oude auyentein androv all einai en hsucia
draft_translation: But I do not permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
ukjv_translation: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

greek_text: αδαμ γαρ πρωτος επλασθη ειτα ευα
transliteration: adam gar prwtov eplasyh eita eua
draft_translation: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
ukjv_translation: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και αδαμ ουκ ηπατηθη η δε γυνη απατηθεισα εν παραβασει γεγονεν
transliteration: kai adam ouk hpathyh h de gunh apathyeisa en parabasei gegonen
draft_translation: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, came to be in transgression.
ukjv_translation: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

greek_text: σωθησεται δε δια της τεκνογονιας εαν μεινωσιν εν πιστει και αγαπη και αγιασμω μετα σωφροσυνης
transliteration: swyhsetai de dia thv teknogoniav ean meinwsin en pistei kai agaph kai agiasmw meta swfrosunhv
draft_translation: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with sobriety.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and love (o. agape) and holiness with sobriety.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πιστος ο λογος ει τις επισκοπης ορεγεται καλου εργου επιθυμει
transliteration: pistov o logov ei tiv episkophv oregetai kalou ergou epiyumei
draft_translation: This is a true saying, If a man desire the oversight, he desires a good work.
ukjv_translation: This is a true saying, (o. logos) If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desires a good work.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered episkope as oversight

greek_text: δει ουν τον επισκοπον ανεπιληπτον ειναι μιας γυναικος ανδρα νηφαλιον σωφρονα κοσμιον φιλοξενον διδακτικον
transliteration: dei oun ton episkopon anepilhpton einai miav gunaikov andra nhfalion swfrona kosmion filoxenon didaktikon
draft_translation: An overseer then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behavior, given to hospitality, able to teach;
ukjv_translation: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, able to teach;
review_notes: modernized behaviour spelling; rendered episkopos as overseer

greek_text: μη παροινον μη πληκτην μη αισχροκερδη αλλ επιεικη αμαχον αφιλαργυρον
transliteration: mh paroinon mh plhkthn mh aiscrokerdh all epieikh amacon afilarguron
draft_translation: not given to wine, not a striker, not greedy for shameful gain; but gentle, peaceable, not loving money;
ukjv_translation: Not given to wine, not an attacker, not greedy of filthy illegal gain; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

greek_text: του ιδιου οικου καλως προισταμενον τεκνα εχοντα εν υποταγη μετα πασης σεμνοτητος
transliteration: tou idiou oikou kalwv proistamenon tekna econta en upotagh meta pashv semnothtov
draft_translation: One ruling well his own house, having his children in submission with all dignity;
ukjv_translation: One that rules well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

greek_text: ει δε τις του ιδιου οικου προστηναι ουκ οιδεν πως εκκλησιας θεου επιμελησεται
transliteration: ei de tiv tou idiou oikou prosthnai ouk oiden pwv ekklhsiav yeou epimelhsetai
draft_translation: (For if a man do not know how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the assembly of God?)
ukjv_translation: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
review_notes: modernized know-not idiom; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: μη νεοφυτον ινα μη τυφωθεις εις κριμα εμπεση του διαβολου
transliteration: mh neofuton ina mh tufwyeiv eiv krima empesh tou diabolou
draft_translation: Not a new convert, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
ukjv_translation: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

greek_text: δει δε αυτον και μαρτυριαν καλην εχειν απο των εξωθεν ινα μη εις ονειδισμον εμπεση και παγιδα του διαβολου
transliteration: dei de auton kai marturian kalhn ecein apo twn exwyen ina mh eiv oneidismon empesh kai pagida tou diabolou
draft_translation: Moreover he must have a good report of those who are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
ukjv_translation: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

greek_text: διακονους ωσαυτως σεμνους μη διλογους μη οινω πολλω προσεχοντας μη αισχροκερδεις
transliteration: diakonouv wsautwv semnouv mh dilogouv mh oinw pollw prosecontav mh aiscrokerdeiv
draft_translation: Likewise must the servants be grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy illegal gain;
ukjv_translation: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy illegal gain;

greek_text: εχοντας το μυστηριον της πιστεως εν καθαρα συνειδησει
transliteration: econtav to musthrion thv pistewv en kayara suneidhsei
draft_translation: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
ukjv_translation: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ουτοι δε δοκιμαζεσθωσαν πρωτον ειτα διακονειτωσαν ανεγκλητοι οντες
transliteration: kai outoi de dokimazesywsan prwton eita diakoneitwsan anegklhtoi ontev
draft_translation: And let these also first be proved; then let them serve, being found blameless.
ukjv_translation: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

greek_text: γυναικας ωσαυτως σεμνας μη διαβολους νηφαλιους πιστας εν πασιν
transliteration: gunaikav wsautwv semnav mh diabolouv nhfaliouv pistav en pasin
draft_translation: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
ukjv_translation: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

greek_text: διακονοι εστωσαν μιας γυναικος ανδρες τεκνων καλως προισταμενοι και των ιδιων οικων
transliteration: diakonoi estwsan miav gunaikov andrev teknwn kalwv proistamenoi kai twn idiwn oikwn
draft_translation: Let the servants be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
ukjv_translation: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

greek_text: οι γαρ καλως διακονησαντες βαθμον εαυτοις καλον περιποιουνται και πολλην παρρησιαν εν πιστει τη εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: oi gar kalwv diakonhsantev baymon eautoiv kalon peripoiountai kai pollhn parrhsian en pistei th en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: For those who have served well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; rendered diakoneo as serve

greek_text: ταυτα σοι γραφω ελπιζων ελθειν προς σε ταχιον
transliteration: tauta soi grafw elpizwn elyein prov se tacion
draft_translation: hoping to come to you shortly:
ukjv_translation: hoping to come to you shortly:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εαν δε βραδυνω ινα ειδης πως δει εν οικω θεου αναστρεφεσθαι ητις εστιν εκκλησια θεου ζωντος στυλος και εδραιωμα της αληθειας
transliteration: ean de bradunw ina eidhv pwv dei en oikw yeou anastrefesyai htiv estin ekklhsia yeou zwntov stulov kai edraiwma thv alhyeiav
draft_translation: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you ought to behave yourself in the house of God, who is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
ukjv_translation: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you ought to behave yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και ομολογουμενως μεγα εστιν το της ευσεβειας μυστηριον θεος εφανερωθη εν σαρκι εδικαιωθη εν πνευματι ωφθη αγγελοις εκηρυχθη εν εθνεσιν επιστευθη εν κοσμω ανεληφθη εν δοξη
transliteration: kai omologoumenwv mega estin to thv eusebeiav musthrion yeov efanerwyh en sarki edikaiwyh en pneumati wfyh aggeloiv ekhrucyh en eynesin episteuyh en kosmw anelhfyh en doxh
draft_translation: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached to the nations, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
ukjv_translation: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: το δε πνευμα ρητως λεγει οτι εν υστεροις καιροις αποστησονται τινες της πιστεως προσεχοντες πνευμασιν πλανοις και διδασκαλιαις δαιμονιων
transliteration: to de pneuma rhtwv legei oti en usteroiv kairoiv aposthsontai tinev thv pistewv prosecontev pneumasin planoiv kai didaskaliaiv daimoniwn
draft_translation: Now the Spirit speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of demons;
ukjv_translation: Now the Spirit (o. pneuma) speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, (o. pneuma) and doctrines of devils;
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered daimonion as demon

greek_text: εν υποκρισει ψευδολογων κεκαυτηριασμενων την ιδιαν συνειδησιν
transliteration: en upokrisei qeudologwn kekauthriasmenwn thn idian suneidhsin
draft_translation: In hypocrisy of liars, having their own conscience seared;
ukjv_translation: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

greek_text: κωλυοντων γαμειν απεχεσθαι βρωματων α ο θεος εκτισεν εις μεταληψιν μετα ευχαριστιας τοις πιστοις και επεγνωκοσιν την αληθειαν
transliteration: kwluontwn gamein apecesyai brwmatwn a o yeov ektisen eiv metalhqin meta eucaristiav toiv pistoiv kai epegnwkosin thn alhyeian
draft_translation: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from foods, which God has created to be received with thanksgiving of those who believe and know the truth.
ukjv_translation: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God has created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

greek_text: οτι παν κτισμα θεου καλον και ουδεν αποβλητον μετα ευχαριστιας λαμβανομενον
transliteration: oti pan ktisma yeou kalon kai ouden apoblhton meta eucaristiav lambanomenon
draft_translation: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, being received with thanksgiving:
ukjv_translation: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

greek_text: αγιαζεται γαρ δια λογου θεου και εντευξεως
transliteration: agiazetai gar dia logou yeou kai enteuxewv
draft_translation: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
ukjv_translation: For it is sanctified by the word (o. logos) of God and prayer.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ταυτα υποτιθεμενος τοις αδελφοις καλος εση διακονος ιησου χριστου εντρεφομενος τοις λογοις της πιστεως και της καλης διδασκαλιας η παρηκολουθηκας
transliteration: tauta upotiyemenov toiv adelfoiv kalov esh diakonov ihsou cristou entrefomenov toiv logoiv thv pistewv kai thv kalhv didaskaliav h parhkolouyhkav
draft_translation: If you put the brothers in remembrance of these things, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, to which you have attained.
ukjv_translation: If you put the brethren in remembrance of these things, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words (o. logos) of faith and of good doctrine, unto which you have attained.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: τους δε βεβηλους και γραωδεις μυθους παραιτου γυμναζε δε σεαυτον προς ευσεβειαν
transliteration: touv de bebhlouv kai grawdeiv muyouv paraitou gumnaze de seauton prov eusebeian
draft_translation: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise yourself rather to godliness.
ukjv_translation: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise yourself rather unto godliness.

greek_text: η γαρ σωματικη γυμνασια προς ολιγον εστιν ωφελιμος η δε ευσεβεια προς παντα ωφελιμος εστιν επαγγελιαν εχουσα ζωης της νυν και της μελλουσης
transliteration: h gar swmatikh gumnasia prov oligon estin wfelimov h de eusebeia prov panta wfelimov estin epaggelian ecousa zwhv thv nun kai thv melloushv
draft_translation: For bodily exercise profits little: but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
ukjv_translation: For bodily exercise profits little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

greek_text: πιστος ο λογος και πασης αποδοχης αξιος
transliteration: pistov o logov kai pashv apodochv axiov
draft_translation: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
ukjv_translation: This is a faithful saying (o. logos) and worthy of all acceptation.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εις τουτο γαρ και κοπιωμεν και ονειδιζομεθα οτι ηλπικαμεν επι θεω ζωντι ος εστιν σωτηρ παντων ανθρωπων μαλιστα πιστων
transliteration: eiv touto gar kai kopiwmen kai oneidizomeya oti hlpikamen epi yew zwnti ov estin swthr pantwn anyrwpwn malista pistwn
draft_translation: For therefore we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, specially of those that believe.
ukjv_translation: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: παραγγελλε ταυτα και διδασκε
transliteration: paraggelle tauta kai didaske
draft_translation: Command and teach these things.
ukjv_translation: These things command and teach.

greek_text: μηδεις σου της νεοτητος καταφρονειτω αλλα τυπος γινου των πιστων εν λογω εν αναστροφη εν αγαπη εν πνευματι εν πιστει εν αγνεια
transliteration: mhdeiv sou thv neothtov katafroneitw alla tupov ginou twn pistwn en logw en anastrofh en agaph en pneumati en pistei en agneia
draft_translation: Let no one despise your youth; but be an example of the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
ukjv_translation: Let no man despise your youth; but be you an example of the believers, in word, (o. logos) in conversation, in love, (o. agape) in spirit, (o. pneuma) in faith, in purity.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; modernized conversation as conduct; modernized no-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εως ερχομαι προσεχε τη αναγνωσει τη παρακλησει τη διδασκαλια
transliteration: ewv ercomai prosece th anagnwsei th paraklhsei th didaskalia
draft_translation: Until I come, give attention to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
ukjv_translation: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

greek_text: μη αμελει του εν σοι χαρισματος ο εδοθη σοι δια προφητειας μετα επιθεσεως των χειρων του πρεσβυτεριου
transliteration: mh amelei tou en soi carismatov o edoyh soi dia profhteiav meta epiyesewv twn ceirwn tou presbuteriou
draft_translation: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you through prophecy, with laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
ukjv_translation: Neglect not the gift that is in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

greek_text: ταυτα μελετα εν τουτοις ισθι ινα σου η προκοπη φανερα η εν πασιν
transliteration: tauta meleta en toutoiv isyi ina sou h prokoph fanera h en pasin
draft_translation: Practice these things; be in them; that your progress may be manifest to all.
ukjv_translation: Meditate upon these things; give yourself wholly to them; that your profiting may appear to all.

greek_text: επεχε σεαυτω και τη διδασκαλια επιμενε αυτοις τουτο γαρ ποιων και σεαυτον σωσεις και τους ακουοντας σου
transliteration: epece seautw kai th didaskalia epimene autoiv touto gar poiwn kai seauton swseiv kai touv akouontav sou
draft_translation: Take heed to yourself, and to the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this you shall both save yourself, and those who hear you.
ukjv_translation: Take heed unto yourself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this you shall both save yourself, and them that hear you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: πρεσβυτερω μη επιπληξης αλλα παρακαλει ως πατερα νεωτερους ως αδελφους
transliteration: presbuterw mh epiplhxhv alla parakalei wv patera newterouv wv adelfouv
draft_translation: Rebuke not an elder, but implore him as a father; and the younger men as brothers;
ukjv_translation: Rebuke not an elder, but implore him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

greek_text: πρεσβυτερας ως μητερας νεωτερας ως αδελφας εν παση αγνεια
transliteration: presbuterav wv mhterav newterav wv adelfav en pash agneia
draft_translation: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
ukjv_translation: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: χηρας τιμα τας οντως χηρας
transliteration: chrav tima tav ontwv chrav
draft_translation: Honor widows that are widows indeed.
ukjv_translation: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

greek_text: ει δε τις χηρα τεκνα η εκγονα εχει μανθανετωσαν πρωτον τον ιδιον οικον ευσεβειν και αμοιβας αποδιδοναι τοις προγονοις τουτο γαρ εστιν καλον και αποδεκτον ενωπιον του θεου
transliteration: ei de tiv chra tekna h ekgona ecei manyanetwsan prwton ton idion oikon eusebein kai amoibav apodidonai toiv progonoiv touto gar estin kalon kai apodekton enwpion tou yeou
draft_translation: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own house, and to give recompense to their parents: for this is good and acceptable before God.
ukjv_translation: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to show piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

greek_text: η δε οντως χηρα και μεμονωμενη ηλπικεν επι τον θεον και προσμενει ταις δεησεσιν και ταις προσευχαις νυκτος και ημερας
transliteration: h de ontwv chra kai memonwmenh hlpiken epi ton yeon kai prosmenei taiv dehsesin kai taiv proseucaiv nuktov kai hmerav
draft_translation: Now she who is truly a widow, and left alone, has set her hope on God, and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.
ukjv_translation: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusts in God, and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.

greek_text: η δε σπαταλωσα ζωσα τεθνηκεν
transliteration: h de spatalwsa zwsa teynhken
draft_translation: But she who lives in self-indulgence is dead while she lives.
ukjv_translation: But she that lives in pleasure is dead while she lives.

greek_text: και ταυτα παραγγελλε ινα ανεπιληπτοι ωσιν
transliteration: kai tauta paraggelle ina anepilhptoi wsin
draft_translation: And command these things, that they may be blameless.
ukjv_translation: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

greek_text: ει δε τις των ιδιων και μαλιστα των οικειων ου προνοει την πιστιν ηρνηται και εστιν απιστου χειρων
transliteration: ei de tiv twn idiwn kai malista twn oikeiwn ou pronoei thn pistin hrnhtai kai estin apistou ceirwn
draft_translation: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for those of his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
ukjv_translation: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

greek_text: χηρα καταλεγεσθω μη ελαττον ετων εξηκοντα γεγονυια ενος ανδρος γυνη
transliteration: chra katalegesyw mh elatton etwn exhkonta gegonuia enov androv gunh
draft_translation: Let a widow be enrolled not less than sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
ukjv_translation: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.

greek_text: εν εργοις καλοις μαρτυρουμενη ει ετεκνοτροφησεν ει εξενοδοχησεν ει αγιων ποδας ενιψεν ει θλιβομενοις επηρκεσεν ει παντι εργω αγαθω επηκολουθησεν
transliteration: en ergoiv kaloiv marturoumenh ei eteknotrofhsen ei exenodochsen ei agiwn podav eniqen ei ylibomenoiv ephrkesen ei panti ergw agayw ephkolouyhsen
draft_translation: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the holy ones' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
ukjv_translation: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

greek_text: νεωτερας δε χηρας παραιτου οταν γαρ καταστρηνιασωσιν του χριστου γαμειν θελουσιν
transliteration: newterav de chrav paraitou otan gar katastrhniaswsin tou cristou gamein yelousin
draft_translation: But refuse younger widows: for when they grow wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;
ukjv_translation: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

greek_text: εχουσαι κριμα οτι την πρωτην πιστιν ηθετησαν
transliteration: ecousai krima oti thn prwthn pistin hyethsan
draft_translation: Having judgment, because they have cast off their first faith.
ukjv_translation: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

greek_text: αμα δε και αργαι μανθανουσιν περιερχομεναι τας οικιας ου μονον δε αργαι αλλα και φλυαροι και περιεργοι λαλουσαι τα μη δεοντα
transliteration: ama de kai argai manyanousin periercomenai tav oikiav ou monon de argai alla kai fluaroi kai periergoi lalousai ta mh deonta
draft_translation: And at the same time they also learn to be idle, going about the houses; and not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
ukjv_translation: And likewise they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but gossiping also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

greek_text: βουλομαι ουν νεωτερας γαμειν τεκνογονειν οικοδεσποτειν μηδεμιαν αφορμην διδοναι τω αντικειμενω λοιδοριας χαριν
transliteration: boulomai oun newterav gamein teknogonein oikodespotein mhdemian aformhn didonai tw antikeimenw loidoriav carin
draft_translation: Therefore I will that younger women marry, bear children, rule the house, give no occasion to the adversary for reproach.
ukjv_translation: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

greek_text: ηδη γαρ τινες εξετραπησαν οπισω του σατανα
transliteration: hdh gar tinev exetraphsan opisw tou satana
draft_translation: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
ukjv_translation: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ει τις πιστος η πιστη εχει χηρας επαρκειτω αυταις και μη βαρεισθω η εκκλησια ινα ταις οντως χηραις επαρκεση
transliteration: ei tiv pistov h pisth ecei chrav eparkeitw autaiv kai mh bareisyw h ekklhsia ina taiv ontwv chraiv eparkesh
draft_translation: If anyone or woman that believes have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the assembly be charged; that it may relieve those who are widows indeed.
ukjv_translation: If any man or woman that believes have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized them-that relative; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: οι καλως προεστωτες πρεσβυτεροι διπλης τιμης αξιουσθωσαν μαλιστα οι κοπιωντες εν λογω και διδασκαλια
transliteration: oi kalwv proestwtev presbuteroi diplhv timhv axiousywsan malista oi kopiwntev en logw kai didaskalia
draft_translation: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially they who labor in the word and doctrine.
ukjv_translation: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word (o. logos) and doctrine.
review_notes: modernized honour spelling; modernized labour spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: λεγει γαρ η γραφη βουν αλοωντα ου φιμωσεις και αξιος ο εργατης του μισθου αυτου
transliteration: legei gar h grafh boun alownta ou fimwseiv kai axiov o ergathv tou misyou autou
draft_translation: For the scripture says, You shall not suppress the ox that treads out the grain. And, The laborer is worthy of his reward.
ukjv_translation: For the scripture says, You shall not suppress the ox that treads out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
review_notes: modernized corn as grain; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: κατα πρεσβυτερου κατηγοριαν μη παραδεχου εκτος ει μη επι δυο η τριων μαρτυρων
transliteration: kata presbuterou kathgorian mh paradecou ektov ei mh epi duo h triwn marturwn
draft_translation: Do not receive an accusation against an elder except upon two or three witnesses.
ukjv_translation: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

greek_text: τους αμαρτανοντας ενωπιον παντων ελεγχε ινα και οι λοιποι φοβον εχωσιν
transliteration: touv amartanontav enwpion pantwn elegce ina kai oi loipoi fobon ecwsin
draft_translation: those who sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
ukjv_translation: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

greek_text: διαμαρτυρομαι ενωπιον του θεου και κυριου ιησου χριστου και των εκλεκτων αγγελων ινα ταυτα φυλαξης χωρις προκριματος μηδεν ποιων κατα προσκλισιν
transliteration: diamarturomai enwpion tou yeou kai kuriou ihsou cristou kai twn eklektwn aggelwn ina tauta fulaxhv cwriv prokrimatov mhden poiwn kata prosklisin
draft_translation: I charge you before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that you observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
ukjv_translation: I charge you before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that you observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

greek_text: χειρας ταχεως μηδενι επιτιθει μηδε κοινωνει αμαρτιαις αλλοτριαις σεαυτον αγνον τηρει
transliteration: ceirav tacewv mhdeni epitiyei mhde koinwnei amartiaiv allotriaiv seauton agnon threi
draft_translation: Lay hands suddenly on no one, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep yourself pure.
ukjv_translation: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep yourself pure.

greek_text: μηκετι υδροποτει αλλ οινω ολιγω χρω δια τον στομαχον σου και τας πυκνας σου ασθενειας
transliteration: mhketi udropotei all oinw oligw crw dia ton stomacon sou kai tav puknav sou asyeneiav
draft_translation: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your often infirmities.
ukjv_translation: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and yours often infirmities.

greek_text: τινων ανθρωπων αι αμαρτιαι προδηλοι εισιν προαγουσαι εις κρισιν τισιν δε και επακολουθουσιν
transliteration: tinwn anyrwpwn ai amartiai prodhloi eisin proagousai eiv krisin tisin de kai epakolouyousin
draft_translation: Some men's sins are manifest beforehand, going before to judgment; and some also follow after.
