ukjv_translation: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

greek_text: ωσαυτως και τα καλα εργα προδηλα εστιν και τα αλλως εχοντα κρυβηναι ου δυναται
transliteration: wsautwv kai ta kala erga prodhla estin kai ta allwv econta krubhnai ou dunatai
draft_translation: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and those who are otherwise cannot be hid.
ukjv_translation: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

greek_text: οσοι εισιν υπο ζυγον δουλοι τους ιδιους δεσποτας πασης τιμης αξιους ηγεισθωσαν ινα μη το ονομα του θεου και η διδασκαλια βλασφημηται
transliteration: osoi eisin upo zugon douloi touv idiouv despotav pashv timhv axiouv hgeisywsan ina mh to onoma tou yeou kai h didaskalia blasfhmhtai
draft_translation: Let as many slaves as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the teaching may not be blasphemed.
ukjv_translation: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

greek_text: οι δε πιστους εχοντες δεσποτας μη καταφρονειτωσαν οτι αδελφοι εισιν αλλα μαλλον δουλευετωσαν οτι πιστοι εισιν και αγαπητοι οι της ευεργεσιας αντιλαμβανομενοι ταυτα διδασκε και παρακαλει
transliteration: oi de pistouv econtev despotav mh katafroneitwsan oti adelfoi eisin alla mallon douleuetwsan oti pistoi eisin kai agaphtoi oi thv euergesiav antilambanomenoi tauta didaske kai parakalei
draft_translation: And those who have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brothers; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
ukjv_translation: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ει τις ετεροδιδασκαλει και μη προσερχεται υγιαινουσιν λογοις τοις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου και τη κατ ευσεβειαν διδασκαλια
transliteration: ei tiv eterodidaskalei kai mh prosercetai ugiainousin logoiv toiv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou kai th kat eusebeian didaskalia
draft_translation: If anyone teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
ukjv_translation: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, (o. logos) even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τετυφωται μηδεν επισταμενος αλλα νοσων περι ζητησεις και λογομαχιας εξ ων γινεται φθονος ερις βλασφημιαι υπονοιαι πονηραι
transliteration: tetufwtai mhden epistamenov alla noswn peri zhthseiv kai logomaciav ex wn ginetai fyonov eriv blasfhmiai uponoiai ponhrai
draft_translation: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, of which comes envy, strife, railings, evil questionings,
ukjv_translation: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof comes envy, strife, railings, evil questionings,

greek_text: παραδιατριβαι διεφθαρμενων ανθρωπων τον νουν και απεστερημενων της αληθειας νομιζοντων πορισμον ειναι την ευσεβειαν αφιστασο απο των τοιουτων
transliteration: paradiatribai diefyarmenwn anyrwpwn ton noun kai apesterhmenwn thv alhyeiav nomizontwn porismon einai thn eusebeian afistaso apo twn toioutwn
draft_translation: constant disputes of men corrupted in mind and deprived of the truth, supposing godliness to be gain: from such withdraw yourself.
ukjv_translation: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw yourself.

greek_text: εστιν δε πορισμος μεγας η ευσεβεια μετα αυταρκειας
transliteration: estin de porismov megav h eusebeia meta autarkeiav
draft_translation: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
ukjv_translation: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ουδεν γαρ εισηνεγκαμεν εις τον κοσμον δηλον οτι ουδε εξενεγκειν τι δυναμεθα
transliteration: ouden gar eishnegkamen eiv ton kosmon dhlon oti oude exenegkein ti dunameya
draft_translation: For we brought nothing into the world, and it is clear that we can carry nothing out.
ukjv_translation: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

greek_text: εχοντες δε διατροφας και σκεπασματα τουτοις αρκεσθησομεθα
transliteration: econtev de diatrofav kai skepasmata toutoiv arkesyhsomeya
draft_translation: And having food and clothing let us be with it content.
ukjv_translation: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

greek_text: οι δε βουλομενοι πλουτειν εμπιπτουσιν εις πειρασμον και παγιδα και επιθυμιας πολλας ανοητους και βλαβερας αιτινες βυθιζουσιν τους ανθρωπους εις ολεθρον και απωλειαν
transliteration: oi de boulomenoi ploutein empiptousin eiv peirasmon kai pagida kai epiyumiav pollav anohtouv kai blaberav aitinev buyizousin touv anyrwpouv eiv oleyron kai apwleian
draft_translation: But those who will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and ruin.
ukjv_translation: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

greek_text: ριζα γαρ παντων των κακων εστιν η φιλαργυρια ης τινες ορεγομενοι απεπλανηθησαν απο της πιστεως και εαυτους περιεπειραν οδυναις πολλαις
transliteration: riza gar pantwn twn kakwn estin h filarguria hv tinev oregomenoi apeplanhyhsan apo thv pistewv kai eautouv periepeiran odunaiv pollaiv
draft_translation: For the love of money is a root of all the evils: which some reaching after were led astray from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many pains.
ukjv_translation: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

greek_text: συ δε ω ανθρωπε του θεου ταυτα φευγε διωκε δε δικαιοσυνην ευσεβειαν πιστιν αγαπην υπομονην πραοτητα
transliteration: su de w anyrwpe tou yeou tauta feuge diwke de dikaiosunhn eusebeian pistin agaphn upomonhn praothta
draft_translation: But you, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
ukjv_translation: But you, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, (o. agape) patience, meekness.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αγωνιζου τον καλον αγωνα της πιστεως επιλαβου της αιωνιου ζωης εις ην και εκληθης και ωμολογησας την καλην ομολογιαν ενωπιον πολλων μαρτυρων
transliteration: agwnizou ton kalon agwna thv pistewv epilabou thv aiwniou zwhv eiv hn kai eklhyhv kai wmologhsav thn kalhn omologian enwpion pollwn marturwn
draft_translation: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you are also called, and have professed a good confession before many witnesses.
ukjv_translation: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, unto which you are also called, and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered homologia as confession

greek_text: παραγγελλω σοι ενωπιον του θεου του ζωοποιουντος τα παντα και χριστου ιησου του μαρτυρησαντος επι ποντιου πιλατου την καλην ομολογιαν
transliteration: paraggellw soi enwpion tou yeou tou zwopoiountov ta panta kai cristou ihsou tou marturhsantov epi pontiou pilatou thn kalhn omologian
draft_translation: I give you charge in the sight of God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
ukjv_translation: I give you charge in the sight of God, who replenishes life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

greek_text: τηρησαι σε την εντολην ασπιλον ανεπιληπτον μεχρι της επιφανειας του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: thrhsai se thn entolhn aspilon anepilhpton mecri thv epifaneiav tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: That you keep this commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
ukjv_translation: That you keep this commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

greek_text: ην καιροις ιδιοις δειξει ο μακαριος και μονος δυναστης ο βασιλευς των βασιλευοντων και κυριος των κυριευοντων
transliteration: hn kairoiv idioiv deixei o makariov kai monov dunasthv o basileuv twn basileuontwn kai kuriov twn kurieuontwn
draft_translation: Which in his times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
ukjv_translation: Which in his times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

greek_text: ο μονος εχων αθανασιαν φως οικων απροσιτον ον ειδεν ουδεις ανθρωπων ουδε ιδειν δυναται ω τιμη και κρατος αιωνιον αμην
transliteration: o monov ecwn ayanasian fwv oikwn aprositon on eiden oudeiv anyrwpwn oude idein dunatai w timh kai kratov aiwnion amhn
draft_translation: Who only has immortality, dwelling in the light which no one can approach to; whom no one has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and power eternal. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Who only has immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized honour spelling; modernized no-man idiom; rendered aionios as eternal

greek_text: τοις πλουσιοις εν τω νυν αιωνι παραγγελλε μη υψηλοφρονειν μηδε ηλπικεναι επι πλουτου αδηλοτητι αλλ εν τω θεω τω ζωντι τω παρεχοντι ημιν πλουσιως παντα εις απολαυσιν
transliteration: toiv plousioiv en tw nun aiwni paraggelle mh uqhlofronein mhde hlpikenai epi ploutou adhlothti all en tw yew tw zwnti tw pareconti hmin plousiwv panta eiv apolausin
draft_translation: Charge those who are rich in the present age not to be high-minded, nor to have hope in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who gives us richly all things to enjoy;
ukjv_translation: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not high-minded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who gives us richly all things to enjoy;

greek_text: αγαθοεργειν πλουτειν εν εργοις καλοις ευμεταδοτους ειναι κοινωνικους
transliteration: agayoergein ploutein en ergoiv kaloiv eumetadotouv einai koinwnikouv
draft_translation: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to share, generous;
ukjv_translation: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

greek_text: αποθησαυριζοντας εαυτοις θεμελιον καλον εις το μελλον ινα επιλαβωνται της αιωνιου ζωης
transliteration: apoyhsaurizontav eautoiv yemelion kalon eiv to mellon ina epilabwntai thv aiwniou zwhv
draft_translation: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the future, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
ukjv_translation: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

greek_text: ω τιμοθεε την παρακαταθηκην φυλαξον εκτρεπομενος τας βεβηλους κενοφωνιας και αντιθεσεις της ψευδωνυμου γνωσεως
transliteration: w timoyee thn parakatayhkhn fulaxon ektrepomenov tav bebhlouv kenofwniav kai antiyeseiv thv qeudwnumou gnwsewv
draft_translation: O Timothy, guard the deposit, turning away from profane empty babblings and oppositions of falsely named knowledge:
ukjv_translation: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to your trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

greek_text: ην τινες επαγγελλομενοι περι την πιστιν ηστοχησαν η χαρις μετα σου αμην
transliteration: hn tinev epaggellomenoi peri thn pistin hstochsan h cariv meta sou amhn
draft_translation: which some professing have missed the mark concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
ukjv_translation: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

ukjv_translation: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God possibly will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

greek_text: και ανανηψωσιν εκ της του διαβολου παγιδος εζωγρημενοι υπ αυτου εις το εκεινου θελημα
transliteration: kai ananhqwsin ek thv tou diabolou pagidov ezwgrhmenoi up autou eiv to ekeinou yelhma
draft_translation: and they may come to themselves out of the devil's snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.
ukjv_translation: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

greek_text: τουτο δε γινωσκε οτι εν εσχαταις ημεραις ενστησονται καιροι χαλεποι
transliteration: touto de ginwske oti en escataiv hmeraiv ensthsontai kairoi calepoi
draft_translation: But know this, that in the last days difficult times shall come.
ukjv_translation: This know also, that in the last days dangerous times shall come.

greek_text: εσονται γαρ οι ανθρωποι φιλαυτοι φιλαργυροι αλαζονες υπερηφανοι βλασφημοι γονευσιν απειθεις αχαριστοι ανοσιοι
transliteration: esontai gar oi anyrwpoi filautoi filarguroi alazonev uperhfanoi blasfhmoi goneusin apeiyeiv acaristoi anosioi
draft_translation: For men shall be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
ukjv_translation: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

greek_text: αστοργοι ασπονδοι διαβολοι ακρατεις ανημεροι αφιλαγαθοι
transliteration: astorgoi aspondoi diaboloi akrateiv anhmeroi afilagayoi
draft_translation: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, savage, not lovers of good,
ukjv_translation: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

greek_text: προδοται προπετεις τετυφωμενοι φιληδονοι μαλλον η φιλοθεοι
transliteration: prodotai propeteiv tetufwmenoi filhdonoi mallon h filoyeoi
draft_translation: traitors, reckless, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
ukjv_translation: Traitors, rebellious, high-minded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

greek_text: εχοντες μορφωσιν ευσεβειας την δε δυναμιν αυτης ηρνημενοι και τουτους αποτρεπου
transliteration: econtev morfwsin eusebeiav thn de dunamin authv hrnhmenoi kai toutouv apotrepou
draft_translation: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power of it: from such turn away.
ukjv_translation: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

greek_text: εκ τουτων γαρ εισιν οι ενδυνοντες εις τας οικιας και αιχμαλωτευοντες τα γυναικαρια σεσωρευμενα αμαρτιαις αγομενα επιθυμιαις ποικιλαις
transliteration: ek toutwn gar eisin oi endunontev eiv tav oikiav kai aicmalwteuontev ta gunaikaria seswreumena amartiaiv agomena epiyumiaiv poikilaiv
draft_translation: For of this sort are those who creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with various lusts,
ukjv_translation: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

greek_text: παντοτε μανθανοντα και μηδεποτε εις επιγνωσιν αληθειας ελθειν δυναμενα
transliteration: pantote manyanonta kai mhdepote eiv epignwsin alhyeiav elyein dunamena
draft_translation: always learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
ukjv_translation: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

greek_text: ον τροπον δε ιαννης και ιαμβρης αντεστησαν μωυσει ουτως και ουτοι ανθιστανται τη αληθεια ανθρωποι κατεφθαρμενοι τον νουν αδοκιμοι περι την πιστιν
transliteration: on tropon de iannhv kai iambrhv antesthsan mwusei outwv kai outoi anyistantai th alhyeia anyrwpoi katefyarmenoi ton noun adokimoi peri thn pistin
draft_translation: Now in the same way that Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses, so these also resist the truth: men corrupted in mind, unapproved concerning the faith.
ukjv_translation: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

greek_text: αλλ ου προκοψουσιν επι πλειον η γαρ ανοια αυτων εκδηλος εσται πασιν ως και η εκεινων εγενετο
transliteration: all ou prokoqousin epi pleion h gar anoia autwn ekdhlov estai pasin wv kai h ekeinwn egeneto
draft_translation: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest to all men, as theirs also was.
ukjv_translation: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized possessive pronoun spelling

greek_text: συ δε παρηκολουθηκας μου τη διδασκαλια τη αγωγη τη προθεσει τη πιστει τη μακροθυμια τη αγαπη τη υπομονη
transliteration: su de parhkolouyhkav mou th didaskalia th agwgh th proyesei th pistei th makroyumia th agaph th upomonh
draft_translation: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,
ukjv_translation: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, (o. agape) patience,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τοις διωγμοις τοις παθημασιν οια μοι εγενετο εν αντιοχεια εν ικονιω εν λυστροις οιους διωγμους υπηνεγκα και εκ παντων με ερρυσατο ο κυριος
transliteration: toiv diwgmoiv toiv payhmasin oia moi egeneto en antioceia en ikoniw en lustroiv oiouv diwgmouv uphnegka kai ek pantwn me errusato o kuriov
draft_translation: Persecutions, afflictions, which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
ukjv_translation: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: και παντες δε οι θελοντες ευσεβως ζην εν χριστω ιησου διωχθησονται
transliteration: kai pantev de oi yelontev eusebwv zhn en cristw ihsou diwcyhsontai
draft_translation: Yes, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
ukjv_translation: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

greek_text: πονηροι δε ανθρωποι και γοητες προκοψουσιν επι το χειρον πλανωντες και πλανωμενοι
transliteration: ponhroi de anyrwpoi kai gohtev prokoqousin epi to ceiron planwntev kai planwmenoi
draft_translation: But evil men and impostors will advance to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
ukjv_translation: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

greek_text: συ δε μενε εν οις εμαθες και επιστωθης ειδως παρα τινος εμαθες
transliteration: su de mene en oiv emayev kai epistwyhv eidwv para tinov emayev
draft_translation: But you continue in the things which you learned and were assured of, knowing from whom you learned them;
ukjv_translation: But continue you in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing of whom you have learned them;

greek_text: και οτι απο βρεφους τα ιερα γραμματα οιδας τα δυναμενα σε σοφισαι εις σωτηριαν δια πιστεως της εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: kai oti apo brefouv ta iera grammata oidav ta dunamena se sofisai eiv swthrian dia pistewv thv en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: And that from a child you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: And that from a child you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

greek_text: πασα γραφη θεοπνευστος και ωφελιμος προς διδασκαλιαν προς ελεγχον προς επανορθωσιν προς παιδειαν την εν δικαιοσυνη
transliteration: pasa grafh yeopneustov kai wfelimov prov didaskalian prov elegcon prov epanorywsin prov paideian thn en dikaiosunh
draft_translation: All scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
ukjv_translation: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

greek_text: ινα αρτιος η ο του θεου ανθρωπος προς παν εργον αγαθον εξηρτισμενος
transliteration: ina artiov h o tou yeou anyrwpov prov pan ergon agayon exhrtismenov
draft_translation: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished to all good works.
ukjv_translation: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.

greek_text: διαμαρτυρομαι ουν εγω ενωπιον του θεου και του κυριου ιησου χριστου του μελλοντος κρινειν ζωντας και νεκρους κατα την επιφανειαν αυτου και την βασιλειαν αυτου
transliteration: diamarturomai oun egw enwpion tou yeou kai tou kuriou ihsou cristou tou mellontov krinein zwntav kai nekrouv kata thn epifaneian autou kai thn basileian autou
draft_translation: I charge you therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
ukjv_translation: I charge you therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

greek_text: κηρυξον τον λογον επιστηθι ευκαιρως ακαιρως ελεγξον επιτιμησον παρακαλεσον εν παση μακροθυμια και διδαχη
transliteration: khruxon ton logon episthyi eukairwv akairwv elegxon epitimhson parakaleson en pash makroyumia kai didach
draft_translation: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
ukjv_translation: Preach the word; (o. logos) be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εσται γαρ καιρος οτε της υγιαινουσης διδασκαλιας ουκ ανεξονται αλλα κατα τας επιθυμιας τας ιδιας εαυτοις επισωρευσουσιν διδασκαλους κνηθομενοι την ακοην
transliteration: estai gar kairov ote thv ugiainoushv didaskaliav ouk anexontai alla kata tav epiyumiav tav idiav eautoiv episwreusousin didaskalouv knhyomenoi thn akohn
draft_translation: For the time will come when they will not endure sound teaching; but according to their own lusts they shall heap up teachers to themselves, having itching ears;
ukjv_translation: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

greek_text: και απο μεν της αληθειας την ακοην αποστρεψουσιν επι δε τους μυθους εκτραπησονται
transliteration: kai apo men thv alhyeiav thn akohn apostreqousin epi de touv muyouv ektraphsontai
draft_translation: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned to fables.
ukjv_translation: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

greek_text: συ δε νηφε εν πασιν κακοπαθησον εργον ποιησον ευαγγελιστου την διακονιαν σου πληροφορησον
transliteration: su de nhfe en pasin kakopayhson ergon poihson euaggelistou thn diakonian sou plhroforhson
draft_translation: But you be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
ukjv_translation: But watch you in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of your ministry.

greek_text: εγω γαρ ηδη σπενδομαι και ο καιρος της εμης αναλυσεως εφεστηκεν
transliteration: egw gar hdh spendomai kai o kairov thv emhv analusewv efesthken
draft_translation: For I am already being poured out, and the time of my departure has come.
ukjv_translation: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

greek_text: τον αγωνα τον καλον ηγωνισμαι τον δρομον τετελεκα την πιστιν τετηρηκα
transliteration: ton agwna ton kalon hgwnismai ton dromon teteleka thn pistin tethrhka
draft_translation: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:
ukjv_translation: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

greek_text: λοιπον αποκειται μοι ο της δικαιοσυνης στεφανος ον αποδωσει μοι ο κυριος εν εκεινη τη ημερα ο δικαιος κριτης ου μονον δε εμοι αλλα και πασιν τοις ηγαπηκοσιν την επιφανειαν αυτου
transliteration: loipon apokeitai moi o thv dikaiosunhv stefanov on apodwsei moi o kuriov en ekeinh th hmera o dikaiov krithv ou monon de emoi alla kai pasin toiv hgaphkosin thn epifaneian autou
draft_translation: From now on there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but to all them also that love his appearing.
ukjv_translation: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized henceforth; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: σπουδασον ελθειν προς με ταχεως
transliteration: spoudason elyein prov me tacewv
draft_translation: Do your diligence to come shortly to me:
ukjv_translation: Do your diligence to come shortly unto me:

greek_text: δημας γαρ με εγκατελιπεν αγαπησας τον νυν αιωνα και επορευθη εις θεσσαλονικην κρησκης εις γαλατιαν τιτος εις δαλματιαν
transliteration: dhmav gar me egkatelipen agaphsav ton nun aiwna kai eporeuyh eiv yessalonikhn krhskhv eiv galatian titov eiv dalmatian
draft_translation: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
ukjv_translation: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

greek_text: λουκας εστιν μονος μετ εμου μαρκον αναλαβων αγε μετα σεαυτου εστιν γαρ μοι ευχρηστος εις διακονιαν
transliteration: loukav estin monov met emou markon analabwn age meta seautou estin gar moi eucrhstov eiv diakonian
draft_translation: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you: for he is useful to me for ministry.
ukjv_translation: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

greek_text: τυχικον δε απεστειλα εις εφεσον
transliteration: tucikon de apesteila eiv efeson
draft_translation: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.
ukjv_translation: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

greek_text: τον φελονην ον απελιπον εν τρωαδι παρα καρπω ερχομενος φερε και τα βιβλια μαλιστα τας μεμβρανας
transliteration: ton felonhn on apelipon en trwadi para karpw ercomenov fere kai ta biblia malista tav membranav
draft_translation: The tunic that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments.
ukjv_translation: The coat that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments.

greek_text: αλεξανδρος ο χαλκευς πολλα μοι κακα ενεδειξατο αποδωη αυτω ο κυριος κατα τα εργα αυτου
transliteration: alexandrov o calkeuv polla moi kaka enedeixato apodwh autw o kuriov kata ta erga autou
draft_translation: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
ukjv_translation: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

greek_text: ον και συ φυλασσου λιαν γαρ ανθεστηκεν τοις ημετεροις λογοις
transliteration: on kai su fulassou lian gar anyesthken toiv hmeteroiv logoiv
draft_translation: Beware of him also; for he has greatly withstood our words.
ukjv_translation: Of whom be you ware also; for he has greatly withstood our words. (o. logos)
review_notes: fixed be-ware artifact; modernized be-ware idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εν τη πρωτη μου απολογια ουδεις μοι συμπαρεγενετο αλλα παντες με εγκατελιπον μη αυτοις λογισθειη
transliteration: en th prwth mou apologia oudeiv moi sumparegeneto alla pantev me egkatelipon mh autoiv logisyeih
draft_translation: At my first answer no one stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
ukjv_translation: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

greek_text: ο δε κυριος μοι παρεστη και ενεδυναμωσεν με ινα δι εμου το κηρυγμα πληροφορηθη και ακουση παντα τα εθνη και ερρυσθην εκ στοματος λεοντος
transliteration: o de kuriov moi paresth kai enedunamwsen me ina di emou to khrugma plhroforhyh kai akoush panta ta eynh kai errusyhn ek stomatov leontov
draft_translation: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the nations might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
ukjv_translation: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered ethne as nations

greek_text: και ρυσεται με ο κυριος απο παντος εργου πονηρου και σωσει εις την βασιλειαν αυτου την επουρανιον ω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
transliteration: kai rusetai me o kuriov apo pantov ergou ponhrou kai swsei eiv thn basileian autou thn epouranion w h doxa eiv touv aiwnav twn aiwnwn amhn
draft_translation: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me to his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forever spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ασπασαι πρισκαν και ακυλαν και τον ονησιφορου οικον
transliteration: aspasai priskan kai akulan kai ton onhsiforou oikon
draft_translation: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
ukjv_translation: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

greek_text: εραστος εμεινεν εν κορινθω τροφιμον δε απελιπον εν μιλητω ασθενουντα
transliteration: erastov emeinen en korinyw trofimon de apelipon en milhtw asyenounta
draft_translation: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
ukjv_translation: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

greek_text: σπουδασον προ χειμωνος ελθειν ασπαζεται σε ευβουλος και πουδης και λινος και κλαυδια και οι αδελφοι παντες
transliteration: spoudason pro ceimwnov elyein aspazetai se euboulov kai poudhv kai linov kai klaudia kai oi adelfoi pantev
draft_translation: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.
ukjv_translation: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

greek_text: ο κυριος ιησους χριστος μετα του πνευματος σου η χαρις μεθ υμων αμην
transliteration: o kuriov ihsouv cristov meta tou pneumatov sou h cariv mey umwn amhn
draft_translation: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. (o. pneuma) Grace be with you. Amen.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παυλος δουλος θεου αποστολος δε ιησου χριστου κατα πιστιν εκλεκτων θεου και επιγνωσιν αληθειας της κατ ευσεβειαν
transliteration: paulov doulov yeou apostolov de ihsou cristou kata pistin eklektwn yeou kai epignwsin alhyeiav thv kat eusebeian
draft_translation: Paul, a slave of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
ukjv_translation: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

greek_text: επ ελπιδι ζωης αιωνιου ην επηγγειλατο ο αψευδης θεος προ χρονων αιωνιων
transliteration: ep elpidi zwhv aiwniou hn ephggeilato o aqeudhv yeov pro cronwn aiwniwn
draft_translation: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before eternal times;
ukjv_translation: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

greek_text: εφανερωσεν δε καιροις ιδιοις τον λογον αυτου εν κηρυγματι ο επιστευθην εγω κατ επιταγην του σωτηρος ημων θεου
transliteration: efanerwsen de kairoiv idioiv ton logon autou en khrugmati o episteuyhn egw kat epitaghn tou swthrov hmwn yeou
draft_translation: But has in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed to me according to the commandment of God our Savior;
ukjv_translation: But has in due times manifested his word (o. logos) through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τιτω γνησιω τεκνω κατα κοινην πιστιν χαρις ελεος ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ιησου χριστου του σωτηρος ημων
transliteration: titw gnhsiw teknw kata koinhn pistin cariv eleov eirhnh apo yeou patrov kai kuriou ihsou cristou tou swthrov hmwn
draft_translation: To Titus, my own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
ukjv_translation: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; modernized mine-own idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: τουτου χαριν κατελιπον σε εν κρητη ινα τα λειποντα επιδιορθωση και καταστησης κατα πολιν πρεσβυτερους ως εγω σοι διεταξαμην
transliteration: toutou carin katelipon se en krhth ina ta leiponta epidiorywsh kai katasthshv kata polin presbuterouv wv egw soi dietaxamhn
draft_translation: For this cause I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you:
ukjv_translation: For this cause left I you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you:

greek_text: ει τις εστιν ανεγκλητος μιας γυναικος ανηρ τεκνα εχων πιστα μη εν κατηγορια ασωτιας η ανυποτακτα
transliteration: ei tiv estin anegklhtov miav gunaikov anhr tekna ecwn pista mh en kathgoria aswtiav h anupotakta
draft_translation: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of dissipation or insubordination.
ukjv_translation: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

greek_text: δει γαρ τον επισκοπον ανεγκλητον ειναι ως θεου οικονομον μη αυθαδη μη οργιλον μη παροινον μη πληκτην μη αισχροκερδη
transliteration: dei gar ton episkopon anegklhton einai wv yeou oikonomon mh auyadh mh orgilon mh paroinon mh plhkthn mh aiscrokerdh
draft_translation: For an overseer must be blameless, as the steward of God; not self-willed, not soon angry, not given to wine, not an attacker, not given to filthy illegal gain;
ukjv_translation: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not self-willed, not soon angry, not given to wine, not an attacker, not given to filthy illegal gain;

greek_text: αλλα φιλοξενον φιλαγαθον σωφρονα δικαιον οσιον εγκρατη
transliteration: alla filoxenon filagayon swfrona dikaion osion egkrath
draft_translation: but hospitable, a lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;
ukjv_translation: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

greek_text: αντεχομενον του κατα την διδαχην πιστου λογου ινα δυνατος η και παρακαλειν εν τη διδασκαλια τη υγιαινουση και τους αντιλεγοντας ελεγχειν
transliteration: antecomenon tou kata thn didachn pistou logou ina dunatov h kai parakalein en th didaskalia th ugiainoush kai touv antilegontav elegcein
draft_translation: Holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the opponents.
ukjv_translation: Holding fast the faithful word (o. logos) as he has been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
review_notes: modernized gainsayers; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εισιν γαρ πολλοι και ανυποτακτοι ματαιολογοι και φρεναπαται μαλιστα οι εκ περιτομης
transliteration: eisin gar polloi kai anupotaktoi mataiologoi kai frenapatai malista oi ek peritomhv
draft_translation: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision:
ukjv_translation: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

greek_text: ους δει επιστομιζειν οιτινες ολους οικους ανατρεπουσιν διδασκοντες α μη δει αισχρου κερδους χαριν
transliteration: ouv dei epistomizein oitinev olouv oikouv anatrepousin didaskontev a mh dei aiscrou kerdouv carin
draft_translation: whose mouths must be stopped, who overturn whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for shameful gain's sake.
ukjv_translation: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy illegal gain's sake.

greek_text: ειπεν τις εξ αυτων ιδιος αυτων προφητης κρητες αει ψευσται κακα θηρια γαστερες αργαι
transliteration: eipen tiv ex autwn idiov autwn profhthv krhtev aei qeustai kaka yhria gasterev argai
draft_translation: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle bellies.
ukjv_translation: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are always liars, evil beasts, sluggards.

greek_text: η μαρτυρια αυτη εστιν αληθης δι ην αιτιαν ελεγχε αυτους αποτομως ινα υγιαινωσιν εν τη πιστει
transliteration: h marturia auth estin alhyhv di hn aitian elegce autouv apotomwv ina ugiainwsin en th pistei
draft_translation: This witness is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
ukjv_translation: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

greek_text: μη προσεχοντες ιουδαικοις μυθοις και εντολαις ανθρωπων αποστρεφομενων την αληθειαν
transliteration: mh prosecontev ioudaikoiv muyoiv kai entolaiv anyrwpwn apostrefomenwn thn alhyeian
draft_translation: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
ukjv_translation: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

greek_text: παντα μεν καθαρα τοις καθαροις τοις δε μεμιασμενοις και απιστοις ουδεν καθαρον αλλα μεμιανται αυτων και ο νους και η συνειδησις
transliteration: panta men kayara toiv kayaroiv toiv de memiasmenoiv kai apistoiv ouden kayaron alla memiantai autwn kai o nouv kai h suneidhsiv
draft_translation: To the pure all things are pure: but to those who are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
ukjv_translation: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: θεον ομολογουσιν ειδεναι τοις δε εργοις αρνουνται βδελυκτοι οντες και απειθεις και προς παν εργον αγαθον αδοκιμοι
transliteration: yeon omologousin eidenai toiv de ergoiv arnountai bdeluktoi ontev kai apeiyeiv kai prov pan ergon agayon adokimoi
draft_translation: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and to every good work reprobate.
ukjv_translation: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

greek_text: συ δε λαλει α πρεπει τη υγιαινουση διδασκαλια
transliteration: su de lalei a prepei th ugiainoush didaskalia
draft_translation: But speak the things which befit sound teaching:
ukjv_translation: But speak you the things which become sound doctrine:

greek_text: πρεσβυτας νηφαλιους ειναι σεμνους σωφρονας υγιαινοντας τη πιστει τη αγαπη τη υπομονη
transliteration: presbutav nhfaliouv einai semnouv swfronav ugiainontav th pistei th agaph th upomonh
draft_translation: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience.
ukjv_translation: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in love, (o. agape) in patience.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πρεσβυτιδας ωσαυτως εν καταστηματι ιεροπρεπεις μη διαβολους μη οινω πολλω δεδουλωμενας καλοδιδασκαλους
transliteration: presbutidav wsautwv en katasthmati ieroprepeiv mh diabolouv mh oinw pollw dedoulwmenav kalodidaskalouv
draft_translation: The aged women likewise, that they be in behavior as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
ukjv_translation: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

greek_text: ινα σωφρονιζωσιν τας νεας φιλανδρους ειναι φιλοτεκνους
transliteration: ina swfronizwsin tav neav filandrouv einai filoteknouv
draft_translation: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
ukjv_translation: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

greek_text: σωφρονας αγνας οικουρους αγαθας υποτασσομενας τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν ινα μη ο λογος του θεου βλασφημηται
transliteration: swfronav agnav oikourouv agayav upotassomenav toiv idioiv andrasin ina mh o logov tou yeou blasfhmhtai
draft_translation: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
ukjv_translation: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word (o. logos) of God be not blasphemed.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τους νεωτερους ωσαυτως παρακαλει σωφρονειν
transliteration: touv newterouv wsautwv parakalei swfronein
draft_translation: The younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded.
ukjv_translation: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

greek_text: περι παντα σεαυτον παρεχομενος τυπον καλων εργων εν τη διδασκαλια αδιαφθοριαν σεμνοτητα αφθαρσιαν
transliteration: peri panta seauton parecomenov tupon kalwn ergwn en th didaskalia adiafyorian semnothta afyarsian
draft_translation: in all things showing yourself a pattern of good works: in teaching, incorruptness, dignity, sincerity,
ukjv_translation: In all things showing yourself a pattern of good works: in doctrine showing incorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

greek_text: λογον υγιη ακαταγνωστον ινα ο εξ εναντιας εντραπη μηδεν εχων περι υμων λεγειν φαυλον
transliteration: logon ugih akatagnwston ina o ex enantiav entraph mhden ecwn peri umwn legein faulon
draft_translation: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that the one who is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
ukjv_translation: Sound speech, (o. logos) that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δουλους ιδιοις δεσποταις υποτασσεσθαι εν πασιν ευαρεστους ειναι μη αντιλεγοντας
transliteration: doulouv idioiv despotaiv upotassesyai en pasin euarestouv einai mh antilegontav
draft_translation: Exhort slaves to be obedient to their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
ukjv_translation: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: μη νοσφιζομενους αλλα πιστιν πασαν ενδεικνυμενους αγαθην ινα την διδασκαλιαν του σωτηρος ημων θεου κοσμωσιν εν πασιν
transliteration: mh nosfizomenouv alla pistin pasan endeiknumenouv agayhn ina thn didaskalian tou swthrov hmwn yeou kosmwsin en pasin
draft_translation: Not embezzling, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.
ukjv_translation: Not embezzling, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

greek_text: επεφανη γαρ η χαρις του θεου η σωτηριος πασιν ανθρωποις
transliteration: epefanh gar h cariv tou yeou h swthriov pasin anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: For the saving grace of God has appeared to all men,
ukjv_translation: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

greek_text: παιδευουσα ημας ινα αρνησαμενοι την ασεβειαν και τας κοσμικας επιθυμιας σωφρονως και δικαιως και ευσεβως ζησωμεν εν τω νυν αιωνι
transliteration: paideuousa hmav ina arnhsamenoi thn asebeian kai tav kosmikav epiyumiav swfronwv kai dikaiwv kai eusebwv zhswmen en tw nun aiwni
draft_translation: teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present age;
ukjv_translation: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

greek_text: προσδεχομενοι την μακαριαν ελπιδα και επιφανειαν της δοξης του μεγαλου θεου και σωτηρος ημων ιησου χριστου
transliteration: prosdecomenoi thn makarian elpida kai epifaneian thv doxhv tou megalou yeou kai swthrov hmwn ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Savior Jesus Christ;
ukjv_translation: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

greek_text: ος εδωκεν εαυτον υπερ ημων ινα λυτρωσηται ημας απο πασης ανομιας και καθαριση εαυτω λαον περιουσιον ζηλωτην καλων εργων
transliteration: ov edwken eauton uper hmwn ina lutrwshtai hmav apo pashv anomiav kai kayarish eautw laon periousion zhlwthn kalwn ergwn
draft_translation: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify to himself an exclusive people, zealous of good works.
ukjv_translation: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself an exclusive people, zealous of good works.

greek_text: ταυτα λαλει και παρακαλει και ελεγχε μετα πασης επιταγης μηδεις σου περιφρονειτω
transliteration: tauta lalei kai parakalei kai elegce meta pashv epitaghv mhdeiv sou perifroneitw
draft_translation: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
ukjv_translation: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise you.

greek_text: υπομιμνησκε αυτους αρχαις και εξουσιαις υποτασσεσθαι πειθαρχειν προς παν εργον αγαθον ετοιμους ειναι
transliteration: upomimnhske autouv arcaiv kai exousiaiv upotassesyai peiyarcein prov pan ergon agayon etoimouv einai
draft_translation: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,
ukjv_translation: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

greek_text: μηδενα βλασφημειν αμαχους ειναι επιεικεις πασαν ενδεικνυμενους πραοτητα προς παντας ανθρωπους
transliteration: mhdena blasfhmein amacouv einai epieikeiv pasan endeiknumenouv praothta prov pantav anyrwpouv
draft_translation: To speak evil of no one, to be no brawlers, but gentle, showing all meekness to all men.
ukjv_translation: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, showing all meekness unto all men.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: ημεν γαρ ποτε και ημεις ανοητοι απειθεις πλανωμενοι δουλευοντες επιθυμιαις και ηδοναις ποικιλαις εν κακια και φθονω διαγοντες στυγητοι μισουντες αλληλους
transliteration: hmen gar pote kai hmeiv anohtoi apeiyeiv planwmenoi douleuontev epiyumiaiv kai hdonaiv poikilaiv en kakia kai fyonw diagontev stughtoi misountev allhlouv
draft_translation: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
ukjv_translation: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

greek_text: οτε δε η χρηστοτης και η φιλανθρωπια επεφανη του σωτηρος ημων θεου
transliteration: ote de h crhstothv kai h filanyrwpia epefanh tou swthrov hmwn yeou
draft_translation: But after that the kindness and love of God our Savior toward man appeared,
ukjv_translation: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

greek_text: ουκ εξ εργων των εν δικαιοσυνη ων εποιησαμεν ημεις αλλα κατα τον αυτου ελεον εσωσεν ημας δια λουτρου παλιγγενεσιας και ανακαινωσεως πνευματος αγιου
transliteration: ouk ex ergwn twn en dikaiosunh wn epoihsamen hmeiv alla kata ton autou eleon eswsen hmav dia loutrou paliggenesiav kai anakainwsewv pneumatov agiou
draft_translation: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Spirit;
ukjv_translation: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Spirit; (o. pneuma)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ου εξεχεεν εφ ημας πλουσιως δια ιησου χριστου του σωτηρος ημων
transliteration: ou execeen ef hmav plousiwv dia ihsou cristou tou swthrov hmwn
draft_translation: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
ukjv_translation: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

greek_text: ινα δικαιωθεντες τη εκεινου χαριτι κληρονομοι γενωμεθα κατ ελπιδα ζωης αιωνιου
transliteration: ina dikaiwyentev th ekeinou cariti klhronomoi genwmeya kat elpida zwhv aiwniou
draft_translation: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
ukjv_translation: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: πιστος ο λογος και περι τουτων βουλομαι σε διαβεβαιουσθαι ινα φροντιζωσιν καλων εργων προιστασθαι οι πεπιστευκοτες τω θεω ταυτα εστιν τα καλα και ωφελιμα τοις ανθρωποις
transliteration: pistov o logov kai peri toutwn boulomai se diabebaiousyai ina frontizwsin kalwn ergwn proistasyai oi pepisteukotev tw yew tauta estin ta kala kai wfelima toiv anyrwpoiv
draft_translation: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that you affirm constantly, that those who have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.
ukjv_translation: This is a faithful saying, (o. logos) and these things I will that you affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized they-which relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μωρας δε ζητησεις και γενεαλογιας και ερεις και μαχας νομικας περιιστασο εισιν γαρ ανωφελεις και ματαιοι
transliteration: mwrav de zhthseiv kai genealogiav kai ereiv kai macav nomikav periistaso eisin gar anwfeleiv kai mataioi
draft_translation: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and fights about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
ukjv_translation: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are useless and vain.

greek_text: αιρετικον ανθρωπον μετα μιαν και δευτεραν νουθεσιαν παραιτου
transliteration: airetikon anyrwpon meta mian kai deuteran nouyesian paraitou
draft_translation: A man that is a heretic after the first and second admonition reject;
ukjv_translation: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject;

greek_text: ειδως οτι εξεστραπται ο τοιουτος και αμαρτανει ων αυτοκατακριτος
transliteration: eidwv oti exestraptai o toioutov kai amartanei wn autokatakritov
draft_translation: Knowing that the one who is such is subverted, and sins, being condemned of himself.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sins, being condemned of himself.

greek_text: οταν πεμψω αρτεμαν προς σε η τυχικον σπουδασον ελθειν προς με εις νικοπολιν εκει γαρ κεκρικα παραχειμασαι
transliteration: otan pemqw arteman prov se h tucikon spoudason elyein prov me eiv nikopolin ekei gar kekrika paraceimasai
draft_translation: When I shall send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
ukjv_translation: When I shall send Artemas unto you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

greek_text: ζηναν τον νομικον και απολλω σπουδαιως προπεμψον ινα μηδεν αυτοις λειπη
transliteration: zhnan ton nomikon kai apollw spoudaiwv propemqon ina mhden autoiv leiph
draft_translation: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be lacking to them.
ukjv_translation: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be lacking unto them.

greek_text: μανθανετωσαν δε και οι ημετεροι καλων εργων προιστασθαι εις τας αναγκαιας χρειας ινα μη ωσιν ακαρποι
transliteration: manyanetwsan de kai oi hmeteroi kalwn ergwn proistasyai eiv tav anagkaiav creiav ina mh wsin akarpoi
draft_translation: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.
ukjv_translation: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
review_notes: modernized possessive pronoun spelling; modernized residual be wording

greek_text: ασπαζονται σε οι μετ εμου παντες ασπασαι τους φιλουντας ημας εν πιστει η χαρις μετα παντων υμων αμην
transliteration: aspazontai se oi met emou pantev aspasai touv filountav hmav en pistei h cariv meta pantwn umwn amhn
draft_translation: All that are with me salute you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
ukjv_translation: All that are with me salute you. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

greek_text: παυλος δεσμιος χριστου ιησου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος φιλημονι τω αγαπητω και συνεργω ημων
transliteration: paulov desmiov cristou ihsou kai timoyeov o adelfov filhmoni tw agaphtw kai sunergw hmwn
draft_translation: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellow laborer,
ukjv_translation: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellow labourer,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: και απφια τη αγαπητη και αρχιππω τω συστρατιωτη ημων και τη κατ οικον σου εκκλησια
transliteration: kai apfia th agaphth kai arcippw tw sustratiwth hmwn kai th kat oikon sou ekklhsia
draft_translation: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
ukjv_translation: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:

greek_text: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: cariv umin kai eirhnh apo yeou patrov hmwn kai kuriou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

greek_text: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου παντοτε μνειαν σου ποιουμενος επι των προσευχων μου
transliteration: eucaristw tw yew mou pantote mneian sou poioumenov epi twn proseucwn mou
draft_translation: I thank my God, always making mention of you in my prayers,
ukjv_translation: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,

greek_text: ακουων σου την αγαπην και την πιστιν ην εχεις προς τον κυριον ιησουν και εις παντας τους αγιους
transliteration: akouwn sou thn agaphn kai thn pistin hn eceiv prov ton kurion ihsoun kai eiv pantav touv agiouv
draft_translation: Hearing of your love and faith, which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all holy ones;
ukjv_translation: Hearing of your love (o. agape) and faith, which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: οπως η κοινωνια της πιστεως σου ενεργης γενηται εν επιγνωσει παντος αγαθου του εν υμιν εις χριστον ιησουν
transliteration: opwv h koinwnia thv pistewv sou energhv genhtai en epignwsei pantov agayou tou en umin eiv criston ihsoun
draft_translation: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you toward Christ Jesus.
ukjv_translation: That the communication of your faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

greek_text: χαραν γαρ εχομεν πολλην και παρακλησιν επι τη αγαπη σου οτι τα σπλαγχνα των αγιων αναπεπαυται δια σου αδελφε
transliteration: caran gar ecomen pollhn kai paraklhsin epi th agaph sou oti ta splagcna twn agiwn anapepautai dia sou adelfe
draft_translation: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, because the inward parts of the holy ones are refreshed by you, brother.
ukjv_translation: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, (o. agape) because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by you, brother.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered hagioi as holy ones; rendered splanchna as inward parts

greek_text: διο πολλην εν χριστω παρρησιαν εχων επιτασσειν σοι το ανηκον
transliteration: dio pollhn en cristw parrhsian ecwn epitassein soi to anhkon
draft_translation: Therefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to admonish you that which is convenient,
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to admonish you that which is convenient,

greek_text: δια την αγαπην μαλλον παρακαλω τοιουτος ων ως παυλος πρεσβυτης νυνι δε και δεσμιος ιησου χριστου
transliteration: dia thn agaphn mallon parakalw toioutov wn wv paulov presbuthv nuni de kai desmiov ihsou cristou
draft_translation: Yet for love's sake I rather plead to you, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: Yet for love's (o. agape) sake I rather plead to you, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
review_notes: modernized such-an-one idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: παρακαλω σε περι του εμου τεκνου ον εγεννησα εν τοις δεσμοις μου ονησιμον
transliteration: parakalw se peri tou emou teknou on egennhsa en toiv desmoiv mou onhsimon
draft_translation: I plead with you concerning my child Onesimus, whom I begot in my bonds:
ukjv_translation: I plead to you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

greek_text: τον ποτε σοι αχρηστον νυνι δε σοι και εμοι ευχρηστον ον ανεπεμψα
transliteration: ton pote soi acrhston nuni de soi kai emoi eucrhston on anepemqa
draft_translation: who once was useless to you, but now useful to you and to me:
ukjv_translation: Which in time past was to you useless, but now profitable to you and to me:

greek_text: συ δε αυτον τουτ εστιν τα εμα σπλαγχνα προσλαβου
transliteration: su de auton tout estin ta ema splagcna proslabou
draft_translation: Whom I have sent again: you therefore receive him, that is, my own inward parts:
ukjv_translation: Whom I have sent again: you therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
review_notes: modernized mine-own idiom; rendered splanchna as inward parts

greek_text: ον εγω εβουλομην προς εμαυτον κατεχειν ινα υπερ σου διακονη μοι εν τοις δεσμοις του ευαγγελιου
transliteration: on egw eboulomhn prov emauton katecein ina uper sou diakonh moi en toiv desmoiv tou euaggeliou
draft_translation: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your position he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the good news:
ukjv_translation: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your position he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: χωρις δε της σης γνωμης ουδεν ηθελησα ποιησαι ινα μη ως κατα αναγκην το αγαθον σου η αλλα κατα εκουσιον
transliteration: cwriv de thv shv gnwmhv ouden hyelhsa poihsai ina mh wv kata anagkhn to agayon sou h alla kata ekousion
draft_translation: But without your consent I wished to do nothing; that your good might not be as by necessity, but willingly.
ukjv_translation: But without your mind would I do nothing; that your benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

greek_text: ταχα γαρ δια τουτο εχωρισθη προς ωραν ινα αιωνιον αυτον απεχης
transliteration: taca gar dia touto ecwrisyh prov wran ina aiwnion auton apechv
draft_translation: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that you should receive him forever;
ukjv_translation: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that you should receive him for ever;

greek_text: ουκετι ως δουλον αλλ υπερ δουλον αδελφον αγαπητον μαλιστα εμοι ποσω δε μαλλον σοι και εν σαρκι και εν κυριω
transliteration: ouketi wv doulon all uper doulon adelfon agaphton malista emoi posw de mallon soi kai en sarki kai en kuriw
draft_translation: Not now as a slave, but above a slave, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
ukjv_translation: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto you, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered doulos-family wording as slave

greek_text: ει ουν εμε εχεις κοινωνον προσλαβου αυτον ως εμε
transliteration: ei oun eme eceiv koinwnon proslabou auton wv eme
draft_translation: If therefore you have me as a partner, receive him as me.
ukjv_translation: If you count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

greek_text: ει δε τι ηδικησεν σε η οφειλει τουτο εμοι ελλογει
transliteration: ei de ti hdikhsen se h ofeilei touto emoi ellogei
draft_translation: If he has wronged you, or owes you anything, put that on my account;
ukjv_translation: If he has wronged you, or owes you ought, put that on mine account;
review_notes: modernized mine-account wording; modernized ought-as-anything idiom

greek_text: εγω παυλος εγραψα τη εμη χειρι εγω αποτισω ινα μη λεγω σοι οτι και σεαυτον μοι προσοφειλεις
transliteration: egw paulov egraqa th emh ceiri egw apotisw ina mh legw soi oti kai seauton moi prosofeileiv
draft_translation: I Paul have written it with my own hand, I will repay it: although it be I do not say to you how you owe to me even your own self besides.
ukjv_translation: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: although it be I do not say to you how you owe unto me even yours own self besides.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized mine-own idiom; modernized yours before noun

greek_text: ναι αδελφε εγω σου οναιμην εν κυριω αναπαυσον μου τα σπλαγχνα εν κυριω
transliteration: nai adelfe egw sou onaimhn en kuriw anapauson mou ta splagcna en kuriw
draft_translation: Yes, brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: refresh my inward parts in the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Yea, brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
review_notes: modernized yea; normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered splanchna as inward parts

greek_text: πεποιθως τη υπακοη σου εγραψα σοι ειδως οτι και υπερ ο λεγω ποιησεις
transliteration: pepoiywv th upakoh sou egraqa soi eidwv oti kai uper o legw poihseiv
draft_translation: Having confidence in your obedience I wrote to you, knowing that you will also do more than I say.
ukjv_translation: Having confidence in your obedience I wrote unto you, knowing that you will also do more than I say.

greek_text: αμα δε και ετοιμαζε μοι ξενιαν ελπιζω γαρ οτι δια των προσευχων υμων χαρισθησομαι υμιν
transliteration: ama de kai etoimaze moi xenian elpizw gar oti dia twn proseucwn umwn carisyhsomai umin
draft_translation: But likewise prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given to you.
ukjv_translation: But likewise prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

greek_text: ασπαζονται σε επαφρας ο συναιχμαλωτος μου εν χριστω ιησου
transliteration: aspazontai se epafrav o sunaicmalwtov mou en cristw ihsou
draft_translation: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you;
ukjv_translation: There salute you Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus;

greek_text: μαρκος αρισταρχος δημας λουκας οι συνεργοι μου
transliteration: markov aristarcov dhmav loukav oi sunergoi mou
draft_translation: Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow laborers.
ukjv_translation: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellow labourers.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα του πνευματος υμων αμην
transliteration: h cariv tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou meta tou pneumatov umwn amhn
draft_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
ukjv_translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. (o. pneuma) Amen.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πολυμερως και πολυτροπως παλαι ο θεος λαλησας τοις πατρασιν εν τοις προφηταις επ εσχατων των ημερων τουτων ελαλησεν ημιν εν υιω
transliteration: polumerwv kai polutropwv palai o yeov lalhsav toiv patrasin en toiv profhtaiv ep escatwn twn hmerwn toutwn elalhsen hmin en uiw
draft_translation: God, who in many portions and in many ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,
ukjv_translation: God, who at several times and in divers manners spoke in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized divers; modernized several wording

greek_text: ον εθηκεν κληρονομον παντων δι ου και τους αιωνας εποιησεν
transliteration: on eyhken klhronomon pantwn di ou kai touv aiwnav epoihsen
draft_translation: Has in these last days spoken to us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
ukjv_translation: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

greek_text: ος ων απαυγασμα της δοξης και χαρακτηρ της υποστασεως αυτου φερων τε τα παντα τω ρηματι της δυναμεως αυτου δι εαυτου καθαρισμον ποιησαμενος των αμαρτιων ημων εκαθισεν εν δεξια της μεγαλωσυνης εν υψηλοις
transliteration: ov wn apaugasma thv doxhv kai carakthr thv upostasewv autou ferwn te ta panta tw rhmati thv dunamewv autou di eautou kayarismon poihsamenov twn amartiwn hmwn ekayisen en dexia thv megalwsunhv en uqhloiv
draft_translation: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:
ukjv_translation: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word (o. rhema) of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τοσουτω κρειττων γενομενος των αγγελων οσω διαφορωτερον παρ αυτους κεκληρονομηκεν ονομα
transliteration: tosoutw kreittwn genomenov twn aggelwn osw diaforwteron par autouv keklhronomhken onoma
draft_translation: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they.
ukjv_translation: Being made so much better than the angels, as he has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

greek_text: τινι γαρ ειπεν ποτε των αγγελων υιος μου ει συ εγω σημερον γεγεννηκα σε και παλιν εγω εσομαι αυτω εις πατερα και αυτος εσται μοι εις υιον
transliteration: tini gar eipen pote twn aggelwn uiov mou ei su egw shmeron gegennhka se kai palin egw esomai autw eiv patera kai autov estai moi eiv uion
draft_translation: For to which of the angels said he at any time, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
ukjv_translation: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

greek_text: οταν δε παλιν εισαγαγη τον πρωτοτοκον εις την οικουμενην λεγει και προσκυνησατωσαν αυτω παντες αγγελοι θεου
transliteration: otan de palin eisagagh ton prwtotokon eiv thn oikoumenhn legei kai proskunhsatwsan autw pantev aggeloi yeou
draft_translation: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the inhabited world, he says, And let all the angels of God worship him.
ukjv_translation: And again, when he brings in the First-Born into the world, he says, And let all the angels of God worship him.

greek_text: και προς μεν τους αγγελους λεγει ο ποιων τους αγγελους αυτου πνευματα και τους λειτουργους αυτου πυρος φλογα
transliteration: kai prov men touv aggelouv legei o poiwn touv aggelouv autou pneumata kai touv leitourgouv autou purov floga
draft_translation: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
ukjv_translation: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, (o. pneuma) and his ministers a flame of fire.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: προς δε τον υιον ο θρονος σου ο θεος εις τον αιωνα του αιωνος ραβδος ευθυτητος η ραβδος της βασιλειας σου
transliteration: prov de ton uion o yronov sou o yeov eiv ton aiwna tou aiwnov rabdov euyuthtov h rabdov thv basileiav sou
draft_translation: But to the Son he says, Your throne, O God, is forever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of your kingdom.
ukjv_translation: But unto the Son he says, Your throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of your kingdom.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forever spelling

greek_text: ηγαπησας δικαιοσυνην και εμισησας ανομιαν δια τουτο εχρισεν σε ο θεος ο θεος σου ελαιον αγαλλιασεως παρα τους μετοχους σου
transliteration: hgaphsav dikaiosunhn kai emishsav anomian dia touto ecrisen se o yeov o yeov sou elaion agalliasewv para touv metocouv sou
draft_translation: You have loved righteousness, and hated lawlessness; because of this God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions.
ukjv_translation: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

greek_text: και συ κατ αρχας κυριε την γην εθεμελιωσας και εργα των χειρων σου εισιν οι ουρανοι
transliteration: kai su kat arcav kurie thn ghn eyemeliwsav kai erga twn ceirwn sou eisin oi ouranoi
draft_translation: And, You, Lord, in the beginning have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of your hands:
ukjv_translation: And, You, Lord, in the beginning have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of yours hands:
review_notes: modernized yours before noun; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: αυτοι απολουνται συ δε διαμενεις και παντες ως ιματιον παλαιωθησονται
transliteration: autoi apolountai su de diameneiv kai pantev wv imation palaiwyhsontai
draft_translation: They shall perish; but you remain; and they all shall wax old as does a clothing;
ukjv_translation: They shall perish; but you remain; and they all shall wax old as does a garment;
review_notes: modernized garment where not contextually technical

greek_text: και ωσει περιβολαιον ελιξεις αυτους και αλλαγησονται συ δε ο αυτος ει και τα ετη σου ουκ εκλειψουσιν
transliteration: kai wsei peribolaion elixeiv autouv kai allaghsontai su de o autov ei kai ta eth sou ouk ekleiqousin
draft_translation: And as a mantle you shall roll them up, and they shall be changed: but you are the same, and your years shall not fail.
ukjv_translation: And as a vesture shall you fold them up, and they shall be changed: but you are the same, and your years shall not fail.

greek_text: προς τινα δε των αγγελων ειρηκεν ποτε καθου εκ δεξιων μου εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
transliteration: prov tina de twn aggelwn eirhken pote kayou ek dexiwn mou ewv an yw touv ecyrouv sou upopodion twn podwn sou
draft_translation: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?
ukjv_translation: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make yours enemies your footstool?

greek_text: ουχι παντες εισιν λειτουργικα πνευματα εις διακονιαν αποστελλομενα δια τους μελλοντας κληρονομειν σωτηριαν
transliteration: ouci pantev eisin leitourgika pneumata eiv diakonian apostellomena dia touv mellontav klhronomein swthrian
draft_translation: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
ukjv_translation: Are they not all ministering spirits, (o. pneuma) sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: δια τουτο δει περισσοτερως ημας προσεχειν τοις ακουσθεισιν μηποτε παραρρυωμεν
transliteration: dia touto dei perissoterwv hmav prosecein toiv akousyeisin mhpote pararruwmen
draft_translation: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
ukjv_translation: Therefore we ought to give the more earn heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

greek_text: ει γαρ ο δι αγγελων λαληθεις λογος εγενετο βεβαιος και πασα παραβασις και παρακοη ελαβεν ενδικον μισθαποδοσιαν
transliteration: ei gar o di aggelwn lalhyeiv logov egeneto bebaiov kai pasa parabasiv kai parakoh elaben endikon misyapodosian
draft_translation: For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward;
ukjv_translation: For if the word (o. logos) spoken by angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
review_notes: modernized recompence spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πως ημεις εκφευξομεθα τηλικαυτης αμελησαντες σωτηριας ητις αρχην λαβουσα λαλεισθαι δια του κυριου υπο των ακουσαντων εις ημας εβεβαιωθη
transliteration: pwv hmeiv ekfeuxomeya thlikauthv amelhsantev swthriav htiv archn labousa laleisyai dia tou kuriou upo twn akousantwn eiv hmav ebebaiwyh
draft_translation: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by those who heard him;
ukjv_translation: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: συνεπιμαρτυρουντος του θεου σημειοις τε και τερασιν και ποικιλαις δυναμεσιν και πνευματος αγιου μερισμοις κατα την αυτου θελησιν
transliteration: sunepimarturountov tou yeou shmeioiv te kai terasin kai poikilaiv dunamesin kai pneumatov agiou merismoiv kata thn autou yelhsin
draft_translation: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
ukjv_translation: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) according to his own will?
review_notes: modernized divers; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ου γαρ αγγελοις υπεταξεν την οικουμενην την μελλουσαν περι ης λαλουμεν
transliteration: ou gar aggeloiv upetaxen thn oikoumenhn thn mellousan peri hv laloumen
draft_translation: For to the angels has he not put in subjection the world to come, of which we speak.
ukjv_translation: For unto the angels has he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized whereof

greek_text: διεμαρτυρατο δε που τις λεγων τι εστιν ανθρωπος οτι μιμνησκη αυτου η υιος ανθρωπου οτι επισκεπτη αυτον
transliteration: diemarturato de pou tiv legwn ti estin anyrwpov oti mimnhskh autou h uiov anyrwpou oti episkepth auton
draft_translation: But someone somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of man, that you visit him?
ukjv_translation: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of man that you visit him?

greek_text: ηλαττωσας αυτον βραχυ τι παρ αγγελους δοξη και τιμη εστεφανωσας αυτον και κατεστησας αυτον επι τα εργα των χειρων σου
transliteration: hlattwsav auton bracu ti par aggelouv doxh kai timh estefanwsav auton kai katesthsav auton epi ta erga twn ceirwn sou
draft_translation: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor, and did set him over the works of your hands:
ukjv_translation: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honour, and did set him over the works of your hands:

greek_text: παντα υπεταξας υποκατω των ποδων αυτου εν γαρ τω υποταξαι αυτω τα παντα ουδεν αφηκεν αυτω ανυποτακτον νυν δε ουπω ορωμεν αυτω τα παντα υποτεταγμενα
transliteration: panta upetaxav upokatw twn podwn autou en gar tw upotaxai autw ta panta ouden afhken autw anupotakton nun de oupw orwmen autw ta panta upotetagmena
draft_translation: You subjected all things under his feet. For in subjecting all things to him, he left nothing unsubjected to him. But now we do not yet see all things subjected to him.
ukjv_translation: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

greek_text: τον δε βραχυ τι παρ αγγελους ηλαττωμενον βλεπομεν ιησουν δια το παθημα του θανατου δοξη και τιμη εστεφανωμενον οπως χαριτι θεου υπερ παντος γευσηται θανατου
transliteration: ton de bracu ti par aggelouv hlattwmenon blepomen ihsoun dia to payhma tou yanatou doxh kai timh estefanwmenon opwv cariti yeou uper pantov geushtai yanatou
