draft_translation: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
ukjv_translation: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

greek_text: επρεπεν γαρ αυτω δι ον τα παντα και δι ου τα παντα πολλους υιους εις δοξαν αγαγοντα τον αρχηγον της σωτηριας αυτων δια παθηματων τελειωσαι
transliteration: eprepen gar autw di on ta panta kai di ou ta panta pollouv uiouv eiv doxan agagonta ton archgon thv swthriav autwn dia payhmatwn teleiwsai
draft_translation: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
ukjv_translation: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

greek_text: ο τε γαρ αγιαζων και οι αγιαζομενοι εξ ενος παντες δι ην αιτιαν ουκ επαισχυνεται αδελφους αυτους καλειν
transliteration: o te gar agiazwn kai oi agiazomenoi ex enov pantev di hn aitian ouk epaiscunetai adelfouv autouv kalein
draft_translation: For both the one who sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one: for this reason he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
ukjv_translation: For both he that santifies and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
review_notes: fixed sanctifies spelling; modernized for-which-cause idiom; modernized he-that relative; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: λεγων απαγγελω το ονομα σου τοις αδελφοις μου εν μεσω εκκλησιας υμνησω σε
transliteration: legwn apaggelw to onoma sou toiv adelfoiv mou en mesw ekklhsiav umnhsw se
draft_translation: Saying, I will declare your name to my brothers, in the midst of the assembly will I sing praise to you.
ukjv_translation: Saying, I will declare your name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και παλιν εγω εσομαι πεποιθως επ αυτω και παλιν ιδου εγω και τα παιδια α μοι εδωκεν ο θεος
transliteration: kai palin egw esomai pepoiywv ep autw kai palin idou egw kai ta paidia a moi edwken o yeov
draft_translation: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Look I and the children who God has given me.
ukjv_translation: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God has given me.
review_notes: modernized behold; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: επει ουν τα παιδια κεκοινωνηκεν σαρκος και αιματος και αυτος παραπλησιως μετεσχεν των αυτων ινα δια του θανατου καταργηση τον το κρατος εχοντα του θανατου τουτ εστιν τον διαβολον
transliteration: epei oun ta paidia kekoinwnhken sarkov kai aimatov kai autov paraplhsiwv metescen twn autwn ina dia tou yanatou katarghsh ton to kratov econta tou yanatou tout estin ton diabolon
draft_translation: Since then the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil;
ukjv_translation: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
review_notes: modernized forasmuch; modernized him-that relative; modernized since-then-as wording

greek_text: και απαλλαξη τουτους οσοι φοβω θανατου δια παντος του ζην ενοχοι ησαν δουλειας
transliteration: kai apallaxh toutouv osoi fobw yanatou dia pantov tou zhn enocoi hsan douleiav
draft_translation: and deliver those who through fear of death were all their life subject to slavery.
ukjv_translation: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

greek_text: ου γαρ δηπου αγγελων επιλαμβανεται αλλα σπερματος αβρααμ επιλαμβανεται
transliteration: ou gar dhpou aggelwn epilambanetai alla spermatov abraam epilambanetai
draft_translation: For truly he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
ukjv_translation: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

greek_text: οθεν ωφειλεν κατα παντα τοις αδελφοις ομοιωθηναι ινα ελεημων γενηται και πιστος αρχιερευς τα προς τον θεον εις το ιλασκεσθαι τας αμαρτιας του λαου
transliteration: oyen wfeilen kata panta toiv adelfoiv omoiwyhnai ina elehmwn genhtai kai pistov arciereuv ta prov ton yeon eiv to ilaskesyai tav amartiav tou laou
draft_translation: Therefore in all things it was essential for him to be made like to his brothers, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore in all things it was essential for him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: εν ω γαρ πεπονθεν αυτος πειρασθεις δυναται τοις πειραζομενοις βοηθησαι
transliteration: en w gar peponyen autov peirasyeiv dunatai toiv peirazomenoiv bohyhsai
draft_translation: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
ukjv_translation: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help them that are tempted.

greek_text: οθεν αδελφοι αγιοι κλησεως επουρανιου μετοχοι κατανοησατε τον αποστολον και αρχιερεα της ομολογιας ημων χριστον ιησουν
transliteration: oyen adelfoi agioi klhsewv epouraniou metocoi katanohsate ton apostolon kai arcierea thv omologiav hmwn criston ihsoun
draft_translation: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Christ Jesus;
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
review_notes: modernized wherefore; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered homologia as confession

greek_text: πιστον οντα τω ποιησαντι αυτον ως και μωσης εν ολω τω οικω αυτου
transliteration: piston onta tw poihsanti auton wv kai mwshv en olw tw oikw autou
draft_translation: Who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
ukjv_translation: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

greek_text: πλειονος γαρ δοξης ουτος παρα μωσην ηξιωται καθ οσον πλειονα τιμην εχει του οικου ο κατασκευασας αυτον
transliteration: pleionov gar doxhv outov para mwshn hxiwtai kay oson pleiona timhn ecei tou oikou o kataskeuasav auton
draft_translation: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who has built the house has more honor than the house.
ukjv_translation: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who has built the house has more honour than the house.

greek_text: πας γαρ οικος κατασκευαζεται υπο τινος ο δε τα παντα κατασκευασας θεος
transliteration: pav gar oikov kataskeuazetai upo tinov o de ta panta kataskeuasav yeov
draft_translation: For every house is built by some man; but the one who built all things is God.
ukjv_translation: For every house is built by some man; but he that built all things is God.

greek_text: και μωσης μεν πιστος εν ολω τω οικω αυτου ως θεραπων εις μαρτυριον των λαληθησομενων
transliteration: kai mwshv men pistov en olw tw oikw autou wv yerapwn eiv marturion twn lalhyhsomenwn
draft_translation: And Moses truly was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
ukjv_translation: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

greek_text: χριστος δε ως υιος επι τον οικον αυτου ου οικος εσμεν ημεις εανπερ την παρρησιαν και το καυχημα της ελπιδος μεχρι τελους βεβαιαν κατασχωμεν
transliteration: cristov de wv uiov epi ton oikon autou ou oikov esmen hmeiv eanper thn parrhsian kai to kauchma thv elpidov mecri telouv bebaian katascwmen
draft_translation: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.
ukjv_translation: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

greek_text: διο καθως λεγει το πνευμα το αγιον σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε
transliteration: dio kaywv legei to pneuma to agion shmeron ean thv fwnhv autou akoushte
draft_translation: Therefore (as the Holy Spirit says, today if you will hear his voice,
ukjv_translation: Wherefore (as the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) says, To day if all of you will hear his voice,
review_notes: modernized today spelling; modernized wherefore; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων ως εν τω παραπικρασμω κατα την ημεραν του πειρασμου εν τη ερημω
transliteration: mh sklhrunhte tav kardiav umwn wv en tw parapikrasmw kata thn hmeran tou peirasmou en th erhmw
draft_translation: Do not harden your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of testing in the wilderness:
ukjv_translation: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

greek_text: ου επειρασαν με οι πατερες υμων εδοκιμασαν με και ειδον τα εργα μου τεσσαρακοντα ετη
transliteration: ou epeirasan me oi paterev umwn edokimasan me kai eidon ta erga mou tessarakonta eth
draft_translation: where your fathers tested me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
ukjv_translation: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

greek_text: διο προσωχθισα τη γενεα εκεινη και ειπον αει πλανωνται τη καρδια αυτοι δε ουκ εγνωσαν τας οδους μου
transliteration: dio proswcyisa th genea ekeinh kai eipon aei planwntai th kardia autoi de ouk egnwsan tav odouv mou
draft_translation: Therefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always go astray in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always go astray in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

greek_text: ως ωμοσα εν τη οργη μου ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου
transliteration: wv wmosa en th orgh mou ei eiseleusontai eiv thn katapausin mou
draft_translation: So I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
ukjv_translation: So I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: βλεπετε αδελφοι μηποτε εσται εν τινι υμων καρδια πονηρα απιστιας εν τω αποστηναι απο θεου ζωντος
transliteration: blepete adelfoi mhpote estai en tini umwn kardia ponhra apistiav en tw aposthnai apo yeou zwntov
draft_translation: Take heed, brothers, lest there is in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
ukjv_translation: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
review_notes: modernized there-be idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: αλλα παρακαλειτε εαυτους καθ εκαστην ημεραν αχρις ου το σημερον καλειται ινα μη σκληρυνθη τις εξ υμων απατη της αμαρτιας
transliteration: alla parakaleite eautouv kay ekasthn hmeran acriv ou to shmeron kaleitai ina mh sklhrunyh tiv ex umwn apath thv amartiav
draft_translation: But exhort one another daily, while it is called today; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
ukjv_translation: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

greek_text: μετοχοι γαρ γεγοναμεν του χριστου εανπερ την αρχην της υποστασεως μεχρι τελους βεβαιαν κατασχωμεν
transliteration: metocoi gar gegonamen tou cristou eanper thn archn thv upostasewv mecri telouv bebaian katascwmen
draft_translation: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end;
ukjv_translation: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast unto the end;

greek_text: εν τω λεγεσθαι σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων ως εν τω παραπικρασμω
transliteration: en tw legesyai shmeron ean thv fwnhv autou akoushte mh sklhrunhte tav kardiav umwn wv en tw parapikrasmw
draft_translation: While it is said, today if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
ukjv_translation: While it is said, To day if all of you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
review_notes: modernized today spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τινες γαρ ακουσαντες παρεπικραναν αλλ ου παντες οι εξελθοντες εξ αιγυπτου δια μωσεως
transliteration: tinev gar akousantev parepikranan all ou pantev oi exelyontev ex aiguptou dia mwsewv
draft_translation: For who, when they heard, provoked? was it not all who came out of Egypt by Moses?
ukjv_translation: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: nevertheless not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

greek_text: τισιν δε προσωχθισεν τεσσαρακοντα ετη ουχι τοις αμαρτησασιν ων τα κωλα επεσεν εν τη ερημω
transliteration: tisin de proswcyisen tessarakonta eth ouci toiv amarthsasin wn ta kwla epesen en th erhmw
draft_translation: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with those who had sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?
ukjv_translation: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?

greek_text: τισιν δε ωμοσεν μη εισελευσεσθαι εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου ει μη τοις απειθησασιν
transliteration: tisin de wmosen mh eiseleusesyai eiv thn katapausin autou ei mh toiv apeiyhsasin
draft_translation: And to whom did he swear that they should not enter into his rest, but to those who disobeyed?
ukjv_translation: And to whom swore he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

greek_text: και βλεπομεν οτι ουκ ηδυνηθησαν εισελθειν δι απιστιαν
transliteration: kai blepomen oti ouk hdunhyhsan eiselyein di apistian
draft_translation: And we see that they could not enter because of unbelief.
ukjv_translation: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

greek_text: φοβηθωμεν ουν μηποτε καταλειπομενης επαγγελιας εισελθειν εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου δοκη τις εξ υμων υστερηκεναι
transliteration: fobhywmen oun mhpote kataleipomenhv epaggeliav eiselyein eiv thn katapausin autou dokh tiv ex umwn usterhkenai
draft_translation: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise remaining of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to have come short.
ukjv_translation: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

greek_text: και γαρ εσμεν ευηγγελισμενοι καθαπερ κακεινοι αλλ ουκ ωφελησεν ο λογος της ακοης εκεινους μη συγκεκραμενος τη πιστει τοις ακουσασιν
transliteration: kai gar esmen euhggelismenoi kayaper kakeinoi all ouk wfelhsen o logov thv akohv ekeinouv mh sugkekramenov th pistei toiv akousasin
draft_translation: For to us was the good news preached, as well as to them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard it.
ukjv_translation: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word (o. logos) preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered euangelion as good news

greek_text: εισερχομεθα γαρ εις την καταπαυσιν οι πιστευσαντες καθως ειρηκεν ως ωμοσα εν τη οργη μου ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου καιτοι των εργων απο καταβολης κοσμου γενηθεντων
transliteration: eisercomeya gar eiv thn katapausin oi pisteusantev kaywv eirhken wv wmosa en th orgh mou ei eiseleusontai eiv thn katapausin mou kaitoi twn ergwn apo katabolhv kosmou genhyentwn
draft_translation: For we who have believed enter into the rest, as he said, As I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
ukjv_translation: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

greek_text: ειρηκεν γαρ που περι της εβδομης ουτως και κατεπαυσεν ο θεος εν τη ημερα τη εβδομη απο παντων των εργων αυτου
transliteration: eirhken gar pou peri thv ebdomhv outwv kai katepausen o yeov en th hmera th ebdomh apo pantwn twn ergwn autou
draft_translation: For he spoke somewhere concerning the seventh day in this way, And God rested on the seventh day from all his works.
ukjv_translation: For he spoke in a certain place of the seventh day likewise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

greek_text: και εν τουτω παλιν ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου
transliteration: kai en toutw palin ei eiseleusontai eiv thn katapausin mou
draft_translation: And in this place again, They shall not enter into my rest.
ukjv_translation: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

greek_text: επει ουν απολειπεται τινας εισελθειν εις αυτην και οι προτερον ευαγγελισθεντες ουκ εισηλθον δι απειθειαν
transliteration: epei oun apoleipetai tinav eiselyein eiv authn kai oi proteron euaggelisyentev ouk eishlyon di apeiyeian
draft_translation: Seeing therefore it remains that some must enter in it, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
ukjv_translation: Seeing therefore it remains that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

greek_text: παλιν τινα οριζει ημεραν σημερον εν δαβιδ λεγων μετα τοσουτον χρονον καθως ειρηται σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων
transliteration: palin tina orizei hmeran shmeron en dabid legwn meta tosouton cronon kaywv eirhtai shmeron ean thv fwnhv autou akoushte mh sklhrunhte tav kardiav umwn
draft_translation: Again, he limits a certain day, saying in David, today, after so long a time; as it is said, today if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
ukjv_translation: Again, he limits a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if all of you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
review_notes: modernized today spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ει γαρ αυτους ιησους κατεπαυσεν ουκ αν περι αλλης ελαλει μετα ταυτα ημερας
transliteration: ei gar autouv ihsouv katepausen ouk an peri allhv elalei meta tauta hmerav
draft_translation: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not afterward have spoken of another day.
ukjv_translation: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

greek_text: αρα απολειπεται σαββατισμος τω λαω του θεου
transliteration: ara apoleipetai sabbatismov tw law tou yeou
draft_translation: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
ukjv_translation: There remains therefore a rest to the people of God.

greek_text: ο γαρ εισελθων εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου και αυτος κατεπαυσεν απο των εργων αυτου ωσπερ απο των ιδιων ο θεος
transliteration: o gar eiselywn eiv thn katapausin autou kai autov katepausen apo twn ergwn autou wsper apo twn idiwn o yeov
draft_translation: For the one who is entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
ukjv_translation: For he that is entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

greek_text: σπουδασωμεν ουν εισελθειν εις εκεινην την καταπαυσιν ινα μη εν τω αυτω τις υποδειγματι πεση της απειθειας
transliteration: spoudaswmen oun eiselyein eiv ekeinhn thn katapausin ina mh en tw autw tiv upodeigmati pesh thv apeiyeiav
draft_translation: Let us labor therefore to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of unbelief.
ukjv_translation: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; modernized labour spelling

greek_text: ζων γαρ ο λογος του θεου και ενεργης και τομωτερος υπερ πασαν μαχαιραν διστομον και διικνουμενος αχρι μερισμου ψυχης τε και πνευματος αρμων τε και μυελων και κριτικος ενθυμησεων και εννοιων καρδιας
transliteration: zwn gar o logov tou yeou kai energhv kai tomwterov uper pasan macairan distomon kai diiknoumenov acri merismou quchv te kai pneumatov armwn te kai muelwn kai kritikov enyumhsewn kai ennoiwn kardiav
draft_translation: For the word of God is active, and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
ukjv_translation: For the word (o. logos) of God is active, and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, (o. pneuma) and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και ουκ εστιν κτισις αφανης ενωπιον αυτου παντα δε γυμνα και τετραχηλισμενα τοις οφθαλμοις αυτου προς ον ημιν ο λογος
transliteration: kai ouk estin ktisiv afanhv enwpion autou panta de gumna kai tetrachlismena toiv ofyalmoiv autou prov on hmin o logov
draft_translation: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
ukjv_translation: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do. (o. logos)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: εχοντες ουν αρχιερεα μεγαν διεληλυθοτα τους ουρανους ιησουν τον υιον του θεου κρατωμεν της ομολογιας
transliteration: econtev oun arcierea megan dielhluyota touv ouranouv ihsoun ton uion tou yeou kratwmen thv omologiav
draft_translation: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
ukjv_translation: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

greek_text: ου γαρ εχομεν αρχιερεα μη δυναμενον συμπαθησαι ταις ασθενειαις ημων πεπειρασμενον δε κατα παντα καθ ομοιοτητα χωρις αμαρτιας
transliteration: ou gar ecomen arcierea mh dunamenon sumpayhsai taiv asyeneiaiv hmwn pepeirasmenon de kata panta kay omoiothta cwriv amartiav
draft_translation: For we have not a high priest who cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
ukjv_translation: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; modernized personal which as who

greek_text: προσερχωμεθα ουν μετα παρρησιας τω θρονω της χαριτος ινα λαβωμεν ελεον και χαριν ευρωμεν εις ευκαιρον βοηθειαν
transliteration: prosercwmeya oun meta parrhsiav tw yronw thv caritov ina labwmen eleon kai carin eurwmen eiv eukairon bohyeian
draft_translation: Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
ukjv_translation: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

greek_text: πας γαρ αρχιερευς εξ ανθρωπων λαμβανομενος υπερ ανθρωπων καθισταται τα προς τον θεον ινα προσφερη δωρα τε και θυσιας υπερ αμαρτιων
transliteration: pav gar arciereuv ex anyrwpwn lambanomenov uper anyrwpwn kayistatai ta prov ton yeon ina prosferh dwra te kai yusiav uper amartiwn
draft_translation: For every high priest taken from among men is appointed on behalf of men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
ukjv_translation: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

greek_text: μετριοπαθειν δυναμενος τοις αγνοουσιν και πλανωμενοις επει και αυτος περικειται ασθενειαν
transliteration: metriopayein dunamenov toiv agnoousin kai planwmenoiv epei kai autov perikeitai asyeneian
draft_translation: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on those who are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
ukjv_translation: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

greek_text: και δια ταυτην οφειλει καθως περι του λαου ουτως και περι εαυτου προσφερειν υπερ αμαρτιων
transliteration: kai dia tauthn ofeilei kaywv peri tou laou outwv kai peri eautou prosferein uper amartiwn
draft_translation: And by reason of this he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
ukjv_translation: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

greek_text: και ουχ εαυτω τις λαμβανει την τιμην αλλα ο καλουμενος υπο του θεου καθαπερ και ο ααρων
transliteration: kai ouc eautw tiv lambanei thn timhn alla o kaloumenov upo tou yeou kayaper kai o aarwn
draft_translation: And no one takes this honor to himself, but the one who is called of God, as was Aaron.
ukjv_translation: And no man takes this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized he-that relative; modernized honour spelling; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: ουτως και ο χριστος ουχ εαυτον εδοξασεν γενηθηναι αρχιερεα αλλ ο λαλησας προς αυτον υιος μου ει συ εγω σημερον γεγεννηκα σε
transliteration: outwv kai o cristov ouc eauton edoxasen genhyhnai arcierea all o lalhsav prov auton uiov mou ei su egw shmeron gegennhka se
draft_translation: So also Christ did not glorify himself to be made a high priest; but the one who said to him, You are my Son, today have I begotten you.
ukjv_translation: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, You are my Son, to day have I begotten you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized article before h-word; modernized he-that relative; modernized residual verb-not wording; modernized today spelling

greek_text: καθως και εν ετερω λεγει συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
transliteration: kaywv kai en eterw legei su iereuv eiv ton aiwna kata thn taxin melcisedek
draft_translation: As he says also in another place, You are a priest forever after the order of Melchisedec.
ukjv_translation: As he says also in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

greek_text: ος εν ταις ημεραις της σαρκος αυτου δεησεις τε και ικετηριας προς τον δυναμενον σωζειν αυτον εκ θανατου μετα κραυγης ισχυρας και δακρυων προσενεγκας και εισακουσθεις απο της ευλαβειας
transliteration: ov en taiv hmeraiv thv sarkov autou dehseiv te kai ikethriav prov ton dunamenon swzein auton ek yanatou meta kraughv iscurav kai dakruwn prosenegkav kai eisakousyeiv apo thv eulabeiav
draft_translation: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
ukjv_translation: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative

greek_text: καιπερ ων υιος εμαθεν αφ ων επαθεν την υπακοην
transliteration: kaiper wn uiov emayen af wn epayen thn upakohn
draft_translation: Though he was a Son, he learned obedience from the things which he suffered;
ukjv_translation: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

greek_text: και τελειωθεις εγενετο τοις υπακουουσιν αυτω πασιν αιτιος σωτηριας αιωνιου
transliteration: kai teleiwyeiv egeneto toiv upakouousin autw pasin aitiov swthriav aiwniou
draft_translation: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation to all those who obey him;
ukjv_translation: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: προσαγορευθεις υπο του θεου αρχιερευς κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
transliteration: prosagoreuyeiv upo tou yeou arciereuv kata thn taxin melcisedek
draft_translation: Called of God a high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
ukjv_translation: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

greek_text: περι ου πολυς ημιν ο λογος και δυσερμηνευτος λεγειν επει νωθροι γεγονατε ταις ακοαις
transliteration: peri ou poluv hmin o logov kai dusermhneutov legein epei nwyroi gegonate taiv akoaiv
draft_translation: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing you are dull of hearing.
ukjv_translation: Of whom we have (o. logos) many things to say, (o. logos) and hard to be uttered, seeing all of you are dull of hearing.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και γαρ οφειλοντες ειναι διδασκαλοι δια τον χρονον παλιν χρειαν εχετε του διδασκειν υμας τινα τα στοιχεια της αρχης των λογιων του θεου και γεγονατε χρειαν εχοντες γαλακτος και ου στερεας τροφης
transliteration: kai gar ofeilontev einai didaskaloi dia ton cronon palin creian ecete tou didaskein umav tina ta stoiceia thv archv twn logiwn tou yeou kai gegonate creian econtev galaktov kai ou stereav trofhv
draft_translation: For when for the time you ought to be teachers, you have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong food.
ukjv_translation: For when for the time all of you ought to be teachers, all of you have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong food.

greek_text: πας γαρ ο μετεχων γαλακτος απειρος λογου δικαιοσυνης νηπιος γαρ εστιν
transliteration: pav gar o metecwn galaktov apeirov logou dikaiosunhv nhpiov gar estin
draft_translation: For every one that uses milk is unskillful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
ukjv_translation: For every one that uses milk is unskillful in the word (o. logos) of righteousness: for he is a babe.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τελειων δε εστιν η στερεα τροφη των δια την εξιν τα αισθητηρια γεγυμνασμενα εχοντων προς διακρισιν καλου τε και κακου
transliteration: teleiwn de estin h sterea trofh twn dia thn exin ta aisyhthria gegumnasmena econtwn prov diakrisin kalou te kai kakou
draft_translation: But strong food belongs to those who are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
ukjv_translation: But strong food belongs to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

greek_text: διο αφεντες τον της αρχης του χριστου λογον επι την τελειοτητα φερωμεθα μη παλιν θεμελιον καταβαλλομενοι μετανοιας απο νεκρων εργων και πιστεως επι θεον
transliteration: dio afentev ton thv archv tou cristou logon epi thn teleiothta ferwmeya mh palin yemelion kataballomenoi metanoiav apo nekrwn ergwn kai pistewv epi yeon
draft_translation: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on to perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
ukjv_translation: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine (o. logos) of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: βαπτισμων διδαχης επιθεσεως τε χειρων αναστασεως τε νεκρων και κριματος αιωνιου
transliteration: baptismwn didachv epiyesewv te ceirwn anastasewv te nekrwn kai krimatov aiwniou
draft_translation: of teaching about baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
ukjv_translation: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

greek_text: και τουτο ποιησομεν εανπερ επιτρεπη ο θεος
transliteration: kai touto poihsomen eanper epitreph o yeov
draft_translation: And this we will do, if God permits.
ukjv_translation: And this will we do, if God permit.

greek_text: αδυνατον γαρ τους απαξ φωτισθεντας γευσαμενους τε της δωρεας της επουρανιου και μετοχους γενηθεντας πνευματος αγιου
transliteration: adunaton gar touv apax fwtisyentav geusamenouv te thv dwreav thv epouraniou kai metocouv genhyentav pneumatov agiou
draft_translation: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
ukjv_translation: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma)
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και καλον γευσαμενους θεου ρημα δυναμεις τε μελλοντος αιωνος
transliteration: kai kalon geusamenouv yeou rhma dunameiv te mellontov aiwnov
draft_translation: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
ukjv_translation: And have tasted the good word (o. rhema) of God, and the powers of the world to come,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και παραπεσοντας παλιν ανακαινιζειν εις μετανοιαν ανασταυρουντας εαυτοις τον υιον του θεου και παραδειγματιζοντας
transliteration: kai parapesontav palin anakainizein eiv metanoian anastaurountav eautoiv ton uion tou yeou kai paradeigmatizontav
draft_translation: If they shall fall away, to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
ukjv_translation: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

greek_text: γη γαρ η πιουσα τον επ αυτης πολλακις ερχομενον υετον και τικτουσα βοτανην ευθετον εκεινοις δι ους και γεωργειται μεταλαμβανει ευλογιας απο του θεου
transliteration: gh gar h piousa ton ep authv pollakiv ercomenon ueton kai tiktousa botanhn euyeton ekeinoiv di ouv kai gewrgeitai metalambanei eulogiav apo tou yeou
draft_translation: For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes often upon it, and produces herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from God:
ukjv_translation: For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes often upon it, and brings forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from God:

greek_text: εκφερουσα δε ακανθας και τριβολους αδοκιμος και καταρας εγγυς ης το τελος εις καυσιν
transliteration: ekferousa de akanyav kai tribolouv adokimov kai katarav egguv hv to telov eiv kausin
draft_translation: But that which bears thorns and briers is rejected, and is near to cursing; whose end is to be burned.
ukjv_translation: But that which bears thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized nigh

greek_text: πεπεισμεθα δε περι υμων αγαπητοι τα κρειττονα και εχομενα σωτηριας ει και ουτως λαλουμεν
transliteration: pepeismeya de peri umwn agaphtoi ta kreittona kai ecomena swthriav ei kai outwv laloumen
draft_translation: But, beloved, we are persuaded concerning you of better things, and things belonging to salvation, though we speak thus.
ukjv_translation: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

greek_text: ου γαρ αδικος ο θεος επιλαθεσθαι του εργου υμων και του κοπου της αγαπης ης ενδειξασθε εις το ονομα αυτου διακονησαντες τοις αγιοις και διακονουντες
transliteration: ou gar adikov o yeov epilayesyai tou ergou umwn kai tou kopou thv agaphv hv endeixasye eiv to onoma autou diakonhsantev toiv agioiv kai diakonountev
draft_translation: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labor of love, which you have showed toward his name, in that you have ministered to the holy ones, and do minister.
ukjv_translation: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, (o. agape) which all of you have showed toward his name, in that all of you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
review_notes: modernized labour spelling; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered hagioi as holy ones

greek_text: επιθυμουμεν δε εκαστον υμων την αυτην ενδεικνυσθαι σπουδην προς την πληροφοριαν της ελπιδος αχρι τελους
transliteration: epiyumoumen de ekaston umwn thn authn endeiknusyai spoudhn prov thn plhroforian thv elpidov acri telouv
draft_translation: And we desire that every one of you do show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope to the end:
ukjv_translation: And we desire that every one of you do show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

greek_text: ινα μη νωθροι γενησθε μιμηται δε των δια πιστεως και μακροθυμιας κληρονομουντων τας επαγγελιας
transliteration: ina mh nwyroi genhsye mimhtai de twn dia pistewv kai makroyumiav klhronomountwn tav epaggeliav
draft_translation: That you may not be slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
ukjv_translation: That all of you be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
review_notes: modernized residual be wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τω γαρ αβρααμ επαγγειλαμενος ο θεος επει κατ ουδενος ειχεν μειζονος ομοσαι ωμοσεν καθ εαυτου
transliteration: tw gar abraam epaggeilamenov o yeov epei kat oudenov eicen meizonov omosai wmosen kay eautou
draft_translation: For when God promised Abraham, because he had no greater by whom to swear, he swore by himself,
ukjv_translation: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he swore by himself,

greek_text: λεγων η μην ευλογων ευλογησω σε και πληθυνων πληθυνω σε
transliteration: legwn h mhn eulogwn euloghsw se kai plhyunwn plhyunw se
draft_translation: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.
ukjv_translation: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ουτως μακροθυμησας επετυχεν της επαγγελιας
transliteration: kai outwv makroyumhsav epetucen thv epaggeliav
draft_translation: And so, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
ukjv_translation: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

greek_text: ανθρωποι μεν γαρ κατα του μειζονος ομνυουσιν και πασης αυτοις αντιλογιας περας εις βεβαιωσιν ο ορκος
transliteration: anyrwpoi men gar kata tou meizonov omnuousin kai pashv autoiv antilogiav perav eiv bebaiwsin o orkov
draft_translation: For men truly swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
ukjv_translation: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

greek_text: εν ω περισσοτερον βουλομενος ο θεος επιδειξαι τοις κληρονομοις της επαγγελιας το αμεταθετον της βουλης αυτου εμεσιτευσεν ορκω
transliteration: en w perissoteron boulomenov o yeov epideixai toiv klhronomoiv thv epaggeliav to ametayeton thv boulhv autou emesiteusen orkw
draft_translation: in which God, willing more abundantly to show to the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
ukjv_translation: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to show unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherein

greek_text: ινα δια δυο πραγματων αμεταθετων εν οις αδυνατον ψευσασθαι θεον ισχυραν παρακλησιν εχωμεν οι καταφυγοντες κρατησαι της προκειμενης ελπιδος
transliteration: ina dia duo pragmatwn ametayetwn en oiv adunaton qeusasyai yeon iscuran paraklhsin ecwmen oi katafugontev krathsai thv prokeimenhv elpidov
draft_translation: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to lay hold of the hope set before us:
ukjv_translation: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

greek_text: ην ως αγκυραν εχομεν της ψυχης ασφαλη τε και βεβαιαν και εισερχομενην εις το εσωτερον του καταπετασματος
transliteration: hn wv agkuran ecomen thv quchv asfalh te kai bebaian kai eisercomenhn eiv to eswteron tou katapetasmatov
draft_translation: which we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and entering into the inner side of the veil;
ukjv_translation: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters into that within the veil;

greek_text: οπου προδρομος υπερ ημων εισηλθεν ιησους κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ αρχιερευς γενομενος εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: opou prodromov uper hmwn eishlyen ihsouv kata thn taxin melcisedek arciereuv genomenov eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: Where the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made a high priest forever after the order of Melchisedec.
ukjv_translation: Where the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; modernized forever spelling

greek_text: ουτος γαρ ο μελχισεδεκ βασιλευς σαλημ ιερευς του θεου του υψιστου ο συναντησας αβρααμ υποστρεφοντι απο της κοπης των βασιλεων και ευλογησας αυτον
transliteration: outov gar o melcisedek basileuv salhm iereuv tou yeou tou uqistou o sunanthsav abraam upostrefonti apo thv kophv twn basilewn kai euloghsav auton
draft_translation: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
ukjv_translation: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

greek_text: ω και δεκατην απο παντων εμερισεν αβρααμ πρωτον μεν ερμηνευομενος βασιλευς δικαιοσυνης επειτα δε και βασιλευς σαλημ ο εστιν βασιλευς ειρηνης
transliteration: w kai dekathn apo pantwn emerisen abraam prwton men ermhneuomenov basileuv dikaiosunhv epeita de kai basileuv salhm o estin basileuv eirhnhv
draft_translation: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
ukjv_translation: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: απατωρ αμητωρ αγενεαλογητος μητε αρχην ημερων μητε ζωης τελος εχων αφωμοιωμενος δε τω υιω του θεου μενει ιερευς εις το διηνεκες
transliteration: apatwr amhtwr agenealoghtov mhte archn hmerwn mhte zwhv telov ecwn afwmoiwmenov de tw uiw tou yeou menei iereuv eiv to dihnekev
draft_translation: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like to the Son of God; abides a priest continually.
ukjv_translation: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abides a priest continually.

greek_text: θεωρειτε δε πηλικος ουτος ω και δεκατην αβρααμ εδωκεν εκ των ακροθινιων ο πατριαρχης
transliteration: yewreite de phlikov outov w kai dekathn abraam edwken ek twn akroyiniwn o patriarchv
draft_translation: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
ukjv_translation: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

greek_text: και οι μεν εκ των υιων λευι την ιερατειαν λαμβανοντες εντολην εχουσιν αποδεκατουν τον λαον κατα τον νομον τουτ εστιν τους αδελφους αυτων καιπερ εξεληλυθοτας εκ της οσφυος αβρααμ
transliteration: kai oi men ek twn uiwn leui thn ierateian lambanontev entolhn ecousin apodekatoun ton laon kata ton nomon tout estin touv adelfouv autwn kaiper exelhluyotav ek thv osfuov abraam
draft_translation: And truly those who are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
ukjv_translation: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; modernized verily; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ο δε μη γενεαλογουμενος εξ αυτων δεδεκατωκεν τον αβρααμ και τον εχοντα τας επαγγελιας ευλογηκεν
transliteration: o de mh genealogoumenov ex autwn dedekatwken ton abraam kai ton econta tav epaggeliav euloghken
draft_translation: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him who had the promises.
ukjv_translation: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

greek_text: χωρις δε πασης αντιλογιας το ελαττον υπο του κρειττονος ευλογειται
transliteration: cwriv de pashv antilogiav to elatton upo tou kreittonov eulogeitai
draft_translation: And without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the better.
ukjv_translation: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

greek_text: και ωδε μεν δεκατας αποθνησκοντες ανθρωποι λαμβανουσιν εκει δε μαρτυρουμενος οτι ζη
transliteration: kai wde men dekatav apoynhskontev anyrwpoi lambanousin ekei de marturoumenov oti zh
draft_translation: And here dying men receive tithes; but there one receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.
ukjv_translation: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.

greek_text: και ως επος ειπειν δια αβρααμ και λευι ο δεκατας λαμβανων δεδεκατωται
transliteration: kai wv epov eipein dia abraam kai leui o dekatav lambanwn dedekatwtai
draft_translation: And, so to speak, through Abraham Levi also, who receives tithes, has paid tithes.
ukjv_translation: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receives tithes, paid tithes in Abraham.

greek_text: ετι γαρ εν τη οσφυι του πατρος ην οτε συνηντησεν αυτω ο μελχισεδεκ
transliteration: eti gar en th osfui tou patrov hn ote sunhnthsen autw o melcisedek
draft_translation: For he was still in the loins of his father when Melchisedec met him.
ukjv_translation: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

greek_text: ει μεν ουν τελειωσις δια της λευιτικης ιερωσυνης ην ο λαος γαρ επ αυτη νενομοθετητο τις ετι χρεια κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ ετερον ανιστασθαι ιερεα και ου κατα την ταξιν ααρων λεγεσθαι
transliteration: ei men oun teleiwsiv dia thv leuitikhv ierwsunhv hn o laov gar ep auth nenomoyethto tiv eti creia kata thn taxin melcisedek eteron anistasyai ierea kai ou kata thn taxin aarwn legesyai
draft_translation: If therefore perfection was through the Levitical priesthood, (for upon it the people received the law,) what further need was there for another priest to arise according to the order of Melchisedec, and not be called according to the order of Aaron?
ukjv_translation: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

greek_text: μετατιθεμενης γαρ της ιερωσυνης εξ αναγκης και νομου μεταθεσις γινεται
transliteration: metatiyemenhv gar thv ierwsunhv ex anagkhv kai nomou metayesiv ginetai
draft_translation: For when the priesthood is changed, of necessity a change of the law also takes place.
ukjv_translation: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

greek_text: εφ ον γαρ λεγεται ταυτα φυλης ετερας μετεσχηκεν αφ ης ουδεις προσεσχηκεν τω θυσιαστηριω
transliteration: ef on gar legetai tauta fulhv eterav meteschken af hv oudeiv proseschken tw yusiasthriw
draft_translation: For he of whom these things are spoken pertains to another tribe, of which no one gave attendance at the altar.
ukjv_translation: For he of whom these things are spoken pertains to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

greek_text: προδηλον γαρ οτι εξ ιουδα ανατεταλκεν ο κυριος ημων εις ην φυλην ουδεν περι ιερωσυνης μωσης ελαλησεν
transliteration: prodhlon gar oti ex iouda anatetalken o kuriov hmwn eiv hn fulhn ouden peri ierwsunhv mwshv elalhsen
draft_translation: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah; of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
ukjv_translation: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; standardized Juda as Judah in tribe/land contexts

greek_text: και περισσοτερον ετι καταδηλον εστιν ει κατα την ομοιοτητα μελχισεδεκ ανισταται ιερευς ετερος
transliteration: kai perissoteron eti katadhlon estin ei kata thn omoiothta melcisedek anistatai iereuv eterov
draft_translation: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the likeness of Melchisedec there arises another priest,
ukjv_translation: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the embodiment of Melchisedec there arises another priest,

greek_text: ος ου κατα νομον εντολης σαρκικης γεγονεν αλλα κατα δυναμιν ζωης ακαταλυτου
transliteration: ov ou kata nomon entolhv sarkikhv gegonen alla kata dunamin zwhv akatalutou
draft_translation: who has become, not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an indestructible life.
ukjv_translation: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

greek_text: μαρτυρει γαρ οτι συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
transliteration: marturei gar oti su iereuv eiv ton aiwna kata thn taxin melcisedek
draft_translation: For he testifies, You are a priest forever after the order of Melchisedec.
ukjv_translation: For he testifies, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

greek_text: αθετησις μεν γαρ γινεται προαγουσης εντολης δια το αυτης ασθενες και ανωφελες
transliteration: ayethsiv men gar ginetai proagoushv entolhv dia to authv asyenev kai anwfelev
draft_translation: For there is truly a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness of it.
ukjv_translation: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

greek_text: ουδεν γαρ ετελειωσεν ο νομος επεισαγωγη δε κρειττονος ελπιδος δι ης εγγιζομεν τω θεω
transliteration: ouden gar eteleiwsen o nomov epeisagwgh de kreittonov elpidov di hv eggizomen tw yew
draft_translation: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw near to God.
ukjv_translation: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized nigh

greek_text: και καθ οσον ου χωρις ορκωμοσιας οι μεν γαρ χωρις ορκωμοσιας εισιν ιερεις γεγονοτες
transliteration: kai kay oson ou cwriv orkwmosiav oi men gar cwriv orkwmosiav eisin iereiv gegonotev
draft_translation: And inasmuch as it was not without oath-taking:
ukjv_translation: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

greek_text: ο δε μετα ορκωμοσιας δια του λεγοντος προς αυτον ωμοσεν κυριος και ου μεταμεληθησεται συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
transliteration: o de meta orkwmosiav dia tou legontov prov auton wmosen kuriov kai ou metamelhyhsetai su iereuv eiv ton aiwna kata thn taxin melcisedek
draft_translation: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him who said to him, The Lord swore and will not repent, You are a priest forever after the order of Melchisedec:)
ukjv_translation: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord swore and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized forever spelling; modernized him-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: κατα τοσουτον κρειττονος διαθηκης γεγονεν εγγυος ιησους
transliteration: kata tosouton kreittonov diayhkhv gegonen egguov ihsouv
draft_translation: By so much was Jesus made a guarantor of a better covenant.
ukjv_translation: By so much was Jesus made a guarantor of a better testament.

greek_text: και οι μεν πλειονες εισιν γεγονοτες ιερεις δια το θανατω κωλυεσθαι παραμενειν
transliteration: kai oi men pleionev eisin gegonotev iereiv dia to yanatw kwluesyai paramenein
draft_translation: And they truly were many priests, because they were hindered from continuing by reason of death:
ukjv_translation: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

greek_text: ο δε δια το μενειν αυτον εις τον αιωνα απαραβατον εχει την ιερωσυνην
transliteration: o de dia to menein auton eiv ton aiwna aparabaton ecei thn ierwsunhn
draft_translation: But he, because he remains forever, has the unchangeable priesthood.
ukjv_translation: But this man, because he continues ever, has an unchangeable priesthood.

greek_text: οθεν και σωζειν εις το παντελες δυναται τους προσερχομενους δι αυτου τω θεω παντοτε ζων εις το εντυγχανειν υπερ αυτων
transliteration: oyen kai swzein eiv to pantelev dunatai touv prosercomenouv di autou tw yew pantote zwn eiv to entugcanein uper autwn
draft_translation: Therefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come to God by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherefore

greek_text: τοιουτος γαρ ημιν επρεπεν αρχιερευς οσιος ακακος αμιαντος κεχωρισμενος απο των αμαρτωλων και υψηλοτερος των ουρανων γενομενος
transliteration: toioutov gar hmin eprepen arciereuv osiov akakov amiantov kecwrismenov apo twn amartwlwn kai uqhloterov twn ouranwn genomenov
draft_translation: For such a high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
ukjv_translation: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

greek_text: ος ουκ εχει καθ ημεραν αναγκην ωσπερ οι αρχιερεις προτερον υπερ των ιδιων αμαρτιων θυσιας αναφερειν επειτα των του λαου τουτο γαρ εποιησεν εφαπαξ εαυτον ανενεγκας
transliteration: ov ouk ecei kay hmeran anagkhn wsper oi arciereiv proteron uper twn idiwn amartiwn yusiav anaferein epeita twn tou laou touto gar epoihsen efapax eauton anenegkav
draft_translation: who does not have daily need, as those high priests, first to offer sacrifices for his own sins, then for the people's: for this he did once for all, having offered up himself.
ukjv_translation: Who needs not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

greek_text: ο νομος γαρ ανθρωπους καθιστησιν αρχιερεις εχοντας ασθενειαν ο λογος δε της ορκωμοσιας της μετα τον νομον υιον εις τον αιωνα τετελειωμενον
transliteration: o nomov gar anyrwpouv kayisthsin arciereiv econtav asyeneian o logov de thv orkwmosiav thv meta ton nomon uion eiv ton aiwna teteleiwmenon
draft_translation: For the law makes men high priests who have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which came after the law, makes the Son, who is consecrated forevermore.
ukjv_translation: For the law makes men high priests which have infirmity; but the word (o. logos) of the oath, which was since the law, makes the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
review_notes: fixed Hebrews 7:28 temporal wording; modernized forevermore spelling; modernized personal which as who; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: κεφαλαιον δε επι τοις λεγομενοις τοιουτον εχομεν αρχιερεα ος εκαθισεν εν δεξια του θρονου της μεγαλωσυνης εν τοις ουρανοις
transliteration: kefalaion de epi toiv legomenoiv toiouton ecomen arcierea ov ekayisen en dexia tou yronou thv megalwsunhv en toiv ouranoiv
draft_translation: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such a high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
ukjv_translation: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

greek_text: των αγιων λειτουργος και της σκηνης της αληθινης ην επηξεν ο κυριος και ουκ ανθρωπος
transliteration: twn agiwn leitourgov kai thv skhnhv thv alhyinhv hn ephxen o kuriov kai ouk anyrwpov
draft_translation: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
ukjv_translation: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

greek_text: πας γαρ αρχιερευς εις το προσφερειν δωρα τε και θυσιας καθισταται οθεν αναγκαιον εχειν τι και τουτον ο προσενεγκη
transliteration: pav gar arciereuv eiv to prosferein dwra te kai yusiav kayistatai oyen anagkaion ecein ti kai touton o prosenegkh
draft_translation: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: therefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
ukjv_translation: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

greek_text: ει μεν γαρ ην επι γης ουδ αν ην ιερευς οντων των ιερεων των προσφεροντων κατα τον νομον τα δωρα
transliteration: ei men gar hn epi ghv oud an hn iereuv ontwn twn ierewn twn prosferontwn kata ton nomon ta dwra
draft_translation: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest, there being priests who offer gifts according to the law:
ukjv_translation: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

greek_text: οιτινες υποδειγματι και σκια λατρευουσιν των επουρανιων καθως κεχρηματισται μωσης μελλων επιτελειν την σκηνην ορα γαρ φησιν ποιησης παντα κατα τον τυπον τον δειχθεντα σοι εν τω ορει
transliteration: oitinev upodeigmati kai skia latreuousin twn epouraniwn kaywv kecrhmatistai mwshv mellwn epitelein thn skhnhn ora gar fhsin poihshv panta kata ton tupon ton deicyenta soi en tw orei
draft_translation: Who serve to the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, says he, that you make all things according to the pattern showed to you in the mount.
ukjv_translation: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, says he, that you make all things according to the pattern showed to you in the mount.

greek_text: νυνι δε διαφορωτερας τετευχεν λειτουργιας οσω και κρειττονος εστιν διαθηκης μεσιτης ητις επι κρειττοσιν επαγγελιαις νενομοθετηται
transliteration: nuni de diaforwterav teteucen leitourgiav osw kai kreittonov estin diayhkhv mesithv htiv epi kreittosin epaggeliaiv nenomoyethtai
draft_translation: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted upon better promises.
ukjv_translation: But now has he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

greek_text: ει γαρ η πρωτη εκεινη ην αμεμπτος ουκ αν δευτερας εζητειτο τοπος
transliteration: ei gar h prwth ekeinh hn amemptov ouk an deuterav ezhteito topov
draft_translation: For if that first had been faultless, no place would have been sought for a second.
ukjv_translation: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

greek_text: μεμφομενος γαρ αυτοις λεγει ιδου ημεραι ερχονται λεγει κυριος και συντελεσω επι τον οικον ισραηλ και επι τον οικον ιουδα διαθηκην καινην
transliteration: memfomenov gar autoiv legei idou hmerai ercontai legei kuriov kai suntelesw epi ton oikon israhl kai epi ton oikon iouda diayhkhn kainhn
draft_translation: For finding fault with them, he says, Look, the days come, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
ukjv_translation: For finding fault with them, he says, Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
review_notes: modernized behold; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ου κατα την διαθηκην ην εποιησα τοις πατρασιν αυτων εν ημερα επιλαβομενου μου της χειρος αυτων εξαγαγειν αυτους εκ γης αιγυπτου οτι αυτοι ουκ ενεμειναν εν τη διαθηκη μου καγω ημελησα αυτων λεγει κυριος
transliteration: ou kata thn diayhkhn hn epoihsa toiv patrasin autwn en hmera epilabomenou mou thv ceirov autwn exagagein autouv ek ghv aiguptou oti autoi ouk enemeinan en th diayhkh mou kagw hmelhsa autwn legei kuriov
draft_translation: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they did not continue in my covenant, and I did not regard them, says the Lord.
ukjv_translation: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, says the Lord.
review_notes: modernized residual verb-not wording; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οτι αυτη η διαθηκη ην διαθησομαι τω οικω ισραηλ μετα τας ημερας εκεινας λεγει κυριος διδους νομους μου εις την διανοιαν αυτων και επι καρδιας αυτων επιγραψω αυτους και εσομαι αυτοις εις θεον και αυτοι εσονται μοι εις λαον
transliteration: oti auth h diayhkh hn diayhsomai tw oikw israhl meta tav hmerav ekeinav legei kuriov didouv nomouv mou eiv thn dianoian autwn kai epi kardiav autwn epigraqw autouv kai esomai autoiv eiv yeon kai autoi esontai moi eiv laon
draft_translation: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
ukjv_translation: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

greek_text: και ου μη διδαξωσιν εκαστος τον πλησιον αυτου και εκαστος τον αδελφον αυτου λεγων γνωθι τον κυριον οτι παντες ειδησουσιν με απο μικρου αυτων εως μεγαλου αυτων
transliteration: kai ou mh didaxwsin ekastov ton plhsion autou kai ekastov ton adelfon autou legwn gnwyi ton kurion oti pantev eidhsousin me apo mikrou autwn ewv megalou autwn
draft_translation: And they shall not teach every man his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
ukjv_translation: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
review_notes: modernized neighbour spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: οτι ιλεως εσομαι ταις αδικιαις αυτων και των αμαρτιων αυτων και των ανομιων αυτων ου μη μνησθω ετι
transliteration: oti ilewv esomai taiv adikiaiv autwn kai twn amartiwn autwn kai twn anomiwn autwn ou mh mnhsyw eti
draft_translation: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more.
ukjv_translation: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

greek_text: εν τω λεγειν καινην πεπαλαιωκεν την πρωτην το δε παλαιουμενον και γηρασκον εγγυς αφανισμου
transliteration: en tw legein kainhn pepalaiwken thn prwthn to de palaioumenon kai ghraskon egguv afanismou
draft_translation: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. Now that which decays and grows old is ready to vanish away.
ukjv_translation: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. Now that which decays and waxs old is ready to vanish away.

greek_text: ειχεν μεν ουν και η πρωτη δικαιωματα λατρειας το τε αγιον κοσμικον
transliteration: eicen men oun kai h prwth dikaiwmata latreiav to te agion kosmikon
draft_translation: Then truly the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
ukjv_translation: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

greek_text: σκηνη γαρ κατεσκευασθη η πρωτη εν η η τε λυχνια και η τραπεζα και η προθεσις των αρτων ητις λεγεται αγια
transliteration: skhnh gar kateskeuasyh h prwth en h h te lucnia kai h trapeza kai h proyesiv twn artwn htiv legetai agia
draft_translation: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, in which was the candlestick, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the sanctuary.
ukjv_translation: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the sanctuary.

greek_text: μετα δε το δευτερον καταπετασμα σκηνη η λεγομενη αγια αγιων
transliteration: meta de to deuteron katapetasma skhnh h legomenh agia agiwn
draft_translation: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called Holy of Holies;
ukjv_translation: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

greek_text: χρυσουν εχουσα θυμιατηριον και την κιβωτον της διαθηκης περικεκαλυμμενην παντοθεν χρυσιω εν η σταμνος χρυση εχουσα το μαννα και η ραβδος ααρων η βλαστησασα και αι πλακες της διαθηκης
transliteration: crusoun ecousa yumiathrion kai thn kibwton thv diayhkhv perikekalummenhn pantoyen crusiw en h stamnov crush ecousa to manna kai h rabdov aarwn h blasthsasa kai ai plakev thv diayhkhv
draft_translation: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, in which was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
ukjv_translation: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

greek_text: υπερανω δε αυτης χερουβιμ δοξης κατασκιαζοντα το ιλαστηριον περι ων ουκ εστιν νυν λεγειν κατα μερος
transliteration: uperanw de authv ceroubim doxhv kataskiazonta to ilasthrion peri wn ouk estin nun legein kata merov
draft_translation: And over it the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat; concerning which we cannot now speak in detail.
ukjv_translation: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercy seat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

greek_text: τουτων δε ουτως κατεσκευασμενων εις μεν την πρωτην σκηνην δια παντος εισιασιν οι ιερεις τας λατρειας επιτελουντες
transliteration: toutwn de outwv kateskeuasmenwn eiv men thn prwthn skhnhn dia pantov eisiasin oi iereiv tav latreiav epitelountev
draft_translation: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests always enter into the first tabernacle, performing the services.
ukjv_translation: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

greek_text: εις δε την δευτεραν απαξ του ενιαυτου μονος ο αρχιερευς ου χωρις αιματος ο προσφερει υπερ εαυτου και των του λαου αγνοηματων
transliteration: eiv de thn deuteran apax tou eniautou monov o arciereuv ou cwriv aimatov o prosferei uper eautou kai twn tou laou agnohmatwn
draft_translation: But into the second the high priest alone enters once every year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the ignorances of the people:
ukjv_translation: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

greek_text: τουτο δηλουντος του πνευματος του αγιου μηπω πεφανερωσθαι την των αγιων οδον ετι της πρωτης σκηνης εχουσης στασιν
transliteration: touto dhlountov tou pneumatov tou agiou mhpw pefanerwsyai thn twn agiwn odon eti thv prwthv skhnhv ecoushv stasin
draft_translation: The Holy Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while the first tabernacle was yet standing:
ukjv_translation: The Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while the first tabernacle was yet standing:
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ητις παραβολη εις τον καιρον τον ενεστηκοτα καθ ον δωρα τε και θυσιαι προσφερονται μη δυναμεναι κατα συνειδησιν τελειωσαι τον λατρευοντα
transliteration: htiv parabolh eiv ton kairon ton enesthkota kay on dwra te kai yusiai prosferontai mh dunamenai kata suneidhsin teleiwsai ton latreuonta
draft_translation: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him who did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
ukjv_translation: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

greek_text: μονον επι βρωμασιν και πομασιν και διαφοροις βαπτισμοις και δικαιωμασιν σαρκος μεχρι καιρου διορθωσεως επικειμενα
transliteration: monon epi brwmasin kai pomasin kai diaforoiv baptismoiv kai dikaiwmasin sarkov mecri kairou diorywsewv epikeimena
draft_translation: Which stood only in foods and drinks, and various washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
ukjv_translation: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

greek_text: χριστος δε παραγενομενος αρχιερευς των μελλοντων αγαθων δια της μειζονος και τελειοτερας σκηνης ου χειροποιητου τουτ εστιν ου ταυτης της κτισεως
transliteration: cristov de paragenomenov arciereuv twn mellontwn agaywn dia thv meizonov kai teleioterav skhnhv ou ceiropoihtou tout estin ou tauthv thv ktisewv
draft_translation: But Christ being come a high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
ukjv_translation: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

greek_text: ουδε δι αιματος τραγων και μοσχων δια δε του ιδιου αιματος εισηλθεν εφαπαξ εις τα αγια αιωνιαν λυτρωσιν ευραμενος
transliteration: oude di aimatov tragwn kai moscwn dia de tou idiou aimatov eishlyen efapax eiv ta agia aiwnian lutrwsin euramenov
draft_translation: nor by blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered once for all into the holy places, having obtained eternal redemption.
ukjv_translation: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

greek_text: ει γαρ το αιμα ταυρων και τραγων και σποδος δαμαλεως ραντιζουσα τους κεκοινωμενους αγιαζει προς την της σαρκος καθαροτητα
transliteration: ei gar to aima taurwn kai tragwn kai spodov damalewv rantizousa touv kekoinwmenouv agiazei prov thn thv sarkov kayarothta
draft_translation: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifies to the purifying of the flesh:
ukjv_translation: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, santifies to the purifying of the flesh:
review_notes: fixed sanctifies spelling; modernized article before h-word

greek_text: ποσω μαλλον το αιμα του χριστου ος δια πνευματος αιωνιου εαυτον προσηνεγκεν αμωμον τω θεω καθαριει την συνειδησιν υμων απο νεκρων εργων εις το λατρευειν θεω ζωντι
transliteration: posw mallon to aima tou cristou ov dia pneumatov aiwniou eauton proshnegken amwmon tw yew kayariei thn suneidhsin umwn apo nekrwn ergwn eiv to latreuein yew zwnti
draft_translation: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
ukjv_translation: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit (o. pneuma) offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και δια τουτο διαθηκης καινης μεσιτης εστιν οπως θανατου γενομενου εις απολυτρωσιν των επι τη πρωτη διαθηκη παραβασεων την επαγγελιαν λαβωσιν οι κεκλημενοι της αιωνιου κληρονομιας
transliteration: kai dia touto diayhkhv kainhv mesithv estin opwv yanatou genomenou eiv apolutrwsin twn epi th prwth diayhkh parabasewn thn epaggelian labwsin oi keklhmenoi thv aiwniou klhronomiav
draft_translation: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new covenant, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, those who are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
ukjv_translation: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
review_notes: modernized they-which relative; rendered diatheke as covenant

greek_text: οπου γαρ διαθηκη θανατον αναγκη φερεσθαι του διαθεμενου
transliteration: opou gar diayhkh yanaton anagkh feresyai tou diayemenou
draft_translation: For where a will is, the death of the one who made it must be established.
ukjv_translation: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

greek_text: διαθηκη γαρ επι νεκροις βεβαια επει μηποτε ισχυει οτε ζη ο διαθεμενος
transliteration: diayhkh gar epi nekroiv bebaia epei mhpote iscuei ote zh o diayemenov
draft_translation: For a will is firm when people are dead, since it never has force while the one who made it lives.
ukjv_translation: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator lives.

greek_text: οθεν ουδ η πρωτη χωρις αιματος εγκεκαινισται
transliteration: oyen oud h prwth cwriv aimatov egkekainistai
draft_translation: Therefore neither was the first covenant inaugurated without blood.
ukjv_translation: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

greek_text: λαληθεισης γαρ πασης εντολης κατα νομον υπο μωυσεως παντι τω λαω λαβων το αιμα των μοσχων και τραγων μετα υδατος και εριου κοκκινου και υσσωπου αυτο τε το βιβλιον και παντα τον λαον ερραντισεν
transliteration: lalhyeishv gar pashv entolhv kata nomon upo mwusewv panti tw law labwn to aima twn moscwn kai tragwn meta udatov kai eriou kokkinou kai usswpou auto te to biblion kai panta ton laon errantisen
draft_translation: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself, and all the people,
ukjv_translation: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

greek_text: λεγων τουτο το αιμα της διαθηκης ης ενετειλατο προς υμας ο θεος
transliteration: legwn touto to aima thv diayhkhv hv eneteilato prov umav o yeov
draft_translation: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded to you.
ukjv_translation: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God has commanded with authority unto you.

greek_text: και την σκηνην δε και παντα τα σκευη της λειτουργιας τω αιματι ομοιως ερραντισεν
transliteration: kai thn skhnhn de kai panta ta skeuh thv leitourgiav tw aimati omoiwv errantisen
draft_translation: Moreover he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the service.
ukjv_translation: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

greek_text: και σχεδον εν αιματι παντα καθαριζεται κατα τον νομον και χωρις αιματεκχυσιας ου γινεται αφεσις
transliteration: kai scedon en aimati panta kayarizetai kata ton nomon kai cwriv aimatekcusiav ou ginetai afesiv
draft_translation: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no forgiveness.
ukjv_translation: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

greek_text: αναγκη ουν τα μεν υποδειγματα των εν τοις ουρανοις τουτοις καθαριζεσθαι αυτα δε τα επουρανια κρειττοσιν θυσιαις παρα ταυτας
transliteration: anagkh oun ta men upodeigmata twn en toiv ouranoiv toutoiv kayarizesyai auta de ta epourania kreittosin yusiaiv para tautav
draft_translation: It was therefore necessary that the copies of the things in the heavens be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
ukjv_translation: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

greek_text: ου γαρ εις χειροποιητα αγια εισηλθεν ο χριστος αντιτυπα των αληθινων αλλ εις αυτον τον ουρανον νυν εμφανισθηναι τω προσωπω του θεου υπερ ημων
transliteration: ou gar eiv ceiropoihta agia eishlyen o cristov antitupa twn alhyinwn all eiv auton ton ouranon nun emfanisyhnai tw proswpw tou yeou uper hmwn
