draft_translation: For Christ did not enter into holy places made with hands, copies of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us:
ukjv_translation: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

greek_text: ουδ ινα πολλακις προσφερη εαυτον ωσπερ ο αρχιερευς εισερχεται εις τα αγια κατ ενιαυτον εν αιματι αλλοτριω
transliteration: oud ina pollakiv prosferh eauton wsper o arciereuv eisercetai eiv ta agia kat eniauton en aimati allotriw
draft_translation: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy places every year with another's blood;
ukjv_translation: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place every year with blood of others;

greek_text: επει εδει αυτον πολλακις παθειν απο καταβολης κοσμου νυν δε απαξ επι συντελεια των αιωνων εις αθετησιν αμαρτιας δια της θυσιας αυτου πεφανερωται
transliteration: epei edei auton pollakiv payein apo katabolhv kosmou nun de apax epi sunteleia twn aiwnwn eiv ayethsin amartiav dia thv yusiav autou pefanerwtai
draft_translation: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the completion of the age has he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
ukjv_translation: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world has he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

greek_text: και καθ οσον αποκειται τοις ανθρωποις απαξ αποθανειν μετα δε τουτο κρισις
transliteration: kai kay oson apokeitai toiv anyrwpoiv apax apoyanein meta de touto krisiv
draft_translation: And as it is appointed to men once to die, but after this the judgment:
ukjv_translation: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

greek_text: ουτως ο χριστος απαξ προσενεχθεις εις το πολλων ανενεγκειν αμαρτιας εκ δευτερου χωρις αμαρτιας οφθησεται τοις αυτον απεκδεχομενοις εις σωτηριαν
transliteration: outwv o cristov apax prosenecyeiv eiv to pollwn anenegkein amartiav ek deuterou cwriv amartiav ofyhsetai toiv auton apekdecomenoiv eiv swthrian
draft_translation: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and to those who look for him shall he appear the second time without sin to salvation.
ukjv_translation: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: σκιαν γαρ εχων ο νομος των μελλοντων αγαθων ουκ αυτην την εικονα των πραγματων κατ ενιαυτον ταις αυταις θυσιαις ας προσφερουσιν εις το διηνεκες ουδεποτε δυναται τους προσερχομενους τελειωσαι
transliteration: skian gar ecwn o nomov twn mellontwn agaywn ouk authn thn eikona twn pragmatwn kat eniauton taiv autaiv yusiaiv av prosferousin eiv to dihnekev oudepote dunatai touv prosercomenouv teleiwsai
draft_translation: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers to this perfect.
ukjv_translation: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

greek_text: επει ουκ αν επαυσαντο προσφερομεναι δια το μηδεμιαν εχειν ετι συνειδησιν αμαρτιων τους λατρευοντας απαξ κεκαθαρμενους
transliteration: epei ouk an epausanto prosferomenai dia to mhdemian ecein eti suneidhsin amartiwn touv latreuontav apax kekayarmenouv
draft_translation: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
ukjv_translation: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

greek_text: αλλ εν αυταις αναμνησις αμαρτιων κατ ενιαυτον
transliteration: all en autaiv anamnhsiv amartiwn kat eniauton
draft_translation: But in them there is a remembrance of sins every year.
ukjv_translation: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

greek_text: αδυνατον γαρ αιμα ταυρων και τραγων αφαιρειν αμαρτιας
transliteration: adunaton gar aima taurwn kai tragwn afairein amartiav
draft_translation: For it is impossible for blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
ukjv_translation: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

greek_text: διο εισερχομενος εις τον κοσμον λεγει θυσιαν και προσφοραν ουκ ηθελησας σωμα δε κατηρτισω μοι
transliteration: dio eisercomenov eiv ton kosmon legei yusian kai prosforan ouk hyelhsav swma de kathrtisw moi
draft_translation: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you would not, but a body have you prepared me:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you would not, but a body have you prepared me:

greek_text: ολοκαυτωματα και περι αμαρτιας ουκ ευδοκησας
transliteration: olokautwmata kai peri amartiav ouk eudokhsav
draft_translation: In burnt offerings and offerings for sin you had no pleasure.
ukjv_translation: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you have had no pleasure.

greek_text: τοτε ειπον ιδου ηκω εν κεφαλιδι βιβλιου γεγραπται περι εμου του ποιησαι ο θεος το θελημα σου
transliteration: tote eipon idou hkw en kefalidi bibliou gegraptai peri emou tou poihsai o yeov to yelhma sou
draft_translation: Then said I, Look, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do your will, O God.
ukjv_translation: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do your will, O God.

greek_text: ανωτερον λεγων οτι θυσιαν και προσφοραν και ολοκαυτωματα και περι αμαρτιας ουκ ηθελησας ουδε ευδοκησας αιτινες κατα τον νομον προσφερονται
transliteration: anwteron legwn oti yusian kai prosforan kai olokautwmata kai peri amartiav ouk hyelhsav oude eudokhsav aitinev kata ton nomon prosferontai
draft_translation: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin you would not, neither had pleasure in it; which are offered by the law;
ukjv_translation: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin you would not, neither had pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

greek_text: τοτε ειρηκεν ιδου ηκω του ποιησαι ο θεος το θελημα σου αναιρει το πρωτον ινα το δευτερον στηση
transliteration: tote eirhken idou hkw tou poihsai o yeov to yelhma sou anairei to prwton ina to deuteron sthsh
draft_translation: Then said he, Look, I come to do your will, O God. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second.
ukjv_translation: Then said he, Lo, I come to do your will, O God. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second.

greek_text: εν ω θεληματι ηγιασμενοι εσμεν δια της προσφορας του σωματος του ιησου χριστου εφαπαξ
transliteration: en w yelhmati hgiasmenoi esmen dia thv prosforav tou swmatov tou ihsou cristou efapax
draft_translation: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
ukjv_translation: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και πας μεν ιερευς εστηκεν καθ ημεραν λειτουργων και τας αυτας πολλακις προσφερων θυσιας αιτινες ουδεποτε δυνανται περιελειν αμαρτιας
transliteration: kai pav men iereuv esthken kay hmeran leitourgwn kai tav autav pollakiv prosferwn yusiav aitinev oudepote dunantai perielein amartiav
draft_translation: And every priest stands daily ministering and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
ukjv_translation: And every priest stands daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

greek_text: αυτος δε μιαν υπερ αμαρτιων προσενεγκας θυσιαν εις το διηνεκες εκαθισεν εν δεξια του θεου
transliteration: autov de mian uper amartiwn prosenegkav yusian eiv to dihnekev ekayisen en dexia tou yeou
draft_translation: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;
ukjv_translation: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

greek_text: το λοιπον εκδεχομενος εως τεθωσιν οι εχθροι αυτου υποποδιον των ποδων αυτου
transliteration: to loipon ekdecomenov ewv teywsin oi ecyroi autou upopodion twn podwn autou
draft_translation: From now on expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
ukjv_translation: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

greek_text: μια γαρ προσφορα τετελειωκεν εις το διηνεκες τους αγιαζομενους
transliteration: mia gar prosfora teteleiwken eiv to dihnekev touv agiazomenouv
draft_translation: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are sanctified.
ukjv_translation: For by one offering he has perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
review_notes: modernized forever spelling; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: μαρτυρει δε ημιν και το πνευμα το αγιον μετα γαρ το προειρηκεναι
transliteration: marturei de hmin kai to pneuma to agion meta gar to proeirhkenai
draft_translation: of which the Holy Spirit also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
ukjv_translation: Whereof the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
review_notes: modernized whereof; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αυτη η διαθηκη ην διαθησομαι προς αυτους μετα τας ημερας εκεινας λεγει κυριος διδους νομους μου επι καρδιας αυτων και επι των διανοιων αυτων επιγραψω αυτους
transliteration: auth h diayhkh hn diayhsomai prov autouv meta tav hmerav ekeinav legei kuriov didouv nomouv mou epi kardiav autwn kai epi twn dianoiwn autwn epigraqw autouv
draft_translation: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
ukjv_translation: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

greek_text: και των αμαρτιων αυτων και των ανομιων αυτων ου μη μνησθω ετι
transliteration: kai twn amartiwn autwn kai twn anomiwn autwn ou mh mnhsyw eti
draft_translation: And their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more.
ukjv_translation: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

greek_text: οπου δε αφεσις τουτων ουκετι προσφορα περι αμαρτιας
transliteration: opou de afesiv toutwn ouketi prosfora peri amartiav
draft_translation: Now where forgiveness of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
ukjv_translation: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

greek_text: εχοντες ουν αδελφοι παρρησιαν εις την εισοδον των αγιων εν τω αιματι ιησου
transliteration: econtev oun adelfoi parrhsian eiv thn eisodon twn agiwn en tw aimati ihsou
draft_translation: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
ukjv_translation: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

greek_text: ην ενεκαινισεν ημιν οδον προσφατον και ζωσαν δια του καταπετασματος τουτ εστιν της σαρκος αυτου
transliteration: hn enekainisen hmin odon prosfaton kai zwsan dia tou katapetasmatov tout estin thv sarkov autou
draft_translation: by a new and living way, which he inaugurated for us, through the veil, that is, his flesh;
ukjv_translation: By a new and living way, which he has consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

greek_text: και ιερεα μεγαν επι τον οικον του θεου
transliteration: kai ierea megan epi ton oikon tou yeou
draft_translation: And having a high priest over the house of God;
ukjv_translation: And having an high priest over the house of God;

greek_text: προσερχωμεθα μετα αληθινης καρδιας εν πληροφορια πιστεως ερραντισμενοι τας καρδιας απο συνειδησεως πονηρας και λελουμενοι το σωμα υδατι καθαρω
transliteration: prosercwmeya meta alhyinhv kardiav en plhroforia pistewv errantismenoi tav kardiav apo suneidhsewv ponhrav kai leloumenoi to swma udati kayarw
draft_translation: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our body washed with pure water.
ukjv_translation: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

greek_text: κατεχωμεν την ομολογιαν της ελπιδος ακλινη πιστος γαρ ο επαγγειλαμενος
transliteration: katecwmen thn omologian thv elpidov aklinh pistov gar o epaggeilamenov
draft_translation: Let us hold fast the confession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
ukjv_translation: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

greek_text: και κατανοωμεν αλληλους εις παροξυσμον αγαπης και καλων εργων
transliteration: kai katanowmen allhlouv eiv paroxusmon agaphv kai kalwn ergwn
draft_translation: And let us consider one another to provoke to love and to good works:
ukjv_translation: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love (o. agape) and to good works:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μη εγκαταλειποντες την επισυναγωγην εαυτων καθως εθος τισιν αλλα παρακαλουντες και τοσουτω μαλλον οσω βλεπετε εγγιζουσαν την ημεραν
transliteration: mh egkataleipontev thn episunagwghn eautwn kaywv eyov tisin alla parakalountev kai tosoutw mallon osw blepete eggizousan thn hmeran
draft_translation: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as you see the day approaching.
ukjv_translation: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as all of you see the day approaching.

greek_text: εκουσιως γαρ αμαρτανοντων ημων μετα το λαβειν την επιγνωσιν της αληθειας ουκετι περι αμαρτιων απολειπεται θυσια
transliteration: ekousiwv gar amartanontwn hmwn meta to labein thn epignwsin thv alhyeiav ouketi peri amartiwn apoleipetai yusia
draft_translation: For if we sin willingly after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,
ukjv_translation: For if we sin willfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,

greek_text: φοβερα δε τις εκδοχη κρισεως και πυρος ζηλος εσθιειν μελλοντος τους υπεναντιους
transliteration: fobera de tiv ekdoch krisewv kai purov zhlov esyiein mellontov touv upenantiouv
draft_translation: But a certain fearful expectation of judgment and fiery zeal, about to devour the adversaries.
ukjv_translation: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

greek_text: αθετησας τις νομον μωσεως χωρις οικτιρμων επι δυσιν η τρισιν μαρτυσιν αποθνησκει
transliteration: ayethsav tiv nomon mwsewv cwriv oiktirmwn epi dusin h trisin martusin apoynhskei
draft_translation: the one who despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
ukjv_translation: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

greek_text: ποσω δοκειτε χειρονος αξιωθησεται τιμωριας ο τον υιον του θεου καταπατησας και το αιμα της διαθηκης κοινον ηγησαμενος εν ω ηγιασθη και το πνευμα της χαριτος ενυβρισας
transliteration: posw dokeite ceironov axiwyhsetai timwriav o ton uion tou yeou katapathsav kai to aima thv diayhkhv koinon hghsamenov en w hgiasyh kai to pneuma thv caritov enubrisav
draft_translation: Of how much greater punishment, suppose you, shall he be thought worthy, who has trampled under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant, with which he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and has done despite to the Spirit of grace?
ukjv_translation: Of how much greater punishment, suppose all of you, shall he be thought worthy, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and has done despite unto the Spirit (o. pneuma) of grace?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized trodden; modernized wherewith; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οιδαμεν γαρ τον ειποντα εμοι εκδικησις εγω ανταποδωσω λεγει κυριος και παλιν κυριος κρινει τον λαον αυτου
transliteration: oidamen gar ton eiponta emoi ekdikhsiv egw antapodwsw legei kuriov kai palin kuriov krinei ton laon autou
draft_translation: For we know him who has said, Vengeance belongs to me, I will recompense, says the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
ukjv_translation: For we know him that has said, Vengeance belongs unto me, I will recompense, says the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: φοβερον το εμπεσειν εις χειρας θεου ζωντος
transliteration: foberon to empesein eiv ceirav yeou zwntov
draft_translation: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
ukjv_translation: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αναμιμνησκεσθε δε τας προτερον ημερας εν αις φωτισθεντες πολλην αθλησιν υπεμεινατε παθηματων
transliteration: anamimnhskesye de tav proteron hmerav en aiv fwtisyentev pollhn aylhsin upemeinate payhmatwn
draft_translation: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions;
ukjv_translation: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after all of you were illuminated, all of you endured a great fight of afflictions;

greek_text: τουτο μεν ονειδισμοις τε και θλιψεσιν θεατριζομενοι τουτο δε κοινωνοι των ουτως αναστρεφομενων γενηθεντες
transliteration: touto men oneidismoiv te kai yliqesin yeatrizomenoi touto de koinwnoi twn outwv anastrefomenwn genhyentev
draft_translation: Partly, while you were made a spectacle both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, while you became companions of those who were treated this way.
ukjv_translation: Partly, whilst all of you were made a gazing-stock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst all of you became companions of them that were so used.
review_notes: modernized so-used wording; modernized them-that relative; modernized whilst; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered theatrizo as spectacle

greek_text: και γαρ τοις δεσμοις μου συνεπαθησατε και την αρπαγην των υπαρχοντων υμων μετα χαρας προσεδεξασθε γινωσκοντες εχειν εν εαυτοις κρειττονα υπαρξιν εν ουρανοις και μενουσαν
transliteration: kai gar toiv desmoiv mou sunepayhsate kai thn arpaghn twn uparcontwn umwn meta carav prosedexasye ginwskontev ecein en eautoiv kreittona uparxin en ouranoiv kai menousan
draft_translation: For you had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
ukjv_translation: For all of you had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that all of you have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

greek_text: μη αποβαλητε ουν την παρρησιαν υμων ητις εχει μισθαποδοσιαν μεγαλην
transliteration: mh apobalhte oun thn parrhsian umwn htiv ecei misyapodosian megalhn
draft_translation: Do not cast away therefore your confidence, which has great recompense of reward.
ukjv_translation: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which has great recompence of reward.
review_notes: modernized recompence spelling; modernized residual verb-not wording

greek_text: υπομονης γαρ εχετε χρειαν ινα το θελημα του θεου ποιησαντες κομισησθε την επαγγελιαν
transliteration: upomonhv gar ecete creian ina to yelhma tou yeou poihsantev komishsye thn epaggelian
draft_translation: For you have need of patience, that, after you have done the will of God, you might receive the promise.
ukjv_translation: For all of you have need of patience, that, after all of you have done the will of God, all of you might receive the promise.

greek_text: ετι γαρ μικρον οσον οσον ο ερχομενος ηξει και ου χρονιει
transliteration: eti gar mikron oson oson o ercomenov hxei kai ou croniei
draft_translation: For yet a little while, and the one who shall come will come, and will not tarry.
ukjv_translation: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

greek_text: ο δε δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται και εαν υποστειληται ουκ ευδοκει η ψυχη μου εν αυτω
transliteration: o de dikaiov ek pistewv zhsetai kai ean uposteilhtai ouk eudokei h quch mou en autw
draft_translation: Now the just shall live by faith: but if anyone draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
ukjv_translation: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

greek_text: ημεις δε ουκ εσμεν υποστολης εις απωλειαν αλλα πιστεως εις περιποιησιν ψυχης
transliteration: hmeiv de ouk esmen upostolhv eiv apwleian alla pistewv eiv peripoihsin quchv
draft_translation: But we are not of them who draw back to destruction; but of those who believe to the saving of the soul.
ukjv_translation: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative; rendered apoleia as destruction

greek_text: εστιν δε πιστις ελπιζομενων υποστασις πραγματων ελεγχος ου βλεπομενων
transliteration: estin de pistiv elpizomenwn upostasiv pragmatwn elegcov ou blepomenwn
draft_translation: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
ukjv_translation: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εν ταυτη γαρ εμαρτυρηθησαν οι πρεσβυτεροι
transliteration: en tauth gar emarturhyhsan oi presbuteroi
draft_translation: For by it the elders obtained testimony.
ukjv_translation: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

greek_text: πιστει νοουμεν κατηρτισθαι τους αιωνας ρηματι θεου εις το μη εκ φαινομενων τα βλεπομενα γεγονεναι
transliteration: pistei nooumen kathrtisyai touv aiwnav rhmati yeou eiv to mh ek fainomenwn ta blepomena gegonenai
draft_translation: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
ukjv_translation: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word (o. rhema) of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: πιστει πλειονα θυσιαν αβελ παρα καιν προσηνεγκεν τω θεω δι ης εμαρτυρηθη ειναι δικαιος μαρτυρουντος επι τοις δωροις αυτου του θεου και δι αυτης αποθανων ετι λαλει
transliteration: pistei pleiona yusian abel para kain proshnegken tw yew di hv emarturhyh einai dikaiov marturountov epi toiv dwroiv autou tou yeou kai di authv apoyanwn eti lalei
draft_translation: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.
ukjv_translation: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.

greek_text: πιστει ενωχ μετετεθη του μη ιδειν θανατον και ουχ ευρισκετο διοτι μετεθηκεν αυτον ο θεος προ γαρ της μεταθεσεως αυτου μεμαρτυρηται ευηρεστηκεναι τω θεω
transliteration: pistei enwc meteteyh tou mh idein yanaton kai ouc eurisketo dioti meteyhken auton o yeov pro gar thv metayesewv autou memarturhtai euhresthkenai tw yew
draft_translation: By faith Enoch was translated so that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had testimony that he pleased God.
ukjv_translation: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

greek_text: χωρις δε πιστεως αδυνατον ευαρεστησαι πιστευσαι γαρ δει τον προσερχομενον τω θεω οτι εστιν και τοις εκζητουσιν αυτον μισθαποδοτης γινεται
transliteration: cwriv de pistewv adunaton euaresthsai pisteusai gar dei ton prosercomenon tw yew oti estin kai toiv ekzhtousin auton misyapodothv ginetai
draft_translation: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for the one who comes to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of those who diligently seek him.
ukjv_translation: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that comes to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: πιστει χρηματισθεις νωε περι των μηδεπω βλεπομενων ευλαβηθεις κατεσκευασεν κιβωτον εις σωτηριαν του οικου αυτου δι ης κατεκρινεν τον κοσμον και της κατα πιστιν δικαιοσυνης εγενετο κληρονομος
transliteration: pistei crhmatisyeiv nwe peri twn mhdepw blepomenwn eulabhyeiv kateskeuasen kibwton eiv swthrian tou oikou autou di hv katekrinen ton kosmon kai thv kata pistin dikaiosunhv egeneto klhronomov
draft_translation: By faith Noah, being warned of God concerning things not yet seen, moved with fear, prepared an ark for the salvation of his house; through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
ukjv_translation: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

greek_text: πιστει καλουμενος αβρααμ υπηκουσεν εξελθειν εις τον τοπον ον ημελλεν λαμβανειν εις κληρονομιαν και εξηλθεν μη επισταμενος που ερχεται
transliteration: pistei kaloumenov abraam uphkousen exelyein eiv ton topon on hmellen lambanein eiv klhronomian kai exhlyen mh epistamenov pou ercetai
draft_translation: By faith Abraham, when called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was about to receive for an inheritance; and he went out, not knowing where he was going.
ukjv_translation: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing where he went.

greek_text: πιστει παρωκησεν εις την γην της επαγγελιας ως αλλοτριαν εν σκηναις κατοικησας μετα ισαακ και ιακωβ των συγκληρονομων της επαγγελιας της αυτης
transliteration: pistei parwkhsen eiv thn ghn thv epaggeliav wv allotrian en skhnaiv katoikhsav meta isaak kai iakwb twn sugklhronomwn thv epaggeliav thv authv
draft_translation: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a foreign land, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, co-heirs of the same promise:
ukjv_translation: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

greek_text: εξεδεχετο γαρ την τους θεμελιους εχουσαν πολιν ης τεχνιτης και δημιουργος ο θεος
transliteration: exedeceto gar thn touv yemeliouv ecousan polin hv tecnithv kai dhmiourgov o yeov
draft_translation: For he waited for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
ukjv_translation: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

greek_text: πιστει και αυτη σαρρα δυναμιν εις καταβολην σπερματος ελαβεν και παρα καιρον ηλικιας ετεκεν επει πιστον ηγησατο τον επαγγειλαμενον
transliteration: pistei kai auth sarra dunamin eiv katabolhn spermatov elaben kai para kairon hlikiav eteken epei piston hghsato ton epaggeilamenon
draft_translation: Through faith also Sarah herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
ukjv_translation: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

greek_text: διο και αφ ενος εγεννηθησαν και ταυτα νενεκρωμενου καθως τα αστρα του ουρανου τω πληθει και ωσει αμμος η παρα το χειλος της θαλασσης η αναριθμητος
transliteration: dio kai af enov egennhyhsan kai tauta nenekrwmenou kaywv ta astra tou ouranou tw plhyei kai wsei ammov h para to ceilov thv yalasshv h anariymhtov
draft_translation: Therefore also from one, and him as good as dead, were begotten as many as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the sand which is by the seashore innumerable.
ukjv_translation: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

greek_text: κατα πιστιν απεθανον ουτοι παντες μη λαβοντες τας επαγγελιας αλλα πορρωθεν αυτας ιδοντες και πεισθεντες και ασπασαμενοι και ομολογησαντες οτι ξενοι και παρεπιδημοι εισιν επι της γης
transliteration: kata pistin apeyanon outoi pantev mh labontev tav epaggeliav alla porrwyen autav idontev kai peisyentev kai aspasamenoi kai omologhsantev oti xenoi kai parepidhmoi eisin epi thv ghv
draft_translation: These all died according to faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and been persuaded, and greeted them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
ukjv_translation: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them far off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

greek_text: οι γαρ τοιαυτα λεγοντες εμφανιζουσιν οτι πατριδα επιζητουσιν
transliteration: oi gar toiauta legontev emfanizousin oti patrida epizhtousin
draft_translation: For those who say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
ukjv_translation: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

greek_text: και ει μεν εκεινης εμνημονευον αφ ης εξηλθον ειχον αν καιρον ανακαμψαι
transliteration: kai ei men ekeinhv emnhmoneuon af hv exhlyon eicon an kairon anakamqai
draft_translation: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from where they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
ukjv_translation: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

greek_text: νυνι δε κρειττονος ορεγονται τουτ εστιν επουρανιου διο ουκ επαισχυνεται αυτους ο θεος θεος επικαλεισθαι αυτων ητοιμασεν γαρ αυτοις πολιν
transliteration: nuni de kreittonov oregontai tout estin epouraniou dio ouk epaiscunetai autouv o yeov yeov epikaleisyai autwn htoimasen gar autoiv polin
draft_translation: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly: therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he has prepared for them a city.
ukjv_translation: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he has prepared for them a city.
review_notes: modernized article before h-word; modernized wherefore

greek_text: πιστει προσενηνοχεν αβρααμ τον ισαακ πειραζομενος και τον μονογενη προσεφερεν ο τας επαγγελιας αναδεξαμενος
transliteration: pistei prosenhnocen abraam ton isaak peirazomenov kai ton monogenh proseferen o tav epaggeliav anadexamenov
draft_translation: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and the one who had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
ukjv_translation: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

greek_text: προς ον ελαληθη οτι εν ισαακ κληθησεται σοι σπερμα
transliteration: prov on elalhyh oti en isaak klhyhsetai soi sperma
draft_translation: to whom it was said, In Isaac shall your seed be called:
ukjv_translation: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall your seed be called:

greek_text: λογισαμενος οτι και εκ νεκρων εγειρειν δυνατος ο θεος οθεν αυτον και εν παραβολη εκομισατο
transliteration: logisamenov oti kai ek nekrwn egeirein dunatov o yeov oyen auton kai en parabolh ekomisato
draft_translation: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from where also he received him in a figure.
ukjv_translation: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

greek_text: πιστει περι μελλοντων ευλογησεν ισαακ τον ιακωβ και τον ησαυ
transliteration: pistei peri mellontwn euloghsen isaak ton iakwb kai ton hsau
draft_translation: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
ukjv_translation: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: πιστει ιακωβ αποθνησκων εκαστον των υιων ιωσηφ ευλογησεν και προσεκυνησεν επι το ακρον της ραβδου αυτου
transliteration: pistei iakwb apoynhskwn ekaston twn uiwn iwshf euloghsen kai prosekunhsen epi to akron thv rabdou autou
draft_translation: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshiped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
ukjv_translation: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

greek_text: πιστει ιωσηφ τελευτων περι της εξοδου των υιων ισραηλ εμνημονευσεν και περι των οστεων αυτου ενετειλατο
transliteration: pistei iwshf teleutwn peri thv exodou twn uiwn israhl emnhmoneusen kai peri twn ostewn autou eneteilato
draft_translation: By faith Joseph, when dying, made mention concerning the exodus of the children of Israel; and gave command concerning his bones.
ukjv_translation: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

greek_text: πιστει μωσης γεννηθεις εκρυβη τριμηνον υπο των πατερων αυτου διοτι ειδον αστειον το παιδιον και ουκ εφοβηθησαν το διαταγμα του βασιλεως
transliteration: pistei mwshv gennhyeiv ekrubh trimhnon upo twn paterwn autou dioti eidon asteion to paidion kai ouk efobhyhsan to diatagma tou basilewv
draft_translation: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king's decree.
ukjv_translation: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

greek_text: πιστει μωσης μεγας γενομενος ηρνησατο λεγεσθαι υιος θυγατρος φαραω
transliteration: pistei mwshv megav genomenov hrnhsato legesyai uiov yugatrov faraw
draft_translation: By faith Moses, when he had come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
ukjv_translation: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

greek_text: μαλλον ελομενος συγκακουχεισθαι τω λαω του θεου η προσκαιρον εχειν αμαρτιας απολαυσιν
transliteration: mallon elomenov sugkakouceisyai tw law tou yeou h proskairon ecein amartiav apolausin
draft_translation: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to have temporary enjoyment of sin;
ukjv_translation: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

greek_text: μειζονα πλουτον ηγησαμενος των εν αιγυπτω θησαυρων τον ονειδισμον του χριστου απεβλεπεν γαρ εις την μισθαποδοσιαν
transliteration: meizona plouton hghsamenov twn en aiguptw yhsaurwn ton oneidismon tou cristou apeblepen gar eiv thn misyapodosian
draft_translation: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect to the recompense of the reward.
ukjv_translation: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized recompence spelling

greek_text: πιστει κατελιπεν αιγυπτον μη φοβηθεις τον θυμον του βασιλεως τον γαρ αορατον ως ορων εκαρτερησεν
transliteration: pistei katelipen aigupton mh fobhyeiv ton yumon tou basilewv ton gar aoraton wv orwn ekarterhsen
draft_translation: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
ukjv_translation: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

greek_text: πιστει πεποιηκεν το πασχα και την προσχυσιν του αιματος ινα μη ο ολοθρευων τα πρωτοτοκα θιγη αυτων
transliteration: pistei pepoihken to pasca kai thn proscusin tou aimatov ina mh o oloyreuwn ta prwtotoka yigh autwn
draft_translation: Through faith he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest the one who destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
ukjv_translation: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

greek_text: πιστει διεβησαν την ερυθραν θαλασσαν ως δια ξηρας ης πειραν λαβοντες οι αιγυπτιοι κατεποθησαν
transliteration: pistei diebhsan thn eruyran yalassan wv dia xhrav hv peiran labontev oi aiguptioi katepoyhsan
draft_translation: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as through dry land: which the Egyptians, attempting, were swallowed.
ukjv_translation: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

greek_text: πιστει τα τειχη ιεριχω επεσεν κυκλωθεντα επι επτα ημερας
transliteration: pistei ta teich iericw epesen kuklwyenta epi epta hmerav
draft_translation: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, having been encircled for seven days.
ukjv_translation: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

greek_text: πιστει ρααβ η πορνη ου συναπωλετο τοις απειθησασιν δεξαμενη τους κατασκοπους μετ ειρηνης
transliteration: pistei raab h pornh ou sunapwleto toiv apeiyhsasin dexamenh touv kataskopouv met eirhnhv
draft_translation: By faith the prostitute Rahab did not perish with those who did not believe, when she had received the spies with peace.
ukjv_translation: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
review_notes: modernized believed-not wording; modernized perished-not wording; modernized porne wording; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και τι ετι λεγω επιλειψει γαρ με διηγουμενον ο χρονος περι γεδεων βαρακ τε και σαμψων και ιεφθαε δαβιδ τε και σαμουηλ και των προφητων
transliteration: kai ti eti legw epileiqei gar me dihgoumenon o cronov peri gedewn barak te kai samqwn kai iefyae dabid te kai samouhl kai twn profhtwn
draft_translation: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gideon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthah; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
ukjv_translation: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

greek_text: οι δια πιστεως κατηγωνισαντο βασιλειας ειργασαντο δικαιοσυνην επετυχον επαγγελιων εφραξαν στοματα λεοντων
transliteration: oi dia pistewv kathgwnisanto basileiav eirgasanto dikaiosunhn epetucon epaggeliwn efraxan stomata leontwn
draft_translation: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.
ukjv_translation: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.

greek_text: εσβεσαν δυναμιν πυρος εφυγον στοματα μαχαιρας ενεδυναμωθησαν απο ασθενειας εγενηθησαν ισχυροι εν πολεμω παρεμβολας εκλιναν αλλοτριων
transliteration: esbesan dunamin purov efugon stomata macairav enedunamwyhsan apo asyeneiav egenhyhsan iscuroi en polemw parembolav eklinan allotriwn
draft_translation: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
ukjv_translation: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

greek_text: ελαβον γυναικες εξ αναστασεως τους νεκρους αυτων αλλοι δε ετυμπανισθησαν ου προσδεξαμενοι την απολυτρωσιν ινα κρειττονος αναστασεως τυχωσιν
transliteration: elabon gunaikev ex anastasewv touv nekrouv autwn alloi de etumpanisyhsan ou prosdexamenoi thn apolutrwsin ina kreittonov anastasewv tucwsin
draft_translation: Women received their dead by resurrection: and others were tortured, not accepting release; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
ukjv_translation: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

greek_text: ετεροι δε εμπαιγμων και μαστιγων πειραν ελαβον ετι δε δεσμων και φυλακης
transliteration: eteroi de empaigmwn kai mastigwn peiran elabon eti de desmwn kai fulakhv
draft_translation: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yes, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
ukjv_translation: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

greek_text: ελιθασθησαν επρισθησαν επειρασθησαν εν φονω μαχαιρας απεθανον περιηλθον εν μηλωταις εν αιγειοις δερμασιν υστερουμενοι θλιβομενοι κακουχουμενοι
transliteration: eliyasyhsan eprisyhsan epeirasyhsan en fonw macairav apeyanon perihlyon en mhlwtaiv en aigeioiv dermasin usteroumenoi ylibomenoi kakoucoumenoi
draft_translation: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were killed with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
ukjv_translation: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

greek_text: ων ουκ ην αξιος ο κοσμος εν ερημιαις πλανωμενοι και ορεσιν και σπηλαιοις και ταις οπαις της γης
transliteration: wn ouk hn axiov o kosmov en erhmiaiv planwmenoi kai oresin kai sphlaioiv kai taiv opaiv thv ghv
draft_translation: of whom the world was not worthy, wandering in deserts, and mountains, and caves, and holes of the earth.
ukjv_translation: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

greek_text: και ουτοι παντες μαρτυρηθεντες δια της πιστεως ουκ εκομισαντο την επαγγελιαν
transliteration: kai outoi pantev marturhyentev dia thv pistewv ouk ekomisanto thn epaggelian
draft_translation: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, did not receive the promise:
ukjv_translation: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

greek_text: του θεου περι ημων κρειττον τι προβλεψαμενου ινα μη χωρις ημων τελειωθωσιν
transliteration: tou yeou peri hmwn kreitton ti probleqamenou ina mh cwriv hmwn teleiwywsin
draft_translation: God having provided something better concerning us, that they should not be made perfect without us.
ukjv_translation: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

greek_text: τοιγαρουν και ημεις τοσουτον εχοντες περικειμενον ημιν νεφος μαρτυρων ογκον αποθεμενοι παντα και την ευπεριστατον αμαρτιαν δι υπομονης τρεχωμεν τον προκειμενον ημιν αγωνα
transliteration: toigaroun kai hmeiv tosouton econtev perikeimenon hmin nefov marturwn ogkon apoyemenoi panta kai thn euperistaton amartian di upomonhv trecwmen ton prokeimenon hmin agwna
draft_translation: Therefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which does so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
ukjv_translation: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which does so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

greek_text: αφορωντες εις τον της πιστεως αρχηγον και τελειωτην ιησουν ος αντι της προκειμενης αυτω χαρας υπεμεινεν σταυρον αισχυνης καταφρονησας εν δεξια τε του θρονου του θεου εκαθισεν
transliteration: aforwntev eiv ton thv pistewv archgon kai teleiwthn ihsoun ov anti thv prokeimenhv autw carav upemeinen stauron aiscunhv katafronhsav en dexia te tou yronou tou yeou ekayisen
draft_translation: Looking to Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
ukjv_translation: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

greek_text: αναλογισασθε γαρ τον τοιαυτην υπομεμενηκοτα υπο των αμαρτωλων εις αυτον αντιλογιαν ινα μη καμητε ταις ψυχαις υμων εκλυομενοι
transliteration: analogisasye gar ton toiauthn upomemenhkota upo twn amartwlwn eiv auton antilogian ina mh kamhte taiv qucaiv umwn ekluomenoi
draft_translation: For consider him who endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest you be wearied and faint in your minds.
ukjv_translation: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest all of you be wearied and faint in your minds.
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουπω μεχρις αιματος αντικατεστητε προς την αμαρτιαν ανταγωνιζομενοι
transliteration: oupw mecriv aimatov antikatesthte prov thn amartian antagwnizomenoi
draft_translation: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
ukjv_translation: All of you have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και εκλελησθε της παρακλησεως ητις υμιν ως υιοις διαλεγεται υιε μου μη ολιγωρει παιδειας κυριου μηδε εκλυου υπ αυτου ελεγχομενος
transliteration: kai eklelhsye thv paraklhsewv htiv umin wv uioiv dialegetai uie mou mh oligwrei paideiav kuriou mhde ekluou up autou elegcomenov
draft_translation: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to children, My son, despise not you the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked of him:
ukjv_translation: And all of you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks unto you as unto children, My son, despise not you the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked of him:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ον γαρ αγαπα κυριος παιδευει μαστιγοι δε παντα υιον ον παραδεχεται
transliteration: on gar agapa kuriov paideuei mastigoi de panta uion on paradecetai
draft_translation: For whom the Lord loves he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.
ukjv_translation: For whom the Lord loves he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.

greek_text: ει παιδειαν υπομενετε ως υιοις υμιν προσφερεται ο θεος τις γαρ εστιν υιος ον ου παιδευει πατηρ
transliteration: ei paideian upomenete wv uioiv umin prosferetai o yeov tiv gar estin uiov on ou paideuei pathr
draft_translation: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chastens not?
ukjv_translation: If all of you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chastens not?

greek_text: ει δε χωρις εστε παιδειας ης μετοχοι γεγονασιν παντες αρα νοθοι εστε και ουχ υιοι
transliteration: ei de cwriv este paideiav hv metocoi gegonasin pantev ara noyoi este kai ouc uioi
draft_translation: But if you be without chastisement, of which all are partakers, then are you bastards, and not sons.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are all of you bastards, and not sons.
review_notes: modernized whereof; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ειτα τους μεν της σαρκος ημων πατερας ειχομεν παιδευτας και ενετρεπομεθα ου πολλω μαλλον υποταγησομεθα τω πατρι των πνευματων και ζησομεν
transliteration: eita touv men thv sarkov hmwn paterav eicomen paideutav kai enetrepomeya ou pollw mallon upotaghsomeya tw patri twn pneumatwn kai zhsomen
draft_translation: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
ukjv_translation: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, (o. pneuma) and live?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οι μεν γαρ προς ολιγας ημερας κατα το δοκουν αυτοις επαιδευον ο δε επι το συμφερον εις το μεταλαβειν της αγιοτητος αυτου
transliteration: oi men gar prov oligav hmerav kata to dokoun autoiv epaideuon o de epi to sumferon eiv to metalabein thv agiothtov autou
draft_translation: For they truly for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
ukjv_translation: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

greek_text: πασα δε παιδεια προς μεν το παρον ου δοκει χαρας ειναι αλλα λυπης υστερον δε καρπον ειρηνικον τοις δι αυτης γεγυμνασμενοις αποδιδωσιν δικαιοσυνης
transliteration: pasa de paideia prov men to paron ou dokei carav einai alla luphv usteron de karpon eirhnikon toiv di authv gegumnasmenoiv apodidwsin dikaiosunhv
draft_translation: Now no chastening for the present seems to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those who are exercised by it.
ukjv_translation: Now no chastening for the present seems to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-which relative; modernized thereby

greek_text: διο τας παρειμενας χειρας και τα παραλελυμενα γονατα ανορθωσατε
transliteration: dio tav pareimenav ceirav kai ta paralelumena gonata anorywsate
draft_translation: Therefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
ukjv_translation: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

greek_text: και τροχιας ορθας ποιησατε τοις ποσιν υμων ινα μη το χωλον εκτραπη ιαθη δε μαλλον
transliteration: kai trociav oryav poihsate toiv posin umwn ina mh to cwlon ektraph iayh de mallon
draft_translation: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
ukjv_translation: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειρηνην διωκετε μετα παντων και τον αγιασμον ου χωρις ουδεις οψεται τον κυριον
transliteration: eirhnhn diwkete meta pantwn kai ton agiasmon ou cwriv oudeiv oqetai ton kurion
draft_translation: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no one shall see the Lord:
ukjv_translation: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
review_notes: modernized no-man idiom; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: επισκοπουντες μη τις υστερων απο της χαριτος του θεου μη τις ριζα πικριας ανω φυουσα ενοχλη και δια ταυτης μιανθωσιν πολλοι
transliteration: episkopountev mh tiv usterwn apo thv caritov tou yeou mh tiv riza pikriav anw fuousa enoclh kai dia tauthv mianywsin polloi
draft_translation: Looking diligently lest anyone fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and by it many be defiled;
ukjv_translation: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

greek_text: μη τις πορνος η βεβηλος ως ησαυ ος αντι βρωσεως μιας απεδοτο τα πρωτοτοκια αυτου
transliteration: mh tiv pornov h bebhlov wv hsau ov anti brwsewv miav apedoto ta prwtotokia autou
draft_translation: lest anyone is sexually immoral, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.
ukjv_translation: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.

greek_text: ιστε γαρ οτι και μετεπειτα θελων κληρονομησαι την ευλογιαν απεδοκιμασθη μετανοιας γαρ τοπον ουχ ευρεν καιπερ μετα δακρυων εκζητησας αυτην
transliteration: iste gar oti kai metepeita yelwn klhronomhsai thn eulogian apedokimasyh metanoiav gar topon ouc euren kaiper meta dakruwn ekzhthsav authn
draft_translation: For you know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
ukjv_translation: For all of you know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

greek_text: ου γαρ προσεληλυθατε ψηλαφωμενω ορει και κεκαυμενω πυρι και γνοφω και σκοτω και θυελλη
transliteration: ou gar proselhluyate qhlafwmenw orei kai kekaumenw puri kai gnofw kai skotw kai yuellh
draft_translation: For you are not come to the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor to blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
ukjv_translation: For all of you are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και σαλπιγγος ηχω και φωνη ρηματων ης οι ακουσαντες παρητησαντο μη προστεθηναι αυτοις λογον
transliteration: kai salpiggov hcw kai fwnh rhmatwn hv oi akousantev parhthsanto mh prosteyhnai autoiv logon
draft_translation: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice those who heard implored that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
ukjv_translation: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; (o. rhema) which voice they that heard implored that the word (o. logos) should not be spoken to them any more:
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ουκ εφερον γαρ το διαστελλομενον καν θηριον θιγη του ορους λιθοβοληθησεται η βολιδι κατατοξευθησεται
transliteration: ouk eferon gar to diastellomenon kan yhrion yigh tou orouv liyobolhyhsetai h bolidi katatoxeuyhsetai
draft_translation: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
ukjv_translation: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ουτως φοβερον ην το φανταζομενον μωσης ειπεν εκφοβος ειμι και εντρομος
transliteration: kai outwv foberon hn to fantazomenon mwshv eipen ekfobov eimi kai entromov
draft_translation: And so fearful was the appearance that Moses said, I am terrified and trembling:)
ukjv_translation: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

greek_text: αλλα προσεληλυθατε σιων ορει και πολει θεου ζωντος ιερουσαλημ επουρανιω και μυριασιν αγγελων
transliteration: alla proselhluyate siwn orei kai polei yeou zwntov ierousalhm epouraniw kai muriasin aggelwn
draft_translation: But you have come to mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
ukjv_translation: But all of you are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized are-come perfect; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; standardized NT proper-name English equivalent

greek_text: πανηγυρει και εκκλησια πρωτοτοκων εν ουρανοις απογεγραμμενων και κριτη θεω παντων και πνευμασιν δικαιων τετελειωμενων
transliteration: panhgurei kai ekklhsia prwtotokwn en ouranoiv apogegrammenwn kai krith yew pantwn kai pneumasin dikaiwn teteleiwmenwn
draft_translation: To the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
ukjv_translation: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits (o. pneuma) of just men made perfect,
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered ekklesia as assembly

greek_text: και διαθηκης νεας μεσιτη ιησου και αιματι ραντισμου κρειττονα λαλουντι παρα το αβελ
transliteration: kai diayhkhv neav mesith ihsou kai aimati rantismou kreittona lalounti para to abel
draft_translation: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaks better things than that of Abel.
ukjv_translation: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaks better things that that of Abel.

greek_text: βλεπετε μη παραιτησησθε τον λαλουντα ει γαρ εκεινοι ουκ εφυγον τον επι της γης παραιτησαμενοι χρηματιζοντα πολλω μαλλον ημεις οι τον απ ουρανων αποστρεφομενοι
transliteration: blepete mh paraithshsye ton lalounta ei gar ekeinoi ouk efugon ton epi thv ghv paraithsamenoi crhmatizonta pollw mallon hmeiv oi ton ap ouranwn apostrefomenoi
draft_translation: See that you do not refuse him who speaks. For if they did not escape who refused him who spoke on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him who speaks from heaven:
ukjv_translation: See that all of you refuse not him that speaks. For if they escaped not who refused him that spoke on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaks from heaven:
review_notes: modernized him-that relative; modernized residual verb-not wording; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ου η φωνη την γην εσαλευσεν τοτε νυν δε επηγγελται λεγων ετι απαξ εγω σειω ου μονον την γην αλλα και τον ουρανον
transliteration: ou h fwnh thn ghn esaleusen tote nun de ephggeltai legwn eti apax egw seiw ou monon thn ghn alla kai ton ouranon
draft_translation: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
ukjv_translation: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: το δε ετι απαξ δηλοι των σαλευομενων την μεταθεσιν ως πεποιημενων ινα μεινη τα μη σαλευομενα
transliteration: to de eti apax dhloi twn saleuomenwn thn metayesin wv pepoihmenwn ina meinh ta mh saleuomena
draft_translation: And this, Yet once more, signifies the removal of the things being shaken, as of things made, that the things not being shaken may remain.
ukjv_translation: And this word, Yet once more, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

greek_text: διο βασιλειαν ασαλευτον παραλαμβανοντες εχωμεν χαριν δι ης λατρευωμεν ευαρεστως τω θεω μετα αιδους και ευλαβειας
transliteration: dio basileian asaleuton paralambanontev ecwmen carin di hv latreuwmen euarestwv tw yew meta aidouv kai eulabeiav
draft_translation: Therefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
ukjv_translation: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

greek_text: και γαρ ο θεος ημων πυρ καταναλισκον
transliteration: kai gar o yeov hmwn pur katanaliskon
draft_translation: For our God is a consuming fire.
ukjv_translation: For our God is a consuming fire.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: η φιλαδελφια μενετω
transliteration: h filadelfia menetw
draft_translation: Let brotherly love continue.
ukjv_translation: Let brotherly love continue.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: της φιλοξενιας μη επιλανθανεσθε δια ταυτης γαρ ελαθον τινες ξενισαντες αγγελους
transliteration: thv filoxeniav mh epilanyanesye dia tauthv gar elayon tinev xenisantev aggelouv
draft_translation: Do not be forgetful to entertain strangers: for by it some have entertained angels unexpectedly.
ukjv_translation: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unexpectedly.

greek_text: μιμνησκεσθε των δεσμιων ως συνδεδεμενοι των κακουχουμενων ως και αυτοι οντες εν σωματι

draft_translation: But I more earnestly plead that you do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

greek_text: γινεσθε δε ποιηται λογου και μη μονον ακροαται παραλογιζομενοι εαυτους
