draft_translation: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
ukjv_translation: But be all of you doers of the word, (o. logos) and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
review_notes: modernized be-you imperative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: οτι ει τις ακροατης λογου εστιν και ου ποιητης ουτος εοικεν ανδρι κατανοουντι το προσωπον της γενεσεως αυτου εν εσοπτρω
transliteration: oti ei tiv akroathv logou estin kai ou poihthv outov eoiken andri katanoounti to proswpon thv genesewv autou en esoptrw
draft_translation: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like to a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
ukjv_translation: For if any be a hearer of the word, (o. logos) and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: κατενοησεν γαρ εαυτον και απεληλυθεν και ευθεως επελαθετο οποιος ην
transliteration: katenohsen gar eauton kai apelhluyen kai euyewv epelayeto opoiov hn
draft_translation: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and immediately forgets what manner of man he was.
ukjv_translation: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and immediately forgets what manner of man he was.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ο δε παρακυψας εις νομον τελειον τον της ελευθεριας και παραμεινας ουτος ουκ ακροατης επιλησμονης γενομενος αλλα ποιητης εργου ουτος μακαριος εν τη ποιησει αυτου εσται
transliteration: o de parakuqav eiv nomon teleion ton thv eleuyeriav kai parameinav outov ouk akroathv epilhsmonhv genomenov alla poihthv ergou outov makariov en th poihsei autou estai
draft_translation: But whoever looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues in it, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
ukjv_translation: But whoso looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

greek_text: ει τις δοκει θρησκος ειναι εν υμιν μη χαλιναγωγων γλωσσαν αυτου αλλ απατων καρδιαν αυτου τουτου ματαιος η θρησκεια
transliteration: ei tiv dokei yrhskov einai en umin mh calinagwgwn glwssan autou all apatwn kardian autou toutou mataiov h yrhskeia
draft_translation: If anyone among you seem to be religious, and bridles not his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
ukjv_translation: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridles not his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

greek_text: θρησκεια καθαρα και αμιαντος παρα τω θεω και πατρι αυτη εστιν επισκεπτεσθαι ορφανους και χηρας εν τη θλιψει αυτων ασπιλον εαυτον τηρειν απο του κοσμου
transliteration: yrhskeia kayara kai amiantov para tw yew kai patri auth estin episkeptesyai orfanouv kai chrav en th yliqei autwn aspilon eauton threin apo tou kosmou
draft_translation: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
ukjv_translation: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αδελφοι μου μη εν προσωποληψιαις εχετε την πιστιν του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου της δοξης
transliteration: adelfoi mou mh en proswpolhqiaiv ecete thn pistin tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou thv doxhv
draft_translation: My brothers, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
ukjv_translation: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
review_notes: normalized NT kurios as Lord; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: εαν γαρ εισελθη εις την συναγωγην υμων ανηρ χρυσοδακτυλιος εν εσθητι λαμπρα εισελθη δε και πτωχος εν ρυπαρα εσθητι
transliteration: ean gar eiselyh eiv thn sunagwghn umwn anhr crusodaktuliov en esyhti lampra eiselyh de kai ptwcov en rupara esyhti
draft_translation: For if there come to your assembly a man with a gold ring, in bright clothing, and there come in also a poor man in filthy clothing;
ukjv_translation: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized raiment; rendered lampros as bright; rendered rhyparos as filthy

greek_text: και επιβλεψητε επι τον φορουντα την εσθητα την λαμπραν και ειπητε αυτω συ καθου ωδε καλως και τω πτωχω ειπητε συ στηθι εκει η καθου ωδε υπο το υποποδιον μου
transliteration: kai epibleqhte epi ton forounta thn esyhta thn lampran kai eiphte autw su kayou wde kalwv kai tw ptwcw eiphte su sthyi ekei h kayou wde upo to upopodion mou
draft_translation: And you have respect to him who wears the cheerful clothing, and say to him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:
ukjv_translation: And all of you have respect to him that wears the cheerful clothing, and say unto him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και ου διεκριθητε εν εαυτοις και εγενεσθε κριται διαλογισμων πονηρων
transliteration: kai ou diekriyhte en eautoiv kai egenesye kritai dialogismwn ponhrwn
draft_translation: Are you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
ukjv_translation: Are all of you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

greek_text: ακουσατε αδελφοι μου αγαπητοι ουχ ο θεος εξελεξατο τους πτωχους του κοσμου τουτου πλουσιους εν πιστει και κληρονομους της βασιλειας ης επηγγειλατο τοις αγαπωσιν αυτον
transliteration: akousate adelfoi mou agaphtoi ouc o yeov exelexato touv ptwcouv tou kosmou toutou plousiouv en pistei kai klhronomouv thv basileiav hv ephggeilato toiv agapwsin auton
draft_translation: Listen, my beloved brothers, has not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to those who love him?
ukjv_translation: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Has not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to them that love him?
review_notes: fixed question casing; modernized hearken; modernized them-that relative; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: υμεις δε ητιμασατε τον πτωχον ουχ οι πλουσιοι καταδυναστευουσιν υμων και αυτοι ελκουσιν υμας εις κριτηρια
transliteration: umeiv de htimasate ton ptwcon ouc oi plousioi katadunasteuousin umwn kai autoi elkousin umav eiv krithria
draft_translation: But you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
ukjv_translation: But all of you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

greek_text: ουκ αυτοι βλασφημουσιν το καλον ονομα το επικληθεν εφ υμας
transliteration: ouk autoi blasfhmousin to kalon onoma to epiklhyen ef umav
draft_translation: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which you are called?
ukjv_translation: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which all of you are called?

greek_text: ει μεντοι νομον τελειτε βασιλικον κατα την γραφην αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον καλως ποιειτε
transliteration: ei mentoi nomon teleite basilikon kata thn grafhn agaphseiv ton plhsion sou wv seauton kalwv poieite
draft_translation: If you fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbor as yourself, you do well:
ukjv_translation: If all of you fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbour as yourself, all of you do well:
review_notes: modernized neighbour spelling; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ει δε προσωποληπτειτε αμαρτιαν εργαζεσθε ελεγχομενοι υπο του νομου ως παραβαται
transliteration: ei de proswpolhpteite amartian ergazesye elegcomenoi upo tou nomou wv parabatai
draft_translation: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
ukjv_translation: But if all of you have respect to persons, all of you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

greek_text: οστις γαρ ολον τον νομον τηρησει πταισει δε εν ενι γεγονεν παντων ενοχος
transliteration: ostiv gar olon ton nomon thrhsei ptaisei de en eni gegonen pantwn enocov
draft_translation: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
ukjv_translation: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

greek_text: ο γαρ ειπων μη μοιχευσης ειπεν και μη φονευσης ει δε ου μοιχευσεις φονευσεις δε γεγονας παραβατης νομου
transliteration: o gar eipwn mh moiceushv eipen kai mh foneushv ei de ou moiceuseiv foneuseiv de gegonav parabathv nomou
draft_translation: For the one who said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.
ukjv_translation: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.

greek_text: ουτως λαλειτε και ουτως ποιειτε ως δια νομου ελευθεριας μελλοντες κρινεσθαι
transliteration: outwv laleite kai outwv poieite wv dia nomou eleuyeriav mellontev krinesyai
draft_translation: So speak you, and so do, as those who shall be judged by the law of liberty.
ukjv_translation: So speak all of you, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
review_notes: modernized they-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: η γαρ κρισις ανιλεως τω μη ποιησαντι ελεος και κατακαυχαται ελεος κρισεως
transliteration: h gar krisiv anilewv tw mh poihsanti eleov kai katakaucatai eleov krisewv
draft_translation: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has showed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.
ukjv_translation: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has showed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: τι το οφελος αδελφοι μου εαν πιστιν λεγη τις εχειν εργα δε μη εχη μη δυναται η πιστις σωσαι αυτον
transliteration: ti to ofelov adelfoi mou ean pistin legh tiv ecein erga de mh ech mh dunatai h pistiv swsai auton
draft_translation: What does it profit, my brothers, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
ukjv_translation: What does it profit, my brethren, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

greek_text: εαν δε αδελφος η αδελφη γυμνοι υπαρχωσιν και λειπομενοι ωσιν της εφημερου τροφης
transliteration: ean de adelfov h adelfh gumnoi uparcwsin kai leipomenoi wsin thv efhmerou trofhv
draft_translation: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
ukjv_translation: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ειπη δε τις αυτοις εξ υμων υπαγετε εν ειρηνη θερμαινεσθε και χορταζεσθε μη δωτε δε αυτοις τα επιτηδεια του σωματος τι το οφελος
transliteration: eiph de tiv autoiv ex umwn upagete en eirhnh yermainesye kai cortazesye mh dwte de autoiv ta epithdeia tou swmatov ti to ofelov
draft_translation: And one of you say to them, Depart in peace, be warmed and filled; notwithstanding you give them not those things which are necessary to the body; what does it profit?
ukjv_translation: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be all of you warmed and filled; notwithstanding all of you give them not those things which are necessary to the body; what does it profit?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized be-you imperative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: ουτως και η πιστις εαν μη εργα εχη νεκρα εστιν καθ εαυτην
transliteration: outwv kai h pistiv ean mh erga ech nekra estin kay eauthn
draft_translation: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.
ukjv_translation: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αλλ ερει τις συ πιστιν εχεις καγω εργα εχω δειξον μοι την πιστιν σου χωρις των εργων σου καγω δειξω σοι εκ των εργων μου την πιστιν μου
transliteration: all erei tiv su pistin eceiv kagw erga ecw deixon moi thn pistin sou cwriv twn ergwn sou kagw deixw soi ek twn ergwn mou thn pistin mou
draft_translation: Yes, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
ukjv_translation: Yea, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

greek_text: συ πιστευεις οτι ο θεος εις εστιν καλως ποιεις και τα δαιμονια πιστευουσιν και φρισσουσιν
transliteration: su pisteueiv oti o yeov eiv estin kalwv poieiv kai ta daimonia pisteuousin kai frissousin
draft_translation: You believe that there is one God; you do well: the demons also believe, and tremble.
ukjv_translation: You believe that there is one God; you do well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

greek_text: θελεις δε γνωναι ω ανθρωπε κενε οτι η πιστις χωρις των εργων νεκρα εστιν
transliteration: yeleiv de gnwnai w anyrwpe kene oti h pistiv cwriv twn ergwn nekra estin
draft_translation: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
ukjv_translation: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αβρααμ ο πατηρ ημων ουκ εξ εργων εδικαιωθη ανενεγκας ισαακ τον υιον αυτου επι το θυσιαστηριον
transliteration: abraam o pathr hmwn ouk ex ergwn edikaiwyh anenegkav isaak ton uion autou epi to yusiasthrion
draft_translation: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
ukjv_translation: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: βλεπεις οτι η πιστις συνηργει τοις εργοις αυτου και εκ των εργων η πιστις ετελειωθη
transliteration: blepeiv oti h pistiv sunhrgei toiv ergoiv autou kai ek twn ergwn h pistiv eteleiwyh
draft_translation: See you how faith worked with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
ukjv_translation: See you how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

greek_text: και επληρωθη η γραφη η λεγουσα επιστευσεν δε αβρααμ τω θεω και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην και φιλος θεου εκληθη
transliteration: kai eplhrwyh h grafh h legousa episteusen de abraam tw yew kai elogisyh autw eiv dikaiosunhn kai filov yeou eklhyh
draft_translation: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed to him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
ukjv_translation: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

greek_text: ορατε τοινυν οτι εξ εργων δικαιουται ανθρωπος και ουκ εκ πιστεως μονον
transliteration: orate toinun oti ex ergwn dikaioutai anyrwpov kai ouk ek pistewv monon
draft_translation: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
ukjv_translation: All of you see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

greek_text: ομοιως δε και ρααβ η πορνη ουκ εξ εργων εδικαιωθη υποδεξαμενη τους αγγελους και ετερα οδω εκβαλουσα
transliteration: omoiwv de kai raab h pornh ouk ex ergwn edikaiwyh upodexamenh touv aggelouv kai etera odw ekbalousa
draft_translation: Likewise also was not Rahab the prostitute justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
ukjv_translation: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

greek_text: ωσπερ γαρ το σωμα χωρις πνευματος νεκρον εστιν ουτως και η πιστις χωρις των εργων νεκρα εστιν
transliteration: wsper gar to swma cwriv pneumatov nekron estin outwv kai h pistiv cwriv twn ergwn nekra estin
draft_translation: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
ukjv_translation: For as the body without the spirit (o. pneuma) is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: μη πολλοι διδασκαλοι γινεσθε αδελφοι μου ειδοτες οτι μειζον κριμα ληψομεθα
transliteration: mh polloi didaskaloi ginesye adelfoi mou eidotev oti meizon krima lhqomeya
draft_translation: My brothers, be not many teachers, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
ukjv_translation: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
review_notes: rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers; rendered didaskalos as teacher

greek_text: πολλα γαρ πταιομεν απαντες ει τις εν λογω ου πταιει ουτος τελειος ανηρ δυνατος χαλιναγωγησαι και ολον το σωμα
transliteration: polla gar ptaiomen apantev ei tiv en logw ou ptaiei outov teleiov anhr dunatov calinagwghsai kai olon to swma
draft_translation: For in many things we offend all. If anyone offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
ukjv_translation: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, (o. logos) the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: ιδου των ιππων τους χαλινους εις τα στοματα βαλλομεν προς το πειθεσθαι αυτους ημιν και ολον το σωμα αυτων μεταγομεν
transliteration: idou twn ippwn touv calinouv eiv ta stomata ballomen prov to peiyesyai autouv hmin kai olon to swma autwn metagomen
draft_translation: Look, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
ukjv_translation: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

greek_text: ιδου και τα πλοια τηλικαυτα οντα και υπο σκληρων ανεμων ελαυνομενα μεταγεται υπο ελαχιστου πηδαλιου οπου αν η ορμη του ευθυνοντος βουληται
transliteration: idou kai ta ploia thlikauta onta kai upo sklhrwn anemwn elaunomena metagetai upo elacistou phdaliou opou an h ormh tou euyunontov boulhtai
draft_translation: Look also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, anywhere the governor decides.
ukjv_translation: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, anywhere the governor decides.

greek_text: ουτως και η γλωσσα μικρον μελος εστιν και μεγαλαυχει ιδου ολιγον πυρ ηλικην υλην αναπτει
transliteration: outwv kai h glwssa mikron melov estin kai megalaucei idou oligon pur hlikhn ulhn anaptei
draft_translation: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. Look, how great a matter a little fire kindles!
ukjv_translation: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindles!

greek_text: και η γλωσσα πυρ ο κοσμος της αδικιας ουτως η γλωσσα καθισταται εν τοις μελεσιν ημων η σπιλουσα ολον το σωμα και φλογιζουσα τον τροχον της γενεσεως και φλογιζομενη υπο της γεεννης
transliteration: kai h glwssa pur o kosmov thv adikiav outwv h glwssa kayistatai en toiv melesin hmwn h spilousa olon to swma kai flogizousa ton trocon thv genesewv kai flogizomenh upo thv geennhv
draft_translation: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of Gehenna.
ukjv_translation: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

greek_text: πασα γαρ φυσις θηριων τε και πετεινων ερπετων τε και εναλιων δαμαζεται και δεδαμασται τη φυσει τη ανθρωπινη
transliteration: pasa gar fusiv yhriwn te kai peteinwn erpetwn te kai enaliwn damazetai kai dedamastai th fusei th anyrwpinh
draft_translation: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:
ukjv_translation: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: την δε γλωσσαν ουδεις δυναται ανθρωπων δαμασαι ακατασχετον κακον μεστη ιου θανατηφορου
transliteration: thn de glwssan oudeiv dunatai anyrwpwn damasai akatasceton kakon mesth iou yanathforou
draft_translation: But the tongue can no one tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
ukjv_translation: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

greek_text: εν αυτη ευλογουμεν τον θεον και πατερα και εν αυτη καταρωμεθα τους ανθρωπους τους καθ ομοιωσιν θεου γεγονοτας
transliteration: en auth eulogoumen ton yeon kai patera kai en auth katarwmeya touv anyrwpouv touv kay omoiwsin yeou gegonotav
draft_translation: with it we bless God, even the Father; and with it we curse men, who are made after the likeness of God.
ukjv_translation: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the embodiment of God.
review_notes: modernized personal which as who; modernized therewith word order; rendered homoioma as likeness

greek_text: εκ του αυτου στοματος εξερχεται ευλογια και καταρα ου χρη αδελφοι μου ταυτα ουτως γινεσθαι
transliteration: ek tou autou stomatov exercetai eulogia kai katara ou crh adelfoi mou tauta outwv ginesyai
draft_translation: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not so to be.
ukjv_translation: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

greek_text: μητι η πηγη εκ της αυτης οπης βρυει το γλυκυ και το πικρον
transliteration: mhti h phgh ek thv authv ophv bruei to gluku kai to pikron
draft_translation: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

greek_text: διο μαλλον αδελφοι σπουδασατε βεβαιαν υμων την κλησιν και εκλογην ποιεισθαι ταυτα γαρ ποιουντες ου μη πταισητε ποτε

greek_text: ουτως γαρ πλουσιως επιχορηγηθησεται υμιν η εισοδος εις την αιωνιον βασιλειαν του κυριου ημων και σωτηρος ιησου χριστου

greek_text: διο ουκ αμελησω υμας αει υπομιμνησκειν περι τουτων καιπερ ειδοτας και εστηριγμενους εν τη παρουση αληθεια

draft_translation: Yes, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
ukjv_translation: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

greek_text: ειδως οτι ταχινη εστιν η αποθεσις του σκηνωματος μου καθως και ο κυριος ημων ιησους χριστος εδηλωσεν μοι
transliteration: eidwv oti tacinh estin h apoyesiv tou skhnwmatov mou kaywv kai o kuriov hmwn ihsouv cristov edhlwsen moi
draft_translation: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me.
ukjv_translation: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me.

draft_translation: Moreover I will endeavour that you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
ukjv_translation: Moreover I will endeavour that all of you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

greek_text: ου γαρ σεσοφισμενοις μυθοις εξακολουθησαντες εγνωρισαμεν υμιν την του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου δυναμιν και παρουσιαν αλλ εποπται γενηθεντες της εκεινου μεγαλειοτητος
transliteration: ou gar sesofismenoiv muyoiv exakolouyhsantev egnwrisamen umin thn tou kuriou hmwn ihsou cristou dunamin kai parousian all epoptai genhyentev thv ekeinou megaleiothtov
draft_translation: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

draft_translation: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
ukjv_translation: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

greek_text: και ταυτην την φωνην ημεις ηκουσαμεν εξ ουρανου ενεχθεισαν συν αυτω οντες εν τω ορει τω αγιω
transliteration: kai tauthn thn fwnhn hmeiv hkousamen ex ouranou enecyeisan sun autw ontev en tw orei tw agiw
draft_translation: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

greek_text: και εχομεν βεβαιοτερον τον προφητικον λογον ω καλως ποιειτε προσεχοντες ως λυχνω φαινοντι εν αυχμηρω τοπω εως ου ημερα διαυγαση και φωσφορος ανατειλη εν ταις καρδιαις υμων

transliteration: ou gar yelhmati anyrwpou hnecyh pote profhteia all upo pneumatov agiou feromenoi elalhsan agioi yeou anyrwpoi
draft_translation: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

transliteration: egenonto de kai qeudoprofhtai en tw law wv kai en umin esontai qeudodidaskaloi oitinev pareisaxousin aireseiv apwleiav kai ton agorasanta autouv despothn arnoumenoi epagontev eautoiv tacinhn apwleian

draft_translation: And in greed they will exploit you with fabricated words: whose judgment from long ago does not linger, and their destruction does not slumber.

ukjv_translation: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

ukjv_translation: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Arrogant are they, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

draft_translation: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: a heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
ukjv_translation: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

draft_translation: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved forever.
ukjv_translation: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

greek_text: υπερογκα γαρ ματαιοτητος φθεγγομενοι δελεαζουσιν εν επιθυμιαις σαρκος εν ασελγειαις τους οντως αποφυγοντας τους εν πλανη αναστρεφομενους

ukjv_translation: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

draft_translation: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the slaves of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
ukjv_translation: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

greek_text: ει γαρ αποφυγοντες τα μιασματα του κοσμου εν επιγνωσει του κυριου και σωτηρος ιησου χριστου τουτοις δε παλιν εμπλακεντες ηττωνται γεγονεν αυτοις τα εσχατα χειρονα των πρωτων

draft_translation: But it is happened to them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

draft_translation: This second epistle, beloved, I now write to you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
ukjv_translation: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

draft_translation: That you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Savior:

greek_text: εν δε τουτο μη λανθανετω υμας αγαπητοι οτι μια ημερα παρα κυριω ως χιλια ετη και χιλια ετη ως ημερα μια

draft_translation: But, beloved, do not be ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

greek_text: ου βραδυνει ο κυριος της επαγγελιας ως τινες βραδυτητα ηγουνται αλλα μακροθυμει εις ημας μη βουλομενος τινας απολεσθαι αλλα παντας εις μετανοιαν χωρησαι
transliteration: ou bradunei o kuriov thv epaggeliav wv tinev braduthta hgountai alla makroyumei eiv hmav mh boulomenov tinav apolesyai alla pantav eiv metanoian cwrhsai
draft_translation: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering toward us, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
ukjv_translation: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering toward us, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

greek_text: ηξει δε η ημερα κυριου ως κλεπτης εν νυκτι εν η οι ουρανοι ροιζηδον παρελευσονται στοιχεια δε καυσουμενα λυθησονται και γη και τα εν αυτη εργα κατακαησεται
transliteration: hxei de h hmera kuriou wv klepthv en nukti en h oi ouranoi roizhdon pareleusontai stoiceia de kausoumena luyhsontai kai gh kai ta en auth erga katakahsetai
draft_translation: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are in it shall be burned up.
ukjv_translation: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

draft_translation: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought you to be in all holy conduct and godliness,
ukjv_translation: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought all of you to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

greek_text: προσδοκωντας και σπευδοντας την παρουσιαν της του θεου ημερας δι ην ουρανοι πυρουμενοι λυθησονται και στοιχεια καυσουμενα τηκεται
transliteration: prosdokwntav kai speudontav thn parousian thv tou yeou hmerav di hn ouranoi puroumenoi luyhsontai kai stoiceia kausoumena thketai
draft_translation: Looking for and hasting to the coming of the day of God, in which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
ukjv_translation: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized wherein

greek_text: καινους δε ουρανους και γην καινην κατα το επαγγελμα αυτου προσδοκωμεν εν οις δικαιοσυνη κατοικει
transliteration: kainouv de ouranouv kai ghn kainhn kata to epaggelma autou prosdokwmen en oiv dikaiosunh katoikei
draft_translation: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, in which dwells righteousness.
ukjv_translation: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness.

greek_text: διο αγαπητοι ταυτα προσδοκωντες σπουδασατε ασπιλοι και αμωμητοι αυτω ευρεθηναι εν ειρηνη
transliteration: dio agaphtoi tauta prosdokwntev spoudasate aspiloi kai amwmhtoi autw eureyhnai en eirhnh
draft_translation: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for such things, be diligent that you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
ukjv_translation: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that all of you look for such things, be diligent that all of you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
review_notes: modernized wherefore; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και την του κυριου ημων μακροθυμιαν σωτηριαν ηγεισθε καθως και ο αγαπητος ημων αδελφος παυλος κατα την αυτω δοθεισαν σοφιαν εγραψεν υμιν
transliteration: kai thn tou kuriou hmwn makroyumian swthrian hgeisye kaywv kai o agaphtov hmwn adelfov paulov kata thn autw doyeisan sofian egraqen umin
draft_translation: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given to him has written to you;
ukjv_translation: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him has written unto you;
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ως και εν πασαις ταις επιστολαις λαλων εν αυταις περι τουτων εν οις εστιν δυσνοητα τινα α οι αμαθεις και αστηρικτοι στρεβλουσιν ως και τας λοιπας γραφας προς την ιδιαν αυτων απωλειαν
transliteration: wv kai en pasaiv taiv epistolaiv lalwn en autaiv peri toutwn en oiv estin dusnohta tina a oi amayeiv kai asthriktoi streblousin wv kai tav loipav grafav prov thn idian autwn apwleian
draft_translation: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which those who are unlearned and unstable shift, as they do also the other scriptures, to their own destruction.
ukjv_translation: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable shift, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized they-that relative

greek_text: υμεις ουν αγαπητοι προγινωσκοντες φυλασσεσθε ινα μη τη των αθεσμων πλανη συναπαχθεντες εκπεσητε του ιδιου στηριγμου
transliteration: umeiv oun agaphtoi proginwskontev fulassesye ina mh th twn ayesmwn planh sunapacyentev ekpeshte tou idiou sthrigmou
draft_translation: You therefore, beloved, seeing you know these things before, beware lest you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own steadfastness.
ukjv_translation: All of you therefore, beloved, seeing all of you know these things before, beware lest all of you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own steadfastness.

greek_text: αυξανετε δε εν χαριτι και γνωσει του κυριου ημων και σωτηρος ιησου χριστου αυτω η δοξα και νυν και εις ημεραν αιωνος αμην
transliteration: auxanete de en cariti kai gnwsei tou kuriou hmwn kai swthrov ihsou cristou autw h doxa kai nun kai eiv hmeran aiwnov amhn
draft_translation: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever. Amen.
ukjv_translation: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
review_notes: modernized Saviour spelling; modernized forever spelling; normalized NT kurios as Lord

greek_text: ο ην απ αρχης ο ακηκοαμεν ο εωρακαμεν τοις οφθαλμοις ημων ο εθεασαμεθα και αι χειρες ημων εψηλαφησαν περι του λογου της ζωης
transliteration: o hn ap archv o akhkoamen o ewrakamen toiv ofyalmoiv hmwn o eyeasameya kai ai ceirev hmwn eqhlafhsan peri tou logou thv zwhv
draft_translation: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
ukjv_translation: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word (o. logos) of life;
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και η ζωη εφανερωθη και εωρακαμεν και μαρτυρουμεν και απαγγελλομεν υμιν την ζωην την αιωνιον ητις ην προς τον πατερα και εφανερωθη ημιν
transliteration: kai h zwh efanerwyh kai ewrakamen kai marturoumen kai apaggellomen umin thn zwhn thn aiwnion htiv hn prov ton patera kai efanerwyh hmin
draft_translation: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and show to you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested to us;)
ukjv_translation: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and show unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

greek_text: ο εωρακαμεν και ακηκοαμεν απαγγελλομεν υμιν ινα και υμεις κοινωνιαν εχητε μεθ ημων και η κοινωνια δε η ημετερα μετα του πατρος και μετα του υιου αυτου ιησου χριστου
transliteration: o ewrakamen kai akhkoamen apaggellomen umin ina kai umeiv koinwnian echte mey hmwn kai h koinwnia de h hmetera meta tou patrov kai meta tou uiou autou ihsou cristou
draft_translation: That which we have seen and heard declare we to you, that you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
ukjv_translation: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that all of you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

draft_translation: And these things write we to you, that your joy may be full.
ukjv_translation: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

greek_text: και αυτη εστιν η αγγελια ην ακηκοαμεν απ αυτου και αναγγελλομεν υμιν οτι ο θεος φως εστιν και σκοτια εν αυτω ουκ εστιν ουδεμια

draft_translation: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
ukjv_translation: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

draft_translation: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
ukjv_translation: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

transliteration: ean de en tw fwti peripatwmen wv autov estin en tw fwti koinwnian ecomen met allhlwn kai to aima ihsou cristou tou uiou autou kayarizei hmav apo pashv amartiav
draft_translation: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

draft_translation: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
ukjv_translation: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εαν ομολογωμεν τας αμαρτιας ημων πιστος εστιν και δικαιος ινα αφη ημιν τας αμαρτιας και καθαριση ημας απο πασης αδικιας
transliteration: ean omologwmen tav amartiav hmwn pistov estin kai dikaiov ina afh hmin tav amartiav kai kayarish hmav apo pashv adikiav
draft_translation: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

transliteration: ean eipwmen oti ouc hmarthkamen qeusthn poioumen auton kai o logov autou ouk estin en hmin
draft_translation: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
ukjv_translation: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word (o. logos) is not in us.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: τεκνια μου ταυτα γραφω υμιν ινα μη αμαρτητε και εαν τις αμαρτη παρακλητον εχομεν προς τον πατερα ιησουν χριστον δικαιον
transliteration: teknia mou tauta grafw umin ina mh amarthte kai ean tiv amarth paraklhton ecomen prov ton patera ihsoun criston dikaion
draft_translation: My little children, I write these things to you, that you do not sin. And if anyone sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

greek_text: και αυτος ιλασμος εστιν περι των αμαρτιων ημων ου περι των ημετερων δε μονον αλλα και περι ολου του κοσμου
transliteration: kai autov ilasmov estin peri twn amartiwn hmwn ou peri twn hmeterwn de monon alla kai peri olou tou kosmou
draft_translation: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
ukjv_translation: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for our's only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

greek_text: και εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εγνωκαμεν αυτον εαν τας εντολας αυτου τηρωμεν

draft_translation: And by this we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
ukjv_translation: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

transliteration: o legwn egnwka auton kai tav entolav autou mh thrwn qeusthv estin kai en toutw h alhyeia ouk estin
draft_translation: the one who says, I know him, and does not keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
ukjv_translation: He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized keeps-not wording

greek_text: ος δ αν τηρη αυτου τον λογον αληθως εν τουτω η αγαπη του θεου τετελειωται εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εν αυτω εσμεν
transliteration: ov d an thrh autou ton logon alhywv en toutw h agaph tou yeou teteleiwtai en toutw ginwskomen oti en autw esmen
draft_translation: But whoever keeps his word, in him truly is the love of God perfected: by this know we that we are in him.
ukjv_translation: But whoso keeps his word, (o. logos) in him verily is the love (o. agape) of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

draft_translation: the one who says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
ukjv_translation: He that says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

greek_text: αδελφοι ουκ εντολην καινην γραφω υμιν αλλ εντολην παλαιαν ην ειχετε απ αρχης η εντολη η παλαια εστιν ο λογος ον ηκουσατε απ αρχης
transliteration: adelfoi ouk entolhn kainhn grafw umin all entolhn palaian hn eicete ap archv h entolh h palaia estin o logov on hkousate ap archv
draft_translation: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.
ukjv_translation: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which all of you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word (o. logos) which all of you have heard from the beginning.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: παλιν εντολην καινην γραφω υμιν ο εστιν αληθες εν αυτω και εν υμιν οτι η σκοτια παραγεται και το φως το αληθινον ηδη φαινει
transliteration: palin entolhn kainhn grafw umin o estin alhyev en autw kai en umin oti h skotia paragetai kai to fwv to alhyinon hdh fainei
draft_translation: Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shines.
ukjv_translation: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shines.

greek_text: ο λεγων εν τω φωτι ειναι και τον αδελφον αυτου μισων εν τη σκοτια εστιν εως αρτι
transliteration: o legwn en tw fwti einai kai ton adelfon autou miswn en th skotia estin ewv arti
draft_translation: the one who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.
ukjv_translation: He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.

greek_text: ο αγαπων τον αδελφον αυτου εν τω φωτι μενει και σκανδαλον εν αυτω ουκ εστιν
transliteration: o agapwn ton adelfon autou en tw fwti menei kai skandalon en autw ouk estin
draft_translation: the one who loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
ukjv_translation: He that loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

greek_text: ο δε μισων τον αδελφον αυτου εν τη σκοτια εστιν και εν τη σκοτια περιπατει και ουκ οιδεν που υπαγει οτι η σκοτια ετυφλωσεν τους οφθαλμους αυτου
transliteration: o de miswn ton adelfon autou en th skotia estin kai en th skotia peripatei kai ouk oiden pou upagei oti h skotia etuflwsen touv ofyalmouv autou
draft_translation: But the one who hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and does not know where he goes, because darkness has blinded his eyes.
ukjv_translation: But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not where he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.
review_notes: modernized because-that wording; modernized he-that relative; modernized knows-not idiom

greek_text: γραφω υμιν τεκνια οτι αφεωνται υμιν αι αμαρτιαι δια το ονομα αυτου
transliteration: grafw umin teknia oti afewntai umin ai amartiai dia to onoma autou
draft_translation: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
ukjv_translation: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

greek_text: γραφω υμιν πατερες οτι εγνωκατε τον απ αρχης γραφω υμιν νεανισκοι οτι νενικηκατε τον πονηρον γραφω υμιν παιδια οτι εγνωκατε τον πατερα
transliteration: grafw umin paterev oti egnwkate ton ap archv grafw umin neaniskoi oti nenikhkate ton ponhron grafw umin paidia oti egnwkate ton patera
draft_translation: I write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, little children, because you have known the Father.
ukjv_translation: I write unto you, fathers, because all of you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because all of you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because all of you have known the Father.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εγραψα υμιν πατερες οτι εγνωκατε τον απ αρχης εγραψα υμιν νεανισκοι οτι ισχυροι εστε και ο λογος του θεου εν υμιν μενει και νενικηκατε τον πονηρον
transliteration: egraqa umin paterev oti egnwkate ton ap archv egraqa umin neaniskoi oti iscuroi este kai o logov tou yeou en umin menei kai nenikhkate ton ponhron
draft_translation: I have written to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.
ukjv_translation: I have written unto you, fathers, because all of you have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because all of you are strong, and the word (o. logos) of God abides in you, and all of you have overcome the wicked one.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized him-that relative; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: μη αγαπατε τον κοσμον μηδε τα εν τω κοσμω εαν τις αγαπα τον κοσμον ουκ εστιν η αγαπη του πατρος εν αυτω
transliteration: mh agapate ton kosmon mhde ta en tw kosmw ean tiv agapa ton kosmon ouk estin h agaph tou patrov en autw
draft_translation: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If anyone love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
ukjv_translation: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love (o. agape) of the Father is not in him.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: οτι παν το εν τω κοσμω η επιθυμια της σαρκος και η επιθυμια των οφθαλμων και η αλαζονεια του βιου ουκ εστιν εκ του πατρος αλλ εκ του κοσμου εστιν
transliteration: oti pan to en tw kosmw h epiyumia thv sarkov kai h epiyumia twn ofyalmwn kai h alazoneia tou biou ouk estin ek tou patrov all ek tou kosmou estin
draft_translation: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
ukjv_translation: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ο κοσμος παραγεται και η επιθυμια αυτου ο δε ποιων το θελημα του θεου μενει εις τον αιωνα
transliteration: kai o kosmov paragetai kai h epiyumia autou o de poiwn to yelhma tou yeou menei eiv ton aiwna
draft_translation: And the world passes away, and the lust of it: but the one who does the will of God abides forever.
ukjv_translation: And the world passes away, and the lust thereof: but he that does the will of God abides for ever.
review_notes: modernized forever spelling; modernized he-that relative; modernized thereof

greek_text: παιδια εσχατη ωρα εστιν και καθως ηκουσατε οτι ο αντιχριστος ερχεται και νυν αντιχριστοι πολλοι γεγονασιν οθεν γινωσκομεν οτι εσχατη ωρα εστιν
transliteration: paidia escath wra estin kai kaywv hkousate oti o anticristov ercetai kai nun anticristoi polloi gegonasin oyen ginwskomen oti escath wra estin
draft_translation: Little children, it is the last time: and as you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; by which we know that it is the last time.
ukjv_translation: Little children, it is the last time: and as all of you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
review_notes: modernized whereby; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εξ ημων εξηλθον αλλ ουκ ησαν εξ ημων ει γαρ ησαν εξ ημων μεμενηκεισαν αν μεθ ημων αλλ ινα φανερωθωσιν οτι ουκ εισιν παντες εξ ημων
transliteration: ex hmwn exhlyon all ouk hsan ex hmwn ei gar hsan ex hmwn memenhkeisan an mey hmwn all ina fanerwywsin oti ouk eisin pantev ex hmwn
draft_translation: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
ukjv_translation: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

greek_text: και υμεις χρισμα εχετε απο του αγιου και οιδατε παντα
transliteration: kai umeiv crisma ecete apo tou agiou kai oidate panta
draft_translation: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.
ukjv_translation: But all of you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know all things.

greek_text: ουκ εγραψα υμιν οτι ουκ οιδατε την αληθειαν αλλ οτι οιδατε αυτην και οτι παν ψευδος εκ της αληθειας ουκ εστιν
transliteration: ouk egraqa umin oti ouk oidate thn alhyeian all oti oidate authn kai oti pan qeudov ek thv alhyeiav ouk estin
draft_translation: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
ukjv_translation: I have not written unto you because all of you know not the truth, but because all of you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized know-not idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: τις εστιν ο ψευστης ει μη ο αρνουμενος οτι ιησους ουκ εστιν ο χριστος ουτος εστιν ο αντιχριστος ο αρνουμενος τον πατερα και τον υιον
transliteration: tiv estin o qeusthv ei mh o arnoumenov oti ihsouv ouk estin o cristov outov estin o anticristov o arnoumenov ton patera kai ton uion
draft_translation: Who is a liar but the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denies the Father and the Son.
ukjv_translation: Who is a liar but he that denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denies the Father and the Son.

greek_text: πας ο αρνουμενος τον υιον ουδε τον πατερα εχει ο ομολογων τον υιον και τον πατερα εχει
transliteration: pav o arnoumenov ton uion oude ton patera ecei o omologwn ton uion kai ton patera ecei
draft_translation: Whoever denies the Son, the same has not the Father: the one who acknowledges the Son has the Father also.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever denies the Son, the same has not the Father: he that acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

greek_text: υμεις ουν ο ηκουσατε απ αρχης εν υμιν μενετω εαν εν υμιν μεινη ο απ αρχης ηκουσατε και υμεις εν τω υιω και εν τω πατρι μενειτε
transliteration: umeiv oun o hkousate ap archv en umin menetw ean en umin meinh o ap archv hkousate kai umeiv en tw uiw kai en tw patri meneite
draft_translation: Let that therefore abide in you, which you have heard from the beginning. If that which you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
ukjv_translation: Let that therefore abide in you, which all of you have heard from the beginning. If that which all of you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, all of you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

greek_text: και αυτη εστιν η επαγγελια ην αυτος επηγγειλατο ημιν την ζωην την αιωνιον
transliteration: kai auth estin h epaggelia hn autov ephggeilato hmin thn zwhn thn aiwnion
draft_translation: And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life.
ukjv_translation: And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: ταυτα εγραψα υμιν περι των πλανωντων υμας
transliteration: tauta egraqa umin peri twn planwntwn umav
draft_translation: These things have I written to you concerning those who seduce you.
ukjv_translation: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized them-that relative

greek_text: και υμεις το χρισμα ο ελαβετε απ αυτου εν υμιν μενει και ου χρειαν εχετε ινα τις διδασκη υμας αλλ ως το αυτο χρισμα διδασκει υμας περι παντων και αληθες εστιν και ουκ εστιν ψευδος και καθως εδιδαξεν υμας μενειτε εν αυτω
transliteration: kai umeiv to crisma o elabete ap autou en umin menei kai ou creian ecete ina tiv didaskh umav all wv to auto crisma didaskei umav peri pantwn kai alhyev estin kai ouk estin qeudov kai kaywv edidaxen umav meneite en autw
draft_translation: But the anointing which you have received of him abides in you, and you need not that anyone teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, you shall abide in him.
ukjv_translation: But the anointing which all of you have received of him abides in you, and all of you need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, all of you shall abide in him.
review_notes: modernized any-man idiom; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: και νυν τεκνια μενετε εν αυτω ινα οταν φανερωθη εχωμεν παρρησιαν και μη αισχυνθωμεν απ αυτου εν τη παρουσια αυτου
transliteration: kai nun teknia menete en autw ina otan fanerwyh ecwmen parrhsian kai mh aiscunywmen ap autou en th parousia autou
draft_translation: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
ukjv_translation: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: εαν ειδητε οτι δικαιος εστιν γινωσκετε οτι πας ο ποιων την δικαιοσυνην εξ αυτου γεγεννηται
transliteration: ean eidhte oti dikaiov estin ginwskete oti pav o poiwn thn dikaiosunhn ex autou gegennhtai
draft_translation: If you know that he is righteous, you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.
ukjv_translation: If all of you know that he is righteous, all of you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.

greek_text: ιδετε ποταπην αγαπην δεδωκεν ημιν ο πατηρ ινα τεκνα θεου κληθωμεν δια τουτο ο κοσμος ου γινωσκει ημας οτι ουκ εγνω αυτον
transliteration: idete potaphn agaphn dedwken hmin o pathr ina tekna yeou klhywmen dia touto o kosmov ou ginwskei hmav oti ouk egnw auton
draft_translation: Look, what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not.
ukjv_translation: Behold, what manner of love (o. agape) the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not.
review_notes: modernized behold; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: αγαπητοι νυν τεκνα θεου εσμεν και ουπω εφανερωθη τι εσομεθα οιδαμεν δε οτι εαν φανερωθη ομοιοι αυτω εσομεθα οτι οψομεθα αυτον καθως εστιν
transliteration: agaphtoi nun tekna yeou esmen kai oupw efanerwyh ti esomeya oidamen de oti ean fanerwyh omoioi autw esomeya oti oqomeya auton kaywv estin
draft_translation: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
ukjv_translation: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και πας ο εχων την ελπιδα ταυτην επ αυτω αγνιζει εαυτον καθως εκεινος αγνος εστιν
transliteration: kai pav o ecwn thn elpida tauthn ep autw agnizei eauton kaywv ekeinov agnov estin
draft_translation: And every man that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
ukjv_translation: And every man that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: πας ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν και την ανομιαν ποιει και η αμαρτια εστιν η ανομια
transliteration: pav o poiwn thn amartian kai thn anomian poiei kai h amartia estin h anomia
draft_translation: Whoever commits sin trangresses also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever commits sin trangresses also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

greek_text: και οιδατε οτι εκεινος εφανερωθη ινα τας αμαρτιας ημων αρη και αμαρτια εν αυτω ουκ εστιν
transliteration: kai oidate oti ekeinov efanerwyh ina tav amartiav hmwn arh kai amartia en autw ouk estin
draft_translation: And you know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
ukjv_translation: And all of you know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

greek_text: πας ο εν αυτω μενων ουχ αμαρτανει πας ο αμαρτανων ουχ εωρακεν αυτον ουδε εγνωκεν αυτον
transliteration: pav o en autw menwn ouc amartanei pav o amartanwn ouc ewraken auton oude egnwken auton
draft_translation: Whoever abides in him sins not: whoever sins has not seen him, neither known him.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever abides in him sins not: whosoever sins has not seen him, neither known him.

greek_text: τεκνια μηδεις πλανατω υμας ο ποιων την δικαιοσυνην δικαιος εστιν καθως εκεινος δικαιος εστιν
transliteration: teknia mhdeiv planatw umav o poiwn thn dikaiosunhn dikaiov estin kaywv ekeinov dikaiov estin
draft_translation: Little children, let no one deceive you: the one who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
ukjv_translation: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
review_notes: modernized he-that relative; modernized no-man idiom

greek_text: ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν εκ του διαβολου εστιν οτι απ αρχης ο διαβολος αμαρτανει εις τουτο εφανερωθη ο υιος του θεου ινα λυση τα εργα του διαβολου
transliteration: o poiwn thn amartian ek tou diabolou estin oti ap archv o diabolov amartanei eiv touto efanerwyh o uiov tou yeou ina lush ta erga tou diabolou
draft_translation: the one who commits sin is of the devil; for the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
ukjv_translation: He that commits sin is of the devil; for the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

greek_text: πας ο γεγεννημενος εκ του θεου αμαρτιαν ου ποιει οτι σπερμα αυτου εν αυτω μενει και ου δυναται αμαρτανειν οτι εκ του θεου γεγεννηται
transliteration: pav o gegennhmenov ek tou yeou amartian ou poiei oti sperma autou en autw menei kai ou dunatai amartanein oti ek tou yeou gegennhtai
draft_translation: Whoever is born of God does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever is born of God does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

greek_text: εν τουτω φανερα εστιν τα τεκνα του θεου και τα τεκνα του διαβολου πας ο μη ποιων δικαιοσυνην ουκ εστιν εκ του θεου και ο μη αγαπων τον αδελφον αυτου
transliteration: en toutw fanera estin ta tekna tou yeou kai ta tekna tou diabolou pav o mh poiwn dikaiosunhn ouk estin ek tou yeou kai o mh agapwn ton adelfon autou
draft_translation: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whoever does not do righteousness is not of God, neither the one who does not love his brother.
ukjv_translation: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loves not his brother.
review_notes: fixed do-righteousness wording; modernized he-that relative; modernized loves-not wording; modernized whosoever

greek_text: οτι αυτη εστιν η αγγελια ην ηκουσατε απ αρχης ινα αγαπωμεν αλληλους
transliteration: oti auth estin h aggelia hn hkousate ap archv ina agapwmen allhlouv
draft_translation: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
ukjv_translation: For this is the message that all of you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

greek_text: ου καθως καιν εκ του πονηρου ην και εσφαξεν τον αδελφον αυτου και χαριν τινος εσφαξεν αυτον οτι τα εργα αυτου πονηρα ην τα δε του αδελφου αυτου δικαια
transliteration: ou kaywv kain ek tou ponhrou hn kai esfaxen ton adelfon autou kai carin tinov esfaxen auton oti ta erga autou ponhra hn ta de tou adelfou autou dikaia
draft_translation: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and killed his brother. And therefore killed he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
ukjv_translation: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

greek_text: μη θαυμαζετε αδελφοι μου ει μισει υμας ο κοσμος
transliteration: mh yaumazete adelfoi mou ei misei umav o kosmov
draft_translation: do not marvel, my brothers, if the world hate you.
ukjv_translation: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
review_notes: modernized marvel-not idiom; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ημεις οιδαμεν οτι μεταβεβηκαμεν εκ του θανατου εις την ζωην οτι αγαπωμεν τους αδελφους ο μη αγαπων τον αδελφον μενει εν τω θανατω
transliteration: hmeiv oidamen oti metabebhkamen ek tou yanatou eiv thn zwhn oti agapwmen touv adelfouv o mh agapwn ton adelfon menei en tw yanatw
draft_translation: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brothers. the one who does not love his brother abides in death.
ukjv_translation: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.
review_notes: modernized archaic directional unto; modernized he-that relative; modernized loves-not wording; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: πας ο μισων τον αδελφον αυτου ανθρωποκτονος εστιν και οιδατε οτι πας ανθρωποκτονος ουκ εχει ζωην αιωνιον εν αυτω μενουσαν
transliteration: pav o miswn ton adelfon autou anyrwpoktonov estin kai oidate oti pav anyrwpoktonov ouk ecei zwhn aiwnion en autw menousan
draft_translation: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
ukjv_translation: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and all of you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
review_notes: modernized whosoever; removed UKJV plural-expansion artifact

greek_text: εν τουτω εγνωκαμεν την αγαπην του θεου οτι εκεινος υπερ ημων την ψυχην αυτου εθηκεν και ημεις οφειλομεν υπερ των αδελφων τας ψυχας τιθεναι
transliteration: en toutw egnwkamen thn agaphn tou yeou oti ekeinov uper hmwn thn quchn autou eyhken kai hmeiv ofeilomen uper twn adelfwn tav qucav tiyenai
draft_translation: by this perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
ukjv_translation: Hereby perceive we the love (o. agape) of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
review_notes: modernized hereby; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered adelphoi-family wording as brothers

greek_text: ος δ αν εχη τον βιον του κοσμου και θεωρη τον αδελφον αυτου χρειαν εχοντα και κλειση τα σπλαγχνα αυτου απ αυτου πως η αγαπη του θεου μενει εν αυτω
transliteration: ov d an ech ton bion tou kosmou kai yewrh ton adelfon autou creian econta kai kleish ta splagcna autou ap autou pwv h agaph tou yeou menei en autw
draft_translation: But whoever has this world's good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his compassion from him, how dwells the love of God in him?
ukjv_translation: But whoso has this world's good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwells the love (o. agape) of God in him?
review_notes: modernized whoso; removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker; rendered splanchna compassion idiom

greek_text: τεκνια μου μη αγαπωμεν λογω μηδε γλωσση αλλ εργω και αληθεια
transliteration: teknia mou mh agapwmen logw mhde glwssh all ergw kai alhyeia
draft_translation: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
ukjv_translation: My little children, let us not love in word, (o. logos) neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
review_notes: removed UKJV inline Strong-style lexical marker

greek_text: και εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εκ της αληθειας εσμεν και εμπροσθεν αυτου πεισομεν τας καρδιας ημων
transliteration: kai en toutw ginwskomen oti ek thv alhyeiav esmen kai emprosyen autou peisomen tav kardiav hmwn
draft_translation: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
ukjv_translation: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

greek_text: οτι εαν καταγινωσκη ημων η καρδια οτι μειζων εστιν ο θεος της καρδιας ημων και γινωσκει παντα
transliteration: oti ean kataginwskh hmwn h kardia oti meizwn estin o yeov thv kardiav hmwn kai ginwskei panta
draft_translation: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
ukjv_translation: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: αγαπητοι εαν η καρδια ημων μη καταγινωσκη ημων παρρησιαν εχομεν προς τον θεον
transliteration: agaphtoi ean h kardia hmwn mh kataginwskh hmwn parrhsian ecomen prov ton yeon
draft_translation: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
ukjv_translation: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
review_notes: UKJV seed retained; needs focused Greek review

greek_text: και ο εαν αιτωμεν λαμβανομεν παρ αυτου οτι τας εντολας αυτου τηρουμεν και τα αρεστα ενωπιον αυτου ποιουμεν
